title: Perkara 1000
overview: seseorang yang menghadapi persoalan tentang uang seribuan di kehidupannya

title: Mereka Benar-Benar Ada
overview: A proof that supernatural beings exist. We do not need to see them or hear their voices. Through our voices, we can know that they are real and that they truly exist

title: Bandits of Batavia
overview: Adapted from comicbook with the same title, set in Batavia that follows the rebellion of outlaws against the Dutch colonizers, led by figures like Si Pitung.

title: Merah Putih: One for All Live Action
originalTitle: Merah Putih: One for All Live Action
overview: Plot under wraps.

title: So Happy It Hurts
overview: Lena wants to be famous at last. Since her acting career isn't exactly taking off, the reality show "Dream Weddings" is her only hope. She even flies all the way to Bali to marry her boyfriend David in style. But then reality sets in: the wedding venue they booked is a scam. Instead of luxurious surroundings, they end up in a mysterious jungle commune where nothing is as it seems.

title: Minal Aidin Mohon Maaf Minta Rizki
originalTitle: Minal Aidin Mohon Maaf Minta Rizki

title: Silent Talk of Paupers
overview: On a quiet night at a bus stop, Tito (35), a snack vendor, strikes up a conversation with Toni (25), who has just returned from a job hunt. Joined by Tono (26), an exhausted worker returning from overtime, the three men share their frustrations about work and the struggles of everyday life.

title: Jerat
overview: Plot under wraps.

title: Bara & Hutan Rahasia
overview: Bara is a pampered child with a super-protective mother, while his father is an adventurous soul who works as a motorcycle mechanic. One day, without his mother’s knowledge, Bara’s father signs him up for a camping trip in the forest. While camping, Bara wanders away from the group and meets some new friends. Their adventure soon turns into a tense situation as they encounter a series of unexpected events that put their courage and teamwork to the test.

title: Sebelum Tiga Puluh
overview: Presents stories of people’s lives before the age of thirty. Dreams, life’s pressures, and the choices that often come our way—we all go through them, a process of struggling, doubting, falling, and then getting back up again.

title: Merah Sebelum Fajar
overview: Amidst the volatile dawn of Indonesian independence, five individuals from starkly contrasting socio-political backgrounds must navigate a heavily fractured nation to deliver a critical state document, confronting severe hostility and paranoia from the very revolutionary factions they seek to serve.

title: Harga Teman
overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

title: Berbagi Suami 2.0
overview: Three women, three separated families. A film about divided love, fractured relationships, and lives that must be pieced back together.

title: Masih Ada Jalan
overview: Plot under wraps

title: 23 Detik
overview: Wishnu (Pangeran Lantang) sudah lama membujuk ibunya, Sutji (Sutjiati Narendra), agar merestui pilihan hidupnya menjadi petarung pro. Sutji sendiri masih trauma kehilangan suami dan putra sulungnya, dalam bencana Tsunami di pantai Phuket, Thailand. Karir tarung Wishnu bersilang jalan dengan petarung asal Thailand, Somchit (Achilleur Ralli). Somchit berambisi menjadi juara dunia Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) karena ingin membalas budi ayah angkatnya. Di luar dugaan, memori traumatik masa kecil Somchit bangkit kembali di ring pertarungan.

title: Zona Merah
overview: Virus merebak di kota Rimbalaya. Orang-orang terjangkit, dan jadi mayit. Maya (Aghny Haque) adalah penyintas yang bertahan hidup bersama adik dan orang-orang terdekatnya di kamp pengungsian. Namun, wabah mayit pun mengacau kamp tersebut. Mereka harus kabur dan mempertahankan nyawa, baik dari serangan mayit maupun orang-orang yang mencurigai mereka juga sudah terinfeksi.  Kemelut politik yang memanas, dan disinformasi yang disebar untuk menenangkan masyarakat juga semakin memperkeruh suasana. Akankah Maya dan kelompoknya mendapat pertolongan untuk segera keluar dari zona merah?

title: Banyak Anak Banyak Rejeki yang Harus Dicari
originalTitle: Banyak Anak Banyak Rejeki yang Harus Dicari
overview: Gravedigger Babe Rojali lives in poverty with his wife Siti Juleha and their three children. During a heavy rain, as he was busy bailing out water from his leaky house, a neighborhood watchman arrived and asked him to dig a grave that night, at the request of the neighborhood head. Reluctantly, he set out, accompanied by his younger brother Abdul. While digging the grave, Babe Rojali prayed and asked God to make him rich. That prayer seemed to be answered because he later found a lump of gold in the ground of the grave he had dug. From that moment on, Babe Rojali’s life changed completely.

title: Ibra Menembus Langit
overview: Before entering the Islamic boarding school, Ibra's teenage life changes drastically after a traumatic event hits his family. Trapped in a vortex of anger and deep loss, Ibra must endure a heavy emotional journey to make peace with destiny. Supported by his family and friends, Ibra struggles to heal his inner wounds and rediscover his purpose in life.

title: Gak Masuk Akal
overview: Three young men are trying to find work. However, because it’s so hard to make a living, they’ve taken an unusual path by opening a shamanic practice. Amid these mind-boggling economic conditions, there are still things that make life even more… absurd.

title: Ningsih: Dendam Arwah Penghuni Pabrik
overview: Based on Novel by Teguh Faluvie.

title: Ben dan Memori Akhir Musim Panas
originalTitle: Ben dan Memori Akhir Musim Panas
overview: Menjelang keberangkatannya ke luar negeri, Ben, seorang remaja laki-laki berusia 14 tahun, menemukan walkman milik Erik, sahabat lamanya yang sudah lama tidak ia temui. Walkman tersebut memicu kenangan dalam bentuk rekaman suara tentang kedekatan mereka, yang kemudian membawanya pada memori memilukan saat hilangnya sang sahabat secara tiba-tiba

title: Beneran Horor
overview: Joe, a film director, is shooting a horror movie on a remote island with his crew. A critical error, however, leads them to the wrong location—a mysterious territory inhabited by creatures that should never be disturbed. When Joe finds himself in need of extras, the crew encounters these "inhabitants," mistakenly believing they were summoned by Opie. Unsuspecting, the crew treats the creatures just like ordinary extras—until the situation takes a turn that is both tense and absurd.

title: Filosofi Teras
overview: Nea (Sherina Munaf) tulang punggung keluarga untuk ibunya; Ratih (Lydia Kandau), adiknya Runi (Zee Asadel), dan juga kakaknya Abi (Rangga Nattra) serta istrinya.  Mendiang ayah mereka menjadikan rumahnya sebagai jaminan utang. Nea mengupayakan segala cara untuk membayarnya meskipun ia menyakiti orang yang ia sayangi.  Namun, semakin keras Nea berusaha, semakin banyak pula masalah yang ia tidak bisa kendalikan. Bisakah Nea merelakan dan menyadari ia tidak bisa mengontrol semuanya?

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Datang Akan Pergi
overview: Four friends, Bara, Rafa, David and Momon celebrated their school farewell together. However, what if that togetherness turns out to be the last time?

title: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan
originalTitle: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan
overview: Four content creator friends—Raka, Naya, Kevin, and Bima—who love exploring horror, decide to visit a mysterious building known as the Three-Story Building, a building without doors, windows, or rooms that stands in the middle of a rice paddy. With their cameras as witnesses, they intend to prove that the haunted stories circulating are just myths.  However, from the moment they enter the building, various illogical events begin to haunt them. Mysterious voices, a dark figure visible only through the camera, and illusions of space and time trap them in an inexplicable terror. When the exit seemingly disappears and the footage begins to show a different reality, they realize that something has been watching them from the beginning.  ARSI 07: Unpublished Footage is a mockumentary and found footage horror film that creates suspense through seemingly real footage, with an ending that leaves the question: did they really escape, or have they become part of the archives forever lost?

title: Beneath the Still Water
overview: film ini bercerita tentang

title: Desember Jani
overview: Sepuluh hari setelah Julia pergi dari rumah tanpa pamit, Jani (13 tahun) cuma ingin kakaknya itu pulang. Ia tahu ibunya, Winnie, adalah penyebab Julia pergi. Hubungan mereka makin renggang, sementara Winnie sibuk bekerja untuk menutupi rasa bersalahnya. Hanya Oma yang bisa menghibur Jani. Diam-diam, Jani masih berhubungan dengan Julia. Selama empat hari di bulan Desember, Jani harus memilih: tetap diam atau menghadapi ibunya.

title: Pok Ame Ame
overview: Tells the story of a child who was left in a disabled state after a brutal murder killed her entire family while on vacation at a villa. After that, the girl suddenly gained mystical powers and made her seek revenge against everyone who was considered to be related to the murder case, including the teenagers, one of whom turned out to be the killer.

title: Sara
overview: Sara, a transgender woman goes back to her remote hometown to attend her father’s funeral. She finds the village has changed greatly, and that the villagers have become extremely religious. Added to that, her mother suffers from dementia and treats her like a complete stranger.

title: First Responders
overview: In the near future, ASTY, an AI, dispatches two First Responders to stop a man’s suicide attempt, detected through a voice chat. Racing against time, they have to follow ASTY’s precise orders even with a life at stake. This is just another case for the Senior Responder (Kimmy) but for the Junior Responder (Haris), something doesn’t add up

title: Bintang Fajar
overview: 12-year-old Danika secretly learns to fish from her late father’s friend, hoping to prove to her mother that she can help support their family and remain close to her father. But as she faces the harsh reality of life at sea, Danika begins to understand the sacrifices her mother has made to raise her alone. She must choose between holding on to her father’s memory and protecting the only family she has left.

title: Comma (,)
overview: Biru is an artist who no longer wants to create, haunted by a blank canvas she cannot face. One day, she awakens in an unfamiliar world with the canvas beside her, encountering mysterious figures who challenge her beliefs and leave scars upon the canvass she fiercely protects. But as a world on the brink of collapse pulls her deeper into despair, one question remains: is there still a reason to create?

title: Ratu Petaka
overview: Behind the glitz and glamour of the Ratu Indonesia pageant, five beauty queen contestants harbor a dark secret: they are responsible for the death of a fellow contestant—a tragedy brought about by the bullying they inflicted upon her just before the grand final. To protect their reputations, they buried Mia’s body and vowed to keep the truth hidden. But following their victory, a mysterious terror begins to haunt them, one by one. The crowns they earned mark the beginning of their undoing—the consequence of their own actions.

title: Larut
overview: A pub guitarist spends his days with his wife, and his nights entertaining strangers. Though skilled at performing, he often finds himself lost in silence. One night, that man realizes how to play not just for others, but for himself.

title: Fatima
overview: Fatima, seorang peruqyah muda yang kehilangan keberanian setelah tragedi kesurupan masal di sekolah, berusaha menjauhi kasus-kasus berbahaya. Namun ketika diminta membantu Raina, seorang gadis yang diduga kerasukan, Fatima justru terseret ke dalam misteri yang lebih gelap. Di tengah gangguan gaib yang semakin mengancam, Fatima menyadari ia harus menghadapi ketakutan dan keraguan yang selama ini ia hindari.

title: 3726 MDPL
overview: For four years, Rangga only dared to greet Andini through a phone screen. Mount Rinjani and its 3,726-meter peak become witnesses to his courage as he finally confesses the sincerity of his feelings. Andini welcomes his love, but behind her smile, doubt lingers. Bintang, the ex-boyfriend who once caused her deepest heartbreak, returns with regret, a changed attitude, and a declaration of love that is just as sincere. Along a climbing trail that tests both body and mind, Andini faces the biggest question of her life: move forward with someone new, or turn back to resolve the unfinished memories of the past?

title: Keluarga Tak Berencana
overview: When her mother falls ill, Gendis—a successful HR consultant—returns home furious. She resents her father, Sanca, a simple mechanic she blames for being absent during her childhood, and decides to take her mother away from him. However, Rima’s wish to bring them together forces Sanca to go to Jakarta, risking a massive secret from his past.

title: Yang Datang dan Yang Pergi
overview: Sinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo), the only daughter of Hartini (Retno Soetarto), inherits the family’s old Wiryo Guest House, a place that holds many memories from the past to the present. Amid the comings and goings of guests, Sinta is reunited with Banawan (Roy Sungkono), her childhood friend and the man she once loved. However, the presence of several other male guests brings with it hope, love, and betrayal, which slowly drag Sinta and her family into various problems.

title: Hajatan Setan
overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

title: Meja Tanpa Laci
overview: This film highlights the life of a young police officer named Dipa, who chooses to remain honest amid a bureaucracy that has long been accustomed to bribery practices.

title: Aisha, On the Day She Blooms
originalTitle: Aisha, On the Day She Blooms
overview: On the verge of her Ratoh Jaroe dance debut, a passionate female student's dream to perform is jeopardized when she must prove her irregular period is real after being accused of lying during a school-mandated menstruation raid.

title: I Saw Her in Motion
overview: The lingering echoes of Ratna Asmara and Kay Mander in 1950s Indonesia, during the early years of independence. Drawing on footage from classic Indonesian films, it moves through memory and the archive to restore their obscured presence, reimagining Indonesian cinema and rewriting film history through women’s eyes.

title: Kampia Siriah
overview: Bahri (27) is set to marry Yulia (23), chosen by his family, when Pia (24), the woman he truly loves, returns with a truth that could shatter everything. What Bahri believed was Pia's betrayal was, in fact, a sacrifice she made to secure the traditional uang jemputan for him. Desperate to undo his family's choice, Bahri chooses to break the sacred premarital vow binding two families and face the consequences.

title: Satu Hari untuk Cinta
overview: After getting laid off from his startup job, Bayu runs an errand for his ex-girlfriend’s wealthy father to retrieve a rare designer bag. When the bag and a borrowed motorcycle are stolen, Bayu embarks on a wild chase across Jakarta alongside a washed-up child star and a hacker friend. Beyond the chaotic twists, Bayu learns to let go of high-society validation and embrace his own self-worth.

title: fly, little plane!
overview: A childhood dream of flight lingers into adulthood, reduced to a habit of watching planes pass overhead. As time moves on, wonder gives way to distance. Eventually, he looks away.

title: Jagalkorak Tapak Proletariat
overview: In 1980, supernatural detective Raden Mastemu investigates a murder linked to the forbidden art of Tapak Proletariat. With the help of Batara Komput and a CIA-agent insect, he uncovers a zombie sect tied to the long-missing monster Jagalkorak. Armed with the giant mecha Pusaka Tempur, Mastemu faces Jagalkorak and his newly enhanced psychic powers.

title: Black Coffee
overview: In the Gayo Highlands of Aceh, Onot and Rabiah, a blind couple, live from their small coffee plantation. Their days move through touch, memory, and routine, shaping a life of dignity and independence while sharing a deep longing for a child. After years of waiting their dream of becoming parents finally begins to take shape, bringing both joy and an unexpected fear of what the future may hold.

title: Sidang Kencan Pertama
overview: Rico terbangun di sebuah ruang gelap layaknya ruang sidang, sementara dua sahabatnya, Hariz dan Resa, berdiri di hadapannya mengenakan toga dan jas lengkap sambil memegang palu hakim. Mereka menuntut penjelasan atas kencan pertamanya bersama seorang gadis bernama Melodi Setiap kali Rico menceritakan kebodohannya, Hariz dan Resa di ruang sidang tak henti-hentinya mengamuk, memukul meja dengan palu, dan menghakimi logika berpikir Rico. Puncaknya ketika Rico yang terlalu percaya diri tiba-tiba melontarkan pertanyaan yang sanagat jauh tentang rencana pernikahan dan jumlah anak, membuat Melodi merasa jijik, membereskan barang-barangnya, dan kabur meninggalkan Rico di tengah kencan.

title: Emmy
overview: In 1945, the Dutch were preoccupied with the resistance led by Robert Wolter Mongisidi and his fighters. Bote, as he was known, caught the attention of Emmy Saelan, a nurse at Stella Maris Hospital, through his daring acts. Emmy joined Bote’s group, prompting the Dutch to order the ruthless psychopath Raymond Westerling to hunt them down, dead or alive. What fate awaits Bote and Emmy as they become the targets of a relentless manhunt?

title: Secrets
overview: Former sex worker Parni built a peaceful life for her daughter, but her abusive ex resurfaces, threatening to destroy everything she fought to protect.

title: Orang Sebelah
overview: Ever since her mother’s death, Evelyn has been haunted by dreams of an old building and her mother warning her to stay away. Together with Riana and a horror content team—Bagas, Gendis, and Raka—Evelyn recklessly investigates the legend of the "Neighbor’s Ghost" at a campus dorm. Their investigation turns fatal when a shaman is killed, turning the terror into a massacre targeting Evelyn and her sister, Lala. Escaping leads Evelyn to uncover her father's past with a black magic cult in her dream building and her mother's mysterious death. Trapped in deadly terror, they must expose dark family secrets to survive.

title: Festival Hantu Lapar
overview: After inadvertently violating a sacred ancestral taboo during the Hungry Ghost Festival, an adopted young man and his friends must break a relentless supernatural curse before the spiritual gates close permanently.

title: Pulang Kampung
overview: Dalam rangka menjadi Caleg sesuai perintah ayahnya, Daniel, pemuda Batak kelahiran Jakarta, terpaksa pulang kampung untuk belajar budaya Batak ditemani Uli, sepupunya yang tinggal di Danau Toba. Masalah muncul ketika Daniel ternyata bukan cuma jatuh cinta pada budaya Batak, tapi juga pada Uli.

title: Sumpah Darah
overview: Mara, a karaoke hostess, receives a proposal of marriage and a better life from Thomas, a mysterious man she has just met. At first she refuses, but then she accidentally kills a client while saving her best friend, Dini, from an attempted rape. Mara accepts the offer and leaves town with him. At the secluded villa where Thomas lives with his mother, Mara hopes to start a new life. However, various oddities slowly reveal a terrifying secret that makes her realize her escape actually poses a threat to her life and her very humanity.

title: Sundel Bolong Desa Wingit
overview: Story of a cursed village. Every three days someone died after experiencing a trance before killing themselves.

title: Lorazepam
overview: Jax is about to jump off a bridge onto the highway below when he unexpectedly runs into Joy, his childhood friend. Joy tries to calm him down and asks him to stay by his side wherever they go. This unexpected reunion brings them closer again as they spend the entire day together, slowly rekindling their bond.

title: Portrait of Tin's Family
overview: After tin mining in Singkep ended, Lunar imagines its past grandeur through her mother’s stories. When a mysterious Tin Man appears across fragmented time, merely photographing the present, the film interrogates memory, extraction, and the lingering socio-ecological afterlife of a mined city.

title: BLACK STAR
overview: Wilson trapped in a suffocating labyrinth of solipsism and modern burnout. Over one sleepless night he searches for something with no name, until a black star appears: a repeating light, an immovable loss, bright and black at the same time.

title: Menang Untuk Kalah
overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.

title: Piye To Kih?
overview: A broken heart drives Mukidi to prove that he is worthy of marrying the woman of his dreams. He works hard until he is able to buy an inexpensive house, which turns out to hold a mystery. In that house, he meets Sukma, a mysterious woman from the spirit world who has a different religion and background, yet manages to help Mukidi get over his heartbreak. Strange events begin to unfold, dragging his two best friends, Gendut and Penyok, into the chaos.

title: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
originalTitle: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
overview: Karina is a young woman who always puts others first and finds it difficult to say "no." This habit leaves her exhausted and causes her to sacrifice her own dreams.

title: Hamka: Awal Mula Vol. 3
overview: Set against the backdrop of West Sumatra, a passionate young rebel clashes with his strict scholar father, prompting a self-funded pilgrimage to Mecca where he discovers his destiny to reform Indonesian Islam and finds the love of his life.

title: Kapan Punya Anak?
overview: The marriage of Alma and Pandu is constantly haunted by the question of when they will have children—a question that, as we all know, has no answer.

title: Sally and The Girls Next Door
originalTitle: Sally and The Girls Next Door
overview: Sally, a highschooler trapped in her home life goes on a short but meaningful adventure with her friends where her life starts to change.

title: Storyboard Surah
overview: Perched on a bench through changing seasons, a bird named Pun watches as other birds forage and sing. All the while, verses from Surah Al-Asr and illustrated Quran lessons slowly reshape his understanding of time, life, and the world around him.

title: GANTARI
overview: A highschool girl learn that her life have more to offer when she discover the art of dancing.

title: Lagi Probation: Kerja Ngejar Apa Sih?
originalTitle: Lagi Probation: Kerja Ngejar Apa Sih?
overview: Bintang harus cari kerjaan untuk hidupin keluarga dan dirinya sendiri. Setelah berjuang sana-sini, kesempatan langka akhirnya datang: Bintang diterima jadi anak probation alias magang di perusahaan bumbu dapur besar, bersama Bima si Cumlaude, Velma si Asbun, Damai si Cari Muka, Mika si Pewaris, dan Claudia si Robot Korporat.  Tapi, baru juga bonding sama teman-teman barunya, eh ternyata cuma satu yang akan lolos probation dan jadi karyawan tetap. Seketika, teamwork berubah jadi team-war, teman jadi saingan, kolaborasi jadi kompetisi. 6 orang, 1 posisi. Siapa yang akan berhasil?

title: Pasukan 1000 Janda
overview: Following the tragic loss of her husband in combat, a fierce Acehnese noblewoman rises to become the world’s first female naval admiral, mobilizing an army of grieving widows into a formidable armada to avenge their families and defend their sovereign homeland against Portuguese colonization.

title: Serangan Balik
overview: Ketika geng mematikan menyerbu rumah terpencilnya, seorang veteran yang dihantui rasa bersalah dan cucu-cucu yang nyaris tak dikenalnya harus bersatu demi bertahan hidup.

title: Dewi Siluman Ular
overview: Dedi, a man who is bankrupt and deep in debt, performs a ritual to marry a beautiful jinn named Dewi in order to get the money to pay off his debts—with one condition: he must never marry anyone else.  As Dedi grows richer and more prosperous, he suddenly falls in love with a woman and intends to marry her. Dewi becomes furious because Dedi has forgotten the condition of the ritual, and eventually, a series of terrifying events threatens the lives of those closest to Dedi.

title: Seporsi Mie Ayam Sebelum Mati
overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

title: Aktor Gagal
overview: Vertical drama actors whose work got threatened when their production house started making AI-based drama.

title: Loba Tahu, Loba Elmu
overview: Powered by Sumedang Tofu, 12-year-old super-genius Ilham enters a culinary-power competition to lift his family out of poverty. But to win, he must overcome a fierce rival and the weight of his father’s doubt.

title: Tua Tua Keladi
overview: The quiet lives of elderly residents in a small fishing village are turned upside down when the Health Department announces that exposure to the chemical P172 triggers a dramatic surge in libido. Amid the panic and awkwardness, the villagers must navigate their suddenly chaotic relationships, reawakened by newfound passion.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

title: Erased From the Map
overview: A man tells a journalist about the photos and memories from his childhood in home and village that will soon disappear for the new national capital city. With his brother, he returns to the places they once played, taking pictures and recreating stories as if the land was still the same.

title: Sandal Jepit No. 10
overview: Akbar, a seemingly ordinary man, is taken into custody and interrogated regarding a serial murder case. From inside the room, he piece by piece reveals the timeline, underlying motives, and complex criminal plot through voice and narration alone.

title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
overview: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.

title: Gak Ada Matinya
overview: Di tengah kondisi keuangannya yang sedang berantakan, Binsar (Oki Rengga) tak tahu ini kabar baik atau buruk: Luhut (Mathias Muchus), bapaknya yang baru meninggal mewariskan asuransi 2 miliar. Namun di dalam mobil jenazah, Luhut tiba-tiba bangkit lagi. Binsar pun harus menyembunyikan bapaknya, - terutama dari Fahri (Fedi Nuril), seorang investigator asuransi, setidaknya sampai santunan asurasinya cair.

title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
overview: Three best friends are obsessed with becoming firefighters so they can look heroic by putting out fires. However, after failing during their training with the legendary Algojo Api squad, the three find themselves stuck doing seemingly “trivial” assignments. When they attempt to take a shortcut to join the firefighting team as soon as possible, they instead find themselves caught up in a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.

title: Hujan dikala senja
overview: Film pendek eksperimental karya A. Sayuti Siregar

title: Fallen Crows
overview: Fallen Crows merupakan film pendek bergenre drama aksi yang mengangkat kisah Alexander, seorang mantan anggota Yakuza yang tengah berjuang melawan kanker hati. Di tengah keterbatasan fisiknya, ia berusaha menebus dosa masa lalu dan melindungi Ambar, perempuan yang dicintainya. Namun, ketika masa lalunya kembali menghampiri dan merenggut satu-satunya harapan yang tersisa, Alexander dihadapkan pada kenyataan bahwa penyesalan tidak selalu menghadirkan kesempatan kedua.  Melalui kisah ini, Fallen Crows mengeksplorasi sisi kemanusiaan di balik kehidupan kriminal, stigma terhadap mantan anggota Yakuza, serta perjuangan seseorang untuk menemukan kembali arti cinta, penebusan, dan kemanusiaan di tengah dunia yang tidak memberinya kesempatan untuk berubah.

title: The Flowers
overview: Seorang remaja berada di persimpangan hidupnya, dihadapkan pada dua pilihan: tetap tinggal atau pergi. Di antara kenangan, perasaan, dan hal-hal yang belum sempat tersampaikan, sebuah keputusan harus diambil.

title: Jangan Dicium
overview: After a long-term relationship, Jali risks losing his chance to marry Ainun—all because his body odor is potent enough to knock out his prospective in-laws. Now, Jali is in a race against time to find a way to smell fresh before Ainun is married off to someone else. Can Jali save his romance, or will his body odor end up being his final "partner"?

title: The Other Side of Makassar City
originalTitle: The Other Side of Makassar City
overview: The Other Side of Makassar City is a documentary film that explores the lives of people whose stories are rarely represented in the city’s image of progress.

title: AUL: The Forgotten Wolf
overview: In a village beneath a geothermal power plant, a local militia controls public order as a cover for its illegal operations. One night, a confrontation with Mala (50), a father who begins questioning their authority, ends in his murder. Hours earlier, he entrusts his karinding to his son, Gal (25), as if passing on a final mission. After witnessing his father's death, Gal accuses the militia, but no one believes him. Guided by the karinding, he enters a realm where myth and reality converge to uncover the truth and awaken his community's forgotten conscience.

title: At Friend's House
overview: Banji is at the absolute lowest point of his life. Wandering aimlessly while enduring starvation, fate reunites him with Tohan, an old friend who immediately invites him home and offers a plate of rice. However, that warmth shatters into a harsh reality when Banji learns the bitter truth: Tohan was recently laid off, his sibling is severely ill, and they survive solely by selling handmade teddy bears. Overwhelmed with guilt for consuming Tohan's precious food, Banji is instead gifted two teddy bears as a lifeline to rebuild his life.

title: Air Pangea
overview: A man prepares for death, washing and wrapping himself in the kafan as his mother reminds him only deeds and prayers matter. As the soul transcends the body, it confronts visions of the afterlife — demonic figures, mythical creatures, three guarded doors — exploring death through sex, drugs, and rock and roll as much as ritual and prayer. Plunged into a metaphorical sea of memory, love, and loss, he searches for his mother's voice amid the waves. He awakens on a lake shore met by angels. What lies beyond the waterfall? Sex drugs rock and roll?

title: A Story About Tiger's Roar
overview: Amid the harsh realities of life in Jakarta, Martha, a single mother working as a laundry worker, struggles to provide for her three year old son, Aldi. When Aldi begs for milk at a minimarket, Martha realizes she doesn’t have enough money. She almost steals it but backs out in fear. Desperate, Martha seeks help from her ex-husband and customers, but every door is closed. Mounting financial pressure and Aldi’s relentless cries push her further into despair. When her work is disrupted and a customer refuses to pay, she loses hope. Martha returns to the minimarket, waiting for the right.

title: One Scan Away
overview: Stranded walletless in Japan during his sister’s medical emergency, an Indonesian student finds his ultimate lifeline in a single QR code.

title: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
originalTitle: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.

title: Esok Masih Ada
overview: Emelie, an elementary school student, must endure the taunts and bullying of her peers. Everything—from her school bag to her simple packed lunch—is turned into a source of mockery, slowly shattering her mental well-being.

title: The Doll Ghawiah
overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

title: The Longest Wait
overview: The first feature-length documentary on the journey of the Indonesian National Team. From the struggles on the pitch to capturing moments in the Indonesian national team's dressing room to qualify FIFA World Cup 2026

title: Laut Bercerita
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: TANDA AIR
overview: Bu Rani, a geprek chicken stall owner with a traumatic past of being falsely accused, unknowingly receives a fake 100,000-Rupiah toy bill. When her son attempts to spend the money at a local store, a wave of paranoia triggers an absurd neighborhood raid led by an overzealous RT chief. In a community fractured by distrust and untraceable cash, digital payment becomes their ultimate watermark of truth and redemption.

title: Where The Tree Stands
overview: A teenager haunted by the lingering shadow of a conflict with a friend that took place years ago. Each of them has their own hidden struggles until one of their friends tries to bring back the memories and the atmosphere of the past.

title: Ramu Irama
overview: For the Sasak indigenous People community, Cilokaq is not merely a form of entertainment, but a space for expression and identity-building that enjoyed great success during the VCD era; as a second-generation member of the Cilokaq Slemor Ate Jelantik group, Ojan utilises the digital space to revive this traditional music in its purest form amidst a modern industry landscape dictated by social media algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI).

title: Pasukan Singa Kardus
overview: Akmal and his three best friends roam around Singkawang wearing a cardboard barongsai, searching for someone that can teach them the proper way to lion dance.

title: Meong, Bikul, dan Kisah Si Pemburu
originalTitle: Meong, Bikul, dan Kisah Si Pemburu
overview: A boy wants to prove himself by carrying out Siwaratri: no food, no drinks, no moving, no talking, and no sleep. While doing it, he experiences an imaginative journey as a hunter, and learns the true meaning of self-control and attentiveness.

title: Samasta Allegra
overview: Allegra is transported to a world where vegetables, the thing she hates the most, can speak. She meets Dewi Sri, a sorceress that is slowly losing her power. Allegra needs to help Dewi Sri before this magical vegetable world vanishes.

title: Katumbiri Nutug Leuwi
overview: Believing that rainbows that reaches the river can bring magic, a group of children bands together to clean a river, hoping that angels may appear.

title: Chopped
overview: Tama and his dad runs a famous fish shop at a market. He will soon take over the business when his dad retires, yet Tama has this lingering thought that his strict dad won't approve him. Although, reality sometimes differs.

title: Forza
overview: An impoverished thirteen-year-old adolescent from the slums of Bali finds his aspirations of professional football within reach after forming an unlikely partnership with a veteran athlete on the verge of retirement, culminating in an unprecedented trial with the AC Milan Youth Academy in Italy.

title: Ngawula
overview: Di Kebon Bagea, tanah bukan sekadar tempat bercocok tanam, melainkan ruang tumbuh bagi anak-anak petani yang sedang mengenal kembali akar budayanya. Lewat interaksi polos mereka dengan alam, Teh Devi dan Kang Arief membagikan pandangan tentang pentingnya keterikatan antara manusia, tradisi agraris, dan kebudayaan lokal. Film dokumenter ini merekam proses regenerasi yang berlangsung secara alami di tapak tanah Kebon Bagea, serta merawat harapan agar warisan leluhur dalam menjaga bumi tetap hidup di tangan generasi muda.

title: Pulang tapi Hilang
overview: Pulang tapi Hilang follows Dika, a young man who returns home after spending time away studying at an Islamic boarding school. But things don't feel the same as he remembers. Everything seems familiar, yet something feels different. There's an emptiness he can't quite explain, as if a part of home is no longer there. Rika is finally home, but somehow, it doesn't feel like it anymore.

title: Tabungan Yang Dimakan Waktu
overview: A high school student realizes that her cash savings for college are damaged.

title: Sirkular
overview: When her mother falls ill, Putri becomes responsible of her mother's profession of clam-shucking. This role slowly takes Putri to repeat the same tragic cycle that her mother unfortunately experienced.

title: Satu Bungkus
overview: Having just recently transferred to a public school from a private one, Bella is still trying to blend in with her high school peers. After Bella's phone gets stolen, the four of them scours Glodok to hopefully find her phone back.

title: Togel: Diantara PHK dan Hutang
overview: After losing his job, Agus pretends to leave for work every morning to spare his pregnant wife the truth. Instead, he roams the streets looking for work and borrowing money just to survive. When Rijal, an old friend with a gambling habit and a talent for bad decisions, reappears, Agus tries his luck with a lottery "magic book" that promises winning numbers. Instead of getting rich, he is chased by debt collectors and forced to hide from his wife's family. Things get stranger when he meets Om Jhon, a quirky ghost who claims to know the secret to lucky numbers. Desperate for one number to change his life, Agus is pulled into a chaotic, darkly funny adventure.

title: Krayon Tanpa Warna
overview: Panji seorang Graphic Designer yang terjerumus AI Addiction dalam pembuatan karyanya, dituntut cepat oleh Pak Joko yang merupakan bossnya, hingga dia sadar bahwa ia telah kehilangan sesuatu yang penting dari dirinya.

title: AYO, PLIS!
overview: Erol, Kenzie, dan Akmal adalah seorang pelajar yang sedang makan dan nongkrong bersama di sebuah warung bakso. Tiba tiba Akmal bertemu dengan temannya Mahesa yang membuat mereka akhirnya mengobrol panjang, membuat Erol dan Kenzie merasa canggung dan bosan. Keduanya saling memberikan kode agar bisa segera pulang. Setelah menunggu cukup lama, Mahesa akhirnya berpamitan. Erol dan Kenzie bersemangat ketika Akmal mengajak mereka pulang dan akhirnya rasa itu selesai.

title: Bajau Laut - The Sea is Our Home
originalTitle: Bajau Laut - The Sea is Our Home
overview: Their stilt houses are burned down, their boats destroyed: the sea nomads of Borneo are stateless and can be displaced at any moment. The film explores the deep cultural roots and spiritual heritage of the Bajau Laut – the first inhabitants of the Semporna region – and contrasts them with the forced evictions targeting their oldest and most traditional villages. In the tension between eradication and assimilation, three chapters trace the evolution of adaptation, while local grassroots movements fight for the rights of the sea nomads.

title: For Me, For You
overview: Haunted by the collateral damage of his own ego, a young man sits with a notebook of past regrets and attempts to heal by leaving behind a message of forgiveness rather than fear.

title: Dua Hati Ibu
overview: Two childless married couples raise an unexpected son from an illicit affair between the two households. Amidst the chaos that follows a paternity reveal, the two wives take parenting into their own hands.

title: Seethe
overview: Ever since her father's sudden death by the Ciliwung River, Aci and her mother’s lives changed forever. Convincing herself the Ciliwung Spirit killed him, Aci vows revenge. Yet, her mother repeatedly insists asthma was the cause. Exhausted by Aci's escalating terror, her mother recklessly summons the entity, triggering an inevitable clash.

title: First Step
overview: As the 100th-day memorial for her younger sibling approaches, 62-year-old Tan Man Moy joins a line-dance community in Petak Enam. As happiness slowly finds its way back into her life, she must confront the guilt of enjoying life again without the person she loved most.

title: Sejuk Ini Karena Aku
overview: Extreme heat and fires sweep through Tambora, one of Jakarta's most densely populated neighborhoods. Uus returns after years away to live with his brother, Surya, an AC technician. Disturbed by the cramped conditions and constant threat of fires, Uus is determined to move to Japan for a better life, urging Surya to join him.

title: Aku Ngelia' Lau Memandangku
overview: Gita, an island woman traumatized by the sea, urges her fiancé Dama—a fisherman—to become a tour guide. Caught between the land and the sea, the two must choose one.

title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

title: Siti Si Vampir
overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

title: Pirunduk
overview: Di sebuah desa terpencil, Siti (Aulia Sarah) menikahi juragan Badarudin (Bucek Depp) demi melunasi utang ayahnya, namun justru terjebak dalam rumah tangga yang penuh kekerasan. Saat kehidupannya semakin terpuruk, Siti memilih jalan terlarang dengan mempelajari ilmu hitam Pirunduk untuk menundukkan suaminya. Namun kekuatan tersebut membawa konsekuensi yang mengancam Siti, Badarudin, dan seluruh warga desa.

title: Beautiful Pain
overview: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

title: Poké Wayang: Hutan Tanpa Selamat Pagi
originalTitle: Poké Wayang: Hutan Tanpa Selamat Pagi
overview: Well, here we are in Sunrise Forest... But wait, something seems a bit strange.

title: Kebakaran
overview: Sebuah hutan yang hijau dan asri serta kota dengan udara yang segar menjadi gambaran lingkungan yang ideal. Namun, semua berubah ketika seseorang membakar hutan, menyebabkan kebakaran hutan dan lahan. Asap menyebar hingga ke kota, mengubah langit menjadi oranye dan udara menjadi keruh serta sesak. Keindahan alam pun berubah menjadi bencana akibat ulah manusia sendiri.

title: Tendangan Bebas
overview: After Ronaldo's free kick shatters a villager's window, he and his friends are forced to wander through the neighborhood in search of a field where they can continue playing.

title: Dear Candidate,
overview: Uki, a Visual Communication Design fresh graduate who is still unemployed, suddenly receives an unexpected online job interview with no time to prepare. Living in a remote plantation area with poor signal, he must search for a stable connection while dealing with frustrating miscommunication with an impatient HR representative, all in hopes of passing the interview and securing a job.

title: The Class: Online
overview: Terhubung melalui layar, mereka mencoba mencari jawaban atas teror yang belum selesai. Namun sesuatu yang tak terlihat ikut hadir dalam pertemuan itu. Satu per satu gangguan muncul, mengubah ruang virtual menjadi mimpi buruk nyata dan membawa mereka pada akhir yang tragis.

title: Limbung
overview: In his old age, Lazuardi, a former detective who raised a vampire child as atonement for his sins, is faced with the reopening of his old case, while the vampire child started to feel distant.

title: Viewfinders
overview: Through postcards, perfect landscapes and a mirror's reflections, the film contrasts landscape's beauty with an environment overwhelmed by waste.

title: Bekel-Bekelan
overview: An unexpected incident! A teenager find six "Bekel Balls" left in front of his door. What happens next? No one knows. But don't take it too seriously. Because what happens next isn't important anyway... At least for him.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: Dari aku, Penyair kecil mu
overview: A poet who brought his wife back to life through poetry.

title: Bapak Paling Jujur
overview: Pencitraan udah disiapin. Jonas Prakoso dan Sambodo udah siap banget jadi calon gubernur dan wakil gubernur idaman. Tapi kutukan nenek bikin Jonas GAK BISA BOHONG SAMA SEKALI!  Kepikiran apa, nyeplos. Di depan keluarga, timses, lawan politik, sampai rakyat.  Kalau mulut nggak punya rem, siap-siap semuanya kebongkar!

title: Aplikasi Iblis
overview: A year has passed since the tragic death of his beloved Laras, yet Arya remains trapped in the depths of his grief. Haunted by longing and consumed by his love for her, Arya turns to a mysterious app called “I LET YOU IN,” rumored to have the power to connect the living with the dead. But what begins as a desperate attempt to reach Laras soon becomes a terrifying nightmare. Blinded by love, Arya unknowingly opens the door to a horrifying terror—one that threatens to consume him and put his own life at risk. Can Arya find the strength to let Laras go before his love for her becomes the very thing that costs him his life?

title: Dendam Arwah Penari
overview: The bankruptcy of Mr. Kusuma’s business forced Harum and her family to move into an old family home. There, Harum discovered a mysterious shawl that turned out to harbor the grudge of a dancer from the past. Since then, a series of terrifying and strange events has begun to haunt Harum and her family. To put an end to this deadly terror, Harum must uncover the mystery behind the dancer’s unjust death.

title: Meditation and the Culture of Sound
originalTitle: Meditation and the Culture of Sound
overview: Capturing the atmosphere of a bus stop and the bustling streets of Surabaya.

title: Ruang Waktu
overview: Menceritakan tentang kehidupan Raka yang berjalan seperti biasa. Sampai dia bertemu dengan seorang perempuan dan memberinya sebuah kalung. Setelah mendapat kalung itu, Raka menerima sebuah fakta yang selama ini disembunyikan ibunya. Apakah fakta tersebut merubah kehidupan Raka? Atau mengubah cara pandangnya terhadap ibunya?

title: Home, Almost
overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

title: Ghosthing
overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

title: Hapus
overview: Key is on probation at a production house. Her boss asks her to erase a mysterious figure from a video, a figure standing behind a “history expert” who is about to talk about the 1998 tragedy. She tries again and again, and fails, while strange things keep happening to her. A short horror film about the 1998 riots and the erasure of history.

title: KILL KILL BANG BANG
overview: A restaurant worker just wants to finish her shift and go home, but the night has other plans for her.

title: Moko: Bisikan Logam Tua
overview: Behind the beauty of the sea and the calm hills of Alor Island, lies the mystery of an old bronze drum called Moko, an inanimate object with magical powers that is believed to be able to come to life, change form, and even demand sacrifices. But for the Abui people, Moko is more than just a sacred myth; it's a wedding dowry and an "eternal debt" that can delay burial and force parents to sweat until their last drop of blood. Through Yoel's emotional narrative and the silent cries of the guardians of tradition, this documentary reveals a profound question: where is the line between inherited dignity and the shackles that cost humanity tears?

title: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
originalTitle: Syekh Yusuf Al-Makassari: In The Blessing of Ceylon
overview: From the Indonesian archipelago to Ceylon and beyond, Syekh Yusuf’s journey is a story of knowledge, faith, resilience, and connections that crossed borders and generations. His legacy continues to connect the histories and cultures of Indonesia and the wider Indian Ocean world.

title: Rainy Day Mother
overview: A mother revisits her old family photographs, now damaged by floodwaters. As she sifts through the fading images, she and her son engage in occasional conversations about religion and marriage.

title: Antrian Nomor Kematian
overview: Nur rushes her critically ill father to a referral hospital, only to find herself trapped in a grueling battle against rigid bureaucracy. Amidst this agonizing delay, her father's condition rapidly deteriorates.

title: The Journal: Berawal Dari Sebuah Penelitian
originalTitle: The Journal: Berawal Dari Sebuah Penelitian
overview: Tim penulis buku yang beranggotakan tiga orang, mencoba untuk meneliti kehidupan salah satu teman mereka yang bernama Fika untuk jangka waktu 30 hari ke depan. Untuk mendapatkan hasil yang akurat, mereka harus ikut menginap di rumah Fika. Awalnya penelitian berjalan dengan lancar sampai pada akhirnya terjadi hal-hal aneh dan juga tentunya perubahan perilaku Fika. Entah semua ini terjadi secara kebetulan atau memang ada sesuatu di balik peristiwa ini.

title: Udah Serius ini Terakhir
originalTitle: Seriously This Is the Last Time
overview: Seorang anak laki-laki terjebak dalam kebiasaan scrolling tanpa henti, menghabiskan hari demi hari di depan layar ponselnya. Di balik wajahnya yang kosong, ia mulai menyadari waktu yang terbuang, momen bersama keluarga yang terlewat, hubungan yang menjauh, dan bayangan masa depan yang perlahan memudar. Ia mencoba berhenti. Berkali-kali ia meletakkan ponselnya, namun dorongan dalam dirinya selalu menariknya kembali. Seolah ada “dirinya yang lain” yang menguasai, membuatnya terus memilih layar dibanding kehidupan nyata. Pertarungan terbesar bukan terjadi di luar, melainkan di dalam dirinya sendiri. Sampai akhirnya, dalam satu momen hening, ia menatap layar yang terus menyala lalu untuk pertama kalinya, ia memilih untuk tidak menyentuhnya. Ia meletakan ponselnya dan menjauh. Ia melangkah pergi, meninggalkan versi dirinya yang lama. Untuk pertama kalinya, ia terlahir kembali.

title: Rumah Lona
overview: For her birthday, Lona (9) received a teddy bear she named Moka. The bond between Lona and Moka filled a void left by her parents—Mama (34) and Papa (35)—whose busy work schedules kept them occupied. Moka remained a steadfast companion to Lona until the day the bear disappeared just as the family was reuniting, ultimately helping to restore the harmony that had once been lost.

title: Jakarta, I Love You
overview: A birthday boy meets a lost a stranger on the Jakarta MRT.

title: Cidro Asmoro
overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Ibuku
overview: A destitute widow and former traditional dancer defies social ostracization to embark on a desperate international journey, seeking a final reconciliation with her estranged daughter who faces execution abroad for the murder of an abusive employer.

title: Kuasa Gelap: Perjanjian Darah
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: Midnight Sun
overview: Surabaya is a bustling city, and this documentary captures a 24-hour cycle in the lives of three people whose lives have been shattered by circumstances beyond their control, yet who refuse to be victims.

title: A Bitter Place
overview: Saka terserang sebuah penyakit yang tidak dapat didiagnosis ketika ia mengalami kecelakaan kerja sebagai supir truk yang membawa bahan kimia berbahaya. Saka, yang tidak percaya terhadap kepercayaan non materil, mendatangi perkumpulan sekte yang melakukan ritual penyembuhan massal. Saat ibadah berlangsung, terjadi sebuah kerusuhan antar para umat yang tidak sabar untuk disembuhkan. Pemimpin sekte muncul menyembuhkan penyakit umat-umatnya untuk meredakan keributan. Kejadian itu membuat Saka takjub dan percaya terhadap mukjizat hingga menumbuhkan rasa percayanya terhadap sekte tersebut. Ketika Saka mendapatkan giliran untuk disembuhkan, penyakitnya semakin memburuk, luka pada tubuhnya semakin membesar. Rasa percayanya memudar dan Saka ingin membongkar kepalsuan sekte.

title: Tarik
overview: A boy named Ridho lives a simple life alongside his father, helping him sell vegetables each day. Amid the relentless demands of daily life, he discovers a modest sense of happiness through a handmade kite. For the very first time, he possesses something that offers him true release from the burdens he carries.  Yet for his father, manhood is defined by utility being useful, capable, and needed. Consequently, flying a kite is dismissed as trivial next to the duties that lie ahead. To Ridho, however, happiness and freedom are the very essence of what he requires.  As their values collide, Ridho must navigate a choice between clinging to his newly found joy or conforming to the life his father considers best for him.

title: The Hill and Mom's Memories
overview: Seorang mahasiswa film, Bayu (20) menelusuri kisah cinta kedua orang tuanya untuk tugas kuliah, tanpa menyadari bahwa ibunya menggunakan perjalanan itu untuk menyampaikan pesan agar ia tidak mengulangi kebiasaan yang telah merenggut nyawa ayahnya.

title: Monster of The Sea Guard
overview: Seorang wanita (26) yang terdampar di laut terbangun tanpa ingatan tentang bagaimana dia sampai di sana. Saat dia berjuang untuk bertahan hidup, dia bertemu dengan sosok bertopeng misterius yang konon merupakan penjaga laut, memaksanya untuk memberanikan diri, sampai akhirnya ia tahu sesuatu yang diluar batas pikirannya.

title: Revisi Harga Mati
overview: Udin is a creative worker in the field of graphic designer who is pressured by his client named Tina, a young politician who demands many things from Udin. However, Udin felt helpless with Tina's demands because he still wanted to get the next service projects. So Udin had to be forced to do what TIna wanted.

title: Çeyrek Asır
overview: Quarter Century is a quiet exploration of a universal yet deeply personal question: What does it truly mean to exist?

title: BAHANA
overview: A mute girl living with her abusive mother creates Alan, a mysterious companion who becomes her only escape. But as reality begins to unravel, Nada must confront what Alan truly represents.

title: 1st Attempt
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Cikiromantic
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Ghost in the Celluloid
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Bayang
overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

title: Semusim
overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

title: Sepele
overview: After ignoring his friend’s warning about a psychopath on the loose, Denis finds himself hunted through the dark corridors of his own home. When Adit comes to save him, Denis begins to question whether he has truly escaped—or is trapped in his own fear.

title: Conjurig
overview: Following a sudden job loss and the dissolution of his romantic relationship in the capital, a dejected young man retreats to his hometown of Bandung, masking his psychological vulnerabilities by donning a traditional ghost costume within a local street-performing subculture.

title: Warga Rusun 609
overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
originalTitle: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
overview: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
overview: Educated under colonial rule, a determined young man from Tanah Karo enlists in a paramilitary unit under the false promise of liberation, ultimately rising to become a pivotal military strategist in North Sumatra's guerrilla defense while balancing acute domestic sacrifices with absolute duty to the nascent Indonesian Republic.

title: Lobang Buaya, 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah
originalTitle: Lobang Buaya, 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Tak Masuk Hitungan
overview: Ibu adalah seorang pelayan rumah makan sekaligus orang tua tunggal, berjuang membesarkan Eci seorang diri. Di tengah rutinitasnya, Ibu terhimpit tekanan ekonomi karena tunggakan kontrakan yang terus ditagih Bu Ratih. Di saat bersamaan, nilai ujian matematika Eci menurun. Melihat temannya mendapat nilai bagus berkat bimbingan belajar, Eci meminta ikut les, yang tentu menjadi beban baru bagi Ibu di tengah kesulitan finansial.  Sepulang kerja dalam kondisi lelah, Ibu mencoba mengajari Eci di rumah. Suasana belajar justru berubah menjadi pertengkaran kecil akibat emosi dan ketidakpahaman di antara mereka. Namun, setelah menyadari kesulitan Eci, Ibu akhirnya mengizinkannya ikut les matematika. Tanpa sepengetahuan anaknya, Ibu rela menggadaikan cincin emas miliknya ke pegadaian demi membayar biaya les dan melunasi sisa tunggakan kontrakan.

title: Kalcer: The New Era ִ
overview: Famous for dominating their alley with their signature street style, The Kalcer (Andra, Ariel, and Milo) find their status challenged when The Siblinkz newly moved siblings Killa and Baskara arrive with an even trendier and more stylish look.

title: Mergawe
overview: Ndarjo adalah pemuda yang belum mendapatkan pekerjaan, ia berusaha menjaga kewarasannya di hadapan sang adik meski pikirannya penuh oleh tekanan hidup. Untuk menjauh dari kenyataan, ia menenggelamkan dirinya dalam dunia imajinasi bersama adiknya,  tempat dimana tak ada penolakan, dan tak ada yang bertanya soal karier masa depan. Namun, saat emosinya tak lagi terbendung, sebuah insiden konyol justru menuntunnya pada bentuk pekerjaan paling absurd dalam hidupnya.

title: Crowyokan
overview: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

title: KOPI
overview: Rendra, a migrant worker who works as a designer for a company, is enjoying his day off when he suddenly receives an urgent task from his boss. Wanting to make a cup of coffee to accompany his day off, he discovers that he has run out of coffee at home. Rendra decides to head to a cafe, but everything he does seems to go wrong, one misfortune after another, turning what was supposed to be a relaxing day off into a complete mess.

title: Jam Makan Siang
overview: seorang kepala sekolah otoriter membuat program makan siang gratis yang justru malah mengubah anak anak menjadi mahkluk mengerikan

title: Return of Rizal
overview: A serial killer stopped his spree because he was wanted by the police. But his evil side told him to go back. He suffered a moral crisis, deeply longing to be just a normal human being.

title: Perahu Kertas
overview: Perahu Kertas (Paper Boat) is a film poem about Atun, the filmmaker's childhood nanny who raised her from birth and became her chosen mother. After decades of domestic work across Indonesia and abroad, Atun now runs a roadside warung in Bali with her husband Mus and members of their extended family. To keep the business and their loved ones afloat, they work tirelessly, allowing themselves just one day off every two weeks. The film is that day off. In Atun’s brief repose from the demands of sustenance, space is made for poetic reflections on care, labour, sacrifice, and a relationship forged beyond blood.

title: Tinu Ninu
overview: Menjadi lulusan DKV dan pernah mengerjakan proyek desain grafis salah satu caleg, tidak menjamin pekerjaan tetap bagi Nino , yang sudah 2 tahun lulus. Pekerjaannya yang tidak tetap memberikan kecemasan yang cukup besar untuk Nino yang membuatnya mengurungkan niatnya untuk menembak Tina sahabat kuliahnya, sebelum Nino kembali ke kampung halamannya untuk mengurus toko buah milik keluarganya.

title: Ibu, Bagaimana Aku Tanpamu?
overview: Confronted with the devastating reality of her mother’s terminal diagnosis, a young woman embarks on a compressed emotional journey to fulfill her mother's final, unexpressed desires before her imminent decease, forcing a profound reckoning with grief and filial duty.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: Draft Me a Future
overview: Doni, feeling outmatched by his best friend, decided to create a fictional future scenario as an escape from the harsh reality.

title: Bisikan Desa Gringsing
overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: Sekelompok jurnalis sedang menginvestigasi kasus pembunuhan anak, namun tiap petunjuk justru membuka teror baru, dan mencari tahu terlalu dalam membuat mereka dalam bahaya yang tak mereka pahami.

title: Kala
overview: Saat perjalanan pulang dari kantor, Kala terpaksa membatalkan janji dengan teman-temannya demi menghadiri rapat mendadak. Perjalanannya diganggu oleh alunan piano misterius yang terus mengikutinya hingga ke rumah. Gangguan itu terus muncul dan memuncak di tengah rapat, bersamaan dengan omelan atasan yang terus menyalahkannya.

title: Kedipan Kamera
overview: "Kedipan Kamera" is a compelling short film that delves into a sharp yet empathetic social critique of contemporary community life. Through a series of poignant visual moments captured by a camera lens, the film explores the stark contrasts within public spaces, highlighting the invisible struggles of ordinary citizens. It challenges the audience to look past the surface of daily routines and recognize the deep human stories, socio-economic gaps, and emotional resilience embedded in the local environment.

title: Absurditas Sebuah Yang Terbagi, Terserap, Terasing, Terkumpul, dan Terhisap.
originalTitle: Absurditas Sebuah Yang Terbagi, Terserap, Terasing, Terkumpul, dan Terhisap.
overview: Bercerita tentang sebuah gelas yang kala bersama gelas lain, selalu membagi airnya (energi) untuk membuat gelas lain menjadi tidak sedih.

title: Empat Musim Pertiwi
overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

title: Afternoons Feel Like Goodbyes
overview: Titi, a 24-year-old woman who has never felt a sense of meaning in her life, attempts to prepare for her own death by sewing a custom shroud, one she can wear by herself so as not to burden anyone when the time comes.

title: Antara Waktu: Bunga Yang Terlambat Mekar
originalTitle: Antara Waktu: Bunga Yang Terlambat Mekar
overview: Lebih dari satu abad setelah kehilangan cinta pertamanya, Liriell menjalani kehidupan sederhana sebagai penjaga toko bunga. Takdir mempertemukannya kembali dengan reinkarnasi Willem, pria yang pernah ia cintai di kehidupan masa lalu, yang kini hidup sebagai Malio. Namun, Malio telah bertunangan dengan Tamara. Di antara kenangan, penyesalan, dan waktu yang terus berjalan, Liriell harus memilih antara mempertahankan masa lalu atau merelakannya demi kebahagiaan orang lain. Sebuah kisah hangat tentang cinta yang datang di waktu yang terlambat.

title: Obstacles
overview: Bound by address issues and average grades, Bunga's dream of getting into her ideal school is crushed. But taking a chance on a new, different path might just change everything.

title: Skenario Sang Jenderal
overview: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

title: RAPTURE
overview: A nun chooses to ascend when an angel comes to rapture her congregation. As she journeys through the pathway to the gate of heavens, she comes face to face with the irrefutable sanctity of her devotion to the Almighty.

title: Istimewa
overview: Five disabled children embark on a desperate search for their runaway foster father, only to find themselves thrust into the public eye.

title: Akal Imitasi
overview: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

title: Upon the Pond
overview: Set in a mysterious lake in the land of Sunda, a siren in love with a textile factory worker embarks on a journey to discover the meaning of love and her true self.

title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
originalTitle: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
overview: On their way to his wife's hometown in West Sumatra, Teddy and his best friend, Kevin, recklessly continue their journey at night and become lost in a forbidden area believed to be the realm of the Urang Bunian. Amidst a forest filled with supernatural terrors and illusions, they must find their way home before they disappear forever.

title: Semusim Lara
overview: Ali and Amir are inseparable fraternal twins with a telepathic bond. The brothers are forced to fend for themselves when their father abandons them after remarrying a younger bride. The arrival of a new teacher, Lara, tests their brotherly bond.

title: Adagium
overview: A hired hitman is paid to assassinate a corrupt politician, but after witnessing the failure of the justice system, he begins taking the law into his own hands.

title: Fana.
overview: manusia bernama fana yang terjebak di badai realita.

title: Bahasa Cinta Yang Beda
overview: Kehidupan pernikahan Cinta dan Rangga, di mana hubungan mereka mulai terasa stagnan akibat rutinitas dan perbedaan bahasa kasih yang tidak disadari.

title: The Worst First Impression
overview: A man tries to reach out to a creature in a room.

title: Arwah Tanpa Jatah
overview: Jeremy, a spirit with no clear identity, struggles to secure his portion on the day of the spirits' banquet.

title: She Taking Care of Me
overview: Follows a personal journey to rediscover the meaning of home through an intimate relationship between two sisters. Beginning with Nabila's body, shaped by scoliosis, it reflects on emotional weight, trauma, and memories of Palu after the 2018 disaster.

title: Lidah Api
overview: Slamet, a construction laborer, is tasked with tearing down his childhood home, which burned down three decades ago. Inside the house, he is possessed by his mother’s spirit, which longs to reunite with her children and reveal what truly happened.

title: Inong Peudame: Together, We Were Brave
originalTitle: Inong Peudame: Together, We Were Brave
overview: Set in Aceh, Indonesia, Inong Peudame (translated as "Women Peacemaker") tells the story of women whose courage, voices, and collective action shaped the journey toward peace during Aceh’s period as a Military Operations Area (DOM). Through the experiences of women activists, survivors, and community leaders, the documentary traces how women came together to support survivors, protect communities, and advocate for peace and justice.

title: Gemuruh Maruk
overview: During the production of a fictional film about mining issues, director Ibrahim, gets into trouble. The local residents acting in the film get angry and decide to go home because the storyfails to reflect their reality. Forced to step in front of the camera himself, Ibrahim experiences something unexpected.

title: aku tahu bapak
overview: Conversing in a tofu factory, a boy realize that life is just like tofu: slow and fragile

title: speaker freaker (the long song)
overview: Indonesian idol group no na dropped "speaker freaker (the long song)" along with its 13-minute medley short film on National Radio Day, September 11, setting the stage for their debut album, island girl, set to drop on September 18. Featuring iconic tracks like "rollerblade", "party in the +62”", and many more! Weave into traditional Indonesian elements, from the clinking of ceng-ceng cymbals in "work" and gamelan motifs in "rollerblade" to the familiar honk of city minibuses in "honk!," capturing the distinct world no na builds.

title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
overview: Following the untimely death of their parents, a resilient young adult assumes sole custody of her two younger siblings, battling escalating housing instability and economic devastation in a desperate bid to secure their education.

title: Agensi Rumah Tangga
overview: A driven entrepreneur establishes a domestic helper agency, navigating the complex and often humorous dynamics of managing her idiosyncratic staff while simultaneously resolving personal crises.

title: Iyus Jenius
overview: Following the tragic loss of his father, a demoralized ten-year-old boy overcomes severe emotional distress and academic decline through the guidance of an whimsical imaginary friend, who helps him reclaim his confidence and intellectual potential.

title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
overview: A debt-ridden, former vocalist relocates to his remote Papuan hometown under the pretense of visiting his terminally ill adoptive mother, masking a sinister plot to plunder her estate that inadvertently unleashes a lethal, ancient supernatural entity.

title: Housekeeper
overview: Egi, seorang housekeeper, disewa untuk menjaga sebuah rumah yang tampak biasa saja. Namun, seiring berjalannya waktu, ia mulai menemukan berbagai keanehan yang perlahan muncul satu per satu. Hal-hal yang sebelumnya tidak ia ketahui tentang rumah tersebut mulai terungkap, membawa Egi pada sebuah kenyataan yang jauh lebih mengerikan dari yang pernah ia bayangkan.

title: Dunia Ini Tak Selamanya
overview: In a world that can predict the exact moment of death, Fana, an apathetic girl with only 12 hours left to live tried to get away from the S.A.F.E. Zone (State Accomodation for Final Existence) alongside a stranger who shared the same countdown, only to rediscover her will to live just as their time runs out.

title: Kita?
overview: Di sebuah padang yang luas nan gersang, dua orang pemuda sedang memperebutkan dengan mati-matian barang paling berharga dalam hidup mereka. Tidak peduli apakah itu akan mengorbankan pertemanan sekalipun nyawa mereka.

title: Disonansi
overview: A documentary about a married couple navigating life amidst financial hardship, social pressure, and family rejection. Through the choices they make, the film explores the disconnect between faith, life, and reality a disconnect that creates dissonance within them and their surrounding environment.

title: Autopsy: Dead Body Can Talk
overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: Bapakmu Kiper
overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Di perjalanan pulang setelah membantu sebuah keluarga mengusir Iblis di tubuh anak mereka, Adam (Arya Saloka) seorang pengajar agama sekaligus praktisi ruqyah mengalami kecelakaan maut yang membuatnya kehilangan Aini, istrinya. Sejak saat itu ia berhenti melakukan ruqyah dan hidup dalam kesedihan berkepanjangan. Sampai suatu hari, ia diminta Anwar (Dimas Aditya) menyelamatkan Fitri (Acha Septriasa) seorang perawat sekaligus putri dari Mansur (Donny Damara), figur yang dihormati di desa tempat Adam tinggal. Adam yang awalnya menolak menemukan alasan untuk kembali melakukan ruqyah karena mengingat pesan mendiang istrinya. Namun, seiring waktu ia menemukan ada rahasia gelap di balik terror gaib yang menimpa Fitri.

title: Menari dalam Lemari
