overview: When their bodies and worlds is in crumble, the men found that a closet is a safe place for them to vent, or perhaps hide it all inside, forever.

title: Kuru' Sumange'
overview: In a small town in the Bugis region, seven children from diverse backgrounds are brought together for a Regional Children's Festival. Aisyah, a lonely girl, meets fellow participants who are each grappling with their own personal struggles. The judges group them together to stage a top-notch performance, and a variety of conflicts arise, challenging them to keep the show going in the name of friendship.

title: Mama Minta Hotspot di Pamulang
overview: The crew members of the documentary film Mama Minta Hotspot decided to summon Mama's Ghost through a ritual to kill their producer who had been exploiting their trauma by screening the film at various film screenings to rake in profits.

title: Plantation Tragedy
overview: Plantation Tragedy presents a surreal dreamscape where trees, labourers, scientists and artificial intelligence confront one another in a shared state of exhaustion. Four figures—Francis the overseer, Dona the vegetal communicator, Watiman the scientist and Cyborg the sentient machine—voice conflicting desires for progress, justice and rest. The oil palms begin to groan, complain and ultimately refuse to produce, a fantasy of vegetal strike in action. As the trees “strike,” the plantation becomes a scene of imagined resistance, inviting us to consider whether the Earth itself might one day refuse and retaliate.

title: Peluru Senja
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Rumah Singgah
overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

title: Paket Santet
overview: Sebuah paket tiba di depan pintu. Tidak ada nama pengirim. Tidak ada alasan mengapa paket itu ditujukan kepada mereka. Namun, sejak paket itu dibuka, hidup penerimanya langsung berubah jadi mimpi buruk. Satu per satu nyawa menjadi taruhan. Kini, pertanyaannya bukan lagi bagaimana cara menghindari paket tersebut, melainkan bagaimana cara terhindar dari kutukan setelah menerimanya.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: Nusantara Dystopia For Whom?
overview: Before it was the new capital city, it was Sepaku -- home to the Balik and Paser people, Bugis migrants, and others who would reside and build around the river bed. This documentary follows how residents of Sepaku had to gradually face massive changes to their land.

title: Sang Suraksha
overview: How difficult it is to find work in Indonesia, which means many people are forced to work to survive on minimal wages.

title: SADAJIWA
overview: This film tells the fantastical journey of a teenage boy who initially looked down on Indonesian culture simply because he was unfamiliar with it, and who even frequently posted negative comments on social media about certain ethnic groups. One day he entered the world of his very own dreams, and within that world he travelled around Indonesia learning about several new cultures that he had previously dismissed as ‘outdated’. Upon waking from his dream, he decided to take on the role of safeguarding and preserving these cultures by joining his nearest cultural centre.

title: Motion
overview: A visual deconstruction of the turbulent nature of life and the messy reality of the human journey. Through visual resets and digital chaos, the film shows that progress is never a straight line, but motion that never stops.

title: Antar Nada
overview: Hana is a middle school girl who once had a deep interest in music who is reluctantly paired with her classmate, Nada, for a school assignment. Nada, too, once had a gift for music, but it has gradually faded as she slowly loses her hearing due to an illness she suffers from. Her limitations in communication make their relationship increasingly awkward and distant, until a piano opens up a new way for them to understand each other without words.

title: Jayalah Prosesku
overview: Two young photographers who feel unsuccessful in their craft acquire an AI-powered nano machine capable of printing any work of art.

title: Ilmu Penguat Gigitan
overview: Ilmu Penguat Gigitan is a short comedy film about pride, ambition, and the absurd lengths people will go to for a simple victory.  In a small village, the annual cracker-eating competition is more than just a game. For years, Mang Bonex has remained undefeated, turning his victory into a local legend. Determined to finally beat him, four challengers seek the help of a mysterious shaman who claims to possess a secret technique capable of strengthening their bites.  What follows is a bizarre journey of rituals, belief, and misplaced confidence, as an ordinary village competition is treated like a battle of epic proportions.  Blending everyday village life with exaggerated mystical elements, the film finds comedy in the contrast between the seriousness of its characters and the absurdity of what they are fighting for.

title: Mathematically
overview: When a group of students gathers at their school, mathematical equations begin to invade their reality.

title: Ayo Pulang
overview: Bima (Akbar) bears the responsibility of providing for his family. He works day and night as an online motorcycle taxi driver. One day, while delivering a food order with his younger brother Satria (Denny)—who has special needs—they witness a murder. Consequently, they are prevented from returning home and forced to fight against a group of thugs.

title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

title: Kuncen
overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

title: Dan Bandung
overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: Harusnya Horror
overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.

title: Film Lokal Situbondoan
overview: An anthology that brings the stories, culture, and distinct essence of Situbondo to the big screen, presenting a variety of narratives deeply rooted in local wisdom and community dynamics through five films: Satria: Santri Patriot Bangsa, Oosthoek: Dengung dari Ujung Timur, A Kor-kor, Iman dan Imam, and Ngidam.

title: Mulai Dari Awal
overview: Jika memiliki akhir yang buruk, maka kita harus memulai nya dari awal.

title: Selamat Ulang Tahun
overview: Returning home exhausted after a long day of organizational work, Raf (20) is greeted by a birthday cake and the lively voices of his friends. Overwhelmed by a sudden surge of happiness, Raf becomes immersed in the moment, dancing and celebrating his birthday in a state of euphoria. However, as exhaustion eventually takes over, the lively atmosphere suddenly disappears. Raf realizes that he is completely alone, confronted by the bitter reality that it was all an illusion.  Raf slips back into a depressive episode, and as time passes, he becomes increasingly consumed by his actions, eventually leading him to self-harm. A portrayal of the reality of how a person living with bipolar disorder navigates life.

title: SUAR
overview: A story of two strangers burdened by the pressures of work life. After a heated customer service call leaves both emotionally scarred, fate reunites them. Unaware of their earlier connection, they share their frustrations and vulnerabilities, discovering that empathy can illuminate even the darkest moments of everyday life.

title: 明月共此時
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: Rencana Besar untuk Mati dengan Tenang
originalTitle: Rencana Besar untuk Mati dengan Tenang
overview: 76-year-old widower Encek convenes his children for a final dinner, unveiling concealed memoirs of love, loss and generational wounds before choosing the sea as his reunion place with his deceased wife.

title: Ketok Mejik
overview: Ben, a grandson who is 'forced' to inherit his grandfather's "Ketok Magic" workshop. However, this inheritance comes with a series of problems that will confuse the entire village!

title: Perumahan Laddaland
overview: Demi memberikan kehidupan yang lebih layak bagi istri dan anak-anaknya, Tomy (Andri Mashadi) memberanikan diri mengambil KPR untuk membeli rumah impian. Kebahagiaan itu tak berlangsung lama. Sejak menempati perumahan baru, keluarganya diteror berbagai kejadian tak wajar. Bisikan misterius, penampakan mengerikan, dan rahasia kelam di balik perumahan tersebut mengancam keselamatan mereka.

title: Seni Merayu Tuhan
overview: Haunted by a dream of his late mother pleading for salvation from the afterlife's torment, a troubled and estranged son embarks on a spiritual journey to uncover the true meaning of wisdom, hoping to redeem both his mother's soul and his own fractured faith.

title: Subamanggala: Sang Penuntun Jalan
overview: Ipung must endure his own heartbreak to lead the wedding procession of his former lover, standing before the very family who once rejected their relationship due to his profession.

title: Traveling With You
overview: Three friends going out to the city of Jakarta before graduating high school and go their separate ways. But something is off with one of them.

title: Bully
overview: Malvin, a quiet eight-grader living life in his own head, is suddenly caught between two bullies, Dillon and Clarissa. Whilst, Michael tries to help him, and Fellycia tries to save himself from his mind and attempt to restore his faith in humanity, not knowing that will only wreak more havoc and challenges Malvin has to go through, even if he has already enough chasms in his daily life.

title: Let Her Play
overview: A teenager attempts to communicate with a building because the place where she used to play as a child has turned into a garbage dump due to the construction of surrounding buildings.

title: Et si Thuy n'existait pas
overview: Buffering through a new country on odd jobs and a phone that speaks for her. An undocumented immigrant is now ready to pair.

title: Anak Babi Bapa
overview: Amid the pressure of tradition, the expectations of his extended family, and the guilt that continued to haunt him, Ardian slowly sank into loneliness and hallucinations about his own identity.

title: Yang Sudah Boleh Pulang
overview: 23 Tahun Berlalu, Keluarga harmonis yang diinginkan berbanding terbalik dengan kenyataan hidup Irham, tumbuh sebagai anak pertama di keluarga yang tampak sempurna dari luar. Sejak kecil, Irham terbiasa menahan tangis, menyembunyikan rasa takut, dan memikul tanggung jawab yang terlalu berat untuk usianya. Beranjak dewasa, Irham tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang pendiam dan tertutup. Trauma masa kecilnya membuatnya sulit mempercayai orang lain. Akankah mungkin… kali ini, ia benar-benar sudah boleh pulang?.

title: Ritual Gaib: Nyai Randasura
overview: A newly pregnant woman must fight for her life and the soul of her husband when a family visit to his estranged, ailing father exposes a generations-old, blood-soaked pact tied to a ruby ring and a demonic seductress.

title: Folding Sadness
overview: Tita tries to forget her ex, who is about to get married, by spending her days in the kitchen. In the end, Tita decides to attend the wedding to resolve everything.

title: Oleh Tangan Naufal
overview: Pushed by the relentless pressure from his family, Naufal could only find a sense of safety and freedom through his painting. Overwhelmed by years of trauma, he made a drastic call to end the suffering for both himself and his family.

title: Parade Si Rambo
overview: Ridho keeping a secret of their married with Ratna, his wife. When the secret revealed, Ridho impulsively drinking his horse’s, Rambo, urine. But things don't go according to plan.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: The Balloon is a Life Never Celebrated
originalTitle: The Balloon is a Life Never Celebrated
overview: Aji, an orphaned boy, watches as other children celebrate their birthdays with balloons and the cheerful song “Happy Birthday.” The simple sight awakens a longing to experience the same joy for himself. Using money meant for his daily necessities, Aji secretly buys a balloon. But before he can celebrate his birthday, the balloon deflates. While searching for a replacement, Aji discovers an unfamiliar object that resembles a balloon. Unaware of its true purpose, he blows it up and uses it to celebrate his birthday alone.

title: Legowo
overview: Legowo explores the inner lives and unspoken struggles of becak (traditional Indonesian pedicab) drivers from an intimate perspective. The story follows Mr. Mariman, a driver living far from home who works tirelessly to provide for his family, alongside Mr. Joko Tentrem, who strives to highlight the true value of their profession to tourists.  Far more than just transport providers, these drivers serve as local storytellers—guiding travelers through historical destinations and connecting them with local culture. However, the massive shift toward modern online ride-hailing services threatens to erase the identity and livelihood of this traditional transport. This documentary aims to inspire audiences to acknowledge, preserve, and continue supporting the invaluable services of these cultural guardians.

title: Sidang BPUPKI
overview: Berlatar pada Mei hingga Juli 1945, film ini mengisahkan jalannya dua masa sidang krusial BPUPKI di Gedung Pejambon, Jakarta. Sepuluh tokoh pergerakan nasional dengan latar belakang ideologi yang berbeda harus berdiskusi dan berdebat sengit; mulai dari merumuskan Pancasila sebagai dasar negara pada Sidang Pertama, hingga menentukan batas wilayah serta rancangan undang-undang dasar pada Sidang Kedua. Di bawah pengawasan ketat militer Jepang, mereka berpacu dengan waktu demi mencapai konsensus pra-kemerdekaan.

title: To Live on Credit
overview: Di tengah tekanan ekonomi dan kehancuran keluarganya, seorang  sopir online menemukan jalan keluar yang tak terduga,  memaksanya memilih antara bertahan hidup atau mempertahankan  nuraninya.

title: Gecko
overview: When Niu Niu discovers her grandfather’s hidden past in Indonesia  through old letters and archives, she unravels the story of the family he  left behind and becomes entangled in a myth surrounding the local  animal Gecko.

title: Jejak Sunyi
overview: Faris, seorang remaja yang berstatus single parent setelah kepergian sang ibu sejak ia kecil, tumbuh dengan keyakinan bahwa dirinya tidak lagi dianggap. Kesibukan dari sang papa membuat setiap usahanya berujung sia-sia. Namun, sebuah luka terbuka ketika ia melihat sisi lain dari sosok yang selama ini ia salah pahami dan artikan. Di balik diam dan kerasnya sang ayah, tersimpan kasih sayang serta dukungan yang selama ini ia harapkan, meninggalkan Faris dengan penyesalan mendalam dan rasa maaf yang tak bisa tersampaikan.

title: Pelet Biduan Jalang
overview: The feud between the veteran singers and the newcomers came to an end after one of the singers was found dead at the Yenna Music Entertainment Singers’ Dormitory.  The mystery surrounding Lola Lolipop’s death and the attempted murder of Cici Bohay set a chilling tone for the other singers, prompting Evi Aurora, Syakila, Iis Gulali, and Debora to decide to unravel the mystery of the murder.  Unfortunately, their decision has put their own lives in danger; now, one by one, they are being marked as sacrificial victims.

title: Andai Waktu Bisa Diulang Kembali
overview: Dinar falls for Faiz, who brings color to her dull life. Amid their romance, she faces mounting troubles—unpaid tuition, her late father’s debts, and her mother’s cancer. Then, Firman, a wealthy man, offers her an easy escape—but at the cost of betraying Faiz.

title: Sajen Satu Suro
overview: Tania (Aisyah Aqilah) returns to Maduabang Village with Jeff (Cinta Brian Glenn Roberts), Laura (Frislly Herlinda Balqis), and Robby (Munggaran Meldrat). They plan to return the heirloom keris belonging to her grandfather, Sapto Dilogo (Clift Sangra), in order to cure her mother, who is suffering from a mysterious illness. Their arrival with the keris stirs up the villagers’ fears that the spirit of Sumarni (Assila Corina ) has returned. The bride-to-be was murdered by Sapto Dilogo with that very keris. Tania and her friends find themselves caught up in the revenge plot of Suparti (Yurike Prastica) and Aryoseno (Harris Syaus), which is closely tied to a past tragedy that occurred on the night of 1 Suro. Amid supernatural terror and a series of attacks that claim victims, Tania finally uncovers the dark truth about her family.

title: Mengejar Cahaya Melalui Rana
overview: Seorang pria paruh baya yang terobsesi memotret cahaya dengan kamera film terus mengulangi rutinitasnya,  sementara hari-hari berlalu tanpa hasil yang diharapkan.

title: The Fraying Tide
overview: Baim, seorang nelayan muda di pesisir Eretan, menjalani hidupnya seperti biasa hingga sebuah pertemuan misterius mengubah cara pandangnya terhadap waktu dan masa depan

title: Wake Up, Gustav!
overview: Rekki (35) arrives at a traditional clinic called Service Penis Neng Esih IX, hoping to solve the problem that has left him feeling incomplete as a man: he has never experienced an erection since birth. In a waiting room filled with eccentric patients and absurd stories of masculinity, Rekki begins to question what it truly means to be a man.  But when he finally meets Neng Esih IX, a young therapist and heir to a legendary ancestral healing practice, something that no treatment has ever been able to awaken emerges on its own. An absurdist comedy about masculinity, hope, and how human connection can sometimes be more powerful than any mystical remedy.

title: Beyond the Light (Pilot)
overview: As political tension spreads across La Luz, the disappearance of actor Jinyoung begins affecting the lives of everyone connected to him. From riots in the streets to secrets behind closed doors, fear slowly push the city closer to collapse.

title: Kado untuk Ibu
overview: A firefighter expecting his first child postpones going to the hospital to help a young girl find a birthday gift for her mother, embarking on an unexpected adventure that teaches him about kindness, selflessness and loss.

title: Leave No One Behind
overview: Suwardi (Suwardi Becak Lawu), a police officer with the rank of Assistant Commissioner, is transferred from Jakarta to his hometown in Garut to carry out a mission for the government’s Task Force on Human Trafficking (Satgas TPPO) to combat kidnapping and human trafficking. The joy of his return home turns into a nightmare when his own niece, Lilis (Cinta Kharisma), is kidnapped by a human trafficking ringleader. Overcome by deep guilt and in conflict with Asep (Iyang Darmawan), Lilis’s father, Suwardi forms a special task force to dismantle the largest human trafficking network in West Java, led by Rando (Macho Hungan). One ambush after another drags Suwardi into an escalating vortex of fistfights and shootouts until a shocking truth about Rando’s true identity is revealed.

title: Sangkal
overview: Luna, seorang mahasiswi tingkat akhir, menjalani bimbingan skripsi dengan dosennya, Pak Garda, yang awalnya tampak ramah dan membantu. Namun, dibalik sikapnya, Pak Garda menyalahgunakan kekuasaan dengan melakukan pelecehan serta mengancam akan menghambat kelulusan Luna jika menolak keinginannya. Trauma yang dialami membuat Luna menghilang tanpa kabar. Sahabtnya Laras, mulai curiga akhirnya mengalami perlakuan yang sama.

title: Free Wifi
overview: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

title: Anak-Anak Bambu
overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Juminten Edan
overview: Juminten, a mute woman, returns to her hometown with her husband and child after eight years away. Initially welcomed warmly by her family, their happiness changes when Juminten begins to behave strangely and endanger those closest to her. When her dark past is revealed, the safety of her family and the entire island is threatened.

title: Mekarnya Kembang Api
overview: Terbelenggu oleh duka dan bayang-bayang masa kecil, Dika menciptakan pelarian semu bersama Raya. Ia akhirnya dihadapkan pada pilihan: terus bersembunyi di balik kenyamanan masa lalu atau melangkah maju menghadapi masa depan yang tak pasti.

title: Pramuka
overview: Panji and his Scout Patrol are preparing to attend a Penggalang Scout camping trip in the mountain forest. Unbeknownst to everyone, Budi, Panji's younger brother and a Cub Scout (Siaga) secretly sneaks aboard the group's truck, eager to experience the excitement of camping alongside his older brother. When Budi's presence is eventually discovered, he is allowed to stay and join Panji's group. What begins as an ordinary journey soon turns into a dangerous adventure when Panji and his patrol become separated from the main camp and find themselves lost deep within the forest. While searching for a way back, they stumble upon a terrifying secret: a hidden, abandoned warehouse where a criminal gang is holding kidnapped children captive. Caught in a life threatening situation, Panji and his friends must rely on their courage, ingenuity, teamwork, and the principles of the Scout Law (Dasa Dharma Pramuka) to survive, find help, and rescue the imprisoned children before it is too late.

title: Batalyon Raider 2026 | The Documentary
overview: tentang perjalanan para penunggang kuda dan perjalanan mereka, masa jabatan setahun yang membentuk mereka selamanya.

title: Sebatang Kara
overview: Di tengah kehancuran ekonomi yang melanda, Andre, seorang pemulung, berjuang mati-matian untuk bertahan hidup. Terdesak oleh kebutuhan finansial yang semakin menghimpit, ia mengambil keputusan yang tak pernah ia bayangkan sebelumnya dengan menerima tawaran transaksional dari seorang pekerja seks transgender. Namun ketika keadaan memaksanya kembali menemui orang yang sama, sebuah percakapan tak terduga mengungkap kenyataan pahit yang mengubah hidup Andre selamanya.

title: Diari Hitam: Lembaran Baru Liriell
overview: Liriell, seorang gadis misterius yang hidup membaur di dunia manusia sebagai perangkai bunga di Toko Galeri Bunga, menyimpan rahasia besar tentang asal-usulnya. Di balik sifatnya yang hangat dan ceria, ia sebenarnya adalah peri putih yang terusir dari bangsanya dan telah hidup selama ratusan tahun. Ketenangannya mulai runtuh ketika Velmor, peri hitam licik yang setengah gila dan telah lama menghantuinya, kembali muncul untuk memburu Diari Hitam — artefak magis kuno yang menyimpan hubungan antara jiwa Liriell dan masa lalu bangsanya. Kesalahpahaman yang dimanipulasi Velmor membuat penyihir Isran memburu Liriell, hingga David, Pak Sulap, dan Fernando terlibat dalam konflik sihir yang perlahan berubah menjadi pertarungan antara cahaya dan kegelapan.

title: Waktu.
overview: On a quiet morning by the sea, 17-year-old Olivia patiently waits for Ayu, her best friend who promised to join her soon. But as the day slowly passes from noon into late afternoon, Ayu never shows up and suddenly stops responding.  Olivia’s boredom gradually turns into frustration and resentment. She floods Ayu’s phone with a series of angry messages, convinced that her time and good intentions have been taken for granted.  As dusk settles and Olivia finally decides to go home, an unexpected notification appears on her phone. In an instant, all of her anger gives way to deep regret. The birthday gift she had prepared for Ayu slips from her hands as she comes to terms with the heartbreaking truth behind why her best friend never came.

title: Lantai Dua Setengah
overview: Indra bersama teman - temannya terjebak dalam sebuah taruhan berbahaya yang menantang rumor paling menyeramkan di sekolah, namun apa yang mereka temukan jauh melampaui apa yang mereka bayangkan.

title: Kota Bersih, Laut Mati?
overview: Yuni (18 Tahun) seorang pelukis tunarungu dari desa, nekat pergi ke Jakarta demi menghadiri pameran lukisannya tentang kerusakan laut di Museum Bahari, namun ia justru tersesat di tengah hiruk-pikuk Ibu Kota hingga akhirnya ditolong oleh seorang pemuda misterius yang menuntun jalannya menggunakan bahasa isyarat seadanya, menyisakan sebuah tanda tanya besar tentang siapakah sebenarnya sosok penolong yang tiba-tiba hadir di saat ia kehilangan arah.

title: Pocong Cantengan
overview: The search for a missing friend leads four young people to a house haunted by the Pocong Cantengan and the secret of human sacrifices ritual.

title: Ghost Buzzer: Antar Aku Pulang
overview: Four mystery-loving friends investigate a haunted basement and encounter the spirit of Maria, who begs for help returning home. Their mission leads them on an adventure filled with terror, puzzles, and friendship as they help the spirits find peace.

title: Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis
overview: Dika felt like he was never enough for his mother, Dini, and their relationship was full of conflict. While pursuing his dreams with Sans Band and receiving guidance from Om Radit, Dika finally realized that beneath all his mother's demands lay genuine love and support.

title: Lastri: Arwah Kembang Desa
overview: Atmi is terrorized by the spirit of Lastri, a woman who committed suicide 30 years ago due to slander and cruel treatment from her village. Now, Lastri has returned to seek revenge, especially on Atmi and those who destroyed her life.

title: Cek Khodam
overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.

title: Hiruk Pikuk Jakarta
overview: Tentang warga Jakarta yang mencoba bertahan hidupdari kehidupan Jakarta yang terkenal cukup ketat dengankesenjangan sosialnya.

title: Arcade Five Part Two: The Last Call
originalTitle: Arcade Five Part Two: The Last Call
overview: A woman receives a call from her friend, who wants to show her something, but it ends in a strange way.

title: A Flower Without a Mirror
overview: Lisa, seorang siswi yang mendapat beasiswa di luar kota harus memilih untuk menjaga ibunya yang tiba-tiba jatuh sakit atau menerima beasiswanya demi mengejar mimpinya sebagai penulis.

title: THE MIND
overview: Shine seorang remaja berusia 20 tahun sering mengalami kekerasan dalam keluarganya yang mengakibatkan dirinya tidak bisa keluar dari bayang-bayang masa lalu itu.

title: Autosave
overview: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

title: Aku Sebelum Aku
overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: Simulakra
overview: Nula is a student who has feelings for her old friend, Joel. One day she is caught in a recurring incident while she is with Joel. When Nula finds out that Joel is ready to express his feelings to his crush, that's where the incident continues to repeat itself and stops when Nula feelings that she has been keeping hidden, she expresses to Joel.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay (Fajar Nugra), penjual ayam di pasar yang diam-diam mencintai Wulan (Givina), nekat menggunakan sebuah cara terlarang dengan menggunakan Pelet dan ajian Pemikat Jiwa untuk membuatnya jatuh cinta dan merebutnya dari Damar (Erdin Wedrayana) calon suami Wulan. Ritual itu berhasil, Wulan pun mulai mencintai Jay secara tidak wajar.  Namun, perubahan itu segera berubah jadi teror. Wulan kehilangan kendali atas dirinya dan mulai dirasuki sosok entitas gaib bernama Nyai Sasigeni yang membuat dorongan obsesif yang semakin brutal. Hubungan mereka berubah menjadi ikatan yang mencekik.  Saat Damar berusaha menyelamatkan Wulan, Jay menyadari bahwa yang ia gunakan bukan sekadar pelet pemikat biasa, tapi pelet yang mengikat jiwa Wulan dan mengancam nyawanya. Setiap usaha untuk melepaskannya justru menuntut harga yang lebih mengerikan.

title: 402 Rumah Sakit Angker Korea
overview: Demi mendapatkan 3 Juta Penonton, content creator yang dikenal dengan nama Para Pencari Hantu, memilih untuk melakukan live streaming di sebuah rumah sakit paling angker di Korea Selatan. Juna (Arbani Yasiz), Adit (Saputra Kori), Bara (Elang El Gibran), Arum (Diandra Agatha), Yuri (Lea Ciarachel), Tyas (Aylena Fusil), dan Daeho (Jang Han Sol), bukan hanya akan mendapatkan content yang menarik banyak penonton, mereka juga mendapatkan pengalaman paling mengerikan, mencekam bahkan mematikan yang tak pernah mereka bisa bayangkan sebelumnya.

title: FOUFO
overview: Di tengah kesulitan ekonomi di Kampung Rombeng, Muslim (Tretan Muslim), seorang pengepul rongsok keturunan Madura terdesak harus segera melunasi sisa biaya ibadah haji ibunya. Situasi berubah ketika ia menemukan bangkai UFO jatuh di pinggiran kota. Alih-alih menjual besi UFO, Muslim justru menyembunyikan UFO dan alien sekarat, lalu ia namai Foufo. Di luar dugaan, teknologi canggih Foufo berhasil menyelesaikan berbagai masalah keluarga Muslim. Namun, konflik memuncak saat tenggat waktu pelunasan haji tiba dan Foufo kehabisan energi. Muslim kini dihadapkan pada dilema krusial: memberangkatkan haji ibunya, atau membantu Foufo pulang ke kapal induknya?

title: Seni Dalam Mengalami
overview: Three sharp-tongued outlanders recount their own perspectives on the evolution of time, love and humanity through a series of tableaux.

title: The Clearing
overview: Sumatra, early twentieth century. The exploitation of rubber by Dutch colonisers leads to the sexual enslavement of female workers. Archival and contemporary images intertwine in a documentary fabulation that plunges into the depth of a long-erased history.

title: Soro
overview: Yetno believes that happiness and prosperity would come naturally after marriage. Decades passed after Yetno and Siti’s marriage, but the life they’d hoped for never materialized; instead, they face nothing but a string of misfortunes and abject poverty. Yetno realizes that all of this was due to a mistake he had made in the past.

title: The Errand Boy
overview: Seorang remaja pendiam bernama Banyu yang rela menjadi pesuruh bagi dua teman, Ido dan dewa, namun keadaan mendesak membuat ia harus berani memutus ikatan tersebut ketika gengnya merampok seorang anak penjual kue keliling.

title: Bittersweet Seventeen
overview: Setelah merusak mobil mainan saudara kembarnya, Vina (17) menjual gaun ulang tahunnya dan membeli mainan baru untuk membujuk saudaranya yang marah padanya.

title: Piece By Piece
overview: Sebuah kasus tabrak lari membawa kepolisian pada penyelidikan melalui kesaksian tiga saksi yang hanya melihat sebagian kecil dari kejadian. Saat potongan informasi mulai tersusun, setiap petunjuk perlahan mengarah pada sosok yang tak pernah diduga.

title: Unexposed
overview: Seorang yang terkenal baik Gunawan dikejar oleh seorang pembunuh misterius, hingga akhirnya ia dibunuh dengan tragis. Namun kenyataan dibalik itu pembunuh tersebut hanya membalaskan dendamnya, orang yang punya topeng sebagai orang baik itu adalah penjahat kelamin yang yang membuat adiknya bunuh diri. Namun karena posisinya yang tinggi dan berpengaruh ia tetap bebas oleh hukum yang akhirnya sang pembunuh misterius lah yang bisa menjatuhkan hukum sosial kepadanya.

title: NAKED
overview: A married man and his mistress face a dilemma when their sex tape accidentally captures a mysterious incident they were never meant to witness during their vacation.

title: Cinematic Intelligence
overview: A film student is reluctant to take on the task of creating storyboards after having been pressured into it by his director's friend.

title: Aku, Kangen.
overview: Ardi dan Nina, pasangan penjaga warung yang menua bersama, menghadapi kabar bahwa Nina mengidap kanker serviks. Di tengah waktu yang menipis, Ardi berusaha merawat sisa waktu yang ada dengan cinta dan kenangan, meski rindu pada masa lalu tak pernah benar-benar pergi.

title: Madness
overview: Sepasang suami istri muda terjebak dalam tekanan ekonomi dan ketakutan dalam rumah tangga. Di tengah keputusasaan, mereka kehilangan akal sehat dan melakukan tindakan yang tidak normal akibat dihantui masalalu yang gelap dari hubungan mereka. Ketegangan memuncak saat ia melihat darah mengalir di paha istrinya. Panik oleh suara tangisan bayi yang mendadak berpindah, ia berlari ke dalam kamar tidur untuk mencari pertolongan. Namun, di dalam kamar ia justru mendapati boneka-boneka manekin anak yang rusak. Sebelum ia sempat keluar, sang istri membanting pintu dan menguncinya di dalam sendirian.

title: Tak Semua Tentang Dirimu
overview: Sejak kecil Raya tumbuh dengan keyakinan bahwa kepuasan diri harus diperjuangkan melalui kesempurnaan. Nilai tinggi, peringkat pertama, dan prestasi demi prestasi menjadi tujuan hidupnya demi memenuhi harapan kedua orang tuanya. Namun, di balik semua pencapaian itu, Raya justru kehilangan dirinya sendiri. Ketika impian yang selama ini dikejar ternyata tidak mampu mengisi kekosongan di hatinya, Raya mulai memahami bahwa kebahagiaan tidak selalu datang dari pengakuan orang lain.

title: Arcade Five Part One: The Different Space
originalTitle: Arcade Five Part One: The Different Space
overview: Dua orang yang terpisah oleh waktu dan tempat secara tiba-tiba. Namun salah satu diantaranya tidak tahu bahwa sesuatu yang janggal terjadi.

title: Saat Masakan Ibu Tak Lagi Hangat
originalTitle: Saat Masakan Ibu Tak Lagi Hangat
overview: Juara Terfavorit Film Drama Ilmu Komunikasi Universitas Tidar 2026  Tyas, anak gadis Rahayu, mencoba menjauh dari ibu yang ia anggap sebagai monster. Tak tahu bahwa masa depannya telah terpelihara di rumah sendiri, dendam tersingkap kala Tyas bersimpuh demi merengkuh kembali wanita yang “rela dikutuk dunia agar cahaya di mata putrinya tak pernah padam”.

title: Dua Nafas
overview: Anto was entrusted to his grandmother in the village, grew up to become a successful doctor, and then returned to make her proud—only to find that his grandmother had died while waiting for him.

title: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua #CLBK
overview: Ambar and Raka have planned their wedding and dreamed of a happy future together, just like any other couple. But their plans are put to the test when Akung Abi and Nin Sita — their grandfather and grandmother — turn out to be former lovers who parted ways 56 years ago. Since their youth, the relationship between Abi and Sita has been shaped by a past filled with stories that were never truly resolved. Without realizing it, that unfinished history begins to affect Ambar and Raka’s relationship in the present. The deeper they uncover their grandparents’ past, the more they feel that something has remained unsettled for the last 56 years.

title: Petaka Gunung Welirang
overview: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

title: Gembyeng
overview: Dua kubu yang saling bermusuhan. Satu kesalahpahaman yang memicu konflik besar.

title: Anduai Aku Bertemu Artis...
overview: Pratama Kadowa has now become a celebrity. Rehan, a teenage boy who has admired Tama since the very beginning of his content-creating journey, finally gets the opportunity to meet him after a long time. Rehan writes a film premise for Tama, which impresses him. Tama then pitches the premise to a film producer. With Tama's help, will Rehan make his dream come true?

title: Rantai Sarat
overview: Zara, a teenager from a low-income family, begins to feel left behind as she constantly compares herself to the luxurious lifestyles she sees on social media. In an effort to appear equal to her peers, she secretly turns to online loans to purchase things she cannot afford.  At first, it feels easy and risk-free. But the debt quickly spirals out of control. Bills pile up, pressure mounts, and her lies eventually unravel in front of her mother. The conflict reaches its peak when debt collectors arrive and seize the few valuable belongings they have.  Amid overwhelming guilt and the breakdown of her relationship with her mother, Zara is forced to confront a painful truth: her desire to feel “enough” has ultimately led to the destruction of her own family.

title: (B)untung
overview: Empat anak menghabiskan satu hari tanpa arah, hingga serangkaian kejadian absurd datang saat mereka sedang tidak bersama dan memaksa masing-masing menghadapi ketakutan yang bertolak belakang dengan persona mereka sendiri.

title: FANTASIA
overview: Diana is an imaginative girl who constantly runs and builds her own world out of domestic trauma. She doesn't believe in love until she encounters the anonymous who called themself as "Dewa Eros" in a note on a romance novel. This journey leads Diana to meet Cinta, the true embodiment of love.

title: Bukan Paru-Paru Basah, Bro!
overview: When his chronic cough escalates to coughing up blood, a student in denial must confront both his failing health and the severe social stigma of Tuberculosis.

title: Tanah Sengketa
overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

title: Tanah Runtuh
overview: Separated from their mother during the chaotic Poso riots, a young boy and his older brother with Down syndrome join forces with a dedicated police officer, forging an unforgettable bond as they navigate deadly conflict to find her.

title: Jangan Buang Ibu
overview: A single mother struggles to raise her three children while burdened by debt after her husband abandons the family, straining their relationships as her children try to rebuild their bond with her before it is too late.

title: i love cherry blossoms so much
originalTitle: i love cherry blossoms so much
overview: Van and Gogh have never seen cherry blossoms in person, yet they've spent their whole lives searching for the reason why they love them so much.

title: Kapsul Waktu
overview: Nina, a bright, high-achieving student, found that she wasn’t quite as smart in college as she had been. Through a time capsule she made with her older brother, Nina learned to come to terms with her past in a healthier way.

title: Mendung Panjang di Ladang
overview: Abdul Latief, a farmer based in Jagakarsa explores the challenges of farm management in post-2020 Indonesia.

title: Ampun Su Murry Ya E
overview: Amara, a civil servant and mother of eight, has long harbored bitterness stemming from a painful past—ranging from a strained relationship with her mother to the judgment of her community, which drove her further away from God. Amidst this emptiness, only Gloria—one of her children—served as a ray of spiritual light in her life, even though Amara often undervalued Gloria’s kindness. Everything began to change when a work trip brought Amara face-to-face with her cousin, Grace. Through Grace’s patience and sincerity, Amara was gradually confronted with a profound question: could there be a way out of the bitterness she had borne alone for so many years?

title: Pendar
overview: In a ruined city consumed by a lethal entity of light, a partially blind teenager and his older sister fight to survive. But when a mysterious encounter disrupts their fragile existence, they are forced to face their deepest fears and long-buried desires.

title: Tutu Teno: The Song For The Bees
originalTitle: Tutu Teno: The Song For The Bees
overview: In the hills of rural Timor Island, a traditional leader watches the bees he once trusted disappear. As their hum fades, so does the honey that sustain his community. Seasons shift, flowers bloom out of rhythm, and he holds onto songs, ceremonies, and stories that honor the bees. Protecting his people’s way of life becomes a struggle to keep nature and tradition alive in a world that is rapidly changing.

title: Nara
overview: Trapped in a constantly shifting reality, Nara launches a desperate pursuit of a mysterious figure she believes is the only way out.

title: Saujana
overview: Guided by his best friend Aradhana, Aksara practices confessing his feelings to the girl of his dreams. However, an unexpected kiss mid-rehearsal changes everything and sparks feelings he never knew existed. Even after winning his crush's heart, the success feels strange and empty. Trapped between a smile and unspoken regret, Aksara is left haunted by what could have been with Aradhana.

title: Langkah
overview: Laffet, anak kampung yang ingin merantau ke kota, berkonflik dengan bapaknya yang menolak keras keputusannya. Mamak mencoba menenangkan, tapi Laffet tetap pergi. Di kota ia bekerja, namun rindu keluarga terus menghantuinya. Saat akhirnya pulang, ia hanya menemukan rumah kosong dan tanda kehilangan yang tak bisa ia cegah.

title: Perfecting A Flaw Until Nothing Remains
originalTitle: Perfecting A Flaw Until Nothing Remains
overview: In a future ruled by algorithms, Sam (22), a young architect, undergoes a job interview with a strict AI interviewer. A series of  failed interviews leaves him trapped within algorithmic standards that grow increasingly absurd and inhuman. In his efforts to adapt to the system, Sam is forced to change his way of thinking and suppress his humanity, until he gradually loses his sense of self.

title: PERJANJIAN
overview: Dua sahabat Tono dan Ucup yang di tuntut oleh tekanan kehidupan, Tono seorang pengangguran yang harus menikahi kekasihnya, Tani. Sedangkan Ucup seorang host live guyur air tetapi sepi penonton terjerat hutang pinjol. Tono dan Ucup mencari jalan pintas dengan melakukan pesugihan babi ngepet dari buku mantra pesugihan dukun kenalan Ucup yang telah tobat. Ketika Tono dan Ucup melakukan ritual babi ngepet, mereka gagal menghadirkan babi ngepet. Namun mereka malah memanggil tuyul dan menghasilkan kekayaan dengan cepat dari sana. Hidup mereka mendadak mewah, Tono melamar Tani dan Ucup berhasil melunasi hutangnya. Namun kehidupan mereka makin tidak tenang, mereka di teror oleh makhluk lain. Kemewahan yang mereka dapatkan berubah menjadi petaka. Mereka harus memilih hidup dengan konsekuensi dari jalan pintas yang mereka pilih atau berhenti dari kehidupan mewah.

title: Saat Aku Bersuara
overview: Nadia, a bright young lawyer, finds her life shattered when her wedding is canceled at the last second. But that bitterness did not make him submit. She rose up and dedicated herself to defending women's rights. Together with her two friends, Andien and Riana, and Adrian, a Public Prosecutor who is an important part of her journey, Nadia struggles to rebuild her life, including her broken relationship with her father. As the wounds of the past slowly find their way, Nadia becomes increasingly convinced that as long as she dares to speak out and doesn't give up, hope will never be extinguished.

title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
originalTitle: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
overview: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

title: MARANDANG
overview: Ketika rendang dipahami sebagai simbol filosofi Minangkabau, muncul pertanyaan: apakah makna tersebut tumbuh dari praktik memasak itu sendiri, atau dari narasi yang dibangun setelahnya?

title: Dukun Magang
overview: Raka is a final-year student frustrated by the constant rejection of his thesis by his lecturers. Sekar, his college friend, suggests that his thesis explore the world of shamanism. Meanwhile, Mbah Djambrong is a legendary and eccentric shaman from Kalimati, a remote village renowned for its supernatural traditions, holding mysteries about humanity's relationship with the mystical and spiritual world.

title: Cerita Lila
overview: Lila, arwah seorang gadis kecil yang masih terikat pada masa lalunya, terus mencari saudari kembarnya yang hilang, Lili. Kehidupannya berubah saat Nia dan ibunya, Tari, pindah ke rumah tempat Lila berada.  Persahabatan yang terjalin antara Lila dan Nia membawa mereka pada pencarian yang perlahan membuka rahasia kelam yang lama terkubur.  Ketika kehadiran sosok Rahma mulai mengancam keselamatan mereka, Nia meminta bantuan Sara Wijayanto dan Wisnu untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik tragedi masa lalu.

title: ALIS : Kenangan Ajaib
overview: Alis, seorang anak perempuan tinggal di kampung neneknya untuk berlibur, menciptakan dunia dan teman imajinasi dari hal yang ditemukan juga ia sukai sehingga menemani dirinya pada saat menghadapi rasa kesepian karena tidak memiliki teman bermain.

title: Niscaya Gelap Gulita
overview: Dalam masyarakat distopia di mana oksigen diperdagangkan sebagai komoditas, seorang pemuda mencari informasi untuk mengungkap rahasia dunia permukaan, namun justru terjerat oleh sebuah kebenaran yang menghancurkan harapannya.

title: Pangeran Jaya Sumitra
overview: Film dokumenter sejarah Pangeran Jaya Sumitra mengangkat kisah kepahlawanan raja pertama Kerajaan Pulau Laut di Kabupaten Kotabaru, Kalimantan Selatan. Cerita berfokus pada perpindahan pusat pemerintahan ke Salino pada tahun 1850 untuk mengatur strategi menghadapi penjajah, serta menjadi media edukasi budaya lokal.

title: Garis Merah
overview: "Ajoy" a mechanic who has a high ego and prestige wants to get more money for fame and success, along with his friend "Biluy" who is also a mechanic. "Ajoy" began to plan and invite "biluy" to join him in illegal racing at night. On the other hand, the car they used in the illegal race was their customer's car which made the situation and atmosphere that night began to worry "Biluy". Until when they finished the race everything felt in vain, to the point where they had to run from the car owner's pursuit.

title: MIN(D/E)
overview: Di reruntuhan Jawa Barat pasca-bencana, Seorang anak kabur dari tempat rehabilitasi dan mencoba mencari makna dan kesejahteraan hidup.

title: Fotokopi Ramli
overview: At a small photocopy shop, Ramli spends his days reading fragments of other people's lives through the documents they leave behind. When a former high school acquaintance he once adored unexpectedly reappears, their growing friendship stirs old dreams, buried disappointments, and quiet questions about identity, failure, and the lives we choose to present to others.

title: Postpartum
overview: A new mother struggles through an exhausting day, quietly confronting the emotional weight of motherhood and the isolation that follows childbirth

title: Tak Bergeming, Tak Bergema, Tak Bersuara
overview: Seorang remaja bernama Samar menjalani hari-harinya dalam diam. Di tengah ruang-ruang yang ramai, ia tetap sendiri, seolah menjadi sosok yang tak benar-benar hadir di antara orang-orang di sekitarnya. Rutinitas yang terus berulang membuat setiap langkah terasa hampa, sementara kesunyian perlahan memenuhi pikirannya. Tanpa dialog, tanpa tujuan yang dijelaskan secara gamblang, film ini mengajak penonton menyelami perjalanan batin Samar, merekam kesepian yang tumbuh perlahan hingga menjadi bagian dari dirinya.

title: BE6IN FOREVER
overview: Arya yang kini sudah kuliah mendapati kabar kematian sahabatnya saat SMA, Asri. momen ini membawa Arya dan teman-temannya kembali mengenang masa masa saat mereka berseragam putih abu, mengingat kembali api muda pertemanan remaja yang membentuk mereka menjadi siapa mereka sekarang.

title: Kambing Kuadrat
overview: After becoming the targets of campus bullying, two starkly different college students are granted supernatural abilities based entirely on how they perceive their trauma.

title: Aku Penamu
overview: Malvin, seorang pelajar yang diam-diam mencintai teman sekelasnya Evelyn, akhirnya berhasil mendekati gadis impiannya sebuah insiden yang tidak terduga. Hubungan mereka perlahan berkembang menjadi kisah cinta yang manis. Namun, terjadi sebuah insinden yang merenggut Evelyn selamanya. Hanya tersisa kenangan dan pesan-pesan yang pernah diberikan Evelyn kepadanya, Malvin mencoba mengubah hidupnya menjadi lebih baik sebagai bukti cinta tulusnya dan sebagai cara membalas kebaikan dari Evelyn

title: 布袋戲
overview: Wayang Potehi is a cultural heritage that has long been part of Indonesia's diversity, yet it remains little known in Surabaya. Through regular performances, preservation efforts, and the sharing of knowledge, dalang Sukar Mudjiono and fellow practitioners work to ensure this traditional art form survives for future generations.

title: The Founder5 II: Unfinished Business
overview: Grander, bolder and sharper, the Founder5 returns to the stage with other talented comedians for more standup, improv and sketch comedy.

title: Dosa: Penebusan atau Pengampunan
overview: Bima and her wife, Ersya, have an accident while they're going out of the town and they are trapped in a mysterious hotel, where they are terrorized and forced to face past sins that cannot be avoided.

title: Warkop DKI: ViRaLiN dOoOoNg..!!
overview: Three best friends, Dono, Kasino, and Indro, want to get quickly rich by becoming content creators. After numerous failed attempts, they try making a horror-drama video in a remote village. However, their fake plan turns into reality when they are actually haunted by vengeful spirits. To survive, they must uncover the spirits' tragic pasts and help them get justice. Although their horror project fails, their hilarious failed videos make them viral and famous.

title: Garuda Di Dadaku
overview: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

title: Sweetness
overview: Lifelong friendship turns to peril when Ravian's deep-seated feelings for Mawar go unrequited. As his growing obsession and jealousy take over, their once-warm bond transforms into a tense and chilling dynamic, leaving him trapped in a dangerous choice between love and total destruction.

title: Into The Ocean
overview: The story follows a couple who are both pursuing their dreams of a better future, only to gradually lose the closeness they once shared. Amidst their growing distance, a filmmaker becomes increasingly consumed by his craft, unknowingly drifting further away from his personal life. This story explores relationships, ambition, time, and the choices we make to hold on to the people we love.

title: A Stranger Lover
overview: Luna, a university student living a monotonous life, meets Rey, a calm and attentive man who is always there for her. As their connection deepens, Luna begins to notice inconsistencies that leave her questioning everything. As the truth slowly unfolds, Luna is confronted with a dilemma: Is Rey real, or merely a figment of something much deeper?

title: Antara
overview: Kinantara (28), an office worker living under the weight of routine and overwhelming expectations, finds himself trapped in a cycle of life that no longer feels like his own. Every step he takes and every decision he makes seem to be revisions of someone else's script, shaping him into a person who appears successful on the outside, yet feels empty within. Through a surreal dream that brings him face-to-face with his past self, Tara is forced to confront the dark and suffocating reality of his life.

title: Sampai Semua Bebas
overview: Accused of inciting unrest through a social media post during the August 2025 protests, a young man must abandon his responsibility to care for his mother, who is recovering from a stroke, and endure a lengthy legal battle. His ordeal exposes a deeper question about freedom and justice: who is truly free under today's legal system?

title: Pool Party
overview: On a hot day, when digital activity suddenly stopped, Adek whined to her family, asking to play in the inflatable pool. But sadly, there was no running water in their house.

title: Sang Penjaga
overview: Di keriuhan pasar malam, Ardo mengikuti Ladya mencari seuntai kalung. Di sana, mereka merajut ruang aman yang asing, sebelum kenyataan menarik paksa Ardo pulang dan membiarkan Ladya memudar menjadi cahaya.

title: Selaras
overview: Laras, a curious girl who seeks the truth about her long-missing father face to face with her stepfather with different believes under Indonesia's social politics state

title: In The Name of Me
overview: inside a strict all girls Catholic dormitory, Kristy struggles with a recurring nightmare and hidden feelings for her best friend,Merry. As the Easter Tableau performance nears, she must face her own denial by playing as “Peter” the disciple who denied Jesus.

title: Anatomi Burung Hantu
overview: After speaking at a literary forum alongside renowned novelist Robert Hausu, Malik dares to send his manuscript, The Anatomy of an Owl. Driven by a longing for recognition, he slips into a gathering of writers and filmmakers at a café, where his ambition slowly collides with reality.

title: When Light Finds You
overview: After losing the people and purpose that once kept him going, Rio drifts through life with little hope for the future. Everything begins to change when he meets Anna, a cheerful young woman who encourages him to see beauty in the ordinary.  When hope finally begins to bloom, an unexpected turn of events challenges everything they have learned about life, loss, and the courage to keep moving forward.

title: Bunga-Bunga Di Jala Ikan
overview: Hit by climate change, a desperate family struggles to survive by participating in the Sedekah Rawa Pening tradition.

title: Kucing Hitam
overview: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.

title: Nobody Loves Kay
overview: Kay, a high school gamer, loses his best friend to become a pro. After a setback, he rises again and meets his rival in the Mobile Legends world finals.

title: Monster Pabrik Rambut
overview: PUTRI (Rachel Amanda) kehilangan ibunya, yang mati setelah beberapa hari tak tidur karena bekerja siang dan malam. Menurut MARYATI (Didik Nini Thowok), pemilik pabrik, ibunya mati bunuh diri. Awalnya ia percaya, tapi IDA (Lutesha), adiknya, mengatakan bahwa ibu mereka mati karena kesurupan. Untuk membuktikan omongannya, Ida memutuskan untuk lembur, tak tidur berhari-hari, demi melihat sendiri sosok hitam yang merebut tubuh ibunya. BONA (Iqbaal Ramadhan), adik bungsu mereka, memiliki kemampuan spesial. Ia mampu meregenerasi bagian tubuhnya. Sosok hitam berhasil menyandera Bona. Mampukah Putri dan Ida menyelamatkan Bona?

title: Thou, My Daughter
overview: A final-year university student moves into a boarding house run by a caring yet possessive landlady. When strange occurrences begin to disrupt her daily life, she becomes entangled in a haunting tale of loss, memory, and a mother's longing for her departed daughter.

title: Between Amber and Blue
overview: Ketika kehidupan tanpa tujuan jadi pilihan, seorang pelukis bertemu dengan gadis ceria penuh mimpi namun sekarat. Menuntutnya untuk cepat mencapai mimpi bersama di tengah persaingan ketat atau jika tidak ia akan kehilangan sang gadis yang termakan oleh penyakit.

title: Roda Sensasi
overview: David and Rosa are two content creators known for their romantic content. To regain their popularity, they created a kissing video that went viral. However, beneath the surface, there were feelings they never fully acknowledged until it was too late.

title: Pistol Berisik
overview: A Guy Randomly FInds A Gun In Front Of His House, What Will Happen Next?

title: Anak Jerapah
overview: Ruth (25), seorang penjaga playground anak tiba-tiba dihadapkan dengan tanggung  jawab dari Tono (45), sang ayah untuk mengurus , Krisna (8) adik dari ibu yang  berbeda. Ia pun harus memilih antara pergi mengejar cita-cita karirnya atau  menolong dan mengurus anak itu.

title: Sisa Kemarin
overview: Someone looking for a way to feel the presence of their deceased partner once again.

title: The Killing
overview: A hitman receives a mysterious assignment to eliminate a target in a grassy field on the outskirts of town. Behind the seemingly simple mission lies dark motives, deep hatred, and a secret slowly coming to light.

title: Paranoia C
overview: In July of 2028, thirty-four students of high school from different schools reported missing at the same time. All subjects were identified as former classroom.  Weeks later, a doll was found in their classroom....

title: Words from Another World
overview: Seorang anak laki-laki yang tidak ingin dilupakan ketika dia sudah tiada.

title: Niskala
overview: Vanessa fought to preserve the life of her unborn child, until pressure from her lover forced her to abort her most precious possession for the sake of her lover's reputation.

title: Mariana
overview: Striving to provide for her child amid a crisis, Mariana becomes entangled in a narcotics case, ultimately finding her true realization as a mother upon earning conditional release in the Jubilee Year 2025.

title: Perselingkuhan AI
overview: Rena ditinggal pergi oleh Akil yang sedang menjalani KKN, membuatnya tenggelam dalam kesepian yang perlahan menggerogoti kesehariannya. Untuk mengisi kekosongan itu, Rena mulai berkomunikasi dengan sebuah AI melalui chat. Awalnya hanya sekadar teman berbagi, tetapi seiring waktu hubungan mereka menjadi semakin intens dan terasa nyata. Tanpa disadari, kedekatan itu membawa Rena semakin dalam ke sesuatu yang gelap, sesuatu yang perlahan mengaburkan batas antara kenyataan dan ilusi, serta mengancam hidupnya.

title: Badut Gendong
overview: Darso, a clown busker, lost his wife and unborn child to thug violence. In grief, he brought his wife's body back to his village. However, the village is in chaos due to a conflict with an evil developer and a curse ritual that summons dark forces. Darso is also caught up in the evil forces connected to the person he loves most.

title: Suamiku Lukaku
overview: A devoted mother trapped in an abusive marriage finds hope through a courageous women's rights lawyer as her daughter's worsening condition forces her to fight for freedom and her child's survival.

title: Children of Heaven
overview: Ali (Jared Ali) dan Zahra (Humairah Jahra), sepasang kakak-beradik yang hidup di bawah garis kemiskinan, terpaksa bergantian menggunakan sepasang sepatu untuk bersekolah setelah sepatu Zahra hilang. Demi menjaga rahasia itu dari orang tuanya, Ali mengikuti lomba lari dengan satu harapan sederhana: memenangkan sepasang sepatu untuk adiknya.

title: Sekawan Limo 2: Gunung Klawih
overview: Three years after climbing Mount Madyopuro, Andrew and his friends reunite when an occult ritual threatens his family and draws them to Mount Klawih.

title: AKHIRNYA
overview: Seorang laki-laki yang merantau merasakan sesuatu yang berbeda dari dirinya ketika mulai ditinggal oleh orang tuanya.

title: Rumah Hening
overview: A father's dilemma between protecting his daughter or his homeland.

title: Strawberry Shortcake
overview: Dahlia, a college student, is ready to end her life on the campus bridge on her birthday, until she unexpectedly meets Tisha, a classmate she barely knows. What begins as a brief encounter slowly unfolds into a night of quiet conversations, leading her to question everything she had planned.

title: THE CHAMELEON WHO FORGOT ITS COLOR
originalTitle: THE CHAMELEON WHO FORGOT ITS COLOR
overview: HIRA hidup dengan terus menyesuaikan dirinya terhadap lingkungan di sekitarnya hingga perlahan kehilangan identitas aslinya. Dalam perjalanan batinnya, fragmen masa kecil yang penuh kebebasan dan kejujuran terus muncul sebagai bayangan yang menghantuinya

title: Perkara Bulu Ini
overview: Ken, a normies who has a Furry friend, is curious about his Furry friend's strange hobby. To answer his curiosity, he became directly involved in the Furry community with his Furry friends to find the essence of the Furry community.

title: Intel Tepi Gerobak
overview: An intelligence agent, a target, and an ordinary citizen meet at the edge of a meatball cart. What will happen?

title: Marionette
overview: Nazwa, seorang mahasiswi desain berbakat yang terjebak dalam siksaan mental keluarganya sendiri. Ia terus-menerus ditekan oleh ibunya dan direndahkan oleh ayahnya, diperlakukan layaknya boneka tak bernyawa demi ambisi dan gengsi semata.

title: Tandampalik: Si Putri Luwu
overview: Di balik kemegahan Kerajaan Luwu, tersimpan kisah pilu seorang putri yang dianggap membawa kutukan.  Akankah Putri Tandampalik menemukan harapan, atau justru tenggelam dalam kutukan yang menghantuinya?

title: Memang Kalian Tahu Apa?
overview: SKYANTARA, berusia 19 tahun dan sedang dalam proses kelulusan, Sky adalah anak yang  mengalami Enosiofobia namun ia tidak menyadarinya. Sky anak pendiam, sedari kecil  lingkup pertemanannya berputar pada Nebula dan Aditya. Di dunia digital ini phobia yang  diidapnya semakin menjadi. Ia merasa setiap orang di dunia selalu menatap dan  membicarakannya. Realitas digital yang ia alami seperti tertuang di kehidupan nyata. Sky  mencoba berdamai dengan dirinya. Dengan monokrom, dalam dunia digital yang ada dalam  pikirannya.

title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
originalTitle: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

title: Sangkar Yang Berpindah
overview: Lasi, perempuan desa yang terluka oleh pengkhianatan, memilih meninggalkan desa dan masa lalunya. Namun, jalan yang membawanya pada kemewahan justru menjeratnya pada rasa sakit yang tak jauh beda.  Di tengah kehidupan yang tampak sempurna, hadir kembali seseorang dari masa lalu yang membangkitkan harapan yang sempat padam. Kini, Lasi harus menghadapi pilihan antara bertahan dalam kenyamanan semu atau mencari kebebasan yang selama ini dicarinya

title: Sienna In Red
overview: A woman trapped inside a locked room desperately attempts to escape, only to drown as the space slowly floods, before realizing that the key to her freedom has been with her all along.

title: Gudang Merica
overview: Belum diketahui.

title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Hama
overview: Trapped in a financially strained household where she is treated more like a servant than a wife, a young woman forces her conflicted husband to choose between his overbearing family and their marriage.

title: Kamu Harus Mati
overview: Meta has been haunted by hallucinations since the death of her boyfriend. She feels terrorized by spirits, but her two best friends assume she's mentally ill, straining their relationship. As the terror intensifies and threatens her friends as well, Meta sets out to uncover the truth behind the events, even as she faces doubts about whether they're real or just hallucinations.

title: A Portrait of Blue
overview: To complete a school assignment about family, Ayi (9)—a mischievous little girl—must overcome her intense aversion to her grandmother's pungent breath to learn how to paint. However, her struggle only results in her painting a solid blue canvas, earning her a zero at school.

title: Meledak di Pesta Ulang Tahun
overview: Since childhood, Bombom only wanted a birthday party. But an “illness” that makes him explode when he's too happy forced him to live in fear of happiness itself.

title: Giliran
overview: Amid her struggles to meet daily needs, Atun is faced with the pressure of hosting a prayer gathering at her home, forcing her to find a way to cover her daughter’s school expenses.

title: Sebuah Dongeng Tentang Bumi dan Bulan
originalTitle: Sebuah Dongeng Tentang Bumi dan Bulan
overview: A mother tells a fairy tale about the Moon Warrior who must save the Earth by accepting and refusing his requests according to his pact with the Star Devil to her daughter.

title: Cacing Biru
overview: Agung's seemingly neverending obsession for finding an alien blue worm after seeing it in his dream drives Bima, a film student's obsession for becoming a film director to make it his documentary group assigment's topic.

title: Tercetak Tertancap Terkenang
overview: Seorang siswa yang ingin membeli Topi untuk upacara terakhirnya, namun Teringat semasa ia Sekolah karena bingkai foto yang terkenang.

title: 異国の親友
overview: A Vietnamese and an Indonesian converse in Japanese about their cultures and struggles, while quietly searching for a sense of purpose in their own lives.

title: Delivery
overview: J (23), an agent who wishes to return to a normal life, is assigned one final mission by his superior: to go undercover as an illegal courier. He sneaks into the environment to take down the drug dealers. At first, J enjoys his work. However, as time goes on, he carries out his duties reluctantly. He tries to quit his job, but doubts always linger in his mind. All that pressure left J unsure of what to do, and it was his own choices that trapped him in a dangerous cycle. There was one final mission for J and it truly became his last, because everything changed when his identity was exposed during that final mission.

title: GEMA
overview: Drowning in guilt after the loss of her brother, Nova finds an unexpected presence that helps her finally embrace her path.

title: Datang dan Diundang
overview: Three young people, namely Ahmad, Bumi, Ananta, with different backgrounds but all skeptical about mystical things, decided to take part in a series of mediumization processes to prove whether supernatural phenomena are just projections of human imagination, or are truly real.

title: Keluarga Bencana
overview: Di rumah kecil yang juga menjadi toko fotokopi, Coki dan Anggun hidup sederhana bersama Kelik dan Ayu. Karena selalu kekurangan ruang dan waktu berdua, mereka berharap bisa menikmati kebersamaan saat Kelik pergi study tour. Namun rencana itu terancam gagal, hingga menghadapi kejadian tak terduga yang menguji kebersamaan keluarga.

title: Sampai Tujuan
overview: Mega spends her days working as an online motorcycle taxi driver, navigating the harsh streets while caring for her sick child. An unexpected event gradually brings to light a secret she has kept hidden all this time. In the end, it is revealed that everything she has done was simply to fulfill her child’s one final request.

title: The House After You
overview: A single father fearing abandonment must learn to let go of his only daughter as her wedding approaches, similar feelings conjuring up images of his late wife who helped him let go of his daughter.

title: Saksi Tengah Malam
overview: Di sebuah laundry rumahan, Asih terpaksa harus bertahan hidup ketika dua pembunuh memasuki rumahnya karena ia tidak sengaja menjadi saksi pembunuhan yang mereka lakukan.

title: “Vaterland” or A Bule Named Yanto
overview: When German-Indonesian Yanto (mid 20s) visits his younger sister in Yogyakarta, he expects a simple reunion – until he realises she belongs more effortlessly than he ever has. As envy and dissonance between siblings surface, Yantos journey becomes a bittersweet exploration of mixed-race identity.

title: Entah Sampai Kapan
overview: Dua saudara hidup dalam keterbatasan. Sang kakak, Nina (20) menanggung hidup adiknya, Dayat (15) yang masih duduk di bangku SMP. Debt collector datang ingin menyita rumah mereka karena utang ayah yang ditinggalkan. Terdesak oleh keadaan, Nina mengambil keputusan yang menghancurkan harga dirinya, ia menjual tubuhnya secara diam-diam di rumahnya sendiri. Karena pekerjaan itu dilakukan di rumah, tetangga mereka mulai curiga dan bertanya kepada Dayat tentang pria asing yang sering berkunjung, namun Nina selalu menghindar dari pertanyaan itu.  Hingga akhirnya pekerjaan Nina terbongkar ketika Dayat menyaksikan sendiri Nina menjual dirinya ke pria asing dikamar rumah mereka.  Dayat mempertanyakan kelakuan Nina yang menurutnya kotor dan memalukan. Dalam keadaan sadar, Nina mengakui bahwa yang ia lakukan karena tekanan hidup. Ia memilih mengorbankan dirinya agar Dayat tetap bisa bersekolah, dan melunasi utang ayah.

title: Hai, Linda
overview: A naughty young man who is lazy about worship is forced to go to church to comply with his parents' demands and his desire to get to know a female church servant who really hates his appearance.

title: Bapak-Bapak Tidak Bercerita
overview: Satu persatu rahasia yang tidak pernah diceritakan Bapak terungkap ketika ketiga anaknya berusaha membuka ponsel Bapak yang baru saja meninggal.

title: Jakarta Sunless
overview: Jakarta, 2045, a world without the sun. On her younger sister’s birthday, Jenas, a hydroponic farmer finally wins a raffle prize—AlfaSur, an artificial sun capable of curing the illness afflicting her sister, Athira. Jenas has to go to the Luminos clinic to get the AlfaSur.  While out selling vegetables, she discovers that the AlfaSur might be linked to the death of one of her customers. Driven by saving her dying sister, Jenas decides to go anyway.  even though there might be danger lurking behind her win.

title: Saksi Kunci
overview: A powerful politician secretly tortures his aide, relying on a supernatural key that whispers what it senses from others. When the aide refuses to surrender and disappears, a former soldier is recruited as the replacement. Realizing he can hear the key speak, the former soldier strikes a deal with the key to uncover the truth behind the aide's disappearance.

title: Udah Boleh Check Out
overview: A Gen Z who thrives on social media and loves creating content gets fired from her job because of her excessive obsession with content creation. She then becomes a social media admin at a traditional weaving workshop, where the job only fuels her ambition to become a content creator.  Driven by her impulsive ambition, she focuses heavily on increasing sales without understanding the production process behind the woven fabrics. She sees sales figures as the ultimate measure of success, and her growing numbers only inflate her ego and create tension with her coworkers.  Everything changes when she witnesses the production process firsthand and sees elderly artisans patiently weaving each piece by hand. In the silence of her thoughts, she finally begins to understand the meaning of weaving and the long, painstaking process behind every piece.

title: Dear, All Robots
overview: A corporate robot stuck in an endless cycle of work must confront his forgotten dreams after a chance encounter with a stray orange cat changes his perspective on life.

title: Mothers Are Mothering
overview: Nia, 50, in an abusive marriage navigates a fragmented inner world where desire, memory, and ritual intertwine. A reunion with a former lover reawakens intimacy but exposes the persistence of violence and entrapment. As reality dissolves into hallucination, she reaches for a final, elusive escape.

title: Annisa
overview: In a crowded housing complex, Anissa, a blind teenage girl navigates a world mainly shaped by sound. As a neighborhood national day celebration unfolds around her, she finds an unexpected way to be heard, reclaiming her place within the noise that surrounds her.

title: Original Wound
overview: After their mother’s death, a brother and sister remain in the house shaped by her control, negotiating conflicting memories of abuse and care. As ritual, body, and memory intertwine, their grief exposes a deeper entrapment, one that persists beyond her absence.

title: Holy Crowd
overview: After Ratna rises from the dead during her funeral, her silent body begins performing unexplained healings, turning her husband Arif into the reluctant center of a growing frenzy. As villagers, opportunists, and religious authorities descend, faith and exploitation collide, and the miracle spirals beyond control.

title: Silent Dance: Tarian Jiwa-jiwa yang Merdeka
originalTitle: Silent Dance: Tarian Jiwa-jiwa yang Merdeka
overview: Demi menyambung hidup, Dewi (Kezia Starbe) bekerja di sebuah studio tari. Bakat menarinya terungkap saat sang pelatih memergokinya berlatih diam-diam setelah studio tutup. Dewi berhasil melakukan gerakan sulit yang gagal dikuasai oleh penari utama, Meggy (Chelsea Starbe). Dewi pun ditunjuk menggantikan Meggy untuk tampil di acara Pesta Rakyat. Keputusan ini memicu amarah Meggy, dan konflik di antara keduanya semakin memanas ketika pacar Dewi berselingkuh dengan Meggy. Di sisi lain, Pesta Rakyat tersebut rupanya dimanfaatkan oleh ayah Meggy, Gurniwa (Aroel Swara), sebagai ajang kampanye pemilihan Kepala Desa. Di balik pencalonannya, Gurniwa memiliki agenda terselubung bersama seorang investor. Ia berencana merampas lahan desa adat untuk dialihfungsikan menjadi hotel dan apartemen mewah, mengancam impian dan usaha warga setempat yang tengah membangun kampung wisata.

title: Urban Legend Mariaban: Kisah Tanah Kalimantan
originalTitle: Urban Legend Mariaban: Kisah Tanah Kalimantan
overview: For generations, the residents of a remote village in Kalimantan have upheld a sacred tradition of making offerings to the Mariaban—an ancient ritual believed to guarantee an abundant harvest. But when this deeply rooted custom is broken, the Mariaban's terrifying wrath is unleashed. One by one, lives are violently claimed, and the nights descend into an endless, waking nightmare.

title: Semua Akan Baik-Baik Saja
overview: After their mother Mentari passes away, a group of estranged siblings must move in with their older brother Langit, forcing them to confront their personal struggles and heal old wounds to rediscover the true meaning of family.

title: Yang Lain Boleh Hilang Asal Kau Jangan
originalTitle: Yang Lain Boleh Hilang Asal Kau Jangan
overview: Kesha, a final-year film student, lives in a warm family with her mother who also her beloved teacher, Yuke. However, their lives change when Yuke begins to experience increasingly severe memory loss. Amidst this, Kesha is faced with a major dilemma, continue pursuing her dreams or return home to avoid missing out on moments with her mother before it's too late.

title: Tumbal Proyek
overview: While investigating their father’s death inside a major bridge construction company, Yuda and his family attempt to prove that the frequent, deadly workplace accidents are actually human sacrifices.

title: Cinta Amatiran
overview: Industri film Indonesia dimulai oleh amatiran: belajar di jalan, ikut teman, dan urunan penderitaan. Ini kisah kenapa mereka masih bikin film.

title: Chī Fàn Le,
overview: Seorang pria mengenakan pakaian wanita, berdandan layaknya  wanita dan melakukan pekerjaan rumah seperti wanita rumah  tangga.

title: Janda Golden
overview: Seorang janda berusia 50 tahun di Makassar yang gemar pamer emas berusaha mati-matian menutupi utang emasnya demi tetap terlihat kaya, namun justru terjebak dalam rangkaian kejadian komedi yang mengancam menjatuhkannya ke jurang kemiskinan.

title: 2SIDE
overview: Bagaimana jika dengan satu voice note sarkastik tentang ketua himpunannya dapat menghasilkan sesuatu hal yang tak terduga? Dengan dibantu dua sahabatnya untuk menghapus pesan memalukan itu dari ponsel sang ketua sebelum rapat besar dimulai!

title: Putri Dongeng
