overview: Di balik kerasnya kehidupan jalanan, Putri menjalani hidup dengan berjualan jalangkote bersama kakaknya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Dira, seorang anak sekolah yang mencintai dunia dongeng. Semenjak pertemuan mereka di depan sekolah, dari lembar demi lembar cerita, Putri mulai mengenal mimpi yang selama ini terasa jauh darinya sekolah, membaca, dan memiliki kehidupan yang lebih baik. Namun ketika persahabatan mereka mulai tumbuh, perbedaan dunia yang mereka jalani mulai menghadirkan kenyataan yang tidak sederhana. Di tengah luka dan keterbatasan, Putri harus menemukan keberanian untuk tetap percaya pada dongeng yang ingin ia ciptakan sendiri.

title: Bolpoin
overview: A short film where a normal ballpoint witnesses its owner, a middle schooler who's known to be smart and diligent, get carried away in life.

title: 'Ain
overview: Driven by childhood traumas of neglect and severe body image issues, a prominent beauty influencer's obsessive pursuit of online validation triggers a devastating spiritual curse, resulting in a gruesome physical deterioration that challenges her vanity.

title: Shaka Oh Shaka
overview: A simple college student's life changes overnight when a chance meeting at a concert blossoms into a romance with her idol, but their deep bond is soon tested by the harsh realities and pressures of his fame.

title: The Bell: Panggilan Untuk Mati
overview: When a stolen bell unleashes the vengeful ghost of Panebok in Belitong, a shaman’s last descendant must recover the artifact and master forbidden rituals to stop its bloody rampage—before nine lives are claimed, including his own.

title: Rizal
overview: A serial killer struggles with an identity crisis, psychosis, and a toxic relationship. He’s trying to find a way to live a calmer, more peaceful life.

title: Cinta Tanpa Tapi
overview: The art blood attracted Arika to Gatta who was passionate about dance. However, her mother did not like her being attracted to the world of dance, especially loving a dancer.

title: Life Changes
overview: Maulana mendapat ajakan untuk batal puasa di siang hari, kejadian tersebut membawa Maulana mengingat kembali masa hidupnya.

title: Garlic's Revenge
overview: BAWANG PUTIH HAS HAD ENOUGH OF THEIR BULLSH*T!!!

title: Polisi Dadakan
overview: An impromptu police enters a forest with his partner to catch the village sandal thief.

title: Tentang Ibu
overview: A Film student asked his mother the meaning of the word "mother".

title: Gio Love
overview: A boy in a world of pure fantasy ventures for his love that he covets, Gio. Yet, this boy isn't the only one.

title: Hari Sial
overview: One of the issues currently gaining attention among young people is climate change that happens suddenly, abruptly, and unexpectedly. The younger generation is among the groups most vulnerable to the negative impacts of climate change. This can place a burden on their quality of life and mental health. In addition, data from the World Bank states that one in seven young people in Indonesia is unemployed and facing financial pressure. It is this double burden that becomes the main focus of our film, which carries the theme of social justice for all Indonesians.

title: Langit Senja
overview: Langit, seorang pria yang baru saja kehilangan cinta sejatinya, merasa hidupnya  hancur. Dalam pelarian emosionalnya, ia mengubur dirinya sendiri, menenggelamkan  kesedihannya dalam amarah, alkohol, dan ilusi yang ia ciptakan untuk dirinya sendiri. Dalam  keputusasaan itu, ia mulai menarik diri dari dunia nyata dan membangun ruang di dalam  pikirannya, tempat di mana segala sesuatu terasa lebih lembut dan menenangkan.  Di dunia itu, seorang wanita muncul. Sebuah visi cinta yang telah lama sirna. Sosok  lembut yang menemaninya, berbicara dan tertawa. Bagi Langit, dia adalah kehidupan itu  sendiri, satu-satunya

title: 5 Stages of Silence
overview: Ammar, a high school student haunted by a dark past, becomes afraid to socialize and gradually shuts himself off from the people around him. He goes through the five stages of silence.

title: The Wheel of Life
overview: Having left home due to the trauma of an abusive father, Jodi lives alone to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer. Despite her ambition and independence, inner wounds and resentment from her past continue to haunt her. However, a simple conversation with a customer slowly opens Jodi's eyes to parental ego and forgiveness. Instead of being haunted by anger, Jodi learns to reconcile with her past to break the chain of trauma, proving she can create a safe and supportive space for the next generation.

title: Felai FX - Trader Gelap: Apa Mau Takut
originalTitle: Felai FX - Trader Gelap: Apa Mau Takut
overview: The dark world of cybercrime and illegal gambling, specifically focusing on "scammer" activities involving online gambling and forex (foreign exchange) investments. The plot centres on the high-stakes operations of these criminal syndicates including significant "plot twists" that are expected to surprise audiences.

title: Kupeluk Kamu Selamanya
overview: Naya, a tough mother who lives her life with one main goal, ensuring that her son, Aksa, has a future far better than anything she has ever experienced.

title: Dilan ITB 1997
overview: Dilan is an ITB student who returned from Cuba in March 1997. In the midst of the heated political situation leading up to the Reformation.

title: Ikatan Darah
overview: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

title: Kesempatan/Kesempitan
overview: A careless college student named Panca lives in constant delay, ignoring his prayers and convincing himself there is always more time, while his disciplined roommate Wahyu reminds him that time is precious;

title: 'til we meet again
overview: a grumpy cook with a not so flavourful life meets a cat that bothers her every now and then.

title: Antarala
overview: A young student, eager to make his mark at the school talent show, finds himself at odds with the trend of his peers who lean toward globalized, modern performances. Feeling disconnected from their style, he dives into a digital search for something deeper—only to rediscover the forgotten power of his own cultural heritage.

title: Berderap
overview: Film "Berderap" menceritakan seorang anak laki-laki memiliki minat besar dalam seni tari. Namun, minatnya sering diremehkan oleh orang-orang di sekitarnya. Meski menghadapi berbagai penolakan dan keraguan, ia tetap berusaha mengembangkan kemampuannya. Dengan tekad, kerja keras, dan keberanian, ia ingin membuktikan bahwa dirinya mampu berprestasi melalui seni tari serta menunjukkan bahwa tari tidak hanya milik perempuan, tetapi juga bisa menjadi ruang ekspresi bagi laki-laki. [Official Selection - 10 Besar Nasional Festival Film Pelajar 57 Production 2026]

title: A Distant Call
overview: In the ancient Bugis way of life in Indonesia, gender non-binary 'bissu' were once revered spiritual leaders. Eka, one of the last remaining bissu, decides to leave behind their identity, searching for belonging in a world that insists on definitions.

title: Rumah di Ujung Bahu
overview: Seorang pemuda rantau yang hidup sebagai yatim piatu berjuang seorang diri ditengah perantauan untuk melanjutkan pendidikan di kampusnya tersebut.

title: What the Water Keeps
overview: After losing his family to the sea, Bahar returns to the sea where the tragedy struck—not for resolution, but presence.

title: Kupilih Jalur Langit
overview: Thrilled to enter an arranged marriage with the cleric she has long admired, a spirited young woman's happiness fades when her new husband refuses to touch her, forcing her to investigate whether his silence hides a secret illness or a lingering love for another woman.

title: Para Perasuk
overview: In a town where pleasure equals being possessed by spiritual beings, Bayu aspires to be the shaman of a trance party so he can fundraise enough money to prevent an impending eviction.

title: Songko
overview: After her family is banished from their village over accusations that her beloved stepmother can transform into a supernatural creature, a young girl fights to clear their names and restore their honour.

title: Ruang Sesak
overview: Dimalam ritual kematian suaminya, INDAY (43) seorang ibu dan juga istri seorang pembelian, berjuang mempertahankan ruang hidup terakhir keluarganya ketika ladang, sumber identitas dan kehidupan mereka di kelola oleh perusahaan, membuat adat tak bisa dijalankan dan masa depan anaknya terancam hilang

title: Tanah Tua: Yang Tak Terlihat Oleh Kota
originalTitle: Tanah Tua: Yang Tak Terlihat Oleh Kota
overview: Di tengah hutan purba Tana Toa, Ikhsan, seorang anak berusia sepuluh tahun dan cucu mantan pemimpin adat, tumbuh sebagai penjaga tradisi dan alam. Kamera mengikuti langkah kakinya yang polos namun tegas, mengajak penonton masuk ke dunia masyarakat Kajang yang memegang teguh nilai leluhur di tengah ancaman modernisasi. Film dokumenter ini menyandingkan ketenangan hutan dan kearifan lokal dengan hiruk pikuk kota, membentuk kontras visual dan emosional yang mempertajam pesan: kemajuan tidak selalu berarti meninggalkan akar. Melalui observasi intim, suara alam, dan penjelasan sejarah yang kelam oleh sejarawan, “Tanah Tua: Yang Tak Terlihat Oleh Kota” menjadi refleksi tentang hubungan manusia dengan bumi, sekaligus peringatan atas rapuhnya budaya yang terpinggirkan.

title: Kukata Miti
overview: Spanning the forests of Germany, Indonesia, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, this layered essay in visual and political anthropology explores the diverse practices, tools, and motives behind timber exploitation

title: A Man Who’s Sleep On His Call
originalTitle: A Man Who’s Sleep On His Call
overview: Ethan spend most of his life in the bedroom, isolated and doesn’t have any connections to the outside world. Then, his little brother, Edgar, called him through the phone and made a far connections, and they were even have a plan to meet together again after several years not met.

title: Denouement
overview: Tentang Laskar, pemuda yang mengidap skizofrenia dan short-term memory yang memiliki perasaan mendalam kepada Luna, wanita cantik teman sebangkunya, ketika ia menyatakan perasaan nya, ternyata Laskar telah berkali-kali menyatakan perasaan kepada Luna, yang dimana Luna ternyata telah memiliki kekasih bernama Neil, setelah mendapat penolakan, Laskar pun kecewa dan memutuskan untuk melampiaskan kekecewaan nya.

title: Last Dance : A Day to Remember
originalTitle: Last Dance : A Day to Remember
overview: Nizar, a high school student, plans to skip his last day of school. However, he changes his mind and ends up spending time with his friends.

title: Snakes and Surf Breaks
overview: In search of waves and one of Indonesia’s most elusive reptiles, this film blends risky field research, road trip filmmaking and faux documentary into a moving story of friendship and obsession that explores our complicated relationships with each other and the natural world. An amateur team’s journey across the Indonesian archipelago in search of a cobra, takes them through some of the thickest tropical jungles, flooded caves, remote coastlines and dense urban sprawls of one of the world's fastest-growing countries. Capturing all the moments of tension, chaos and absurdity that comes with a wild and mostly unplanned chase.

title: Sandekala
overview: The deaths of children in the village are believed to be due to the Sandekala myth, a time considered terrifying in the afternoon. Bayan is a child who has lost his friends. However, behind this incident, it turns out there is a dark secret: a soil-fertilization ritual. Slowly, the truth is revealed, including who is behind all the deaths.

title: Gelap 'kan Habis Terang 'kan Datang
overview: The story follows Pati Amar, a young Malay man who wants to change the elders’ rules regarding education—which is considered forbidden in their village—and must face his own father’s anger.  Meanwhile, Hamidah shares the same dream as Pati Amar; she wants to change the rules regarding child marriage in their village and demand gender equality, just like the heroine she idolizes, R.A. Kartini.

title: Dalam Sujudku
overview: Aisyah had a harmonious long-distance marriage until she discovered her husband, Farid, was having an affair. Wounded and devastated, she was faced with the choice of staying or leaving. In the midst of despair, Aisyah turned to God for strength and guidance, though the path to forgiveness and family restoration was not easy.

title: Tiba Tiba Setan
overview: A sibling visit an abandoned hotel in search of their father's treasure. Initially, the terror is thought to be a hoax by a hotel guard hired to pose as a ghost, but things change when the spirit of a woman murdered in the hotel actually rises and haunts them. Now they must fight to survive this supernatural terror.

title: Ghost in the Cell
overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

title: Medium Rare
overview: Medium Rare bercerita tentang seorang pria yang menyajikan sebuah daging dengan cara pada umumnya: membumbui, memasak, hingga akhirnya menikmatinya.

The journey of Bayu, a final-semester university student whose days are usually filled with laughter alongside Rizki and Rizal, slowly begins to change as the hope of seeing his beloved team win the championship fades away. In the midst of isolation, he faces emotional and spiritual struggles, until he finally realizes that there is something far more valuable than anything else.

title: Selfish Wants
overview: A nonprofit independent film created by aspiring creatives!  After his friend's sudden victory from her competition, Our main protagonist finds himself trying to suppress his jealousy and selfish thoughts as he slowly descends deeper in the dark areas of his mind.

title: Terpaut Janji Kecil
overview: After her mother's departure, Adira tries to keep the promise she made to her mother to look after her younger sibling. However, her own trauma and fear lead her to take the wrong steps and strain their relationship.

title: Dari Balik Dinding
overview: Seorang perempuan muda yang memiliki trauma korban kekerasan masa kecil, menyadari bahwa telah terjadi KDRT pada tetanga sebelah rumahnya. Perempuan itu mengalami dilema yang mendalam, apakah ia harus bertindak dan mencegah hal yang tidak diinginkan terjadi, atau harus bersikap tidak acuh karena merasa itu bukan tanggung jawabnya.

title: HOME AT FIVE
overview: Seorang ayah yang meyakini bahwa disiplin keras adalah bentuk cinta, tanpa menyadari bahwa  dominasi dan kontrol yang ia anggap benar justru menghancurkan dunia batin sang anak — hingga  suatu peristiwa memaksa keduanya melihat kebenaran dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

title: SMILE!
overview: Juna,seorang pemuda yang putus asa karena masalah ekonomi dan percintaan ingin memperbaiki hidupnya lewat sebuah aplikasi yang menawarkannya pada kesuksesan secara instan.

title: Info Loker
overview: Hardi is a jobless broke guy who is looking for a job, until one day he "accidentally" meets his old friend who now works as an illegal parking attendant. That meeting brings him to the job he was looking for, but the job is informal and has an unfavorable system.

title: Langit
overview: Langit, menerima kontrak yang menjanjikan jalan keluar dari hutang ibunya, namun pilihannya untuk membuktikan diri justru menyeretnya ke dalam kehancuran yang jauh lebih besar.

title: Lily
overview: A girl finds comfort in someone she believes is her home; until love slowly turns into something that takes more than it gives.

title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
originalTitle: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
overview: Raised in the shadow of an emotionally distant father, a young woman must step up during a family crisis and navigate the burdens of adulthood without the guidance she always craved.

title: Warung Pocong
overview: Three young men — Kartono, Agus, and Makmur — accept jobs at a food stall without knowing that they will be used as scapegoats.

title: Yohanna
overview: A young nun's encounter with the underworld of child labor in Sumba restores her sense of purpose in life.

title: Deadline
overview: A peaceful night turns into an adrenaline fueled nightmare for Rahman, a student who is casually enjoying his downtime in front of his editing monitor. Everything shifts drastically when a group chat notification abruptly announces that his project deadline has been moved up to 8:00 AM the next morning even though he hasn't started a single thing. Trapped in a late-night panic, Rahman must race against the clock, his rendering software, and overwhelming exhaustion. The film captures the classic, universal struggle of a deadline warrior, culminating in a hilariously ironic twist.

title: Rumah Duka
overview: Seorang pria yang bekerja keras demi memenuhi syarat memiliki rumah sebelum menikah, tanpa dia sadari ambisinya perlahan menjauhkan dirinya dari hal paling berharga dalam hidupnya.

title: Invisible Color
overview: A white colored pencil struggles to prove its worth after being dismissed as useless because its color never appears on paper.

title: When Stillness Trembles
overview: Setelah mendengar pengumuman mengenai pembangunan ulang, Yayun—seorang pria yang tinggal di sebuah bangunan tua—diminta untuk membantu membereskan barang-barang di bangunan tersebut; hal ini secara tidak langsung mendorongnya untuk pergi. Namun, ada banyak hal yang membuat Yayun tidak bisa meninggalkan tempat itu.

title: ᬫᬾᬭᬳ᭄ᬤᬭᬳ᭄ᬓᬸ ᬧᬸᬢᬶᬳ᭄ᬫᬦᬶᬫᬸ
overview: Between the blurred lines of the seen and the unseen, Melati brings her American boyfriend, Sam, on a homecoming trip to Bali. When Melati starts wailing in her sleep, the Island of the Gods responds by revealing Sam’s true colors. Their relationship is put to the test as his sunburn worsens and she believes him to be possessed.

title: Tropenkolder
overview: If cinema symbolized progress in the 20* century, the railway delivered it. Tropenkolder explores the entanglement between phantom ride films - shot with cameras mounted on moving trains to document the landscape - and the 1923 railway workers strike in Java.

title: Silap Mata Bayang Berbalam
overview: Haunted by nostalgia for a place they never knew, gallery workers steal a Mooi Indië landscape painting and drive towards the sea.

title: Let's Talk About the Film Wonderen uit Pygmy-Land
originalTitle: Let's Talk About the Film Wonderen uit Pygmy-Land
overview: 1926 marked the Dutch and American colonial expedition to Dutch New Guinea, later documented in Matthew W. Stirling's film By Aeroplane to Pygmyland (1927). Mahardika Yudhas latest film Let's Talk About the Film Wonderen uit Pygmy-Land documents the exhibition, discussions, and informal conversations he staged in Jayapura in August 2025 to revisit the infamous expedition and its lingering repercussions in Papua, Indonesia. In this research sketch, he maps the aesthetics of colonial film and how they continue to infiltrate Indonesian cinema and interpretations of history more than a century later. Yudha reflects on how these decidedly one-sided colonial archives can be used to recuperate lost traces of Papuan heritage and form a new basis for Papuan cinema today.

title: Aku Harus Mati
overview: Jalan cerita masih belum diungkap.

title: The Hostage's Hero
overview: Ship hijackings in the Malacca Strait are on the rise and attracting global attention. Lieutenant Colonel Taufiq is reassigned to Indonesia to lead a maritime patrol aboard the KRI Karel Satsuitubun. While on their mission, they face the hijacking of the MT Pematang tanker by a group of pirates. Amidst the dangerous task, the soldiers are faced with a dilemma between national responsibility and family.

title: Sebuah Hadiah
overview: Mengikuti cerita Sonia, seorang siswi Sekolah Menengah Atas (SMA) yang tengah berduka akibat kehilangan sosok sang kakak. Dalam masa berkabungnya, Sonia memutuskan untuk melanjutkan kehidupannya perlahan, dan menghormati sang kakak lewat janji memenangkan lomba fotografi.

title: Bunga Kesayangan Bapak
overview: When her grades start slipping, Bunga, who’s carrying heavy trauma from home, begins getting called out by the school.

title: Waktu Luang
overview: A 70 year old mother's birthday was marked by the presence off her daughter despite being limited by the long distance.

title: I Don't Want to Go Home
originalTitle: I Don't Want to Go Home
overview: A curious little mouse dreads going home to loneliness, finding comfort instead in the lively community of his school. Every day, he tries to blend in with every group the jocks, the nerds, the goths hoping to be accepted, yet never truly feeling like he belongs. But perhaps today will be different. Perhaps today is the day he finally discovers where he truly belongs.

title: Followers
overview: Nia (27), seorang influencer yang bermimpi memiliki ribuan pengikut di media social sedang melakukan live streaming kunjungannya ke tempat hidden gem di Jakarta, seketika takut ketika mengetahui dirinya sedang diikuti oleh penggemarnya di dunia nyata. Namun ternyata hal itu membawanya kepada ketercapaian impiannya, dan membuatnya memikirkan kembali konten yang bisa menghantarkannya kepada popularitas.

title: Dalam Pelukan Waktu
overview: On the day of his daughter’s wedding, Sumarna, a father who has raised Indah on his own since she was a child, is confronted with a moment he never truly prepared himself for: letting go.  During the short journey to the venue, silence and small conversations slowly reveal the vulnerability they have kept buried for so long. Through nervousness, gentle laughter, and tears that finally break free, the two come to acknowledge the love that has never faded between them.

title: BACK N REPLAY*
overview: The expectations he imagined about his new dormitory residents were the same as those in his old dormitory—friendly and kind. However, reality turns out to be the exact opposite of his hopes. Will everything slowly change for the better, or will it instead get worse?

title: Pulkam
overview: Rispo, a single parent living in a small rented house with his child, struggles through life with many limitations. Every day, he simply tries to survive.  When life feels increasingly difficult, bad news comes from his hometown: his mother has fallen seriously ill and hopes Rispo can return before it’s too late. Rispo then does everything he can to make it back home.  Will Rispo succeed in returning home and meeting his mother?

title: Selamat Malam, Selamat Tinggal
overview: at 2 AM in the morning, A guy called his sister, Co-worker, and his old best friend from high school.

title: Mengejar Zara
overview: Despite having zero dating experience, Rafa is determined to do anything to get Zara's attention. Alongside his two equally inexperienced best friends, he embarks on a series of wacky plans to bridge the gap between him and the girl of his dreams. The clock is ticking—can Rafa win her over before the Lebaran break is over?

title: Tunggu Aku Sukses Nanti
overview: Facing constant ridicule from his successful relatives every Eid, an unemployed man desperately races to secure a job before the 2026 family gathering to save his dignity and support his struggling family.

title: Suzzanna: Santet Dosa di Atas Dosa
originalTitle: Suzzanna: Santet Dosa di Atas Dosa
overview: Suzzanna is determined to exact revenge on Bisman, the cruel village ruler who killed her father with black magic. To achieve this, she learns black magic, but realizes Bisman's power is immense. In the midst of her efforts, Suzzanna falls in love with Pramuja, a religious man who doesn't know her secret, forcing her to choose between pursuing her revenge or sacrificing him for love.

title: Na Willa
overview: A six-year-old girl who views her narrow Surabaya alley as a magical haven faces the bittersweet pain of growing up as her close friends drift away and her world begins to shrink.

title: Senin Harga Naik
overview: Promoted to general manager on the condition that she clear her mother's property for development, an ambitious real estate agent must return home and confront the mother she abandoned three years earlier after a bitter falling out.

title: Pelangi di Mars
overview: Kisah tentang perjuangan seorang anak dalam menghadapi tantangan hidup dan mengejar mimpi-mimpinya, yang dianalogikan seperti mencari pelangi di tempat yang mustahil (Mars). Film ini mengeksplorasi tema harapan, keluarga, dan keteguhan hati di tengah kesulitan.

title: Danur: The Last Chapter
overview: After years of separation from her ghost friends, Risa goes on with her life, closing the door to any communication with any ghosts. However, things change when her sister, Riri, is proposed. In an old theater and begins acting strangely in the time leading to her wedding. Not only does Riri change, but Risa also begins experiencing a series of strange events, as if she’s experiencing a painful death repeatedly. Risa suspects that this was happening because her ghost friends, Peter and his friends, were trying to convey something.

title: Ingin Tenang
overview: Seorang pemuda yang hide dalam tekanan batin ketika soal asmara nya bertepuk sebelah tangan yang mengakibatkan ia frustasi dan menyendiri, mengubah kehidupannya seakan tidak ingin mempertanyakan tentangnya

title: Screentime
overview: A troubled middle school student lives his days in school while his phone gets confiscated for a week.

title: Faith Under Pressure
overview: A woman believes that faith is about seeking refuge in a quiet place whenever the pressures of life begin to overwhelm her. However, as time passes, she slowly realizes that the true meaning of faith is not about escaping from hardship, but about enduring and continuing to believe even in the midst of difficult circumstances.

title: Aksara Cahaya
overview: David, Gondes, dan Pak Sulap menemukan sebuah warisan leluhur berupa naskah mantra kuno. Namun, naskah itu hanya bisa terbuka jika seseorang berani berubah—menanggalkan kesombongan dan belajar dari budaya leluhur. Perjalanan singkat mereka membuka rahasia bahwa keberhasilan bukan sekadar kekuatan sihir, tetapi keberanian untuk menjaga warisan dengan hati yang rendah.

title: Singgah
overview: Seorang wanita kembali ke rumah lamanya setelah merasa hidupnya gagal. Setiap bulan, ia secara misterius menemukan krisan putih di kotak suratnya, yang membangkitkan kenangan tentang seseorang yang tidak pernah benar-benar bisa ia lupakan.

title: Di Sudirman
overview: A workaholic who was laid off by her boss, went looking for new happiness under the city lights of Jakarta, around Sudirman street.

title: Arika Nusa
overview: Arika Nusa, specially created for the exhibition Bakudengar at Museum Arnhem, addresses the urgency of nature conservation in light of life and culture in the Moluccas. “Arika” in the Moluccan language refers to someone who is quick, alert, and courageous. “Nusa” means land or homeland. Arika Nusa therefore stands for agility of mind, skill, and courage in protecting one’s own Moluccan homeland.

title: The Unfinished Script
overview: Jovial, a young filmmaker on the verge of directing his first feature, meets his former lover, Kadisya, at a quiet cafe as a steady rain blurs the world outside. He has come to return a weathered box—a collection of relics from their shared past.  What begins as careful, lighthearted conversation about their careers, old jokes, and fading dreams soon begins to peel back the layers of a relationship that once left them both emotionally drained. Surrounded by the aroma of coffee, letters that have yellowed with time, and old music albums, they are finally forced to confront the unspoken questions that lingered long after they parted: why they truly let go, and whether the "okay" they claim to be today is a reality or just a mask. That night, amidst the clinking of porcelain and the rhythm of the rain, a small decision made at a cafe table fundamentally shifts how they choose to remember their history.

title: Pesta Babi
overview: Film dokumenter investigatif hasil kolaborasi Jubi Media, Watchdoc, Ekspedisi Indonesia Baru, Pusaka Bentala Rakyat dan Greenpeace Indonesia.  Film "Pesta Babi" merekam bagaimana orang-orang Marind, Yei, Awyu, dan Muyu di selatan Papua, melawan proyek biodiesel sawit dan bioetanol tebu untuk bahan bakar kendaraan. Bersamaan dengan kisah mereka, juga tergambar isu separatisme dan 60 tahun operasi militer Indonesia yang terkait dengan eksploitasi tanah Papua.  Disutradarai Dandhy Laksono dan Cypri Dale, "Pesta Babi' merekam bagaimana jaringan politikus, investor militer, dan gereja berhadapan dengan gerakan sosial masyarakat dan komunitas adat. Ini rekaman praktik kolonialisme yang tak perlu menunggu jadi sejarah.

title: Luka diantara Kaki Kita
overview: Arif sangat membutuhkan uang untuk membiayai amputasi kaki ayahnya akibat luka diabetes yang parah, sambil berjuang menanggung beban seluruh keluarganya seorang diri.

title: a news about “someone who is going to be shot in the head on the street”
originalTitle: a news about “someone who is going to be shot in the head on the street”
overview: An old analog news broadcast archive containing a threatening message: “I’ll shoot you in the head on the street”

title: Juara Sejati
overview: Elang, an orphan who lives with his grandmother, befriends Melati, a tomboyish girl with dreadlocks who is believed to be the incarnation of an ancestor, and Rafi, a spoiled child from a wealthy family. Despite coming from different backgrounds and beliefs, the three must face various challenges and struggles to achieve their dreams and prove what it means to be a true champion.

title: Setan Alas!
overview: 5 student. An old villa. Old well. Forbidden room. Dark secret of the past. A seemingly omnipotent evil. Survival is the key. Let the battle of wits begins...

title: Siti’s Promise
overview: Siti, janda muda asal Kutai yang hidup sebagai pengajar tari di tepi sungai, menyimpan kesepian sejak kepergian suaminya. Pertemuannya dengan Abdul membawanya pada percakapan tentang waktu, kesetiaan, dan janji yang tak selalu selesai bersama kematian, menyisakan pertanyaan apakah ia dapat tetap memegang janjinya sambil terus menjalani hidup?

title: Job
overview: A twist upon a man who is currently seeking a job.

title: Azab Caleg
overview: An ambitious political candidate faces the music for all his lies and slander.

title: Tumpukan Sekitar Kota
overview: A woman finds herself without the space to live, or even to bury her mother, suffocated by the crowding and bureaucracy of urban life.

title: Sebenarnya Percakapan Ini Untuk Apa?
overview: The older brother intended to replace the role of they mother who had just passed away, but this only made his younger brother hate him even more.

title: Pulanglah... Aku Tak Bisa Sendiri 2
overview: Setelah kedua penculiknya pergi berlibur selama dua minggu, Chacha ditinggalkan sendirian di dalam kamar dalam kondisi tubuh terikat rapat sehingga ia tidak bisa bergerak atau melarikan diri. Hari demi hari ia harus menahan lapar dan haus karena tidak ada yang memberinya makan dan minum. Ironisnya, penderitaannya justru semakin berat ketika rumah itu menjadi sunyi tanpa kehadiran Penculiknya. Dalam keadaan lemah dan terkurung, Chacha hanya memiliki dua pilihan: bertahan hidup sampai para penculiknya kembali, atau menemukan cara untuk membebaskan dirinya sebelum semuanya terlambat.

title: Rajah
overview: Cakra and Nilam are beset by mystical terrors ready to devour their souls. Fate brings them together with Malawangsa and Birsha, along with the emergence of Tribuana. Will they survive the unseen threat, or will it lead them to an even more terrifying age of madness?

title: Lift
overview: Six years after an office elevator accident that claimed many lives, PT Jamsa Land is terrorized again. Linda, the company's public relations staff, is trapped in the elevator and forced to face a mysterious voice from the intercom. Her child is taken hostage, and Linda has no choice but to participate in a dangerous game that slowly reveals the dark secrets of the tragedy six years ago.

title: Titip Bunda di Surga-Mu
overview: Driven by financial desperation, three siblings try to maintain appearances beside their devastated mother, but an uncovered family secret soon forces them to choose between coming clean or facing irreversible consequences.

title: Air Mata Buaya
overview: An overbearing mother who lives with her son in a secluded crocodile farm spirals out of control when her son sees the outside world and falls for a girl for the first time.

title: a thing for 25/02
overview: Just a few things that happened to be there. For the day, for the person.

title: Best Egg Fried Rice Ever
overview: A young man and his friend try earnestly to recreate the magic of his grandma's egg fried rice. In other words, to cook the Best Egg Fried Rice Ever.

title: NON-FIKSI
overview: Edward, a thirty-something filmmaker and former critic, tries to make his first feature by turning his failed relationship into an autofiction script. As he meets with actors, producers, and friends, the line between memory and invention begins to blur, and the ghost of his ex-girlfriend Aurora quietly returns to haunt him.

title: Lost In Thought
overview: Saat dorongan obsesifnya memuncak, seorang mahasiswa muda berusaha merapikan kamarnya demi menenangkan diri. Namun, upaya itu justru menyeretnya ke dalam kekacauan psikologis yang semakin tak terkendali.

title: Pulanglah... Aku Tak Bisa Sendiri
overview: Dua kakak beradik dengan gangguan psikologis menculik seorang gadis kecil bernama Chacha dan menyekapnya di rumah mereka. Tanpa diduga, keduanya pergi berlibur selama dua minggu dan meninggalkan Chacha sendirian dalam keadaan terkunci. Alih-alih menjadi kesempatan untuk bebas, situasi itu berubah menjadi mimpi buruk. Terjebak tanpa makanan dan minuman, Chacha harus berjuang bertahan hidup. Mampukah ia selamat sebelum semuanya terlambat?

title: Antara Mama, Cinta dan Surga: Bahasa Cinta Nommensen
originalTitle: Antara Mama, Cinta dan Surga: Bahasa Cinta Nommensen
overview: Bernard, the youngest child of a Batak family, faces an inner conflict when his desire to become a priest clashes with his family's expectation of a civil servant. Haunted by the call of faith and caught between love, family, and his faith, Bernard must make life choices that will determine his future.

title: Pocong Merah
overview: Katiyem, a black magic shaman who was murdered, now she is a Pocong Merah and terrorizes the residents who killed her and looks for sacrifices.

title: Taneuh Kalaknat
overview: A group of horror YouTubers called The Eyes visit Tanah Kalaknat, a cursed place where it's said no one can leave. Despite numerous prohibitions, their curiosity leads them there. Upon arrival, strange things begin to happen, and one by one, The Eyes members begin to experience life-threatening misfortune.

title: Asrama Putri
overview: Mia's arrival as a new lecturer coincides with a surge in cases of possession on campus, which has a serious impact on the female dormitory students, especially Loly. Amidst the chaos, the campus is also rocked by illegal prostitution practices and the terror of a female ghost named Sally who always brings death. Mia and Gwen's investigation uncovers Sally's past through a diary, including the story of her love that turned into hatred for a lecturer named Lazuardi.

title: Red Flag
overview: Karin, a female student who attends the most modern Islamic boarding school in Indonesia. The Islamic boarding school allows its students to use gadgets for learning such as cellphones or laptops. One day, suddenly there was a rumor that Karin spread a selfie photo of herself naked in her dorm room. Even though it was just a rumor, people believed the gossip so much that Karin was shunned by her friends. Assisted by her secret boyfriend, Affan, the two of them tried to find out the truth about this gossip. And if the photo really exists, who faked the photo and spread it?

title: Mantagi
overview: Film ini mengikuti perjalanan spiritual dan fisik dari hulu ke hilir di sepanjang Sungai Batanghari. Melalui lima fragmen naratif, penonton diajak untuk melihat bagaimana air menjadi saksi bisu kehidupan masyarakat Jambi—dari tempat penyucian, sumber kehidupan, hingga korban kerusakan ekosistem.

title: Lihat ke sana
overview: Steve yang merupakan mahasiswa tingkat akhir ditengah kesibukan dan jadwal padat kuliahnya. Waktu Imlek semakin dekat rasa rindu semakin besar namun semua terhalang waktu dan kegiatan yang membuatnya tidak bisa menghadiri acara imlek tersebut.

title: Sambung Silaturahmi
overview: A comedy drama about human characters who are often selfish and prioritize their own interests, yet sometimes forget to empathize and open their hearts to reconnect and build meaningful relationships with the people around them.

title: Her Absence is the Ritual
overview: Serani (20) lives among a land that cultivates silence and patience, where time never truly moves forward, it only loops, repeating events that keep knocking in different faces. When truth is seen as a disturbance, and silence is praised as virtue, Serani drifts between those who stay quiet and those who know. Her voice slowly loses its form.

title: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
originalTitle: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
overview: This documentary explores how familiar formulas, particularly in the horror genre, continue to dominate Indonesian cinema, raising questions about originality, diversity, and the future of storytelling in a culturally rich nation.

title: Another Half Heart
overview: Seorang laki-laki bercelana pendek Kuning dan laki-laki bercelana pendek biru dihadapkan pada situasi bahwa mereka memacari perempuan yang sama.

title: Daun yang Merekah
overview: Menceritakan tentang seorang anak bungsu yang ingin mendapat perhatian khusus sama seperti kakaknya yang berkebutuhan khusus, namun dia anak yang normal, akhirnya dia melakukan hal yang tak terduga.

title: Rumah Tanpa Cahaya
overview: Following the sudden passing of their devoted mother, a grieving family struggles to keep her cherished traditional food stall alive while dealing with the crumbling harmony of a home that has lost its heart.

title: AIU-EO: Macam Betool Aja!
overview: Three friends from Medan who have an Event Organizer (EO) called AIU-EO get a big project to organize a rich businessman's wedding, but instead get an unexpected mission from the bride-to-be to thwart the wedding itself.

title: Jangan Seperti Bapak
overview: Angel has to face the harsh reality after her father, Pablo, was found brutally murdered on her 20th birthday. Pablo was one of the leaders of the Red Dragon gang along with Vincen, Hans, and Chandra. Pablo's death becomes the starting point for Angel to find the mastermind behind this murder.

title: Waru
overview: Adrian's career as a businessman who tries his hand at politics is going well, but the situation at home is inversely proportional. His wife was locked up in the basement because of a mental disorder. His son is in a coma after being involved in a mysterious tragedy which resulted in the loss of other people's lives. As if that wasn't terrible enough, his family begins to be terrorized by a female ghost. The tragedy brings Adrian to flashbacks of the past. Long before achieving success, his life had suffered greatly. When almost giving up, a help appears. Connecting it to a sacred hibiscus tree which apparently did not give all success to Adrian for nothing. Is the destruction of his family a fair price for what Adrian has achieved? Or is there another secret that hasn't been uncovered from his past?

title: Kerja, Apa Dikerjain?
overview: Five friends, struggling with financial woes, decided to head to Kalimantan to turn their lives around. Armed with a job advertisement, they traveled to the city of Balikpapan. However, a single fatal mistake forced them to confront a situation beyond anything they had ever imagined.

title: Jepretan Bayang
overview: Suryo (47) is a retired photographer who developed an obsession with photographing human shadows as a representation of the absence of Dewi (42), his wife. Meanwhile, Adzkia (25), Suryo and Dewi's only child, has had to become the family's breadwinner because Suryo is aging and has been suffering from an illness that has worsened since Dewi's passing.

title: The Rooftop is Empty
overview: Forced to work on a Saturday, three office workers receive an enticing offer from a mysterious janitor.

title: Macho Mystic Meltdown Chapter 2: Monster; She Wrote
originalTitle: Macho Mystic Meltdown Chapter 2: Monster; She Wrote
overview: Alone and isolated in a remote region of Indonesia during the early 1960s, a female Permesta fighter performs military drills and prepares for a Minahasan ancestral ritual.

title: Berat Hati
overview: A kitchen worker, Yasa, meets his best friend who is on college vacation to chat about life updates.

title: Sadali
overview: Three years after his love story ended, Sadali chooses a quiet life as a painter in Magelang and prepares for the most important exhibition of his career. His tranquility is disturbed when he hears the news of Mera's marriage and reunites with Mera and Arnaza, two figures from his past who have left scars. Trapped between regret, suppressed love, and a search for identity, Sadali must choose between being tied to the past or moving towards new meanings in love and art.

title: Balas Budi
overview: After four women discover they were all duped by the same seemingly ideal man, they unite into a secret, highly strategic team dedicated to exposing his lies and executing a master plan of revenge.

title: Teman Tegar: Maira - Whisper From Papua
originalTitle: Teman Tegar: Maira - Whisper From Papua
overview: Tegar and Teh Isy travel to Papua. Upon arrival, Tegar meets a child from a remote tribe named Maira. Maira teaches Tegar much about Papuan customs, including how to coexist amidst the beautiful natural environment.

title: Ahlan Singapore
overview: An Indonesian student in Singapore finds her guarded heart opening to a mysterious older classmate, only for her fragile new romance to be upended when a devoted childhood friend arrives and ignites a turbulent love triangle.

title: Check Out Sekarang, Pay Later (Caper)
overview: Tina, a former beauty queen, teams up with fellow victim Mail to expose a powerful illegal loan network while struggling to repay her debts and support her younger brother.

title: This Didn't Happen
overview: Two people meet at the edge of goodbye. They don’t try to stop it. They just decide to make it evergreen.

title: The Shape of Invisible Skies
overview: An anthology of seven stories exploring the unseen spaces that shape us: between memory and desire, departure and return. Each lifetime captures fleeting moments of connection and transformation across time and space, where meaning hides behind invisible skies

title: Tut Wuri Handayani
overview: Seorang siswa berprestasi yang berusaha mengungkap kekerasan yang ada di sekolahnya pada saat evaluasi dari sekolah ramah anak, ia ditekan secara psikologis oleh seorang guru agama korup yang berusaha melindungi reputasi institusi. Terjebak di dalam sistem pendidikan yang manipulatif, sang siswa dihadapkan pada sebuah dilema moral yang menyiksa, antara menyelamatkan masa depan akademisnya, atau mengorbankan integritas moralnya.

title: Thus Spoke the Late
overview: A recently deceased denial-ridden young woman—wanders through a familiar park to confront the man of her past and the manifestation of the doctor who failed her, seeking to fully let go of her worldly-self.

title: Who We Once Were
overview: A young Indonesian actress faces pressures of tradition and a distant relationship as her first on-stage kiss blurs the line between acting and reality.

title: Mattaro Janci
overview: Raka and Dinda, who have been in a relationship for four years, promise to marry. However, the death of Ayla, Dinda's older sister due to an accident, makes the girl's parents ask her to marry her brother-in-law, Bayu. The reason for this request is because Ayla and Bayu have just had a baby girl. Dinda's confusion about whether to follow her parents' request or continue her relationship with Raka without their blessing, makes Dinda's life difficult.

title: Sola Fata
overview: While traversing a region unknown to him, a colonial explorer tries to make sense of the world around him. As soon as the film permeates reality, the boundaries between cast and crew, documentary and fiction, and past and present start to fade.

title: "It's too cold for the spirits to live here"
originalTitle: "It's too cold for the spirits to live here"
overview: On October 16th, 1958, a family fled Indonesia. They spent a month at sea aboard the M.S. Sibajak on a voyage to The Netherlands. When they arrived, it was getting winter. Coming from the tropics, the cold was a shock. The family quickly noticed that the spirits who had always been with them in Indonesia were no longer there - they had left them along the journey.

title: Tung Tung Uma
overview: Last Land and Lost

title: Abed's Journey: A Tale of Gebyar Pandu
originalTitle: Abed's Journey: A Tale of Gebyar Pandu
overview: A 20-year-old loser is given a chance to return to his middle school years and rewrite his past by daring to perform at the school’s biggest talent show, Gebyar Pandu.

title: Hikayat hayat tanah bayah
overview: West Java, in current-day Indonesia, was home to the Sundanese Kingdom that flourished for over nine centuries, yet few physical traces remain today that sing of its glory. Nestled in a geologically sensitive zone, the region has long been subject to nature’s unabated fury, with periodic earthquakes, tsunamis and volcanic eruptions wiping out its heritage and reducing it to a “landscape of amnesia”.

title: Dua Matahari Terbenam di Ujung Kota
originalTitle: Dua Matahari Terbenam di Ujung Kota
overview: Galuh (24), a young man on the brink of despair in his search, meets Riko (26), whose life is the polar opposite of his own. This encounter brings a major change to Galuh's life. However, a series of oddities continue to occur, as if fate never intends to allow Galuh a peaceful life.

title: Midnight Crave
overview: Edwin, Ferdinand, dan Hakim adalah tiga perantau dari latar berbeda yang tinggal di sebuah kos sederhana. Hidup di kota besar membuat mereka sibuk mengejar mimpi, hingga hal-hal kecil yang dulu terasa dekat perlahan terabaikan.  Di suatu malam yang tampak biasa, rasa lapar menjadi pemicu ketegangan. Komunikasi yang terputus dan kebutuhan sederhana yang tak terpenuhi membuka sisi lain dari hubungan mereka. Hal kecil berubah menjadi konflik emosional yang tak terduga.  Melalui ruang sempit kos dan situasi sehari-hari, kisah ini menyorot bagaimana ego, kelelahan, dan luka personal bisa menguji persahabatan. Sebuah potret intim tentang manusia, kebersamaan, dan hal-hal sederhana yang sering terlupakan.

title: Kota Emas
overview: Two friends, one Papuan, one Javanese, make a film together. Going through the footage they shot, they end up discussing the conflicted relationship between Papua and the rest of Indonesia.

title: Selamat Ulang Tahun Rara
overview: Lina (17) datang ke pesta ulang tahun Rara(17) untuk memperbaiki hubungan mereka yang sempat renggang. Namun, di tengah upayanya memperbaiki hubungan itu, mereka kedatangan sebuah kado yang berisikan flashdisk

title: Recess (Waktu Istirahat)
overview: Moko feels increasingly distant from his child due to the demands of work and the pressures of life. One day, he discovers a special park for people aged 40 and above, where visitors can play and have fun without having to worry about their responsibilities. However, strange occurrences within the park begin to unfold, causing him to reconsider his position and purpose in life.

title: Surat untuk Masa Mudaku
overview: Di sebuah panti asuhan, seorang remaja pemberontak dan pengurus pendiam tanpa diduga menjadi sahabat, saat mereka berusaha untuk berdamai dengan masa lalu penuh luka.

title: Kafir: Gerbang Sukma
overview: Eight years after Herman's tragic death due to black magic, Sri is rebuilding her life with her daughter, Dina, and Andi, who has married Rani. Sri's father informs her that her mother is seriously ill. They come to visit, and that's the beginning of their disaster. A past sin Sri has been hiding now threatens her family.

title: Tuhan, Benarkah Kau Mendengarku?
overview: After a devastating divorce leaves her to raise her child alone, a resilient single mother faces the ultimate test of forgiveness when she is forced to care for her ailing ex-husband and his new wife under her own roof.

title: Kuyank
overview: Rusmiati tak kunjung memiliki anak setelah bertahun-tahun menikah dengan Badri. Lantaran takut ditinggalkan oleh sang suami, dia nekat mempelajari ilmu hitam bernama kuyang agar selalu tampil cantik dan memesona. Sayangnya yang dipelajari Rusmiati berbuah petaka ketika efek dari ilmu itu malah meneror dan membuat nyawa warga desa melayang. Mau tak mau Rusmiati harus pun mempertanggungjawabkan atas apa yang terjadi dan bagaimana nasib Badri sebagai seorang suami yang harus menyelamatkan Rusmiati dari ilmu kuyangnya tersebut ?.

title: Dowa Juseyo
overview: Tania, an Indonesian student in Korea, experiences mysterious hallucinations and terrifying encounters. She meets Min Yong, a restless spirit and alleged victim of assault. As she tries to help, the terror intensifies, making her life increasingly unbearable.

title: No Love 1/2
overview: A cocktail mix of yuri with neo-noir and girls-with-guns.

title: Sena - Tradisi di Ujung Jemari
overview: Sena simply wants to change his fate. But at an exclusive massage resort, his body is sold, his soul is bound, and his life is at stake. Now he must choose between submission or fighting to the death.

title: A Tale of the Stolen River
originalTitle: A Tale of the Stolen River
overview: A family from the Balik Indigenous community in East Kalimantan shares a strong bond with the water and land. However, this  sacred connection is being disrupted by the development of Indonesia's new capital city.

title: Sengkolo: Petaka Satu Suro
overview: The village terror grew increasingly tense due to the many strange occurrences occurring in the village, especially since many of the victims were pregnant women. The succession of terrifying and disturbing incidents angered the villagers, angering them. The terrifying terrors and apparitions intensified as the night of Suro approached.

title: Sebelum Dijemput Nenek
overview: Hestu (Angga Yunanda) dan Akbar (Dodit Mulyanto) adalah saudara kembar. Hestu merantau ke kota, sementara Akbar tinggal di kampung bersama Nenek. Hubungan Hestu dengan keluarganya retak hingga ia bersumpah hanya akan pulang jika Nenek meninggal.  Ucapan jadi kenyataan. Nenek wafat tepat pada hari keramat, Sabtu Wage bulan 6 tanggal 6, jam 6.. Konon, siapa pun yang meninggal di hari itu akan gentayangan sampai ada yang menemaninya ke alam baka. Sejak saat itu, arwah Nenek memburu Hestu dan Akbar untuk ikut bersamanya.  Teror semakin menjadi-jadi, memaksa dua bersaudara ini mencari cara menghentikannya termasuk membuat kekacauan di desa demi mencari “pendamping” bagi Nenek di alam baka. Mampukah mereka selamat dari jeratan arwah Nenek?

title: Esok Tanpa Ibu
overview: Rama, a 16 year old teenager, must face reality after a tragic accident that left his mother in a coma. With the help of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Rama and his father try to face their new reality.

title: Holy Salt
overview: Demi uang, ustad penipu nekat menerima tawaran rukiyah sungguhan, namun harus menghadapi teror nyata hanya bermodalkan garam krosok dan kebohongan.

title: Sorry (I Love You)
overview: Jasson merupakan pemuda yang Sudan match cinta pada perempuan bernama Nana. Dan Ia mendapati barang-barang pemberian-nya dibuang begitu saja, tanpa ada kejelasan.

title: Riverside Forest: Against Modern Football
overview: Di tengah industri sepak bola modern yang sarat kepentingan bisnis, Riverside Forest hadir sebagai klub independen dari Bandung. Film ini menjadi potret perlawanan anak muda dalam menjaga jiwa sepak bola agar tetap berpihak kepada rakyat.

title: LUKAS PULANG
overview: A catechist who welcomed back his son who had just been released from prison, even though he was ostracized by the community.

title: Sisa Kita Luka Dunia
overview: Masuknya impor ilegal ke Indonesia menciptakan lingkungan persaingan yang tidak adil bagi penjual legal. Film dokumenter ini mengeksplorasi bagaimana praktik ini terjadi, dampaknya terhadap usaha kecil, dan upaya pemerintah untuk mengekang arus barang ilegal.  The influx of illegal imports into Indonesia creates an unfair competitive environment for legal sellers. This documentary explores how this practice occurs, its impact on small businesses, and the government's efforts to curb the flow of illegal goods.

title: Atitama
overview: Iyan merupakan seorang anak rantau yang tinggal jauh dari orang-tuanya karena menempuh perkuliahan, hari yang semula baik baik saja berubah menjadi duka, yang membuat Lian terpuruk karenanya

title: Telatt!!
overview: Seperti anak kuliah pada umumnya, Jodi seorang mahasiswa yang berkeinginan untuk mengikuti sidang skripsinya dan sudah berusaha menyelesaikan skripsi yang ia buat. Tetapi, pada malam hari sebelum sidang skripsi dilaksanakan di pagi hari, dia terlalu mengantuk akibat tidak tidur dalam beberapa hari padahal skripsi yang ia buat tinggal menulis daftar isi. Jodi terbangun di pukul 10.30 pagi, lalu tersadar ia telat mengikuti sidang skripsinya dan mulai panik. Terburu-buru, ia berangkat naik motor, namun motornya mogok ditengah jalan. Tidak ingin menyerah dan merelakan sidang skripsi begitu saja, ia memutuskan untuk berjalan melewati berbagai masalah seperti jalanan rusak, mabuk, tawuran anak SMA dan banyak lagi. Sesampainya Jodi di kampus, dosen menolak skripsi yang ia buat. Merasa sedih, ia menelpon ibunya dan mendapat dukungan dari orang yang ia sayang.

title: Project Roaring House
overview: An ambitious documentary filmmaker brings together a scientist and a priest to explain the supernatural events occurring in a haunted house. However, the phenomena inside the house begin to challenge their beliefs.

title: Sup Ayam
overview: YOU will be brought to confusing dreams of Dimas—an uneventful event, a chicken soup, and god knows what else.

title: Arwah Pue Tuko
overview: Ada sebuah kampung yang dikenal angker berkat kemunculan sosok arwah Pue Tuko atau Kakek Tongkat. Teror bermula ketika kekacauan terjadi di kampung tersebut hingga memicu pengambilan tumbal oleh sang Pue Tuko.

title: Mencadin 2: Tamu Mayit
overview: Keluarga Siti harus pindah ke rumah Farida di tengah perkebunan, setelah terusir dari rumah mereka karena ulah rentenir. Namun, sosok yang lebih kelam dan jahat daripada rentenir datang menjemput mereka untuk pindah ke akhirat saja.

title: Why Must be Concerned?
overview: A group of film students at ISI Yogyakarta is making a documentary about disability. As they worked on the documentary, they began to have concerns about the topic and felt they couldn’t fully understand it, yet they had to take responsibility for their work before it was screened. Eventually, they reflected on their mistakes and decided to turn their journey into a documentary.

title: Fadhil and The Journey of Revenge
originalTitle: Fadhil and The Journey of Revenge
overview: Fadhil, an unemployed cinephile, lives in trauma after being kidnapped, beaten, and most painfully, having his beloved cigarettes stolen by three pocongs and their boss, the Heavenly Demon. Driven by vengeance and the desire to reclaim his cigarettes, Fadhil accepts an offer from Ki Arak, the formidable “Guardian of the Realm,” to train in martial arts and supernatural powers, on the condition that he must not smoke until his mission is accomplished.

title: A Flower is Not a Flower
originalTitle: A Flower is Not a Flower
overview: A girl named Bunga experiences self-alienation after the death of her younger sibling, whom she raised without the presence of their parents. This loss leads her to pour all her longing into writing poems on sticky notes, which she scatters across walls and objects that hold memories of her sibling. In her grief, Bunga develops a desire to let go of her identity as a human and become a flower in its truest form.

title: Suara dari Sudut Kelas: Sayap Garuda
originalTitle: Suara dari Sudut Kelas: Sayap Garuda
overview: Allana, a student who transferred to Sukma Middle School with her father, Mr. Wahyu, begins to face new challenges. At school, she witnesses the bullying experienced by several students, including Kenzi, a quiet student who participates in the pencak silat club and is highly skilled in the art. Allana and Kenzi learn many life lessons from pencak silat: that true strength does not come from physical power, but from a heart that seeks to protect and continues to stand up for what is right.

title: The Legend of Tuan Tapa and the Two Dragons
originalTitle: The Legend of Tuan Tapa and the Two Dragons
overview: When two exiled dragons rescue a lost child from the sea, they seek the guidance of Tuan Tapa, a giant hermit, to raise her as their own. But as the child grows, the truth of where she comes from finds its way back to her.

title: Batas Nyata
overview: Judul : Batas Nyata Sutradara : Muhammad Faiq Razka Wibowo Genre : Horor Tahun Rilis : 2026 Durasi : 8 Menit  Sinopsis :  Rani, mahasiswi, tertidur saat kuliah di laboratorium komputer dan mendapati dirinya terperangkap dalam versi mengerikan dari gedung kampusnya. Setiap upaya keluar selalu membawanya kembali ke lantai enam, tempat sosok misterius terus memburunya. Saat akhirnya terbangun, Rani mengira semuanya hanyalah mimpi hingga sosok itu kembali muncul di dunia nyata.

title: Melody of Eloquence
overview: Nadiya, a young musician still living in the shadow of her popular father, is dragged into the real world after a failed stage performance. There, she witnesses old memories that remind her of where it all began.

title: NARA
overview: Before he was born, Nara, a doubtful soul, met his adult version of himself, where he became a autobiography writer. This conversation made them reflect for each other to find the true meaning of life.

title: Lu Sahabat Gua
overview: While mourning his best friend Yayat, Bagas meets him again as a spirit. Thrilled with excitement, they catch up with each other. Until Bagas remembers—last time he saw Yayat, they were not on very good terms. However, like usual, Yayat persuades Bagas to go to his favorite place, the beach. That made Bagas think of something..

title: Satu Meja
overview: At a dining table shrouded in silence since Mother’s passing, Nadia and her father are locked in a silent of pride and unspoken grief, until an emotional outburst tears their wounds open. Their emotional deadlock finally breaks not through words, but through a small, sincere gesture. When Father finally finds the courage to sit in his late wife’s empty chair and gently strokes his daughter’s head, the once-hollow silence turns warm. Love doesn’t always need a voice, it only needs the courage to bridge the gap.

title: Just a Driver
overview: After losing his partner, Niko continues working as a motorcycle driver in Jakarta while struggling with grief. As exhaustion distorts his perception, he begins hearing her voice and questioning whether she is truly gone.

title: Railway
overview: Mentari, an elderly woman, embarks on a long train ride towards the afterlife.  Along the way, she is faced with the memories of her past, forcing her to question  whether she is ready to let go of her life or choose to hold on for the sake of her  daughter.

title: Di Ujung Masa
overview: Bagi Komi, Nenek adalah dunianya. Menghabiskan waktu bersama pemiliknya adalah suatu  hal yang paling membuatnya bahagia. Namun, Waktu perlahan merenggut kebahagiaan  mereka. Komi harus menghadapi ketakutan terbesarnya, yaitu sebuah perpisahan.

title: Slice of Luna
overview: Raka (27), a wedding photographer, was deceived by a woman named Luna (26), a woman who loves creating collage artworks from pieces of images and photos. Raka assembled pieces of other people's wedding photos that he had captured over time, turning them into a complete collage as an expression of his love for Luna.

title: Mati Ketawa
overview: On the night of his twenty-seventh birthday, a comedian sits backstage at a comedy club, haunted by the recent death of his father. When he is called to the stage, he abandons his rehearsed routine to deliver an unscripted eulogy, attempting to find closure in front of a live audience.

title: Imam
overview: Imam, a stubborn teenager, continues to neglect his prayers despite his mother's constant reminders. Their conflict escalates until his mother chooses to remain silent and give in. The silence at home after their argument leads Imam to discover the meaning behind his mother's admonishments.

title: MENCERDASKAN KEHIDUPAN BANGSA
overview: Lilis hopes certification will offer a way forward, but the system moves slower than her need to survive.

title: Bidadari Surga
overview: Seorang YouTuber kaya dan terkenal dengan konten kontroversialnya tiba-tiba jatuh hati pada putri seorang kiai yang taat dan berprinsip.

title: Penerbangan Terakhir
overview: A high-stakes romantic entanglement develops within a commercial airline company when a prominent pilot enters into a clandestine relationship with a flight attendant from his past, triggering a volatile cycle of psychological warfare with his ambitious, influencer partner.

title: Alas Roban
overview: After a terrifying night forces them on a perilous journey through the eerie forests of Alas Roban, a mother and her young daughter must face relentless, otherworldly horrors to uncover the ancient secret haunting the land.

title: Penunggu Rumah: Buto Ijo
overview: Srini, a single mother, faces disturbances from a giant figure as her child's 6th birthday nears. Seeking help, she contacts her ex, Ali, a horror content creator. Ali and his sister, Lana, agree to assist due to financial struggles. However, as the figure of Buto Ijo appears, terror unfolds, revealing dark secrets in Srini's home.

title: Di Antara.
overview: Naya is a college student caught up in the pressure of a deadline as she  tries to finish her storyboard, until the conflict within her own mind  causes her to lose her way and ultimately ruins her last chance to  come up with an idea.

title: Terang Terkarang
overview: Laut Palabuhan Ratu yang pernah memberi kehidupan, kini membawa perubahan  yang perlahan. Terang Terkarang mengikuti Kang Entis, seorang mantan  nelayan di Palabuhan Ratu yang tak lagi melaut seperti dulu. Saat laut tak lagi  memberi penghidupan, ia memilih menyelam, mengamati, dan merawat apa yang  tersisa di bawah permukaan.  Sampah plastik, terumbu karang yang rusak, dan kehadiran PLTU menjadi bagian  dari kesehariannya. Melalui kedekatan Kang Entis dengan laut, terlihat bagaimana  perilaku manusia dan pembangunan di darat bermuara pada kerusakan laut,  meninggalkan pertanyaan tentang siapa yang bertanggung jawab menjaga rumah  bersama ini.

title: Atma Tantra Rasa
overview: Seniman pertunjukan digadang-gadang dianggap sebagai pertunjukan atau persembahan karya yang di anggap klenik dan mistic, maka tumbuhlah sikap erotisme yang membuat beberapa masyarakat,menganggap seni selalu dikaitkan dengan hal yang diluar logika manusia.

title: Rana : Yang Tak Terdengar
overview: Kekerasan dalam Lingkup kecil sering terjadi kepada anak-anak dan terutama perempuan. Tidak hanya kekerasan saja yang mereka alami,akan tetapi trauma psikologis yang berdampak pada masa yang akan datang

title: Nelayan Eksil
overview: The construction of the concrete seawall in Cilincing has made things difficult for local fishermen, including making it harder to catch fish along the coast, limiting their movement at sea, and increasing the fuel consumption of their boats.

title: Chronicles of You
overview: Tentang dua insan Nino dan Kaya yang mempunyai luka masa lalunya masing masing dan mencari harapan bersama orang baru, namun mereka mempunyai isi hati yang berbeda

title: WUK
overview: Ulfah, seorang ibu muda yang menghadapi tekanan dari keluarga dan tradisi terkait praktik sunat perempuan. Di tengah konflik dengan suami dan ibu mertuanya, Ulfah harus mengambil keputusan penting tentang masa depan anak perempuannya.

title: Nala, Dengar Aku Juga
overview: Amidst the hustle and bustle of everyday life, a family moves to their own separate rhythms—slowly drifting apart in a silence left unspoken.

title: Tugas Sedih yang Panjang
overview: Edo (40), a dedicated teacher who has just been laid off, struggles to regain his rights and role as a husband, which he lost when he lost his job.

title: Hafiz & Friends: We Were Always Meant to Be Here
originalTitle: Hafiz & Friends: We Were Always Meant to Be Here
overview: Hafiz & Friends: We Were Always Meant to Be Here reflects on the quiet evolution of friendship—how closeness can change, how distance can grow, and how time reshapes the bonds we once believed were permanent. Through intimate moments and unspoken shifts, the film captures the fragile space between holding on and letting go, offering a gentle meditation on connection, memory, and becoming.

title: 3x4 METER
overview: A barber, Rahmat, who dreams of continuing his education, instead becomes a place for his customers to tell stories.

title: Malam 3 Yasinan
overview: Samira returns home to the Djoyodiredjo family, a wealthy sugar conglomerate from the 1980s, after the sudden death of her twin sister, Sara. Unlike Sara, who had always been close to her family, Samira distances herself, fed up with the pressure of perfection and the inheritance dispute between Ari's two wives. On the first night of the Yasinan (Reciting Surah Yasin), a terrifying terror unfolds, revealing a dark, hidden family secret.

title: Uang Passolo -Amplop Kondangan-
overview: Biba (guru beranggaran minim) dan Rizky (videografer terpuruk) yang bermimpi menggelar pesta pernikahan sederhana. Namun, rencana mereka terhambat oleh keluarga Biba yang memaksakan pesta mewah demi status sosial dan keuntungan finansial dari tamu undangan, sehingga mengancam masa depan hubungan mereka.

title: Suka Duka Tawa
overview: A rising stand-up comedian who built her career on jokes about her estranged, washed-up father reunites with him to farm new material, only for their uneasy stage collaboration to unearth painful family wounds.

title: Musuh Dalam Selimut
overview: The happy marriage of Gadis and Andhika unravels when an intrusive friend named Suzi enters their lives and systematically destroys their domestic harmony.

title: Selamat Datang Para Mesin
overview: Film ini mengisahkan tentang seorang pria yang dikenal sebagai The Rider. Ia berusaha menghancurkan dunia dengan mengonsumsi bensin sebanyak mungkin menggunakan sepeda motornya.

title: Again and Again
overview: Seorang pria pekerja bernama Teo ingin kabur menaiki bis setelah tidak sengaja membunuh seseorang.  Namun, Teo selalu kembali ke halte dan jalan tempat Ia naik. Hingga akhirnya ia memutuskan untuk  mengambil tanggungjawab atas kesalahan yang ia perbuat untuk mengakhiri kutukan yang Ia dapat.

title: Berharap Dikenal Di Duniamu Yang Ramai
originalTitle: Berharap Dikenal Di Duniamu Yang Ramai
overview: Seorang pemuda yang kesepian rela menghabiskan uang terakhirnya demi mendapatkan pengakuan dari sang idola melalui video call , namun ia harus menerima kenyataan pahit bahwa dirinya hanyalah seorang asing dalam rutinitas kerja sang idola yang melelahkan.

title: Pesanan Terakhir
overview: Seorang mahasiswa yang kesal karena pesanannya tak kunjung tiba akhirnya melampiaskan amarahnya kepada sang pengantar. Tanpa ia ketahui, pengantar tersebut harus berjalan kaki setelah motornya dirampas dalam perjalanan mengantarkan pesanan.

title: Ayah Bukan Pahlawan
overview: A teenager who was confused when his teacher assigned him to write an essay about the good deeds of his abusive father.

title: Daring Menderita
overview: Radit, an unemployed man who likes to be lazy and has a dirty room, is going to attend a job interview at a well-known company via an online meeting. Radit begins to imagine a personal event as the interview progresses.

title: Sampai Kita Mengerti
overview: Lulu, a young woman who wants to pursue her dream of becoming a filmmaker, but is opposed by her older brother because of their "dark" past regarding their mother.

title: Memories Burn
overview: a creature reminiscing the memories of her lives and deaths

title: Attempt
overview: A young man wants to end his life. Beside the highway he sees his other self who wants to do it, he tries to stop him.

title: Menjaring Anjing Daring
overview: Roblox dikenal sebagai ruang bermain anak-anak, tapi di balik itu muncul pertanyaan "apakah platform ini benar-benar aman ketika orang dewasa juga ikut bermain?" Dokumenter ini menggali batas kabur antara hiburan, interaksi, dan keamanan di dunia virtual.

title: Aya's Diary
overview: Aya menyukai Baim dalam diam, hingga sebuah kenyataan menghancurkan harapannya. Ketika ia memilih menjauh, sebuah diary justru mengungkap perasaan yang terlambat untuk diketahui.

title: Tutti's Revenge
overview: Hullo! so today we decided to make a short video with our vintage dolls. I hope this teaches you a lesson. dont steal men Enjoy

title: Mau Makan Di Luar?
overview: After work, Mama invites her daughter, Emily to eat out. Throughout the meal, they barely speak and Emily remain focused on her phone, until a video Emily watches and a message the mother receives make them realize the distance in their relationship and try to start a conversation.

title: Di Amabng Pilu
overview: Nilan ingin membaca lima buku impiannya sebagai hadiah terakhir untuk dirinya sendiri, dengan harapan bisa merasakan pucak kebahagiaan di sisa hidupnya sebelum ia meninggal. Namun, saat buku terakhir akhirnya berhasil dibeli, Hal yang mengejutkan terjadi.

title: 3 clicks
overview: Filled with longing for her friends abroad, a young woman stumbles upon a mysterious abandoned camera in a park and accidentally captures moments she can never reclaim.

title: Pemburu Yang Beruntung
overview: Ulla yang sedang mencari adik dari temannya tidak sengaja terlibat dengan dua kelompok yang bertikai.

title: Pusara Bercerita
overview: Seorang pemeduli sejarah menemukan ironi pahit ketika upayanya menjaga ingatan hirtoris justru  berakhir dengan hilangnya jejak historis pribadinya, namun dari situ dia menemukan makna pemulihan, bahwa sejarah bisa tetap hidup meski tanpa bentuk fisik.

title: Niskala
overview: Amid the relentless pressure of looming deadlines, Nala (25), an illustrator, finds herself trapped in an art block that leaves her unable to complete her work. When she discovers a paper crane origami and her late mother's childhood sketchbook, she begins retracing the memories that first sparked her love for drawing. Through fragments of the past filled with hope, joy, and pain, Nala realizes that she has spent so much time chasing expectations that she has forgotten why she started creating in the first place. This journey leads her to embrace every experience both painful and beautiful as an essential part of who she has become. With a renewed sense of purpose, Nala picks up her pencil once again, not in pursuit of perfection, but to create honestly and reconnect with herself.

Dalam keseharian yang berulang dan kosong Tomi hidup tanpa beban, hingga saat siklus hariannya terganggu, Tomi teringat akan penyebab asli dari repetisi yang dia jalani, hal ini membuka kesalahan lama yang selama ini dia acuhkan.

title: Berkelana Dengan Sang Insan
overview: Menceritakan tentang seorang remaja yang baru saja menginjak umur 17 tahun dan ia sangat senang berkelana bukan tanpa sebab, itu semua dia lakukan karena keadaan dirumahnya yang membuat sang tokoh utama alias Tamam tidak nyaman berada disana.

title: Gak Jadi
overview: Di balik setir mobil dinas, seorang pejabat melihat nasibnya terbelah: satu menuju kuasa, satu menuju kehancuran. Bayangan tangisan anaknya dan borgol di tangannya muncul silih berganti. Kala suara hati bicara lebih keras dari godaan dunia, ia sadar. Langkah kecil jadi berkata tegas: "Gak Jadi.”

title: Modual Nekad
overview: When three estranged brothers discover their missing fortune was secretly used to reclaim their seized family home, a hidden photo found inside a torn suitcase plunges them into a deadly web involving a dangerous businessman, a corrupt prosecutor, and the darkest secrets of their own past.

title: Dusun Mayit
overview: Four hikers become trapped in a mysterious village after getting lost in a mountain foot market said to be an interdimensional gateway. There, the world turns strange—graveyards with no headstones, grinning bald figures, puppets with no puppeteer, and cult rituals dancing atop corpses. It all leads to one chilling truth: those who are trapped can never leave. The village is preparing a dark ritual to fill the hamlet with the dead. Faced with harrowing choices, can they survive—and make it home alive?

title: USO
overview: A plan turns disastrous when things don’t go as expected.

title: Brian and His Consequences
overview: A man who has to pay his online loan debt because of online gambling. He has angpau, but there is a 3-day tradition that prevents him.

title: Diari Emas: Pewaris Cahaya Terakhir
overview: Buku emas warisan misterius menyeret Leira, gadis remaja penyihir terbuang, ke dalam pertempuran melawan penyihir jahat yang membunuh keluarganya. Untuk melindungi dunia dan menemukan takdirnya, ia harus menjadi Pewaris Cahaya Terakhir.

title: Fanfictie: Volcanology
overview: Deep down in the bowels of a mountain, a Dutch geologist’s volcanic theories clash with local cosmologies in the Indonesian archipelago. Colonial science encounters the poetic, radical possibilities of reading nature otherwise.

title: Mens Rea
overview: Dalam komedi spesialnya yang ke-10, Pandji Pragiwaksono mengulas budaya hukum Indonesia dan berbagai keabsurdan kehidupan sehari-hari dalam stand-up satire politik ini.

title: Lempung Bunda
overview: Dafa adalah anak sederhana yang tidak mampu melanjutkan sekolahnya. Ia menemukan kembali semangat hidupnya saat melihat hasil karya kerajinan tanah liat milik orang lain. Terinspirasi oleh kenangannya bersama ibunya. Ia mulai membuat kerajinan tanah liat. Setelah beberapa kali gagal, ia akhirnya berhasil dan mulai menjual hasil karyanya didepan rumahnya, meski awalnya tidak laku, perlahan orang-orang mulai tertarik. Uang hasil jualan ia kumpulkan untuk kembali melanjutkan sekolahnya.

title: Vakansi Raksasa
overview: When they found out that the place had many pleasant things, the almighty sent the giants to vacation there.

title: Comic 8 Revolution: Santet K4bin3t
overview: When two evil shamans use black magic to curse and control the government, eight agents disguised as staff members try to stop their plan.

title: Patah Hati Yang Kupilih
overview: Deeply in love but separated by an unbridgeable divide, a young couple must navigate conflicting family blessings and deep-seated differences to discover if their relationship can truly survive.

title: Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino the Prequel
originalTitle: Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino the Prequel
overview: After losing their family home in a devastating fire, two impoverished siblings accept the hospitality of a wealthy long-lost uncle, unaware that his grand estate holds a sinister plot to exploit them.

title: Cinta Sintesis
overview: Seorang gadis penjaga warteg ingin mempuyai seorang pasangan, abangnya memberi saran untuk mencari pasangan yang ada disekitarnya. Namun, terhalang oleh ekspektasi pria idamannya yang tinggi dan sifatnya yang mudah ilfeel.

title: Drama Komedi - Stoa di Kota
overview: A comedy set series by Sinemarolas. The hustle and bustle of life—a comedy set in everyday school life.

title: Terbang Terendam
overview: A woman finds a tambourine that was playing on its own, shocking the village residents. Amidst the chaos, she discovers that the tambourine was made from human skin—a medium for black magic. With the help of firefighters, the "possessed" tambourine was successfully secured. Following the commotion, she continued to be followed by ghosts, both in bad luck and good fortune.

title: Day O
overview: Laras, a girl who has lost her beloved companion, Radja. However, fate gives her another chance to meet him again. Laras spends the time she has left with Radja, unaware of what will happen next. She does not know that day will be the last time she will ever be with Radja.

title: Padamu Kupercaya
overview: Rafi, a religiously devout young man who rejects all forms of idolatry, has his life upended by personal hardship. Consumed by grief and despair, he loses his sense of direction and, in his search for meaning, turns to tarot cards for guidance contradicting the beliefs he once held firmly.

title: Sorry Madam We Brought Our Trauma
originalTitle: Sorry Madam We Brought Our Trauma
overview: Sepasang kekasih mendatangi seorang dukun tarot demi mengetahui masa depan hubungan  mereka, tetapi bacaan kartu yang awalnya tenang berubah menjadi pertengkaran sengit yang  melibatkan sang dukun dan meninggalkan kenyataan mengejutkan pada kartu terakhir.

title: Ink, And Silence
overview: Archives of manual screen printing in Jakarta's Chinatown. Behind the process, a father earns a living far from the family he left in Pandeglang; he lives in a repeating routine—a colorful job that consumes the entire day to perform.

title: Misuh
overview: Chandra, mahasiswa rantau dari Jogja, tinggal di Kos Sinar Jaya yang sering mati lampu dan harus berurusan dengan Raka, penghuni kamar sebelah yang berisik dan hobi misuh.  Suatu malam saat listrik padam, mereka terpaksa berkumpul bersama dua penghuni lama, Jimboy dan Topek, dan dari kegelapan itu lahir persahabatan absurd khas anak kos.  Namun semakin sering gelap, semakin rusuh pula keadaan, hingga konflik mengancam memecah mereka, sampai suatu malam kejadian misterius membuat mereka kembali bersatu. Di tengah tawa, kekacauan, dan gelap tanpa akhir, mereka menemukan hangatnya kebersamaan.

title: SAY CHEESE!
overview: In a school obsessed with spotless records, one violation sets off a quiet chain reaction. Forced to expose seven offenders, a model student uncovers hidden sins committed by the least suspected. As the list nears completion, justice blurs into manipulation, revealing a system where truth is disposable and silence protects power.

title: Eling
overview: Tulus, a quiet 13-year-old boy, diligently attends Tahlilan (religious gatherings) in his village at the invitation of his uncle. Since his father's death, Tulus has often felt lonely. His mother works late into the night to make ends meet, leaving their home often lonely. Therefore, Tahlilan (religious gatherings) has become the only time Tulus can feel together and try to fill the emptiness in his heart.

title: Moal Baleg
overview: Seorang pria melakukan bentuk dekadensi moral seperti memakai peminjaman online dan judi online, karena ia merasa lingkungan nya sudah buruk.
