title: TIGA POT ONG
overview: Tiga sahabat dimasa kecil, yang bertahun-tahun terpisah kini bertemu  kembali di kota besar dan mencoba menepati janji untuk bersama lagi.  Namun rasa cemburu, cinta diam-diam, dan luka lama perlahan membuka  jarak di antara mereka membuat mereka sadar bahwa tidak semua yang  kembali bisa seperti dulu lagi.

title: Siapa Yang Salah?
overview: Who's at Fault?

title: Menanti Niscaya
overview: Setahun menganggur akibat PHK semasa pandemi COVID-19, Toyib, kini menjadi ayah rumah tangga yang hidupnya dihabiskan mengurus rumah dan putrinya. Tekanan dari sang istri yang menjadi tulang punggung keluarga membuatnya berusaha merebut kembali harga dirinya dan keutuhan keluarga. Namun sulitnya mencari pekerjaan dan ancaman perceraian membawanya pada keputusan yang justru membuat keluarganya mengalami penyesalan seumur hidup.

title: The Tree and the Life: A Poem
originalTitle: The Tree and the Life: A Poem
overview: An experimental short film based on a poem “The Tree and the Life” by Alga Wahyu Aditya. We could listening he read his own poem with nature sounds through surreal naturalism shot that actually a random things.

title: Timur
overview: Follows the real-life international hostage crisis that took place in Mapenduma in 1996. The subsequent rescue operation was overseen by now-Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.

title: Kalau Hari Itu Kita Bicara Lebih Banyak
originalTitle: Kalau Hari Itu Kita Bicara Lebih Banyak
overview: A college student slowly forms a bond with a mysterious girl he often meets on a bench outside the campus library. But when she suddenly disappears, he is left haunted by the things he never had the courage to say.

title: Reparasi Memori
overview: Hendri (23), who was repairing a handy talky owned by a customer named Mr. John (50), suddenly found the device making a strange sound, the voice of a man calling Manto's name. Hendri, who felt confused, immediately answered him.

title: Kagol
overview: Anton, a village gambler who is deeply in debt, has no money left. This drives him to resort to black magic at Kali Urip under the guidance of Mbah Djiwo, a village shaman who seems somewhat dubious, in order to get money quickly. Armed with offerings, meditation, and strange spells, Anton performs the ritual at Kali Urip. However, this leads to absurd terror in his own home. When the terror of a female ghost in a white robe appeared, the situation grew increasingly chaotic until it was revealed that the ghost they feared was merely a patient who had escaped from mental hospital.

title: HOW TO MAKE A FRIEND
overview: Karena kesepian, seorang pemuda berusaha mencari hantu agar tidak sendirian.

title: Hertz
overview: A young woman living in an abusive family finds an old radio that can play her family's future, but the more she relies on it, the lines between reality and illusion begin to blur.

title: Simulacra
overview: After having his life shaped by watching superhero shows on television, Raffa decides to become a superhero in the real world on New Year’s Eve. However, his good intentions are misunderstood, and in the end the world keeps moving on without noticing Raffa, while it continues to celebrate the arrival of new hopes.

title: LeQost - Short Film
overview: Leqost is a short promotional film that captures the everyday struggle of students searching for a place to live in an unfamiliar city. What begins as a simple need quickly turns into a tiring journey filled with uncertainty, limited options, and wasted time.  Through a grounded and realistic visual approach, the film presents Leqost as a digital solution that connects students with affordable, comfortable, and reliable boarding houses. More than just a platform, Leqost becomes a bridge between people and the spaces they temporarily call home.  Told in a concise runtime, the film highlights student routines, modest living spaces, and the quiet hope of finding a safe place to return to. It offers a contemporary portrait of how technology reshapes the search for belonging and everyday comfort.

title: Beneath the Shadows
overview: A group of eighth-grade students find themselves trapped in a surreal version of their classroom, where their favorite Mafia game comes to life. Forced to play roles of suspects and allies, they must uncover the truth while trust begins to crumble. As the game intensifies, friendships are tested and every choice becomes a matter of survival.

title: Keluh Kesah Arwah
overview: An annoyed spirit haunts a politician visiting his grave to ruin their campaign.

title: White Flower.
overview: Naya once had an older brother named Naru, who died by suicide after suffering from toxic masculinity and relentless bullying at school. Years after his death, Naya graduates from middle school and decides to attend the same high school her brother once went to. But unexpectedly, she ends up in the same school—and even the same grade—as Dira, the younger sibling of the student who used to bully her brother. From there, tension rises, and conflicts between Naya and Dira begin to unfold.

title: Silent
overview: In Makassar, a leprosy survivor fights to reclaim their dignity amid the lingering shadow of the disease's history and the crushing weight of societal stigma.

title: Harga Sebuah Kehormatan
overview: A documentary that explores Siri' culturen of Makassar people and the consequence for someone who violates another person's honor.

title: Who Am I?
overview: A girl finds herself in absurd television programs.

title: How I Survived Culture Shock in Indonesia
originalTitle: How I Survived Culture Shock in Indonesia
overview: After spending most of her life in the Netherlands, Dyana struggles to adapt to life in Indonesia upon her return.

title: Seribu Payung Hitam dan Sisanya Rindu
originalTitle: Seribu Payung Hitam dan Sisanya Rindu
overview: Sawitri seorang aktivis lingkungan yang kembali ke kampung halamannya untuk menggerakkan aksi demo peduduk desa Kandangrejo melawan korporasi yang melakukan privatisasi air di desa itu.

title: Interviewed
overview: Happy-go-lucky journalist Bobby gets a rare chance to sit down and talk with dictator Mulford Voss.

title: A Bite with Friends
overview: During a quiet evening, a group of young women gather for dinner. As laughter fades and conversations deepen, small moments reveal hidden tensions. What begins as a warm reunion slowly shifts, exposing the quiet weight of words and what they leave behind.

title: Mimpi Keluarga Sempurna
overview: As a result of a fight with a classmate, Dere was moved by Mar, her mother, to Yogyakarta. Mar, who raised Dere as a single parent, only wanted the best for her daughter. Dere never questioned Mar's decision, until she met her new friends. Dere began to doubt whether everything Mar did was really the best for her.

title: Mengejar Restu
overview: An inspiring encounter with an 11-year-old boy at an Islamic boarding school reignites a young man's determination to fulfill his late father's legacy and carry on the school's mission.

title: Qorin 2
overview: Fitri (Wavi Zihan), seorang guru BP muda, sudah beberapa lama mencurigai terjadinya perundungan terhadap muridnya, Jaya (Ali Fikry). Bukan hanya Fitri, bapak Jaya, Makmur (Fedi Nuril), juga sudah pernah meminta pihak sekolah menolong anaknya namun tidak digubris. Hal ini membuat Fitri terdorong mengusut kasus Jaya sendiri, dengan mencari saksi dan bukti dari warga. Namun, pencarian itu malah mengantarkan Fitri pada misteri lain di kampung, di mana orang-orang mulai bertindak bukan seperti diri sendiri, melainkan sebagai jin Qorin mereka. Semakin Fitri menelusuri, kaitan antara dua kasus semakin jelas, dan kejadian-kejadian mencekam pun semakin mengikuti.

title: Mertua Ngeri Kali
overview: When her bossy socialite mother-in-law moves in, a soap opera writer’s life becomes real-life drama and a crisis forces them to choose: pride or unity.

title: Kasus Misterius di Museum Seni
overview: The story begins when a young woman named Miranda blind dates a mysterious young man who gets her into bewilderment.

title: Urban Legend: Begu Juma - Penunggu Ladang Tanah Karo
originalTitle: Urban Legend: Begu Juma - Penunggu Ladang Tanah Karo
overview: Seorang anak petani rantau dari tanah karo yang bernama Kris Ginting, berusaha membantu ayahnya untuk menyembunyikan mayat yang mati secara misterius di ladang jagung keluarga mereka. Namun usaha mereka diketahui oleh beberapa warga.

title: Seorang Pria yang Berusaha untuk Bunuh Diri
originalTitle: Seorang Pria yang Berusaha untuk Bunuh Diri
overview: Hancur karena kematian kekasihnya, Hardi telah berkali-kali mencoba untuk membunuh dirinya. Namun akhirnya Ia menemukan cara untuk mengalihkan hasratnya: yaitu dengan membunuh orang lain.

title: Whispers Of Red
overview: Seorang anak perempuan yang mengalami menstruasi pertama dengan kebingungan, ketakutan dan sendirian.

title: Menyusuri Sunyi
overview: Sakiran (11), yang ditinggal orang tuanya pergi, keluar dari rumah dan bertemu seorang teman yang mengajaknya ke rental PS2. Namun kesenangan itu tak mampu menggantikan kehangatan keluarga yang diam-diam ia inginkan.

title: Toxic Threads
overview: Naya (25), seorang influencer yang dikenal dengan citranya sebagai pencinta lingkungan,  melakukan challenge 30 Hari Zero Waste. Suatu hari, ia menghadapi masalah ketika  mengunggah endorsement dari sebuah brand fashion yang ternyata terlibat praktik tidak ramah  lingkungan. Tekanan dari manajernya, Saras (27), serta hujatan warganet membuat Naya harus  memilih antara mempertahankan idealismenya sebagai pencinta lingkungan atau kelanjutan  kariernya.

title: Langganan
overview: An isolated young man finds comfort in getting his hair cut, believing his barber truly understands him. But when he realizes that this connection isn’t his alone, his fragile sense of belonging slowly turns into jealousy.

title: Kebahagiaan
overview: Leila is a student who dreams of becoming a doctor. However, her dream is often hampered by depression caused by an unstable family situation. Her friend, Yaksa, a psychologist, is there to provide Leila with mental and emotional support. Will Leila be able to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor?

title: Gak Nikah Gapapa Kan?
overview: The dilemma of being wrapped in the burden of life, forced to solve the family problems that are incessantly coming from the evil of the father's family, is it okay not to get married?

title: Kemana Aku Harus Pulang?
overview: Jeje (L/19) adalah seorang mahasiswa semester 3 yang sedang berjuang untuk studi kuliahnya. Ia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa orangtuanya tidak lagi memiliki uang untuk melanjutkan studinya sehingga ia harus mencari uang sendiri. Di tengah kesulitannya, ia ingin memiliki tempat pulang di mana ia bisa mencurahkan apa yang ia rasakan, namun Rara (P/19) pacar Jeje bersikap tidak peduli terhadap apa yang sedang dialami Jeje. Ketika Jeje hendak bercerita terhadap temannya Ega dan Chandra, Jeje mendapatkan perlakuan yang tidak menyenangkan di mana teman-temannya membandingkan masalah Jeje dengan masalah mereka sendiri. Jeje tidak punya siapa - siapa selain dirinya sendiri dan kesulitan menentukan ke mana arah dia pulang selain kepada dirinya sendiri melalui buku harian yang ia tulis.

title: Kerangkeng
overview: Vika, seorang mahasiswi Teknik Mesin, hanya punya satu tujuan: didengarkan teman-temannya.

title: Busa-busa di Piring
overview: Forced to attend a family gathering at her grandmother’s house, a young girl meets two cousins and plans a bold scheme to unleash her anger toward her uncle.

title: 5 Stages of Grief
overview: Adnan is a guy who feels lost after his brother—his only family, died. He feels like he has no one left, even though his girlfriend, Gisel, is by his side. He begins to blame himself for his brother's death.  The universe gives him a second chance to relive the times he spent with his brother. However, not everything goes according to plan.

title: 1998. To Chase The Monsters Away (Méuhambö)
overview: Berlatar di Aceh, 1998, di mana manajer Jawa, Suwandhi, dan istrinya, Mar, berdarah Aceh, menghadapi konflik etnis. Latar belakang Jawa dan kekayaannya menjadikannya sasaran bandit bersenjata yang melakukan perampokan, menyematkan label 'cuak' (mata-mata) sebagai kedok politik. Pasangan ini menjalani kesenjangan linguistik. Ketika para bandit menyergap rumah mereka, Mar memulai pertahanan spiritual dengan ayat-ayat Qur'an. Namun, ketika anak mereka ditangkap di depan rumah, Suwandhi menghadapi batas keimanan, menggunakan silat Aceh untuk melindungi identitas keluarga mereka yang terkoyak.

title: Keluarga Cendana
overview: In the 1999 Timor war, Darius (40), a financially strapped father, fights to protect a state-owned priceless sandalwood tree in his front yard from thieves, while struggling to support his daughter’s dream of joining the military.

title: Gokill
overview: A pregnant woman uses the service of the GoKill app, a pest control company, to help her end her life and simultaneously frame her unfaithful husband.

title: Pulasara
overview: A father died and experienced the atmosphere of his own funeral. He could only watch as his children, who should have been grieving, were busy arguing.

title: Ānjìng
overview: What a beautiful day for a Cute Little Dog to do nothing, then some random Blue Dude decided to approach.

title: Rasmein
overview: A husband and wife recall an event when their love was tested amid Punjabi pre-wedding customs, as their family continued to create a scene due to cultural and racial differences, which persisted despite the customs.

title: Habitus Kolektif
overview: A group of teenagers, three cleaning staff, and a young married couple confront a social contract when they meet in the elevator queue of a middle-class apartment building.

title: Ozora: Penganiayaan Brutal Penguasa Jaksel
overview: When his son falls into a coma after a brutal assault by the son of a powerful official, a father fights a corrupt legal system alongside loyal allies and a united nation praying for a miracle to secure justice for the boy.

title: Slave Island
overview: Activist Jeremy Kewuan faces the invisible power of ideology and faith as he combats traditions of present-day slavery on a remote Indonesian island.

title: Karim
overview: Karim, a devoted husband and father, loses everything when his construction business collapses, leaving only an old meatball stall inherited from his father. Unable to cope with poverty, his wife Watik leaves him and takes their young daughter, Arum. Desperate to rebuild his life and reunite with his family, Karim is persuaded by his younger brother, Heri, to perform a forbidden ritual promising wealth. As fortune returns, the ritual’s terrifying consequences begin to surface, forcing Karim to confront a deadly price that threatens his family and his own life.

title: Krayon Isa
overview: After school, Isa walked into the quiet house. Only the soft sound of running water accompanied his solitude. On the table, a sticky note was attached with his mother's handwriting. When he read the message, Isa was startled, realizing that only he and his sister were at home today.

title: BUNTU
overview: What started out as a simple filming process turned into a series of chaos when various obstacles arose one after another. The director and crew worked hard to keep production going amid unexpected situations, minor conflicts, and constant time pressure. Buntu presents a portrait of the efforts and failures that are often hidden behind the making of a film.

title: Blackout
overview: In the midst of a power outage, a family accustomed to being busy with their gadgets is forced to talk to each other again. But a fragile family remains fragile. Problems that have been piling up for a long time finally reach a breaking point that either worsens or ends the situation, depending on their actions.

title: OOPS... SALAH TARGET!
overview: Udin is a high school student with high self-confidence. He also has a special ability where his wink can make all female students like him. Until he meets Bella, a transfer student who is captivated by Udin's charm without the influence of his power.

title: Lenggak-Lenggok
overview: The lives of Jaipong dancers who persistently uphold tradition amidst economic pressures and changing times. Through their moving bodies and distinctive voices in traditional performing arts, these women dance not only for the stage but also to survive. Their voices, whether vocal expressions, soft utterances, or sinden singing, serve as the living spirit and "voice" that sustain and preserve their cultural heritage. An intimate portrait of resilience, steadfastness, and the voice in traditional arts that is gradually being marginalized.

title: Wasiat Warisan
overview: Returned to Toba to manage their late parents' abandoned hotel, three siblings face a bitter internal rift when a woman arrives claiming an unpaid debt to seize the property, forcing the brother to navigate a blossoming romance and unearth the secret behind his mother's true will.

title: Nia
overview: After an 18-year-old street vendor is brutally murdered on her way home, her grieving family and heartbroken boyfriend seek closure while her killer flees the law, pursued by intense guilt.

title: Riba
overview: A young father, Sugi, once lived a peaceful life with his loving wife Rohmah, their two children Dimas and Bening, and his mother-in-law Lastri. Everything falls apart when Sugi gets trapped in a high-interest debt to a ruthless loan shark.  Under pressure and threats, Sugi gets involved in a dark ritual called “Getih Anak,” introduced by his old friend Muji. The ritual promises instant wealth, but every drop of blood spilled invites a real and binding curse. Soon, terrifying events begin to happen inside the house, haunting the whole family.  Not everything that looks easy brings blessing, and even a simple choice can have a heavy price. Now Sugi must face the consequences of his own fatal decision.

title: Galura Tropikalia Alive
overview: Blurring the line between live performance and cinema, Galura Tropikalia Alive transforms The Panturas' surf-rock sound into a drifting journey across West Java. Told through six surreal episodes interwoven with live performances, the film follows a couple slowly growing apart.

title: Tunggal Ditinggal
overview: A 55-year-old woman and Arul, 33, live in a remote village in the Sigi valley. After suffering a work accident, Arul has been confined to bed, while his mother cares for him lovingly. Many people have come to visit, but their presence has brought more sadness than support.

title: Judheg
overview: As a teenager, Warti carried too much burden: being a mother, the backbone of the family, as well as a victim in her own household. She tried to breastfeed her baby, but stress and malnutrition prevented her from producing milk. Meanwhile, her husband, Supri, is immersed in online gambling and violence. From behind a pile of false eyelashes that she strings together to survive, Warti searches for the strength to make a decision: stay in the toxic household, or leave for a better life for herself and her baby.

title: Bandit
overview: Two bestfriend, Gatra and Tiar, plot one final heist in Bali to escape poverty, but when they discover a corpse in the stolen car's trunk, they're thrust into a deadly conspiracy. Now relentlessly hunted by both preman and police, they must rely on their wits and loyalty to survive the night.

title: Lupa Daratan
overview: Tepat saat seorang aktor ternama mendapatkan peran bergengsi, kemampuan aktingnya hilang secara misterius, sehingga memicu pencarian jati diri di tengah tekanan publik.

title: Pamacan
overview: Tells the story of a family of silat fighters living in a small village. They have long kept the secret of their tiger- style martial art, a tradition passed down through generations within the family. However, a minor incident at the local market, caught on video and going viral, begins to reveal their once-hidden tiger-style silat to the public. This exposed secret captures the attention of an outsider who becomes obsessed with the tiger-style martial art. Together with his followers, he is determined to track down the tiger-style fighter, aiming to seize the key to this legendary martial art.

title: Lampiran Cyclofemmes
overview: Lampiran Cyclofemmes is a choreography created with queer-camp aesthetics and popular archives to reinterpret the figure of Mak Lampir through transgender experience. Drawing from HRT (Hormone Replacement Therapy), the body becomes a shifting dramaturgical field combining drag, lip-sync, and soap-opera imagery, celebrating transgressive femininity, untamed love, and resistance to patriarchal norms.

title: Ghariban
overview: Ghariban is a meditation on how to measure our history through filling the gaps of the Indonesian New Order era film Ajian Nyi Mas Gandasari (1989).

title: Oikouménē
overview: This speculative anthology film navigates the interstitial space between ancestral memory and technologically mediated hallucination. Each episode is anchored within a shared cosmology shaped by Minahasan ritual, Cold War remnants, postcolonial narratives, gendered spectres, and the often paradoxical rhythms of everyday life.

title: αLPα
overview: After his arrest, Banyu, a punk vocalist, is sent to a moral rehabilitation center—where he meets Deri, the ghost of his past and the town’s respected cleric. Between rebellion and remorse, Banyu fights against the system that confines him, only to realize his only path to freedom lies within the last person on earth he wants to see.

title: The Blue Screen Between Us
overview: Sara struggles to recall any good memories with her late father, Doni, and wishes to reconnect with him before the burial the next morning. Moreover, she discovers his secret that makes her feel estranged from him. When she touches her father’s corpse, a blue vision appears . A magical bridge that allows them to speak. This becomes her chance to mend their once-distant relationship. Driven by guilt, Sara tries to create one last good memory with her father.

title: Mars KB
overview: CES suffers from a mysterious illness. In response, her mother, SRI, crafts a techno-metaphysical device for CES’s alternative therapy. Her father, ROBANI, on the other hand, is becoming more and more infuriating in his own way. Despite their differences, both SRI and ROBANI share the same goal to hold onto memories that are as fragile as the flickering lights of a low-cost apartment building.

title: Anaktana
overview: Anaktana tells the story of a mute boy who can communicate with nature. When a palm oil company faces the mysterious disappearance of its workers in the forest, they force his mother to make him help them. Along with her, Paulus (the foreman), and two workers, they journey deep into the woods. There, they uncover dark secrets about human greed and nature’s vengeance.

title: Memburu Manusia Kijang
overview: A poor girl named Mira enters a competition to hunt the Men’sia Kijank, a mythical creature believed to be a child-abducting monster. She is driven by the desire to cure her ailing mother. However, during the hunt in the Kelam Mountain forest, she is confronted with a dilemma when the creature appears before her in the perfect image of her mother. This encounter leads her to the realization that not all humans are humane, and not all monsters are monstrous.

title: Bulan di Tepian Surga
overview: On an island sold as paradise, a young widow who lost her husband to the cruise-ship dream stands at the edge of a choice to leave in search of life, or stay and slowly drown within its beauty.

title: Salam Dahsyat Fantastis Luar Biasa
overview: Angga is trapped in mounting online loan debt. At his lowest point, a friend invites him to a financial seminar led by Mira Prameswari, a charismatic motivational speaker. What begins as a promise of financial freedom turns into an absurd spectacle. As the line between motivation and manipulation begins to blur, Angga finds himself caught in an inner conflict between logic and the seductive dream of false salvation.

title: Apa Kabar Rindu?
overview: THE ECHOES OF HOME

title: Perjamuan Terakhir
overview: Story of 3 former political prisoners in the era of the anti-democratic Soeharto regime. They were a musician named MARKUS TALAM in a Buru Island concentration camp prison for 10 years, a radioman named SUKIMAN and an ordinary farmer named SUYATMAN both were detained in Blitar, East Java prison for 1 year, all without a judicial process. A military operation codenamed “TRISULA” was carried out in the South Blitar area, East Java, to purge the remnants of the members of Indonesian Communist Party (PKI). They weren’t communists, just ordinary farmers who had been caught in that military operation, some of their family members were killed and tortured. Trauma haunts them throughout their lives and justice never served them. Through whispered stories, they hope that in their twilight they will get justice to restore political and citizen rights that were seized by the regime. This film is a story of a long and winding road with a big question, will justice come to those who are oppressed?

title: Sound Guardians
overview: As Jakarta sinks and sea levels rise, Indonesia is moving its capital to Borneo, on the traditional land of the indigenous Balik people. Abidin, a Balik elder, is documenting his forest’s soundscape with the help of scientists to preserve ancestral knowledge – before it’s too late.

title: Submeria
overview: Seseorang mencari pasangannya yang hilang ke kebun binatang.

title: Negana
overview: It was only one year after the earthquake in Palu, amidst the hustle and bustle of Palu City’s revitalization, Gana a 14 year old girl, is forced to marry a 40 year old widower to reduce the economic burden on her family. After the disaster, Gana lives with her aunt and uncle in a temporary shelter.  In the days leading up to her wedding, Gana wants to run away but feels conflicted. Whenever she tries to run away, aftershocks come.

title: Moon Among the Silence
overview: Arkin harbored a profound sense of guilt after his girlfriend, Livi, a journalist, died during the genocide in Gaza. This guilt stemmed from Arkin's inability and failure as a human being to accompany his girlfriend in her fight for truth in the city. Consequently, he decided to write a final poem for Livi as an act of atonement for his guilt, along with an inexpressible sense of loss, and as a final expression of his love.

title: Hanya Ada Kedamaian di Balik Jendela Rumahku
originalTitle: Hanya Ada Kedamaian di Balik Jendela Rumahku
overview: Dunya, a man living in a modest rented room, only wants to escape the stench that seeps through his window every time the neighborhood hosts a bird contest. To stop people from urinating there, he builds a fake grave complete with offerings to make it look sacred. But his small act of deception spirals into absurdity: the window becomes a revered site, offerings keep coming, the local economy begins to thrive, and the place evolves into an unexpected religious attraction beyond his control.

title: Hutan yang Hilang
overview: Uli (7), seorang anak dari gua karst Kalimantan yang dibesarkan dalam tradisi prasejarah, dikirim ke hutan untuk membuktikan legenda leluhurnya. Namun ketika ia menemukan jejak manusia modern di sana, Uli harus memilih antara memercayai mitos leluhurnya atau menerima kenyataan baru yang dapat mengguncang identitas sukunya.

title: Acquainted
overview: During a visit to a museum, an art lover finds himself drawn to a woman who catches his attention

title: Ini Ujian!
overview: Acil (25), an artifact student and campus donor who has not passed for 12 semesters, is again facing the Calculus III exam, which he has retaken seven times. Pressured by the threat of dropping out, he desperately prepares a cheating plan: swapping his exam sheets.

title: Di Sekitar Pegunungan Sampah
overview: Group 3 of International Relations Class of 2025 UNHAS embarks on a field study to TPA Antang to uncover the everyday reality behind one of the region’s most challenging environments. Through interviewing a member of the community and on-site observations, the team explores how residents adapt to living near the landfill, navigating issues of waste management, public health, and environmental pressures.  This documentary captures the resilience of a community that has learned to coexist with conditions many would consider unlivable. From the routines of families who have called Antang home for decades, to the subtle ways the environment shapes their mindset and livelihoods, the film offers a grounded, human perspective on life at the edge of a landfill.

title: The Stone That Remembers
overview: The Stone That Remembers interprets the Durga Mahisas-uramardini statue’s journey from its home, the Singhasari Temple, to the hands of colonizers, and various museums. The film follow the patriarchal displacement of a woman that represents the Durga, exploring the parallels between the fate of the statue and many women today.

title: Idak-Idak-Idak
overview: Idak-Idak-Idak is a hybrid-documentary relating the stolen Lombok Treasures with the Sasak diaspora through three generations of women: a daughter, her mother, and her grandmother. Blending full-spectrum cinematography with personal footage, this film moves between Indonesia and the Netherlands to examine colonial legacies, displacement and healing the heart of home. In Sasak, "Idak" can be interpreted as both “heart” and “absence”, becoming a container for memory, loss, and the unseen layers of the self between generations.

title: Air Mata Mualaf
overview: Anggie, a woman who is a victim of her boyfriend's violence and finds guidance after being saved by a girl who runs a mosque.

title: Legenda Kelam Malin Kundang
overview: Legenda Kelam Malin Kundang merupakan film yang terinspirasi dari cerita legenda masyarakat Minangkabau dengan setting cerita masa kini, dikemas dengan genre drama-misteri-thriller, dan akan mengikuti kisah seorang seniman lukisan mikro bernama Alif. Setelah pulih dari kecelakaan, dokter mengingatkan bahwa ingatannya belum pulih sepenuhnya. Ketika dia pulang ke rumah dijemput oleh istrinya yang bernama Nadine dan anaknya Emir, dia diberitahu bahwa ibunya akan datang berkunjung dari kampung untuk pertama kalinya. Masalahnya, Alif tidak ingat wajah ibunya, bahkan tidak ingat sama sekali tentang masa lalunya. Ketika perempuan itu tiba, dia curiga bahwa perempuan itu bukan ibunya.

title: Agak Laen: Menyala Pantiku!
overview: After repeatedly failing their missions, Detectives Bene, Boris, Jegel, and Oki are given one last chance: to go undercover in a nursing home in search of a fugitive wanted for the murder of the mayor’s child.

title: Statues Rule the Waves
overview: The film brings together two young female symbols of a history of oppression: Anne Frank and Martha Christina Tiahahu. Despite originating from disparate places, they are connected by the same land, history, and one person in particular. Through the personal journey of the filmmaker, who visits both the place where she grew up and the place her grandparents were forced to leave, the film forms a collage of encounters that challenge our contemporary memory culture and how we construct our narratives.

title: Ari-Ari
overview: Four friends wander about the Red Zone, a former neighborhood that turned into a mass grave by the Palu-Koro Fault's liquefaction. As they search for a missing cow, the landscape grows increasingly unstable.

title: Malino Recordings
overview: A group of friends goes on a trip to Malino, a well-known region in South Sulawesi. Through fragmented scenes that blur between fiction and reality, they recall moments of their friendship by listening to recordings from their previous trip to the same place.

title: WHAT WE CHOICES
overview: A married couple leads a simple household life without the presence of a child. The wife continues to be haunted by social pressure and is trapped in hallucinations that blur the boundaries between reality and her own mind. As the sound of a baby's laughter turned into a cry, and the whisper of public discrimination became more and more stressful, he almost lost control. But the husband's grip became the anchor that brought him back to reality. On the table, flowers in the vase slowly bloom a symbol of love that grows calm, warm, and whole, even without a child's presence.

title: As Promised
overview: A man suddenly wakes up in a strange white room. There, he reunites with his wife, the woman who was once the greatest love of his life. The meeting leads him to fulfill an old promise.

title: Review Klinik Baru (feat. Sissy)
overview: Seorang kuntilanak newbie ingin pindah tinggal ke klinik baru yang kosong dari setan demi ketenangan, tapi malah harus menggagalkan operasi ilegal penjualan obat kadaluarsa oleh manusia, meski dia belum jago jadi setan.

title: Kiat Menjadi Aktor
overview: Mistaken for a real cop after filming while still wearing his costume, an actor is dragged into a situation far more complicated than he expected.

title: Bungkus Terakhir
overview: To regain the warmth he had lost, Damar dressed and presented himself like his mother. Not as an attempt to find his identity, but as a simple way to ease his longing. However, despite his efforts, social stigma caused people to view him negatively, even though Damar simply wanted to rediscover the person who had once made him feel at home.

title: Frame Terakhir
overview: Abdi celebrates his graduation by watching an old memorable video with his family.

title: Bisikan Terumbu
overview: This film reflects the journey of artist Teguh Ostenrik in uniting art and nature, especially the ocean. Troubled by the damage to marine ecosystems and longing for the kind of silence not found in galleries or studios, Teguh created ARTificial Reef, an underwater sculpture that is both beautiful and functional as a home for coral and marine life. Told through a personal and contemplative narrative, the film explores a creative process that blends art, science, and spirituality. Teguh collaborates with divers, scientists, and coastal communities, showing that art thrives through connection and ecological awareness.

title: Inggi Kaliuda
overview: Rambu Merti (22), the youngest daughter in a family of traditional weavers in the village of Kaliuda, East Sumba, stands at a crossroads. On one hand, she feels a deep responsibility to carry on the legacy of Inggi Kaliuda, a woven tradition passed down through generations. On the other hand, she harbors a strong desire to pursue higher education and carve out a different path for herself. Accompanied by her mother, Yustina (64), Merti goes from house to house, seeking handwoven cloths to sell. Through each conversation—about motifs, life stories, and cultural values—emerge questions of identity, sacrifice, and hope. Amid uncertainty, Merti chooses to stay with her mother, while quietly searching for new ways to find meaning in the place she calls home.

title: The Red Egg
overview: Red eggs have always been present in Ivonne’s life—a symbol of birth, continuity, and the cycle of life itself. Through a reflective and autoethnographic approach, she weaves together family archives from her childhood with the documentation of her grandmother’s 91st birthday celebration. In tradition, red eggs are prayers for a prosperous future, but for Ivonne, they also mark the passage of time.

title: Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta
overview: The three-year history of past violence that changed the fate of thousands of Indonesian women forever through the ianfu system seems to have never been fully resolved. Instead, the gap in knowledge of history to the current generation seems to be widening.

title: Maragap Humbayang
overview: Since I was little, I often heard stories from my grandfather that had a profound impact on my memory because when I was a teenager, my grandfather suffered a stroke that left him unable to speak. Because I was studying abroad, my grandfather and I were separated by miles. The stories my grandfather told me left a lasting impression on me, and I always remember them because I miss him and want to fulfil my promise to him, which makes me long to return home.

title: NH Dini
overview: NH Dini, a visionary Indonesian writer, left a legacy that goes beyond words. This film tells the story of a woman ahead of her time, from her youth in Semarang to her relentless journey as a writer and activist. Through Pondok Baca Sekayu, Dini planted seeds of change in underprivileged children. This film portrays how her vision of a literate and gender-equal Indonesia slowly became reality, even if she never lived to see it.

title: Aba Dai Helok
overview: The Rote Islanders, who live in Indonesia's southernmost edge, have carried on the ancient art of ikat weaving for hundred years. As the wombs that nurture the Rote people's civilization, women play an essential part in this long journey. Mama Masri, one of the last remaining weavers, facing the complexities of life as a mother, wife, and weaver.

title: The Key to the Past
overview: The Manggarai Water Gate is a silent witness, absorbing the traces of time that flow with it. It reflects the two eras of colonialism and independence, like a wound that never fully heals, like a current that never stands still. On its banks, two teenagers read the city from what is left behind: drifting trash, fragments of memories, and whispers of change.

title: The Last Accord: War, Apocalypse, and Peace
originalTitle: The Last Accord: War, Apocalypse, and Peace
overview: This film takes viewers on an extraordinary journey through one of Southeast Asia’s longest and deadliest conflicts. For nearly 3 decades, the conflict between the Indonesian government and the Free Aceh Movement (GAM) left deep scars and generations warped by violence. This documentary offers an in-depth look at the tortuous path of the peace process in Aceh—often regarded as a mission impossible—featuring untold stories of behind-the-scenes tensions, and dramatic twists and turns that finally yielded the Helsinki Accord.

title: Tupon
overview: At 70 years old, Mbah Tupon should be enjoying her twilight years in peace. However, the 1,655 square meters of inherited land she had cared for over decades has vanished, allegedly due to land mafia practices. The land certificate was transferred to a foreigner’s name and even used as collateral at a bank. Now, the land is being auctioned off, leaving Mbah Tupon at risk of being evicted from the place that has long been a part of her life.

title: Tembak Gak Ya?
overview: Aim for the Heart

title: Rangsot Ita
overview: Set in Rangsot, this film unravels how memory, play, and storytelling endure through voice, gesture, and communal presence. Songs once sung to lull children, tales whispered by parents, and games played with sticks, stones, or dragonflies re-emerge as elders recount them—sometimes laughing, sometimes grieving. The film reflects on how the apparatus mediates these transmissions. Between oral history and the camera’s framing, it explores how memory is shaped, reenacted, and perhaps even transformed through the production and consumption of technical images.

title: Sampi
overview: A farmer chances upon a book, and within its pages he perceives that the devotion of his life, since his first breath, draws near its close. Once touched by knowledge, he feels estranged from cows, no longer bound to their world.

title: Rumah
overview: A cinematic interpretation of a singular aspect from the universe of Gabriel García Márquez’s One Hundred Years of Solitude. Emerging from Macondo, the film foregrounds the domestic routines of the Buendía women who repair and renovate the house each time it collapses under extraordinary events across the century. These recurring gestures, which in the novel traverse generations, are recontextualized through the logic of contemporary reality and reconfigured into a visual play of form that interrogates narrativity.

title: Di Kamar Melquiades: Kausa-Prima
overview: Dr. Sjarif, a researcher, is reconstructing a lost city, Kejora, using found objects. In the imaging laboratory where he works, two ghosts are watching him, waiting for an opportunity to sneak back into the city he is rebuilding.

title: Sekutu Sejajar
overview: A visual essay obsessed with lines in space—as form, boundaries, and language—that tells a story about a part of the history of solidarity through cinema. Will they have a second chance?

title: Tidak Ada yang Mati di Sini
originalTitle: Tidak Ada yang Mati di Sini
overview: Fragments of light and language once circulated under a military regime’s gaze. Drawing from newspaper archives and the incident site, the work asks what printed words conceal, preserve, or reveal. In revisiting the 1984 Tanjung Priok tragedy, it examines both the violence itself and the contested role of media in shaping memory and truth. Two narratives emerge: official accounts and marginal voices. By confronting archival dissonance, the film exposes how media operates—exhuming suppressed histories and counter-narratives, and suggesting that history is shaped not only by authorities, but also by what remains unwritten.

title: Pedang Pena
overview: Some people draw fragments of lines on paper as an idea of possible disasters that could happen to them. These lines turn abstract ideas into something that is visually identifiable. The collection of images of objects and lines then becomes a depiction of an event. From this process emerges a collective visual narrative in which personal experiences are represented as part of a shared pattern, emphasizing the connection between individual perceptions and broader visual constructions.

title: Constructed
overview: After 12 years of documentary courses being absent as a form of Integrated Practicum in the Film Department at IKJ, Bikeska, Paul, Arrivo, and Raihanul chose to break the tradition. Amidst the dominance of fiction films, which are considered more prestigious, they chose documentaries due to budget constraints and a desire to respond to the world in a more honest and intimate way. Their poetic documentary film captures two layers of reality: a man who draws architectural spaces, and the laborers who build them.  However, the process led to a creative crisis and the images were too structured as the treatment felt like fiction filmmaking. The question arose: were they recording reality or constructing it? The camera turned around, highlighting the team’s process and confusion. Ultimately, the film not only captures space and labor, but also reflects that documentaries, like buildings, are the result of construction and choice.

title: Hollow
overview: Nata, seorang gadis muda berjuang keras untuk menyelesaikan lukisan yang ditinggalkan ayahnya.

title: Summa: Dendam Perempuan Sinting
overview: Four students majoring in nutrition, Tristan, Denisa, Reno, and Sigit, carried out field research in Kampung Tenung, a remote hamlet. They were allowed to stay overnight in a rickety hut belonging to Mak Summa, an old widow who lives alone with her daughter who was born with a serious mental disorder. Everything turns into a nightmare when Tristan and Reno commit despicable acts against the helpless Nini. This serious violation awakened another side of Mak Summa that had been sleeping for a long time: pure bloodthirsty madness. As a result, the four students were trapped in a deadly terror, fighting desperately to defend their lives from the wrath of a mother who had lost everything, including her sanity.

title: Benih Kehidupan
overview: Menjelang hari kiamat, seorang anak laki-laki cemas atas semua perbuatan selama masa hidupnya. Kemudian ia memutuskan untuk melakukan satu hal terakhir sebelum semuanya berakhir.

title: Sharp Objects
overview: ‘Sharp Objects’ follows the forgotten story of the Klungkung keris back to its origins and to its post-colonial relevance to Bali today, tracing the looting of the keris to modern day tourism in Bali. The film juxtaposes the 'knowledge' of colonial archives against community-based knowledge and mythology, convoluting the understanding of what is preserved, what is dead and what is lost. The artists apply a tangible intervention on the photochemical material they use for the film. This time consuming approach embodies the narrative of the labor intensive iron forging craftmanship of a keris blacksmith.

title: Tanah Kitai / Menua Iban
overview: Deep within the rainforests of Borneo, the Iban people live as a resilient community bound by sacred ties to the land, rivers, and ancestral traditions. In facing the challenges of their time, the younger generation discovers strength within themselves and their identity—a struggle not only for survival, but also for dignity and the preservation of a way of life that grows ever more endangered.

title: BIANG RW 1
overview: Rakat, a child of Batak descent, is overwhelmed with guilt after being forced to kill a dog in order to be served as food for his father’s restaurant.

title: Remote AC
overview: Seorang pria mencari remote AC karena terganggu dengan suara digitalnya.

title: NASISA
overview: Pandu seorang anak SD yang bertujuan membuktikan suatu pamali, namun terjebak dalam mimpi buruk.

title: Leak 2 (Jimat Dadong)
overview: It begins with a married couple, Putra and Sandra, originally from Jakarta, who decide to move to Bali. They leave their busy lives in Jakarta so his wife can get pregnant. However, unfortunately, the Leak magic rises and terrorizes them. The Leak magic originates from a talisman the wife carries, and they receive spiritual help to end the Leak terror.

title: Belum Ada Judul
overview: Umar Bakri, a respected high school teacher, faces public outrage after a video of him slapping a student goes viral. Despite pressure to explain, he remains silent to protect a secret that could ruin his students' futures. A touching drama about sacrifice, morality, and a teacher’s unwavering dedication.

title: Danyang Wingit Jumat Kliwon
overview: Ki Mangun Suroto, an ambitious puppeteer, seeks ancient knowledge for wealth and immortality. Citra, is recruited as a sinden but chosen as a sacrifice. Training hard to fund her sister treatment, Citra faces terrifying events.

title: Keadilan
overview: Raka, a court security officer, and his pregnant wife, Nina, celebrate her success in passing the bar exam. But their joyous celebration is shattered when Nina is found brutally murdered. As the trial spirals towards an unjust outcome, Raka resolves to overturn the corrupt verdict and seek justice for his late wife.

title: Mempertahankan Kenangan Yang Hampir Hilang
overview: A documentary about the daily life of a horse coachman in Yogyakarta.

title: Layangan Ajaib
overview: Ayla menemukan layang-layang yang terdampar di sebuah bukit. Dia menerbangkannya sendirian, sampai dua layang-layang misterius muncul dan memutus talinya. Layang-layangnya tidak jatuh, tetapi terus terbang.

title: Leleng
overview: Leleng is a mythical being, one of 'the tree mothers' of the far, barren forest of Borneo or Kalimantan. It is crying after being separated from her last descendant by the old forest guardian, who is in charge for seasons. Her hope as a part of the earth is drifting with her dance, a symbol of life cycle, along with the hoarse voice of a hornbill or Enggang/Rangkong which sung signs of nature on every chapter of her life.

title: Biasa Aja
overview: MENCERITAKAN MENGENAI CERITA ORANG TUA DANI(25) DALAM KISAH CINTA MEREKA SETELAH 30 TAHUN MENIKAH DAN DINAMIKA MEREKA.

title: Dopamin
overview: Pasangan muda yang terjerat utang dan terancam kehilangan segalanya menemukan sekoper uang misterius yang mengubah hidup mereka sekaligus menguji cinta dan moralitas mereka.

title: Sampai Titik Terakhirmu
overview: When his long-time secret crush is diagnosed with ovarian cancer, a devoted man stands resolutely by her side through worsening illness and chooses to marry her, proving that true love can endure the ultimate test.

title: Tak Kenal Maka Taaruf
overview: Two rival students find their lives upended when they begin the traditional courtship process of taaruf, only for an unexpected third presence to complicate their budding relationship.

title: Sehelai Cadar dan Kalung Salib
overview: Aisyah felt isolated in her school environment because she wore a veil, until she finally found true friendship when she helped find her friend's cross necklace.

title: Pesugihan Sate Gagak
overview: Three friends are caught between the pressures of life and the promise of instant wealth through a crow satay ritual. But when ghosts begin to appear incessantly, they must choose: continue serving for money, or stop before everything spirals out of control.

title: Terlalu Takut Pulang
overview: Seorang laki-laki merantau berniat untuk merasakan kebebasan dari tuntutan Ibunya, tetapi ketika di perantauan ia merasakan tuntutan yang sama dari lingkungannya.

title: Paradigma
overview: Adam Santoso, calon kades termuda di Desa Jawi, ingin mengubah desa "paling kotor" dengan visi unik: memberi denda pada warga yang membuang sampah sembarangan, terinspirasi Singapura. Namun, cara ini ditolak karena dianggap radikal. Akankah Adam berhasil?

title: Stalker
overview: A very popular girl is stalked by a mysterious man who has been obsessed with her for a long time, until something terrible happened, making the innocent girl in a destiny that should not have happened at a young age.

title: The Elderphone
overview: One day, a grandmother asked her grandchild to delete the contacts of people who had passed away from her old, worn-out cell phone..

title: Gara-Gara Cicilan
overview: The story of the friendship between a photographer (Rijja), a barista (Jhaka) & (Tiara) a final semester student who works part-time to support her family in the village. Jhaka's delay in paying his motorbike installments because he helped Tiara pay for college fees becomes the trigger for their problems. At their lowest point, the three of them begin to get to know each other better until a love triangle forms that will destroy their friendship.

title: Paused Love
overview: Aji (19) and Aira (18) have been best friends since childhood. They secretly like each other. At the end of high school, they will part ways to continue their studies at different universities. Aji wants to express his feelings. However, every time he wants to confess his feelings, time stops.

title: Return of the Fireflies
overview: In Bali, artist Daan Roosegaarde and local Balinese spent three years breeding a Firefly Garden where light returns at night. This love story of people and nature flickers with courtship, longing, and reunion.

title: What's Up with Secretary Kim?
overview: Kimberley Laksono, who has worked as a secretary for nine years in a giant retail company, decided to quit to find a new life, making her boss Rendra Prakasa panic and start to realize his feelings for Kimberley.

title: Metamorfosa
overview: A burned out stylist is forced to confront her past when an old shirt and an unexpected reunion with a childhood friend remind her that not everything can be restored to what it once was.

title: Rumah Nenek
overview: Arkan (M,19) Seorang streamer yang acuh terhadap lingkungan terpaksa menghabiskan liburan bersama neneknya di sebuah lingkungan yang penuh interaksi sosial. Di tengah kejenuhan dan benturan kebiasaan, ia perlahan menemukan makna baru dalam kehidupan di luar layar.

title: Tanah dan Ikat
overview: A man must undergo a traditional marriage trial as he tries to propose to a lover he has never met.

title: KONTAKKK
overview: Near the rice fields, Selga and Fikri spend a relaxed moment together while playing on their phones. A trivial issue about how a contact is named on a phone sparks a difference in perspective between them, for Selga, it is a symbol of closeness, while for Fikri, it means nothing at all. Through this light conversation, the dynamics of an intimate and honest friendship are revealed.

title: Potret
overview: A reserved seventeen-year-old studio photographer, accustomed to capturing the unguarded vulnerabilities of strangers, experiences a profound existential crisis when an unassuming client is revealed to be his long-absent biological father.

title: Sosok Ketiga: Lintrik
overview: After six months of marriage, Andin begins to notice many oddities in her marriage. From the beginning, Uncle Bagyo suspected the marriage was rushed, and together with Amara—Andin's younger sister who also inherited the mystical arts—he often noticed disturbing, odd signs.  Their suspicions were proven correct when it was revealed that Ario, Andin's husband, had been having a special relationship with Naura, a wealthy woman in their town who was trying to steal Ario completely from Andin using the Lintrik love spell, a dangerous mystical power that dragged Andin and her family into endless supernatural terror. What will happen to Andin and Ario's marriage going forward?

title: Pangku
overview: Sartika, a pregnant young woman, moves away from her city hoping to provide a better future for her child. She meets Maya, a coffee shop owner in Pantura. Maya takes care of Sartika and helps with her deliveries. After Sartika gives birth, Maya manipulates her into working for her as the "Kopi Pangku" waitress, a job that requires her to serve coffee on a man's lap, until one day she meets a fish distributor truck driver named Hadi and falls in love. Will she find happiness?

title: Solata [Teman Adalah Keluarga yang Kita Pilih]
originalTitle: Solata [Teman Adalah Keluarga yang Kita Pilih]
overview: Angkasa, a volunteer from Jakarta who is a teacher in the Remote Class in the interior of Toraja. There, he met six students with unique names that were similar to the names of the Presidents of the Republic of Indonesia.

title: Kuncen
overview: After 24 hours without news from her boyfriend who was climbing a mountain, Awindya, a high school girl, was determined to invite her two friends, Agnes and Mojo to follow her boyfriend to Mount Merbabu. Upon arrival, the caretaker or Kuncen of the mountain had died tragically due to black magic. Together with two other people, Yoga and Diska, who also lost their closest people on the mountain, they agreed to find out who the new Kuncen was in order to find their missing friends. It is said that according to local beliefs, without a Kuncen, the mountain is a place that holds mysteries and all supernatural creatures succeed in terrorizing those who dare to enter it. Will they succeed in finding the successor of the guardian; the Kuncen of the Mountain?

title: Jangan Ambil Bonekaku..!! 3
overview: Bab ini melanjutkan peristiwa di Bagian 2. Kakak tertua menerima telepon dari seorang pembeli yang menuntut agar seorang gadis kecil yang telah dijanjikan segera dikirimkan kepadanya. Pembeli itu mengancam akan membatalkan kesepakatan jika gadis tersebut tidak segera diserahkan. Dengan panik, kakak tertua memberi tahu kakak kedua, memperingatkan bahwa mereka bisa kehilangan sejumlah besar uang jika gagal menyelesaikan transaksi tersebut. Masalahnya, gadis kecil itu masih berada bersama si bungsu, yang memperlakukannya seperti boneka kesayangan. Demi menyelamatkan kesepakatan, kakak kedua, yang sebelumnya membiarkan si bungsu melakukan sesukanya, kini mencoba membujuknya agar menyerahkan gadis itu, dengan janji bahwa ia akan mendapatkan yang lebih baik di masa depan.

title: FIRST OR LAST?
overview: A Bestfriend since highschool meet again for the first time in a while. Arsena dare himself to confession into Kaira his secret lover since high school. But that's it's good option or not?

title: Appinru
overview: Di sebuah tempat terpencil yang dipeluk kabut pagi dan jalanan menanjak yang terjal, berdiri sebuah rumah belajar kayu sederhana. Di sanalah sekelompok pengajar muda dari Komunitas Appinru hadir setiap minggunya. Menempuh perjalanan jauh di tengah padatnya aktivitas perkuliahan, mereka memilih untuk terus kembali dan menyapa anak-anak yang setia menunggu.  ​Lewat pertemuan-pertemuan singkat namun penuh arti, huruf demi huruf dibaca dan cita-cita sederhana mulai disemaikan. Film dokumenter ini merekam jejak kesetiaan dan ketulusan para pengajar dalam memelihara harapan di tengah berbagai keterbatasan. Sebab pada akhirnya, pengabdian bukan tentang seberapa besar panggung yang dimiliki, melainkan tentang keberanian untuk terus hadir dan memilih tidak pernah berhenti memberi.

title: Masih Bingung
overview: Riski (17) assigned by his teacher to make a short interview video about passion. At first, he doesn’t take it seriously until he ends up involving his three absurd friends, each with their own quirky passions, leading to laughter and chaos. Yet behind their jokes, a deeper question arises: what does Riski truly love? As the deadline approaches, he rediscovers a long-buried memory. Slowly, Riski realizes the true reason behind his love for capturing moments in life.

title: Losong : Awal Mula Serunai
overview: Seorang remaja bernama Raka yang tinggal berdua dengan Kakak Ijah, yang dibesarkan tanpa kehadiran kedua orang tua mereka. Semenjak itu Raka yang menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Setelah latihan sanggar musik Raka pulang dengan Pak Din menggunakan pick up yang beralaskan jerami ia teringat semasa kecilnya bermain alat musik sederhana dari sisa Jerami, Pak Din terkagum kemudian mengajarkannya bermain Serunai dan Raka meraih penghargaan.

title: Mirage: Agape
overview: The third entry in Riar Rizaldi's Mirage series continues his investigation of mysticism through the conventions of educational film and television, a format designed to make complex theories accessible. Framed as a sword-and-sandals historical reenactment, Mirage: Agape examines Sufi mysticism in the Indonesian archipelago, using the spread of various religions from the maritime hub of Barus as a mechanism to introduce the theory of emanation. In contrast to the theories of both creationism and materialism, emanation theory posits that the universe, and everything contained therein, "flows" from a single infinite and unchanging point. Within the world of the film, two protagonists embody matter and anti-matter, creating an endless cycle of destruction and reincarnation each time they touch.

title: Nugas Club
overview: A silent film about someone who wants to do college assignments with his friend (?)

title: Gema Dalam Sunyi
overview: Aurel lives in a modest family burdened by expectations and unspoken conflicts. As pressure from her parents grows and her brother remains silent under similar demands, Aurel is pushed to confront the limits of obedience and her desire for freedom.

title: Badik
overview: “Badik” tells the story of two brothers, the children of a martial arts teacher in a remote part of Makassar, who follow different paths in life.

title: Anak Macan
overview: Eki, living by the landfill, searches for a memento to honor his late mother. Battling the relentless rain, landslides, and looming threats from scavengers and machinery, he fears her memory could be lost beneath the waste forever.

title: Si Paling Aktor
overview: After a blacklisted extra actor is kidnapped by a ruthless criminal alongside his secret crush, her movie-star boyfriend, and their director, he must use his decade of ignored film-set experience to navigate a series of deadly traps and save the group.

title: Harun
overview: To save his failing business, an elderly tailor must confront his deep-seated prejudice when he accepts an unusual order: creating a female cosplay costume for a young man.

title: Shutter
overview: Sebuah remake resmi Indonesia dari "Shutter (2004)"

title: Pengin Hijrah
overview: Alina, a popular Instagram celebrity, is facing various challenges in her life. The death of her best friend further depresses her. Her encounter with Omar, a final-semester student, rekindles her hope for love. Omar also encourages her to become a better person. However, just as her life's direction begins to change, Alina loses her "migration" direction.

title: For Now
overview: Leandra chooses to spend the night at the house of Alexa, a stranger she has just met earlier that evening in a bar. As the night progresses, the two women begin to open up to each other, and their deepest, most personal secrets are revealed. What starts as a casual encounter slowly turns into a transformative experience, and Leandra finds that the events of that night change her in profound ways she never anticipated.

title: bendungan
overview: The artist and choreographer use oral history and bodies to make visible how deeply the Dutch colonization of Southeast Asia is engraved in the collective memory.

title: Subur
overview: Sebab tak semua yang rakus berakhir makmur, dan tak semua yang jujur berakhir hancur. Kadang tanah yang diberi darah tumbuh subur sekejap, tapi kehilangan jiwa untuk selamanya.

title: Sebelum Melangkah Jauh
overview: Reno , anak tunggal laki-laki yang harus memperjuangkan dan membiayai hidupnya sendiri,dikala kedua orang tuanya tiada, rasa rindu pada orangtua-nya dan sesak akan kehidupan seakan hadir ditengah kesepian, keputusan berat untuk melangkah mencari suasana hidup yang baru ,untuk meninggalkan duka yang mendalam 2 Tahun silam itu.

title: In The Still of The Night
overview: Di ulang tahunnya ke-25, Derana mendapat tekanan untuk pulang ke kampung halaman saat ingin mengejar karir impiannya di kota, bersamaan dengan itu ia mengalami pemecatan di tempat kerjanya. Berlatar dunia yang cepat dan individualistis, ia dalam krisis, kesunyian, dan hidup yang terasa semakin tak pasti.

title: The Last Supper
overview: In a deserted house, a mysterious man savors an exquisite menu in the company of an unseen guest. From this eerie dinner table, a succession of terrifying stories is revealed-each probing primal fears of hunger, flesh, and survival.

title: Planet of Love
overview: Ngatiyem and her grandson Okta live at Lentera, an orphanage in Solo for children with HIV. After the orphanage is relocated to a secluded cemetery, Okta and friends are expelled from school. As Okta's health declines, Ngatiyem becomes overwhelmed, struggling to provide the care and attention he desperately needs.

title: Duka Cita
overview: Cahya must face the bitter reality of losing both of his parents at the same time. In his grief, he embarks on a journey of mourning in a funeral home, accompanied by the ghosts of his parents. Along the way, Cahya recalls memories of himself with his parents—from his childhood to the painful moments of growing up. These fragments of memory gradually guide him toward understanding the meaning of loss.

title: Salon Gue Aje
overview: Nurjanah has been running her small salon in South Kemang for 17 years. More than just an affordable haircut place, her salon has become a safe space and gathering spot for women from lower- to middle-income backgrounds. Bad news strikes when Lilis, a longtime client, informs her that Salon Gue Aje is about to be evicted to make room for a wellness center complex deemed more "suitable" for Kemang’s aesthetic.

title: Amelia, Amelia
overview: Amelia, a 12-year-old Chinese-Indonesian girl, has just learned of a tradition that says women who have received their period must not wash their underwear together with men's clothes, or the men will face bad luck.

title: Cyberbullying
overview: Neira, a second-year junior high school student, is known as a role model at school. Her seemingly perfect life comes crashing down after a video of her fight with a classmate goes viral. Neira experiences psychological stress, withdraws into herself, and loses her will to live. Her family decides to send Neira to live with her grandfather. In this new environment, Neira rediscovers hope. Together with her new friends, Neira builds a reading garden and a Spelling Bee practice center for underprivileged children. She then returns to her old school to participate in the Spelling Bee competition and successfully achieves success, while simultaneously healing the wounds of her past.

title: Maju Serem Mundur Horor
overview: Sebuah film horor komedi Indonesia yang menceritakan kisah empat mahasiswa film yang mengharuskan mereka membuat film horor sebagai proyek akhir mereka untuk menyelesaikan studi. Namun, peristiwa mistis seperti penampakan hantu dan kerasukan mulai mengganggu proses syuting mereka, mengacaukan produksi dan keselamatan tim.

title: Air Mata di Ujung Sajadah 2
overview: Baskara celebrated his ninth birthday with Aqilla, but on the other hand, he was also celebrating it with Yumna and his adoptive family in Solo. So, in the next story, will Baskara return to his biological mother, Aqilla? Or will he continue to grow up with his adoptive family in Solo?

title: Tumbal Darah
overview: Struggling debt collector, Jefri, awaits the birth of his second child with Ella in her 8-month pregnancy. Haunted by the loss of their first child, their high hopes for the baby’s arrival. When complications arise, they unknowingly turn to an illegal maternity clinic run by a twisted doctor and nurse couple, Iwan and Sandra. Jefri and Ella must fight for their survival as the clinic sacrifices unborn children to demonic forces. A terrifying night of damnation ensues, with them battling the survival of Ella and their unborn child from the clock-ticking and unexpected horrors.

title: Abadi Nan Jaya
overview: Ramuan jamu memicu kemunculan para zombi di suatu desa. Sebuah keluarga yang tak akur harus bersatu dan berjuang untuk bertahan hidup saat kampung halaman mereka hancur.

title: Berdoa
overview: Di sebuah kantin yang ramai, dua orang asing duduk berdekatan tanpa saling kenal. Tanpa disadari, gerak-gerik mereka mulai selaras satu sama lain dari melepas headset, menyesuaikan kacamata, hingga mengeluarkan bekal, seolah saling mencerminkan. Namun di satu momen kecil sebelum makan, salah satu dari mereka menyadari ada gerakan yang ternyata tidak sama.

title: Patung Manusia
overview: About statues and men.

title: Where Milo Used to Sleep
overview: A woman who lost her cat found new meaning when a stray kitten came into her life.

title: 生日 Sang Nyit
overview: A teenager and his sisters who wanted to surprise his mom on her birthday but got the wrong idea of her birth date: is it on the Lunar or the Gregorian calendar?
Dalam “Zaman Edan,” Arundaya diperbudak oleh Batara Kala, sosok destruktif dari mitologi Jawa, dan ia merindukan kebebasan serta kemanusiaannya kembali.

title: The Shadow I Wrote
overview: Synopsis Alex (22/M) lives with his uncle in a house. He has a history of PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder). One day, his uncle disappears without any explanation, leaving Alex confused and uncertain about what to do. Trying to cope with the situation, he begins writing a book titled *Shadow I Wrote*. Unbeknownst to him, Aldo (22/M) — a character from his book — exists in real life.  Aldo starts to feel that something is controlling his life, as he experiences a strange sense of being trapped in a time loop. Confused by what’s happening, he begins to question his own reality, and it turns out that he also suffers from PTSD, just like Alex. In his search for the one controlling his life, Aldo eventually encounters Alex. However, the meeting was deliberately planned by Alex, who intends to kill Aldo, believing that by doing so, he can silence the turmoil inside his mind.

title: Paturay Tineung
overview: Synopsis : Raka (21/M) spent his teenage years with Ati (49/F), his mother, after his parents divorced when he was 5 years old. Throughout his life, Raka grew up without the presence of a father and felt that he did not need one. However, everything changed when Yana (52/M), Raka's father who worked as an expedition courier, suddenly appeared to deliver a package to their house. This unexpected meeting slowly changed Raka's perspective, from feeling that he didn't need a father's presence, to a new happiness because he felt the warmth of a father figure in his life again. However, behind this happiness, Raka was faced with a conflict that forced him to give up his favorite item to sell.

title: Goldfish Memory
overview: Seorang mahasiswi rantauan bernama Grace yang kesepian meminta saran kepada teman imajinasinya yang berbentuk ikan mas koki untuk menghilangkan fokus ingatannya sejenak terhadap keluarganya yang tidak bisa dihubungi beberapa hari kebelakang, agar bisa menyelesaikan tugas akhir kuliahnya tanpa distraksi apapun.

title: Jangan Ambil Bonekaku..!! 2
overview: Dua kakak beradik berhasil menculik seorang gadis kecil untuk dijual. Namun rencana itu berubah ketika adik bungsu mereka mengira sang gadis adalah hadiah ulang tahunnya. Saat kakak tertua berusaha mengambil kembali “hadiah” tersebut, kakak tengah justru menahannya, tak ingin adik bungsu mereka merasakan kekecewaan. Konflik keluarga pun berubah menjadi mimpi buruk yang tak terkendali.

title: Menuju Pelaminan
overview: Tells the story of love and marriage between Fajar and Rahma, who come from Javanese and Minang cultures, as well as the conflicts that arise due to differences in family traditions on both sides.

title: Jangan Panggil Mama Kafir
overview: The meeting of Maria and Fafat in a church on Christmas Eve, changed their fate. Maria did not expect that her relationship with Fafat would lead to an interfaith relationship. But the two of them had already fallen in love and decided to marry. When their daughter was born and not yet a year old, Fafat died in an accident. Maria was left alone, patiently raising her daughter Laila, according to the Islamic teachings that had been promised to her late husband. However, Ustadzah Habibah saw that Maria's efforts in educating Laila with Islamic teachings were still lacking, so she wanted to take and educate her granddaughter herself. After her husband, would Maria also lose her child?

title: Getih Ireng
overview: Targeted by Santet Getih Ireng—a dark curse aimed at destroying their bloodline through endless miscarriages—a desperate married couple must unearth the dark origins of the ritual and break the black magic before it consumes their last chance at a family.

title: Cristine: Tidak Seperti Yang Kamu Lihat
originalTitle: Cristine: Tidak Seperti Yang Kamu Lihat
overview: A supernatural agreement between Nyimas and Jin Rabak requires the fetus to share a body with a spirit descendant of a jinn named Cristine, who grows up with her biological child, Naya, and eventually haunts their lives with the terror of two souls in one body.

title: Ora Abot Ora Maem
overview: Minah has been working as a female porter at Pasar Gede Hardjonagoro for over fifty years. The film captures her daily routines at the market along with her personal stories about life, struggles, and the values she holds.

title: Untuk Hari Ini dan Selamanya
overview: Di tepian yang terancam, Ratu mengangkat kamera kuno yang selalu ia bawa. Di bawah keindahan lautan eksotis tersembunyi dampak. Di bawah kakinya, penurunan permukaan tanah memaksa pengungkapan. Dengan terkurasnya waktu, air laut menutupi permukaan tanah dengan jiwanya. Melalui jurnalnya, ia mencari perubahan signifikan. Sebuah kalimat muncul di balik matanya, apakah semua ini hanya untuk Hari Ini... ataukah untuk Selamanya? Namun, Ratu tahu, di antara desakan ombak yang menenggelamkan dan halaman jurnal yang kian terisi, waktu untuk memilih antara bertindak hari ini atau kehilangan segalanya selamanya kian menipis.

title: Kontapati
overview: In a world where humans only communicate telepathically, Nima searches for a butterfly. Her encounter with a black cat leads her to an apathetic old man, putting her in questions about the world she lives in.

title: Mangsa Ketiga
overview: Mursid, seorang jurnalis yang ingin mengembalikan nama baiknya, nekat melakukan ekspedisi menyingkap mitos kuno Watu Gajah bersama rekannya, Ami. Perjalanan mereka penuh penolakan, pantangan, dan misteri yang menguji hubungan manusia, alam, dan Tuhan.  Hingga pertemuan dengan seorang peneliti asing memisahkan mereka, meninggalkan Mursid seorang diri menghadapi ritual terakhir di Watu Gajah.  Akankah kebenaran terungkap, atau justru semakin menjadi misteri?

title: Badak
overview: Badak reflects on extraction as both method and worldview – on the pulling of value and meaning from creatures, minerals and landscapes, and the scars left behind.

title: Terkunci Waktu
overview: Amar, mahasiswa psikologi yang kehilangan kemampuan merasakan emosi sejak tragedi masa kecil, dipertemukan dengan Elin lewat sebuah tugas kuliah. Pertemuan itu membawanya pada "Kafe Waktu". Sebuah tempat yang memberi kesempatan untuk kembali ke masa lalu. Namun ketika pintu menuju luka lama terbuka, sanggupkah Amar benar-benar menghadapi rasa yang selama ini ia kunci?

title: The Iron Lung
overview: Rian, the director who stunned the world with his debut, is now a prisoner of his own success. The spotlight that once illuminated his genius has become a scorching lens, magnifying the crushing demands of producers, the stifling hunger of the audience, and the paralyzing doubt cast by his own father. Rian yearns for bold experimentation, but finds himself shackled to the market-tested echoes of his past work, trapped in The Iron Lung of expectation. The Iron Lung is a visceral story of artistic suffocation and rebirth, asking a single question: What does it take for a visionary to choose freedom of expression over the comfortable silence of surrender?

title: Zombiephoria
overview: Four civilians are trapped in a deserted mall when a zombie outbreak occurs, and only a mysterious book can help them survive.

title: The Second Chance I Need to Live
originalTitle: The Second Chance I Need to Live
overview: Pram wakes up from a fatal accident and meets an angel to begin a journey into the afterlife, which makes him realize  life is not as bad as he thought.

title: Silentium
overview: Ayu, a young woman still grieving the death of her younger sibling, lives in silence and isolation. One night, she begins to sense something unusual—seeing the shadow of a small child and experiencing strange, unsettling events that remind her of her sibling.  When she hears her sibling’s voice coming from a laptop and encounters a terrifying figure in the storage room, Ayu becomes convinced that something is haunting her. However, when Olivia arrives, it slowly becomes clear that what Ayu is experiencing might only be hallucinations caused by unresolved trauma and overwhelming guilt.  This film explores the psychological side of deep grief, portraying how the pain of loss can blur the line between reality and imagination.

title: Growing Pains
overview: The relationship of a grieving father and daughter is tested when they are forced to navigate the daughter’s first menstruation cycle without her mother.

title: Melawan Stigma
overview: Setelah diputuskan oleh pacarnya, Gilang tidak bisa menerima kenyataan dan mengalami sebuah perubahan dalam dirinya. Dia mencoba untuk mengatasi rasa kehilangan dengan berdandan layaknya seorang perempuan. Gilang berpikir dengan menjadi seorang perempuan, dia dapat memiliki seorang perempuan tersebut seutuhnya.  Pencarian jati diri ini membuat Gilang terperosok ke dalam krisis identitas. Belum lagi, Gilang mulai mendapat banyak penolakan secara sosial dan diasingkan oleh sahabat-sahabatnya. Perubahan yang dia lakukan tidak berdampak baik dalam kehidupan  bermasyarakat. Merasa tertekan, Gilang akhirnya mengalami konflik batin dan memutuskan untuk menemui seseorang untuk mencari sebuah tuntunan. Pertemuan ini mempertemukan dua pandangan yang saling bertolak belakang dan dapat digunakan sebagai pelajaran kehidupan.

title: Yakin Nikah
overview: Niken faces familial pressure to marry despite her lack of desire. With both her ex-fiancé and current boyfriend pushing for marriage, Niken grapples with a critical question: to wed or not to wed? Oh, and more importantly, to whom?

title: Jembatan Shiratal Mustaqim
overview: After the tsunami disaster and rumors of aid fund embezzlement, Arya is frequently terrorized by visions of a place believed to be the Shiratal Mustaqim bridge — the dreaded bridge in the afterlife that connects to heaven and stretches over hell. Arya and his mother then try to investigate the connection between the embezzlement and the Shiratal Mustaqim bridge. However, their pursuit comes at the cost of their lives.

title: Dibalik Pintu Kematian
overview: Rahmat and Anisa, a poor village couple, rob the bank where they work. After succeeding, they marry and live happily ever after. However, their happiness is shattered when the house they buy turns out to belong to Mr. Gawat, the owner of the gate of death within his house and a demon-keeper. Can they escape the terror of their own dream home?

title: KEBERADAANMU
overview: Sudah 3 hari tidak ada kabar dari sahabatnya. Jullie tidak berhenti memikirkan apa yang sebenarnya terjadi padanya.Suatu hari, Jullie mendapat surat dari sahabatnya yang terletak dibawah laci mejanya. Sahabatnya tidak sempat menyampaikan sesuatu yang sangat penting untuknya, maka dari itu diungkapkan melalui surat-surat yang ditinggalkan.Mulai saat itu, Jullie bersikeras ingin mencari tahu keberadaan sahabatnya melalui surat yang ditinggalkan dan penasaran dengan apa yang sebenarnya ingin disampaikan oleh sahabatnya itu.

title: Penyangkalan
overview: In his daily life, Bayu is disturbed by the presence of his younger sibling who always follows him wherever he goes.

title: KENZO
overview: Di balik dunia hangat antara Kenzo dan pemiliknya, Mey, ada dunia lain yang tak pernah mereka bayangkan. Sesekali, kenyamanan itu retak—disusupi rasa lapar yang tak terucap. Ketika rasa penasaran dan rasa lapar bertemu, tak ada yang tahu siapa yang akan kembali.

title: Jangan Ambil Bonekaku..!!
overview: Tiga saudari berkepribadian gelap hidup terisolasi di sebuah rumah. Dua kakak menculik seorang gadis untuk dijual, namun sang adik bungsu salah paham dan mengira gadis itu adalah hadiah ulang tahun khusus untuknya. Kesalahpahaman ini memicu rangkaian peristiwa menegangkan yang mengungkap sisi tergelap keluarga mereka.

title: Grace of Time
overview: Cika, seorang mahasiswi yang kelelahan dengan rutinitas kampus dan hidupnya, mulai merasakan sesuatu yang aneh terjadi di sekitarnya.

title: Salah Seleh
overview: A simple misunderstanding transforms into deep psychological tension.

title: BAYANGAN WAKTU
overview: Satya (18) mahasiswa yang dikejar oleh deadline. Karna itu Satya stres dan berhalusinasi. Semua yang apa dia alami tergambar dalam Naskah dan Storyboard yang ia buat.

title: Gelap Mata
overview: A domestic worker finds cash belonging to her employer, who has been arrested for corruption. It turns out she's not the only one after the money.

title: Palangapa
overview: Untuk memenuhi keinginan terakhir kakeknya yang sakit keras, Danang, seorang preman yang meski akan menikah tetapi masih gemar mendatangi tempat karaoke, pergi ke rumah Tutik, untuk mencari obat yang akan menyembuhkan kakeknya.

title: Mãe Menjaga Masjid
overview: During her 28 years in Brazil, Bu Ipah has never stopped working. Initially arriving as a housewife with her migrant worker husband, she has spent the last 21 years as a mosque caretaker. During Ramadan, she is especially busy with food orders and iftar events.
