Despite her many duties, she cares for her youngest child, Totó, while balancing her roles as a mother, liaison to the ummah, and committee member for mosque social programs.

title: Badak
overview: A deaf single dad's life with his daughter changes when she becomes a hip-hop star. Meanwhile, another father faces ongoing challenges communicating with his deaf son.

title: Lavender Marriage
overview: A hotel housekeeper's life is upended when she discovers a devastating secret about an idolized actor that threatens to destroy his picture-perfect marriage and career.

title: Tukar Takdir
overview: Rawa, the only surviving passenger with injuries and trauma, must face the grief of Zahra, the pilot’s daughter, as well as the anger of Dita, the wife of a passenger who questions: “Why wasn’t it her husband who survived?”

title: Rangga & Cinta
overview: After a popular girl loses a poetry contest to an outcast, they develop an unexpected interest in each other – but is their young love meant to be?

title: Rest Area
overview: Five crazy rich people are stranded at a remote rest area during their nighttime journey. What was supposed to be a stopover turns into a nightmare when they are attacked by the Kresek Ghost, a wandering spirit with a face covered in black plastic, seeking revenge for past sins. One by one, they begin to lose control, terrorized relentlessly in every dark corner. The dark secrets they have been hiding are slowly revealed. What fatal mistake have they committed? And… can they survive the revenge that comes from beneath the ground?

title: Hantu
overview: Unknown plot.

title: Harapan Baru
overview: This film tells the stories of four women in Central Sulawesi who are building peace and resilience in communities shaped by conflict and disaster.

title: Mangkat
overview: Rian, a university student from Lampung, sets out on a journey to his campus in Bandung. He travels in a shared car with three other passengers. Conflict arises when the car breaks down and the driver is unable to fix it, causing some of the passengers to grow frustrated and angry. Amid the tension and uncertainty, they begin to open up to each other—sharing their backgrounds and the personal struggles they face. Through this unexpected moment of connection, they come to a new realization: “mangkat” (to depart) is not just about a physical journey, but about the courage to face life itself. Eventually, they manage to repair the car and continue their journey.

title: The Period of Her
overview: An anthology explores the lives of four women as they navigate the societal pressures of womanhood.

title: Sisa Sengsara
overview: A teenager is still struggling to accept his mother’s recent passing. His inner struggles are made worse by his strained relationship with his father. One night, an argument with his father pushes him into deep regret.

title: Andaikan Kau Datang Kembali
overview: In 1998, on the eve of a massive storm, a young boy witnessed a murder and became a fugitive. 25 years later, on the night of an equally large storm, a woman accidentally found a channel to communicate with the boy-right before the boy witnessed the murder. The woman manages to prevent the boy's death, but with another unexpected effect.

title: BERAKIT - Rakit Ke Hulu Rindunya Kemudian
originalTitle: BERAKIT - Rakit Ke Hulu Rindunya Kemudian
overview: Sebuah film pendek dokumenter yang mendokumentasikan tentang sebuah pengalaman dari kelompok KKN yang ada di desa Berakit.

title: Unstitched The Reveire
overview: Malo, a 19 year old teenager lives with his mother who works as a seamstress at home. One day, his mother hears a radio broadcast about a teenager's success at a young age, and his mother begins to hope that Malo can be like him. As a people-pleaser, Malo strives to live up to the expectations of his mother and those around him.

title: Cantik
overview: Arin seorang perempuan muda, yang sering merasa insecure dengan penampilannya. Namun, Reva memberikan perspektif baru bahwa cantik bukan sekedar apa yang dilihat oleh mata. Namun, bagaimana ia menerima dan mencintai dirinya sendiri.

title: Teror
overview: Adit seorang mahasiswa akhir, tengah terjebak dalam masa yang berat. Ego besar membuatnya menolak uluran tangan dari orang terdekatnya. Hal ini membuatnya tenggelam dalam lautan kesalahan, kesendirian, dan ketakutan dalam pikirannya. Tanpa sadar membentuk sosok yang mulai memburunya dan mendorongnya ke ruang batas antara semu dan nyata.

title: Semua Tentang Kita
overview: Menjelang hari jadinya dengan yang tersayang, Ryo yang merupakan seorang musisi membuat sebuah lagu untuk Angel, pacarnya. Sebuah lagu yang mengingatkan kenangan mereka berdua. Tapi ada hal tak terduga yang terjadi di antara mereka berdua. Ini membuat keduanya harus mengulik kembali semua kenangan tentang mereka.

title: Tumbuh tak Mekar
overview: Not everything that grows will bloom. Some stories end halfway, yet leave traces that time can never erase. This is a quiet tale about love that arrived too late, about moments that slipped away before they could be held, and about the kind of loss that teaches us what it truly means to care even when it’s already too late

title: Menjiwai Gangguan Jiwa
overview: Seorang wanita dengan kondisi mental terguncang, tersesat di hutan tanpa tahu arah pulang. Dalam kebingungan dan tangisan, ia terjatuh dan mendapati dirinya berada di dunia asing yang lebih menyeramkan. Di tengah dunia luas, muncul seorang wanita cantik bermata putih yang mengaku diutus untuk menyelamatkan wanita lusuh dari dunia fana. Namun, bukannya menenangkan, sosok itu justru mengajaknya menari dalam kegilaan yang makin lama, makin intens.

title: Debus.
overview: Maulana mendatangi seorang dukun demi mempelajari ilmu khas banten, debus.

title: Skenario Kakak Pertama
overview: Seorang adik perempuan dengan polos membagikan kisah cinta barunya kepada kakaknya. Di balik senyum hangat sang kakak, tersembunyi rahasia mematikan. Dengan bantuan tetangga penjual minuman, racun diselipkan ke dalam segelas minuman. Saat sang adik tewas, kakak itu mengalihkan kesalahan kepada tetangga yang tak menyadari apa pun.

title: Janji Senja
overview: In a village, lived Mr. Arman's family, Mr. Arman has one wife and 3 children, the first child is named Maria, Mr. Arman wanted Maria to become a TNI-AD, after Maria graduated from high school, Mr. Arman died, Maria decided to migrate, to pursue her dream of becoming a TNI-AD, as her late father wished. Because Petrus was the only son, he decided to manage his father's sago plantation. After three years of migrating and attending education in the TNI-AD, Maria applied for leave to the Commander to return to her hometown, meet her mother and two younger siblings to relieve her longing for them, after a few days of Maria's return home, her mother fell ill and eventually died.

title: Kang Solah from Kang Mak x Nenek Gayung
originalTitle: Kang Solah from Kang Mak x Nenek Gayung
overview: Solah Vicenzio returns to his hometown, accompanied by Fajrul, Jaka, and Supra. Solah imagines his homecoming will be celebrated like that of a hero but instead, he’s mistaken for a ghost. His disappointment deepens when he learns that the girl he’s long had feelings for, Dara Gonzales, is about to marry his own younger brother, Iqbal. However, their wedding is disrupted by terrifying appearances of a ghostly figure—Nenek Gayung, the corpse-washing spirit searching for her next victim to bathe. The only way to save Iqbal and Dara’s wedding is for Solah and his friends to confront Nenek Gayung and seek help from Kangmas Pusi.

title: Dilanjutkan Salah Disudahi Perih
overview: To reconcile after a final divorce, a former couple must navigate a legally required interim marriage, leading to unexpected jealousy and drama when the ex-husband repeatedly interferes in her new relationship.

title: Dia Bukan Ibu
overview: After her father’s death, Vira’s mother has a mental breakdown. To start fresh, the family moves to a new city and opens a hair salon together. While the family attempts to adjust to their new lives, Vira’s mother, Yanti, begins exhibiting strange, violent behavior reminiscent of her mental breakdown and becomes particularly preoccupied with her son’s sex life. Vira begins to investigate the strange occurrences and discovers that a dangerous ritual and a demonic possession are just the tip of the iceberg.

title: Tumbal Birahi Dukun Jahanam
overview: Taking the wrong action leads to disaster, Zakia, who wants her soulmate to come, has to face the reality of entering the circle of lust of a hellish shaman.

title: Machine Vacations
overview: When someone prompted an A.I chat box, 1 and 0 out of curiosity, goes on vacation through the internet. They questioning love and choices that human do.

title: Sekat Sekat
overview: Asun is about to start renovating their old house because of a will from his father, who passed away years ago. His mom, Aling, isn’t on board with the renovation. It has something to do with her unresolved past that she's kept buried in that house.

title: Back to the Weed
overview: A man who has lived a comfortable life returns to his past to change the fate of his best friend, who is trapped in a chaotic life. However, his intervention has unforeseen consequences that change the course of both their lives. In the future, the choices he made become burdens he must pay, leaving behind a changed relationship and the realization that not everything can be fixed without losing something.

title: Login ke Masjid
overview: An Islamic teacher and a young man were concerned about the declining attendance at the mosque, so they had to find a way to revive it.

title: Kerlap-Kerlip My Love!
overview: One night, Nugraha and Ajeng experienced the dynamics of their dating patterns which fluctuated like the flickering of lights.

title: A DISTORTED INDIVIDUAL.
overview: After 18 years in the underground music scene, Individual Distortion sets his sights on Indonesia's most prestigious music awards. Determined to be acknowledged, he navigates the complexities of the music industry, confronting challenges that test his identity and aspirations.

title: Perihal Jam Kosong
overview: 9 September pukul 09.00 menjadi tanggal, hari, bulan, dan jam paling traumatis untuk Nava (P, 15). Karena dirinya telat datang haid lebih dari tiga bulan. Perasaan cemas, takut, dan bingung menyelimuti hati perempuan itu.

title: Jadi Tuh Barang
overview: Bonar has just fallen out of love with Cantika and is trying to rise from his downturn with the help of his two friends, Awang and Wongso. They also received offers to become rain charmers to earn money.

title: Maryam: Janji dan Jiwa yang Terikat
originalTitle: Maryam: Janji dan Jiwa yang Terikat
overview: Since birth, Maryam's life has never been free from terror and the shadow of a genie. Until finally she received a mysterious letter that always appeared in front of her, the letter always appeared even though it had been thrown away, torn apart, even burned. She knew there was something invisible following her. The figure promised her not to leave her, clinging to her every step, whispering in a voice only she could hear. The more Maryam tried to run, the stronger the bonds held her back. Until slowly, she wasn't sure anymore... was she still living as herself, or did she belong to that figure forever?

title: Perempuan Pembawa Sial
overview: Mirah, a woman shunned by her village after the mysterious deaths of men connected to her, seeks refuge in a Padang restaurant owned by Bana, who falls in love with her. As more men die, Mirah discovers she’s cursed by her stepsister Puti with the deadly “Bahu Laweyan” curse, which kills any man who becomes intimately involved with her. Fueled by revenge, Mirah plans to destroy Puti’s happiness by targeting her husband. Despite the deadly curse, Mirah and Bana craft their own tragic love story, choosing to be together no matter the consequences.

title: Rumah
overview: maulana, seorang anak sma yang kesepian dan merasakan ketidakhadiran orang tua, merasakan depresi akibat orang tuanya yang kasar. suatu hari konflik maulana dengan kedua orang tuanya pecah hingga maulana memutuskan bunuh diri

title: Boi Bajingan Mamati
overview: Set in the city of Kupang, Boi, a young sasando seller, dreams of defeating all the criminals trying to seize the people's land. However, his anger only makes things worse.

title: The Body
overview: Six friends set out on a getaway to a remote villa to celebrate their bond, but the joyful atmosphere quickly turns unsettling when a shocking discovery sparks tension, revealing cracks in their friendship and drawing them into an unexpected nightmare.

title: Before Morning Comes
overview: A rising young filmmaker dreams of attending a writing residency in France to realize her first feature film, but finds herself torn when her partner insists she stay in Jakarta, forcing her to choose between love and ambition

title: Judecca
overview: In a decaying mall, a poet unravels from the inside.

title: Death (死)
overview: Wesley, a young man with OCD (Obsessive Compulsive Disorder), struggles against evil shadows that appear every time he repeats an action four times. Because it began to feel disturbing, he tried to break the cycle to get rid of the shadows.

title: Rekaman Terakhir Ilham
overview: A psychic teenager, who has a difficulty differentiating between hallucinations and reality, is assigned by his psychiatrist to spend the night in his abandoned childhood home. With a camcorder and polaroid as his aid, he must confront his hallucinations while a psychopath is lurking within his house.

title: Pengais Mimpi
overview: A young man narrated the details of his dream from last night to his father about the celebration of demonstration, anger, and graduation.

title: LIBAS
overview: A vocational school student is driven to take revenge on the bully who ruined his best friend's life and ended the terror of school bullying.

title: Surat untuk Presiden
overview: Bryan, an elementary school student in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), lives in poverty. He is filled with hope when he hears about President Prabowo Subianto's Free Nutritional Meal Program (MBG). The film's story begins with a simple letter he wrote to the President. The letter expresses his longing and dream that his schoolmates will be able to enjoy nutritious meals every day. This hope finally comes true when the MBG program is launched at their school, bringing real change to the lives of Brian, his family, and the children in his village.

title: Luka Bakar
overview: A Jakarta neighborhood rebuilds after a fire, seen overtime from a single angle.

title: Broken Wings
overview: The untold story of bird poaching in Southeast Asia. Forests are being cleared on a massive scale, and more than a thousand bird species are threatened with extinction. Almost no one knows about it.

title: Dia Pergi dan Belum Kembali
overview: Wulan, a woman who lost her brother, Stevanus, in the Klender Mall looting in May 1998. Although her memories of her brother only come from the stories of her mother, Maria Sanu, Wulan is inspired to write an essay titled "Dia Pergi dan Belum Kembali" and continue her mother's struggle to seek justice.

title: Imam and His 9 Friends
overview: Imam and His 9 Friends

title: Uji Kaji
overview: An indie filmmaker is asked to be a professor's test subject after his main subject goes missing while documenting.

title: 시네마 속 5월
overview: This work tells the story of the daily lives of two ticketing cinema staff during two incidents that sparked the birth of democracy in Jakarta in 1998 and Gwangju in 1980. They never experienced it directly or went onto the streets to face the soldiers, yet the stories they heard and the voices that reached them felt like an endless war film replaying in their minds.

title: Cahaya untuk Ibu
overview: After her father died at sea, Asih lived solely with her mother. To make ends meet, she helped her mother with various tasks, ranging from selling fish at the market to helping run a food stall. This grueling routine often left her exhausted, causing her to fall asleep in class. Her hardships intensified when her mother was diagnosed with kidney failure and required dialysis. Financial constraints hindered the treatment, and her mother eventually passed away. Fate brought Asih together with Denise, an American journalist. Asih’s honesty in finding and returning Denise’s mobile phone led to her being taken in as a foster daughter. Asih’s life was transformed; she continued her education in the city, pursued medical studies, and cultivated her photography skills to the point of landing a job with a foreign media outlet. She also succeeded in becoming a doctor, opening a medical practice where she provided free care to the underprivileged.

title: Penantian
overview: Seorang pemuda yang sebentar lagi akan pindah ke kota bahkan negara lain, menyadari bahwa ia tak bisa lagi menunda untuk mengungkapkan perasaan yang selama ini ia pendam kepada wanita yang ia cintai. la berusaha menyampaikannya lewat sebuah hadiah istimewa yang dikirim dengan biaya tinggi agar tiba tepat waktu. Namun, ketika hari yang ditunggu datang, hadiah itu dinyatakan hilang. Dalam kepanikan sekaligus tekad yang kuat, ia akhirnya memutuskan untuk menemui wanita itu secara langsung dan menyampaikan perasaannya tanpa perantara.

title: Lintrik: Ilmu Pemikat
overview: Sari, seorang wanita yang berusaha menggapai mimpinya untuk menjadi seorang ibu rumah tangga kaya raya menempuh suatu cara berbahaya: menggunakan lintrik terhadap cinta pertamanya yang kini sudah beristri.

title: Mama: Pesan Dari Neraka
overview: Setelah ibunya yang adalah peramal tarot ternama wafat, Putri menerima pesan misterius dari nomor telepon ibunya. Ia mengabaikannya sampai semua ramalan jadi kenyataan.

title: Sukma
overview: Arini and her family went to a small town to start a new life, but it turns into a disaster after they find an ancient mirror in a secret warehouse.

title: Gereja Setan
overview: Ribka experiences a low point in her life after becoming pregnant out of wedlock and losing her fiancé, Matthew, in a tragic accident. Ribka's parents ask her to hide out of town so that no one else will know about this "shame." Ribka then meets Gladys who gives her a place to stay and introduces her to Hendrik, the leader of the heretical Satanic church. Ribka slowly loses her identity and becomes trapped in horrific dark rituals. The problem becomes even more complicated when Ribka meets Lucifer, who wants to make her "the devil's bride." But amidst her despair, a glimmer of light comes through a spiritual experience that brings her back to true faith.
Two teenagers can be heard questioning the existence of dinosaurs over the phone.

title: Vivere Pericoloso
overview: In alternate universe of 1965 in Indonesia, two vampires struggle to survive a hunt by communist sympathizers.

title: High Tension
overview: A happy couple celebrates their six-month anniversary, wrapped in the illusion of a perfect love. But as the night unfolds, buried truths resurface, forcing them to confront whether their relationship is built to last or just a beautiful lie.

title: Rumbia
overview: Rumbia, its leaves are more than just a roof covering for Acehnese houses. They have long supported the livelihoods, including Dahlan, an elderly man who still faithfully gathers them to be crafted into roofs by local artisans. Today, rumbia groves have been sold off and buried beneath housing developments. The trees that once maintained moisture and stored groundwater are disappearing. The ecosystem is shifting, livelihoods are vanishing, and a humble yet vital local heritage is slowly being eroded.

title: Tarian Gajah
overview: This film sheds light on a traditional dance from the Gayo highlands—one that holds a memory of the once harmonious relationship between elephants and the Gayo people in ancient times. It all begins with a simple question: How did the Gayo community manage to coexist peacefully with elephants, leaving behind such a remarkable history? And how can this perspective on human-elephant conflict offer solutions for those affected today?

title: Fight!
overview: Zahwan menemukan ancaman baru ketika ia berusaha menghindari pertikaian dengan musuhnya

title: A Tale of Two Nomads
overview: Amid government restrictions on ritual burning due to environmental concerns, 60-year-old Wang and 7-year-old Ming strive to fulfill a prayer boat offering for their departed loved ones.

title: Lahir Batin
overview: Menceritakan Andri, seorang anak laki-laki dari keluarga sederhana yang terpaksa memendam impian masa depannya karena himpitan ekonomi yang tak kunjung membaik. Idulfitri yang seharusnya menjadi momen penuh sukacita dan kebersamaan, justru menjadi cermin pahit atas kesenjangan yang ia rasakan baik secara lahir maupun batin.

title: A Veiled Hunt
overview: A veiled figure walks through narrow alleys, carrying a mysterious bottle to an Islamic gathering, where a prominent cleric delivers a sermon that eventually takes a demeaning turn.

title: Irama Panen Rakyat
overview: This is the story of Waki Leman, a performer and practitioner of Alee Tunjang, a traditional art form played after the rice harvest. Waki Leman faces a major challenge: the lack of regeneration among Alee Tunjang players. While he continues to preserve this tradition with joy and devotion, many children are unwilling to learn. The main reason—children have begun to immerse themselves in gadgets.

title: Berkabung
overview: One afternoon, just before they leave for their mother's funeral, a father overhears his two children pouring their hearts out about her death. His son, Evan, feels he isn't ready to live without her. His daughter, Sella, is also consumed by sadness, even though her initial intention was to comfort a crying Evan. Hidden behind the door and his own emotions, the father listens, despite being just as shattered as his children.

title: Not My Mother
overview: Nayana is the perfect mother. She's tireless in taking care of her family even when she's not welcomed by Naura, the oldest daughter. In contrast, Axel is willing to accept her as his mother. Nayana never gives up to get the daughter's approval, accepting her with kindness and tenderness. The father brought Nayana hoping to fill the emptiness within the family, but Nayana's unwavering kindness seems almost too perfect. Will she be able to truly fill the void left by their mother, or is there a deeper truth to her unwavering perfection?

title: Driveway
overview: Reyhan, a 23-year-old man, works as a personal driver for Adit, his 35-year-old boss. One night, they give Lila, their co-worker, a ride home who is stranded at a bus stop. During the ride, Adit begins to behave inappropriately toward Lila. Reyhan, who witnesses this in the rearview mirror, is triggered by childhood trauma from seeing his older sister become a victim of violence. He secretly records the incident. As the situation escalates, Reyhan stops the car and rescues Lila.

title: Mulai Bicara
overview: Arya, seorang siswa SMP, kesulitan berkomunikasi dengan ayahnya. Merasa perlu melampiaskan rasa frustrasinya, Arya mengungkapkan semua perasaannya kepada AI.

title: Potong Kuku
overview: Dita, a rational high school student, is used to dismissing superstitions as mere myths. But that night, she cuts her nails despite her mother’s warning. The next morning, tragic news arrives: Mrs. Wati, their neighbor who had also warned her about the superstition, suddenly passes away. Dita begins to be haunted by guilt and fear. In the silence of the house and the whispers of myths, she is caught between modern logic and the fear of things that cannot be explained.

title: Pudar
overview: In his monotonous daily routine, Anka, an ordinary office employee, is crushed by a series of problems. His days started the same way: waking up, brushing his teeth, sipping bitter coffee, then being scolded by his boss at the office. His personal life is no less bleak—his relationship has failed and his father is in critical condition. The feeling of disappointment continued to pile up, making him feel like the world was hostile to him. In the midst of the destruction, Anka was haunted by pain that never subsided. When everything felt hopeless, he sank into the darkest despair.

title: DARMA
overview: Darma is a visceral and unflinching short film that confronts the dark realities of abuse and power. With its brutal and blood-soaked sequences, the film delivers gripping action that heightens adrenaline, supported by dynamic and precise camera movements.  At its core, Darma explores sexual abuse committed by those in positions of authority, individuals who not only perpetrate violence but also manipulate systems to conceal their crimes. The narrative also reflects on the power of media in shaping public opinion, and how such coverage can deeply affect the psychological state of survivors.  With a runtime of 14 minutes, Darma is both urgent and impactful, pulling the audience into an uncomfortable yet necessary confrontation with truth, silence, and justice.

title: Dosa Berbalut Doa
overview: A man named Retno, who appeared to be a religious figure, arrived in a poor, remote village. He distributed luxury food packages and offered to teach Quran lessons to the children. The villagers welcomed him and trusted him with spiritual guidance. In class, Retno taught that students must obey their teacher completely, even without reason. One student, a beautiful and obedient girl named Lala, caught his attention. She was kind, respectful to her parents, and had a younger brother.

title: A Boy and Dilemma at The End of Times
originalTitle: A Boy and Dilemma at The End of Times
overview: In the village, no one aspires to become an ustaz anymore. A seven-year-old boy named Awang struggles to find his dream amid the chaos of the end times. a reality he must confront, until his dilemma deepens when the only ustaz in the village passes away. With the community suddenly left without a religious leader, Awang’s unease and restlessness push him further into his search for meaning and the true shape of his aspirations.

title: Agape: The Unconditional Love
overview: A story about a silent, but deep struggle. About a caregiver who loves unconditionally, with a heart that never asks for something back.

title: Andai Ibu Tidak Menikah Dengan Ayah
originalTitle: Andai Ibu Tidak Menikah Dengan Ayah
overview: When her medical school scholarship was at risk of being revoked, Alin, who had been living away from home, was forced to return. After coming back, Alin’s perspective began to shift. She realized for the first time that her mother had been living in hardship, while her father was rarely around. Her younger sibling and older sibling also had to bear heavy burdens for the family, even sacrificing themselves and their dreams. While at home, Alin accidentally discovered her mother’s diary. Its pages were filled with memories from her mother’s youth, including her first love. This made Alin wonder: if her mother hadn’t married her father, would she have lived a happier life?

title: Piringan Bermarka Biru
overview: Lugu accidentally played an adult film, which was watched by the villagers and local figures.

title: Menjelang Magrib 2: Wanita Yang di Rantai
originalTitle: Menjelang Magrib 2: Wanita Yang di Rantai
overview: In 1920s Dutch East Indies, Giandra, a young doctor from STOVIA, reads about Layla—a girl shackled in a remote village as a "cure" for mental illness. Disturbed, he travels to Karuhun, where tradition and mysticism prevail over science. Guided by journalist Rikke, who warns him with three words—Culture. Mysticism. Superstition.—Giandra must confront a clash between modern medicine and ancestral belief.

title: Il Fiore Senza Vita
overview: A guy who tries to reconcile his relationship with a girl  at a library by giving her a flower. But with no luck finding the right moment, he scrambles to catch the right moment before she leaves, hoping to make amends and rekindle their relationship.

title: Livin By Curse
overview: During a blackout, Mira, Nadia, and Juan play an old snakes-and-ladders board game to pass the time. Unbeknownst to them, the game carries a curse. The further they play, the deeper they are drawn into a dark journey that forces each of them to confront their own egos, ambitions, and inner shadows.

title: Destined
overview: A man who believes in destiny keeps encountering the same woman wherever he goes. One day, he finally gathers the courage to approach her.

title: Shadow of Words
overview: Alexa, a novelist known for mystery and horror, is under contract to deliver three books and struggles to finish her latest work. Pressed by a looming deadline, she begins to experience strange events, as if her story were coming to life.

title: Cokelat Susu
overview: Beno, a fifth-grade student, has a crush on his classmate Erika. He tries to get closer and win her attention, but Erika prefers spending time with another friend. Confused by his failed attempts, Beno eventually experiences a change of perspective after a conversation with his father.

title: Kiamat: The End Of A Ballad
originalTitle: Kiamat: The End Of A Ballad
overview: In the final hours before the end of the world, a family—parents, a grandfather, an older sibling, and the youngest child—faces the impending catastrophe in their own ways. Amid it all, the youngest feels they should be together when the last moments arrive, and sets out to bring everyone closer as the world approaches its end.

title: Zakar
overview: A100.9 is a member of a secret organization whose mission is to restore nature by putting all humans to sleep for 1 decade. He joined a Javanese-style dhikr assembly to find peace of mind. In the midst of his inner conflict in carrying out his mission and culture, he makes a crazy decision. This man whose real name is Zakaria decided to become a tree to protect nature and life in the future.

title: Wong Mumet
overview: People come and gather to... do nothing?

title: Pamit
overview: Seorang gadis bernama Dian (22) harus memilih antara memenuhi kewajiban keluarga untuk hadir dalam tahlilan ayahnya yang baru meninggal atau menerima pekerjaan pertamanya demi membantu perekonomian keluarga. Dalam tekanan emosional antara harapan Ibu Dian (50) dan tanggung jawab masa depan, Dian berusaha membuktikan bahwa kepergiannya bukanlah bentuk pengabaian, melainkan kepedulian dalam bentuk lain.

title: A Cat Can Look at a King
originalTitle: A Cat Can Look at a King
overview: On his way to the police school, a young man, accompanied by his parents, brought his beloved cat. Unfortunately his father didn't like this. About him, cats and things are weak.

title: Rumahku, rumahmu
overview: When 13-year-old orphan Doni learns that his uncle Adi may be planning a life-changing decision, his world begins to crumble. Unbeknownst to him, Adi is secretly preparing to sell their beloved family home to escape mounting debt and secure Doni’s future. But when a charming woman suddenly enters their lives, Doni misreads the situation—believing Adi wants to replace him. Driven by fear and jealousy, Doni launches a series of mischievous attempts to sabotage the woman, unaware that the real threat is the truth he has yet to face.

title: Mocca: Life In Bloom
overview: To celebrate 25 years of their music journey, Mocca invites you to a colorful world. Life in Bloom is a special live session that will transport you into Mocca's new universe.

title: Siti Walidah
overview: The life journey of Siti Walidah and how she founded 'Aisyiyah, an autonomous, non-governmental organization under Muhammadiyah focusing on women empowerment.

title: Catalyst
overview: In a desolate future where Earth has lost most of its atmosphere, two brothers Nathan and the ailing Reza journey across a barren land in search of a mythical flower their late mother once spoke of. As survival grows harder, their bond and fading hope become the last light in a dying world.

title: Cinta Pertamaku
overview: Mentari, an elementary school student, lives alone with her father, Rais, who has mental retardation. Mentari's mother, Ayu Ling, who worked as a traditional dancer, died of an illness. Due to his limitations, Rais can only work as a street cleaner. His father's job makes Mentari often bullied by his schoolmates. Nevertheless, Mentari still feels proud and wants to make her father proud. The opportunity comes when Mentari is asked to participate in a school event by dancing a traditional dance. However, Rais himself does not want to see his son dancing, because it reminds him of his late wife.

title: Karya di Atas Luka
overview: Melihat lebih dalam kehidupan wanita bertato ditengah pandangan masyarakat. Keanggunan, kecantikan, moral memang penting bagi wanita, namun jangan menilai orang dari fisiknya, mereka memiliki alasan tersendiri untuk bertato bukan hanya untuk gaya semata.

title: Lebih Dari Selamanya
overview: Salim and Rifa had a marriage full of love and happiness, until Rifa passed away. Salim refuses to fall in love again and chooses to focus on looking after his daughter, Nasya. Salim's loyalty is tested when he meets Mila.

title: Pencarian Terakhir
overview: After Sita's disappearance at Mount Sarangan on Drupadi's 10th birthday, Tito's attitude became cold, leaving Drupadi sad. Her boyfriend, Raka, and her best friends, Maya, Ucok, Jamal, and Nurul, along with her parents' friends Bagus and Oji, and her uncle, Gancar, provided support for Drupadi. However, this was not enough, and on her 17th birthday, Drupadi set off for Mount Sarangan to search for her mother.

title: Panji Tengkorak
overview: Panji, who sold his soul to black magic to avenge his wife's death, intended to end his life, but found his body now shackled by black magic that controlled his soul. After wandering aimlessly, Panji met an old warrior who asked for his help to chase a bandit who had seized a sacred heirloom that was said to be able to eliminate the power of black magic. Panji accepted the offer that dragged him into a long war between two kingdoms and revealed the reality of his dark past.

title: Siapa Dia
overview: Layar, a popular film star who feels bored with his career wants to make a musical theater set in a family history that is always linked to Indonesian film history.

title: Bangsawan No. 42
overview: Kesatuan Pangaea merupakan suatu negara yang dikuasai oleh rezim totaliter bernama "Ordo Agung". Mereka menciptakan sistem dimana 150 orang terpilih akan di tunjuk untuk menjadi petugas negara dan akan mendapatkan gelar "Bangsawan"  Bangsawan No. 42, pada satu hari menerima tugas yang memicu ingatan-ingatan aneh. Saat ia semakin terjerat dalam pesan-pesan rahasia dan manipulasi psikologis, No. 42 terhubung dengan Jinhai, seorang Kapten dari Pasukan Revolusioner yang terlarang.  Pada akhirnya ia harus memilih, antara melanjutkan pengabdiannya atau menghancurkan sistem yang telah membentuk hidupnya.

title: Adikku Sayang
overview: Seorang adik perempuan ditinggal sendirian saat kakaknya pergi sebentar. Ia mencoba mengusir kebosanan di kamarnya dengan bermain. Namun, ketika sore berganti malam dan sang kakak tak kunjung kembali, rasa sepi berubah menjadi kegelisahan. Rumah itu kian sunyi, hingga akhirnya sesuatu yang mengerikan terjadi.

title: Melangkah Tanpa Suara
overview: Sebuah film tentang model tuna rungu yang sukses go internasional.

title: Get Money
overview: A worker rat wins a jackpot from online gambling and uses the money to travel to a luxury resort. Thinking that he is lucky, he continues to gamble online and loses all of his money.

title: Dia, Cerita yang Hilang
overview: Gibran, dikenal sebagai sosok yang kerap hidup sesuka hati, tak jarang menimbulkan masalah dengan sikapnya yang seenaknya. Berbanding terbalik dengan Nadira, seorang remaja berhati lembut, penuh empati, dan bijak dalam mengambil keputusan, seperti menjadi guru anak-anak terlantar secara sukarela.  Pertemuan tak terduga menyatukan dua dunia yang tampak bertolak belakang. Namun seiring kedekatan mereka, langkah demi langkah justru membuka rahasia lama yang terkubur dalam. Dari kepingan cerita yang hilang, perlahan muncul kebenaran—dan sosok misterius yang disebut “Dia”.

title: CIAK, CIAK, CIAK!
overview: Sebagai anak tunggal dalam keluarga Tionghoa-Indonesia yang menjadikan makan bersama sebagai sebuah keharusan, Feli dibesarkan dengan limpahan kasih sayang dari ayahnya. Namun, seiring bertambahnya usia, perbedaan sudut pandang di antara mereka mulai bertabrakan. Pada akhirnya, ia melewati berbagai fase di meja makan dalam perjalanannya untuk benar-benar memahami sang ayah.
1. What i eat  2. What i see when I'm at home  3. What i watched  4. What i read

title: Hanya Namamu Dalam Doaku
overview: Nala live a seemingly harmonious family. The father always prayed for his family to remain healthy and happy, both in this world and the hereafter. However, a figure from the father's past, whose matters remained unresolved, eventually caused a rift in their family life.

title: Labinak: Mereka Ada di Sini
overview: Najwa, a teacher from a small town, moves to Jakarta for the sake of her daughter Yanti’s future after accepting a teaching position at an elite school run by a foundation. However, their new home harbors both terror and clues from vengeful spirits—victims of an ancient cannibalistic practice carried out by the foundation's founders. As a deadly ritual draws near, Najwa must confront dark forces to save herself and her daughter from becoming the next sacrifices in the cannibalistic rite.

title: Darah Nyai
overview: A woman named Rara experiences a strange incident on the South coast. A murder far from humanity sets in motion a vicious chain of revenge.

title: Ambil Alih
overview: On their way home from vacation, Rafa and Rena accidentally hit a cat, whose color and size reminded them of their cat who had died... because it was hit by someone. Rana insisted on burying it on the side of the road, against Rafa's proposal, who wanted to take the foreign cat's body home, to bury it in the yard. When she got home, Rena began experiencing incessant strange events, which ended in tragedy.

title: Last Shadow at First Light
overview: Ami, haunted by recurring apparitions, embarks on a journey from Singapore to Japan in search of her missing mother. Amidst the transforming landscapes, Ami's dreams, hauntings and lost mother unveil their true form.

title: Sisupu Wonge
overview: Aswad Minggu is among the few people in Ternate, North Maluku, who still practices wonge-wonge, a ritual believed to be an alternative healing through summoning ancestral spirits. The spirits are said to possess their descendants, unconsciously making them dance endlessly to the beat of tifa drums, while performing healing rituals.

title: Remember Me
overview: A grandmother does her best to keep her granddaughter happy, hoping it's enough to be remembered.

title: MAIA: Sebuah Cerita Solarpunk
overview: Alfea hidup dengan nyaman sebagai seorang ilmuwan di Maia, kota terakhir di muka Bumi. Suatu hari ia menemukan Aruna, seorang asing yang mencari bantuan untuk desanya yang terancam. Bersama, keduanya menguak rahasia dibalik kota Maia.

title: SUMPAH PEMUDA
overview: SUMPAH PEMUDA (YOUTH PLEDGE) is an experimental documentary exploring self and state-crafted conceptions of Indonesian national identity of young Indonesians in the U.S.. Composed of scans of personal identification documents and participants’ objects of ‘Indonesian-ness’, recitations of the Youth Pledge, digital video of the Indonesian consulate in New York, and 16mm footage of self-identified Indonesians dressed and posed for a U.S. visa-compliant photo, the film is an exploration of what it means to be ‘Indonesian’ beyond national borders, whether here by choice, necessity or otherwise.  SUMPAH PEMUDA is a reflection on migration and displacement in an age of rising authoritarianism and fascism.

title: Putra
overview: Putra, si anak pembela kebenaran! Bersama dua teman setianya: Iis, gadis cerdas yang tangkas dan pemberani, dan Budi, si badan besar yang kuat dan hobi makan, Putra siap membela kebenaran serta melindungi lingkungan dan teman-temannya dari bahaya.

title: Perburuan
overview: Peaceful Kuntilanak siblings face terror from a powerful TikTok shaman who suffers a humiliating defeat in a chess match against his neighbors.

title: Diponegoro Hero
overview: Film ini berpusat pada kisah perjuangan Pangeran Diponegoro selama Perang Jawa yang terjadi pada tahun 1825

title: Topeng Suci: Sang Penjaga Perdamaian Batavia
overview: Pada masa penjajahan Belanda, Ki Jauhar bangkit melawan penindasan. Sebelum dihukum mati, ia mewariskan kekuatan pada boneka sakral yang dipercaya mampu melindungi rakyat dari kesengsaraan.

title: Merah Putih: One for All
overview: In a quiet village eagerly awaiting Indonesian Independence Day, a group of children are chosen to be the "Tim Merah Putih" to guard the sacred flag, the flag that is always flown during the annual August 17th ceremony. However, three days before the ceremony, the flag goes missing. Eight children from various cultural backgrounds—Betawi, Papua, Medan, Tegal, Central Java, Makassar, Manado, and Chinese—unite in a heroic mission: to save the mysteriously missing sacred red and white flag.

title: Panggilan Dari Kubur
overview: When Alya loses her daughter in a tragic accident, she buries her in the backyard of her mother’s village home. But the land is cursed—now her daughter has risen and she’s no longer the same.

title: Tinggal Meninggal
overview: After his father's death, Gema, an awkward young man, is surprised by the warmth from his coworkers. When it fades, he begins to wonder who must die next, setting off a chain of lies that spirals into chaos.

title: La Tahzan: Cinta, Dosa, Luka...
overview: Alina, who has a harmonious and loving family, never expected that the arrival of a new nanny in her home would become a significant threat. Now, Alina is faced with the choice to let go or fight to protect the unity of her family.

title: 49 DAYS - 四十九天
overview: Haunted by visions of her deceased daughter, Lydia searches for answers while facing pressure from her mother who insists she must calm the daughter's restless spirit

title: Wandering of The Lights
overview: In a city that never truly cared, a young man walked aimlessly. He had no one—only a pair of weary feet and a hope that was nearly extinguished. Each day, he tried to weave meaning from brief conversations with strangers, as if hoping that just one might last longer than a mere greeting. In the crowd that felt lonelier than solitude, he wondered how much longer he had to endure before he truly disappeared.

title: Menjaga Pangan Lokal Jagakarsa
overview: Documentary about a urban farming program in Jagakarsa, South Jakarta.

title: Pencarian Warna Ke-3
overview: Firyal (12) a color blind middle school student got a drawing assignment from her teacher. In pursuit of the perfect drawing she went out and try to match her colored pencil to the things that she drew.

title: Rolling Destination
overview: Parodi final destination! Syuting film yang mana dibintangi oleh Bryan, kelihatannya berjalan kurang mulus karena Bryan kurang menguasai aktingnya sehingga membuat sutradara kesal. Hingga akhirnya syuting dihentikan dan tak lama kemudian terjadi hal-hal aneh dan tragis, menimpa seluruh kru film di lokasi syuting!

title: Asa
overview: A high school senior grapples with the weight of failure and the fear that his future is slipping away. During his lowest moment, an unexpected encounter offers him a quiet reminder of resilience, and the strength to keep moving forward.

title: Bola Pinoama
overview: La Nane, Wati, and Tomi were happily playing soccer. Accidentally, La Nane kicked the ball hard, sending it into the yard of Uncle La Ompu, a man known for being fierce and mysterious. Tomi, the ball's owner, whined and insisted on retrieving the ball, a keepsake from his late father. Just as La Nane was about to fetch it, Uncle La Ompu suddenly shouted in a language they did not understand. They fled, deciding to retrieve the ball another day; however, their quest to get it back would prove to be no easy task.

title: Memories from Fire's Chaos
overview: Solo, May 1998. Riots erupted, shops were burned, lives were at risk, and chaos spread. Amidst the devastation, photojournalist Sunaryo Haryo Bayu kept raising his camera; capturing history while searching for truth and a glimmer of hope within the tragedy.

title: Reversal, Apoteosis Sepanjang Masa
overview: Two souls: One seeks to know her life's true essence and the other is haunted by foreign sights of himself, as they both are influenced by an existence beyond human realm—whom continually oversees them across eras, trapping them in a labyrinth of time and the unknown.

title: Satu Langkah Lagi
overview: This film tells the story of Anggi Wahyuda, a person with a physical disability who once had dreams of becoming a public servant and an athlete. However, his dreams were shattered when he was involved in an accident that resulted in the amputation of his right leg. His struggle to recover from depression and overcome his fear after the accident led him to decide to do something he had never done before.

title: Where All The Waves Go
overview: After years of silence, Aryo (Mochisyam Hidayat), a young Indonesian man yearning to reignite an old spark, finally meets Si Yuen (Pavel Gunawan)—his Singaporean online lover from the COVID-19 lockdown—for the first and last time in Jakarta, honoring a promise they made years ago in silence. Guided by an old notepad containing their long-imagined wishlist, Aryo chases reconnection while Si Yuen seeks quiet closure. Between memory and make-believe, can these tender illusions make up for the little time they have left?

title: Besok Mungkin Sampai
overview: Ngatinah (62) mantan transmigran mengobati rasa rindu anaknya lewat makanan yang ia buat

title: Kabar Bahagia
overview: Wati (49) seorang janda yang tengah mempersiapkan syukuran untuk anak semata wayangnya Fajar (24). Namun, kepulangan Fajar justru membuat harapan Wati tidak sejalan dengan kenyataan yang terjadi.

title: Selamat Makan!
overview: Bekalnya yang sederhana membuat Nadia, siswi  kelas 5 SD merasa minder di antara teman-temannya yang selalu membawa makanan estetik. Ia mendesak ibunya, Rahma, pemilik laundry rumahan, untuk menyiapkan bekal yang lebih menarik, tanpa tahu bahwa ibunya tengah kesulitan karena mesin cucinya rusak dan butuh biaya besar untuk diperbaiki. Rahma tetap berusaha memenuhi permintaan Nadia, sementara desakan yang berulang membuat Nadia semakin larut dalam keinginannya untuk menyesuaikan diri dengan teman-temannya.

title: Percaya
overview: Under the crushing pressure of a film deadline, Ryo finds an unexpected confidant in Ridhwan. What starts as a simple vent session in the school restroom turns into a chilling discussion about a mysterious figure terrorizing their friends.

title: Ketika Hantu Yatim Piatu
overview: Ketika anak manusia yatim piatu bertemu dengan anak hantu yatim piatu yang sama-sama ingin bertemu kedua orangtua mereka─hingga kenyataan yang menyakitkan menyadarkan mereka berdua.

title: Panggil Aku Ayah
overview: Little Intan was used as collateral for a debt by her mother, who was forced to become a migrant worker and leave her behind. But from that moment, her life took a turn. Dedi, the debt collector — a stranger who initially just came to collect — ended up becoming an important figure in Intan’s life. Together with Tatang, they grew into an unusual kind of “family.”

title: Els Invisibles
overview: A homeless man explores the bustling city after receiving a fragmented mirror piece from a mysterious, odd-looking figure.

title: Lyora: Penantian Buah Hati
overview: Follow the touching and inspiring story of a married couple, Meutya and Fajrie. Both of them struggled to have a child through IVF. However, it turned out that the process was not as easy as imagined.

title: Pamali: Tumbal
overview: When Putri's mother suddenly disappeared mysteriously, she decided to trace the available clues to find her mother again, starting from walking through a haunter forest, an abandoned factory, until arriving at an old house which turned out to be inhabited by "tuyul" and the terrifying black "kuntilanak".

title: RRR: Roaring Rhythmic Remix
overview: Lilik, ibu rumah tangga sekaligus ketua senam kampung, merayu anggotanya untuk berlatih senam secara diam-diam meski kegiatan itu telah dibubarkan paksa oleh sejumlah warga karena dianggap tidak pantas.

title: Sidik Saksi Senandika
overview: A police detective investigates a series of mysterious disappearances in a tenement to uncover the truth.

title: No More Noodles, Please
overview: To respect the fasting month, Dani (18) refrained from eating out by packing food from a warteg. However, two of his boarding house friends accused Dani of having no empathy and took his packet of food. He was forced to endure his hunger in his boarding room, until finally Dani could not endure the hunger and he returned to the warteg. At the warteg, she met her two boarding house friends who had cornered Dani while she was eating at noon.

title: The Last Dawn
overview: In an alternate universe, after the state abolished a banned ideology two decades ago, the country returned to safety. However, one of the former executioners began to hear strange voices that disturbed his activities at night.

title: MURNI: Wanita di Ujung Malam
overview: Beneath dim village lights, Murni walks the night — a quiet act of survival in the face of unseen burdens.

title: Dalam Jiwa
overview: Lagu Dalam Jiwa mengangkat tema konflik internal sebuah pertarungan senyap namun menggetarkan antara diri yang hampir menyerah dan sisi yang terus bertahan. Dalam visualisasi video, Zen diperlihatkan menghadapi versi jahat dari dirinya sendiri, menyimbolkan pergulatan mental dan emosi yang seringkali dialami dalam diam.

title: Jam Pasir Ajaib
overview: The Magic Hourglass is Adam’s ray of hope. With the Magic Hourglass, he can make his younger sister Ralin happy and lift his family out of poverty. However, Professor Ginanjar, along with Hendrik and his henchmen, are plotting to steal the Magic Hourglass. Adam realizes that the integrity he has always upheld is far more valuable than the magic of the Magic Hourglass.

title: Bestiary
overview: In a film about monsters, an actor’s greatest enemy is his own grief, a beast that grows stronger with every scene.

title: Sihir Pelakor
overview: Because of Rini's spell, Edi left his wife and two children. As a daughter who lost her father, Vita tried to win back her father's love and bring him back into the arms of his family.

title: Rego Nyowo
overview: Lena and her brother, Benhur, moved from Jakarta to Malang for college and stayed in a cozy boarding house owned by Mrs. Astri and Mr. Wiryo. Every week, all tenants gathered for a communal dinner. However, the peace turned into terror when a tenant had a strange dream and claimed the house was haunted, even seeing a hanging pocong. At first, no one believed it—until Lena saw it herself. This was no ordinary boarding house. The price to stay wasn’t money, but lives.

title: Harmoni
overview: Inspired by a true story about two farming families in Bali and Gorontalo. Made (60) a seaweed farmer in Nusa Lembongan, Bali, he insisted on maintaining his seaweed farming business, amidst the rapid flow of change and the massive tourism sector that damaged the sustainability of the marine ecosystem. Meanwhile, far away in the Transmigration area, Tuwarno (55) a Corn Farmer in Saritani Village, Gorontalo must face drought due to long drought, he is aware of climate change and wants to re-implement an environmentally friendly agricultural system and believe in local wisdom.

title: Bertaut Rindu
overview: Two high school students from vastly different worlds form a quiet bond that heals their hidden wounds and alters their perspectives on life, family, and hope.

title: DEAL!
overview: Sofi (16) terjebak antara ambisi dan tuntutan keluarga. Saat ujian menentukan segalanya, ia dan Roni (16) mengambil risiko besar yaitu melakukan kecurangan. Satu keputusan mengubah hubungan, nilai, dan cara mereka melihat diri sendiri.

title: Blacksquad "The Revenge"
overview: Blacksquad "The Revenge"  LEONDARDO (29), a skilled spy assigned to carry out a dangerous mission. With advanced skills and tactics, L successfully seizes a flash drive from the enemy. However, L's joy is short-lived. Members of the criminal group come seeking revenge and try to reclaim the flash drive. L must face them alone in a life-and-death battle.

title: Boarding
overview: Apip, a teenage cinephile, is forced to go to school in an Islamic boarding school by his mother for being "too free." In his final year, he discovers a golden opportunity: a national short film competition. But rigid school rules stand in his way, forcing Apip to choose between his passion and institutional demands.

title: Panitia Hari Kiamat (dan Jurus Jitu Dalam Menghadapi Akhir Dunia)
originalTitle: Panitia Hari Kiamat (dan Jurus Jitu Dalam Menghadapi Akhir Dunia)
overview: A false prophet attempts to exploit news of the apocalypse to deceive people into becoming his followers, but many people simply dismiss him as insignificant.

title: GULDIK!! GENJI'S LITTLE LIFE COACH
overview: A snackable drama series about the life of GENJI, whose world is constantly overflowing with drama—because everyone around him is way too sweet (literally “too much sugar”). Luckily, there’s GULDIK, always ready to lay down the real talk, offering tips and tricks so GENJI can keep moving forward—just like the main character in the movies.

title: Tuan Berkantung Tebal
overview: Seorang calon kepala desa yang gemar bermain perempuan tak menyadari bahwa gaya hidup yang ia nikmati diam-diam mengakar di rumahnya sendiri.

title: Gak Nyangka..!!
overview: Belum diketahui.

title: Doti - Tumbal Ilmu Hitam
overview: Ikhsan (Ahmad Pule) asks permission from his mother, Daeng Rannu (Sri Herawati), to visit the grave of his father, Daeng Rate (Jerry Wong), who died 15 years ago after being accused of being a black magic Doti shaman in Jonjo village. Although traumatized, Daeng Rannu finally allows it on the condition that Ikhsan be careful and hide his identity.

title: Kampung Jabang Mayit: Ritual Maut
overview: A rising young photo model named Weda finds her career on the brink of collapse due to a scandal involving her boyfriend, Bagas. In a desperate attempt to find a way out, Bagas takes Weda to his hometown—Rangkaspuna Village, a remote and isolated place once used as a dumping ground for unidentified corpses. The village still clings to dark mystical practices led by a shaman named Ni Itoh and her loyal servant, Rini. However, their initial intention to save Weda’s future quickly turns into a nightmare.

title: Believe: Takdir, Mimpi, Keberanian
overview: The son of a veteran named Agus was faced with the shadow of his father's absence, so he grew up to be an undisciplined child. Until the veteran died and made his son follow in his father's footsteps to enter the military world.

title: A Normal Woman
overview: Saat sebuah penyakit tak dikenal mulai mengacaukan kehidupannya, seorang sosialita harus mengungkap misteri di balik penyakit ini—sebelum ia menjadi gila sepenuhnya.

title: Call Me
overview: Sebastian, a cold and highly disciplined courier, lives a quiet life defined by routine. Outside of work, he spends his time wandering through parks, eating ice cream, and riding public transportation with no particular destination. Simple rituals that fill the emptiness of his days.  One day, he receives what appears to be a straightforward assignment, retrieve a teddy bear from a locker and deliver it to a designated location. The client’s instructions are clear, follow the orders and ask no questions.  After taking the item, Sebastian begins to notice that something is off. Someone seems to be watching him. Soon after, a group of men with malicious intent begins following him through both the quiet and busy streets of Yogyakarta.

title: Pertarungan Hewan Buas
overview: Di sebuah asrama terpencil, sekelompok pemuda menjalani latihan brutal demi sebuah pertunjukan yang disebut "Rakshassenayuddh"  simulasi kesurupan binatang buas untuk menghibur penonton. Toni, salah satu anak asrama, mulai mempertanyakan kekerasan sistem ini saat Gofar, sahabatnya semakin melemah akibat tekanan fisik dan mental yang berlebihan.

title: Ting-Ting Dance With Breathes Hope
overview: Seorang Remaja Perempuan SMP, terobsesi  ingin memiliki HP Aipon seperti teman sebayanya. Ia terus merengek meminta Bapaknya.

title: Sanap Any!ng
overview: A mother gives birth upside down, the husband panics, the fan breaks—everything spirals into chaos as the countdown from nine begins.

title: Jejak
overview: Di kota yang diliputi teror seorang pembunuh berantai, seorang wanita bernama Luna tampak ketakutan setelah menerima kabar dari seorang penjaga tentang korban terbaru. Ketakutannya sangat terasa, saat ia berjalan dengan hati-hati, merasa seolah-olah terus-menerus diikuti. Kecemasannya semakin dalam ketika seorang pria asing mulai mengikutinya.

title: Right Below The Neck
overview: A Theater student named Laras witnesses her friends rehearsing for a performance. At the same time, Laras is in the middle of conflict with someone from her house hold

title: Assalamualaikum Baitullah
overview: Amira, a woman who initially lived happily with the person she loved. However, everything changed when she experienced betrayal and lost someone close to her. Disappointment, devastation, and loneliness made Amira lose her direction in life. She felt heartbroken and found it difficult to recover from deep wounds. In desperation, Amira decided to go to the Holy Land. For Amira, this journey was not just a pilgrimage or an escape from problems, but a search for identity and new hope. In Mecca, Amira tried to make peace with her past, rebuild her fragile heart, and strengthen her spiritual connection with God. During her time in the Holy Land, Amira reflected a lot and discovered the true meaning of life. She also met new people who helped her healing process, including Barra who was always there to support her. This journey slowly transformed Amira into a stronger and more sincere person.

title: Arti Cinta
overview: A music producer who has a perfect family. However, he has a prankster nature that causes problems in his life.

title: Kitab Sijjin & Illiyyin
overview: Saat masih kecil, Yuli menyaksikan kedua orang tuanya tewas di tangan kekuatan misterius setelah ibunya dirasuki. Dicap sebagai anak yang dikutuk dan tidak diinginkan, ia bertahan hidup dan tumbuh di bawah naungan istri ayahnya yang lain, Ambar, dan putrinya, Laras, sambil menanggung penghinaan terus-menerus. Namun, semuanya berubah saat Ambar membisikkan rahasia terakhir ke telinga Yuli. Didorong oleh rasa dendam, Yuli melakukan ritual terlarang. Saat sihir hitam itu mengakar, dunia di sekitarnya mulai terurai.

title: Gerbang Setan
overview: Diki, Beni, Rachel, Bagas, and Wina went on a horror trip to Lawase Urip Village after Beni found a mysterious flyer on the campus bulletin board. Upon arriving in the village, they began to feel something strange and unsettling... They thought they were in for a fun adventure, but it suddenly turned into a horrifying terror. The line between real ghosts and fake ones became impossible to distinguish.

title: Urban Legend Sumiati: Teror Angkot Makassar
originalTitle: Urban Legend Sumiati: Teror Angkot Makassar
overview: Setelah serangkaian teror yang melibatkan kecelakaan sopir angkot di Makassar. Hasna seorang anak sopir angkot, mulai menerima petunjuk melalui mimpi dari arwah Sumiyati, korban pembunuhan yang jasadnya belum ditemukan. Hasna harus mengungkap misteri ini sebelum lebih banyak nyawa melayang, termasuk nyawa ayahnya, Jufri.

title: Pelan-Pelan Sayang
overview: Kev and Manda are trying to shape their future together, while Kev is also starting his own travel business. Everything changes when Lutesha, a new employee, arrives bringing ideas and a new spark into Kev’s world, threatening his long-time relationship.

title: Menjadi Utuh Dan Asli
overview: Miko, yang baru saja dipecat dari pekerjaannya dan dikucilkan oleh orang tuanya, bertemu dengan sosok dalam dirinya versi kanak-kanak, yang datang untuk menuntut permintaan maaf karena pernah ia abaikan di masa lalu.

title: Sesuatu di Jakarta
overview: Two individuals, each about to return to their hometown, coincidentally meet on their final day in Jakarta.

title: Star Fall In Me
overview: Hana (23) seorang remaja perempuan yang mencoba beradaptasi dengan lingkungan barunya dengan bergabung dalam sebuah band bersama saudara nya Arum (22), ia membuat sebuah lagu untuk band mereka demi bisa mengikuti sebuah audisi musik. Namun dengan ambisinya yang ingin selalu menjadi pusat perhatian membuat pertikaian pada band tersebut. hingga ia kehilangan arah dan dihantui bayang-bayang masa lalu dari bundanya membuat ia tersadar akan kesalahannya.

title: Alibii.com
overview: When a cover-up agency founder falls for a woman who despises deceit, his life unravels after discovering his own father is a client.

title: Yang Tersisa Hanya Cinta
overview: Melati and Jati's household, which has been built for seven years, is facing a storm. Tired of being the backbone of the family because Jati is reluctant to look for work, Melati is determined to divorce her husband. However, on the eve of Eid, the request of Melati's mother, who suffers from dementia, to celebrate Eid together postponed their divorce. Will they get back together or is separation inevitable?

title: Gamophobia
overview: Marja always has a fear of starting a serious relationship. As a friend, Gupa always gives advice to Marja, even though he is still single. Marja and Kirina are ex-girlfriends who meet again. Their relationship always fails, Kirina thinks this is because of her actions. They agree to find the whereabouts of the Shaman and the Doll that Kirina used to come to play a trick on Marja. Their efforts fail. Marja's love for Kirina grows again, but it's too late.

title: Gorengan Superpower 2 : Raja dari Segala Raja
originalTitle: Gorengan Superpower 2 : Raja dari Segala Raja
overview: An absurd action-comedy short film from Galih Wolfie. The story follows Azazel Thundercock, a legendary hunter who has spent decades tracking down the mythical "Gorengan Superpower" a food treasure that promises god-like power and absolute global dominion. Just as Azazel secures the Gorengan Superpower and prepares for his inevitable rise as the "King of Kings," his path is blocked by the Manusia Kerupuk (Cracker Man), a legendary figure who has been hiding for millennia. What follows is an over-the-top confrontation between two legendary rivals fighting for ultimate control. Will the power of the legendary Gorengan Superpower bring peace, or will it ultimately become a curse for the world?

title: Selasih Ireng
overview: Terjebak dalam keadaan ekonomi keluarga yang buruk, Asih yang lugu terpaksa bekerja sebagai wanita penghibur di tempat prostitusi milik mami Della yang licik. Cercaan dan perundungan di tempat kerjanya membuat Asih putus asa, sehingga Asih menempuh jalan sesat: mengamalkan ilmu hitam Selasih Ireng; yang menuntut banyak tumbal. Ketika seorang pemuda yang mencuri hatinya datang, Asih dihadapkan pada pilihan di antara cinta dan kesuksesan duniawi, sambil bertahan di tengah serangan teror Mami Della dan ilmu Selasih Ireng itu sendiri.

title: Hotel Sakura
overview: Sarah hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalunya sejak sang ibu tewas. Terjebak dalam rasa bersalah, Sarah bertemu seorang pria yang menawarkan opsi spiritual untuk menjawab keinginannya untuk berjumpa dengan sang ibu. Yang Sarah tak tahu, dia telah membuka pintu teror yang lebih besar. Keinginan untuk menebus kesalahan perlahan berubah menjadi petaka, dan dunia nyata mulai kehilangan batas dengan dunia arwah.

title: Sore: Istri Dari Masa Depan
overview: A young man living alone in Croatia encounters a woman who claims to be his wife from the future, sent on a mission to help him correct his bad habits and improve his lifestyle.

title: The Returning Dead
overview: A child in Surabaya wants to bury his father's body. However, on the night after the tahlil, his father's body rises, walks out of the house, and disappears into the darkness. On the same night, a resident of Lamongan sees the apparition of a walking corpse at the end of the village road; a village that is cursed: those who are born in the village, if they die outside the village and are not immediately sent home will return home by themselves.

title: Primate Visions; Macaque Macabre
overview: Set in a dystopian future, the film Primate Visions: Macaque Macabre (2024) opens with the fictional character Imago Organella, an experimental primatologist specializing in studying simians, apes and monkeys. Along with their companions, Xenomorphia and Madame Chauffeur, they free two yakis from captivity. Together, they embark on a surreal journey: they gather at a peculiar dinner where they eat a mysterious pudding elixir, visit an experimental biology facility, and explore each other’s subconscious as they traverse a prehistoric cave. Along the way, they celebrate the strange and unpredictable nature of evolution and knowledge, culminating in their return to Minahasa, where they face the reality of freedom.

title: Tertutup Rapat
overview: When she visits her childhood home, Uma is confronted with bad memories of her family. But it is there that the truth is revealed, and she begins to learn to make peace with her past.

title: Aksara dan Rasa
overview: Dikta is a writer who enjoys finding inspiration from the lives of people around him. One day, he notices a cheerful woman who catches his attention. At first, it seems ordinary, but over time, his curiosity turns into attraction. They often meet and grow close. But a few weeks later, Dikta suddenly disappears, leaving behind a big question and an unexpected truth.

title: Mr. Darmo: The Essentric
overview: A group of freshmen history students, who are currently being introduced to university life, expect that college will be as beautiful, comfortable, and straightforward as they imagine. But it’s not that simple, my friend. There exists an anomaly a slick, boomer-era lecturer with a phenomenal background: intelligent yet mischievous, moody, and downright weird. This becomes a challenge for the history students a mix of threat, pressure, entertainment, and amusement for those with different personalities.

title: Senandika
overview: This film is a short story of an Indonesian language teacher who teaches at a vocational technical school. The learning system he provides makes literary views look impressive in the eyes of his students. However, the progress of this art field is not well received at the school, resulting in losses for the teacher. Not only that, the losses suffered by the teacher were not only due to the school's decision, but there were irresponsible individuals who tried to destroy his career.

title: Jagad'e Raminten
overview: The documentary follows a  Javanese queer mother who redefines tradition and inclusivity through the iconic character of Raminten, forming a vibrant chosen family and a legacy of empowerment at the famed Raminten Cabaret.

title: Arwah
overview: Five siblings who have plans to go on vacation. However, on their journey, they experienced a serious accident which killed Sofi, their youngest sister. After Sofi's death, her four older siblings felt guilty until finally they felt terrorized by the incident.

title: Semesta Setelah Kamu
overview: Di taman senja tempat cinta mereka dulu bermula, Gema (25) dan Niskala (25) bertemu untuk terakhir kalinya. Raffa memilih mengikhlaskan, saat cinta tak lagi berpihak padanya. Dalam tenang, ia pamit kepada Lisa, dan pada harapan yang pernah ia simpan dalam diam.

title: Seribu Bayang Purnama
overview: Putro returned to his village after being discouraged from pursuing his hopes and dreams in the city. Determined to start a new life and dreams of revitalizing his family's land through natural farming methods. However, plans quickly resolve the resistance when his family's old rival challenges him to a prestigious farming competition. These battles can determine who will gain influence over the villagers.  As Putro struggles to prove the value of sustainable natural farming, his journey becomes more complicated when he falls in love with Ratih, the owner of the village's chemical fertilizer and pesticide shop, the daughter of his family's rival. Caught between his ideals and feelings, Putro struggles to bring meaningful change to society while facing personal and social conflicts. His determination to improve the lives of those he loves is tested at every turn, forcing him to face challenges deeper than his dreams.

title: Agen +62
overview: Dito dan Martha adalah dua agen rahasia dari PUANAS (Pusat Usaha Nasional), badan intelijen paling bawah di Indonesia. Namun karena statusnya yang rendah, data mereka luput dari peretasan besar-besaran yang membocorkan informasi rahasia di seluruh negeri. Hal itu membuat PUANAS mengambil peluang dengan mengadakan misi terbesarnya untuk mengungkap kasus paling meresahkan di negara ini, yakni perjudian online.

title: Narik Sukmo
overview: Kenara Cahyaningrum has a hobby of dancing. But when on vacation to a village, this hobby triggers the anger of an entity that had passed away decades ago.

title: KAR
overview: Sehari sebelum peringatan seribu hari kematian suaminya, Kar, seorang wanita tua, menerima kabar bahwa orang lain telah bermimpi melihat suaminya bersama seorang wanita misterius. Sementara itu, Kar belum pernah didatangi suaminya dalam mimpi. Lalu, Kar memutuskan untuk tidur sebentar, menanti saat terakhir ketika suaminya akan datang kepadanya dalam mimpi, sebelum kepergiannya untuk seribu hari.  Perjalanan Kar menuju hari ke-seribu kematian suaminya membawanya lebih dalam ke dalam distorsi esensi, identitas, dan waktu.

title: Literacy Amidst Ignorance: Anton Solihin and Batu Api Library
originalTitle: Literacy Amidst Ignorance: Anton Solihin and Batu Api Library
overview: Anton Solihin is an interesting person. As the owner and caretaker of Batu Api library, a small library in Jatinangor, West Java, Indonesia, he is known for his unique taste and character. Batu Api, established on April 1, 1999, has been a haven for university students studying in Jatinangor—an educational area with four universities and a combined student population of no less than 10,000—to find and check out books. In a country that ranks lowest in literacy statistics, owning and operating a private library in Indonesia can be considered a determined and tenacious act, if not a bit crazy.

title: Magrib Jakarta
overview: As twilight falls and the call to prayer echoes, we seek to uncover what happens in Jakarta.

title: FOKUS
overview: Non dialogue movie about a young high School students who pursues his film making career a midst of struggle and self doubt.

title: Will Today Be a Happy Day
originalTitle: Will Today Be a Happy Day
overview: Mira, a single mother, must make a tough decision for her daughters future despite their joyful days together.

title: Paddle Pop: Game On!
overview: Max Paddle Pop and Liona discovering a signal emanating from Earth, specifically the city of Orbis, indicating a dangerous situation. They find that Shadow Master is collaborating with Pixel Devil to create a game called Glitch, which has a negative impact on the minds of its players. Arka, a child from Orbis, becomes entangled in the adventure and joins Max and Liona in their quest to stop Shadow Master.

title: Rabi Jiwo: Menikahi Mayat
overview: A young man who is in love from a different caste. He does everything he can to get his lover. He doesn't care about what will happen to him in the future.

title: Jodoh 3 Bujang
overview: Three bachelor brothers—Fadly, Kifly, and Ahmad—were asked by their parents to have a joint wedding due to financial limitations in upholding tradition. However, Fadly's fiancée was suddenly arranged by her parents to marry a more well-off man. Now, Fadly must find a new bride in the short time remaining, or their joint wedding will be in jeopardy!

title: Lorong Kost
overview: On the second day of Eid, Koko's boarding house was still occupied by several residents who did not go home for the holidays, and on that day, Tika became a new resident. Unfortunately, on that same day, a murder tragedy occurred, causing all the residents to suddenly become witnesses and be prohibited from leaving! During the investigation, what happened instead was the haunting of the spirit of the murdered resident, which sparked suspicion among the boarding house occupants.

title: Warkop DKI Kartun
overview: The Warkop trio — Dono, Kasino, and Indro — are dragged into the most daring mission yet: disguise themselves as Indonesian national team players in a World Cup qualifier to sabotage a match in the fictional country of West Korea and stop a conspiracy that could trigger a nuclear war. But saving the world is only a small part of their job as CHIPS agents. They also have to hunt down their own rebellious robots; and transform into elementary school children to uncover a national exam cheating scandal.

title: Pilem Tentang Pilem Maker
overview: Dua sahabat muda nekat mengangkat kisah gelap, demi memberi suara pada seseorang yang telah lama kehilangan kemampuan untuk bersuara.

title: Dibawah Pohon Rindang
overview: Sepasang mahasiswa yang nekat berpacaran di area kampus saat senja tanpa mengetahui larangan tak tertulis tentang pohon tua angker di sana, membangkitkan kemarahan makhluk gaib penunggunya. Membuat mereka gelisah karna bisikan kata putus terus menerus disetiap kegiatan mereka, hingga akhrinya.

title: Reach
overview: A girl finds herself captive in a desperate mental state, struggling to grab the only source of light in obscure darkness. She then realizes that her alternate self effortlessly overlooks the possibility of attempt when she tries to reach the sun.

title: Muka Mika
overview: Through an interview, a man retells his past experiences with his late friend that didn’t have a photograph.

title: Senyap
overview: After a devastating fire destroys their mountain village, a young girl and a pregnant woman seek refuge in an isolated wooden house. Haunted by trauma and surrounded by silence, strange events unfold marked by mysterious paper cranes slipping beneath the door. SENYAP explores the weight of memory, violence, and survival in a world where even silence has its own scream.

title: See No Evil
overview: JO (37) a hitman who begins to change when he is sentenced to only have 24 hours to live, his decision to leave the dark world and try to atone through good deeds which becomes a reflection of his inner struggle and emotional journey towards the end, when his only hope is to die with a peaceful heart.

title: Antara Dua Panggilan
overview: Seorang guru honorer yang berdedikasi menerima telepon mendadak dari tetangganya—anaknya yang sedang sakit tiba-tiba kritis. Panik dan diliputi kecemasan, ia segera memohon izin kepada kepala sekolah untuk pulang lebih awal. Namun, permohonannya ditolak. Ia masih harus mengajar kelas penting yang tidak bisa digantikan siapa pun. Di tengah tekanan dan waktu yang terus berjalan, sang guru dihadapkan pada pilihan paling menyakitkan dalam hidupnya: mempertahankan pekerjaan yang menjadi tumpuan keluarganya, atau pulang demi menyelamatkan anak yang paling ia cintai.

title: EMAK
overview: A loving elderly mother dedicates herself to caring for her child with mental health struggles. As she provides unwavering love and support, her own health begins to decline, causing uncertainty and distress for her child.

title: Kidung Tani
overview: Amid an ecological crisis in Indonesian agriculture, a farmer's Javanese practices and poetic expressions offer a quiet resistance and a vision of living in harmony with the land.

title: Menjadi Maling Dalam 11 Menit Bersama Bang Sat!
originalTitle: Menjadi Maling Dalam 11 Menit Bersama Bang Sat!
overview: Satria, a professional thief, lives ironically within an academic community. Behind his friendly demeanor, he crafts a step-by-step guide to stealing—divided into two phases: pre-theft and theft. Through witty yet biting narration, the film peels back the layers of moral absurdity in society, questioning the line between cleverness and crime. A social critique wrapped in satire and irony.

title: Sakit Tumbuh
overview: In a city gripped by political ambition, WIDI-an idealistic mayoral candidate finds his moral compass crumbling under the weight of a brutal campaign. With his pragmatic aide GALIH by his side, their fight for justice turns into a game of manipulation, black campaigns, and masked corruption.  As a relentless journalist, RAJA, uncovers the rot beneath their promises, tensions explode, morality clashes with ambition, and loyalty with betrayal. In the end, no one walks away clean.  Sakit Tumbuh is a dark political drama about the price of power, the death of idealism, and the scars left behind when hope is lost to compromise.

title: Hari Ini Mau Makan Apa, Sayang?
overview: “What’s for dinner, dear?” is the question that stays with Mama day after day—until one dinner makes her stop asking.

title: Nadir
overview: NN lives in an environment that is completely at odds with who they are. Their past has made them lose faith in the concept of God—only the plants they care for and Yono, a man who runs a plant shop and seems to share the same beliefs, offer any sense of connection. One day, NN decides to prove that God does not exist and begins to challenge Him. One by one, their wishes are granted—but the consequences are far from what they expected. NN's life starts to change in unexpected ways.

title: Kita Yakin, Mereka Yakin
overview: In the end times, a common man finds himself in dialogue with an angel in a toilet room that became a place of confession.

title: Mirrors
overview: Mirrors follows the inner journey of Lucien Hale, a detective haunted by an unsolved murder case, one that remains unresolved, at least in his conscience. Years after the system closed the file and the world moved on, Lucien uncovers a new clue that pulls him into a series of conversations with someone believed to be connected to the crime.  When a man named John Corwin is brought in for interrogation, Lucien is convinced he's finally closing in on the truth. But their exchange is far from ordinary. Fragmented memories, hazy flashbacks, and cryptic, blood-stained messages begin to collide with Lucien's own beliefs, blurring the line between the truth he seeks and the reality he fears.

title: Syirik: Danyang Laut Selatan
overview: After six years of studying at a pesantren, Said returned to his village, Wonosari, only to find it drastically changed. His village was now entangled in mystical beliefs. Amid the chaos, Said reunited with Sari, his childhood sweetheart, but their relationship was hindered by Sari’s mother, Santika, who was determined to make Sari the lead dancer in the village's ritual.
