Unaware of the true importance of her role, Sari found herself caught in a dangerous web of intrigue involving Santika, Ningsih, and the village chief. Ningsih, who aspired to take the lead dancer's place, was willing to do anything—including using black magic—to threaten Sari. Meanwhile, Ki Dalang, the leader of the ritual, struggled to uncover who truly possessed the qualities to become the lead dancer. This search led to a confrontation with dark forces that threatened everyone involved. This tale, rich in mystery and conflict, tests the limits of love, trust, and tradition.

title: Jalan Pulang
overview: After her husband's mysterious death, Lastini believes a dark entity is possessing her daughter, Arum. With only five days before Arum's leap-year birthday, Lastini and her two other children journey across Java to seek help from spiritual healers. As the demon's grip tightens, they race against time to save Arum and find their way back home.

title: Angél Pol
overview: Jati and Lastri form a traveling “dangdut” orchestra with a truck to survive among marginalized communities.

title: Assalamualaikum Beijing 2: Lost in Ningxia
overview: Aisha thought she had found happiness with Arif, a figure who perfectly complemented her life. Making her not hesitate to remove all obstacles, even the most difficult ones, to prove how great her love was. In fact, the love that Aisha believed in not only gave her wings to fly high, but also dropped her from the highest place, taking her to wander the jungle without a clear goal. Making her ask, Have the decisions she has made so far been right? Where will her love find its estuary? Truly God is All-Good, the journey through Ningxia made Aisha realize that time is another form of His goodness. And the most important part is not the beginning, but the end. Always the end.

title: Malam Jahanam
overview: Indah, a cheerful high school student suddenly became gloomy every night because she terrorized by supernatural beings.

title: One Last Walk
overview: Elva preparing to leave behind her hometown and memories before starting a new life elsewhere.

title: Waiting For The D'day
overview: Kebebasan ingin berkuliah dikampus luar kota, berujung pada hubungan pertemanan  yang toxic serta pergaulan bebas, hingga akhirnya Aluna pulang ke rumah dan  menyesali perbuatannya.

title: Last Attendance Book
overview: Four high school friends, Rey, harboring deep resentment; Laras, a perfectionist masking her failures; Dimas, silently scarred by trauma; and Safa, bitterly sarcastic, are forced to reunite when their scary teacher, Mrs. Mira, passes away.

title: lensa hening
overview: A photo contest revives Arul’s dream. With an old camera and 2 a.m. prayers, he chases one shot that could change everything.

title: Step Through the Memories
overview: Menceritakan tentang Cetta yang ingin memperbaiki hubungan dengan teman-teman sekolahnya sebelum hari kelulusan.

title: DOR!DOR!DOR!
overview: Ito, a young guy battling a cold, Reza, the wise mentor, Hendra "Samurai" from Sunda, and Anton, a tough-as-nails scoundrel they're four guys who've pulled off countless jobs for their boss, Pak Angga. This time, Pak Angga really needs them because his daughter, Naomi, an idol, has been kidnapped by a fanatical fan. But something terrible goes wrong because of their screw-up.

title: Skenario Remi
overview: Keenan is a boy who dreams of going to a football school but financial constraints make him desperate and play online gambling.

title: The Sadness is Not Over Yet
originalTitle: The Sadness is Not Over Yet
overview: Sulastri, seorang ibu tunggal yang harus melanjutkan hidupnya selepas bercerai. Ia mendapatkan tekanan masyarakat atas status barunya. Ia juga dianggap sebagai pembawa aib bagi keluarga lantaran tak kunjung menikah lagi.

title: Wali
overview: As her wedding day approaches, Cantika sets out to find her estranged biological father, only to uncover a shocking truth: her father, long kept hidden by her late mother, has transitioned into a woman named Dewi. As Cantika and Dewi navigate  the complexities of their past and present, they must confront deep-seated wounds  and attempt to rebuild a relationship fractured by time and secrets.

title: Tutup Hari Kiamat
overview: A married couple who own a Madura small shop that they say will only close on apocalypse day want to be intimate again. But the husband doesn't want to close the small shop because he thinks the apocalypse would happen if he does.

title: Sisa.
overview: Seorang anak perempuan yang bernama Sheily memiliki minat kuat terhadap seni, namun ia hidup bersama ayahnya yang memiliki trauma terhadap seni dan hidup keterbatasan dilingkungan yang kumuh. Ia selalu menolong ayahnya memulung hingga mendapat kesempatan mengikuti lomba yang diingikannya, dalam gelap ia pergi tanpa sepengetahuan ayahnya hingga membawa hasil membanggakan kepada ayahnya.

title: Senandika
overview: A woman wants to be liked on her social media by following trends, but she doesn't get a good response.

title: Memory Lane
overview: A man worn down by the stress of adult life begins to drift back into memories of his childhood—and unexpectedly finds himself reliving its most beautiful, forgotten moments.

title: Slices of Leek
overview: Cuz all those slices of leek will always lay scattered on the chopping board of our mind.

title: Selamat Tinggal, Michelle
overview: Goodbye Eri Fan Film. Setelah mereka membuat film dokumenter selama 6 bulan, Michelle (Indah) berencana mengungkapkan alasan nya memilih Melki (Rifkya) sebagai sutradara dari film dokumenter nya, dan Michelle juga ingin menantang Melki untuk membuat film baru dengan unsur fantasi dan fiksi, karena Michelle ingin Melki menjadi seorang filmmaker yang hebat. Apa alasan Michelle? Apakah Melki berhasil memenuhi tantangan Michelle?

title: The Dark House
overview: The story begins when Dewi, who is trying to undergo a pregnancy program with her partner, Arya, a psychosis sufferer, goes on holiday to an old house that once had a tragic and frightening story, located at the foot of Mount Selamet. When they arrived at the house, Arya, Dewi, and their beloved dog, Gomes, began to feel that something was wrong in the house they lived in. Mystical events that cannot be explained by common sense began to occur frequently. The supernatural incident peaked when Dewi invited her friends Gaby and Ansel to come stay overnight while Arya was away. Long story short, one night Dewi, Gabby and Ansel played Charlie-Charlie "a game of summoning spirits which is quite legendary and very popular in Mexico". Suddenly! A frightening phenomenon occurred after Dewi wanted to end the game.

title: GJLS: Ibuku Ibu-Ibu
overview: The togetherness of 3 siblings in thwarting their father's intention to remarry leads to family disintegration and minimal inheritance distribution.

title: Keluarga Super Irit
overview: Setelah sang ayah di-PHK, keluarganya yang hemat harus kompak saat mereka pindah ke rumah lebih kecil dan melakukan pengiritan sangat ekstrem.  Dalam kondisi sulit itu, mereka mengandalkan warisan keluarga, TRIK (Taktik Irit Keluarga): jurus bertahan hidup turun-temurun.  Mereka terus berjuang mempertahankan cinta, kebersamaan, dan harapan akan masa depan yang lebih baik.

title: Senyum Manies: Love Story
overview: Biopic film about the love story of Anies Baswedan and Fery Farhati while studying in Yogyakarta.

title: Kuning
overview: Father and son who were immersed in an awkward conversation throughout their journey to who knows where they were going

title: That's Life
overview: Naskahnya dikritik “kurang hidup.” Darren, penulis muda yang sedang kehilangan arah, mencoba menulis ulang. Namun, sesuatu yang tak biasa terjadi: kejadian-kejadian yang ia tulis mulai terjadi di dunia nyata, persis seperti yang ia bayangkan.  Dari kejadian konyol hingga yang mengusik logika, Darren mulai sadar bahwa ini bukan kebetulan. Apa yang ia pikirkan jadi nyata dan hidupnya perlahan masuk ke dalam ceritanya sendiri.  Namanya Juga Hidup adalah film pendek surealis tentang absurditas, imajinasi, dan hilangnya batas antara fiksi dan realita. Lalu… siapa sebenarnya yang menulis akhir cerita ini?

title: A Tale of the Unseen
overview: (Sini), a old woman is preparing for her own death, because for her it is better to die than to live but be alone.

title: Kita Usahakan Rumah Itu
overview: Amel and her lover, Iko, plan to revisit Amel's childhood home. However, when they arrived there, they found the house had been turned into a sewing shop. After asking permission from the shop owner, Amel and Iko entered. Inside, Amel tried hard to remember every corner of the room, comparing it with memories of her old house while telling Iko.

title: Ini Ibu Budi
overview: The death of his mother plunges Budi into the feelings of loss and sadness that he has yet to understand. To process his feelings, Budi must go on a journey to find a final resting place for his mother.

title: Atma Akusara
overview: Mello wants to create a beautiful painting, but he keeps erasing his sketches. One day, he meets a mysterious man who will help him finish his painting.

title: Sektor Merah
overview: A homesick college student secretly supports a rival team in enemy territory and must find a clever way to watch the championship match without blowing his cover.

title: Serves and Bounces
overview: After getting laid off from work, Bagas turns to squash sport to manage his emotions, invited by his friend who is also a former employee that had been laid off months ago. Bagas feels it's best to not tell the news to his girlfriend, Devi, while she is still in recovery from depression. Later that day, Devi accidentally finds out.

title: Way Back Home
overview: Mesala dan Ratih ingin pergi ke Pacitan Jawa Timur, untuk menemui anak Ratih yang sudah lama terpisah. Bersamaan dengan rencana itu. Juda menemui Mesala, kakak tirinya, untuk mencari ayah mereka yang telah lama menghilang. Namun Mesala tidak ingin menemui ayah dan ibu tirinya, karena ia belum bisa memaafkan ayahnya, yang dianggapnya telah mengkhianati dan menyia-nyiakan ibu kandungnya yang sakit-sakitan dan kemudian meninggal. Meskipun terpaksa pergi karena dibujuk oleh Ratih, Mesala akhirnya menemani Juda menembus hutan belantara Kalimantan. Selama perjalanan, konflik batin kedua bersaudara tiri itu makin memanas.

title: Awas Kepunan: Kelak Celako
overview: Menolak minum kopi membuat sial, begitulah yang terjadi pada Kristin dan Clo. Adat yang dilanggar menjadi awal malapetaka, kesialan dan kesialan datang hingga ajal di depan mata.

title: Ruang Rahasia Ibu
overview: Erin is a cheerful girl who is always cheerful, but changes after losing her mother in a plane crash. Wanting Erin to be cheerful again, Alex volunteered if Erin needed help. Even though she was reluctant at first, Erin finally asked Alex to help open the door to her mother's studio. The problem becomes even more complicated when they find a music box in the room which actually reveals the mystery of Erin's mother's origins and the reason why her mother left.

title: Douze Dubls
overview: Dalam Douze, sebuah film dengan tema video musik, kita tenggelam dalam kenangan kelas bernama "Douze." Perjalanan sinematik ini menggunakan musik sebagai bahasa utamanya, menyatukan serangkaian sketsa yang memukau secara visual dan emosional. Setiap adegan adalah video musik yang dibuat dengan cermat, tidak hanya diatur ke lagu, tetapi juga bagian integral dari narasi itu sendiri.  Film ini meninjau kembali momen-momen penting dalam kehidupan para siswa ini—kegembiraan yang singkat, patah hati yang tenang, dan ikatan yang mendefinisikan satu generasi. Melalui lensa yang bersemangat dan nostalgia, Douze mengeksplorasi tema universal masa muda, persahabatan, dan berlalunya waktu yang pahit. Soundtrack bertindak sebagai detak jantung film, membimbing kita melalui permadani pengalaman bersama yang sangat pribadi dan dapat dihubungkan secara universal. Ini adalah penghargaan atas kekuatan musik untuk menangkap dan mengabadikan kenangan kita yang paling berharga.

title: Paris in Bali
overview: Unexpectedly, a man named Bumi met a girl named Paris. Starting with a silly misunderstanding, their story evolved into love. Unfortunately, a fact emerged that Paris was still connected to a traumatic event from Bumi's past.

title: Basement: Jangan Turun ke Bawah
overview: Mempertemukan sekelompok anak muda dalam petualangan paling kelam yang pernah mereka alami. Apa yang awalnya hanya rasa penasaran tentang lorong gelap di bawah apartemen, berubah menjadi teror tanpa akhir. Mereka tidak tahu... bahwa setiap langkah mereka ke bawah adalah satu langkah menuju kematian.

title: Cuerpos de Maria
overview: A woman is found lying down in different circumstances and locations, revealing a dark truth for women in Spain.

title: Tenung
overview: Ira lives with her mother, Linda. One day, without any rational explanation, a mystical incident causes Linda to behave like a madwoman—suffering physically and frequently hallucinating. Unable to cope with her mother's condition, Ira asks her siblings, Ara and Ari, to come home and help take care of their mother. Unfortunately, fate has other plans, and Linda eventually passes away.

title: Tak Ingin Usai di Sini
overview: Mencintai berarti merelakan. Tapi bagaimana kalau hati tak pernah rela untuk mengucapkan selamat tinggal? K dan Cream berharap cinta mereka Tak Ingin Usai di Sini.

title: Gowok: Kamasutra Jawa
overview: Set in 1960s Java, a young Javanese woman betrays her teacher, falls in love and must face dire consequences.

title: Sampai Jumpa, Selamat Tinggal
overview: Wyn arrives in Seoul searching for her missing boyfriend, Dani, and meets Rey, an Indonesian worker who helps her. As they grow close, Rey uncovers Dani's secret new identity but keeps it hidden. When Wyn reunites with Dani, she disappears soon after, leaving Rey to embark on a desperate search to find her.

title: Kholik
overview: A young elementary school student saw a strange light at night and believed it was a UFO. However, his family and the neighbors think that what he'd seen was a "Pulung Gantung", a phenomenon believed to bring disaster.

title: Yang Terjadi Di Antara Banyaknya Kejadian Di Malam Jakarta
originalTitle: Yang Terjadi Di Antara Banyaknya Kejadian Di Malam Jakarta
overview: A man meets a woman in the middle of Jakarta.

title: Terjebak Paradox
overview: Sekelompok mafia ambisius mendengar kabar tentang serum misterius yang konon bisa memberikan keabadian. Dipimpin oleh seseorang yang penuh ambisi, mereka merencanakan pencarian serum di tempat terkutuk yang memiliki sejarah kelam. Salah satu dari mereka mulai merasakan firasat buruk, tetapi keserakahan menutupi rasa takut mereka. Ketika akhirnya berhadapan dengan pemilik serum, sebuah keputusan gegabah diambil sebuah tembakan dilepaskan. Namun, yang tertembak tidak mati, justru bangkit sebagai makhluk mengerikan. Perlahan, satu per satu mulai terinfeksi, kehilangan kemanusiaan, dan berubah menjadi sesuatu yang tak bisa mati. Hanya satu yang tersisa. Ia bertahan, melawan, dan berpikir telah menemukan harapan. Namun, saat terbangun, ia menyadari bahwa semuanya telah berubah. Teman-temannya yang gugur kini berdiri kembali bukan sebagai manusia, melainkan pengikut setia kegelapan.

title: Jelmo Sukmo
overview: Raka is faced with the choice of using a magical flute that he is not allowed to use because a village head wants to move his studio.

title: Semoga Agus Bahagia
overview: Agus, who is determined to get back with his ex, finds his pet catfish transforming into an astral figure named Yanti, and Yanti will accompany Agus on his journey until the meeting will change his life forever.

title: PHAM
overview: A man finds an alien friend who gives him a magic stone as a way to communicate. However, his mother exploited the stone as a healing tool for material gain, forcing Panji to work as a shaman in her village.

title: KAUSALITAS
overview: Usal dan Lunar, dua teman lama yang tidak sengaja bertemu kembali setelah dua tahun. Pada pertemuan itu, Usal mengetahui fakta mengejutkan tentang Lunar dan dirinya yang seharusnya tidak ia ketahui.

title: Jangka Kala
overview: A lower-level fisherman is waiting for the birth of his wife's child after both of them have been through prolonged anxiety. They believe the myths about the stolen turtle eggs are able to maintain the wife's pregnancy. But they will be faced with regulation of turtle conservation and climate change in their area.

title: Mantai Gak Nyantai
overview: Bob's beach vacation is hurdled by many unfortunate surprises, many of which are caused by climate change.

title: Life of Time
overview: A grieving father desperately attempts to redeem himself by talking a young woman out of taking her life.

title: Bayang Dalam Wayang
overview: Nara, seorang remaja bisu dan lumpuh, sekaligus kehilangan ayah setelah kecelakaan tragis 2 tahun lalu, hidup dalam kesunyian dan keterasingan. Di tengah ketegangan keluarga, ia menemukan wayang peninggalan leluhurnya dan mulai mendengar suara misterius bernama Arsaka. Lewat bimbingan bayangan itu, Nara belajar bahwa suara hati dan warisan budaya dapat menjadi jembatan untuk menyatukan kembali keluarga yang nyaris terpecah. Sebuah pertunjukan wayang sederhana pun menjadi bahasa baru yang menghubungkan kembali cinta dan pengertian di antara mereka.

title: FETCH!
overview: Kane, a genius inventor who has created S.I.G.M.A, a small device capable of storing massive clean energy. He lives a happy life with his beloved dog, Foster. One day, while playing fetch in the park, tragedy strikes when Foster is hit by a truck and dies. Devastated, Kane refuses to accept the loss. Using S.I.G.M.A, he builds a time-traveling wristwatch called REWINDER to go back and save Foster. But when he arrives in the past, the same tragedy repeats itself.

title: Love Therapy
overview: Seeking to save their failing marriage, a distant couple enters a mysterious sex therapy clinic, only to be framed, secretly recorded, and blackmailed in a sinister trap.

title: Tambang Emas Ra Ritek
overview: The documentary “Tambang Emas Ra Ritek” tells the story of why the people of Trenggalek don’t need a gold mine. The film captures the stories of Trenggalek people at various gold mining concession sites, from the mountains, forests, settlements, and even coastal areas. The Trenggalek people featured in the film include farmers, fishers, women, religious groups, artists, and youth communities. To protect the environment and their future, the people of Trenggalek unite against the largest gold mine on Java Island.

title: Curhatan Revi Siterusah
overview: In a country where job requirements are often unreasonable,  a college student, pressured by the need to make ends meet, accepts a job as a video editor only to face vague requests and absurd demands.

title: Penayangan Konser Selamat Ulang Tahun
overview: Diselenggarakan tepat pada Hari Ibu tahun 2022, "Konser Selamat Ulang Tahun" dipersembahkan sebagai bentuk perayaan lima tahun dirilisnya album debut Nadin Amizah yang berjudul "Selamat Ulang Tahun".

title: {02} PINK LAUNDRY
overview: Indi, a young architect living in Kyoto, Japan, leads an independent life while working at a bakery shop. When an unexpected encounter and childhood memories resurface, Indi must choose to let go or make peace with her past.

title: Dendam Malam Kelam
overview: Jefri and Sarah are an adulterous couple now desperately trying to create an alibi after the corpse of Sofia, the lawful wife they murdered, mysteriously disappears from the morgue. Arya Pradana, a police investigator, uses all his logic to uncover the truth. Has the corpse come back to life to take revenge on her killers?

title: Waktu Maghrib 2
overview: 20 tahun setelah kejadian yang dialami Adi (Omar Daniel) dan kawan-kawannya di Jatijajar, Jin Ummu Sibyan kembali meneror anak-anak di sebuah desa, kali ini di Giritirto. Yogo (Sulthan Hamonangan), Dewo (Ghazi Alhabsy), dan Wulan (Anantya Kirana) beserta 5 anak lainnya terlibat keributan di pertandingan bola antara pemain inti dan cadangan. Kalah dalam keributan, mereka bergegas pulang ke desa di waktu maghrib. Sepanjang perjalanan mereka menyumpahi tim inti sepak bola agar terkena musibah. Tanpa mereka sadari, mereka telah membangkitkan petaka seperti kejadian Jatijajar. Kali ini lebih gila dan mencekam, di tengah hutan dan malam yang dingin, Ummu Sibyan merasuki salah satu dari mereka untuk memburu nyawa anak-anak tanpa ampun.

title: HAKIM DI DAPUR
overview: Nania. A housewife who always wakes up very early every day to prepare breakfast for her family. Unfortunately, her efforts are never appreciated, the dishes she makes are never enjoyed well by her family.

title: Atas Nama Budiman
overview: Karena ayahnya sakit pinggang, Ilham harus jadi kurir dadakan dan ia berjanji mengantarkan ayahnya ke tukang pijat pukul tiga sore. Namun, dalam perjalanan nya ia menghadapi kejadian penuh drama. Mulai dari pelanggan mengamuk, ponsel mati, motor mogok, hingga rumor penerima terakhir adalah seorang mantan napi kanibal! Tinggal satu paket misterius, siapa sebenarnya “Budiman” ini?

title: Sudah Jatuh Tertimpa Mangga
overview: Eko, Dwi, dan Tri adalah tiga sahabat yang ingin pergi bermain bola sebelum UAS. Ketiganya, melalui ide Dwi, memutuskan untuk mencuri mangga milik Pak RT untuk dijual dan dibelikan bola. Namun, tertangkapnya mereka membuat hal-hal menjadi lebih rumit dari sekedar pencurian mangga.

title: The Silenced Soil
overview: Yos Suprapto, an artist who held an art exhibition at the Indonesian National Gallery entitled "The Rise of Mother Earth for Food Sovereignty". Unfortunately, this exhibition was canceled due to disagreements between the artist, curator, and gallery. This documentary will explore more deeply the major themes behind it, starting from criticism, history, Arts, and innovation in Indonesia.

title: Kikuk
overview: Dava, Seorang siswa pendiam yang gemar menulis puisi. Dara, siswi yang berbakat dalam ilmu eksak dan sering menjadi langganan sekolah untuk mengirimnya ikut olimpiade. Mereka jarang berinteraksi walaupun mereka satu kelas. Suatu hari, Dara meminta bantuan Dava untuk mengerjakan tugas Bahasa Indonesia. Disembari mereka mengerjakan tugas, mereka berbincang tentang impian dan keraguan mereka terhadap masa depan.

title: Putih Rambut Panjang
overview: Winner, a boarding school student who is a fan of Stanley Kubrick, trying to prank his parents during a video call. The prank is an appearance of scary kuntilanak behind Winner. Because his parents' reaction is so funny, they make the prank scarier. But they didn't know the consequences of what they did.

title: GAP
overview: Two teenagers estranged from their parents begin meaningful conversations to bridge emotional distances, explore the past, understand the present, and foster hope for the future.

title: Insya Allah Berkah
overview: The story of the friendship between Dudung, an orphan who lives with his grandmother, Romlah, and Kasniza, the little girl who is the daughter of Romlah's employer. Kasniza, who never knew her grandparents, found the grandmother she missed in Romlah. Dudung, who knows that his grandmother has a dream of seeing the Kaaba, is assisted by Kasniza in his efforts to make this dream come true. However, in their efforts, they both experienced many trials, and Kasniza also had to deal with bullies at school. So how will their efforts end, will Romlah's dream of seeing the Kaaba be achieved?

title: Angkara Murka
overview: Ambar is a young mother who is forced to work in a sand mine after her husband mysteriously vanishes. But what she faces is not just the harshness of life, but also the intangible horrors that evoke old wounds and trauma.

title: Gundik
overview: A former soldier gets a job to rob a house, but it turns out that the house is the house of Nyai, a concubine a.k.a Gundik.

title: Beri saya waktu
overview: Dua pemuda dalam sebuah coffeshop

title: Besok Shooting!
overview: Seorang remaja laki-laki berjuang mengatasi kebiasaan menunda-nunda pekerjaan akibat keasyikan menelusuri media sosial. Ia berusaha mengatasi kebiasaan tersebut dengan menerapkan kebiasaan-kebiasaan baik lainnya. Kebiasaan-kebiasaan itu mencakup sejumlah rutinitas dasar dalam kehidupan sehari-hari kita.

title: Broken Hallelujah
overview: As an adult, Ana is haunted by the shadows of her past, bravely sharing one of her most painful memories in a support group. Years earlier, Ana and her mother, Hawa, lived a life of relentless hardship inside a brothel. As a child, Ana loved her mother unconditionally, unaware of the cruel world around them. But as she grew older, the harsh truths of her environment began to surface, leaving her with painful questions and a fractured sense of trust. During a quiet visit to a church, Ana and Hawa met a mysterious figure who offered a glimmer of hope. For Hawa, it was a chance for peace and escape from suffering. For Ana, it stirred a storm of emotions, forcing her to confront her beliefs about faith, forgiveness, and the meaning of salvation. Now, as Ana navigates the delicate balance between past wounds and present struggles, she embarks on a soul-searching journey toward healing, redemption, and the courage to reclaim her life from the darkness that shaped it.

title: Sandekala
overview: Setelah kematian ayahnya, seorang gadis kecil mengalami kejadian aneh di rumahnya, kemunculan sosok misterius yang menguntitnya ternyata membawa pesan terakhir dari ayahnya untuknya.

title: The Number
overview: A teenage girl named Maya is stalked by a mysterious man after she carelessly discards a package box containing her personal data outside her house.

title: Satu Perhentian Sebelum Pulang
overview: One afternoon, Yayan, a transvestite, was about to go to work on public transportation, on his way, he received a lot of criticism from others around him, but he met a kind-hearted girl

title: Serate
overview: a girl who feels less loved by her mother than her older brother.

title: Romantic Cult
overview: Arya  seorang pria Jawa pengusaha biro jodoh yang sedang melakukan sesi perjodohan terganggu oleh komunitas joget lansia yang sedang karaoke dengan musik yang keras. Jojo, rekan kerja Arya, menyarankan untuk membeli pengedap suara, tetapi uang kas mereka belum cukup untuk membeli. Tak lama, seorang laki-laki tua Tionghoa, Yongki mendaftar menjadi klien yang bersedia membayar biaya lebih untuk mencarikan anak perempuannya Leoni pasangan keturunan Tionghoa, yang ternyata merupakan kekasih dari Arya.

title: Mengejar Untuk Mengalah
overview: Vino (18) adalah seorang anak SMA yang ingin sekali berkuliah. Vino hanya tinggal dengan Ibunya (43) karena Ayah Vino sudah meninggal. Vino juga memiliki 2 sahabat, yakni Doni (18) dan Brian (18). Ayah meninggalkan sebuah rumah yang besar. Ketika masih ada Ayah Vino, keadaan ekonominya sangat mapan. Keadaan berbalik ketika kepergian Ayah. Ekonomi keluarga Vino menjadi serba pas-pasan. Ibu memilih untuk berjualan sosis di depan rumah. Keinginan Vino untuk berkuliah sangat memberatkan Ibu dalam hal biaya. Vino memilih untuk daftar beasiswa keluarga kurang mampu. Tapi dari situ, Vino mendapat tawaran dari Doni dan Brian untuk melakukan kecurangan beasiswa.

title: Dasim
overview: Salma, who has just married Arman, begins to feel mystical disturbances. When Salma is pregnant and Arman receives a big project that often makes him work overtime, they move to Arman's mother's house. Salma faces increasingly scary terror, conflict with her in-laws, plus her suspicion that Arman is cheating, until Salma relies on her mysterious neighbor.

title: Cocote Tonggo
overview: To preserve the reputation of their family's traditional fertility herbal shop from neighbors' ridicule, a married couple who have been childless for years pretend to be pregnant so they can claim a found baby as their own.

title: Godaan Setan Yang Terkutuk
overview: An ustad exorcist expert in a remote village attacked by a powerful demon. When the exorcist tries to perform an exorcism to drive out the demon, the demon instead enters the exorcist's family and begins to tempt and threaten the safety of the exorcist's family.

title: Mungkin Kita Perlu Waktu
overview: One year after the accident of his elder sister, Ombak, a suicide survivor gets an anxiety attack because he is tortured by remorse and guilt-tripping from his mother.

title: Rannu (Cinta Bugis Makassar)
overview: Rara, a strong-willed and courageous woman, harbors deep-seated trauma after losing her boyfriend in a tragic accident; her life is defined by strict rules and limitations. However, her world shifts when she meets Andi, a nerdy man with an insatiable curiosity. Andi is determined to help Rara overcome her trauma, even though he often stumbles and causes chaos along the way. Amidst their journey, a major secret from Andi's past comes to light, steering the story in an unexpected direction.

title: Luminara
overview: "Luminara" is about a meeting between a boy who has big sadness from his past, and a girl who has many questions but can't talk well. Their meeting changes their life. Arsa, the boy, gives his light of life to Kaia, the girl, who lives in darkness. Maybe that's why destiny brings them together in this life. But... Arsa forgets something. He also needs light to live. In the end, will Arsa lose all his light?

title: Yang Merdeka Itu Siapa?
overview: Set in a high school navigating Indonesia’s new “Merdeka Curriculum,” this graduation film follows a group of students grappling with the pressures of modern education. As projects pile up and expectations rise, they begin questioning the very system that promised them freedom. Through reflection, resistance, and growth, they discover what it truly means to learn, and to be heard.

title: Sayap Sayap Patah 2: Olivia
overview: A bomb explodes in a cafe, at the same time as Leong is released from prison. Sadikin orders Pandu to investigate Leong's trail. Pandu's time is increasingly taken up with Olivia, his daughter who needs the presence of a father after her mother died of illness. Luckily there is Suri, Olivia's teacher, who tries to fill the void by approaching Olivia. Because of Olivia, Pandu and Suri's relationship becomes closer. But the situation becomes more dangerous for Pandu because his face is seen when the ambush and revenge action are about to be carried out.

title: Tabayyun
overview: Zalina and Arlo, two individuals from different worlds who meet in the midst of a storm of prejudice. The conflict begins to heat up when their love must face challenges from Zalina's mysterious past and pressure from Arlo's family, especially his mother, Samira, who is strongly against the relationship.

title: Pembantaian Dukun Santet
overview: As violence erupts over accusations of black magic, a pesantren becomes the center of terror. As teachers and students are killed one by one, Satrio fights to survive and protect his parents—while uncovering the dark force behind the chaos.

title: Orang Ikan
overview: In the Pacific, 1944, a Japanese soldier and a British prisoner of war are stranded on a deserted island, hunted by a deadly creature. Two mortal enemies must come together to survive the unknown.

title: Unseen Letter
overview: Sejak kecil, saya sering mendengar cerita-cerita dari kakek saya yang sangat membekas di ingatan saya. Saat remaja, kakek saya terkena stroke yang membuatnya terhalang untuk bicara. Karena saya kuliah di luar pulau, saya dan kakek terpisah jarak yang sangat jauh. Cerita-cerita dari kakek saya yang membekas membuat saya selalu mengingatnya. Sebab saya merindukannya dan ingin memenuhi janji saya kepadanya, membuat saya selalu ingin pulang.

title: Parah Bener
overview: A quartet of friends—Marko, Paing, Nacing, and Japri—constantly find themselves in trouble. One day, Marko witnesses his girlfriend, Marni, being abducted. Assisted by Japri, Marko sets off in pursuit of the kidnappers. Unfortunately, along the way, the pair are struck by a car driven by Tania, an up-and-coming celebrity who had reportedly run away from home. Overcome by guilt, Tania joins Japri and Marko in the chase to rescue Marni, with Paing and Nacing also tagging along. They eventually locate Marni in Anyer; however, instead of being pleased, Marni lashes out at Marko in anger.

title: Kde Domov Můj
overview: Unit 2 of the StB receive information from their Polish counterparts on a suspicious Indonesian diplomat. He is to be stationed in the Indonesian Embassy in Warsaw but flew early and is headed towards Prague instead. He was seen to be carrying a nondescript box. Agent Tomáš of the StB is assigned to stalk him and find out why he decided to go to Prague.

title: Work Love Balance
overview: Deden (25), a live TokTok host, started a business selling love potions with a shaman he knew to save his career. His decision bore fruit, but also invited disaster, because his box of love potions was stolen by Adi (25), a live sports equipment host who had just broken up, while he was working. Feeling lost and desperate, Deden again collaborated with the shaman he knew to track down his lost box of potions.

title: Pundi Pun Ndi?
overview: Pak Didi, Indi, Rudi, and Budi are a family who live in the suburbs and always listen to the radio as their trusted source of information. One morning they heard an advertisement about a bottle cap with a prize of hundreds of millions. Finally, they decided to work together to find the bottle cap. However, personal desires and selfishness made their plans go awry. Will they get the prize?

title: One More Cup of Coffee for Ambe'
originalTitle: One More Cup of Coffee for Ambe'
overview: Torajan People of South Sulawesi, Indonesia are deeply rooted in a culture where death is not seen as an end but as extension of life itself. This ethnographic film explores the unique approached to death among adherents of Aluk to Dolo belief system who have recently converted to Christianity. It contrasts the funerary practices of two families - one middle class and one upper class - both deeply devoted to honoring the deceased fathers. While the upper-class family held an elaborate funeral with sacrificing 170 buffaloes, the middle-class family struggles to gather enough buffaloes for their ceremony.

title: I Feel Like an Outsider
overview: Access to all films available at the in-person screening, as well as films that could not be screened in person due to time constraints.

title: It's Okay I'm Here
overview: A young panic attack struggler with a traumatic past experience encounters his trauma while hanging out with his friends near the railroad.

title: Doa Dosa Malam Kelam
overview: The sun mysteriously disappear, the world is plunged into darkness. A group of mysterious light bringer  cult found Hamsa in his house in the depth of the dark. The Cult takes care of him as a family. Tuan,  their leader. Gave them 3 sacred commandments that should never be broken to achieve salvation  and safety from something lurking in the dark.

title: The Fall of Hades
overview: Satan and three demons having a fun time in hell while ignoring the fall of their domain.

title: Masihkah Ada Maaf
overview: When sin and destruction destroy a person's life, must she remain immersed in failure? Bita and her family learn that anyone can fall into sin, but what matters is not the destruction, but how she responds to it.

title: SINS PART ONE
overview: Two detectives pursue a cunning and sadistic serial killer who punishes his victims in gruesome ways each murder inspired by the seven deadly sins

title: Mendadak Dangdut
overview: After a deadly incident involving her producer, rising pop star Naya flees with her sister and ailing father to a remote village. There, she’s forced to hide her identity and perform as a dangdut singer—while struggling to escape her past and the law closing in.

title: Penjagal Iblis: Dosa Turunan
overview: Ningrum, a 19-year-old girl, was accused of being the perpetrator of the murder of a family while performing ruqiah. But she swore that she was not a murderer - but a devil's slaughterer. When a reporter tried to dig up the truth, he was caught in a battle between Ningrum the devil's slaughterer and the devil worshiper.

title: The Violence Is Always Happening Somewhere Else
originalTitle: The Violence Is Always Happening Somewhere Else
overview: Clarissa lives in Paris. Cooking Indonesian dishes helps her to maintain her connection to her mother country. But then a question crosses her mind: Where does European garbage actually disappear to?

title: A Closure
overview: In a long-awaited moment, Dimas teamed up with his dad, to pull off a surprise for his mom. But what they didn’t expect was just how truly shocked she’d be.

title: Mercy Me
overview: Kefas, a Catholic school student, struggles with his faith while living in a Muslim-majority neighborhood. His inner conflict leads him on a journey toward true forgiveness.

title: Nawasena
overview: Hana ingin masuk SMA, tapi ibunya, Dahlia, ingin dia masuk SMK. Hana mengikuti keinginan ibunya dan akhirnya terlibat dalam lomba desain di sekolahnya. Namun, dia melakukan plagiarisme yang menimbulkan konflik dengan temannya, Alina. Azriel, teman lainnya, membantu Hana dan mereka semakin dekat. Perdebatan antara Hana dan ibunya memuncak, tapi akhirnya Hana menemukan mimpinya yang baru dan berhasil membanggakan ibunya dengan memenangkan lomba fotografi.

title: Di Balik Matamu
overview: Silvi (17), a popular vlogger at her school, suddenly changes. Her friends begin to worry, sensing that something is wrong with Silvi. Unbeknownst to them, Silvi is continuously haunted by the apparition of Diana (17), her late best friend. Amid the lingering grief and an increasingly blurred reality, Silvi must confront something from her past that continues to haunt her.

title: Mangku Pocong
overview: Hendri and Nurul are siblings who reluctantly return to their hometown after years of avoiding it due to painful childhood memories. Their father, Mardi, is in critical condition and soon passes away. Struggling with financial difficulties, they work hard to revive their late father's legendary restaurant business, despite opposition from their extended family. However, as they push forward, a series of terrifying pocong hauntings threaten their lives, leading them to uncover dark secrets about their family's past.

title: Sah! Katanya...
overview: The youngest child, torn between family expectations and her existing relationship, faces an unexpected arranged marriage on the day of her father's death.

title: Anak Medan: Cocok Ko Rasa!?
overview: The story of the friendship of four young men namely Ucok, Rafly, Joko and Chisa. Due to an incident, those who originally wanted to achieve their dreams together are far from each other.

title: Sepiring Berdua
overview: When traces of memories haunt a young scavenger who works hard just to enjoy a plate of food with his mother again

title: Brainstorming
overview: Dua mahasiswa, Shafwan dan Mirza tengah mencari ide film untuk ujian tengah semester mereka yang deadlinenya minggu depan. di tengah buntunya ide, Mirza mendapatkan cara untuk menemukan ide secara instan.

title: Voice Of Time
overview: Tells the story of two teenagers Candice and Liam who have complicated personal problems in their lives, which are connected by Voices that are accidentally brought together by Time. They try to solve their problems together.

title: Hutan, Mantan, Jalan Pulang
overview: A poignant, intimate portrait of indigenous youth wrestling with identity, reconciling old wounds, and finding their way back to a place they can truly call home.

title: Laut Bercerita
overview: In the turbulent shadow of the 1998 regime collapse, a young activist's defiance against state tyranny leads to his brutal abduction, triggering a painful struggle for survival in captivity and a desperate search for answers by his family.

title: Kado Hari Jadi
overview: Surga, seorang anak yang tumbuh dalam sebuah keluarga, mengetahui dari pengakuan ibunya bahwa dirinya adalah anak pungut. Tanpa disadari, adiknya, Firdaus, turut mendengar pengakuan tersebut, memicu konflik yang mengubah dinamika hubungan dan keharmonisan keluarga mereka.

title: Trinity of Tales
overview: From drama, comedy, to horror, every genre has become a space for expressions of love for film, fashion and photography artists. Three short films in three different genres that show the character and characteristics of their respective aesthetic views, are a form of respect for various styles of storytelling from different perspectives.

title: Rumah Untuk Alie
overview: Alie, the youngest and only daughter among five siblings, suffers relentless abuse from her father and siblings—blamed for their mother's death—when all she longs for is a bit of compassion and acceptance from her family.

title: Muslihat
overview: An orphanage moved to a new and more suitable place for the children to live. However, unexpectedly, a number of mystical disturbances occur.

title: Pengepungan di Bukit Duri
overview: Edwin berjanji pada kakaknya sebelum meninggal untuk menemukan anak kakaknya yang hilang. Pencarian Edwin membawanya menjadi guru di SMA Duri, sekolah untuk anak-anak bermasalah. Di sana, Edwin menghadapi murid-murid paling beringas sambil mencari keponakannya. Ketika akhirnya ia menemukan sang keponakan, kerusuhan pecah di seluruh kota dan mereka terjebak di sekolah, melawan anak-anak brutal yang kini mengincar nyawa mereka.

title: Perang Kota
overview: In war-torn Jakarta 1946, a haunted violinist ordered to bomb a colonial theatre sees his plan unravel when a charismatic rebel falls for his wife—jeopardising Indonesia’s freedom and their lives.

title: Astranova - Beyond The Stars
overview: Astranova: Beyond The Stars is a docu-fiction short film that explores memory, friendship, and the emotional transition of leaving school life. The story follows a recent graduate who reunites with his friends and reminisces about the moments they once shared. In a nostalgic atmosphere, he drifts into a dream-like journey that brings him back to those memories, making him feel as if he is still living in them.  By blending documentary-style realism with narrative storytelling, the film creates a reflective and intimate experience, highlighting how memories shape identity while emphasizing the importance of creating one last meaningful moment before moving forward.

title: Fondness
overview: A polptych following a group of people trying to understand the act of fondness.

title: Keajaiban Dalam Pelukan Iman
overview: Dihari pengumuman hasil ujian test perguruan tinggi, seorang siswi madrasah aliyah mensiasati diri untuk berkunjung ke makam sunan kalijaga.

title: Sinyal Jaringan
overview: A pair of roommates experienced a network failure around their apartment, when they needed the internet they found a network from the next room. Unfortunately they did not know the password, so they did various unethical ways to access the network.

title: Soffie: Dendam Dalam Dosa
overview: In a village full of intrigue, the loveless marriage between Sofie, an Indo-Dutch woman, and Raden Sasmita, a rich, much older man, triggers a series of tragedies. Sofie loves Awang, but he is caught in a power play centered on a pendant inherited from his ancestors, which is believed to have supernatural powers. When his plan to poison Sasmita failed, he died mysteriously. Sofie's spirit returns through jelangkung, uncovers dark secrets and seeks revenge. In a supernatural battle, Ki Barlan faces Sasmita, Subrata, Nyi Gandasari, and Nyai Ratu Kerincing Wesi, ending the curse that haunts the village.

title: Pinjam 100: The Movie
overview: Economic pressures make two friends Paris and Jerstang decide to migrate to Jakarta from Binjai to try their luck. The hustle and bustle of the capital makes them think that they will find work more easily than in their village, Binjai. But unfortunately, unbeknownst to them, the harshness of Jakarta is a tough challenge for both of them. Can they survive in the capital?

title: Dewasa
overview: A guy has grown up now. Everything around him has changed and so has he. The world feels heavier, and he can no longer feel the simple joys he once did as a child.

title: Kotak Amal
overview: About a boy and his father that stole donation box from a mosque.

title: Among
overview: Tiur (25), an only daughter from a Batak family, wants to talk for the last time with her father's body. In the midst of deep grief, he had to follow various customary demands to meet the expectations of his family and the surrounding community.

title: Rokok? Iya Rokok.
overview: A dude is way too hooked on cigarettes, like, seriously addicted. When he runs out of smokes, he freaks out. He needs a cig. Instead of trying to cut down, he's straight-up thinking about ending it all, but...

title: Rhythmic Exercise with Priadi
overview: We invite you to the world of early 2000s satellite television in Indonesia, with all its nostalgia, charm, along with its hidden flaws.

title: Melbourne Ska Orchestra Live at Bali Spirit Festival
originalTitle: Melbourne Ska Orchestra Live at Bali Spirit Festival
overview: Melbourne Ska Orchestra is an orchestra with a difference. Helmed by the energetic Nicky Bomba and comprising up to 26 members, this juggernaut contains some of Australia’s finest musicians and performers. Their unique take on the genre of Ska has wowed audiences all over the world since their 2003 formation, and May 2024 saw their first time headlining The BaliSpirit Festival, a concert captured for posterity in this magnificent recording.

title: Cerita Pulang
overview: Seorang remaja yang telah lama tidak pulang ingin membangun kembali hubungan dengan ayahnya namun sama seperti daerahnya semua terasa asing, melalui perjalanan pulang mereka kembali mencari cara untuk terhubung kembali.

title: Uduk
overview: An ojek driver who helps his mom sell nasi uduk until his life takes a turn after he gets into an accident.

title: Reprep
overview: Akan segera ditambahkan - segera

title: Komang
overview: Separated by distance and the arrival of a faith-aligned rival, a young dreamer from Buton and a Balinese wanderer must test whether fate is strong enough to reunite them after he leaves for Jakarta.

title: Pabrik Gula
overview: Sekelompok buruh musiman yang datang ke sebuah pabrik gula tua di pedesaan untuk bekerja selama musim panen. Namun, mereka tidak mengetahui apa rahasia di balik pabrik gula tersebut.

title: Norma: Antara Mertua dan Menantu
overview: Norma yang baru menikah berharap pernikahannya bahagia, tanpa mengetahui bahwa suaminya diam-diam berselingkuh dengan ibunya.

title: Qodrat 2
overview: Ustadz Qodrat now embarks on the next journey to find his wife, Azizah and once again strike the revenge of evil powers.

title: Jumbo
overview: Desperate to prove to his peers that he’s more than a chubby kid that never wins at anything, little Don wishes to win his local talent show by performing a stageplay inspired from a storybook written by his late parents. When unfortunately a bully stole that book, at the same time a little ghost appeared from the spirit world asking for Don’s help to reunite her with her parents’ spirits. The two new friends then embark on an exciting adventure to help each other and learn the true meaning of friendship.

title: Setetes Embun Cinta Niyala
overview: Niyala adalah seorang wanita muda yang berhasil mewujudkan mimpinya menjadi seorang dokter.  Namun, ayahnya mengatur pernikahannya dengan Roger, putra orang terkaya di desa, untuk melunasi hutang keluarga dan ini membuat kehidupan Niyala menjadi kacau. Namun, pernikahan ini mungkin satu-satunya cara untuk menyelamatkan keluarga Anda.

title: Ibu Sudah Pulang!
overview: Maya, a secondary school pupil who is sceptical about taboos, regards them as nothing more than mere myths. One afternoon just before sunset, without a hint of fear, she inadvertently broke the taboos by sweeping the courtyard, leaving the door open, combing her hair and cutting her nails as the sun set. However, since then, strange things have begun to happen. Dark shadows seemed to lurk in the corners of her room, and disturbing whispers could be heard

title: Keluarga Besar
overview: Pak Wahyu, who only worked as an electronic equipment repairman in a rented shop, was made dizzy by his wife and two children who are only busy with their own lives. There are rumors that Mrs. Wiwik is a fraud, Agung is a believer in black magic, and Ati is pregnant out of wedlock increasingly widespread in their flats. Pak Wahyu also tried to create a large family they were whole again and loved each other.

title: Doa Doa Di Atas Kepala
overview: As a result of criticizing the village head on social media, Markum was fired from his job and forced to do so become an online taxi driver. Disappointed with the injustice in his life, Markum complain about it to God. But instead of receiving justice, he got the ability to hear and clearly see various kinds of prayers being said by the people around him. He came to know the prayers his mother prayed every day, even the prayer of a woman he likes. Over time, Markum felt disturbed,  because he was busy hearing other people's prayers, he couldn't concentrate on praying for himself.

title: Surga Di Telapak Kaki Bapak
overview: After Imah died suddenly, Nawawi became head of the household  trying to fill the void left by Imah in taking care of her two children, Dinar  and Adi. However, Nawawi's efforts were not easy because those who felt the shock of loss Imah is not only her two children, but also herself, so all three are already there getting used to depending on Imah's figure becomes difficult in living his daily life.

title: Bunga Semerah Darah
overview: Sumirah, the wife of a pedicab driver, is pressured by the local landlord Den Bei Hardjo to marry him with the promise of wealth. She rejects the offer. Den Bei Hardjo threatens to evict her family for failing to pay their rent. Sumirah’s beauty becomes a curse; in addition to suffering from poverty and tuberculosis, her husband, Amat, leaves her out of jealousy. Only her son, Ali, remains by her side.

title: Delirium
overview: Neil is a nerdy student who is often bullied by his classmates. One day, his classmates end up in the same group as him, and they all decide to do their group project at Neil's house. However, upon arriving there, many unexpected things happen to them.

title: Mencari Kakek-Nenek
overview: A grandson tries to revisit his grandparents' graves for the second time after a year.

title: Siklus
overview: As riots erupt across the nation, a man isolates himself in front of the TV, obsessively watching the live news to understand what sparked the chaos—until the boundary between screen and reality begins to dissolve.

title: Mimpi Matahari
overview: Matahari grew up in a modest family. She has a younger sister named Bulan. Matahari accidentally lost Bulan's only pair of shoes. Feeling responsible, she sets out to find the shoes for the sake of her sister's happiness. Faced with limited financial means, she must struggle and find a way to earn the money needed to buy a new pair.

title: HOPE (希望)
overview: Deciding to follow her vocation as a nun and leave her responsibilities at home, made Airen (27) feel guilty, especially to her father, Pak Ahong (60). The regret increased when Mr. Ahong passed away and could not see for the last time. Funeral events and Sa Cap Meh prayers spark arguments between her and her sister Mayleen (25). Blaming each other, until a fact about Mr. Ahong was revealed that Airen had just found out. An apology was delivered in the Chinese tradition of burning Sa Cap Meh.

title: Cosmic Balance
overview: Hour-long musical trance sessions lead a young man from a small Indonesian village to his first concert outside the city limits at a music festival in Denmark. A cosmic film about music, spirituality and heritage.

title: Fajar dan Penjelajah Samudera
overview: Fajar's mother has gone to Malaysia to work. He is left with his grandfather and his turtle. One day Fajar hears that if you release a turtle into the sea, you can get your beloved ones back.

title: Jam 1 Malam
overview: Nayaka and Arby return to campus in the middle of the night to look for Nayaka's lost motorbike key. Unbeknownst to them, a stranger is stalking them.

title: The Assignment
overview: What happens when the roles of teacher and student reverse? In a single moment, a second-grader’s innocent question exposes the fragile foundation of a rigid educator’s beliefs, forcing her to reconcile the difference between what’s taught and what’s lived. 'The Assignment' is a sharp satire that challenges the boundaries of authority, tradition, and the truths we cling to.

title: Bukan Film Superhero
overview: Seorang anak kecil yang terobsesi dengan sosok superhero dan ingin mencari superhero-nya di dunia nyata.

title: Obrolan Ruang Makan
overview: Two brothers, bound by loss, learn to find warmth in routine and strength in each other as they navigate life without their parents.

title: Still Here
overview: Faris is forced to confront the emotional distance he’s created between himself and his daughter, Trisha, when she suddenly falls seriously ill. As he reflects on the time he missed, Faris must navigate the tension between regret and redemption, grappling with the realization that the moments he neglected can never be reclaimed.

title: Neverwhen
overview: As a young lady prepares to leave behind her childhood home, a playful and enigmatic elf from her past invites her into a nostalgic game of hide and seek.

title: Jenuh Eksistensialisme
overview: Three female students discusses existentialism while trapped in their classroom.

title: Lewat Senyum Kecilnya
overview: Alya, a sixth-grade student, feels insecure because she has never fasted and is often teased by her classmates. When she receives an assignment from her teacher to write a story about activities during Ramadan, she becomes determined to try fasting to complete the task and avoid further teasing from her classmates.

title: Benang Dalam Awan
overview: Ezra (M19) and Awan (F19) are two melancholic teenagers who one day meet by chance in the Library. In their meeting, they both feel they have the same memories and speculations. In the memories and speculations created between the two of them, they are lost in feelings of love in their minds. Those thoughts make them feel the complexity of love that they have never felt before.

title: Internet Sarang Iblis
overview: After losing her sister, Ghea is drawn into a mysterious online game spreading through an underground internet forum. Guided by a faceless curator, she and her friends must complete increasingly disturbing challenges that seem to make their wishes come true. As the game grows more violent and players begin disappearing, Ghea becomes obsessed with the belief that finishing the game could bring her brother back — even if it means sacrificing everyone around her.

title: Bukan Jodoh Biasa Nih!!!
overview: Tells the story of Richard, Jonggi and Lingga, three miskom students who are trying to overcome routine financial problems. Of the many solution options that they often debated, they finally came up with one method that made Richard and his friends take a desperate path. Serve Mr. Brandon's challenge to get a hidden secret box in exchange for money and the heart of his daughter, Marsya.

title: Uwentira: Kota Jin
overview: A woman named Dewi visited the city of Palu to look for Salena, her acquaintance. When she arrived at the village, Tiara, her friend, welcomed Dewi warmly. However, Tiara's expression turned cold for a split second when Dewi said the word "Uwentira". Tiara's panic increased when she slowly realized the strange behavior of her old friend. A few seconds later, Tiara was sure that the Goddess in front of her now was not the Goddess she knew.

title: Samar
overview: After moving into her family's abandoned house, horror comic artist Ilmira struggles to complete her latest work while battling financial hardship. But when eerie figures from her past stories come to life—especially the haunting Hooded Woman—her reality spirals into a nightmare, forcing her to confront a buried childhood trauma.

title: Singsot: Siulan Kematian
overview: A kid defies the ancient taboo of whistling at dusk, unleashing a sinister terror tied to a cursed figure who made the same mistake. Bound by an inescapable curse, he’s thrust into a deadly race against time—because if he fails, the nightmare will become his new reality.

title: Samar: Diam Atau Mati
overview: Horror film about the negative impact of bullying in public schools

title: Limbo
overview: On the edge of self-destruction, a young artist meets a boy who has everything—sparking an unspoken bond that could either save him or slip away forever.

title: Kalau Gw Takut Film Ini Kelar
originalTitle: Kalau Gw Takut Film Ini Kelar
overview: Ardi, a 21-year-old cinephile who prides himself on being immune to Indonesian horror films. Introduced by Kitti, an ambitious film producer, and Rossi, a creative director working on a new project, Ardi expresses his disdain for local horror films, which he believes are of poor quality and rely too much on cheap jump scares.  Through interviews and interactions with his friends, including humorous moments shared while watching horror films together, Ardi's arrogance and skepticism toward the genre are evident. His friends challenge him to watch clips from some of the most terrifying horror films, hoping to make him experience fear. However, Ardi remains unimpressed by each clip shown, continuing to mock the genre's ability to frighten him.  As the film progresses, Ardi's journey becomes not just a challenge of fear but a humorous exploration of his own biases and the nature of horror in contemporary Indonesian cinema.

title: Transient Harmonies
overview: A parable following an ongoing departure to an unknown destination, while we are to take a look at the daily life of the miserable world.

title: The Choice
overview: A hitman is assigned to kill a male office worker, but he thinks he has seen the man before.

title: Arwah Sinden
overview: Four teenagers who renovate the house of Mba Darti, the daughter of Nyai Melati, a famous traditional singer (sinden). They experience strange events related to the death of Nyai Melati, who was murdered due to rivalry with another sinden, Fahma. The cremated ashes of Fahma are used by Kliman, a former foreman, to drive the teenagers away with the help of Ki Renggo, a paranormal expert. The spirit of Fahma possesses Darti and attacks them, but the terror is eventually stopped when Ki Renggo burns Fahma’s ashes, ending the haunting.

title: Misteri Rumah Darah
overview: Shafeera, a rising host, is given the chance to host the remake of Percaya Ngga Percaya. While studying old footage, she discovers an unaired tape labeled "Rumah Darah," leading to disturbing paranormal events that threaten her life. As she investigates the mystery behind Rumah Darah, she uncovers dark secrets from the past that put her soul at risk.

title: Setan Botak di Jembatan Ancol
overview: The presence of Si Manis (Maryam) at Ancol bridge has made the villagers uneasy. The village has become deserted, and not a single person dares to go outside at night. The villagers' belief in Si Manis' terror is exploited by Setan Botak (the Bald Devil) to create even more chaos. What is really happening in Ancol Village?

title: Desa Mati The Movie
overview: Five students went on vacation to a waterfall, but they didn't expect disaster to come because the waterfall they entered was in a dead village.

title: Jabang Mayit
overview: Hujan mysteriously loses her baby. In desperation, she meets Bayu, who offers help. Bayu took her to a shaman. The shaman reveals that Hujan's baby has been taken by a creature from another world, "Hantu Jabang Mayit", a ghost summoned through dark rituals to target babies of mothers who are not ready to give birth.

title: Mengusahakan Pertolongan Ilahi
overview: The inspiring journey of Nurhayati Subakat, founder of Wardah—Indonesia’s leading beauty brand—told across three pivotal eras: 2023, 1990, and 1966.

title: Samawa
overview: Yura grew up in a strong Javanese family and sought spiritual growth as she matured. After marrying Andy, darkness emerged in their home due to his sins, turning her life into a small hell. Holding onto the belief that a wife must always obey her husband, can Yura still achieve Samawa while his sins remain unforgiven?

title: Pernikahan Arwah
overview: An engaged couple returns to the groom's ancestral home after his aunt's death. But a ghostly bride who hides a dark family secret threatens their peace.

title: Jagal Teluh
overview: An ugly woman who was ostracized from her environment, in order to become beautiful, she finally carried out a ritual that required her to look for the corpse of a woman with long hair. After success, revenge was carried out.

title: Iblis Dalam Kandungan 2: Deception
overview: Amelia returns to her old home with her adopted children, Alani and Vito, as she prepares for childbirth. Advised by Dr. Imam to transfer hospitals for safety, she agrees, but soon discovers a conspiracy between the doctor and the hospital. Alani, Vito, and Bara must fight to save Amelia and her baby from growing danger.

title: Jejak Dara
overview: A healer woman works as a narrator in the theater, telling a story of other women who have the same ability as her. In the story, powerful women always end up in exile. Turns out, history never changes. When her work friends find out about her power, she also ends up the same way.

title: The Congress
overview: Indonesian activist, Rukka Sombolinggi believes the key to confronting the climate crisis is to unite and mobilize the Indigenous communities who are often impacted the most. Now, as the first female general secretary of the world’s largest Indigenous Peoples organization, she has the power to do just that. But the challenge is monumental. One October thousands traveled from across the island nation of Indonesia to attend one of the largest gatherings of Indigenous Peoples in the world. Whether arriving by open-air trucks, boat or even by foot the AMAN congress, led by Rukka, drew thousands of people across the Indonesian archipelago and its 17,000 islands.

title: TETHER
overview: A young man with mysterious healing powers faces the moral complexities of curing patients whose suffering extends beyond the physical.

title: Kandi
overview: Suryo dan Kandi baru menjalani hubungan asmara. Suatu hari Suryo merasakan kenikmatan masakan Kandi yang luar biasa. Suryo penasaran dengan rahasia masakan Kandi.  Suryo diundang Kandi untuk datang ke rumah Kandi. Namun, otak mesum Suryo mengubah segalanya.

title: Jejak-ke-Jejak
overview: Armand becomes trapped in a repeating day after a small decision during an exam leads to unexpected consequences. As he repeatedly tries to change his fate, he eventually realizes that life is not about avoiding mistakes, but about making choices that create a meaningful impact on others.

title: Anak Kunti
overview: Menceritakan Sarah, seorang santriwati, diusik oleh serangkaian mimpi buruk tentang Kuntilanak yang mengancamnya. Sesuai petunjuk sang pengasuh pesantren, Nyai Fatima, Sara pergi ke sebuah kampung yang angker, Wonoenggal, untuk mengungkap rahasia gelap masa lalunya.

title: Rahasia Rasa
overview: When a gifted chef loses his sharp sense of taste, he turns to an old friend who helps him rediscover traditional flavors through an old recipe book.

title: Made in Bali
overview: A young man from a family of Balinese puppeteers must choose between a sensible arranged marriage or take a chance with his childhood best friend.

title: Bilur
overview: Asih, a woman who lives in the colonial era must undergo 'pingitan' to marry a man she does not love.

title: Queer as Punk
overview: Being LGBT is criminalised in Muslim-majority Malaysia. Trans man Faris and his punk band still travel the country playing gigs and protesting on the streets. A documentary portrait of courageous people, humorous friendship and the spirit of punk.

title: Frost
overview: In their final night together, a boy and a girl create a tender universe under their blanket fort, blissfully indifferent to the world outside that is slowly coming to an end.

title: Sammi, Who Can Detach His Body Parts
originalTitle: Sammi, Who Can Detach His Body Parts
overview: Sammi has the ability to remove parts of his body and give them to those he loves and wants to help. After his death, Sammi’s mother goes in search of the pieces of her son.

title: Pejuang
overview: Perjuangan seseorang yang merasa tersesat di tengah pilihan-pilihan berat yang mengimat. ia mencari jawaban dalam segala hal yang  dilihat, namun terus-menerus ditarik maju mundur oleh tali-tali putih. Kebingungan, ketakutan, dan tekanan bercampur menjadi badai emosi yang kacau, mendorongnya ke ambang kepasrahan.

title: Telepon Yang Tak Pernah Berdering
overview: Tini entrusted by Surti, her mother who is working as a migrant worker in Saudi Arabia. One day, through a letter Surti asked Tini to pick up the phone at five o'clock in the afternoon because Surti was in the custody of Saudi Arabia. However the call turned out to be a far greater tragedy about his mother.

title: Berebut Jenazah
overview: When Naomi died, her Muslim father and Buddhist mother fought over her body, which made the burial process complicated.

title: Cinta Tak Pernah Tepat Waktu
overview: Daku, a writer, feels pressed for time to find true love. In the midst of a complicated journey, he searches for the meaning of comfort in love.

title: Kampung Keramat
overview: Erlan Mario and Widi Kania decided to return to their grandfather's village after Maya suffered a fatal accident that left her paralyzed and frequently experiencing magical occurrences. Jabo came to pick up his three grandchildren along with Ruth to take them back to the village for Maya's healing. Jabo believed that Maya's illness was not an ordinary one, but a mystical disease that could only be cured by a shaman in a deserted village called Kampung Bekandang. Maya's healing by the shaman, however, brought about disaster and terror, threatening the lives of their family.

title: Pintu Pintu Surga
overview: Latifah's happy family life is tested when her husband passes away, leaving her to care for their child with ADHD and manage his educational foundation. Her former lover, Arman, helps with the foundation, bringing them closer until he proposes. Now, Latifah must decide whether she can accept becoming a second wife.

title: Rumah Teteh: Story of Helena
overview: Unsettling experiences and a terrifying ghostly presence plague Brii and his friends after a mysterious woman with a dark past enters their lives.

title: The Most Beautiful Girl in the World
originalTitle: The Most Beautiful Girl in the World
overview: Demi warisan, seorang pria mata keranjang membuat acara perjodohan untuk memenuhi permintaan terakhir ayahnya yang ingin putranya itu menikahi gadis tercantik di dunia.

title: GAMANG
overview: Kisah Surealis mengikuti Davies yang mencoba menghadapi masa depannya yang berupa lautan, namun rasa takut menguasainya.

title: SAMA 2
overview: sequel to the short film “SAMA” in 2019

title: Tarian Jiwa
overview: Tanti, seorang penari tradisional berusia 18 tahun yang sensitif dan kerap merasa kesepian, menemukan makna sejati tarian di bawah bimbingan gurunya yang bijaksana, Candramaya. Ia menyadari bahwa tarian bukan sekadar rangkaian gerak, melainkan bahasa jiwa, tempat kisah hidup, cinta, perjuangan, dan harapan mengalir melalui setiap langkah anggunnya.

title: Misteri Cek Khodam
overview: Seorang pemuda tanpa sadar mewarisi khodam dari sang ayah. Keberadaan khodam (makhluk gaib) tersebut membawa berbagai kejadian di luar nalar dan mengungkap rahasia kelam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

title: Coto vs Konro
overview: In Makassar, “Coto Haji Matto” is very famous and crowded with visitors. One day, Daeng Sangkala intends to buy the “Coto Haji Matto” stall, renovate it, and develop it into a franchise business. Haji Matto rejects it and kicks Daeng Sangkala out of his stall. A few weeks later, Daeng Sangkala returns with his wife Lina and their children to open a konro restaurant "Konro Daeng Sangkala". It is located right in a former empty shophouse directly opposite Haji Matto's stall. The maneuver of “Konro Daeng Sangkala” succeeded in making Haji Matto's loyal customers move to Daeng Sangkala. The feud heats up as their children Rizal and Sara start to get closer to each other even though Rizal actually has a special mission from Daeng Sangkala.

title: A Business Proposal
overview: Short on cash, food analyst Sari makes a deal to go on a blind date, only to realize she's been set up with Utama, her hateable but handsome boss.

title: Pulung Gantung: Pati Ngendat
overview: A teenager returns to his hometown with his friends when he learns his father has died — and discovers a curse consuming the isolated community.

title: Petaka Gunung Gede
overview: A hike on Mount Gede during school break turns terrifying for two friends when one defies a local superstition — and a vengeful spirit takes hold of her.

title: Psykopat
overview: A famous illusionist challenges four participants to stay in a mysterious house for five days to win a grand prize. Though the house seems luxurious, it hides a dark past of murder. Strange events and terrifying apparitions soon reveal the true challenge. Who will make it out alive?

title: Bachtiar
overview: After over a decade in prison, little trace of filmmaker and member of the leading Communist cultural movement Bachtiar Siagian’s life and work could be found, but Hafiz Rancajale still searched. Alongside his colleagues, they revise his mis-slandered history.

title: Pia & Mei
overview: 19-year-old Pia is an aspiring writer who is struggling to find materials for her book after being rejected by a literary agent. Desperate for fame and success, Pia starts secretly writing about Mei, her best friend and a rising actress with an authoritarian mother who confides in her about her personal struggles.

title: Menunggu Kamu Pulang
overview: A teenage boy, El, sees the girl he has a crush on, Cia, sitting alone waiting for her to be picked up to go home. El takes the initiative to accompany her home and at the same time tries to get closer to Cia.

title: Menata Masa Depan
overview: Weaving together interviews with political prisoners detained after the 1965 anti-communist purge in Indonesia with footage from an unmade film about romance between communist cadres, this multifaceted docufiction assemblage interrogates the historical limits of an eternal sentiment.

title: WRAPPED
overview: A man's past trauma resurfaces due to the disturbance caused by a young child.

title: MAAGHLUG
overview: Bisma and his colleague got caught in a last minute overtime. In a dark office late at night, work stress, caffeine, and unfilled stomach slowly turns them into a monstrous creature

title: Aku Bukan Boneka! Aku? Bukan Boneka?
originalTitle: Aku Bukan Boneka! Aku? Bukan Boneka?
overview: Rini menjalani hari-hari yang penuh keanehan. Profesi yang ia jalani terus berubah-ubah secara misterius, dari seorang penyiar radio yang ceria, koki yang terampil, polisi yang tegas, hingga penari balet yang anggun. Semua itu terjadi dalam rumahnya, di antara rutinitasnya aneh dan penuh imajinasi. Namun, semakin banyak peran yang ia mainkan, semakin muncul pertanyaan besar: apa yang sebenarnya terjadi pada Rini? Apakah ini hanya permainan khayalan, atau ada sesuatu yang lebih dalam sedang berlangsung?

title: Therefore I Am
overview: A seasoned theater actor, caught in the endless cycle of performances and fleeting applause, drifts through the absurdity of life, unsure whether to search for meaning or simply surrender to the stage.

title: Lumina Qibla
overview: Mariam Al-'Ijliya, a Muslim woman who wants to be an astronomer and research the direction of the qibla. However, her dream must be barren because of the stigma of society including her family about women who according to them are not worthy of being science researchers, they think women should just stay at home and do not deserve higher education. Mariam tries to realize her dream while fighting against the patriarchal principles that are still rampant.

title: Nyanyi Sunyi Dalam Rantang
overview: Puspa, a novice lawyer handling trivial cases, fights for the cause of poor people accused of petty crimes and threatened with disproportionate punishment. As she takes on a rigged legal establishment, she must grapple with her crippling senses of powerlessness, and empathy.

title: Midnight in Bali
overview: Other than her hugely popular shows at one of Bali’s favourite gay bars, life isn’t exactly going to plan for trans performer Bulan. After meeting aspiring filmmaker Lily, however, Bulan starts to address her pain and anger. The result is both shocking and cathartic.

title: Steps of Sorrow
overview: Starla, a student struggling with family pressure and bullying at school, gradually loses her confidence and courage. One day, she begins experiencing mysterious and terrifying encounters that force her to confront the fears, wounds, and painful memories she has long suppressed.  As she journeys through these haunting experiences, Starla eventually comes face to face with her younger self and realizes that she cannot simply run away from her pain. By accepting and making peace with herself, Starla rediscovers her courage to move forward and face life without fear of her past.

title: CALLSH#T
overview: An assistant director trying to finish the final shot of a chaotic film shoot that has already gone into overtime.

title: Truth or Dare: 2036
overview: "The watcher is in contol. Play or pay the price."  I was really lucky to work with all these talanted people, I had such an amazing time making it and I hope you have an amazing time watching it as well!  In a world where lockdowns are just a routine due to radiation in the air, a group of teenagers get on a zoom call to have fun while  they're at home. But having fun can quickly turn dar when an unknown user named "The watcher" joins.  A deadly game of Truth or Dare starts and everything goes downhill when everybody's secrets are revealed. Who will survive, who will die and will go missing is the right question...and who the hell is "The watcher" who hunts them and becomes their worst nightmare...

title: Lagu Cinta Untuk Mama
overview: A wealthy young man falls in love with a café singer, but his disapproving mother schemes to separate them and forces the pregnant woman to terminate her pregnancy to protect the family's reputation.

title: Perayaan Mati Rasa
overview: When they suddenly lose their parents, rival siblings lan and Uta must set aside their dreams to help each other navigate their grief.

title: Pengantin Iblis
overview: Ranti adalah seorang ibu dan istri yang amat berbakti. Ranti memiliki putri yang amat ia sayangi, tapi cacat kondisinya sejak lahir, Nina. Suatu hari Nina mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang membutuhkan penanganan segera. Namun suami Ranti yang bekerja sebagai pelaut sedang tidak berada di rumah, dan keluarga besarnya juga tidak bisa membantu Ranti. Ranti akhirnya harus mencari jalan apapun demi keselamatan Nina. Ranti terpaksa menerima tawaran untuk menjadi pengantin iblis. Akhirnya Nina dapat disembuhkan, namun ada harga lain yang harus Ranti bayar, yang menyangkut nyawa seluruh anggota keluarganya.

title: Duped
overview: Celine terjebak pada sebuah hubungan yang abusif dengan seorang lelaki yang manipulatif, ia dibohongi, dimanipulasi, dan diancam. Namun, ia akhirnya sadar bahwa sebenarnya, Andhika lah yang bermasalah. Maka dari itu, ia pun menemukan sebuah justifikasi yang kuat untuk mengajak putus.

title: Gara-Gara Pisang Om Bram!
overview: Two high school student tries to fix a laptop infected with virus. One of them obstruct the other to hide the reason why the laptop got infected in the first place

title: Tujuh Hari Untuk Keshia
overview: Sadewa was shocked by his ex-girlfriend who suddenly returned and brought a child named Keshia. Keshia's arrival made Sadewa realize that his life would be destroyed and in disarray, until an accident changed everything.

title: Semusim Setelah Kemarau
overview: A young woman with a strained relationship with her biological father is forced to travel with him before her wedding, giving her a chance to confront past disappointments and uncover the truth about his long absence.

title: Mengintai
overview: Seorang wanita duduk sendirian menikmati ketenangan di sebuah taman tepi laut, tanpa menyadari bahwa dirinya diam-diam diawasi oleh seorang gadis misterius dari kejauhan. Tatapan sang gadis menyimpan niat yang tak diketahui, menciptakan ketegangan sunyi di udara. Tak lama kemudian, sebuah peristiwa tak terduga terjadi, mengubah sore yang tenang menjadi momen mengejutkan yang mengubah segalanya.

title: SHE/HER "Sihir"
overview: Kongko sosok pria yang mengalami masa - masa pubertas keduanya dipertemukan oleh jaka alias mira dengan latar belakang pekerjaan sebagai waria di dalam sebuah kamar mandi kecil, Mereka menemukan kenyamanan dalam perbincangan yang tulus di tengah kekacauan kehidupan masing - masing.

title: 1 Kakak 7 Ponakan
overview: After the untimely death of his older sister and her husband, a struggling young architect suddenly becomes a "single parent" for his nieces and nephews. When the opportunity for a better life arises, he must choose between his love life, career, or his family.

title: Sebelum 7 Hari
overview: A curse on their recently deceased mother leaves Tari and her brother Kadar with only seven days to free her soul and protect their family from darkness.

title: Keajaiban Air Mata Wanita
overview: After her husband's death, a woman faces financial struggles, unemployment and the threat of losing her daughter, but with the support of her best friend, she fights to rebuild her life and find happiness again.

title: Mama
overview: Dinda, who had just graduated from elementary school, had to feel the loss of her mother, who she loved so much, because of a hit-and-run accident. In this unfortunate incident, Wahyu, Dinda's father, broke his leg. Dinda and her father returned to the family's old house to calm down and heal their wounds. But there is another figure that inhabits the house. A figure who expects the presence of a child, to accompany her solitude.

title: Missed Calls
overview: Indra is a student who likes to prioritize his own desires over his responsibilities. One day, he ran away from home to have fun, leaving his responsibilities at home and ignoring his mother's words. On the same day, Indra received bad news about his mother, who had suffered an accident while he was traveling, leaving his mother alone at home.

title: COD Berdarah
overview: Angga, a  package courier, encounters a crazy customer who seeks victims through cash on delivery, revealing that all the madness comes from the residents. Angga fights the residents so that there will be no more similar incidents.

title: 1 Coto 5 Ketupat
overview: The family life of Daeng Naba (Baso Daeng Naba) is warm yet fraught with conflict as they face differing views regarding the future of their family's coto stall.

title: Pepali
