overview: Kenzo and his friends get stranded during a nature survey and take shelter in an old house owned by a woman named Anjani. Aura starts seeing things the others don’t, and a stolen ring quietly sets something sinister in motion. As strange events escalate inside the house, the group realizes they might have stepped into a mystery none of them are prepared for.

title: Kenangan
overview: In a house on the edge of the forest, two siblings with magical powers live their days. The cheerful younger sibling and the quiet elder one, along with their father, who is still lost in memories of his late wife. The elder sibling feels it is unfair that their father shows more care for the younger one than for them. When the younger sibling is kidnapped by an evil spirit from the forbidden forest, the elder consumed by guilt sets out with their father to rescue them. On their journey deep into the forest, father and child are forced to confront their wounds, unspoken grief, and the truth behind the mother’s death, leading them to rebuild the bond that had long been broken.

title: Bunyi Hujan di Bawah Halte
overview: Renata (19 Tahun) dan  Rio (19 Tahun) sedang menunggu bus di halte. Namun karena hari terlalu sore, Renata mengalihkan transport pulang mereka dengan lo-car (taksi online). Ditengah menunggu, Rio meminta Renata untuk membelikan kasa baru untuk luka di kakinya. Setelah dibantu oleh Renata, ternyata Rio mengucapkan kalimat yang membuat Renata kecewa sehingga terjadi pertengkaran diantara mereka berdua yang mengungkap bahwa selama ini Rio hanya menganggap Renata sebatas teman dan memanfaatkan kebaikan Renata. Tak disangka, dibalik Renata yang tersakiti, ia juga memanfaatkan Aqmal (19 Tahun) untuk membayar lo-car.

title: Silent Thursdays.
overview: Behind the dark history that still lingers in Indonesia, there are voices that never fade. Silent Thursdays takes us on a journey with two young individuals, Kak Virdinda and Kak Vebrina, active members of KontraS (Commission for the Disappeared and Victims of Violence). Both have long been involved and vocal in supporting Aksi Kamisan, a movement that continues to fight for justice for victims of human rights abuses and the disappeared. With tireless dedication, they strive to ensure that the neglected voices are heard and the rights taken away by the state are restored.

title: Yang Tak Terucap dibalik Asap
overview: Kakak beradik yang telah lama terpisah memutuskan untuk pergi ke warung kopi setelah menguburkan ayahnya.

title: Proyeksi Masa Lalu
overview: Kurnia, seorang wanita berusia 37 tahun, kembali menghadapi kenangan masa lalunya melalui proyeksi gambar-gambar yang membawa perasaan haru sekaligus duka. Dalam perjalanan ini, ia menceritakan kisah cinta, penerimaan, perpisahan, dan penyesalan yang membentuk dirinya sekarang. Meratapi memori-memori itu, Kurnia perlahan menemukan kekuatan untuk melepaskan keterikatannya dengan masa lalu dan mencapai pengikhlasan.

title: Miss(ed)
overview: Dibalik warna-warni, kelap-kelip dan keceriaan di pasar malam ada Nabil, seorang kakak yang kehilangan adiknya. Ketika ia merayakan ulang tahun adiknya yang ke-10.  Berbagai rintangan dalam mencari adiknya seorang diri Nabil lewati, hingga ia menemukan kenyataan yang sebenarnya.

title: We're on the same frame
overview: The stigma in Indonesian society (especially parents) assumes that civil servants  have a higher status than other jobs. Most parents in  Indonesia will definitely prioritize civil servants for their children over other informal jobs.  But do their children also want to become civil servants?  In a family with both civil servant parents, Tutik (F77) who is a retired teacher  (civil servant), has 2 children with one civil servant, Iwan (M42) and one non-civil servant, Ika (F45). Iwan himself works  at the regent's office (as a civil servant) following in the footsteps of his parents. Meanwhile, Ika, chose not to  follow in the footsteps of her parents and chose to become a private employee. With two different career views, this family still respects each other. Because  basically all jobs have the same status and dignity. These jobs have their respective portions in life.

title: Narasi di Malam Sunyi
originalTitle: A NARRATOR IN THE SILENT NIGHT
overview: Seorang anak sering menjadi sasaran kekerasan dari ayahnya dan hanya bisa bermain dengan mainannya saat tengah malam, satu-satunya waktu ia merasa aman namun suatu malam ia mendapati kehadiran sosok misterius yang mulai berinteraksi dengannya.

title: Hari Ini, untuk Bapak
overview: Lea, a teacher, takes a city bus to her civil servant exam, but she meets a child who reminds her of precious moments with her father.

title: Together Without You
overview: Asri and Yasmin, two scientists stranded on an alien planet with deadly flora and fauna, attempt to find a way back to Earth. Although the reckless Asri and the quiet Yasmin often have different views, they still support each other. When they succeed in activating a rocket station using alien eggs, the situation becomes critical. The alien begin to hunt them until they are cornered in a situation that forces them to separate.

title: Halat
overview: Nila, a younger sister who now feels alienated from her own older sibling. She actually misses the times when their relationship was so close. However, now, every time she sees her older sister, she feels distant. Not understanding what to do, she finally tried to build some talk through cooking. Tracing every memory they have together, hoping that their relationship will return to being as warm as before. They connected conversation after conversation, exchanging news and childhood memories, until finally Nila revealed the anxiety that was hidden deep in her heart. About how the house really is, about her current situation, and about the wrong understanding that has grown within her.

title: Sepasang Sepatu
overview: Niran yang baru saja memulai tahun ajaran baru di sekolahnya mendapatkan bahwa teman teman nya menggunakan sepatu baru. Hal tersebut membawa niran pada keinginan mempunyai sepatu baru. namun pada saat ia meminta pada ayah nya yang seorang pembuat sepatu terjadi konflik antara mereka.

title: Bayang-Bayang Anak Jahanam
overview: Gina and Gani's lives changed drastically when they discovered their son Agni drew his energy from unknown sources. As fear spread, they uncovered the truth: Agni was no ordinary child—he was the Child of Damnation.

title: Pengantin Setan
overview: Caught in a strained marriage, Echa finds solace in a man who visits her dreams. But comfort turns to terror when he emerges as a malicious spirit.

title: 1 Imam 2 Makmum
overview: A devoted woman struggles to earn her husband's love while living in the long shadow of his late wife.

title: Eva: Pendakian Terakhir
overview: Pasha invited Eva, his girlfriend, to climb a mountain with Nisa, Vicky, and their leader, Joni. However, breaking mountain taboos triggered supernatural disturbances. Vicky was possessed, Eva vanished, and they encountered Tenri, a woman imprisoned for allegedly following her father's demonic cult. Chaos soon engulfed them and the nearby villagers.

title: Tonya
overview: Pertemuan seorang pemuda dengan gadis yang memiliki kekuatan mistis membuatnya terhanyut keserakahan.

title: Rika
overview: Kala, seorang pelukis yang terasing, terobsesi menyelesaikan lukisan terakhirnya dengan satu warna yang belum pernah ia temukan yaitu warna merah yang “hidup”. Ia mengundang kekasihnya, Rika, untuk menjadi model, namun perlahan sikapnya berubah dingin dan tak terkendali. Ketika sebuah insiden kecil merusak kanvasnya, obsesi Kala memuncak dan mengaburkan batas antara cinta dan kegilaan. Dalam satu keputusan fatal, ia akhirnya menemukan warna yang selama ini ia cari namun dengan harga yang tak bisa dikembalikan.

title: アイドルの意味
overview: Chika idols or local idols are all about chasing dreams, but it’s not as easy as it looks. They deal with tons of pressure and crazy fan expectations, often getting dragged into a stressful parasocial world. Behind those bright smiles, they’re fighting battles that really test their limits.

title: Kita Ke Seinvious
overview: Sebuah dokumenter pendek perjalanan seinvious menuju gunung bunder

title: Diam atau Nilai
overview: Di sebuah kampus selama semester pendek, dua mahasiswi, Ilmi dan Riezka, berusaha keras untuk lulus dari mata kuliah yang diampu oleh seorang asisten dosen (asdos), Zaqy. Zaqy adalah mahasiswa senior yang dipercaya menjadi pengajar sementara. Namun, Zaqy menyalahgunakan posisinya dengan membuat tuntutan tidak pantas kepada Ilmi & Riezka, dengan dalih mempermudah kelulusan.

title: ANGKARA
overview: Sella, a university student who has been dating Angga for just a few months, finds herself confronted by a wave of murderous terror striking her campus. This reign of terror is no mere passing event, it ensnares the couple in a conflict that began long before they even met. Naura and Beni, Sella’s new friends, join her in the effort to unmask the mastermind behind the terror.

title: MEMAHAMI TALANGSARI 1989 DALAM 30 MENIT
overview: A documentary about the 1989 Talangsari Incident.

title: Kira, Duka & Air Mata
overview: Kira (21) is a girl who was forced to abort her pregnancy by her lover and his family. Not accepting this, Kira tried to fight back, but unexpectedly a robbery incident caused her to lose her life. Her best friend who knew about Kira's incident tried to seek justice.

title: The Unseen
overview: Seorang pemuda hiper rasional yang menertawakan keberadaan hantu harus menyaksikan hancurnya segala logika yang ia percayai ketika rentetan keanehan yang tak bisa dijelaskan mulai meneror kamarnya sendiri.

title: Belenggu Masa Lalu
overview: Rian, a former convict who had just been released from prison, wanted to repent and change his ways. However, because of his past actions, he found it difficult to repair his image as people still considered him a criminal.

title: Abel F*cking Rebel
overview: An office worker trapped in a monotonous life cycle begins to question his future after realizing that his colleague reflects the bleakest version of himself, prompting him to seek back the meaning of life through a moment that changes everything.

title: Waffle
overview: A man who tries to buy a waffle but unfortunately always runs out

title: Dunia Kiki
overview: Menceritakan tentang seorang anak yang sangat menyukai ultraman tetapi sayangnya dia memiliki keluarga yang kurang harmonis hingga pada akhirnya membuat sang anak memiliki trauma mental yang membuatnya memvisualisasikan orang tuanya yang bertengkar adalah ultraman dan monsternya.

title: Laut Untuk Biru
overview: A robber who manages to support himself and his blind sister, but he begins to question his criminal actions after he robs the house of a middle-aged man who is also blind.

title: Love In A Pin
overview: Haris akan melamar Hana, pacarnya yang sudah ia pacari selama 5 tahun. Namun, tepat sebelum melamar Hana, susuk (jimat yang haris gunakan agar terlihat tampan) milik haris kehabisan masanya. Setelah gagal meminta tolong kepada dukun, Haris harus mengakui kebohongannya selama ini dan berharap akan di maafkan oleh Hana.

title: Main Hakim Sendiri
overview: Seorang pria diserang pencuri di rumahnya. Setelah pergumulan sengit,pria itu berhasil melumpuhkan pencuri. Namun, dalam keadaan emosi, pemuda itu membunuh pencuri yang sudah tak berdaya. Saat polisi datang, pemuda tersebut ditangkap karena pembunuhan.

title: Kopi Susu Gula Aren
overview: Dalam kurun waktu 1 tahun terakhir (2023-2024) budaya nongkrong street coffee di kota yogyakarta berkembang sangat cepat. Firman shaleh merupakan salah satu orang yang berpengaruh besar dalam perkembangan budaya nongkrong tersebut, ia membuka salah satu street coffee pertama di daerah kotabaru dan membuka jalan bagi street coffee lainnya untuk buka. Walaupun mengalami berbagai rintangan firman bersama pinggiran tetap menginspirasi dan memberikan dampak berbagai budaya street coffee di kota yogyakarta.

title: Elang
overview: Elang, a football player for the Indonesia Football National Team, is forced to fight on the streets to pay for medical expenses for his mother who suffers from Alzheimer's. Elang's decision to leave the Indonesia Football National Team and join Sidney Warriors Football Club for the sake of money, disappointed his mother and Laras, his sister. When he returned to Indonesia, Elang faced threats from Hardiman who took his mother hostage and forced his team to lose. In a big dilemma, will Elang choose the honor of the his nation or his mother's life?

title: Ketindihan
overview: Under unbearable pressure, a young tennis star summons a djinn who begins to prey on people in their sleep, threatening the lives of her loved ones.

title: Ambyar Mak Byar
overview: Jeru wants his band to be a success. But when he meets Bethari, their romance puts his dreams at risk as her royal family seeks to sabotage their lives.

title: Almarhum
overview: Kematian tragis Pak Mulwanto, sang Ayah pada Selasa Kliwon menjadi awal petaka bagi keluarga Nuri. Konon, siapa pun yang wafat pada hari itu akan mengajak anggota keluarganya untuk sama-sama menjemput ajal. Sehingga keluarga yang ditinggal pun diminta menjalani serangkaian ritual untuk mencegah hal tersebut.  Wisesa, anak sulung yang berprofesi sebagai dokter, menolak ritual itu karena dianggap tidak masuk akal dan memilih menemani Ibunya yang masih terpukul. Namun, kejadian aneh dan mengerikan yang menimpa Nuri dan adiknya, Yanda, memaksa mereka mencari tahu tentang kebenaran di balik mitos dan ritual tersebut.  Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi? Apa benar ini ada hubungannya dengan kematian sang Ayah di Selasa Kliwon? CEPAT atau LAMBAT, semua akan menjadi ALMARHUM.

title: Gemerincing Mimpi
overview: Di balik tawa riang dan wajah polos, anak-anak jalanan ini menyimpan mimpi besar. Setiap hari, mereka harus berjibaku dengan kerasnya hidup, mengais harta di antara hiruk pikuk kota. Namun, di sela-sela perjuangannya, ada satu hal yang mereka rindukan yaitu kesempatan belajar. Dengan semangat yang membara, mereka berjuang untuk mendapatkan pendidikan yang layak, meski harus menghadapi berbagai rintangan.

title: No End in Sight
overview: Erna, a mother who has just been released from prison, then she looks for the figure of her child who she has lived with all this time

title: Jejak Hitam di Masa Kecil
overview: This documentary film reveals how domestic violence occurs in real families. This film takes the audience into the stories hidden behind the doors of houses that appear peaceful from the outside, revealing the mental and physical suffering experienced by the victims. This film also tells the story of their struggle to find a way out of the cycle of violence, as well as the process of recovering from this trauma, by presenting narratives from victims, experts and psychologists.

title: Film Wajib Tonton Sebelum Mati
overview: Kino, his wife Via, and their best friend Wahyu celebrate one million subscribers on their YouTube channel by reviewing ‘Must-See Movies Before You Die,’ unaware it will be their last video together. Now, Kino sits alone, haunted by memories and wrestling with overwhelming despair, desperately trying to find hope.

title: Final Draft
overview: Ciko, a film editor, faces a major dilemma when tasked with cutting several scenes of the lead actor due to acting flaws. Secretly, Jagad, the director, asks Ciko to edit the actor out of the film entirely, without the knowledge of Tasya, the producer. The situation becomes even more complicated as the actor is a special request from an important investor. During the preview, the investor demands more scenes of the actor, threatening to withdraw funding if his request is ignored. Tensions escalate as Tasya and Jagad clash over the final cut of the film, with Ciko caught in the middle. Feeling there is no way out, Ciko ultimately decides to leave the project.

title: Little Rebels Cinema Club
overview: 2008, the Indonesian city of Parepare. Together with his best friends, 14-year-old Doddy tries to recreate an iconic scene from a zombie movie and record it with the video camera that belongs to his sad and angry emo brother, Anji.

title: Busur dan Anak Panah
overview: Seorang Ibu yang sendirian setelah anaknya menikah

title: Ruang Tunggu
overview: The story revolves around Pras, a cafe barista who, that evening, wanted to invite one of his customers at the cafe where he works, Chery, to go somewhere. Unfortunately, Chery suddenly canceled the invitation without any clear reason, leaving Pras speechless. As time passed slowly that night, he began to reveal facts that left Chery astonished.

title: Maju Skena Mundur Skena
overview: A final-year student often mocked for his "weeb scene" lifestyle and his gray jacket, is forced by his friend to adopt a "culture scene" style for the yearbook photoshoot.

title: Us, Gece Us
overview: Zhafran, a 15-year-old teenager who often worships at the mosque but his family has just become poor because his father is addicted to online gambling. One day, Zhafran asks for help from his best friend named Genius, or often called "us" to help him steal money from the charity box at the mosque.

title: Bangkai Nafsu
overview: Thea is aroused by the genital decay! Juna is happy to let his genitals rot! Everything was done in order to marry the satan!

title: Menyulam Lobang
overview: Menyulam Lobang departs from the story of a mother who is forced to leave her bamboo stilt house and move into a concrete structure. This personal transition becomes a reflection on the paradox of modernity, where human development reshapes the earth to sustain comfort like embroidering the abyss . Through fragments of 35mm imagery, the film explores material fragility, time, and memory, suggesting that every structure we build carries traces of loss and unseen damage.

title: GULISTAN
overview: Gulistan, kata yang menjadi memori nostalgia bagi Adam, Putra dan Rian yang merupakan seorang santri. Kata tersebut diambil dari kitab klasik karya penyair Iran, Sa’di Shirazi, yang berjudul Gulistan—artinya "Taman Bunga", ustaz mereka yang memperkenalkannya, dan memiinta mereka untuk mencari gulistan versi mereka masing-masing dalam pesantren yang disinggahi kala itu.  Bagi tiga sahabat tersebut pesanteren hanyalah hamparan tanah biasa. Maka kaburlah mereka. Hingga dalam pelariannya mereka bertemu dengan versi lain dari mereka di dalam diri seorang tukang ngarit. Memberi jawaban atas tugas yang ustaz mereka berikan. Mereka menemukan gulistannya.

title: Mưa trên cánh bướm
overview: After discovering her husband’s affair on live television, a wedding venue worker seeks a powerful spell master to win back his love, while her daughter dreams of a brighter future abroad and a mysterious spirit haunts their crumbling home.

title: Ajian Maut
overview: Suraji, a simple farmer who lives in a remote village in the middle of the forest. The village is called Sumberjati, a village far from the luxury of the city and filled with ancient customs and beliefs. However, things began to change when a long drought hit the village of Sumberjati, making Suraji's harvest worse and making Suraji unable to pay his debts to the village loan shark. One day, Suraji uses an ancient spell that can give instant wealth and power to its user called the Segoro Geni spell. However, the spell will endanger its user if they cannot control its power properly.

title: Utusan Iblis: Dia Yang Berada di Antara Kita
originalTitle: Utusan Iblis: Dia Yang Berada di Antara Kita
overview: Telling the story of Olivia, a psychiatrist specializing in mental health, who tries to help Rendy, a police officer, dealing with a brutal massacre case carried out by Cantika against her child and husband. After going through several therapy sessions, Olivia's own psychological condition deteriorates. A terrifying entity has long possessed Cantika’s body and was the reason she slaughtered her entire family, and now it is causing Olivia’s past to resurface.

title: Zanna: Whisper of Volcano Isle
overview: Zanna, a girl separated from her family suddenly enters a world full of wonders that she never imagined. Together with two beautiful fairies, Dinda and Novi, Zanna dared to explore various new and challenging things, even fighting attacks by evil enemy forces.

title: Bintang Lima
overview: Adi, a 30-year-old online taxi driver, picks up Wahyu, a 50-year-old officer carrying drug evidence for a high-profile case. Unaware of Wahyu's identity, Adi vents his deep frustration about incompetent law enforcement while driving. Irritated by Adi's harsh criticism, Wahyu spitefully sneaks a bag of drugs under the car seat before leaving. Moments after dropping him off, Adi is violently intercepted by mysterious men in black who accuse him of drug trafficking, trapping him in a frame-up using the planted evidence.

title: Bebaskanlah Kami Dari Yang Jahat
overview: Luigi, a new kid at an orphanage, spends his days with his new friend, Angel. Luigi and Angel's closeness grows over time, until finally his daily life begins to change after a Father comes into his life. Filling Luigi's life with something he has never been able to feel, and this leads Luigi to discover the secret behind his friend Angel.

title: Aneka Kue
overview: A child who loves his mother’s cake so much that he is reluctant to share even a small piece of cake with his mother. In the end, he finds the reason why he loves eating cake so much and finds his deepest regret in the simplest thing, a piece of cake.

title: Amara
overview: Amar (27), a woodcutter, accidentally lost his chainsaw file to replace it at a building shop. However, when he wanted to pay using the qr application from Ruhiyah (35), the cashier asked him to pay in cash only because QR was only for transactions over IDR 100,000. Annoyed, Amar was forced to leave the shop to find a mini ATM. After waiting in line for quite a long time, Amar was finally able to withdraw cash with the remaining balance, which he could only withdraw IDR 100,000. Amar later returned to the store to pay cash, but the cashier refused.

title: The Philosopher's Journey
overview: Biographical documentary of Romo Magnis about his early life in Germany, his work as a Jesuit priest and philosopher in Indonesia, and his contributions to Driyarkara School of Philosophy.

title: Muliha
overview: After hearing a mysterious voice calling “Muliha” from outside their home, a mother and her two children become haunted by strange occurrences that force her to confront a buried truth about her family and the dead.

title: A is for Andra
overview: A short film following a queer, revisionist narrative, taking as its core the story of Andra, a former MTV VJ and host in Indonesia from 2007-2011. Using humour, performance, and poetry, Andra tracks their evolution from a young, rising star in Bandung to a non-binary transmasculine adult living a private life as a kindergarten teacher in Berlin. The film maps the limits of expression in the early 2000s media imaginary and the gendered constraints that Andra often found themselves in, as well as the slow unlearning of their identity.

title: Can the Monster Speak
overview: a short film by Angelissa Melissa

title: Roda Kota Arteri Jakarta
overview: Roda Kota Arteri Jakarta explores Jakarta’s latest public transportation system, Mikrotrans (often called JakLingko). Beneath its perceived success, the documentary uncovers systemic realities where delayed wages and demanding work targets affect driver performance, passenger comfort, and safety. Through multiple perspectives, from drivers and operators to government officials. The film reveals structural conflicts within a public transport system whose ideals have yet to be fully realized.

title: Podol!
overview: UJANG (12/M) is memorizing Pancasila (Indonesia’s state ideology) all night, accompanied by his MOTHER (30/F) and FATHER (35/M), for his school exam. While Ujang is studying, he faces one distraction after another, disrupting his focus. These distractions stem from issues (both in the real world and online) that conflict with the values of Pancasila that Ujang is trying to memorize.

title: Ipan dan Pahlawan Super Manusia Ikan
originalTitle: Ipan dan Pahlawan Super Manusia Ikan
overview: Ipan (11), an elementary school student who often dreams of being visited by the fishman superhero Truno, feels that his dream is a sign. One day, his classmates laugh at him because they claim that Truno will give him powers. Not only that, when Ipan saves Nisa (11) from bullying, Ipan pretends to be Truno. However, he is beaten even more badly. After school, Ipan goes to a river to call Truno so that he can be given powers.

title: Torosiaje: The Bajou, The Sea, and The Future
originalTitle: Torosiaje: The Bajou, The Sea, and The Future
overview: The loss of preservation of the Bajo Torosiaje tribe’s traditional and maritime culture among the younger generation has led some children to prefer to seek employment and settle in urban areas. Not only that, the loss of this preservation has brought about other impacts, such as the emergence of illegal fishing activities that contradict their customs, making this phenomenon contrary to their identity as “Guardians of the Sea”.

title: Terlahir Kembali
overview: Dara seorang wanita muda yang hidup tanpa kehadiran ayah selama 20 Tahun. Bertemu kembali dengan ayahnya, pertemuan ini membuka luka lama dan menjadi momen penuh emosi di mana keduanya saling mengungkapkan isi hatinya. Dalam dialog yang intens, Dara mencoba memaafkan sang ayah sambil menghadapi kenyataan bahwa dirinya kini berada dalam situasi serupa dengan ibunya.

title: Kloningan
overview: 3 sahabat pengangguran mencoba mengubah hidup mereka dengan membuat konten di sosial media namun tanpa sengaja hal itu merusak pertemanan mereka.

title: Silent Vendetta
overview: Ethan menerima tawaran misterius dari seseorang bernama user ID yang membawanya pada kesuksesan tak terduga. Namun, ketika ancaman gelap mulai menghantui, ia dan teman-temannya terjebak dalam permainan berbahaya yang penuh rahasia, pengkhianatan, dan bahaya mematikan.

title: Hangat Selimut Nadi
overview: Ayah, main catur yuk!  It tells the story of Bunga, who experiences her most cherished day: spending time with her father, who suddenly recovers from his illness. However, amidst constant prayers and hope, she learns to accept the lessons of mistakes and loss.

title: Aku Gak Suka!
overview: A girl who doesn't like eating vegetables refuses the free lunch provided by her school.

title: Tanggal Kadaluarsa
overview: A young man copes with being ghosted by his girlfriend by finding solace in an unexpected ritual: eating canned sardines as a means to heal and move forward.

title: Video Profil Sekolah SMA Jembatan Budaya 2024
originalTitle: Video Profil Sekolah SMA Jembatan Budaya 2024
overview: Sebuah persembahan kolaborasi kreativitas siswa SMA Jembatan Budaya yang berfokus untuk mengenalkan dan mengeksplorasi berbagai macam kegiatan sekolah dan profil sekolah dalam bentuk video yang dihadirkan dengan atmosfer sinematik dan penceritaan visual.

title: Mielikku
overview: Seorang istri yang sedang hamil muda mengidam sebuah spaghetti, namun sang suami hanya bisa memberi yang ia mampu untuk memenuhi permintaan istrinya.

title: Kembang Nu Ceurik dina Palaminan
overview: Zahra, gadis muda yang masih di bangku sekolah terpaksa menikah karena tekanan keluarga dan tradisi. ia merasa seperti bunga yang belum mekar sempurna, dipaksa untuk hidup dalam dunia orang dewasa yang tidak ia pahami. Tangisnya di pelaminan bukan hanya tentang kehilangan masa muda, tetapi juga tentang ketakutan akan masa depan yang penuh ketidakpastian.

title: Panggonan Wingit 2: "Miss K"
overview: Setelah ibunya meninggal, ALMA dan adiknya, MIA pindah dari Jakarta ke Surabaya karena Alma mendapat pekerjaan sebagai manajer di Apartemen Sasmaya. Anehnya, lantai 6 di apartemen itu ditutup. Tetapi karena ada hal mendesak, Alma dan Mia terpaksa masuk ke lantai tersebut dan masuk ke unit nomor 610. Mereka melihat sosok seorang wanita dan anak kecil perempuan misterius di sana yang berkata, “Papat dina, maghrib…” Sejak itu Alma dan Mia mulai mengalami teror mengerikan. Ternyata unit 610 itu adalah sebuah tempat angker. Siapapun yang membukanya akan mati dalam empat hari di waktu maghrib.

title: My Other Half
overview: Tama, seorang remaja yang putus asa, berencana mengakhiri hidupnya di atap sebuah gedung kosong. Namun, rencananya terhenti ketika ia bertemu Sela, seorang gadis misterius yang tiba-tiba muncul di tempat yang sama. Percakapan singkat mereka mengungkap luka batin yang mereka berdua rasakan, dan perlahan-lahan menumbuhkan secercah harapan di tengah keputusasaan mereka.

title: Patah Arang
overview: Since Mom left, Dad has often scolded Tasya over trivial matters. Tasya got fed up and decided to live with her mother, leaving Dad with all his regrets.

title: BUANG MAYAT
overview: Alva dan Akmal ingin membuang Mayat dari penagih hutang mereka, tapi Bingung harus buang dimana.

title: Hana
overview: Andre, a migrant, is trapped in his boarding house when the pandemic hits. With an indifferent mother and best friend, Andre remembers his ex, Hana.

title: The Boys Who Can't See The Skies
originalTitle: The Boys Who Can't See The Skies
overview: The Boys who's try to revenge from what happened to them when they were kidnapped by the village leader who wanted to take away their freedom.

title: Rita Coba Rokok
overview: Rita akhirnya mencoba merokok setelah dia melihat toples tembakau milik temannya.

title: HELL_V4.mp4
overview: Nugra mendapati temannya bunuh diri secara tidak wajar, Lalu ia menemukan sebuah hal aneh di harddisk temannya yang berkaitan dengan kematiannya

title: Mari Kita Usahakan Rumah Itu
overview: When their mortgage application is rejected by the bank due to insufficient income, a married couple, Rendi and Suci, who work as cleaning service workers, must find a way to raise a 100 million down payment as instructed by the bank officer so that the following installments will be lighter. Pressured by the situation, they rack their brains and try various ways to gather that amount of money.

title: Senyum Merah Putih: Bukit Satu Kaki
originalTitle: Senyum Merah Putih: Bukit Satu Kaki
overview: Mansyur finds his two grandchildren, Nurani and Arya, abandoned at the home of his son-in-law, Ahmad. Ahmad was forced to leave his two children behind to seek his fortune in the city in order to provide a better life for them. Mansyur, who lost his daughter, Maisaroh (Auliany Dewi), after she gave birth to Arya, is angry at Ahmad for causing Arya to have a disability in one of his legs. Ahmad made a mistake while trying to help his wife give birth. Nurani also has a disability that limits her ability to speak. Mansyur is thus forced to take care of his two grandchildren. Upon entering elementary school, Nurani and Arya must face various challenges and obstacles at their school.

title: Modal Nekad
overview: Desperate to pay their father's medical bills, three brothers wind up in a world of trouble when they try to burglarize the home of a mob boss.

title: Sorop
overview: Berniat kembali ke rumah masa kecilnya, Hanif (Hana Malasan) dan Isti (Yasamin Jasem) justru harus dikejutkan dengan kematian Pakde (Egi Fedly) yang terjadi tepat di hadapan mereka. Kematian Pakde rupanya membawa sesuatu yang lebih gelap datang ke rumah mereka. Kini, Hanif dan Isti harus membuka tabir teka-teki yang berhubungan dengan masa lalunya.

title: Behind The Maestro
overview: Observing the behind-the-scenes experiences full of stories, film editors struggle alone in silence, facing time pressure and demands for perfection, as they try to maintain mental balance amidst the endless routine.

title: Bertuhan/Bertahan
overview: The relationship between native women in the cities of Cianjur, Bogor, and male tourists from the Middle East, that merges beliefs and morals.

title: Di Balik Pintu
overview: A teacher who loves his students in the wrong way

title: Lintas Masa
overview: Bercerita mengenai Hendri yang membayangkan masa lalu keluarganya hanya karena dirinya malas kuliah.

title: Goodluck Mr. Genie
overview: Jaya is a greedy man who was cursed to become a genie. He was trapped for 59 years in a kendi until someone finally let him out, but unfortunately because of the shock, his prospective master fell unconscious, so he had to wait for his master to wake up to remove the curse.

title: Recorder
overview: Indra, seorang detektif muda yang sedang menyelidiki kasus bunuh diri menemukan sesuatu yang janggal dari sebuah rekaman suara pada recorder yang menuntunnya kepada hal yang tidak biasa.

title: Sadrah Poem Of Blood
overview: Sepasang suami istri, Salwa dan Dadang, telah lama mendambakan kehadiran seorang anak. Meskipun penghasilan mereka pas-pasan dan privasi mereka terbatas, mereka tetap bertekad untuk berusaha. Mereka telah mencoba berbagai strategi, termasuk meminta nasihat dari dukun online. Namun, ketika mereka mencoba menerapkan strategi terbaru mereka, mereka menemui kendala yang tak terduga.

title: Disiplin Itu Penting
overview: Four students skip class by pretending to go to the toilet, but are caught hanging out at the canteen and punished. The next day, they repeat the same mistake, get reported to the principal, and are punished again.

title: Dinding Khayalan
overview: Flora dan Fauzan, dua anak yatim piatu tanpa kampung halaman, berkelana bersama dalam pencarian untuk menemukan kampung mereka sendiri.

title: Maybe, in Another Universe?
overview: Ditto hopelessly romantically pursues his longtime crush named Ghea but fails miserably until he finds a magical watch that can travel from universe to universe.

title: Melukis Harapan Di Langit India
overview: Devi goes to India to find her father, who according to her mother is a famous Indian actor. Did Devi succeed in meeting her father?

title: Hutang Nyawa
overview: The old factory where Erwina works holds a dark secret - and because her family owes a debt to the devil, she must pay a terrible price for being there.

title: Racun Sangga: Santet Pemisah Rumah Tangga
originalTitle: Racun Sangga: Santet Pemisah Rumah Tangga
overview: Soon after getting married, couple Maya and Andi begin to experience eerie disturbances from unseen malevolent forces.

title: Berhenti Berjalan
overview: Adriel, seorang ayah yang berusaha menyampaikan kebenaran dibalik keberadaan istrinya kepada anak perempuannya.

title: Tabrak Lucy
overview: Wanting to help his mother pay her medications, Antonio devises a plan. Papuan customary law enforces a fine to anyone that kills a pig from crashing their vehicle. By putting his beloved pig Lucy on the road, Antonio hopes that he'll see results.

title: Sandal Bupati
overview: A regent loses his sandals after praying at a local mosque.

title: Jadilah Bonekaku
overview: Seorang wanita misterius dengan gangguan kepribadian antisosial menjalani hidup yang sunyi dan terasing. Di balik ketenangannya, ia menculik seorang gadis muda untuk dijadikan boneka dalam koleksi pribadinya. Sang gadis didandani dengan indah dan dirias layaknya boneka, namun terperangkap dalam sebuah ruangan sunyi yang dipenuhi oleh boneka-boneka lain.

title: Petrus: Penembak Misterius
overview: A documentary that tells the story of the mysterious Peter, a mysterious shooter in the Soeharto era, from the perspective of a former perpetrator and a survivor.

title: Selasar Luka
overview: Kirana has an older sister who excels academically and has always been a source of pride for her parents. For as long as she can remember, Kirana has been constantly compared to her sister because she isn’t academically gifted. Then, one tragic day, her sister died in an accident while on her way to a theater performance; from that point on, her mother began to resent Kirana’s involvement in theater and put even more pressure on her. Kirana always tried to explain her goals in theater and the positive things she gained from it, but she always received a negative response from her mother. Kirana had no one to confide in—until one day, someone approached her and was willing to lend a listening ear.

title: Pirates of Sepuluh Ribuan
overview: Lutfi and Iman, two elementary school boys, are happily playing knights when they hear the story of a gold panner who claims to be a real pirate. The pirate offers them a treasure map for 100,000 rupiah, but they can only afford half. Fueled by a spirit of adventure, they gather a crew and set sail using Lutfi’s father’s sampan.  Unfortunately, Iman's greed in recruiting too many crew members leads to disaster

title: A Lonely Son
overview: An orphan named ANDI (10) is always under pressure in his environment. Every day he always looks battered because he fights with his rival RIVAL (11) at school. Likewise, when at home, ANDI is always scolded and beaten by his FATHER (35). All this made Andi miss and long to be with his late mother. One day his mother came but took the form of a pocong. Does Andi accept the condition of his mother who is in the form of a pocong?

title: Misteri Bilik Korek Api
overview: After discovering a chamber filled with toys and stacks of matchboxes in the orphanage they recently moved into, Dina and the other orphans continue to experience supernatural disturbances in the house. In addition, the arrival of Luna, a new orphan who is no less mysterious than the orphanage they just moved into.

title: Nyla
overview: Berkisah tentang Nyla, gadis penenun asal Sumba yang mengejar mimpinya untuk menjadi pemain sepak bola profesional. Perjalanan Nyla tidaklah mudah, ia harus berlari dari benang ke lapangan, dari tradisi ke ambisi. Tapi dengan akar yang kuat dan keberanian dalam melangkah, Nyla percaya bahwa mimpinya adalah harapan bagi banyak perempuan muda lainnya.

title: Menabur Angin Menuai Badai
overview: Yohanes’ life hangs by a thread as financial hardship leaves him unable to afford the medication for his heart condition. In his despair, he returns to the Field of Grace Church (Gereja Ladang Kasih), seeking healing and renewed hope. However, instead of solace, Yohanes discovers that the cure he longs for comes at a steep price. As his health continues to decline, he is faced with demands for sacrifices far beyond what he ever imagined.

title: Skenar10
overview: Angga, a screenwriter who lives in an Islamic boarding school, faces a dead end when trying to design an interesting storyline.

title: Warung Acil Idah
overview: Acil Idah, a coffee shop vendor, has to live with her daughter in an environment of prostitution. Her life is full of gossip about her and her daughter, but she still survives and always realizes that the truth of her life only belongs to people who understand her condition.

title: Itu Bukan Dia
overview: After losing her fiance, Arini (24) constantly feels sad and lonely. She is willing to do anything to reunite with her loved one, even daring to engage in forbidden acts by performing a “Spirit Summoning Ritual.” This is a ritual she witnessed as a child.

title: Konco-Konco Edan
overview: Belum terdapat sinopsis. Namun film ini dahulu berjudul Duit Express.

title: Terkutuk
overview: A desperate photojournalist seeking to salvage her collapsing career inadvertently activates a lethal supernatural curse after opening an unaddressed, anonymous parcel, forcing her into a race against time to uncover the origin of the artifact before succumbing to its fatal deadline.

title: Sampai Nanti, Hanna!
overview: Two college friends must split their close bond when one uproots her life. Years later, a sudden reunion could tether their lingering feelings.

title: My Paws Are Soft, My Bones Are Heavy
originalTitle: My Paws Are Soft, My Bones Are Heavy
overview: On this lonesome birthday, Johan tries to celebrate it as if his late mother is still here. Succumbing to his past, though in reality, there is only Paran, his best friend.

title: Cinta Tak Seindah Drama Korea
overview: Seorang perempuan (Lutesha) mendapatkan kejutan manis dari kekasihnya (Ganindra Bimo), yaitu berlibur ke Seoul bersama dua sahabatnya sesama pecinta drama Korea (Anya Geraldine & Dea Panendra). Tak disangka, di sana ia justru bertemu dengan cinta pertamanya ketika SMA (Jerome Kurnia). Apakah ini akan lebih dramatis dari drama Korea?

title: Samsara
overview: Darta, a man from an impoverished family, is rejected by the wealthy parents of the woman he loves. Desperate, he strikes a bargain with the Monkey King, performing a dark ritual to gain wealth. However, in doing so, he accidentally curses his wife and child to a life of suffering. Rooted in Indonesian mysticism, this universal narrative explores the insatiable hunger to become something one is not and the boundaries one is willing to cross to achieve it.

title: Jawa Randu Di Jalan Jalang
overview: In a bustling metropolitan city, "a goat" wanders the streets in search of fresh meat for its special dinner.

title: Pagbibisikleta Sa Umaga
overview: In 2024, in Surabaya, a teenage boy is cycling alone in the morning.

title: SAH!
overview: Putri, 17 and seven months pregnant, feels suffocated by societal expectations on her wedding day. Overwhelmed by a bleak future, she escapes in her wedding dress and jumps into the back of a catering truck driven by Rizqy, a gay man also trapped in an arranged marriage. Their spontaneous journey is filled with humor, tension, and moments of genuine human connection. Both begin to question the life choices and paths forced upon them. SAH. is a powerful exploration of the collision between tradition and individual freedom, challenging deep-rooted norms about love, identity, and the right to define one's destiny.

title: Serious People?!
overview: Indonesian candidate Leo Tirtayasa heads to New York, determined to win over the diaspora in the 2024 regional elections. As he campaigns, a journalist follows closely, documenting his every move—until both start to reveal their true selves.

title: Stirring the Broth
overview: Risa calls her mother for cooking advice. As the dish simmers, her emotions begin to boil over as she finally confronts her deeply buried issues.

title: SAH!
overview: Putri, 17 and seven months pregnant, feels suffocated by societal expectations on her wedding day. Overwhelmed by a bleak future, she escapes in her wedding dress and jumps into the back of a catering truck driven by Rizqy, a gay man also trapped in an arranged marriage.

title: Dini Hari
overview: An overworked career mom who tries to get home early for her daughter’s birthday ends up taking care of her boss’ daughter all night and missing the whole birthday.

title: Kotak
overview: Kota, trapped in a confined space, watches her friend Alam dance freely in nature. Alam’s graceful movements reflect the harmony with the environment. In contrast, Kota’s dance is a desperate response to her restrictive surroundings, mirroring her mother’s struggles. As Alam extends a hand of friendship, Kota gradually breaks free from her confinement, learning to embrace the natural world and dance harmoniously with her friend.

title: Hen
overview: Maria receives a text message informing her husband has been jailed for a drug case. She has to find some money for ransom. But her neighbours who get involved in the drug case have a different solution to get the money and put her daughter into a traumatized situation.

title: Babon
overview: Maria receives a text message informing her husband has been jailed for a drug case. She has to find some money for ransom. But her neighbours who get involved in the drug case have a different solution to get the money and put her daughter into a traumatized situation.

title: The Pieces Of Guitar
overview: 19-year-old college student suffering from mental health issues finds solace in music, but when the guitar that he order broken, he must discover what happened to himself.

title: 17 Surat Cinta
overview: A 2024 environmental documentary by Ekspedisi Indonesia Baru (Dandhy Dwi Laksono), which exposes brutal deforestation and illegal palm oil expansion in the Rawa Singkil Wildlife Sanctuary, Aceh. The film documents 17 letters from local residents to authorities, highlighting threats to the Leuser ecosystem and the habitat of endangered species.

title: Bran And Fey
overview: Bran (23) is devastated after being betrayed by Fey (22). Consumed by rage, he becomes determined to end his lover's life.

title: Terang Bulan
overview: Munawaroh, a village midwife, secretly cares for Mira, a former prostitute shunned by the community. As Mira’s pregnancy progresses, she becomes increasingly anxious about her safety. One evening, Mira collapses at a women-only village gathering, where Munawaroh pretends not to know her to protect her standing among the conservative women. However, when the situation becomes life-threatening, Munawaroh faces a moral dilemma: help Mira deliver her baby in front of the villagers or preserve her reputation.

title: Pelabuhan Berkabut
overview: During a tough time, Rozaq (35) , a soon-to-be father, desperately stole fish from a food supplier at the harbor to save his wife, Sasa (36), and her pregnancy. Worried about their baby being stunting like him, he took a big chance. However, a mysterious gas threatened to transform him into a fish.

title: Memori Air
overview: Traumatized by witnessing the death of a close friend, a child kept coming back to the spring hollow, finding ways to free himself of guilt, sorrow, and accusations.

title: Bong
overview: Hayat lives with his wife Sekar, a pregnant woman, in an illegal house built on a Chinese cemetery. Their peace is disturbed when Suwargono comes looking for his mother’s grave, which is believed to be in their house. To hide the truth, Hayat is caught in a deep inner conflict as his child approaches birth.

title: Under the Whether
overview: A middle aged lady who’s going through a premenopause phase, tries to replace her busy daughter with a cat, but too bad, the cat is in puberty.

title: Makwan City of Dreams - The Silvermen
originalTitle: Makwan City of Dreams - The Silvermen
overview: In a city divided by a wall, two brothers living outside the affluent Zone struggle to save their ill mother. While Dino seeks The Zone Work Permit for her treatment, Joni leads a rebellion against the wall. Their diverging paths and Joni’s tragic fate push Dino to confront the harsh realities of their world and fight for justice.

title: Ikan Terganteng Sedunia
overview: Two best friends, Kayla and Heidi, accidentally killed Tejo, the school’s mascot fish, who had just received the award for the most handsome fish in Indonesia. They must cover their tracks after receiving a reaction from the principal, who is determined to punish the culprit.

title: Dengarlah Nyanyian Ping Pong
overview: Caitlin, a 6-year-old girl, navigates her life amid the commotion of her family’s arguments in a Hokkien dialect she doesn’t understand. She tries to make sense of the confusing pressures and emotions around her through the rhythmic sound of a ping-pong ball.

title: Arrow and Bullseye
overview: In order to win an archery competition, Kumey (L/10) must venture into the forest with his best friend, Aduy (L/10) to find enau wood to replace his broken bow. However, because he did not perform the panaki ritual when entering the forest, Kumey became unconscious after being reprimanded by Roh Agung. He regretted his actions and promised to respect the nature and culture of his ancestors.

title: Cening Nepukin I Kawa
overview: Cening, a young girl from Bali, is given the important responsibility of performing the Tumpek Pengarah ritual in her family’s orange grove. Reluctant at first, as she’d rather play with her friends, she follows her mother’s wishes and heads to the grove. She’s not finished the ritual and go to the river with her friends, Cening finds herself drawn into a mystical world, where she encounters Kawa, a magical guardian. Through this otherworldly meeting, Cening discovers the deeper meaning of gratitude and sacrifice.

title: Ada Hantu di Menara Merdu
overview: Zeo invited Remi, Ara, Gembi, Darra, Raga and Annika to his hometown, Banyuwangi, to spend their summer vacation together. They have a special mission: to find a local ghost! The seven friends set off to places that are believed to be mystical, including a bamboo tower standing in the middle of rice fields that plays a mysterious tune!

title: Suraci!
overview: Suraci is a boy who loves to enter his imagination. He feels sorry for his Mother who works under the hot sun every day. He wants to fly to the sun using a kite to cool it down with ice. However, Suraci doesn’t know what dangers await him.

title: A Tale of the Light
overview: A child (Lintang) wants to celebrate his birthday with family and friends, but his father has been critically ill in the hospital for a week. He then hears about a myth that fireflies can grant a wish. However, fireflies have not been seen in the area for a long time and are nearly extinct. Lintang and his friends then try to bring the fireflies back so that his father can come home soon.

title: Darah Ksatria
overview: Often bullied because of his fat body and a mysterious condition that causes him to have nosebleeds when he panics, Satria, a high school student, is forced to participate in the initiation of the all-boy school gang.

title: Smong
overview: This documentary film will follow Juman and Zahrina’s journey in the process of healing from the trauma of the Aceh Tsunami, 20 years ago.

title: Saru Latar Biru
overview: Seorang remaja yang mencari orang tua nya di kota berakhir terdampar dihalte pinggir kota.

title: The Secret Life of Daydreams
overview: An aspiring young actress trying to break into the film industry crosses paths with a miserable arthouse filmmaker to produce a film which manages to challenge both of their resolve to survive in the film industry.

title: Kujang Sasaka Bwaga Sunda
overview: Kang Aries and Kang Oca are two cultural observers of Kujang who try to provide a justification perspective on the Kujang Philosophy made by one of the blacksmiths named Abah Jajang, where the general public often considers that Kujang is a sharp weapon. The two of them "Kang Aris & Kang Oca" entered the realm of the trial to defend the essence of Kujang, so as not to be considered misunderstood by the general public.

title: Daemon Mind
overview: A neuroscientist creates a device which frees her inner Daemon allowing her to seek a terrible vengeance upon her enemies

title: Negeri Para Ketua
overview: The situation in the city of Medan is not conducive because there is a feud between five big gangs seeking influence and power. They are the Batak Gang that controls Central Medan, the Javanese Gang that controls North Medan, the Chinese Gang that controls East Medan, the Indian Gang that controls South Medan, and the Malay Gang that controls West Medan. The Chinese Gang Leader wants to match his younger brother, Kenzo, with Indian Gang Leader Rakesh's younger sister Anjali. They secretly want to unite the territories they have previously controlled. However, Binsar, the leader of the Batak Gang, strongly opposed the match.

title: Cinta Dalam Ikhlas
overview: A troubled teen turns his life around with the help of a classmate. Years later, their reunion sparks old feelings, but uncertainty clouds their story.

title: Guna Guna Istri Muda
overview: Horror pierces Vivian's life when her husband, Burhan, decides to marry Angel, an avaricious young woman who uses witchcraft to terrorize her family.

title: Rizal dan Cinta
overview: Rizal carried out his usual activities, killing. In his past life, he fell in love with someone, and he truly understood what love was. His life was very normal, until...

title: LIAR
overview: The life of Fajar, a high school teenager who is afraid of being left behind by current trends. Doing a live broadcast to get donations to get the items he wants by following the orders of an unknown account which leads him to regret.

title: Others
overview: Armen lived a life shadowed by deep emotional wounds until he met Fadhil, a friend who offered comfort through meaningful conversations about pain and resilience. However, this solace began to fracture when those around Armen started questioning Fadhil’s existence, blurring the line between reality and the projection of his overwhelming loneliness. As the truth began to unfold, Armen was forced to confront the trauma he had long suppressed, realizing that true healing only begins with the courage to accept reality and seek real support.

title: Kepaten Obor
overview: BETARI came to Cemoro Lawang with mixed feelings when he found out that his biological mother was still alive. He brought his late father's last letter to convey to his mother. There he was caught up in the Kasodo ritual so he had to stay in Bromo until all the Bromo gates were opened. He is trapped and has to try to repair his relationship with his biological mother, whom he has never met in his life, so he has to finish it before he leaves Bromo.

title: Goresan Pena pada Kertas
overview: Putri, a first-year student who is also the daughter of a lecturer at the same university, was bullied by her seniors during the campus orientation period.

title: Sangkar Manusia
overview: A young college man suffers with his unbearable self and family condition.

title: Crown of Glory
overview: Suntiang adalah sebuah Mahkota penghargaan kepada wanita Minangkabau yang telah melaksanakan Ijab Kabul dan telah siap menjadi ibu rumah tangga.

title: A Reunion Of Joy
overview: Menjelang Hari Raya Imlek, Koh Aming yang tinggal sendiri semakin kesepian setelah lama bercarai dengan istrinya di masa lalu, dan harus menghadapi dilema dan gengsi karena anak semata wayangnya semakin sibuk bekerja. Ia yang mengatahui akan meninggal dalam Waktu dekat karena penyakit kanker nya, terpantik untuk merayakan Imlek terakhirnya bersama Acong, namun pertemuan yang dinanti ternyata berubah menjadi pertikaian, Acong yang selama ini memendam semuanya sendiri, melampiaskan semua rasa kesalnya pada malam itu, namun dilain sisi di tengah pertikaian mereka, Acong baru mengetahui penyakit bapaknya dan membuat situasi serba salah untuk keluarga mereka.

title: Arum
overview: An independent photographer then meets his old friend as a client. Between their meetings, conversations arise and feelings are expressed.

title: Folklore
overview: Seorang Penulis Skenario dan Sutradara muda sedang membaca bersama skenario yang akan mereka filmkan. Mereka sepakat untuk mengangkat cerita tentang sifat perilaku manusia namun lupa bahwa mereka juga manusia.

title: Hidup Ini Terlalu Banyak Kamu
overview: An aspiring painter promises to return home from Yogyakarta after his studies and marry a local woman, but a gallery owner tests his commitment.

title: Pantaskah Aku Berhijab
overview: After enduring an abusive relationship and unexpected pregnancy, Sofi starts a journey of self-discovery in search of happiness and inner peace.

title: Hide and Seek
overview: Sari diculik oleh Wewe Gombel ketika Rahman sang kakak lengah mengawasinya yang sedang bermain petak umpet di sebuah rumah tua, kini Rahman berusaha menyelamatkan Sari dengan bantuan teman-temannya.

title: Ms.K Don't Cry
overview: Generally, we know that a kuntilanak often cries and laughs, but we never really understand why. One day, Ms. K, out of boredom, decides to try a dating app and ends up meeting Mr. P. Eventually, they go on a date.

title: Laut Memendam Luka
overview: Saad (16) is a teenage boy who has become the backbone of his family, caring for his younger sister, Asih (10), and his grandmother (60), who has long struggled with mental illness. Growing up without parental figures, he lacks an emotional connection with both his sister and grandmother. However, a tragic event involving Asih forces Saad to confront his own neglect and realize the importance of protecting his family. The film is inspired by a traditional Sundanese song titled Hihid Kabuyutan, which conveys a meaningful moral about mutual care within a family.

title: Saku Rupiah
overview: Dzaky, a careless class treasurer, has a bad habit of keeping money in his pocket — often crumpled, sometimes forgotten. One day, his negligence almost costs the class fund when the money ends up in the washing machine. With guidance from his mother and valuable lessons learned, Dzaky begins to understand the true meaning behind every rupiah. “Saku Rupiah” reminds us to cherish the nation’s symbol of struggle, starting from the smallest act — taking care of it properly.

title: Grooming
overview: The “different” affection from his parents makes a teenager experience attachment to it. When he finds himself at the lowest point of his life, he tries various ways to feel it again.

title: What's For Dinner?
overview: Seorang Ibu dan anak yang sedang menikmati makan malam tanpa Ayah mereka, hal ini membuat sang anak murung, namun, sang Ibu memiliki kejutan untuk anaknya.

title: Sendok & Garpu
overview: Dika, a thoughtful young man in his twenties, is overwhelmed by panic when he realizes that he is trapped in the middle of a crowd. Things that once seemed ordinary have now turned into frightening threats to him.

title: Unknown
overview: tells the story of a nuclear explosion that attacks the earth which will focus on three brothers who flee to the forest to take shelter from the boom boom attacks out there.

title: Midnight Sun
overview: Seorang wanita yang telah menikah selama bertahun-tahun tetapi masih belum melahirkan, dia bergabung dengan sekte untuk melakukan ritual kesuburan dan ditemani oleh anggota sekte yang telah bergabung untuk waktu yang lama

title: After Colossus
overview: In the chaotic aftermath following the collapse of Indonesia’s dictatorship, a team of researchers discovers a forgotten archive revealing a covert operation that manipulated dreams and memories.

title: Cross Road
overview: A crossroads in a village can grant any wish at the expense of the supplicant's most precious possession, binding them to repentance, forgiveness, and sincerity. Alita is trapped in a time loop and must resolve a 30 year old conflict between Budiman, Yahya, and Indah, to be able to return to their time.

title: Joko Soroh
overview: Joko, a village boy who dared to learn the art of Jaranan secretly from his grandfather because he didn't have his mother's blessing. When his secret was finally revealed and sparked a debate, Joko succeeded in proving to his mother that Jaranan wasn't a bad thing, but rather a valuable Indonesian cultural heritage worthy of preservation.

title: Puang Bos
overview: The Pinisi Shipbuilding Family is facing conflict! The sole heir, Dewa Rucci, refuses to continue his father Puang Sinar's shipbuilding business and instead enjoys riding motorcycles with his friends. Meanwhile, the wood from the Na'nasa tree, used as raw material for Pinisi ships, is in crisis. When Dewa Rucci unexpectedly reunites with Pertiwi, his unresolved first love, Puang Sinar, with the help of Yudis and Puang Hari, comes up with ideas to keep the shipbuilding business running smoothly. Moreover, Pertiwi is the heir to the largest Na'nasa tree land in all of Bulukumba.

title: Wanita Ahli Neraka
overview: Seeking to become a wife, a conservative Farah marries Wahab. But terror engulfs her life as she realizes he may not be who he seems.

title: Bila Esok Ibu Tiada
overview: Four adult siblings must set aside their differences after their mother's health declines, but can they come together and be a family again?

title: Geger Perikoloso
overview: The Indonesia political turmoil of 1965 prevents Koesno from pursuing his dreams. His desire to dance clashes with political prejudice against dancers, thrusting him into dangers he cannot comprehend.

title: Suicide Call
overview: A guy who had just returned from work was called by his friend who intended to commit suicide.

title: Aku Ingin Seperti Itu
overview: Bercerita tentang seorang pemuda yang selalu memiliki cita-cita dan ingin menjadi siswa berprestasi. Namun, hal tersebut terhalang oleh dukungan orang tuanya yang tidak mendukung bakatnya.

title: Tumbal Layar
overview: A film editor who must save his film crew from a mysterious cult by following the group's conditions, namely completing their own filmmaking. But he did not know that the cult he was facing was a terrifying cult that he could not trust.

title: Disaat Lengah
overview: Kisah seorang pemuda yang selalu ceroboh dan lalai hingga lupa waktu, karena asyik bermain game online, dan terjadilah sesuatu pada dirinya akibat kelalaian yang dilakukannya

title: Only God Can Judge Me
overview: Mahdi (25), sedang dilanda keraguan atas kepercayaan yang selama ini dia yakini. Perbincangan dan perdebatan teman-teman sepergaulannya membuat Mahdi mempertanyakan kebenarannya. Berbagai sumber informasi ia selami dan membuatnya berubah keyakinan.

title: Tenang, Amara
overview: Amara (17), a girl neglected by her father, develops a relationship with the guidance counselor at her school.

title: Jerat Leluri
overview: Abimanyu (41) and Linda (39) are a couple who have started a new life in a village. The village they have just moved to, is associated with a myth that neither Linda nor Abimanyu believes in. Eventually, they ended up violating this myth. So, what actions did they take due to the disturbances caused by this myth?

title: Dering Semu
overview: Siti Anantri (49) is an abusive mother who wants to make amends for her past mistakes. However, her child is in critical condition. She must express her apologies before her child dies. Will she succeed in gaining forgiveness?

title: ꦮꦫꦶꦱꦤ꧀ꦏꦠ
overview: Kahiyang's journey of homesickness for a sense of emotional closeness to her culture. Nostalgic conversation and shows how Kahiyang contributes to her cultural roots

title: Karsinoma Mama
overview: A young scientist, Peni Ahmadi, finds purpose in blending her love for art and science after losing her mother to breast cancer. Driven by grief and determination, she embarks on a mission to develop a breast cancer cure derived from marine life hoping to bring healing to others across Indonesia.

title: Mencoba Terbang Meski Terikat
overview: On his way to perform in the school’s end-of-semester show, a young boy stops to help a struggling rickshaw driver, risking being late for his big moment. But an unexpected twist on stage turns his small act of kindness into something truly magical.

title: Jakarta dari Mata Seorang Pendosa
overview: Through fictional and non-fictional recordings, we witness small moments in the life of a teenager in Jakarta before their escape.

title: SIE...
overview: Veronika Nona, the only person who remained in the north of Mount Gai, tended and guarded the crops against the various thieves she encountered. Veronika Nona left Mount Gai in her old age. Her successor was her brother, Nong Titus, who left his sick wife, Maria, to live alone in the fields. One time, when Nong Titus returned home to see his wife, the goats in his garden were missing. He had to go around the jungle looking for his lost goat by shouting, “Sie…” as the locals would call a goat.

title: The Other Daughter
overview: unravels the hidden struggles between mothers and daughters across generations.

title: Anak Kolong
overview: Arya refuses to follow his father's expectations, but he falls in love with Amira, the daughter of his father's superior, who shares the same views as his father. On the other hand, he has to compete with Salim, his former rival who is now his friend. So, what will Arya choose to win? His own dreams, his love for Amira, or his friendship with Salim?

title: Santet Segoro Pitu
overview: Sejak ayahnya menemukan sebuah bungkusan misterius dan mendengar suara sekawanan suku pedalaman yang menyeramkan, ARDI dan keluarganya mengalami kejadian aneh. SUCIPTO (ayahnya), MARNI (ibunya), dan ARIF (adik laki-lakinya) satu-persatu jatuh sakit. Ardi dan adik perempuannya, SYIFA meyakini bahwa ini adalah serangan santet dan selanjutnya mereka berdua lah yang akan bernasib sama. Sebuah santet tingkat tinggi dari luar tanah Jawa yang disebut Santet Segoro Pitu.

title: Danyang: Mahar Tukar Nyawa
overview: A young farm worker named Galang falls in love with Resti, who was born into a rich family. As a result, Resti's parents forbade Galang from loving their daughter. Unable to accept that her love was not approved, Galang decided to go to Mount Srandil to seek healing. Over time, Galang's life was filled with wealth, with the condition that Galang must regularly offer sacrifices for his life. One day, Dasmi found out about the place where her daughter-in-law was being offered, and Galang secretly came to her in-laws' house. There, Galang found his in-laws' offering room. Worried about saving Resti, both Galang and Dasmi decided to go to Segoro Sewu to carry out a sacrificial exchange ritual. When they arrived at Segoro Sewu, they accidentally met and had an illicit relationship as a condition for the sacrificial exchange ritual.

title: Hujan Panas
overview: Sunshower portrays the quiet, reflective atmosphere of daily life at the filmmaker grandparents' home through static, unhurried images during his visit in the midst of Indonesia's turbulent presidential election. The title refers to rain falling under blazing midday sun—a phenomenon in Indonesian culture often regarded as an omen or harbinger of misfortune.

title: Ibnu Nurwanto - Sang Kayu
overview: Highlighting the personal life of a wood sculptor Ibnu Nurwanto who has consistently worked for 50 years. Ibnu interprets wood as a bridge for people to contemplate his work. During his difficult times, a little girl came along who became his lantern.

title: The Class
overview: A group of students is haunted by a malicious presence in their classroom, leaving them deeply traumatized.

title: Tutaha Subang
overview: In fast-changing Papua, a mother stammers through fear and uncertainty as industry and fading traditions reshape her world.

title: Penjara Hati
overview: Ariel menyukai Adhira, di lain sisi Adhira juga sudah cukup lama mengagumi Ariel. Namun, di antara keduanya tidak ada yang berani untuk mengungkapkan perasaannya tersebut. Keduanya saling kebingungan dalam menyikapi perasaan satu sama lain. Keadaan seperti ini yang membuat hati mereka terpenjara.  Ketika Ariel sudah memberanikan dirinya untuk mengutarakan perasaannya, Adhira justru menerima hati dari orang lain. Kesal dan tak menerima kenyataan, Ariel mengurung diri di kamarnya sembari menyelesaikan sebuah lagu. Lagu yang mengungkap isi hatinya untuk Adhira.

title: Sirkus Sahaya
overview: Rehan, a street clown, struggles to support his disabled sister, Layla, and becomes entangled in the dark world of human trafficking to make ends meet. Despite the dangers, Rehan remains steadfast in his role as her protector.

title: Cerita Sebelku
overview: From late 2023 to early 2024, Raditya Dika toured Indonesia with My Annoying Story, a show that combines stand-up comedy and audience interaction.

title: Makanlah, Bella..!! 2
overview: Makanlah, Bella..!! Part 2 melanjutkan teror psikologis dari film sebelumnya, membawa penonton semakin jauh ke dalam hubungan kuasa yang kejam antara Martha dan Bella. Hari demi hari berlalu, dan makanan “khusus” yang selama ini diberikan Martha perlahan habis, meninggalkan Bella dalam ketakutan yang semakin nyata.  Saat makanan terakhir disajikan, Martha mengungkap niatnya untuk mengakhiri hidup Bella. Terjebak antara hidup dan mati, Bella dilanda kepanikan dan memohon agar nyawanya diselamatkan. Dalam kondisi putus asa, Bella bersedia menuruti apa pun yang Martha inginkan, selama ia tidak dibunuh.  Namun, permohonan itu justru membuka pintu bagi ide yang jauh lebih kejam. Martha menemukan cara baru untuk mempertahankan kendali, bukan dengan kematian, melainkan dengan perlakuan yang lebih menyakitkan secara psikologis, sesuatu yang tak pernah terbayangkan oleh Bella sepanjang hidupnya.

title: Journal Halloween Edition: Ouija Board
overview: Mey adalah seorang konten kreator yang iseng membeli papan Ouija dari toko online dan menghubungi beberapa roh. Lalu ia mencoba untuk mengontak mendiang ibunya dan awalnya berjalan lancar. Akan tetapi, tiba-tiba berbagai hal aneh dan tidak wajar mulai terjadi. Apakah benar itu ibunya Mey?
A teenage girl who experiences terrible terror in her boarding house after having a nightmare, but it was all in a dream. until then she woke up and experienced the same thing as the nightmare

title: Echoes Of The Unknown
overview: seorang petani yang mencoba mengungkap apa yang ada di balik suara dentuman keras yang mengganggu tidurnya.

title: My Therapist Said, I am Full of Sadness
originalTitle: My Therapist Said, I am Full of Sadness
overview: Monica scours archive material for answers to the question of how queer life in Berlin and the wish to be accepted by their Christian-Indonesian parents can be reconciled.

title: Koma: Berhenti Sebelum Mati
overview: Three teenagers who often create “gimik” content for social media, Karina, Nita, and Ronu, went on an adventure to the Mount Dempo tea plantation area in Pagar Alam, South Sumatra. They intended to create mystery content but polluted a lake in the area. As a result, Kevin's guardian ghost became angry and harmed the three teenagers until they fell into a coma. It was during their coma that they entered another world and the conflict between them just began.

title: Aku Jati, Aku Asperger
overview: Autistic teenager Jati struggles with change when his brother's breakup disrupts their routine — so he tries to find him a new girlfriend.

title: Dosa Musyrik
overview: Pushed by debt to the point of despair, Nugie is forced to take her terminally ill mother to the sakti shaman, Mbah Narto. Seeing Mbah Narto's treasure, Nugie was tempted to get it. But unfortunately, all he got was not money, but the sacred gift of the shaman. Since then, Nugie has had to face the terrible terror of Ni Loro Pati! Not only Nugie experienced terror, but the people around her began to die one by one.

title: A Candy for Bobby
overview: A father who is uncomfortable with the state of his family as he is craving perfection from them.

title: Tunggang langgang
overview: The powerful interventions of the Indonesian artist, cultural studies scholar and filmmaker Timoteus Anggawan Kusno are internationally renowned. What distinguishes them are the empowering attitude and the breathtaking aesthetics he employs to re-interpret in different media the cultural traditions passed on in his homeland. With “Afterlives”, he delivers another unequivocal reckoning with the representations of history shaped by colonial annexation.

title: Saiaku
overview: A girl fears that the repeated knocks on her door are the beginning of a terror that will soon follow her.

title: Ambang Batas
overview: Ginanti’s ride home suddenly turns uncomfortable when her taxi driver starts to talk about his sexist point of view about Ginanti’s way of life. Little do they know, the night has some surprises in store.

title: Abang Pulang
overview: Bayu merupakan seorang mahasiswa yang merantau dari Jawa ke Jakarta. Bayu memiliki keinginan untuk menjadi seorang aktor dan mendapat kesempatan untuk berperan dalam sebuah karya film pendek untuk tugas akhir kakak tingkatnya di kampus. Namun, karya video yang harus Bayu perankan memiliki cerita budaya betawi yang disutradai oleh Bang Romli yang memiliki latar belakang budaya betawi yang kental. Bayu yang memiliki darah Jawa dan bahasa Jawa yang sudah melekat di dirinya, harus melakukan dialog dan beradegan seperti orang Betawi.

title: Koesroyo: The Last Man Standing
overview: A documentary that uncovering untold stories from Yok Koeswoyo & its musical milestone as the members of Koes Bersaudara/Koes Plus.

title: Pembayun
overview: Ayu, who has been living away from home, returns to her hometown to help her mother, Mrs. Kus, prepare the manggar gudeg (a traditional Indonesian dish) for the Kupatan (Indonesian traditional Kupatan) celebration. At a Family Welfare (PKK) meeting, Mrs. Kus proudly offers to cook the manggar gudeg, even though the main ingredient, manggar, is becoming increasingly difficult to find due to climate change. This difficulty sparks a heated debate between Ayu and Mrs. Kus at the market, until they meet Mr. Budi, who ultimately helps them obtain the manggar. Through this emotional journey, Ayu learns about the power of women and the importance of preserving family heritage.

title: Gin Swa
overview: "Gin Swa" (A Gift for My Father) tells the story of Alin, a 22-year-old who saves up to buy a car for his aging father, a dedicated Gin Swa craftsman who continues working despite his declining health. When tragedy strikes, Alin is forced to let go of that dream—only to discover that the traditional craft becomes his way of reconnecting with the love he shared with his late father.

title: Rasulan
overview: Rasulan atau Bersih Desa merupakan salah satu bentuk tradisi perayaan pasca panen yang diselenggarakan oleh masyarakat Jawa di Kabupaten Gunungkidul, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta. Tradisi ini biasanya dilakukan oleh masyarakat sebagai bentuk rasa syukur atas hasil panen hasil pertanian yang melimpah sekaligus untuk merti atau membersihkan desa, mengharapkan keselamatan dan mencegah terjadinya celaka bagi seluruh warga desa.

title: APARAT KEBERSIHAN
overview: Mochamad Rifai, seorang pekerja DLH (Dinas Lingkungan Hidup) Kota Pekalongan, telah bekerja selama lebih dari 20 tahun sebagai pemungut sampah keliling menggunakan truk bersama rekan-rekannya. Meskipun pekerjaannya sering dipandang rendah dan memiliki risiko tinggi (seperti penyakit kulit, flu, dll), dokumenter ini menyoroti dedikasinya.

title: Bersandiwara di Balik Layar
overview: Raka, a child actor, is conflicted to choose whether he should attend a school trip with his friends, or pursue a film job opportunity. His mother then makes the choice for him, with some hesitation from Raka's part.

title: Rugi Dong
overview: A man who wants to get instant money by gambling online, ends up losing and losing everything.

title: Gambuh Tarian Untuk Kekasih Yang Hilang
originalTitle: Gambuh Tarian Untuk Kekasih Yang Hilang
overview: A princess hears about her lover who will marry her step-sister. Heartbroken by the news, she prepares a secret plan to prove her love with the performance of Gambuh before everything is too late.

title: The Silence Of The Scream
overview: Seorang politisi yang diculik oleh seseorang tanpa identitas yang mengoceh tentang aspirasinya kepada politisi tersebut.

title: Tak Pernah Mati
overview: seorang Ibu yang mengenang kejadian  bersama anaknya yang menghilang karena diculik

title: Ignited
overview: Inspired by a true story, Ignited is a film that looks at the domestic life of a family living amidst forest and land fires from the perspective of mothers and wives. Through outpourings and sarcastic jokes, we are shown the point of view of an anonymous woman who chats in her domestic space.

title: If You're Happy, I'm Happy
overview: Hesti feels bored and lonely while caring for her daughter, Safa. They are both alone in a small apartment on the outskirts of Jakarta, because her husband Yudi comes home late due to work commitments. A misunderstanding between the couple leads them to reveal their respective efforts to maintain harmony. Yudi is busy pursuing a promotion to secure the promise of a better family holiday, while Hesti is disappointed that her pleas for family time are perceived as impatience with Yudi.

title: Piknik Bersama Maut
overview: Rudi, a freelance graphic designer, is too absorbed in his career and dies suddenly from exhaustion. When his spirit is reaped by Death, Rudi refuses to sign the documents that consent his departure from this world.

title: Mancing Mayit
overview: To pay off his loan debt, Togog, a casual laborer, is squeezed by circumstances and is forced to fish in a river filled with the remains of bodies that have drifted away. According to myth, fishing at the place of the dead will bring good luck. But unfortunately it wasn't luck that Togog got, it was actually a disaster that he created himself.

title: Sang Pengadil
overview: Jojo, a young judge, returns to his hometown after a series of events disturb his composure. While struggling with the shadows of corruption and the suicide of his father who is also a judge, Jojo finds himself trapped in a human trafficking network. Together with her colleagues, including a new judge named Abigail, she is determined to uphold justice despite having to deal with dark forces that threaten her life and her family.

title: My Annoying Brother
overview: When a gifted athlete loses his sight, his convict brother sees an excuse for early parole. But with their joyful reunion comes tragedy.

title: The Stars Are Falling
overview: When two cats are forced to separate, one moves on in a new relationship, while the other is granted superpowers.

title: Saling Silang Sandal
overview: Adi couldn't find his sandals. In a hurry, he took another pair that looked like his. Putra, Gilang, and Agus does the same thing.

title: Kelas C
overview: A short documentary about the C class in 3rd Semester

title: Topiku
overview: Today is a special day, for Piku to finally receive the respectable hat from his parents. It is a special hat worn by all of his family members through the generations. However, turns out Piku is not strong enough to wear the hat, so he was forced to come up with all ways for him to be able to wear his special hat.

title: Pesta Oligarki
overview: The wait is over. In Oct 20th 2024, Indonesians will have the new president and vice president. The interesting thing is that the new elected vice president is the late president's son.

title: Akibat Internet Bebas
overview: ARA, IAN, and KANA, three admins of a gore shitpost account, must face a serial killer whose victims they have used as meme material.

title: Cahaya Ditanah Rantau
overview: Ibu itu belum siap melepaskan anaknya untuk berangkat dalam sebuah perjalanan. Karena takut sendirian, ia melakukan segala upaya untuk bisa tetap bersama anaknya. Namun akhirnya, ia menyadari bahwa cinta juga berarti melepaskan. Dengan hati yang berat, ia melepaskan anaknya, sambil belajar hidup tanpa bayang-bayang kehadiran anaknya.

title: Dewi
overview: A transfer student named DEWI (17) who has a beautiful face becomes the target of boys at her new school. This makes ANGGI (17), SANTI (16), and RINA (17) feel jealous. The three friends decide to prank DEWI by locking her in the school’s haunted bathroom.

title: Putri Bintang Lima
overview: Stifled by her controlling father, Cempaka gets her first taste of freedom when she falls for Perdana, a kind café manager navigating his own future.

title: Bolehkah Sekali Saja Kumenangis
overview: After her sister leaves home, Tari fights to protect her mother from her father's abuse and joins a support group where she meets a new lifelong friend.

title: Tebusan Dosa
overview: Wening, seorang ibu mengalami kejadian tragis ketika Nirmala, anaknya yang berusia 11 tahun, hilang dalam kecelakaan motor di sebuah jembatan. Kecelakaan itu juga merenggut nyawa Uti Yah, ibunda Wening. Wening merasa sangat berdosa karena membuat ibunya meninggal dan anaknya hanyut di sungai, tapi dia percaya Nirmala masih hidup.
