Tirta, seorang perempuan kreator podcast misteri, berminat memviralkan tragisnya kehidupan Wening, namun bantuannya malah membuat Tirta menyibak rahasia gelap masa lalu Wening yang mengakibatkan hilangnya Nirmala.  Dengan segala upaya dan penuh harapan, Wening mencari Nirmala, termasuk meminta bantuan Tetsuya, peneliti dari Jepang. Wening juga meminta bantuan Mbah Gowa, seorang dukun misterius. Namun, di tengah pencarian, Wening selalu didatangi oleh hantu Uti Yah.  Akankah Wening bersatu lagi dengan Nirmala?

title: Makanlah, Bella..!!

overview: A teenager tried to escape after being held captive in a warehouse by an unknown person.

title: Arit
overview: Paiman and Boni are brothers who are farmers, but it is always Paiman's crops that are harvested from Boni's farm. Suspicious, Paiman wants to find out the secret behind his brother's farm.

title: Living Last Minutes
overview: Tiga orang pengangguran berusaha meraih mimpinya menjadi musisi setelah mendengar kabar bahwa nuklir dari Rusia akan tiba di Indonesia.

title: Three Ways to Remember
overview: Lily and Jay were flying in the Jakarta Capital sky, and decided to talk about how they would die and be remembered. But their conversation came to a halt, because Lily could never answer several of Jay’s questions.

title: Titisan Genderuwo
overview: Bram is a youth who works as a civil servant in a small village. He marries a village girl named Anna but the young couple have not yet been blessed with children. One day, Bram found a pendant belonging to an evil Genderuwo figure, which ultimately brought disaster to Bram and Anna's family.

title: Harta Tahta Raisa
overview: Recording the journey of Raisa, a great Indonesian singer from childhood to her greatest achievements, holding a big concert at Gelora Bung Karno.

title: Saat Menghadap Tuhan
overview: Growing up with a dark past and a simple dream: to make his mother happy, Damar had to 'fight' against himself in order to become a good teenager.

title: Paku Tanah Jawa
overview: Since childhood, Ningrum has had to face the negative views of local residents, because her mother, Handini, was always rumored to have had many men as a condition for marriage. The death of a close friend of Handini's made his family even more cornered by residents. Ningrum's life becomes increasingly uneasy after the man she secretly loves, Jalu, is trapped as Handini's new victim. Ningrum has to fight many supernatural terrors. Ningrum got a clue and asked for help from a Kyai who gave him a powerful spear that could be used to destroy black magic on the face of the earth.

title: Dinda
overview: Dinda and Geri experienced changes in their relationship after a 3-year long-distance relationship. Dinda felt that Geri was keeping too many secrets, making her feel estranged from him. It was at this moment that Arsya arrived, offering a comfortable home for Dinda's lost heart

title: Perempuan Paling Merana
overview: Perempuan Paling Merana mengisahkan kehidupan Saleha, istri seorang pengusaha sukses bernama Amir, yang hidup harmonis bersama keluarga kecilnya. Saleha dikenal sebagai wanita salehah dan aktif di kegiatan sosial, serta disayangi keluarga mertua. Namun, kedatangan Pak De’—anggota keluarga yang lama merantau—membawa kembali bayangan dari masa lalu Saleha, mengguncang ketenangan yang selama ini ia miliki.

title: Para Pencari Syaiton
overview: Empat orang mahasiswa membuat konten horror di kampus mereka saat tengah malam. Alih-alih ketemu hantu, malah mereka kena prank selama membuat konten.  Namun, mereka tidak menyadari hal yang lebih mengerikan sebenarnya sudah terjadi.

title: Megatruh
overview: On their way home, Bayu and Indra experienced a mystical incident that trapped them somewhere. However, in the end they continued their journey in different conditions than before

title: Mawang: Jangan Sebut Namanya
overview: Bangka in 1981. A brother and sister were fighting over a 'pet' known as Mawang. A large, hairy, fanged and sharp-nailed creature. The older brother wants to keep Mawang, so that he can become powerful and wealthy. In the end, the Mawang was locked up by the younger brother in a sacred box. 30 years later, a griup of researcher accidentally finds and opens the sacred box. Mawang escapes and terrorizes them and the surrounding community.

title: Misteri Rumah Tua
overview: Dua bocah pengemis (Siti dan Akmal) berteduh di sebuah rumah seram yang terlihat tidak berpenghuni.  Namun, ternyata rumah tersebut dihuni oleh seorang kecil bernama Nemo.  Nemo mempersilahkan Siti dan Akmal untuk masuk ke dalam rumah. Tak hanya itu, Nemo mengajak mereka berdua makan.  Saat mereka makan, tiba-tiba muncul ibunya Nemo yang terlihat seperti mayat hidup.  Malam pun tiba. Nemo menyarankan mereka untuk menginap. Rumah Nemo memang terpencil.  Berbahaya untuk pulang malam-malam. Lalu kejadian menyeramkan mulai terjadi.

title: Sinema Black Magic
overview: Two filmmakers who always fail to market their films, try to find a way to success by doing black magic in their film production.

title: Journey Through Time by Roftwe Films
originalTitle: Journey Through Time by Roftwe Films
overview: Menceritakan tentang adanya kotak rahasia yang membuat geger satu sekolah

title: Pemanggilan
overview: Two teenagers were lured in by a mysterious piece of paper and somehow, it ended up summoning them into another world.

title: Bakmi Kangen Rasa
overview: Sinta wants to continue the legendary noodle shop her recently deceased adoptive father owned. Still, the biological child of her adoptive father comes from out of town and intends to sell the house and the noodle shop.

title: A Ballad In A Sea Of Rubbish
originalTitle: A Ballad In A Sea Of Rubbish
overview: A husband and wife who live in a sea of rubbish find a stranger’s baby from heaven. They were confused about whether to return the baby to heaven or keep the baby.

title: Retakan Kaca Dirumahku
overview: Retakan Kaca Di Rumahku menceritakan seorang mahasiswa yang menuntut ilmu di perantauan, akan tetapi mahasiswa tersebut terpengaruh dengan hal-hal buruk oleh temannya yang ada di perantauan dan mengabaikan nasehat dari ibunya.

title: Behind, Behind The Scenes: How To Take A Shoot?
originalTitle: Behind, Behind The Scenes: How To Take A Shoot?
overview: As a film director works on his submission for a film festival, the mounting issues during production reveal what truly unfolds behind (the scenes) what we've seen.

title: Kian Santang : Prince of Pajajaran
overview: In the ancient kingdom of Pajajaran, a young prince named Kian Santang rises between legend and history. As betrayal threatens his royal bloodline, he must master both his blade and his heart to defend his people.

title: Rupiah Dari Besi Tua
overview: Some Madurese choose to live outside their homeland, migrating to build a better life. Surabaya has become one of the destination cities for the Madurese people. They work hard, pursuing various professions. some of them are owning a scrap metal business.

title: Temurun
overview: Setelah meninggalnya sang Ibu akibat sebuah kelalaian anak pertama, Dewi (Yasamin Jasem) dan Sena (Bryan Domani) dijemput oleh sang Ayah (Kiki Narendra) untuk tinggal bersama di kota dan mewariskan perusahaan produksi daging milik keluarga. Namun saat tiba disana, keduanya mesti menghadapi segala teror, trauma, serta sosok nenek kandung mereka, Gayatri (Jajang C. Noer), yang mulai menunjukan wujud aslinya.

title: Satu Hari Lagi
overview: Melki yang memiliki hobi videografi ini diajak oleh teman sekelasnya yang bernama Michelle untuk membuat film dokumenter tentang dirinya. Yang mana membuat hubungan asmara antara Michelle dan Melki, hingga membuka alasan di balik motivasi Michelle dalam membuat film tersebut

title: It's Weekend Time: Strolling Around North Jakarta
originalTitle: It's Weekend Time: Strolling Around North Jakarta
overview: Fawwaz and Nanda will take you on an exciting journey to explore the best tourist spots—from cultural landmarks to seaside escapes—in North Jakarta!

title: Taksu Bali: Leak Ugig
overview: Black magic was sent to the Galuh family (Galuh Bilen), the second wife of Ngurah (Ngurah Subakti). As a result, the story of 17 years ago was revealed. Sari (Astrid Ular), Ngurah's first wife, was divorced after all the sacrifices she made, including aborting her unborn child.

title: Bersenandung
overview: A father who is still trapped in feelings from the past, makes him forbid his daughter who wants to have a career like his wife, through an offer from his wife's old producer. His decision to reveal what he felt was a new beginning for them.

title: A Silent Symphony
overview: Pria (35) mengalami rasa duka yang begitu dalam dan merasa bersalah dalam kecelakaan sepuluh tahun yang lalu yang mengakibatkan istrinya yang sedang mengandung meninggal. Di setiap harinya Pria menuangkan emosi lewat lukisan yang sering dia gunakan. Namun, suatu hari Pria kedatangan seorang anak kecil, anak tetangganya bernama Agam (10) yang tidak sengaja menabrak pagar rumah Pria. Dari pertemuannya dengan Agam tersebut, Pria akhirnya menemukan sesuatu yang belum pernah ia temui dalam hidupnya.

title: The Afterlife Club
overview: A stranger walks into a club, he encounters two other strangers and a dungeon master who invites them all to play a sinister Tabletop RPG game.

title: Tanpo Dunung
overview: Rani ingin tahu di mana ayahnya berada. Ia selalu bertanya kepada ibunya, tetapi ibunya tidak menjawab apa yang ditanyakannya. Saat Rani berusia 17 tahun, ia merasa berhak untuk mengenal ayahnya. Namun yang terjadi hanyalah pertengkaran antara ibu dan anak.

title: Sebagai Manusia
overview: A teenager labeled as having a mental disorder by his father. When he has no intention or purpose in life, his friend comes and will change his life completely.

title: The Nun II
overview: Kekuatan Iblis kembali lagi kepermukaan haus akan kekuasaan mengalahkan kekuatan iman, siapakah dia?

title: Ayo Balikan
overview: Selatan reverts to his old ways of life, only needing three days to start dating again. Unbeknownst to him, all the women he dates share a common resemblance to Alma, his former lover. Until he hears the news of Alma's upcoming marriage, which compels him to become determined to win Alma's love back.

title: Rizal dan Nyamuk
overview: Rizal is an insect killer. While he tries to live his life peacefully, the problems around him make him upset. Rizal starts to change. He becomes a different person, someone who wants to do something bad.

title: Malam Pencabut Nyawa
overview: A teenager with the ability to enter other people's dreams. When he witnesses a dark spirit taking people's lives in their dreams, he quickly realizes that it's related to the mysterious deaths that are happening in the real world.

title: Tuhan, Izinkan Aku Berdosa
overview: Kiran, a Muslim woman, loses her faith and falls into promiscuity after a hard-line Islamic organization, meant to strengthen her faith, ends up depriving her of it.

title: Mimpi Buruk Farhan
overview: Farhan wakes up from a strange dream, one that feels more like a nightmare carved out of his past. Deep inside it, shadows from his childhood return in distorted shapes, echoing the pain caused by people who once shattered his innocence.

title: Haribaan
overview: Radit, a middle child who often feels invisible, forms an unlikely bond with Manda, a lonely girl raised by a workaholic father. As they navigate their chaotic yet bittersweet lives, unexpected feelings begin to bloom. However, their growing romance faces a major wall because of a bitter, long-standing feud between their own parents.

title: Bayangan
overview: Ketika seseorang dibutakan oleh imajinasi dan melupakan realita

title: Lovebirds: Ai愛
overview: Sky dan VI-990 adalah dua produk humanoid AI buatan Ai Tech, salah satu perusahaan AI terbesar yang sedang diteliti sebab tragedi "The Blast" yang mengakibatkan sistem operasi mereka terganggu. Mereka berusaha meneliti tentang hal besar apa yang terjadi di antara Sky dan VI-990.

title: Tarian Akhir
overview: On the last day. A man in a robe comes to a field with two masked men accompanying him. Meanwhile, 5 masked female dancers in the field are curious about the man in the robe. And consider him as a savior.

title: Do You See What I See: Cerita Horor #64 - First Love
originalTitle: Do You See What I See: Cerita Horor #64 - First Love
overview: After Mawar falls for her very first boyfriend, her friends' joy turns into suspicion as they realize he may not be who he seems.

title: Behind the Sea
overview: The impact of fishermen regeneration on the coastal areas of the southern coast of Yogyakarta, which is famous for its ferocious waves.

title: Capable : Director's Cut
overview: During the COVID-19 pandemic, classes were held online from each student’s home. Although the students had not yet gotten to know each other well in person, Mahesa felt that his classmates never paid attention to or cared about their school responsibilities. With his determination and abilities, he tried to make his classmates aware of the importance of responsibility in life.

title: KALUT
overview: FIlm ini bercerita tentang perjalanan seorang remaja laki-laki bernama Yosa dalam mengatasi ketakutannya melihat orang-orang di sekelilingnya.

title: Girls
overview: A pair of mother and her daughter, namely mother Erma and her daughter Fiona, whose relationship has been distant. So Fiona came to a party but instead of her burden disappearing, there is a big thing waiting for her at home.

title: JKT48 Magic Hour: The Daydream, The Midnight Thieves, The New Dawn
originalTitle: JKT48 Magic Hour: The Daydream, The Midnight Thieves, The New Dawn
overview: As the lights fade, mysteries unfold. That’s when the 12 apprentices' magical journey begins.

title: Vina: Sebelum 7 Hari
overview: Jenazah Almarhumah Vina (Nayla Purnama) yang ditemukan di flyover Cirebon dianggap mengalami kecelakaan motor tunggal. Nenek Vina (Lydia Kandou) curiga karena tubuh Vina remuk tak wajar namun tak punya cukup bukti untuk menolak berita acara. Vina merasuki tubuh sahabatnya Linda (Gisellma Firmansyah), Ia hanya punya waktu sebelum 7 hari usai kematiannya untuk mengungkap kebenaran yang menyakitkan. Alfatihah.

title: Possession: Kerasukan
overview: A young woman leaves her family for unknown reasons. Her husband, determined to find out the truth, starts following her. He initially suspects that a man is involved, but gradually, discovers more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a simple love affair.

title: The Day The Fly Flies
overview: The death of his child caused by the pandemic demonstration makes a single-father retreat into a bunker and resent humanity. Until a fly comes and convinces him to plan revenge against mankind based on the father's deepest desire.

title: Ocean Cage
overview: You step into "Ocean Cage" as if in a dream. On the island of Lembata, in Indonesia, the village of Lamalera is one of the last places in the world where whales are still hunted. From there, Chinese visual artist Tianzhuo Chen and Indonesian performer Siko Setyanto set out, in a hybrid ceremony where video meets dance, where trance encounters digital imagery, where Siko Setyanto becomes, in turn, divine, human, animist. Tradition and ecology, spirituality and inter-species symbiosis: everything is summoned in this visual, choreographic and sonic whirlwind.

title: Jangan Biarkan Terbuka
overview: Cindy adalah seorang anak yang tidak percaya akan larangan-larangan. Ia menganggap bahwa makhluk-makhluk halus tidaklah nyata. Liburan telah tiba, Cindy memutuskan untuk pergi kerumah kaka k perempuannya, April. Namun, setelah Cindy sampai ke rumah kakaknya, Ia mendapat kabar kalau kakaknya sedang melakukan sebuah proyek. Hal tersebut mengharuskan Cindy untuk tinggal sendirian selama beberapa waktu. Kakak Cindy menitipkan pesan untuk selalu menutup pintu rumah jika waktu magrib sudah tiba. Namun Cindy yang tidak percaya akan hal itu, tidak terlalu menghiraukan pesan dari kakaknya.

title: Fatamorgana
overview: Ratna seorang gadis dari desa yang pergi merantau ke kota untuk melanjutkan pendidikannya. Banyak hal yang asing bagi Ratna selama di perantauan, hingga ia bertemu dengan Rian, yang akan menemani hari-hari Ratna. Bagaimana Ratna akan menjalani kehidupan barunya di kota ini? Bisakah Ratna bertahan disini?

title: Days Together
overview: Hari pertama sebagai mahasiswa adalah waktu yang paling di nanti-nantikan. Salah satunya Arya. Arya menyimpan banyak angan-angan menyenangkan tentang dunia perkuliahan. Namun, semua berjalan sebaliknya. Berbagai rintangan dihadapi oleh Arya, pukulan dan hantaman ia rasakan setiap hari dari senior yang tidak punya hati. Dengan tekanan dan rasa sakit, Arya berpikir untuk keluar dari zona perpeloncoan yang ia rasakan.

title: SALVADOR
overview: A teenage girl who has a high interest in local culture, one day she visited a museum which turned out to be empty. However, because of her efforts and creativity of culture-loving teenager, the museum suddenly turned into the busiest place in just one day.

title: Sekejap Mata
overview: Penantian Ucup tak berjalan mulus setelah mendapat penolakan dari sahabatnya, membuat ia menjadi tak terkendali dalam kegelapan.

title: Mencadin: Dendam Pocong
overview: Wuri's death forced Aryan, Wuri's brother, to return to his hometown in Kulong Parigi. Nara, Wuri's friend and Aryan's girlfriend, accompanied by their two friends Baron and Alin, also joined them. Aryan and his group had to stay in the village for seven days after Wuri's death, in accordance with tradition. These seven days became a terrifying experience. Aryan and the others were haunted by a figure called Mencadin, who resembled Wuri but with a terrifying face. The villagers believed that when someone dies unnaturally, their soul returns in a different form. It is called Mencadin: a ghostly figure with a horrifying face and a strong stench of decay. Mencadin's arrival is believed to be a sign of an unsent message or an unavenged grudge.

title: Menjelang Ajal
overview: Sekar, berusaha menghidupi 3 anaknya sendirian dengan cara membuka warung makan. Akhir-akhir ini ia resah karena dagangannya selalu basi sesaat setelah makanan dihidangkan. Sekar pergi menemui Mak Ambar, Dukun yang memasang 'penglaris' di warungnya. Namun ternyata, Mak Ambar telah meninggal dunia.  Sejak itu, Jin yang selama ini menolongnya menuntut nyawa hingga Sekar kerasukan tiap malam. Ketiga anaknya berusaha untuk mengobati, namun upaya itu malah mengancam nyawa mereka sekeluarga.

title: The Architecture of Love
overview: Raia, a famous writer struggling with writer's block, travels to New York to get inspired. There, she meets River and becomes entangled in a love story haunted by the past.

title: Life in a Fishbowl
overview: Luna Calista seorang influencer cilik, dipaksa membuat konten aneh oleh orang tuanya demi melunasi utang, yang membawa konsekuensi pada kehidupan pribadinya.

title: Imajin[Asih]
overview: Setahun setelah perceraian kedua orang tuanya, Asih menemukan sebuah buku komik karangan-nya yang berisi tentang imajinasinya mengenai harapan keluarganya yang hidup sejahtera dan harmonis.

title: Glenn Fredly: The Movie
overview: Starting from the determination and great desire to create a music concert to embrace peace in Ambon City, Glenn ultimately gave up all his income to hold the concert.

title: Bapak Ini Harus Remidi!
overview: A religious leader trapped in a time looping situation.

title: Linger
overview: In an office, two coworkers are eating together. Until one piece of food is left, both are reluctant to take the last piece and offer it to each other until a conflict arises between them.

title: Last Minute Habit
overview: Saga, a kid tasked to make a film project, procrastinates, a lot. A habit that keeps coming back into his life continues to put him in rock bottom. He has a few ideas on how to embrace it.

title: PENCOERIAN BALIK!
overview: Tiga orang pelajar SMA, Saras "The Mastermind", Cale "The Influence" dan Malaka "The Hack & Driver" merencanakan pencurian balik setelah menemukan artefak dalam video tugasnya di sebuah rumah tua Belanda. Dengan intrik dan rintangan yang tak terduga, mereka harus menghadapi tantangan yang menguji keberanian dan kecerdasan mereka.

title: Nene Pakande
overview: A Bugis folklore film about five children who try to stop the kidnapping terror committed by Nene Pakande.

title: Kesepian
overview: Wahid has been lonely for a long time. One midday, as he slips into another daydream, he suddenly finds himself standing face-to-face with his ex. Her presence feels warm and familiar, like a memory returning to life.

title: Dua Hati Biru
overview: Reunited after years apart, a young couple faces a new chapter of parenthood as they navigate challenges in raising their 4-year-old son together.

title: Beef Soup Ballad
overview: Seorang Anak bernama haki (17) diperintah ibunya ibu dina (30) untuk mengantarkan Soup Sapi kepada tetangga barunya, yang tak disangka-sangka ternyata tetangga barunya itu beragama Hindu.

title: Kembali ke Persimpangan
overview: After his uncle's death, Rudy returned to the intersection where he last met his lover, Maya.

title: Redbells
overview: Janna and Fey are siblings, when Janna moved into her new house she found a bell in her warehouse. When she played the bell, the guardian of the bell was summoned by Janna.

title: Pacar Merah
overview: After a bad omen occurred at Seroja’s engagement ceremony, her family decided to postponed Seroja from getting a henna tatoo. Instead, she is asked to drop off an offering of betel nuts at her grandmother’s.

title: Mukidi
overview: A misunderstanding resulted in Mukidi being accepted to work as a Credit Analyst. He also approves all credit applications to help many people. Unfortunately, that decision resulted in disaster. Together with his wife, Markonah, and his two friends, Samingan and Wakijan, Mukidi must clean up the huge losses he caused.

title: Siksa Kubur
overview: Setelah kedua orang tuanya jadi korban bom bunuh diri Sita jadi tidak percaya agama. Sejak saat itu tujuan hidup Sita hanya satu: mencari orang yang paling berdosa dan ketika orang itu meninggal Sita ingin ikut masuk ke dalam kuburannya untuk membuktikan bahwa siksa kubur tidak ada dan agama tidak nyata. Namun, tentunya ada konsekuensi yang mengerikan bagi mereka yang tak percaya.

title: Sujud Terakhir Bapak
overview: The goodness we cultivate does not need to be shown in words. Sometimes good and bad values ​​always seem biased in a person.

title: Demi Si Buah Hati
overview: The struggle of Dona, a pregnant woman who was diagnosed with kidney failure. Dona had a strong desire to give birth, even though the threat of dialysis and loss of life always loomed over her. Accompanied by Yuda, her husband and Haryati, her mother-in-law, Dona fought hard to realize her dream of giving birth and seeing her child grow up.

title: Bincang-Bincang Simatupang
overview: A grieving comedian was invited to a talk show, hoping to gain support from the audience. However, what follows is far from what he had hoped for.

title: Baju Kurung
overview: In the story "Baju Kurung," Nizam decides to leave his family to find work in the city. Despite his mother and younger brother living in hardship, Nizam believes his departure can change their family's fate. Meanwhile, Azmi, Nizam's younger brother, tries to take on the family's responsibilities. However, an unexpected tragic accident changes everything.

title: Lihatlah
overview: Sebuah perjuangan dan mencari arti dari kegagalan

title: Jarak Sunyi
overview: A deaf boy's tale to find his older sister who was accidentally separated from him on the commuter train.

title: Jamur Merah
overview: A woman loses her grip on reality as she is haunted by the fact that she is the only one who knows exactly what caused her younger sister to commit suicide.

title: Buku Terkutuk
overview: Seorang gadis bernama Rosela yang tiba-tiba mempunyai kekuatan supranatural misterius yang membuat kakaknya terganggu oleh sesosok menakutkan.

title: Ronggeng Kematian
overview: Four friends ensnared in a village, haunted by a ghost because of their sins in the past. They are forced to confront the malevolent specter that hungers for retribution, a horrifying Ronggeng dancer ghost determined to unleash its vengeance upon them.

title: Keluar Main 1994
overview: A high school teenager named Ibo has a dream of becoming a professional soccer player. However, Ibo's dream of becoming a professional footballer did not find support from his parents.

title: Jemparingan
overview: A girl struggles to become an archery championship winner.

title: ROKOK
overview: ROKOK - FILM PENDEK  Film pendek berdurasi 4 menit tentang seorang pemuda yang kecanduan merokok, menghabiskan semua uangnya hingga menghadapi masalah kesehatan seperti batuk terus-menerus dan sayangnya, menemui ajalnya.

title: Jayaprana Layonsari
overview: When the plague attacked the Kalianget area of North Bali, many people became victims. The Regent of the Kalianget Saunggaling kingdom found a small child named Jayaprana and took him to the castle. The adult Jayaprana was ordered by the King to marry immediately. He met a beautiful girl named Sekarsari, the daughter of the village head of Sekar. This meeting was pleasant and they decided to get married. On the day of the wedding, King Kalianget was surprised to see Sekarsari's figure. There is a power that makes him fall in love. A love that cannot be suppressed, drifts into disrupting his work as King, neglecting important royal affairs. Royal officials are looking for a solution. One of the remedies to restore the King's condition was to make Sekarsari his wife.

title: Para Betina Pengikut Iblis 2
overview: A village faces a wave of terror when three women fall prey to demonic forces, becoming deadly instruments of malevolence and revenge.

title: Gagabah: Ucap Laku Lampah
overview: This story tells about the murder case of Viona, a female dancing student at SMAN 5 Kaler, Zara, Dina, and Ghifar as new students in the 2023 school year often received terror from Viona while they were at the LDKS CAMP at the school, what happened their fate?

title: Realita Merajut Cita
overview: The existence of a red and white non-formal school between two nightclubs, creates conflict between the community and teachers who are trying to fight and maintain education there.

title: Kereta
overview: Meeting in an unexpected place with an unexpected situation but ultimately being able to accept each other, Maudy who wants to make peace with herself and Hansi who always wants to be grateful.

title: Dua Surga Dalam Cintaku
overview: Arham has a little friend named Husna in his hometown in Bogor. Even though they secretly love each other, their relationship is revealed, and their love story continues down the aisle. However, Husna had an acute illness, namely brain cancer, and was given a life sentence that would not last long. Arham, with firm determination, promised to accompany Husna until the end of her life. Even though Husna and his family encouraged Arham to continue his education, Arham reluctantly decided to move on and separate from his beloved wife in order to complete his studies. On the other hand, Zilka, a young woman who has fallen into a dark world, tries to migrate to the right path. He needs someone who can be a guide in his new life. Meeting Arham gave Zilka hope, because Arham was considered a figure who could hopefully guide her to a better life.

title: Kurban: Budak Iblis
overview: Dewi and her two children, Bella and Dio, moved into a house that apparently once belonged to Purnomo and Dewi. The late Purnomo left a secret that made his two children suffer. Rama, who lives in front of the house, tries to help Bella and her family, to escape the terror of Aisyah's ghost. A grandmother named Sunarti (Dewi Sri), who knows the secrets kept by the Purnomo family in the past, returns to work as a maid in the house.

title: Kukejar Mimpi
overview: The story of a high school girl named Mimpi who wants to become a cheerleader. She and her friends then struggled to show their existence in the midst of a school situation that likes to fight.

title: Perjuangan Petani Tak Bertanah
overview: Years after getting slowly evicted by a local sugar factory, members of Serikat Petani Indonesia in Indramayu fight for their land rights.

title: DÍVIDA
overview: seorang penghutang yang ditagih oleh penagih hutang

title: Sub-Budaya Menyimpang
overview: Synopsis  Sub Budaya Menyimpang (Sirkus Koboi Absurd) is an experimental absurdist crime short film that explores the hidden world of a deviant subculture operating beyond society's moral boundaries. Through surreal imagery, dark humor, and fragmented storytelling, the film follows Ton*** as he becomes entangled in a bizarre network ruled by a mysterious Faceless Boss and enforced by a ruthless Mafia figure.  Blurring the line between reality and performance, the film presents its criminal underworld as a twisted circus, where violence, loyalty, and identity become theatrical acts. Rather than offering conventional answers, Sub Budaya Menyimpang invites viewers to interpret its symbolism, questioning the nature of power, conformity, and the absurdity of human behavior within marginalized communities.

overview: Tells the story of four friends—Alex, David, Cindy, and Bella—whose bond is strengthened through music. As they prepare to perform at their school music festival, Bella suddenly announces that she will be moving away, putting their friendship and performance at risk.

title: A Nightmare

title: Escape From The Cannibal

title: Behind The Stage
overview: Zain is a Stage Manager who is trusted to manage a show. But on the other hand, Zain is dealing with family problems at home which require him to always be absent from managing the show. On the night of the dress rehearsal, Zain finally arrives to really make the performance a success before it's too late. Unfortunately all the show crew don't trust him anymore, everyone hates Zain without knowing the reason for his absence.

title: Clekontong Mas The Movie - Nyi Rimbit
originalTitle: Clekontong Mas The Movie - Nyi Rimbit
overview: A fertile and prosperous village called Kalidasa, was suddenly hit by an epidemic for no apparent reason. Death continues to periodically attack village residents. It is suspected that this plague was caused by a Leak, a witch-like practitioner of black magic named Nyi Rimbit.  As suspicions mount, the village head assembles a team of 3 loveable dunces to head up an investigation into the mysterious plague to rid the village of evil and restore prosperity once and for all.

title: Diwe: Hutan Larangan
overview: Getting lost in the Forbidden Forest frustrated Intan and her 4 friends and they chose to separate from each other from the group. Their choice to separate actually became a big opportunity for Diwe, the Guardian of Kelekak Namak who was after their Flesh and Blood.  Will they succeed in getting out alive from the terror of the man-eating creatures? What will they choose? Save yourself or save yourself?

title: Trinil: Kembalikan Tubuhku
overview: Returning home after their honeymoon, a couple find themselves haunted by a disembodied head seeking its missing body.

title: Suami Yang Lain
overview: Faced with years of childlessness and relentless family pressure, a desperate couple's failing marriage plunges into complete chaos after a final attempt at reconciliation leads to a dangerous affair with a third party.

title: Kontroversi Konservasi
overview: The story of the issue of influencers who keep protected and unprotected wildlife that have received a lot of criticism from various parties, both from ordinary people and conservationists and people who are involved in the world of wildlife. This documentary film also questions the conservation practices carried out by the influencer and explores the ethics and morals in the world of conservation.

title: Like a Song Without Rhyme
overview: A story about a couple who live their relationship with two different beliefs.

title: Rahasia Sebelum Kematian
overview: Delapan orang di dalam sebuah ruangan berdebat untuk tetap bertahan di dalam atau keluar dengan resiko kematian.  Sebelum menghadapi kematian di luar ruangan tersebut mereka menceritakan rahasia masing-masing.

title: Don(i) Juan
overview: Doni seorang mahasiswa tampan nan flamboyan dituduh sebagai pelaku hilangnya Sarah (pacar Doni)  Setelah kejadian tersebut, muncul Alexa, mahasiswi baru nan cantik di kampus Doni. Insting Don Juan Doni pun terpancing. Hal tersebut membuat Sugi (Dosen Krimonologi) mengawasi hubungan Doni dan Alexa.  Benarkah Doni adalah pelaku hilangnya Sarah?

title: Asri: West Sumatra
overview: Asri adalah sebuah eksplorasi Sumatra Barat, sebuah daerah yang beragam dan kaya sejarah, yang menawarkan pemandangan menakjubkan, tradisi yang semarak, serta kuliner yang menggugah selera, menjadikannya salah satu rahasia terbaik Indonesia.

title: Teman Padang 12
overview: While skipping school to look for beach clams around Padang 12, Fadli lost his friend Ridho. He meets a little girl, Dini, who invites him to play and suggests he should look for clams somewhere else.

title: Meraki Sangkal
overview: Gina unexpectedly suffers visual hallucinations and sees her dead son whilst preparing to move houses. A cop arrives for an investigation and asks her if she knows anything about the neighbors' missing children. Through this new missing persons case, Gina has to confront the memories and reality she had long tried to suppress.

title: KORINCO MUSEUM
overview: Children from Korea, Indonesia, and Colombia introduce their national museums through animation set on the magical island of Korinco.

title: KORINCO GAMES
overview: On the magical island of Korinco, where animals have human souls, a Colombian bear, a Korean tiger, and an Indonesian Komodo dragon seek traditional games from their countries to help the depressed monkey president.

title: City of Oz
overview: City of Oz adalah film horor-sci-fi berbahasa Bengali karya Sadik Ahmed. Ceritanya mengikuti seorang anak bernama Tanju yang tersesat di kota gelap bernama “Oz” dan berjuang menemukan ibunya, sambil menghadapi karakter-karakter menyeramkan yang mengintai di jalanan

title: Saat Lanjut Usia
overview: While picnicking in a flower garden with her two best friends, Yanti (62) learns that their togetherness will soon end because each of them must move to be closer to their children. In the midst of the inevitable separation, Yanti learns to accept change and care for memories through small, touching routines.

title: Cukup Sampai Malam Ini
overview: After two years apart, former lovers Dido (25) and Uca (24) meet again by chance at a cafe. Their reunion happens on an ordinary afternoon, just after Uca finishes shopping for her wedding preparations. Dido offers her a ride home, and what begins as a casual gesture slowly turns into an unexpected emotional journey.  As they drive, laughter fills the silence between them. Memories resurface, and for a brief moment, they forget the distance that time once built. Old feelings quietly rekindle in Dido’s heart, leading him to confess what he has long kept hidden, that he still loves her.  What was once a cheerful reunion becomes heavy with unspoken emotions. Uca, torn between her past and her present, finds herself questioning whether love ever truly ends or simply changes its form.

title: Rolly: A Story of My Father
originalTitle: Rolly: A Story of My Father
overview: At 73, Rolly Wuisan, an Indigenous Minahasan from Sulawesi, has spent over 50 years as a traditional palm wine maker and steward of his land. The film follows Rolly’s daily routines as he walks a considerable distance from his home to climb palm trees up to 50 meters high and search for firewood to distill Captikus (Traditional Palm Wine from Minahasa). Rooted in ancestral knowledge, he believes that nature and humans are close relatives who must protect each other. By planting trees and safeguarding forests and rivers, he ensures the survival of future generations. Rolly: A Story of My Father is a meditative portrait of traditional craftsmanship, resilience, and the vital role of Indigenous wisdom in the fight against climate change.

title: Tau Tau
overview: The story follows a middle-aged man living in a peaceful village. One afternoon, Grandpa relaxes with milk and a cigarette while listening to his old radio. His calm is broken when the news announces a major development project that may bring progress but threaten the village’s natural beauty. The report triggers a vivid daydream: he imagines the hill behind his home, once full of rice fields and green trees, now covered with grand buildings. The scene turns unsettling as the scarecrow begins to move, symbolizing the villagers’ anger and fear of environmental destruction. Nature’s voices grow tense, reflecting the community’s warning. Grandpa wakes up frightened, realizing that the “tau-tau” guardians have long protected the hill. The film reflects the fragility of nature amid modernization and one man’s struggle to preserve his environmental heritage.

title: Kabanti Bula Malino
overview: Lia, a young woman from Buton, rediscovers the manuscripts Kabanti— an oral art inherited from his grandmother, Wa Mia, who was once known as a singer Kabanti. The tradition was nearly extinct, especially since his mother was reluctant to continue it. With the guidance of traditional figures and the support of her friends, Lia tries to understand the deep meaning behind each verse of Kabanti that is full of Islamic teachings and life values. She learned to recite it with feeling and a sense of responsibility for his ancestral heritage. At the peak, Lia performed Kabanti at a campus exhibition. Her melodious voice revived a long-forgotten tradition and touched the hearts of many, becoming a symbol of the revival of Butonese culture in the hands of the younger generation.

title: Thirteen Missing Books
overview: May, 1998. Simon, a university student who loves collecting books, owns thirteen of them. One day, in his small rented room, he is visited by a mysterious young boy, a Book Devourer who seeks to seize all his books. One by one, the boy consumes Simon’s treasured collection, leading Simon into an intense emotional conflict with himself.

title: Dontol
overview: a short film by Tuta

title: Nyat: Perempuan dan Krisis Air di Kintamani
originalTitle: Nyat: Perempuan dan Krisis Air di Kintamani
overview: Kintamani is increasingly swarmed by profit seekers. Amid the rapid development, an old problem remains unresolved.

title: Kembang Eleh
overview: Rusdi and Inayah, two vocational high school students in the bloom of young love, decide to drop out of school and get married.

title: Regret
overview: Xiao Hu, a man of Chinese descent, was praying at his parents' graves to carry out the Qingming Festival, his face filled with sadness and regret for something he had yet to fulfill.

title: Biang Kerok
overview: At a hangout spot, Dimas, Cipet, Jek, and Andre got together to relax and enjoy their time together. However, their cheerful atmosphere was disrupted when one of them (Andre) realized that his favorite lighter was missing. Suspicion began to arise among them, leading to accusations against each other without clear evidence. In this tense atmosphere, they engaged in a sharp and emotional conversation.

title: Ketulah

When he arrived at the queue, Ucup lost his queue coupon. The decisions Ucup makes will take him on a journey that will teach him lessons.

title: Terburjur Kaku
overview: Adam is currently in a period of overthinking, because he feels that communication with his son is getting difficult. That's why Adam tried a picture lottery game to give something special for his son. But one of the rules of the game that Adam must practiced is to finish dream codes, by sleeping on a leaf to visit the dream world.

title: Keep On Running
overview: A professional runner stands at the starting line of a race. She prepares herself to compete, but her mind drifts to the past. She remembers how hard she had to work to become a professional runner.

title: Late Night Paranormal Shenanigans
overview: A group of junior high school reunion crew are gathering at Zaki's house for a grill reherseal, but Abdur is seeking a horror footage near Zaki's house.

title: Abdur's tribute to 2023
overview: A short documentary that contains Abdur's life through the year of 2023.

title: Koridor

title: Kala Akhir Pekan
overview: Prastiwi (23), a pramurukti who works at an elderly home named Kartini (63) who has diabetes and had to have her right leg amputated. However, in her work, Kartini often protests Tiwi's performance for unclear reasons to the point that Tiwi is threatened with being expelled from her job.

title: Yok Shooting Yok
overview: Danny, a young elementary student, is inspired to become a movie director after watching a film that changed his life. Through a long and arduous journey, He chases after that dream with passion. Danny studies in film school, achieves awards, and interns in the film industry. However, things didn't go as smoothly as he imagined. He is faced with seniority, power plays, sexual harrasment, and faces many tough challanges in the industry. However, with great will, Danny succeeds in fulfilling his dream of becoming a famous movie director. However, his time in spotlight is only a brief moment, as Danny dies from overwork and sickness just after he achieves the prime success of his life.

title: Tumbas
overview: Suatu hari Banyu (10) dan Saka (10) secara bersamaan mendapatkan tugas dari ibu mereka masing-masing untuk membeli minyak dan garam. Warung langganan mereka tutup. Banyu dan Saka tidak punya pilihan selain "tumbas" ke warung Mbah Warno (60) yang terkenal galak. Akankah perjalanan "tumbas" Banyu dan Saka akan baik-baik saja?

title: 13 Bom di Jakarta
overview: Badan kontraterorisme harus berpacu melawan waktu demi menghentikan gelombang serangan bom fatal di berbagai penjuru ibu kota Indonesia.

title: Memorium
overview: Seorang mahasiswa baru lulusan homeschooling untuk pertama kalinya  bersosialisasi, mencoba menyembunyikan foto polaroid lamanya untuk mendapatkan  pertemanan.

title: Arkian(Sebelum itu-Setelah itu-Kemudian dari pada itu)

Becoming a member of PASKIBRAKA is the biggest challenge in her life. At the same time, it is the starting point towards her dreams and path of devotion to the nation.

title: Syaitan Munafik
overview: A gang of youngsters try to find a group of their friends who disappeared in a haunted house five years earlier.

title: Layangan Putus: The Movie
overview: Setelah resmi berpisah dari Aris, Kinan memulai perjalanan penemuan jati diri, menghadapi tantangan menjadi single parent sambil melanjutkan perannya sebagai dokter yang berdedikasi. Di sampingnya adalah Raya yang tangguh—mereka pun menjalin kehidupan baru bersama. Ketenangan hidup mereka tiba-tiba terganggu ketika Aris, mantan suami Kinan, kembali bersama Lidya, selingkuhannya, di belakangnya.  Lidya, tidak puas dengan statusnya sebagai kekasih belaka, mendambakan lebih dari Aris. Cita-citanya mencapai puncak tertinggi saat ia menuntut pernikahan, keinginan untuk menjadi ratu di dunia Aris yang penuh gejolak. Menghadapi tawaran tak terduga ini, Aris meminta bimbingan Kinan dengan mengungkapkan keinginan yang masih ada untuk mendapatkan kasih sayang kedua wanita di hidupnya, Kinan dan Lidya.

title: Anahita

title: Hitler Mati di Surabaya
overview: One afternoon, the public was shocked by the news of the discovery of the grave of Adolf Hitler, a Nazi leader, at the Ngagel cemetery, Surabaya. Mitro (40), a grave guard was interviewed by TV journalists regarding the discovery. Mitro answered simply because he didn't know about Hitler. Mitro is considered an artist by his family and neighbors, not a few of whom want to take selfies with Mitro. One day, his wife said that she really wanted to go on holiday. Mitro, whose life is barely possible, is only promising. He then got the idea to create a paid ride at the tomb. Visitors can enter the cloth booths that surround the tomb and take photos with Hitler inside, with Mitro dressed up as Hitler. He then found out who Hitler was via the internet.

title: Trauffea
overview: Iqdun (19), seorang remaja temperamental yang sedang berusaha keluar dari imajinasi surreal yang telah ia ciptakan, namun pikiran tersebut semakin berubah menjadi kenyataan tatkala masa lalunya hadir kembali

title: Hafiz & Friends Recap: This Is Why We Can Have Nice Things
originalTitle: Hafiz & Friends Recap: This Is Why We Can Have Nice Things
overview: The event commences with a montage showcasing Hafiz and his friends' camaraderie and shared experiences. They are seen laughing, playing, and simply cherishing each other's company. Their strong bond and unwavering support for one another are evident. Hafiz takes the stage to deliver a heartfelt speech about the importance of friendship. He recounts how his friends have consistently been there for him, offering unwavering support and guidance throughout his life. He also shares how friendship has empowered him to navigate challenging times.

title: Smart Protector Bardion Director's Cut
overview: An alien military force from disaster-stricken planet Byron must face a monster-supremacist faction from their homeworld or both their homeworld and Earth will face annihilation.

title: Dewa Dewi
overview: The film tells the story of Dewi (Anneth Delliecia), who runs an event planning business, and Dewa (Diza Rafengga), who is both the breadwinner of his family and Dewi’s business partner.  Their friendship was fine at first. Dewa always helped out at the events Dewi organized.  However, one day, their friendship became strained because Dewa—who was supposed to be the clown at a children’s birthday party organized by one of Dewi’s clients—had to leave right as the event was starting to take his sick grandmother to the hospital. Dewi was confused by the incident, especially since Toni (Heru Kurniawan)—Dewi’s boyfriend—asked her to end her working relationship with Dewa, claiming he was unprofessional. However, Dewi refused; on the other hand, she understood that it wasn’t Dewa’s choice. It was Dewi’s stance that angered Toni, causing a rift in their relationship.

title: SELOT

title: Five Minutes of Love

Di dalam ketidaksengajaan, Ratna bertemu dengan seorang pria lanjut usia (Jati, 70 Tahun) di penyebrangan Zebra Cross. Ratna merasa ada yang berbeda dalam rasa yang ada di dalam hatinya. Ratna jatuh suka terhadap Jati. Lalu Ratna membayangkan bagaimana jika Ratna dan Jati hidup bersama.

title: Nak.
overview: Tatang, a systematic and melancholic widower, loses his enthusiasm for his routines when he begins to realize that he needs the presence of Caca, his only daughter in his life.

title: Looking for Europe
overview: Alang (19), seorang pemain Timnas sepak bola Indonesia memutuskan untuk mengikuti seleksi di klub bola Eropa namun ia kemudian menemukan fakta yang mengejutkan. Ketika ia ingin kembali bermain dengan Timnas Indonesia, ia ternyata sudah diganti oleh pemain naturalisasi.

title: Thanks For Today
overview: Reza dan Neisha, 2 remaja dengan latar belakang berbeda dipertemukan di perjalanan dan menghabiskan waktu mereka di Bandung.

title: On Air
overview: Ema, seorang announcer radio kampus, menghadapi skandal ketika video-nya disebarkan oleh pacarnya, Bima, yang ingin berpisah.

title: Delusi Layar
overview: Too exposed to television, Deva is now confused as to whether the reality he believes is real or not.

title: Siksa Neraka
overview: Empat kakak beradik, Saleh, Fajar, Tyas, dan Azizah, sejak kecil telah mendengar kisah-kisah mengenai surga dan neraka. Mereka dididik dengan keras oleh bapak mereka, seorang ustad muda yang terpandang di desa.  Suatu malam, dalam perjalanan menuju desa seberang tanpa sepengetahuan orang tua mereka, Saleh dan adik-adiknya terseret arus sungai yang deras dan menghilang. Saleh kemudian terbangun di alam yang lain, neraka yang selalu dikisahkan bapaknya.  Pencarian dilakukan di dunia untuk menemukan anak-anak bapak, entah hidup atau mati. Satu per satu rahasia terungkap, membuat bapak dan ibu mempertanyakan apakah mereka sudah cukup membekali anak-anaknya. Di neraka, Saleh dan yang lain juga saling mencari, sambil menghadapi siksaan yang kian besar atas dosa-dosa yang selama ini mereka sembunyikan.  Di bioskop 14 Desember 2023.

title: Kapan Hamil?
overview: Two married couples, Alan and Nadya and Athar and Karin, have not been blessed with children after approximately three years of marriage. In an effort to have children, they both undergo IVF program at the Doctor Sanjaya clinic. Alan, who felt himself to be sterile because before marriage he lived a free life but none of his girlfriends could get pregnant by him was very afraid of getting himself checked out, worried that he would find out that he was actually infertile, which would surely make him very embarrassed.

title: Dual Perspektif
overview: A man is sitting at a bar, chatting with a bartender. A young man comes in and sits next to him, shifting the conversation toward the newcomer. Their conversation flows smoothly until they reach a disagreement about politics, which sparks a debate between the two characters.

title: Bangun
overview: A student who wakes up late on the day of his exam.

title: Melaboeh

Pada suatu sore, Minah mendapat kabar bahwa Fajar (15), anak keduanya menghilang di sungai ketika lagi bermain bersama temannya. Minah menggunakan kulit buaya peninggalan almarhum suaminya untuk menemukan anaknya tanpa harus membuat perjanjian itu berlangsung kembali.

title: Tipuan Muslihat

title: Le Parfait
