After a while, Zara started make a distance from Ayra, she's already found a new friends to became Ayra replacement.

title: Cynosure
overview: Theo get in trouble after he thrown away a banana peel accidently, which is became the first step of his campaign ruined.

title: Kronik Puriwicara
overview: Dewi Kirana (P/27), anak kedua dari Raja Puriwicara ke XI (L/58), yang akan bertanding melawan adik kandungnya, Panji Wiratama (L/24), dalam sebuah pemilihan walikota di Kerajaan Puriwicara. Reza Mahardika (L/34), anak pertama raja, akan segera meninggalkan jabatan walikota, karena akan dilantik menjadi Putra Mahkota, dan sedang dipersiapkan untuk menjadi raja selanjutnya. Dewi mendapatkan tekanan dari Panji, yang membuatnya ragu untuk melanjutkan pencalonannya. Raja dan Reza pun juga berbeda pendapat terkait siapa yang pantas menjadi walikota. Apakah Dewi berhasil mengalahkan Panji dalam pemilihan walikota di Puriwicara?

title: Of Other Tomorrows Never Known
overview: Guided by the Minahasa’s influence, this speculative fiction of mystical belief interlaces care and ancestral dialogues, embracing a healing renewal across numinous, material and technological realms.

title: Pipit Dalam Badai
overview: The voice of Miriam de la Croix’s letter covers the life of a botanist and her three children. The letter contains Miriam de la Croix’s compassion for the plight of the Dutch East Indies under European colonial rule, especially the Netherlands. The content of the letter became the background sound in the activities of a botanist in doing modern work and science with her three children that day, where modernity and science in the Indies actually came together with European colonialism.

title: Peta Gula
overview: The Glebagan system was created to force farmers to rotate crops and convert some of their land from basic agricultural commodities to industrial raw materials. This system has changed the face of agriculture and shaped the sugar map in various regions in Indonesia. With psychogeographical documentary approach, the film shows the landscape of the sugar map in a village of Krembung region, tracing step by step the sugarcane plantations that occupy farmers' rice fields. It is an observation of a repeating cycle, interjected with past archival footage of sugarcane and people movements.

title: Kulihat Kau Lihat Dia
overview: A woman looks for traces of surveillance from the urban spaces around her, she uses a camera and takes pictures of things that she thinks are potential surveillance sites, but to understand more about what she is doing, she also positions herself as a surveillance by taking pictures of people, in the middle of her journey, the woman realizes that she is being followed by a man carrying a long lens camera.

title: Salu Dao Tangngana Langi
overview: A network of images drawn from the archive of Torajan videographer, Victor, collide to paint a journal-like portrait of both his community and personal life, its grief and its joy.

title: Rumah Masa Depan
overview: Sukri and Surti had to return to Cibeureum because Sukri's father died. However, after the funeral, Sukri's family could not immediately return to Jakarta, because his mother was involved in a criminal case. Meanwhile, their two children, Bayu and Gerhana, are starting to feel comfortable because they have met extraordinary new friends, Cempaka and Sangaji, go on an adventure to help solve the family's problems in an unexpected way. The sense of family is tested in the face of challenging situations.

title: Malam Para Jahanam
overview: Trapped in a remote village, three friends must survive attacks from a horde of evil spirits over three nights.

title: Rumah Makang
overview: Michelle is the second child and first daughter in a Mongondow family that migrated to Java long ago. After decades of running a family restaurant serving Manado cuisine, her mother announces that she wants to return to the village and pass the restaurant on to one of her children. Michelle, who has led the family most responsibly in keeping with the customs of Mongondow women, learns that her mother intends to give it to Peter, her older brother. As both feel entitled to succeed her, the friction between custom and gender norms leads Michelle to a discovery about her mother's past.

title: Everything Will Not Be Good
overview: Tells the story of two friends who want to understand each other and want to always be there for each other, one day they have a big fight…

title: Basuki and The People He Met
originalTitle: Basuki and The People He Met
overview: Basuki (22) seorang fresh graduate dengan logat  Jawa Semarang  merantau ke kota metropolitan. Lewat online video conversation, ia  mencoba melancarkan Bahasa Indonesianya untuk interview kerja.

title: An Experimental on Color and Frames
originalTitle: An Experimental on Color and Frames
overview: A film director experiment and dreaming about his dream.

title: Mother of the Sea
overview: Mother of the Sea is a short documentary about the struggle of Siti Darwati, a fisherwoman from Demak, Indonesia. Despite having to put her life on the line to make a living, she and her community have had to fight just to get recognition from the government.

title: The Sound From Yesterday
overview: In a coastal city and port, Heri (23), a soundman, records various city ambiences. During the sound capture process, he encounters the voice of his deceased sister, engaging in a one-sided conversation. As they visit a sunken house, his sister disappears, carried away by the sounds of construction.

title: Terror & Shadow
overview: Mitha dan kekasihnya (Adit) pindah ke Jakarta untuk kuliah di kampus yang sama.  Di kampus tersebut Mitha berkenalan dengan seorang pemuda Bernama Rafael.  Hal tersebut membuat Adit cemburu.  Tidak hanya itu, Adit melakukan kekerasan fisik bahkan mau membunuh Mitha.  Namun, apakah itu realita atau hanya halusinasi Mitha?

title: Mama Lihat Awan Jatuh
overview: Mama Laurensia Yame, an Awyu woman, paddles along the Digul River while recollecting her past life. Along the riverbank, the  voices of children fill the air, echoing through a landscape poised on the brink of change. As corporations move to claim land occupied for thousands of years, from the time of their ancestors, the distant strains of Mama Lihat Awan Jatuh sound a heart lending lament, ‘we, the Awyus, don’t know where to go’.

title: Mystery Package
overview: Seorang kakak laki-laki masih berusaha menerima kenyataan setelah kehilangan adiknya secara misterius. Di tengah duka yang belum usai, ia menemukan sebuah paket tanpa nama tergeletak di depan rumahnya. Isi paket tersebut menjadi petunjuk pertama yang membawanya pada serangkaian kejadian ganjil dan penuh tanda tanya. Semakin jauh ia mengikuti jejak yang ada, semakin tipis batas antara harapan dan kenyataan. Mampukah ia menemukan sang adik sebelum semuanya terlambat?

title: Snapshot Fiasco
overview: A model and a photographer, after hours of trying, strive for the perfect shot but face challenges as their high aesthetic standards get in the way.

title: Bagasi
overview: In the middle of the night, a woman drags a huge heavy bag on the street. The content of her bag is a mystery.

title: Gaung Gaung Jemari
overview: seorang wanita bernama LISA, mengalami pembullyan dan penghakiman massa di media sosial hanya karena fisik dia yang tidak dianggap “cantik” untuk konten make up.

title: Pemburu Hibah
overview: Tiga orang filmmaker  Santosa, Bayu, dan Budi ditangkap polisi karena mencurangi judi togel online untuk membuat film. Di tempat interogasi mereka menceritakan proses perjuangan mereka untuk memburu dana hibah.  Dengan aplikasi AI buatan kawan-kawan Anarko, Santosa dan krunya yang gagal mendapat dana hibah kementerian nekat untuk mengakali judi togel online demi mendapatkan uang produksi dan mengikutkan film mereka di festival.  Setelah selesai syuting mereka ditangkap polisi dan dihukum. Dua bulan kemudian, atas usaha editor mereka Asep yang tidak ditangkap, film mereka menang festival.

title: Mermaid And Kingdom Of Smoke
overview: Mermaid And Kingdom Of Smoke adalah teater dari karya penulis Yoan S. Nugraha

title: Semesta
overview: Kinanti lost her direction in life after her child died. One day, Kinanti met a group who promised to return her long-lost happiness. But to get it, Kinanti had to sacrifice something even more valuable.

title: Kudapan Rindu Rasa
overview: After hearing that his father was sick, Gian returns to Singkawang, only to find that Han, his father, has been lying in order to ask him to continue the family Choipan shop. Caught in a clash of egos, Gian chooses to leave again for the city. However, along the way, he realizes something about the question of what it truly means to return home.

title: Buku Hitam 3: The Finale
overview: Satu minggu setelah Ruben berhasil mendapatkan tongkat penyihir putih dan merekrut Lionel, kini mereka harus mempersiapkan sisa bahan untuk ritual terlarang. Dalam prosesnya, Lionel kini juga merekrut Jaka untuk memperbanyak pasukan Hanna. Apakah mereka berhasil mendapatkan seluruh bahan untuk ritual terlarang tanpa tercium oleh musuh mereka, David?

title: Riuh Membisu
overview: A street clown is reunited with his estranged daughter through a wedding invitation, forcing him to confront a past where he was never acknowledged as a father

title: Jalan Prestasi
overview: Kisah 3 pelajar yang bersahabat dan menyukai matematika dan mereka bersaing secara sehat, namun Abraham sering mengalami bullying tanpa alasan yang jelas, Ia memiliki impian untuk berprestasi di sekolah dan masih banyak yang harus ia lalui di masa depan.

title: Luka dan Bisa Kubawa Berlari
overview: A young man sets out on a train journey along a railway route that was previously utilized for transporting sugar in colonial times. While taking a short nap, he encounters an unusual dance and visions from the past, drawing him further into his concealed ancestral memories. As he explores the deserted sugar industry in a dreamlike state, he confronts the spirits, wounds, and venom embodied in his motions.

title: Pohon Yang Tumbuh Jauh Dari Buahnya
originalTitle: Pohon Yang Tumbuh Jauh Dari Buahnya
overview: Jul just got laid off and chose to pursue his old dream. It comes with a price however, as he has to face his daughter’s expectations that she had set for him.

title: Panggonan Wingit
overview: Two sisters travel to Semarang to help manage a mysterious hotel where they encounter a dark secret and a deadly curse.

title: Jatuh Cinta Seperti di Film-Film
overview: Bagus, a screenwriter, reunites with his high school friend and crush, Hana, who is still grieving from the loss of her husband. He wants to convince her to fall in love once again, just like in the movies.

title: Akhir Dari Sebuah Permulaan
overview: Siti (30), a middle-aged woman waiting for his husband did a penance to get a child in a room of their house. During the 40 days of the penance, Siti was not allowed to meet or even see her husband. Every day, Siti had to deliver food for her husband and had to turn away so she didn’t see her husband. On the 40th day, Siti was happy because her husband’s hermitage would finish at 12 o’clock at night. However, after 12 o’clock at night, her husband did not come out of the room.

title: Harga Sebuah Restu
overview: Hadian (male, 25 years old) & Anin (female, 25 years old) are lovers who love each other. One day, Anin reported that she was pregnant with Hadian’s child. Anin forces Hadian to marry her as soon as possible without anyone knowing before her pregnancy gets bigger. To get married, Hadian still does not have proper preparation, until finally he chooses to sell his house and motorbike. At the very least, to cover all wedding expenses temporarily.

title: Memorabilia
overview: Tells the story of a son’s journey named Adrian, to search for his father’s spirit to complete all his life affairs. Adrian is assisted by Dharma a psychic who helps spirits to meet with someone they want to meet before their 40th day of departure. Adrian then meets with a spirit named Karjo who was on the bus looking for his family. Adrian must meet his father before the 40th day of his departure.

title: Bercinta di Udara
overview: Sassi and Lintang are close friends who didn’t meet for a long time. After graduation, Lintang decides to stay at Sassi’s house for college enrollment. They spend the night talking about things that have happened in the past. Sassi memorizes back the story about sexual harassment at school that happened to her. The incident caused Lintang was dropped out from school because she was considered to be spreading false information. Sassi regrets it and hopes that Lintang will fix their friendship from the start again.

title: Nalika Maranehna Ngomongkeun 'Bobogaan' Urang
overview: Putra, a 5 year old boy, is circumcised for the first and last time. One day when Yeni (Putra’s mother) was preparing a party for her child, Putra suddenly fainted and something strange happened to his genitals.

title: Setelah Kita Menangis
overview: Stuck in grief because of the passing of a loved one, Syahrul (48) and Reno (10) became two very strange and different figures. Relationship that used to be warm between the father and son became bland. Syahrul, who must always be strong in order to be an example for his son, even seems to have abandoned his only child. Meanwhile, Reno didn’t want to be seen as weak as a man because he had promised his father not to be a crybaby.

title: Monster
overview: After being abducted and taken to a desolate house, a girl sets out to rescue her friend and escape from their malicious kidnapper.

title: Pecel Plus Plus
overview: Lastri, an erotic masseuse must go home to pay the debt of her father who recently died in form of 500 portions of pecels to the cruel mob boss of the cruel who won’t hesitate to burn her house. This legendary pecel recipe is a forbidden secret that her father has kept until he died. The journey to find her Father’s mysterious pecel recipe leads Lastri to the world full of violence and dark magic that she did not expect before.

title: Yang Kelak akan Retak (Which Eventually Crack)
originalTitle: Yang Kelak akan Retak (Which Eventually Crack)
overview: The film follows the trails of the historical borders as an attempt to retrace and archive the space through some underrated small-scale monument or monument-look-like which span around 500 kilometers through Indonesia.

title: Kelompok Penerbang Roh
overview: After her biological son takes his own life, a mother leaves her new family in Arabia to return to Gunungkidul.

title: Pencatat Rindu Yang Datang di Tengah Malam
originalTitle: Pencatat Rindu Yang Datang di Tengah Malam
overview: Di tengah malam, Yati didatangi tiga aparat: Babinsa Ratib, Kapolsek Ridwan, dan Rohman. Rohman adalah “orang dari Pusat” yang ditugaskan mencatat keterangan Yati atas hilangnya Yatman, suaminya. Sementara Yati yakin, mereka bertiga adalah yang bertanggung jawab atas hilangnya sang suami.

title: Nasida Ria: Sun Stage
overview: Tahun 1975, di sebuah asrama perempuan di Kota Semarang. H. Muhammad Zain (Alm) dan 9 santriwatinya berlatih memainkan alat musik untuk berdakwah, dalam sebuah grub bernama Nasida Ria. Ajaibnya, Nasida Ria menjadi grup kasidah internasional tahun 1980. Saat ini, melalui cara berfikir, cara bersikap dan cara menyikapi era digital yang dilakukan oleh Choliq Zain sebagai manajer, Nasida Ria telah berusia hampir setengah abad lamanya, dengan total 4 kali regenerasi. Sempat mengalami pergolakan dengan label rekaman dan personil yang berpindah grup. Choliq tidak ambil pusing. Ia menyelesaikan semuanya bermodal kesabaran selama hampir tiga tahun. Alih-alih ingin menjadi inspirator dalam musik arus utama, Nasida Ria memilih setia membawakan dakwah melalui musik kasidah dan ingin menjadikan kasidah sebagai bagian dari Nusantara.

title: Yongky's First Heartbeats
overview: Believing a stethoscope holds power, Yongky steals his dad's. It’s broken—until Sri helps him finally hear his own heart.

title: Pamit Ronda
overview: Tupiah, a 42-year-old mother who is pregnant with her fifth child, found herself in a remarkable situation one night. With unwavering determination, Tupiah decided to step out to cover her husband's neighbourhood watch duty, as he was unable to fulfil his responsibilities. She brought along some snacks as a token of appreciation for the watchmen stationed at the guard post. To her surprise, when she arrived at the guard post, she didn't encounter the watchmen but rather other mothers who were came also filling in for their husbands. In that unexpected moment, a strong sisterhood blossomed among them as they collectively confronted a thief. Their empathy, courage, and sense of unity were put to the test.

title: Lullaby
overview: In order to fulfil her dream of becoming a musician, a cat from the countryside named Ocon must face the fears and anxieties of performing in front of the glamorous city animals.

title: The Night Seemed So Wrong
overview: On the night of the orphan's Eid celebration, Aldi and Eka exchanged pranks to fight over compensation money from various parties and even parties who are campaigning.

title: Storyboard Suli
overview: Suli wants to know about the fate of old buildings in her city. After drinking a coffee with eyeballs in it, Suli became even more confident that she could reveal those secrets.

title: Wisisi Nit Meke
overview: Through an encounter between modern technology and the rituals of the people in the central mountainous region of West Papua, Nikolas, Asep, and other youths transformed the local Papuan music Wisisi and Pesek into a popular electronic music offering with a rocking Aster shuffle. From self-distribution mode such as Bluetooth transfer, to YouTube algorithm recommendations, Wisisi is now a contemporary music that is not only loved in West Papua, but also by many in other parts of the world.

title: Remeh Temeh Segumpal Daging
overview: A married couple who are odd workers seek sustenance in the middle of a city where environmental resources are constantly being dredged by the elitist, trapping them in increasingly surreal nightmares. Their efforts are solely for the better future life of their children.

title: Spektakel
overview: Arif, the black sheep in a family who has long been absent from any family gatherings, suddenly arrives at his uncle's celebration in a mysterious mission.

title: Ndogmu & Ndogku
overview: On a dining table, two playful Salted Eggs are scroned by a prideful box of Fried Chicken, igniting a clash between arrogance and humility. What follows is a spirited showdown: one boastful side dish, against the united front of the humble and overlooked.

title: Lebaran dari Hongkong
overview: Yanto takes his son Puput to school and stopped on the way at a small shop, where people put up lottery numbers. Yanto suspects that his motorbike’s license plate number will hit the jackpot. He tries to confirm asking the lottery number prediction to a madman who has lived under a tree for a long time. And it turns out that Yanto’s feelings were right, the madman also agreed that Yanto’s license plate number would come out that night. Without thinking, he bought the lottery number.

title: Peluit Panjang
overview: One day at a stadium, football fans start arriving to watch their beloved team’s match.

title: Shallot Salad
overview: A depressed policeman saw a tragedy that kills hundreds of people.

title: PKI Madiun
overview: PKI Madiun adalah film pendek karya sutradara Nuri Harianti yang menceritakan tentang pemberontakan PKI di madiun pada 1948

title: 172 Hari
overview: A young woman with a troubled past turns to religion as she seeks purpose in life — and a chance at finding true love.

title: Rumah Iblis
overview: The supernatural disturbance in the house he had just lived in came from a painting full of mystery.  What's behind the painting? Will they be free from supernatural interference?

title: Srimulat: Hidup Memang Komedi
overview: After Gepeng's indiscipline, Srimulat's life in the capital suddenly turned upside down. The story of love, career and generations of legendary comedians continues!

title: Nusa Ina
overview: The first Moluccans to arrive in the Netherlands were mostly soldiers serving in the KNIL (Royal Netherlands East Indies Army) and their family members. Their stay in the Netherlands was only expected to be temporary; they hoped to later return to the recently independent Indonesia where they would fight for a free Republic of South Maluku. The Dutch government thwarted their plans for diplomatic reasons, discharging these soldiers from the army. Going back to their Moluccan mother island, Nusa Ina, was no longer an option for them.

title: Pelat Merah
overview: Hearing that her parents were ill in the village, Hermia planned to return home during the upcoming long holiday. However, she had to take her office motorcycle because her own motorcycle was broken. Hermia tried to replace the office's official licence plate with a regular one to avoid getting caught while taking it home.

title: Muspra
overview: Lika is a child who likes to collect toys. She felt dignity when she saw her friend had a new toy.

title: Lamis
overview: Galih is a final-year student who likes to criticize law violations. His chatterbox often annoys the people around him.

title: Ombèn
overview: Seorang freelancer bekerja lembur untuk menyelesaikan proyek besar, tetapi terhambat oleh dirinya yang kecanduan alkohol.

title: Malaikat Tanpa Sayap
overview: The angel whose job is to accompany human repentance before death, fell in love for the first time. Is he willing to give up his immortality for the sake of a love that is said to be eternal?

title: Melukis Luka
overview: Alisa, a team of curators and art dealers who live affluent lives, meets Henry, a painter and member of the Bio Khong Temple in Petak Sembilan who lives in poverty. Alisa tried to offer Henry cooperation regarding painting, but Henry always refused. For Alisa, Henry is full of puzzles that are difficult to solve. Supposedly, all painters want to exhibit and earn money, right?

title: Perjamuan Iblis
overview: Kala and Radit are a husband and wife who live happily and feel perfect with their only child named Bima. One day, this happiness slowly disappeared after they had to go to Radit's old house because their long-lost mother was found to have mysteriously committed suicide in Radit's old house. The death of the grandmother made this family experience a lot of terror by creatures beyond reason in the house. And strangely, all the terror was aimed at their only child, Bima. Kala and Radit decided to leave that place. They thought leaving that place was the best way to save Bima, however, they never thought that it was just the beginning of a series of nightmares that would soon happen, and the dark secret behind their grandmother's death was related to with the rise of a demonic figure.

title: Nur
overview: At an Islamic school in Yogyakarta, all the adult students are transgender. Here, they can live the way they choose to—it’s a stark contrast with the hostile world outside. Despite the threats, they cheerfully go on with their work.

title: Asmo
overview: Devi young mother, who is confused about how to stop her child from being fussy, because her child is prone to illness. Until one day she is visited by a village mother, Umik Suliha, and her assistant, Mbak Lastri. Where they even provide unreasonable solutions. From changing the child's name, to a ritual to exorcise spirits that they say have disturbed the child.

title: Badrun & Loundri
overview: A civil servant taking shelter from the rain in front of a laundry shop. Then, he was given a bag of laundry clothes which he thought belonged to the laundry shop clerk. Unexpectedly, he took the bag containing lots of clothes and ran away and sparked a commotion in the surrounding community.

title: g e n d r u w o
originalTitle: g e n d r u w o
overview: Ambitious student strives for perfection, not knowing the existence of a mathematical ghost.

title: Petra
overview: Marcel, remaja yang kehilangan kakak laki-lakinya yang sering mengajarinya bahasa Inggris, harus berjuang untuk mendapatkan beasiswa. Namun, ternyata kakak laki-lakinya menyembunyikan sesuatu untuk membantu Marcel mengejar mimpinya.

title: The Unsung Heroes
overview: Anatman Films documents the long process behind the success of The Sounds Project, a six-year-old music festival. The Sounds Project was founded by Gerhana Banyu Biru, better known as Ghana. It began in 2015 as a campus and community music festival held every year in Jakarta, and in its sixth year it has grown into a national music festival.

title: Kinanthi
overview: Kamu bisa lebih dari apa yang orang tuamu dapatkan. Namun, apa yang akan kamu dapatkan tidak jauh dari apa yang dari kamu pelajari sebelumnya. Mugi, seorang anak laki-laki yang memiliki cita-cita menjadi seperti sang ayahnya. Namun, sang ibu menentang keras cita-cita Mugi karena sebuah alasan.

title: Aku Rindu
overview: Lailani was called to build a school and teach in a remote village in Larantuka, East Nusa Tenggara, the area where her husband, Banyu, was assigned.

title: Sijjin
overview: Irma falls in love with Galang, her cousin who already has a wife and children. Irma is very obsessed and wants to be the only woman in Galang's life. Irma comes to the shaman to send black magic to Galang's wife. Since then terror and mystical disturbances, possession and death have occurred in Galang's house. However, the threat also targeted Irma herself.

title: PAMOR THE GREATEST
overview: A short documentary about pamor iron and the cultural transformation of blacksmithing. preserved by 3 jewelry craftsmen who make from pamor iron.

title: Tanggal Selamat Tinggal
overview: PUTRI and WILDAN have to abide to a condition set by Wildan's parents if they want their relationship to be approved: Wildan must meet his former lover and first love, TASYA, for the last time on a set date. Knowing how much Wildan had loved Tasya in the past, Putri is worried that Wildan will be defeated by memories and chooses Tasya.

title: Segalanya Adalah Revisi
overview: A wolf who is an animation director, is annoyed that his series was always told to revise continuously by his producer until he is scared to death.

title: THE TIGER DANCING STILL
overview: GONDI (20s) is watching an entertainment show in his village. RUMI (40s), a middle-aged man standing in the center, leads the show with captivating tiger spirit music. Suddenly, a young man writhes and dances like a tiger (possessed). The villagers are instantly delighted and entertained. After the show ends, the villagers disperse. Unaware, RUMI returns home with GONDI following him. The young man who danced like a tiger earlier arrives, and RUMI pays him. RUMI begins to practice again. They are preparing for the next performance.

title: Kultus Iblis
overview: A pair of twins come to a remote village to find out the cause of their father's strange death, but they end up trapped in a dangerous village full of terror.

title: Nona Manis Sayange
overview: Sika, a girl who is in love with her childhood friend named Akram. However, their relationship did not receive the blessing of Sika's father. Until then Akram was challenged to fulfill the very high belis (dowry).

title: Budi Pekerti
overview: A schoolteacher's reputation is at risk when a video of her speaking up against injustice goes viral on the internet and is misinterpreted.

title: Sumpah Serapah Sampah
overview: When Piyungan Waste Disposal Site was closed for two months due to overloaded garbage, the neighboring areas face a messy situation. As waste collection services paused, trash started pilling up everywhere. People didn’t know what to do, so they ended up throwing trash on the streets, rivers, forest, and ocean. In the midst of this turmoil, air pollution spiked due to the practice of burning waste.

title: Non-consensual Dissemination of Intimate Images
overview: Maira, the all known smartest girl in Senior High got her life turned upside down miserably when her nude video got leaked in her school's Instagram account.

title: DUKA
overview: Under the shadow of the gang leader of a legendary hitman organization, four skilled assassins are used to working together as an efficient team. However, everything changes when the leader mysteriously passes away. With the suitcase he inherited containing access to vast amounts of digital assets, the battle for control of the deadly legacy begins. Every move and decision is key to their respective fates. Their killing instincts are tested to the limit.

title: Rindu, Apa Kabar?
overview: Waluyo dan Soeparni tinggal di sebuah desa kecil di pulau Jawa. Mereka mencoba segala yang mereka bisa untuk menemukan putra mereka yang hilang.

title: Insan dan Semestinya
overview: Raja Setya Bumi, a mysterious and greedy nature mafia, searches for a prosperous and happy place to live in the green land and seeks sources of food and clean water to save himself from the destruction of Mother Earth, after feeling the impacts of climate change such as floods and water crises. He becomes enraged and scolds the Queen of Nature because he is hungry, while the Queen of Nature hopes that the trees she cares for will provide him with food. Armed with courage, he depletes the Queen of Nature's food reserves and forces her to find him food and drink that are fit for consumption, so that he is believed to be able to save the Earth and the survival of humanity. The only thing he fears more than hunger and death is being expelled from the Queen of Nature's home.

title: Sekar
overview: A young girl mysteriously awakens from a deep coma, drawn by the eerie sound of a child playing with shadow puppets nearby. Captivated and unsettled, she embarks on a quest to uncover the hidden meaning behind the other child's strange performance.

title: Ngangkot
overview: Iwan, who was in a hurry to get to school for an exam, boarded a crowded minivan with a diverse group of passengers. Suddenly, a pregnant woman's water broke, creating panic among the passengers. They decided to vote on whether to drop off the pregnant woman first, even though some of them, like Iwan, were also in a hurry. As they got stuck in traffic and encountered traffic officers, conflicts and excitement ensued. The question is, can the pregnant woman reach the midwife safely, and will Iwan make it to school on time?

title: Ngidam
overview: Abdul has been tired lately. It turns out that Abdul's wife, Lela, is currently having pregnant cravings called "Ngidam". She craves Betawi cuisine that is becoming rare. Her requests for "selendang mayang" (a traditional Betawi dish) and "nasi ulam" can still be fulfilled. But then, Lela asks for a difficult dish, "sayur babanci" (a specific vegetable dish). For several days, Abdul hasn't been able to find this dish, even though he has been traveling around Jakarta. Their third child is expected to be a boy, the child they've been waiting for after two previous daughters. His mother-in-law often reminds him of the myth that if cravings are not fulfilled, the child might be born with a birthmark. His colleagues then assist him. It turns out that Lela's cravings are not as straightforward as those of a typical pregnant woman.

title: One Big Sumba Family
overview: Martha is the daughter-in-law of MD Raya. Her Husband is the first son of MD Raya's twelfth wife. When Adi, Martha's husband, was studying at the University in Malang, Martha worked for MD Raya while waiting for her husband to come home. In the meantime, MD Raya is waiting for Adi to graduate with hope that he can get back his family's pride that was lost since he's not the head of the village anymore.

title: Rabu Yang Bahagia
overview: A young man who claims to work in an office job must accept the consequences when his lie is discovered by his father who visited him in Jakarta.

title: Mohon Doa Restu
overview: Mel dan Satya, teman kecil yang saling jatuh cinta. Bertemu kembali saat dewasa, meyakinkan mereka untuk menghabiskan masa tua bersama melalui sebuah pernikahan idaman mereka berdua. Namun mimpi indah berubah buruk, ketika Widi dan Ira, ibu dari Mel dan Satya, mulai mengganggu masuk ke rencana-rencana indah dua anaknya itu. Satya berusaha bertahan, tapi Mel ragu. Apakah situasi ini yang benar-benar dia inginkan? Terjebak dengan mertua yang tak beda jauh dengan ibunya? Bagi Mel, apakah Satya laki-laki yang tepat untuk dia?

title: Saranjana: Kota Ghaib
overview: Sebuah band ternama asal Jakarta tengah menggelar konser di Kotabaru, Kalimantan Selatan. Vokalis mereka, Shita (Dinda Azani) menghilang secara misterius. Para personel band lainnya pun berusaha mencari sang vokalis. Setelah mencari dan menemukan informasi, ternyata Shita berada di Saranjana, sebuah kota gaib yang diyakini oleh warga setempat sebagai kota misterius yang modern dan maju. Demi mengembalikan sang vokalis ke dunia nyata, mereka harus berpetualang melewati berbagai kejadian mengerikan dan mistis untuk menemukan portal ke Saranjana.

title: Wakaf
overview: Tells about waqf land which was previously used for misguided things.

title: Wicanten
overview: In a world embracing change, Ajeng distances herself from her Javanese roots. She explores the consequences as she grapples with the clash between tradition and modernity. "Wicanten" is a poignant reflection on the evolving dynamics of language and its profound impact on personal and cultural connections.

title: Alif Pengen Punya Pacar, Yuli Pengen Dibonceng Ngabers
originalTitle: Alif Pengen Punya Pacar, Yuli Pengen Dibonceng Ngabers
overview: Yuli wants to date Alif because she thinks Alif is an idiot. During their first date, Alif's motorbike was confiscated by the leasing officer because it had not been paid off. Yuli is disappointed and no longer interested in Alif.

title: Upheaval
overview: They fight just for the heck of it.

title: Lamaran Berdarah
overview: Siang itu perdebatan berakhir manis antara Puan dan Pria tatkala Pria berjanji pada malam hari saat bulan purnama ia akandatang melamar sang Puan. Malam yang dinanti tiba, makan malam yang seharusnya menjadi makan malam terindah bagi Puantak seindah angan, berakhir berdarah ketika Pria berubah wujud dan menghabisi keluarga dan harapan Puan.

title: Klonphobia
overview: Bercerita tentang makhluk kloning dari dimensi lain yang merupakan kelainan phobia pada salah satu karakter laki-laki dalam film pendek ini. tokoh kembaran kloningnya yang berwujud menakutkan dan terus menghantuinya, dengan wajah yang sama seperti dirinya. walaupun wajah nya sama, wujudnya jauh lebih mengerikan daripada dirinya.

title: Pasinaon
overview: Oma Spinoza is a shaman who specializes in Gypsy black magic combined with ancient magic from Yemen. With all her efforts, this old grandmother defeated her enemies and her family's enemies using the deadly magic of kalakembar. Until Sonny, who was desperate, asked Grandma Spinoza for help. Sonny, assisted by Grandma, managed to harm Herman, who is Mas Ngabehi Akadikoen's grandson-in-law.  Herman is Sonny's rival at medical school, his intelligence threatens Sonny's existence at medical school.  Luckily Herman was handled by Grandfather Marnu at the right time, so that death did not come to him.

title: Bakmiracle
overview: Latief, a noodle shop employee who is disappointed with his father, hopes to have a father figure like his boss, and miraculously his wish comes true after Latief eats noodles using magic chopsticks that he got from a mysterious grandfather.

title: Merangkai Ratna Asmara
overview: Sebuah dokumenter tentang perjalanan Kelas Liarsip (kolektif periset dan arsiparis film) yang menelusuri jejak-jejak keberadaan Ratna Asmara (sutradara perempuan pertama di Indonesia) yang terlupakan, melalui dokumen, reparasi dan digitisasi puing film terakhir yang masih tersisa “dr. Samsi” (1952), hingga mempresentasikannya ke Eye Film Museum di Belanda.

title: Boss With Love
overview: 'Boss With Love' tells the story of Ana who once rejected Aditya just because of his social status. Until Ana becomes Aditya's subordinate, the man takes revenge for his heartache.

title: The Untitled Road
overview: Six days after her father's tragic death after being hit by a police convoy, Asty (24) is still trapped in deep grief and a broken heart. Feeling empty and lost, she asks Teguh (27), an online motorcycle taxi driver, to accompany her on a motorbike through the night. A journey that slowly changes Asty's perspective on separation, loss, and the meaning of presence.

title: Imam Tanpa Makmum
overview: Imam falls in love with Naira, a violinist who owns a shelter for street children. Imam called her "Humaira" like the Prophet Muhammad's nickname for Siti Aisyah. Mamak disapproves of the relationship because Naira works at a nightclub.

title: Indigo
overview: In order to rescue her sister from the clutches of a vengeful ghost, a woman must unlock her latent supernatural abilities and navigate the metaphysical realms.

title: Ketika Kecerdasan Buatan Mengubah Pendidikan
overview: Dzaky and his tech-genius friends think they have found the ultimate shortcut - an AI that can solve anything. But when their trusted teacher turns out to be behind it all, the game of cheating becomes a lesson about truth, trust and consequences.

title: Roh
overview: After her father’s funeral, a young woman wishes to return to her home, but her mother’s insistence keeps her in the house where she was born, paving the way for an unexpected encounter.

title: Layar Sentuh
overview: Baskara, seorang remaja populer di kalangan teman seumurannya dan sangat aktif di media sosial. Dia dikenal sebagai seorang anak yang cukup sporty dan gemar membagikan kegiatannya secara online. Namun, popularitasnya membawa Baskara ke dunia yang penuh dengan komentar dan pesan yang merendahkan, bahkan melecehkan.

title: Eyesight
overview: Vina (21), seorang mahasiswa geografi yang telah kehilangan ayahnya secara  misterius. Pada suatu hari Vina mendatangi kantor dosennya untuk mengurus  beasiswanya. Namun, secara tidak sengaja ia mendengarkan percakapan sang  dosen tentang ayahnya. Karena penasaran yang besar, Vina mengambil buku dosen  tersebut. Ternyata buku itu mengungkap hal aneh tentang sebuah wilayah misterius  di kampusnya.

title: Janin Iblis Neraka
overview: Randika and Ranti, a young couple who now live in the house they just bought. While living in her new house, Ranti often experienced strange dreams in the form of real life clues. He often experiences strange events. Starting from the appearance of a mysterious black cat, the arrival of a shabby man named Galang, to the climax, namely Ranti who is pregnant. However, Randika actually hates the baby Ranti is carrying. The presence of an astral creature who wants to have offspring is assisted by his minions in human form. They work together to disturb Randika and Ranti's harmony. Can Randika and Ranti maintain their household?

title: Surat Cinta Dari Pesantren
overview: Erni realizes there is something off with her "boarding school" daughter after reading the grocery list.

title: Ara, Dika, Raka
overview: Ara, Dika dan Raka have lived as street children since childhood. Their meeting with a vloger began to make them curious about family food which was asked by the vloger. This film wants to tell that family is not only about biologically having a father, mother, child, sibling, and the form of a biological family in general, can these 3 children who are not related by blood not be considered as family.

title: Jangan Bilang Siapa-siapa
overview: Di dalam toilet, Suci tanpa sengaja mendengar sahabat dekatnya membocorkan rahasia kehamilannya.  Tak hanya itu video hubungan intimnya dengan sang pacar pun tersebar di kampus. Hal tersebut memicu Suci untuk melakukan bunuh diri.

title: Sacred Irony
overview: Nabila loves movies. Disturbed by the loud sounds from the movies that Nabila watches, Nabila's mother decide to exorcise her to cast out the film djinn that her mother believes has controlled Nabila's mind.

title: Saya Nikahkan
overview: On a busy night of his daughter's wedding preparations, Subandi asks his son to teach him the process of ijab kabul.

title: Nyanyian Bisu
overview: Guntur confronts his uncle Rahardja, accused of involvement in his brother's execution during the 1965 suppression. As Rahardja denies guilt, they embark on a conservation of truth and redemption, unearthling secrets and confronting consequences to heal their fractured family bond.

title: မျောတလွင့်လွင့်
originalTitle: မျောတလွင့်လွင့်
overview: Two months after fleeing Myanmar and arriving in Paris, Phyo, whose status is uncertain, dreams of romance with another man. He dances freely with a sensual dancer in front of the Pont Neuf bridge, but trauma and desire become a trap.

title: Berpulang
overview: Haufan arrives in his hometown with the feeling of agitated because he has to accept his father’s death while he was on his way to visit his father after a while. Haufan must escort his father to the last resting place by doing the funeral process which is Haufan’s family tradition. In this funeral process, Haufan found out things that he never knew before.

title: Diponegoro 1830
overview: Film Animasi pendek ini adalah kisah perjalanan Pangeran Diponegoro (1785-1855) setelah penangkapannya yang licik di Magelang pada hari Minggu, 28 Maret 1830. la dibawa ke Batavia melalui Semarang, perjalanan diatas laut yang tidak pernah ia lakukan sebelumnya. Lalu selama 26 hari di Balai Kota Batavia (Stadhuis), Sang Pangeran harus menunggu keputusan pemerintah Hindia-Belanda tentang nasibnya sebagai tahanan politik. Film ini berdasarkan catatan Mayor Ajudan De Stuers dan rekannya Kapten Roeps selama perjalanan mengawal Pangeran Diponegoro dari Magelang ke Batavia.

title: The Rootless Bloom
overview: In the midst of their parents' separation, sisters Cindy and Jena are forced to choose between which parent to go with, and consider the consequences of each choice.

title: Nusa Antara
overview: Nusa Antara (The Nusantara) is an animated documentary short film, which records the ideas and dialogues of each director involved (film director, animation director, sound director) related to childhood memories, and/or past memories about what it means to live and live in Indonesia.  Indonesia, an archipelagic country, highlighting illegal logging, romance, COVID-19, and life in the countryside.

title: Pagi Membunuh Bulan
overview: Surya has been trapped in the shadows of his past life or pain for the past five years with a figure named Stephanie. During those five years, Surya's life was never good. He then expressed his feelings of loss towards Stephanie in a book, which was accidentally discovered by another character named Maira.

title: Where the Wild Frangipanis Grow
overview: A personal assistant in a Hindu ashram in Bali is torn between his charismatic Guru and an innocent recruit.

title: 24 Jam Bersama Gaspar
overview: Dengan sisa hidup hanya 24 jam, seorang detektif swasta mengikuti berbagai petunjuk membingungkan untuk menguak misteri hilangnya seorang kawan masa kecilnya.

title: Teori Cakrawala
overview: A young teacher named Cakrawala who will teach in the Jember area. The teacher with a conventional teaching style then met a young man who had graduated from a master's degree. As a result of the conflict between the two, Cakrawala finally finds a different teaching method, so they fall in love with each other.

title: Bangku Kosong: Ujian Terakhir
overview: Dozens of students died gruesomely during the last school exams. It started with one of the students being possessed and harming the others. The devil's power threatens their lives.

title: Bangsatnya Cinta Pertama
overview: Fraya, a pastry chef who comes to the Netherlands for a vacation with her friends, Dara and Tya. There they meet a boy from Indonesia named Elmar who likes Fraya. The situation becomes complicated when Tya turns out to have an interest in Elmar. She then moved away from Fraya as soon as she found out who the boy liked. Not wanting her friendship to be destroyed, Dara tries to solve the problems between Fraya and Tya.

title: 1, 2, 3 Senyum!
overview: Saat ini, sedikit lapangan pekerjaan yang menerima fresh graduate SMA. Abim adalah salah satu anak lelaki yang tengah mengalami hal tersebut.  Hingga akhirnya ia teringat barang peninggalan ayahnya yang bisa ia manfaatkan untuk mencari lapangan pekerjaan sendiri dalam bidang ekonomi kreatif

title: eRror
overview: 'Tak tergantikan' merupakan kata yang tepat untuk menggambarkan pengalaman COP di Sumba yang diadakan pada 13 Juli 2023 sampai 03 Agustus 2023. Tentu tidak mudah menyatukan sejumlah mahasiswa dari Universitas Kristen Petra dengan berbagai universitas dari dalam dan luar negeri, untuk bekerjasama membangun desa yang ada di Sumba. Perbedaan budaya dan kepribadian menjadi suatu tantangan yang perlu dihadapi dengan terus bergandeng tangan. Simak lebih lanjut cerita perjalanan mereka, para peserta COP yang akhirnya menemukan pesan dan kesan istimewa dari Sumba.

title: We Need To End This
overview: A workaholic woman named Dinda (23) is trapped in a toxic age-gap relationship with a college student named Aldo (19). Aldo decides to rekindle with Dinda in many ways but unfortunately, various disturbances in their relationship make them stuck at the intersection.

title: Gumeulis Ratna
overview: Ratna (65) is a widow who is looking for love again because her only child Diah (37) will leave her to pursue her dreams. Ratna is afraid of having to live alone in her old age, so she decides to look for a partner and rushes to hold a proposal event. Ratna also met a bachelor named Rudy (35) who claimed to be a contractor on a tourism project in Jatigede. But unfortunately, Rudy is a fraud who only uses Ratna. Rudy's presence made Ratna's situation worse, but thanks to this incident, Diah and Ratna's bad relationship became better. Ratna finally has to live alone, giving up Diah and trying to be a happy mother by seeing her child happy.

title: Takabur
overview: seorang pelajar yang akan menghadapi ujiannya

title: Coblos Yang Mana
overview: Winda, a commercial sex worker who needs some money for her child's education. Winda decided to borrow a sum of money from one of the village head candidates, with the condition that he must vote for him on election day even though the candidate had a vision and mission that threatened his job. After prioritizing her child's needs and giving up her job, Winda discovered the rottenness of the future village head.

title: Kelas Malam
overview: Nathan, a highschool teen, is trapped in a school. The school has an urban legend about a nun that died a horrible death. Nathan tries his best to escape with this haunting story in mind.

Seorang anak bernama Ferdinand bertemu dengan dirinya sendiri dari Universe lain. Ferdinand dari Universe lain tersebut mengatakan bahwa 14 Februari 2024 bumi akan hancur. Apakah ramalan terbukti benar?

title: Sculpting the Giant
overview: In 1990, a famed Balinese sculptor Nyoman Nuarta promised to build for Bali what would have been the largest copper and brass statue on Earth. He ended up dragging his family along into a 28-year journey ridden with crisis and sacrifice.

title: In The Never Ending Whirl Of A Reel
originalTitle: In The Never Ending Whirl Of A Reel
overview: A researcher is searching for a film directed by a member of LEKRA in the 1960s that have never been found in order to complete his post-graduate thesis. In the midst of the search, he meet a man who helps him to locate the reels.

title: Di Balik Rupa
overview: Pada tahun 1983, mahasiswa seni Subarkah bergabung dalam produksi film Indonesia yang paling kontroversial berjudul “Pengkhianatan Partai Komunis.” Subarkah ditugaskan untuk menangani tata rias mayat para jenderal. Empat puluh tahun kemudian, Subarkah mengenang kembali pengalamannya menggambarkan sejarah yang penuh gejolak ini dalam film.

title: Ludruk Dahulu, Kini, dan Nanti
overview: Para seniwati Ludruk Tobong berjuang keras untuk mempertahankan kesenian yang menghidupinya sejak dahulu. Mereka juga berupaya manghalau stigma negatif dari transpuan melalui media kebudayaan.

title: Ice Cold: Murder, Coffee and Jessica Wongso
originalTitle: Ice Cold: Murder, Coffee and Jessica Wongso
overview: This documentary delves into the unanswered questions surrounding the trial of Jessica Wongso — years after the death of her best friend, Mirna Salihin.

title: Sweet Dreams
overview: Tumultuous events triggered by the death of a Dutch sugar plantation owner who ends up leaving his Indian Ocean island estate to his young illegitimate son - the child of his Indonesian housemaid.

title: Di Ambang Kematian
overview: Nadia, satu-satunya yang selamat dari nasib tragis keluarganya, bergulat dengan ancaman pengorbanan ayahnya saat dia menghadapi kehidupan di ujung tanduk.

title: Segalanya Tentang Melly
overview: Melly has passed away. A couple of months later, Fian, her best friend, is looking back at old pictures. While reminiscing about the old day, Fian realizes that he's starting to forget about Melly. Because of that, Fian is making a documentary for himself and everyone that ever known and loved Melly, so her memory will not be forgotten.

title: Alone
overview: Mengikuti cerita Radit, seorang siswa SMP yang kerap menerima aksi bullying

title: Resep Kebahagiaan
overview: Yuli, a girl who knows nothing about cooking or culinary experience had to take over his late father Soto Betawi restaurant who died from a heart attack, after she discover his passing will, she then had to trace her past and learn how to cook Soto Betawi so she can keep her father business going successful.

title: Proyeksi
overview: When a famous director finds themselves trapped in a difficult situation on the set of their latest film, they behave aggressively and abuse their power due to past trauma experienced by their spouse.

title: We Need More Fans in Summer !
originalTitle: We Need More Fans in Summer !
overview: Suatu hari, Kucing yang kesepian karena selalu ditinggal oleh pemiliknya, bersama Anjing tetangganya bermain bersama di Kamar Losmen milik Kucing. Karena panasnya kota Semarang yang semakin ekstrim, daripada mereka kehilangan bulunya secara perlahan. Mereka pun memesan Kipas Angin secara delivery memakai hp milik majikan kucing sambil memainkan barang-barang di kamar si Kucing yang canggih.

title: Too Far
overview: After finishing her overtime in her office, Keisha went back home. When she starts to relax at her house, she heard something suspicious.

title: Saat Orang Baik (tidak) Diam
overview: The increase in slum areas in urban areas is a social problem that is still difficult to resolve. Through the KOTAKU (City Without Slums) program, collaboration between good people can ultimately create better quality and livable housing.

title: Mananti
overview: Seorang ibu yang merindukan kepulangan anak nya di rantau

title: Hajat
overview: The suffering they have been experiencing takes Tole and Mother on a silent night journey as their last effort to hasten their father’s long-awaited death.

title: Ali yang Terheran-Herman
overview: One day at a Travel office, there were two employees with different personalities, namely Herman, an overly serious employee, and Ali, a more relaxed employee. Due to the difference in age and character, they found it difficult to get close. However, they had similar financial conditions. Herman was worried about his finances because his side business was not going well, while Ali, who lived from paycheck to paycheck, was also worried about not being able to save for his future.

title: Maaf. Terima Kasih
overview: A student who has graduated from a computer science degree, attends a job interview at a company, but his deafness makes him doubtful.

title: Mayflies
overview: Aksara and Nada just got married. But their happiness didn't last long, because a truck hit the car they were traveling in. The false memory disease that Aksara suffers from makes Aurora try hard to restore her husband's memory. Aurora is sad and almost despairs about everything.

title: Tamu Di Tengah Badai
overview: Devi is an 8-year-old child who is thought to have an imaginary friend, but as time goes by the imaginary friend does not go away and causes concern for her mother.

title: Behind the Content
overview: Gilang, an autistic person, was told to beg on social media but slowly started to be found out by his older brother who had been looking for Gilang for years

title: A Film by Asrul
overview: A grandson, Kaleb, wants to give his grandfather, Asrul, a birthday present, a film directed by Asrul. The film tells the story of Asrul's youth and childhood.

title: The Cold of Our Sun
overview: The feud between the people of Jl. Anyer Dalam and PT.KAI has had many impacts, including those experienced by mothers and children. Their experiences, hopes, and struggles to persist in demanding justice are an important part of grassroots culture that needs to be immortalized.

title: Mira Sudah Tidur
overview: Mira seorang perawat yang mencari pengganti suara dengkuran mendiang suaminya untuk mendapatkan kenyamanan tidur

title: Satu Hari Dengan Ibu
overview: A man who is angry with his mother finds himself trapped in a timeloop where he has to repeat his day with his mother.

title: I Saw a Ghost, and It Was Beautiful
originalTitle: I Saw a Ghost, and It Was Beautiful
overview: Miss Eloise, a melancholic property agent, is assigned to manage the vacation of a countryside apartment room due to the sudden disappearance of its last tenant, a blue collar worker at a neighbouring company. However, her whimsical decision to spend the night in the mysteriously abandoned room—fuelled by her desire to flee from her own soporific reality—slowly spirals into a feverish odyssey.

title: Invalidite
overview: The life of a disabled girl suddenly changes when she meets an arrogant man, they form a bond of love that creates new characters in themselves afterwards.

title: Kisah Tanah Jawa: Pocong Gundul
overview: Hao, dengan retrokognisi, menyelamatkan Sari dari murka Pocong Gundul, seorang penyihir jahat dalam bentuk hantu, mempertaruhkan nyawanya untuk menghentikan rencana jahatnya.

title: Romansa di Balik Pagar Akal
overview: Pia and her husband, Adul, are the spouses of former people with mental disorders who are married living in a rehabilitation center. Their love began when they became patients at the rehabilitation center. Their stories are full of struggles, anxiety, hopes and the desire to live like normal human beings in general. Considering there is a lot of bad stigma against people like Pia and Adul as well as people with other mental disorders.

title: BUDDY COP: Pilot
overview: Buddy Cop is mostly a non-narrative series about two slackers who are detectives, Detective Hennessy (Ariobimo) and Detective François (Keanu Acyuta), living their lives like a comedy. Be a witness to the pilot of our series.

title: Adam & Eva
overview: In the mid-90s, God made two strangers bump into each other, but god decide that these two strangers wouldn't be together. In the end, God was wrong.

title: Iya Iya Iya Iya
overview: Mariana and Callista reveal their true feelings for each other in a realistically awkward but cute way.

title: Ada apa dengan Cici?
overview: Film ini menceritakan tentang seseorang yang kecanduan gadgetnya. tanpa disadari gadgetnya pun menimbulkan dampak negatif bagi dirinya dan orang sekitarnya.

title: Burning Blue
overview: Gita, a distraught teenager forced to be a badminton player by her authoritarian father, finds a way out through a strange request she proposed to her boyfriend.

title: Curhatan Arwah Seorang Istri
overview: Broto asks a team of documentary filmmakers to document his marriage life with a Kuntilanak, Marni. Though, there is more to their household life after they revisit Marni on her own.

title: Balek ke Jambi
overview: After going away for eight years, Anggun decides to return home to seek acceptance from her father in her hometown, Jambi.

title: TRASHTALK
overview: An ordinary story about an awesome trashman.

title: Bising
overview: Late at night, unable to find the whereabouts of his father, a desperate young man searches for a release in a motorbike repair shop, where he meets a distraught mechanic who had just lost custody to his son.

title: PUISI BIRU
overview: Bekerja sebagai nelayan untuk menghidupi keluarga kecilnya, UCUP (27 tahun) sudah biasa  mengkonsumsi tangkapan hasil melautnya, sebagai makanan sehari-hari. Hingga suatu hari  terjadilah hal aneh yang menyadarkannya bahwa ternyata yang ia tangkap selama ini adalah  sampah-sampah laut.

title: Kejarlah Janji
overview: Pertiwi, a strong and independent woman who took care of her three children: Adam, Sekar, and Isham until they became adults and left their hometown.  Her husband died after losing the village head election against his rival, Janji Upaya. The children of Pertiwi, who blamed Janji Upaya for their father's death, harbored deep feelings of resentment towards Janji Upaya.

title: Aku Tahu Kapan Kamu Mati: Desa Bunuh Diri
originalTitle: Aku Tahu Kapan Kamu Mati: Desa Bunuh Diri
overview: Dimana Siena mengalami depresi akibat bisa melihat tanda kematian seseorang. Bahkan dalam situasi ini, ia mencoba membantu masyarakat Desa Remetuk yang diselimuti misteri bunuh diri.

title: Jomblo Fi Sabilillah
overview: Ali (30th) belum pernah pacaran dan tidak punya temen dekat perempuan. Babe Hasan (55th) yang khawatir  maraknya isu LGBT cemas,  kalau anak semata wayangnya disorientasi dan tidak tertarik dengan lawan jenis. Ia  memaksa Ali segera menikah dalam waktu satu bulan. Ali yang mengidap venustraphobia dan sering pingsan jika bertemu perempuan cantik, menjadi panik. Ali pun meminta bantuan pada ketiga sahabatnya Anton, Yusuf, dan Imron untuk mencarikan solusi, padahal ketiga sahabat Ali tersebut juga jomblo, alias jomblo fi sabilillah. Atas nama solidaritas, Yusuf  berusaha membujuk Anton dan Imron agar mau membantu Ali dengan berbagai cara untuk menemukan jodohnya. Padahal Yusuf sendiri sedang berjuang mendapatkan pasangan impiannya, seorang gadis manis yang telah ia kagumi dan cintai dalam diam. Lalu, bagaimana akhir nasib Ali, Yusuf, dan sahabatnya? Berhasilkah mereka mengakhiri status jomblo dan menemukan pasangan halal mereka?

title: Pick Me
overview: Perempuan berparas cantik yang selalu ingin menjadi pusat perhatian dan atensi. Memperlakukan banyak lelaki yang mendekatinya sesuka hati. Lalu dihadapkan dengan situasi sulit yang asing baginya.

title: Sawo Matang
overview: In a post-New Order Jakarta, Native Indonesians (Pribumi) are legalized to perform the black magic ritual “Babi Ngepet” to balance their economy against Chinese Indonesians. When Kai, a Chinese Indonesian boy, needs money for university, he asks his best friend Nala, a Pribumi girl, to perform the ritual for him.

title: Sora
overview: High school hothead aspires to become a basketball athlete.

title: The Journey: Angklung Goes to Europe
originalTitle: The Journey: Angklung Goes to Europe
overview: 35 musical beginners went to compete in a prominent folk-competitions in Europe to preserve and promote angklung, an Indonesian heritage. They must succeed otherwise they will ruin the angklung’s reputation. This film is more than a story about Angklung – which by the way was recognised by UNESCO as world’s intangible cultural heritage in 2010. It is about a journey into the unknown for a large group of young people – their first international travel, chaotic schedules, meeting and touching the hearts of people from different cultures. It’s a journey that none of them will ever forget.

title: Penantian
overview: A son wants to continue his studies but is hampered by his parents quarrel. This also made him unable to find peace.

title: Patgulipat
overview: Andine (7) siswi berprestasi yang culas memiliki keinginan untuk mendapatkan sesuatu sesuai dengan keinginannya. Namun, akibat keculasannya, Ia tidak bertanggung jawab atas perbuatannya di kantin kejujuran. Lalu, apakah keinginan Andine dapat tercapai atau justru sebaliknya?

title: GAME
overview: A high school teenager named Nabiel who is already late for school tries to return to his house to pick up the homework he left behind. But it was a trap, Nabiel's childhood friend Mansur. He wants to take revenge on Nabiel for what Nabiel did to him as a child.

title: Hikayat Para Keparat
overview: Chandra eventually married Putri, Mr. Somad's only daughter. As parents, they would want their daughter to get the best match, not with a criminal like Chandra. Mr. Somad and his wife devised a cunning plan to separate Putri and Chandra. They also managed to send Chandra to a prison cell. However, Chandra was not the only one who could not escape from prison. Again, Mr. Somad and Mrs. Romlah used Jeni to help them. So, will their efforts succeed?

title: Air Mata di Ujung Sajadah
overview: Filmnya menceritakan tentang Aqilla (@titi _kamall) yang dibohongi oleh ibunya sendiri, Halimah, bahwa bayinya meninggal. Halimah menyerahkan bayi Aqilla untuk diasuh oleh pasangan Arif (@fedinuril) dan Yumna (@citraciki) yang sudah lama mendambakan seorang anak. Tujuh tahun kemudian, Aqilla mengetahui bahwa anakya, Baskara (@faqih_alaydruss), masih hidup. Agilla berusaha mendapatkan anakya kembali, namun di sisi lain dia tidak tega merenggut kebahagiaan kecil keluarga Arif dan Yumna. Sementara itu Arif dan Yumna juga tidak sanggup kehilangan Baskara, namun mereka juga merasa bersalah telah merebut satu-satunya kebahagiaan Aqilla.

title: Sleep Call
overview: Dina, terjerat dalam utang dan dipaksa untuk bekerja di perusahaan pinjaman ilegal, mencari kedamaian dalam aktivitas 'sleep call' dengan Rama, seorang asing yang karismatik dari situs kencan. Tetapi seiring hubungan adiktif mereka semakin dalam, serangkaian kematian yang tak dapat dijelaskan menghantui dirinya, mengubah kedamaian menjadi obsesi yang mematikan.

title: Orpa
overview: A teenage girl with a tragic life is desperate to run away from her village to continue her education even though she has to go through the ferocity of the Papuan Jungle.

title: Awan Awam Bertiup Menutupi Langit Biru
originalTitle: Awan Awam Bertiup Menutupi Langit Biru
overview: Willy, who is taking part in the Gautama Buddha coloring competition which will be submitted online in the next few days, also wants to go to the temple to ask for blessings. However, after his mother, Fenny, took him to the temple and prayed there for the first time. Willy unexpectedly saw a sight that made him even more confused about who he should worship.

title: A Lion Roaring Quietly
overview: Tells the story of a pocong who rose from his grave 40 days after his death and wanted to convey his feelings to Shafa, a woman he liked when he was still alive. Alongside her feared otherness, Rangda is also conceived as a balancing force for spiritual order, and a powerful matriarchal protector.
