title: Autobiography
overview: A young man is working as a housekeeper in an empty mansion. When its owner returns to start his mayoral election campaign, the young man bonds with him and defends him when his campaign is vandalized, setting off a chain of violence.

title: Balada Si Roy
overview: After the death of his father, Roy moved to Serang with his mother. He is different from most boys and that makes him liked by lots of girls in his school.

title: Starting From A Road Then Comes The Memories
originalTitle: Starting From A Road Then Comes The Memories
overview: Sebuah problematika mahasiswa baru yang harus merasakan keresahannya atas kisah cinta dejavu

title: Di Balik Kemudi
overview: Two delivery drivers face their daily challenges in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic as they ride through the streets of Surabaya.

title: Melius Vivere: Ucup's Ideal Planet
overview: Bermimpi menjadi astronot dan menjelajahi Planet Melius Vivere, Ucup harus kembali ke kehidupan nyatanya sebagai anak dari keluarga miskin.

title: Ibu
overview: Azrul curiga pemuda yang kos di rumahnya adalah seorang pembunuh yang masih buron. Azrul menyampaikan hal tersebut ke ibunya. Namun, ibunya tidak mempercayai kecurigaan Azrul.

title: Worms Zone in Real Life 3
overview: short action comedy about a worm fighting “tournament” with a prize of 1 million rupiah

title: Layar
overview: Marni, 35 years old, a village woman who is very happy because she was accepted to work at the Merapi Theatre.  After just a week of work, cinemas are closed due to the pandemic.  Employees were mowed down, sails had to be lowered.  Cinema for sale.  This is a story about how Marni tries to maintain the only screen in the cinema with all her efforts.

title: The Day Before The Wedding
overview: Clara, a cosplayer in a wedding dress who wants to become a flight attendant, lives in the same house with her best friend Kinan, but has to separate when the two become pregnant from the same man.

title: Anak Titipan Setan
overview: Anak Titipan Setan bercerita tentang Putri (Gisella Anastasia) yang harus kembali ke desanya dari Australia karena keluarganya di desa Meloyo Kidul, Surakarta sedang kena masalah besar. Eyang Susana (Ingrid Widjanarko), Ibu dari Putri memaksa Putri pulang membawa anak laki-lakinya, yang diyakini bisa jadi solusi dari masalah yang dihadapi. Masalah yang mengancam keselamatan seluruh keluarga itu berawal ketika Eyang Susana ikut ritual pesugihan dan mengikat perjanjian dengan iblis Jaran Penoleh. Bagaimana Putri mengungkap misteri keluarga dan menyelesaikan perjanjian dengan Jaran Penoleh menjadi gagasan utama film ini.

title: Hidayah
overview: Di tengah imannya yang goyah, ustadz muda yang mantan narapidana bernama Bahri (Ajil Ditto) berusaha mengubur masa lalunya dengan bekerja di kota. Suatu ketika, sahabat Bahri bernama Hasan (Alif Joerg), datang dari desa untuk meminta tolong kepadanya. Desa kelahiran mereka sedang mengalami gangguan gaib yang mengusik kedamaian. Warga yakin semua itu disebabkan oleh Ratna (Givina) teman lama Bahri dan Hasan. Ratna sakit keras namun tak kunjung menemui ajal, dan mengundang kemunculan suatu makhluk gaib yang meneror desa itu. Setiba di desa, bahaya yang harus dihadapi Bahri ternyata lebih besar dari dugaannya. Ia pun tidak punya pilihan selain meraih kembali hidayah dan memperteguh imannya.

title: Sa Pu Nama Moses
overview: Nina is a vlogger from Jakarta that is currently travelling to Sorong by boat. After a porter offers to help her carry her bags and then disappear, Nina has to find out what happened to the man and her bags.

title: Alena: Anak Ratu Iblis
overview: Hendra and Maya found a small child on the street and they decided to take him back to their house and adopt him. Since adopting the child, they have both fortune and disaster. Who is this kid really?

title: Puisi Cinta Yang Membunuh
overview: Words of poetry spell certain death when a young woman grows increasingly distraught after a string of unusual murders take place.

title: Lato lato
overview: Ketika berry memarahi seorang anak karena bermain lato lato dan anak tersebut membalas dendam..

title: SOERA ING BAJA: Gemuruh Resolusi '45
overview: A description of the events that occurred after the proclamation of Indonesian independence in Surabaya until the national battle of Surabaya occurred. The central government designated November 10 as Heroes' Day and built a Heroes Monument to commemorate this great event.

title: JIA (家)
overview: Aming and Annchi, siblings of Chinese-Indonesian descent, reunites during Chinese New Year after years of separation. Reunion quickly turns to tension when they start to talk about inheritance from their aging mother.

title: KORINCO DESSERT
overview: Korinco, an isolated island, is home to three animal chefs of a famous dessert shop. One day, when a monkey president writes a letter to the chefs asking them to make the best dessert, they ask their children for advice.

title: The Overwoman
overview: The Overwoman reworks the cinematic trope of the femme fatale to explore trans-diasporic identity in a society drifting toward fascism. By subverting Nietzsche’s Übermensch—later appropriated by right-wing ideologies—the film critiques Western exceptionalism and examines how its myths shape and discipline queer existence.

title: China, Beijing, I Love You!
overview: Follow nickel dust and cobalt as they are extracted from the earth and traded along China’s Maritime Silk Road. Drawing on geopolitical research and footage of real labour protests, the film examines how the movement of these raw materials through global supply chains is causing rapid environmental, social, and political consequences.

title: Mlethek
overview: Gogo, Triton, and Nunu skip their Qur’an class to steal and feast on rambutans. While they are enjoying themselves, one of them chokes and accidentally swallows a rambutan seed. Soon after, a sprout begins to grow from their head, gradually turning their body into a tree. They believe this is a curse that must be broken.

title: Sang Penerang Desa
overview: Puni has loved villages since childhood. To her, villages have everything—food resources and beautiful nature. Yet the people who live there cannot always enjoy that wealth. Whenever Puni visits villages in other countries, she studies what makes them prosperous. She believes that villagers can transform the natural resources around them into something more valuable. In this way, Indonesia’s villages can become prosperous.

title: Vova Sanggayu
overview: Adapted from the West Sulawesi folktale "Vova Sanggayu," this animation tells the story of a grandmother's long wait for the return of her only grandchild.

title: Hikayat Lumba Lumba
overview: This film tells the story of an accidental meeting between Bolo and Daeng Rukka while they were both fishing. In the midst of a casual chat, Daeng Rukka tells a strange tale, so strange that Bolo herself doesn't believe it.  But everything changes when Bolo sees a mysterious event that really happens before his eyes.

title: Pertarungan Kongga
overview: Adapted from the legend "The Origin of Mount Mekongga"from Southeast Sulawesi, this animated short film tells the story of Tasahea, a smart and brave young man. He tries to trap a giant bird named Kongga to save his village. The bird has been eating the villagers' livestock for years, and and Tasahea becomes their last hope to end the terror.

title: Kurinrera
overview: Bulan, the wife of a fisherman named Lallo, who lives by the Galesong coast with her mother-in-law, Daeng Ngiji, waiting for her husband’s return from the sea. While enduring loneliness and the burden of being a fisherman’s wife, Bulan forms a forbidden emotional connection with Aldebaran, the young son of her husband’s superior. As gossip and tension rise within the coastal community, Bulan’s inner turmoil pushes her toward rebellion against her fate.

title: Harta Karun Wau
overview: Boy Ode, an intelligent and music-loving orphan, lives with his grandfather, who often tells him stories about the legend of Waode Wau’s Treasure. One day, Boy and his two friends, Cikulu and Ode, steal the Waode Wau heirloom and discover an ancient map leading to the treasure. They are pursued by La Cobra, a ruthless pirate, and end up on Snake Island, home to the cannibalistic Kelor tribe. With the help of a mysterious old man named Aba Gugu, they face many challenges. When La Cobra seizes the treasure chest, its contents have secretly been taken by Cikulu. In the end, Boy and his friends triumphantly recover the real Waode Wau Treasure.

title: Kursi
overview: A pink chair was crushed under a truckload of gravel. It happened on the shoreline. Rumor has it that there was cheating at a village meeting stage involving students and village officials. As a result, the young children, who had become familiar with the chair and a few lines of the sea song, no longer sang it.

title: Osmosia
overview: Sebuah investigasi dan penceritaan ulang karya I Gde Dharna dari perspektif ekologi, menggunakan metode Opera dan teknik vokal Bali eksperimental.

title: After the Flags
overview: Inspired by Arahmaiani’s career spanning ‘Flag Project’; After the Flags stands as a visual poem that invites us to join the open-ended dialogue between our imagination and the messages of hope embedded onto each flag.

title: ReReReverse
overview: Seorang pria berusaha menyelamatkan hubungannya dengan memutar balikkan waktu

title: Akedah
overview: During the 1965 Indonesian anti-communist purge, a pastor promises to secretly baptize a pregnant woman seeking for protection.

title: Superia (Suara Perempuan Indonesia)
overview: Project SUPERIA (Suara Perempuan Indonesia or Voices of Indonesian Women) is a multi-disciplinary artistic storytelling project created to explore the diversity and complexities of Indonesian women’s experiences, through film and theatre production. SUPERIA short film, the first introduction of Project SUPERIA, features 7 women from various professions, ages, ethnicities, and sexuality sharing their experiences and perspectives on bodies, motherhood, relationships, etc. All have very nuanced lives and values, yet face intersecting challenges in facing societal expectations.

title: Sunset at Alverno
overview: Kisah dari mantan penderita kusta yang pernah mengalami perlakuan secara berbeda, ditolak, dibuang, dan stigma itu hingga kini masih melekat di masyarakat. Kini mereka bertahan dan berjuang bekerja sebagai petani sayur-sayuran dan dibantu oleh para suster SFIC

title: Titik Ayam Penghabisan
overview: In the bustling chicken stall of Jakarta, a dispute over the last piece of chicken escalates into a  surreal journey. Three individuals find themselves transported to an expressionistic jail realm,  where a deadly fight unfolds.

title: Yusufputus1 Baru Saja Mengunggah Video
overview: Yusuf, a worker who recently got viral online must find a way to keep his online sensation status afloat.

title: Di Luar Sedang Tidak Aman
overview: A 9 year old child was forced to leave his parents to defend Indonesia's independence. Every day he always hoped that his parents would come home, but that didn't happen.

title: Dandan Ini Jelas Untukku
overview: A never satisfied Woman keep applying makeup while she threatened by a mysterious man.

title: Sunat
overview: Tells the story of a mother named Marni who had to circumcise her child named Yuda in order to get money to fulfill her prestige, but Marni found that the child did not want to be circumcised. Marni tries to get Yuda to be circumcised by promising to buy her son shoes.

title: Eksekusi Jaminan
overview: In 2177, when the Country is destroyed and the Bank controls everything, Guruh, a treasure hunter, meets Anna, a slave whose master is in debt; what they don't know is that the Master is being hunted by the Hitman from the Bank.

title: Notes from Gog Magog
overview: An exploration of the interconnection between ghost stories, tech company culture in South Korea, and the economy of logistics in Indonesia told through a notebook/premake film and dossier of an unmade techno-horror feature-length film set in between port in Jakarta and an unnamed employee assistance programme office in Seoul.

title: Soulmate is a Strange Concept
overview: Nala visits the studio owned by Ranum, a jewelry craftsman, to make couple rings. Nala and Ranum's meeting led them to talk about the concept of a soulmate and an unforgettable encounter.

title: Chicken Awaken
overview: The residents of Suka Kuning Village are disturbed by the arrival of a giant chicken. Only the Robot can handle it.

title: Gue Pengen Lu Nganterin Nih Barang Ngelintasin Waktu Pake Kendaraan Waktu Lu
originalTitle: Gue Pengen Lu Nganterin Nih Barang Ngelintasin Waktu Pake Kendaraan Waktu Lu
overview: The Time Traveler Courier was assigned by his employer to deliver an item. Along the way, unexpected things happened.

title: REWIND INDONESIA 2022
overview: Rewind indonesia, sebuah perayaan kreatifitas generasi muda yang merangkum berbagai macam fenomena dan trend satu tahun terakhir dan disajikan dalam sebuah video yang berisi Kompilasi peristiwa populer di Indonesia baik di dalam maupun luar negeri yang dihadirkan dari kolaborasi para konten kreator  & figure lintas platform tanah air.

title: KKN di Desa Penari: Luwih Dowo, Luwih Medeni
originalTitle: KKN di Desa Penari: Luwih Dowo, Luwih Medeni
overview: A group of students encounter strange and terrifying events during their community service in a remote village. This film is an extended version of 2022's KKN di Desa Penari.

title: Argantara
overview: Young marriage never crossed Arga's mind, Arga don't know what his parents were thinking of, until he was able to marry himself to the son of his father's best friend. Or as a will that must be fulfilled when Arga is eighteen years old.

title: Mula ni Hangoluon (Mulanya Kehidupan)
overview: Legend has it that the Batak people trace their origins to an ancestor named Siraja Batak. From him descended the people we now know as the Batak tribe.  Although there are varying accounts regarding the history of Siraja Batak, the consensus is that he originally settled in the Sianjur Mula-Mula region.  This film is a collaboration between Potret Sumatera, Yutrip Media, and the Indonesian Ministry of Tourism and Creative Economy (Kemenpar/Barekraf) through the 2022 Lensa Creatif Program.

title: Rumah Terpilih: Titipan Benda Ghaib
overview: Rina and Wahyu are building a new house. And it turns out that without them knowing it, their new home stands on the border between the supernatural realm and the human realm.

title: Harmoni Cinta Bhinn Dan Eka
overview: Bhinn (Damara Finch) and Eka (Hana Hanifah) are lovers of different ethnicities and religions. Bhinn is a Malay youth while Eka is a girl of Chinese descent. This film conveys a message about culture and religious harmony (tolerance), in the midst of a pluralistic society in the country of Serumpun Sebalai, Bangka Belitung, which always maintains and respects pluralism. This film, which depicts the diversity and natural beauty of Bangka Belitung, was produced by PT Galuh Prabu Sinema and the press from the Bangka Belitung Online News Agency (KBO Babel), under the auspices of the United Bangka Belitung Media Foundation (YMBBB). This film was adapted to the big screen by the wishes of the people of Bangka Belitung, after the short film Bhinn & Eka was screened in a Pangkalpinang Bessinema city cinema.

title: Cek Toko Sebelah 2
overview: Erwin wants to propose to Natalie, but encounters obstacles due to demands from his prospective in-laws. On the other hand, Koh Afuk urges Yohan and Ayu to have children soon.

title: Tumbal Kanjeng Iblis
overview: After two years of not hearing from her brother who was studying in another city, Tia received constant promptings to look for her brother or that her father, Yusuf, had died. Armed with a photo, Tia's search leads her to a mysterious boarding house near her brother's campus.

title: The Big 4
overview: Seorang detektif wanita bekerja sama dengan empat pembunuh bayaran untuk menyelidiki pembunuhan ayahnya.

title: Gang Buntu
overview: A desperate love song to Jakarta. Nocturnal wanderers lost in the maze of sex and religion, culture and loneliness. East and West fuse in the archetypal search for meaning across the many narratives of existence.

title: Musik Bhumi Sambhara Budhara
overview: Ridho Hafiedz and Marcello Tahitoe's journey in Central Java, took them to Borobudur Temple located on a plateau called the Kedu Plain. The temple, known as the world's library and built since the 8th century AD, captivated the two musicians to witness for themselves the various musical instruments engraved on the temple's reliefs. A real proof that since the beginning of civilization, the archipelago has known music and various other forms of art, including dance.

title: Infidelis
overview: A contemporary retelling of the tragic Greek myth of Orpheus and Eurydice: A maestro who is endowed with superhuman musical skills loses his fiancé before their wedding day. Distraught with grief, he made a deal with death in order to restore her to mortality. Even just for a fleeting moment.

title: Sesaat Sebelum Ku Melangkah
overview: Bagas, seorang anak yang takut petir, bersembunyi dalam lemari saat hujan deras dan tanpa sengaja memasuki sebuah dunia imajiner di mana ia bertemu kembali dengan almarhum ayahnya.

title: Laras Asa
overview: Pak Mujianto seorang difabel yang menjadi driver ojek difabike. Tidak seperti pandangan masyarakat pada umumnya kepada seorang difabel, Pak Mujianto selalu ingin hidup mandiri tanpa belas kasih dari orang lain.  Tidak mudah bagi Pak Mujianto untuk mempertahankan prinsip tersebut. Beliau mengalami banyak diskriminasi dari orang-orang sekitarnya. Meskipun begitu Pak Mujianto tetap menjalani kehidupannya dengan tekun dan semangat pantang menyerah.

title: Cerita Liburan
overview: Ria is a third grade student and she got a writing assignment about her holiday. But, she writes about her story with her mom instead.

title: Ratu Dansa
overview: Two young girls living in different eras, Hana and Hira are brought together by a miracle. The two of them get to know each other, support each other, and try to find each other's answers about their future.

title: Mena Musik Amboina
overview: Ridho Hafiedz, besides being a musician but also a local son, has long wanted to learn more about Ambonese music in a way that he has never done before. Together with Ardhito Pramono, Ridho traveled to various areas in Ambon, such as Hutumury, Amahusu, Batu Merah, to Dusun Tuni, to learn and study various Ambonese musical instruments.

title: RATIH - Behind the Scenes
overview: Delve into five minds behind the captivating dance video RATIH, as the talented crews unveil the intricate choreography, stunning visuals, and the creative process that brought it to life.

title: Aku , Kamu & Kurir Napza
overview: Menceritakan Raihan merupakan kurir barang terlarang , Raihan harus bisa melewati tantangan serta geng sebelah yang mencoba mengambil alih wilayah yang ditugaskan oleh atasan nya.

title: Amatir
overview: Amatir , adalah Film Dokumenter Pendek, proses pembuatan sebuah film oleh sekelompok orang yang masih amatiran, mulai dari proses pra produksi, proses syuting hingga sedikit hiburan oleh pemerannya.

title: Ayo Putus
overview: Selatan memiliki prinsip mendapatkan seorang gadis dan kemudian putus setelah tiga hari berpacaran. Namun prinsip itu goyah ketika dia mengincar Alma. Bisakah Selatan putus dengan Alma?

title: LOMA
overview: Loma, siswi SMP yang ingin mencalonkan diri sebagai ketua dewan penggalang, namun banyak orang yang menghina dan tidak mempercayainya sebab dirinya adalah anak seorang koruptor

title: Nada Nada Penting
overview: As a musician who cares about Nusantara music, Ridho Hafiedz realizes that the wealth of musical instruments in many regions is threatened with extinction and almost lost. Bali, as an island that has long been known for its sustainable arts and culture, is also no exception to facing similar threats. Ridho, together with Yura Yunita, a musician from West Java, took a Nada Nusantara trip to Karangasem, Bali, to trace the trail of a musical instrument that has a long historical record called “penting”.

title: Menjamah Cahaya
overview: Cakra sedang ada diambang antara membunuh dirinya atau bertahan hidup, setelah kegagalannya meraih mimpinya menjadi seorang penyanyi. Ian, sahabatnya, datang untuk menenangkan Cakra. Sempat ditolak, Ian akhirnya berhasil membujuk Cakra. Mereka pun pergi ke tempat dimana mereka biasanya banyak menghabiskan waktu. Tak disangka, perjalanan menuju tempat itu telah membuka apa yang selama ini Ian tak ketahui tentang Cakra. Hingga akhirnya mereka sampai di tempat itu, semua kebenaran yang tabu bagi Ian pun terungkap. Cakra dan Ian sama-sama terlahir kembali. Semua kebenaran yang terungkap itu justru telah memperkuat persahabatan mereka.

title: A Prayer
overview: Indonesia's 1945 Constitution guarantees the independence of every citizen to embrace their religion and to worship according to their beliefs. Is it applied well in current day Indonesia?

title: Renjana
overview: Ditengah pandemi ekonomi keluarga Syakila menjadi hancur yang membuat orang tuanya selalu bertengkar setiap hari. Syakila (P/17) hanya bisa bernyanyi untuk bisa menenangkan pikirannya dan mengunggah videonya di Tiktok. Namun karena video yang ia unggah di Tiktok hidupnya semakin runyam.

title: Humuq: Jangan Tidur Sore
overview: The two girls decided to do their daily prayers in the school, but turns out one of them accidentally fell asleep instead. But when she woke up, she felt uneasy with her friend that's undergoing the prayer without her.

title: Iradat
overview: Izza has to wear hijab to fit in with her friends during Islamic Education class, but her lack of confidence and her boyfriend stand in her way.

title: Bisik-Bisik Sayur
overview: Bu Ria yang dikenal suka menggosip apa saja yang ia ketahui. suatu hari membeli sayur dan mulai menghibah di gerobak sayur tersebut

title: Tidak Ada Lagi Kesempatan Kedua
overview: SAMIN (21) seorang laki-laki pemabuk berharap mendapatkan kesempatan kedua pada hari pengadilan dengan mengajukan banding kepada hakim.

title: Ceng Beng
overview: Kim is a poor Chinese single father who lives in Manado with 2 sons  who had the opportunity to carry out the ritual of invoking ancestral spirits on Ceng Beng Day. This possibility is Kim's last chance.  Kim tries to preserve the tradition and explain the meaning and purpose of the prayer ceremony  of this ancestor to his children and nephews in the remaining time he has. With its simplicity,  Qing Ming is a philosophy he can inherit, not property, money, or objects.

title: Like & Share
overview: Two best friends who create ASMR content together discover a world of personal exploration that leads them both toward harrowing outcomes.

title: Nagih Janji Cinta
overview: Not willing to let the woman he loves be matched with someone else, Bagas promised Ajeng and her family of blue blood descendants to be successful people and could become people who deserve Ajeng in the eyes of her family.

title: Kacamata Kala Nanti
overview: Seorang remaja yang bertafakur merelungi bilik-bilik masa depan. Satu saja pilihan keliru akan mengubah jalan hidupnya. Hidup dan mati ditentukan oleh iktikad pilihannya. Sanggupkah ia?

title: Terra Incognita
overview: In his hypnotic ‘Terra Incognita’, Timoteus Anggawan Kusno questions colonial power and heritage by stretching in the liminality of fiction, history, imagination and memory.

title: Anjing-Anjing Menyerbu Kuburan
overview: A couple tries to dig a freshly buried corpse for its ear. They believe it would bring wealth.

title: Gina
overview: Gina wants to get attention from her busy father through a report of harrasment from one of her schoolteachers.

title: Vania on Lima Street
overview: Young Vania faces her fears and finds courage in tumultuous times when she takes in an injured thief seeking refuge in her family’s traditional Chinese medicinal hall.

title: Soto Ayam
overview: As rising ingredient costs threaten their chicken soto stall, a young girl and her father must find a way to keep it alive.

title: The (memories) We Never Forget
overview: Since Covid-19 struck in 2020 and to be precise in March in Indonesia, it made a big change. Because of Covid-19 too, Hafiz & Friends Recap was also stopped because they couldn't do much activities as usual.

title: Bambang
overview: Candid memories and salacious gossip flow freely as two men deliberate collecting their debt while paying respects at their philandering friend’s funeral.

title: Rumah Paku
overview: A man who lives in the last house standing at a development site contends with the onslaught of destruction.

title: Rencang
overview: Kelereng Doni dirampas oleh komplotan Mamat karena ia bermain di Lapangan kekuasaanya. Doni yang tidak terima menantang Mamat untuk mempertaruhkan seluruh kelerengnya dalam sebuah pertandingan kelereng dan Doni memepertaruhkan kelereng emas andalannya.

title: Sejarah Kisah Kisah yang Musnah
overview: A grandmother decided to become a hermit in the middle of the forest. One day, his children and grandchildren came to visit. The 3.5-year-old granddaughter doesn’t want to go home and wants to stay with his grandmother to live and play in the forest. Day after day they spent together, until finally the granddaughter entered a forbidden area in the forest, making it difficult for her to find her way home. The grandmother failed to find her granddaughter and she decided to continue her meditation. After meeting the forest spirit guard who was carrying out a rite, the granddaughter managed to find her way home by following a puppy who led her to meet her grandmother again. Unfortunately, this time her grandmother never woke up again from samadi.

title: Qorin
overview: Life at a boarding school descends into chaos when a teacher instructs his students to perform a forbidden ritual that summons their doppelgängers.

title: 2045 Apa Ada Cinta
overview: Indonesia 2045. When getting an assignment from the campus, Meara meets a young entrepreneur named, Marshal, the cofounder of Go Green which she is currently promoting. That meeting made Meara fall in love with Marshal, Meara asked for help from Renata, her best friend, who is very attached to technology. Marshal actually wanted Renata, which made Magic Life Ice Cream that he founded grow after several years of being stagnant.

title: Strangers with Memories
overview: Following six different characters in four different stories: Dimas, a rude and selfish employee; Roby, a reckless and awkward nerd; Stefanny, a sweet and friendly Lost and Found clerk; Clara, a nonchalant career woman; Jevi, a gentle but strict train conductor; and Fajar, a caring and dedicated CSOT (Customer Service On Train) who comes from the outskirt of the city. All become interrelated after they each get involved in a mind boggling life-changing event related to the places where they usually board train for their daily activities' needs.

title: Alang-alang
overview: Huda, a fish thief in fish auction, decided to leave his home since his mother passed away in addition to abusive behavior of his alcoholic father. Harsh life in the auction site made Huda want to achieve his dream to catch the golden fish in sea. Sri, a fish collector, is close with Huda and considers the ‘golden fish’ as a myth. However, Huda is becoming more confident that if he were to catch the golden fish, his life would be happier. In the end, Huda must choose whether to survive in the fish auction site with little hope or go to find the golden fish in desperation.

title: Tumbal
overview: A student who fell asleep on campus after studying overtime stumbles upon a mysterious incident.

title: Nisan Tak Terukir
overview: The Petrus incident from 1982 to 1985 during President Soeharto’s leadership left trauma for some people. Pariyo, a middle-aged man who is now grateful that he was given the opportunity to live, experienced dark times while working as a robber and was almost killed. Another thing with Santuso Waluyo, he had to accept the fact that his brother had to be killed after disappearing for several days. He received news when his brother had been buried by local residents.

title: Airani
overview: AIRANI (16) is a teenage prostitute who is pregnant and living alone in a flat. She wants to end her life by committing suicide in her room. However, AIRANI meets DIANDRA (6), a small child whose presence greatly disturbs AIRANI. With his innocence and curiosity as a child, DIANDRA asks many questions about AIRANI’s life and why AIRANI wants to commit suicide while pregnant. The longer DIANDRA is around AIRANI delays her plan to commit suicide. Finally, AIRANI tries to push DIANDRA away

title: Mahkota Yang Terbang Bersama Angin
overview: After failing to get a commercial gig, Tiwi enrolls herself to a kite competition to earn money so she can help her dad.

title: Heirlooms
overview: A woman tries to escape from a wrapped ghost, Pocong, by hiding in a man’s house. Later, she realizes that the man is scarier than the Pocong itself.

title: Teh Tawar Untuk Akong
overview: A mother introduces her husband and child to her disapproving father

title: Toya & Roh Seninya
overview: Setiap seniman harus menjalin hubungan istimewa dengan suatu Roh Seni yang akan membantu dirinya berkarya. Toya menginginkan Roh Seni Batik agar bisa membuat batik yang bagus, tetapi bakat alami Toya ternyata adalah seni... bela diri. Nah lho, bagaimana dong?

title: Stroke
overview: During a pandemic, a father, who had a stroke, felt increasingly useless in front of his family members. His wife and children, who are now forced to do all their household chores due to the pandemic, have to deal with the increasingly unstable emotions of the “head of the household”. The uncomfortable atmosphere at home gets worse when a man who is an old friend of his wife suddenly comes and helps fix a broken water pump.

title: Roda-Roda Nada
overview: Ubay (50 years), a Dangdut musician and owner of a traveling Dangdut cart group in Lenteng Agung of South Jakarta. Together with his wife and dangdut cart member, he wanted to be able to record their songs. A long-held desire and must be realized before their age is getting older. Didiet (53 years) is Ubay’s old friend who is willing to help them to realize their dreams, even though he has only a simple recording device and an old computer. The process of recording was not entirely as well as they expected, many obstacles they faced. But in the name of Dangdut they don’t give up. Their great passion for dangdut music is the main reason for facing it all.

title: Titip Sendal
overview: A community vaccination becomes chaotic before it even starts due to an unfair "placing sandals" queuing system.

title: Made in Madness
overview: An illegal cigarette maker finds a new formula to expand his market in an unhygienic way.

title: Uma de Raffa
overview: In a fishing village, The employees of Uma de Raffa, a nearly bankrupt resort, are getting anxious. However, a visit from the resort investor brings new hope. The situation suddenly gets complicated when said investor instantly dies from a heart attack.

title: Pecel Kronikel
overview: On a deserted beach, Urip, a debt collector, visits a food stall run by Ambar. Urip ordered a plate of pecel that reminds him of a tragedy that happened a week ago. At that time, he and his brother Darto went to the stall, which was still being managed by Ambar’s mother, Mak Sati. They argued about how Mak Sati should pay her debts. Talks about debt heated up and resulted in a riot.

title: Marsiti & Sapi-Sapi
overview: Marsiti is a girl who dreams of winning a bull race. She was trained by her late father and inherited two buffaloes. Upon hearing her mother’s intention to sell the buffaloes to Haji Roni, her father’s rival, Marsiti stole the bulls with the help of her two best friends, Ponidi and Marjuki. The problem is, no female had ever been jockey for a bull race before. As the head of the race organizers, Haji Roni rejects Marsiti’s request. Marsiti secretly sets up a plan to continue take part in the race and prove that she is a skilled jockey.

title: Gedang Renteng
overview: Gina and Mutia are two best friends, searching for the whereabouts of Celuluk, a demon commonly known for residing in a papaya tree or Gedang Renteng. Gina, who was initially unenthusiastic, guided the Celuluk summoning procession half-jokingly and was instead faced with an unexpected situation.

title: Bakmie Bangka Heri
overview: HERI (55) takes his daughter, FEMI (23) for a vacation to his hometown, the town of Bangka. He wants to show her the city that introduced him to Bakmi Bangka (a type of noodle dish), a dish that they sell in their family owned noodle shop in Jakarta. This is an important trip for Femi, as she is destined to inherit the shop when Heri retires. Femi is forced to go, even though she doesn’t want to. In fact, she has no interest in taking over the noodle shop.

title: Jus Nanas Kue Lapis
overview: A movie about a young mother who’s trying to enjoy her me time by having a picnic in the pine forest. In reality, the tranquility she expected keeps on getting interrupted by many calls, video calls, chats about work and house affairs. Following the story, we learn that she is a property agent who runs an online florist shop, and also helps for her husband's koi fish business.

title: Golden Age
overview: Arif and Yati, an old couple who are celebrating their anniversary by trying to make a remake photos when he proposed to her in a specific spot in Borobudur Temple.

title: (s)Aya
overview: AYA (25), is an influencer who is slowly losing her popularity. She decides to go on a holiday to an exotic coast resort, far from the demands of her work in Jakarta. Although she is far from the city, her manager, ANDHIKA (33), sends her a few products to review. Aya is then trapped in a contract, which obliges her to work.

title: Percakapan Kecil
overview: Diego, a man with Dwarfism, works as an extra for a Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs pre-wedding photoshoot project. This photoshoot leads him into an intimate conversation with the bride, who seems to question her decision to marry the prince of her life.

title: Evakuasi Mama Emola
overview: When an earthquake occurs in the prison where Julius (35) has been held for the last few years, the warden receives a word from Julius’s village that a tsunami might be coming to his village, located quite far from the prison. Julius receives priority to go home since he still has a mother, Emola (90s), in the village. The warden assigns a newly appointed officer, Nuri (25), to escort Julius on a motorcycle.  On their way, Julius and Nuri are convinced that the tsunami is going to happen in Julius’s village. They cross paths with several refugees and rescuers, who has just evacuated the residents and reports the chaos occurring in Julius’ hometown due to the signs of approaching tsunami.  Arriving at the village, Julius and Nuri witness a robbery coordinated by fake rescue team.

title: Segudang Wajah Para Penantang Masa Depan
originalTitle: Segudang Wajah Para Penantang Masa Depan
overview: An essayistic film exploring the legacies of cinema in New Order Indonesia and what it means to be inheritors of its filmic language.

title: Oskab Geger Geden
overview: A business competition between two bakso (meatball)  sellers that has been going on for a long time. One day the misunderstanding between the two that made this cold war culminated. The two insisted on accusing each other that a rival stall was using "pesugihan" (deal with the devil)

title: Money Laundry
overview: Masli adalah pemilik jasa laundry kelas menengah yang narsis. Di tengah kondisi ekonomi yang memprihatinkan, seorang pelanggan datang meninggalkan setumpuk uang di laundrynya. Perjuangan batin dan keinginan manusia juga hadir untuk alat pertukaran nilai ini.

title: Pedhut
overview: An old man who's trapped in his past, stole the army uniform to chase away the ghosts that terrorize his long nights.

title: Tegar
overview: Tegar (10), seorang anak berkebutuhan khusus yang menginginkan bisa seperti anak pada umumnya, berteman dan bersekolah. Di hari ulang tahunnya yang ke-10, Tegar mengutarakan impiannya kepada sang Kakek. Namun, keputusan Kakek untuk mewujudkan impian Tegar justru membuat Kakek dan Ibu berselisih. Akhirnya, Tegar memutuskan untuk pergi dari rumah demi mengejar mimpinya.

title: Keramat 2: Caruban Larang
overview: A group of young people from Jakarta left for Cirebon with different destinations. Arla, Jojo, and Maura want to do research on their final assignment, which is assisted by a documentary filmmaker named Umay. Meanwhile, Ajil and Keanu are horror YouTubers who create content to maintain their existence. Their journey becomes wild and uncontrollable after meeting Ute, an indigo who has a secret agenda.

title: Ritus
overview: A student finds a secret  afterschool cult.

title: Kisah Perjuangan Suku Naga
overview: A performance adapted from a drama script by W.S Rendra. In a village, there lived a group of Naga tribe members. They lived from natural resources. However, on the other hand, there was a threat from the Astinam Kingdom who wanted to seize their territory. Can the Naga tribe fight back?

title: Against The Wind
overview: Two pilots from opposing sides fight for their lives in a dogfight during World War II.

title: Tano Na Uli, Hagodanganki
overview: Ompung Putra Boru, a sixties indigenous Batak woman from Humbang Hasundutan, North Sumatra, retraces her life stories through photographs that interweave her past and present as a wife, mother, healer and indigenous land defender in two neighboring villages. Her multi-layered stories are juxtaposed with visual records of everyday life in the two villages, where people’s living space is still increasingly threatened by a giant pulp expansion.

title: Kemono No Wakasa - DIRECTOR CUT!
overview: Di tengah bayang-bayang kota yang suram, seorang pemuda bertarung dengan kekerasan, identitas, dan luka yang terus menghantuinya. Terjebak di antara kesetiaan, amarah, dan keinginan untuk menemukan jati dirinya, ia harus menghadapi sisi tergelap dalam dirinya sebelum semuanya terlambat. Kemono No Wakasa adalah drama neo-noir tentang masa muda, kehilangan, dan pencarian makna kemanusiaan di dunia yang keras.

title: Anoksia
overview: A husband and wife caught in an avalanche while driving in a car. While having difficulty breathing, the secrets that had been hidden for so long, were slowly revealed.

title: Denyut
overview: Aura and Jiwa, two popular vloggers, got lost in a mysterious forest and try to survive without communication technology.

title: Kata Tukang Tahu, Kita Tak Boleh Sok Tahu
originalTitle: Kata Tukang Tahu, Kita Tak Boleh Sok Tahu
overview: A woman tries to bargain with a tofu seller or else she can’t go home. When the tofu seller refuses to negotiate, the woman devises a plan to get the tofu mischievously.

title: Poverty Porn
overview: Bambang yang putus sekolah harus bekerja menjadi kuli agar bisa bertahan hidup. Bambang mempunyai adik bernama Joko yang sedang sakit. Mereka berdua yatim piatu. Adalah Jeje, tetangganya Bambang dan Joko yang tanpa mempunyai tepo seliro sedikit pun setiap hari menyanyi dan bermain tiktok dengan suara gaduh. Hal itu membuat Karim seorang driver ojol (pacar Jeje) menjadi kesal karena Jeje tidak ada sedikut pun kepedulian kepada tetangga yang sedang sakit. Karim dan Jeje pun bertengkar dimana tanpa mereka sadari dalam kondisi video live. Video itu pun viral. Akhirnya bantuan dan donasi ke Joko pun mengalir. Tentu saja hal tersebut tak luput dari pandangan mata para orang-orang yang mau pansos (panjat sosial)

title: Uti Deng Keke
overview: Maria/Keke after moving schools to Gorontalo from their native Manado due to following their father's duties, became friends with Umar/Uti, Ruslan and Danial. These 4 friends from different backgrounds are intertwined, they have been together since childhood to achieve the goals they often pledged on the top of the hill. But will they grow up hope and friendship will be like in childhood?

title: Joki
overview: Akbar seorang Joki Skripsi, bertemu dengan Amir seorang mahasiswa yang menggunakan jasanya untuk menyelesaikan skripsi tersebut, saat proses pengerjaan berlangsung mereka berbagi cerita mengenai kehidupan masing masing

title: Pesantren
overview: A rare look inside Indonesian Islamic boarding schools, showcasing a centuries-old educational system that fosters character, compassion, and respect in the face of rising extremism.

title: Ashiap Man
overview: Sejak kecil, Zulkarnaen terobsesi dengan pahlawan yang selalu diceritakan oleh ayahnya, Pak Ibrahim. Aisyah adalah satu-satunya orang yang selalu mendukung Zul untuk menjadi ksatria mempertahankan desanya. Suatu hari Zul bertemu dengan gadis misterius bernama Kiara yang membuat Zul takjub. Namun setelah Zul gagal menyelamatkan ayahnya, Zul patah semangat. Apakah Zul sebagai Ashap Man bisa menjadi pahlawan? Dan siapa yang akan dipilih Zul, Aisyah atau Kiara?

title: Sri Asih
overview: Alana discover the truth about her origin: she’s not an ordinary human being. She may be the gift for humanity and become its protector as Sri Asih. Or a destruction, if she can’t control her anger.

title: Alkisah Timur
overview: New cosmopolitanism started with the bromocorah’s (free agent) dynasty. Through Palah (Panataran), we see the legitimacy of his great-grandsons appropriating the power of the Central Javanese dynasty, perpetuating the throne and cultural hegemony through the story of the man in the tkes hat, Panji.

title: The Wannn Believe
overview: Wannn is a native Pontianak who finds happiness through playing games. However, growing up in an old-fashioned family, Wannn's parents were against his hobby and side job as a game jockey. Differences of opinion between Wannn and his father caused a major dispute. This also fueled his father's health, so that Wannn lost the opportunity to prove his achievements as a gamer.

title: Ngantih
overview: Ngantih (Spinning Yarn) is one of the traditions of residents in Tumagal Village, Pengadegan District, Purbalingga Regency since the 1980s. Even though the Tumangga fabric has been exported, the residents of Tumangga Village and its surroundings only produce the yarn. It takes the support of many parties so that the entire Tumagal community is able to manage the whole ecosystem of fabric products.

title: Mayday! May day! Mayday!
overview: In their five-year ongoing strike, the workers are still surviving and struggling to make ends meet. Deni Purba sells used clothes after being released from prison. Steven Yawan who still continues to speak loudly in the capital. Musyawir with his expertise in coffee tells the story of the brutal actions at the beginning of the strike.

title: Marganing Gesang
overview: The film chronicles the life of Waluyo, a confident young puppeteer who is fighting to pursue his career. The various obstacles he went through did not make him give up on living life. Even it becomes a lighter to continue working. However, the Covid-19 pandemic strikes and changes his perspectives to survive. He also has to be realistic and has to adjust to the situation.

title: Cold Body
overview: Cases of missing student in some universities slowly unravels while Helena trying to find her missing friend.

title: Dorasembada
overview: Ahmad (48/L), Seorang kepala rumah tangga yang baru saja di PHK Perusahaan Tambang Batubara ingin mempertahankan rumahnya yang ingin dibeli perusahaan tambang batubara, namun kondisi anaknya yang terkena penyakit bronkitis kronis membuat Ahmad membutuhkan uang untuk menyembuhkan anaknya

title: A Good Day for Everybody
overview: A Good Day for Everybody (Hari yang Baik untuk Semua Orang)

title: Monokrom 2: A Pathetic Records
overview: Kami menerima kisah nyata sedih seseorang dan memperagakannya supaya lebih tergambarkan. Bermula dari seorang wanita yang berpacaran dengan pria yang ternyata memiliki pacar ganda. Kemudian ada lagi seorang wanita yang ditipu oleh pacarnya dengan dalih uangnya untuk pengobatan ibunya. Ternyata uang itu digunakan untuk selingkuh.

title: Do Not Ask
overview: About how an old maid would react when people continually push her to get married, even though, there's no option for her because she hasn't met her true partner yet.

title: Lansia Lan Sopo
overview: Aji dan Mamat, members of two different village chief campaign teams, competes to get one vote from the elderly Kusno. They just need to assist Kusno's grandson Budi to find "Jamal".

title: Kopi Stigma
overview: Bennip merupakan seorang penyandang disabilitas intelektual yang mampu menjadi seorang barista di sebuah Café milik Sentra Terpadu Kartini Temanggung. Namun, menjadi barista yang sekarang ini tidaklah mudah bagi bennip karena ia harus melawan stigma negatif masyarakat yang beranggapan bahwa para disabilitas tidak mampu bekerja dengan baik. Oleh karena itu, Bennip berusaha membuktikan kepada masyarakat bahwa para disabilitas mampu untuk bekerja dengan baik.

title: Oh My Mind
overview: The shadows of childhood memories continue to haunt a young man suffering from a mental illness.

title: Modus Operandi
overview: Modus Operandi tells the story of three journalists who are at a loss in their careers and romance, disguised as fried rice cooks to expose a banking crime kingpin.

title: Nariti: Romansa Danau Toba
overview: A triangular love story that doesn't usually happen in the lives of indigenous people, especially in Batak Land. There is an infinite moral message and makes us understand deeply the customs that apply in the area.

title: Before I Met You
overview: Gadis, a girl in the midst of the bustle of the bustling city of Jakarta, she is faced with a choice of her future, which is her soul mate. Should the girl choose Bara or Rama as her heart's choice?

title: Perempuan Bergaun Merah
overview: Since her best friend disappeared, Dinda's life turns into a nightmare when an evil spirit in the form of a woman in a red dress haunts her. Dinda's life is threatened, not only by the evil spirit but also by people who try to keep the events of the night of her best friend's disappearance a secret.

title: Rasa Sementara
overview: Beno (11 years old) who has just returned from school waiting to be picked up, felt thirsty and intended to drink water from a bottle.

title: Another Kind of Blue
overview: Three Afghan girls share what their ideal day may look like.

title: Larut Kalut
overview: When his birthday dawns, Adam struggles to soothe his own thoughts that prevent him from sleeping.

title: Klab Astral
overview: Athira invited her classmates to join her club, Klab Astral. She and her best friend Arya, held a big welcoming party at her house. Turns out, nobody showed up. Instead, there is a group of demons who can't wait to join in.

title: Dust Away
overview: “I imagined the United States to be the most beautiful place in the world. And no, I met hell instead,” says one of the mostly undocumented Latin American immigrants who were employed as cleaners in the aftermath of the attack on the World Trade Center, at the cost of their health. Some talk about their experiences and the lack of recognition they received. One of them notes that white Americans didn’t put their lives on the line in the way that they did.

title: Yang Patah Tumbuh, Yang Hilang Berganti
originalTitle: Yang Patah Tumbuh, Yang Hilang Berganti
overview: Yasmin's happiness in managing a small inn in Solo with Darto disappeared after the arrival of Hardiman, Yasmin's father, who was a former legendary dancer.

title: My Mother, At The Beach
overview: A woman and her young toddler escape the city to a small coastal town. She checks in to a run-down motel by the sea. Burdened by a troubled past, she hangs on vulnerably by a thread. As night approaches, ghastly occurrences haunt her movements and actions as she prepares for a horrific act. However, a chance encounter with a stranger changes the course of events. Like her, the stranger harbors a burden of his own and their meeting brings to surface their deeply buried emotions and hope/fear for the future, culminating in a beautiful, redemptive and serendipitous ending.

title: Disania
overview: Disania selalu setia menunggu bapak datang menjemputnya sepulang sekolah.

title: Terikat, Tak Senyawa
overview: In the midst of a mid-life crisis, a Priest commits a sin as he falls in love with one of his church choristers. He is now faced by the choice of either continuing the path towards God or following his love.

title: Qodrat
overview: A former clergyman finds himself back in his old boarding school where the disturbances experienced by its community might help him regain his faith and tie up loose ends in regards to his son's death by a deadly spirit.

title: Crazy, Stupid, Love
overview: Surya, who is already owned by someone, goes to Yogyakarta by night bus and sits next to Asti, whom Surya saves from pranksters. Unexpectedly, this meeting with Asti changes Surya's life, both in love and in his relationship with his parents.

title: Rumah Kaliurang
overview: Rencana berlibur lima sahabat berubah menjadi petaka ketika terjebak di sebuah rumah misterius di Kaliurang, yang terletak di kaki Gunung Merapi. Rumah yang seharusnya jadi tempat singgah justru menyimpan dendam dan amarah. Apakah mereka bisa pulang dengan selamat?

title: Chandramawa
overview: A small village is being terrorized by witchcraft; at least that's what Ajeng, a servant girl who claims to know who has become a witch in secret, says. One by one, people are arrested and put on trial without any solid evidence. In the midst of the chaos, Rama Adiwijaya is suspicious of Ajeng, especially after his own wife is arrested. Twisted facts, revenge, betrayal, and other unexpected things finally began to unfold.

title: Menanti Pagi Yang Tak Kunjung Datang
originalTitle: Menanti Pagi Yang Tak Kunjung Datang
overview: Being able to make peace with a painful situation is not an easy thing. Dion’s (35) days are still filled with beautiful memories with Dara (28) that are hard for him to forget. Should Dion continue to dissolve in sorrow? Or trying to adapt to change?

title: Neangan
overview: Mimpi yang hadir di setiap tidurnya membawa Rengganis ke perjalanan "magis" tanpa  ujung yang jelas demi mengetahui maksud dari mimpi dan keberadaan kekasihnya yang tak kunjung kembali. Diadaptasi dari Cerita Rakyat Situ Patenggang.

title: Perfect Strangers
overview: Seven friends who attend a dinner and decide to play a game with their cell phones. Unfortunately, the game ends in disaster when their dark secret is revealed.

title: Tropic Fever
overview: The semi-autobiographical account of a European plantation manager on Sumatra during Dutch colonial rule becomes a starting point for reflections on the structure of the plantation itself. An essay about local tobacco and rubber cultivation, the construction of skin colour as a social category and the "tropic fever” which rises slowly but inexorably, edited from archive material dating from 1890 to 1930.

title: Jenglotman dan Keinginan Mertua Jahanam
overview: Sisworo the Jenglotman, married Anggun, the daughter of Mbah Kusumo, a shaman. During five months of the marriage, Sisworo and Anggun were terrorized. Apparently, they were terrorized by Sisworo's own father-in-law. Mbah Kusumo wants the power of the Jenglotman Belt! Like it or not, Sisworo had to fight his own in-laws to be able to live in peace.

title: Hari Sebelum Puasa
overview: It tells the story of Feri , the youngest of two brothers who live in an area in Pasundan. One day, his mother gives him a message to make sesajen (ritual offerings) the day before the month of fasting.

title: Pergi Menghias Bapak
overview: A mother invites her son to visit her husband who has been sick for a long time. This is the first time for the son because, in fact, he does not want to see his father again. But the mother still loves her husband, and this angers the son.

title: Sweet & Bitter
overview: Sekar wants to get a sense of comfort that she cannot get from her family. However, she failed to find comfort when she was not with the right person.

title: LÈLÈGÉN
overview: Adit is a boy who wants to buy a watch like his friend's. He pursued his own will. However, this intention is hindered by his innocence about interpreting things.

title: Dua Ruang
overview: A mistress named Clara who is on the run in Jakarta and her neighbor a young Japanese named Kenji who works in a production house become attracted to each other because of the sounds they hear every day through the walls of their living quarters.  Clara works in a cafe that is only open in the afternoon until the morning, she claims to be a film student. The cafe is owned by Dimas, a young man who was abandoned by his fiancé.  Kenji was sent to Jakarta, Indonesia as a representative of a Japanese production house. In Jakarta he fell in love with a woman he worked with.

title: Berita Duka Hari Ini
overview: Two brothers had to remove their unstable mother from their home before their older brother's remains arrived.

title: Galang
overview: Her sister's tragic death in an underground music concert made Galang devastated and searched for the cause until he finally met Asmara, the manager of her sister's favorite band who happened to be performing at the same concert when her sister died. Will Galang take revenge or will he find his true identity?

title: Pesan(an) Terakhir
overview: Marzuki, menggunakan hoaks tentang restorannya yang angker untuk menarik pengunjung, tetapi jalan yang dia pilih ini ditentang oleh ayahnya, Ismail. Apa yang harus dilakukan Marzuki?

title: Bukan Anak Meriam
overview: Sepasang suami istri bernama Mer dan Ian sudah lama menantikan kehadiran buah hati. Mereka melancong ke Jakarta – Kota Tua untuk melakukan sebuah ritual yang diyakini akan mendatangkan hal baik yaitu mendapatkan momongan.

title: After The Funeral
overview: After the funeral of his wife, a man tries to reconcile with his estranged daughter.

title: Datang Bulan
overview: 'Datang bulan', the coming of the moon, is one of the euphemisms most Indonesians use for menstruation. Datang Bulan (Come Moon) is a short documentary about a teenage Indonesian girl's uncomfortable experience of menstruating in a village where it is still widely treated as taboo.

title: Kalian Pantas Mati
overview: A teenager with the uncanny ability to communicate with the dead must stop a vengeful demon who's exacting revenge on students at his high school.

title: Inang
overview: Karena kekurangan uang dan tempat tinggal, seorang wanita setuju untuk membiarkan pasangan tua yang kaya raya untuk merawat dia dan bayinya yang belum lahir, tanpa mengetahui bahwa mereka memiliki rencana jahat yang melibatkan putra satu-satunya mereka.

title: Ringroad
overview: Mulyani, a domestic worker who decided to run away from an elite housing complex with Reza, her boyfriend, a construction worker. They are on an adventure and have to face the consequences of violating Mulyani's work contract.

title: Desa Timun: Bola
overview: When Cilo's ball went flat when a chicken pecked him, Cila and Cili had to find a way to comfort their crying sister.

title: Ritual, Belahan IV: Bauran
overview: Tracing the footsteps of urban space involves understanding the various elements that influence urban development. One of the inseparable problems of cities is the attraction of migrants from various fields. The river, which has been a part of the city’s long history, brings with it all the polemics related to the city’s development.

title: Memori Dia
overview: A short film about the childhood memories of a trans* non-binary person. Triggered by an old family photograph, a young adult named Azka starts to trace back their childhood – a stage of life when they began learning about the world around them and themselves. While revisiting these long-forgotten memories, Azka discovers unresolved pains they never knew existed. This experience marks the beginning of a journey that unfolds profound self-acceptance.

title: Kau, Rabu, dan Perkara2 Sepintas Lalu
originalTitle: Kau, Rabu, dan Perkara2 Sepintas Lalu
overview: Rhun, a well-known novelist, must finish his latest novel soon. Ajeng was chosen by a publisher to read the script before the novel was declared finished. Rhun is captivated by her. But in the end, the woman stopped coming.

title: Days To Forget
overview: Setelah mengalami perpisahan yang sulit, Noah menemukan dirinya tersesat dalam kesepiannya. Dia menyaksikan teman-temannya menjauh membuat pemulihan perpisahannya menjadi salah satu momen terberat dalam hidupnya. Sejak itu, dia melewati 4 tahap kesedihan, mengetahui bahwa segala sesuatu memiliki proses dan segala sesuatunya benar-benar menjadi lebih baik. Pada akhirnya, Noah menerima semuanya apa adanya dan menemukan awal yang baru.

title: Kuntilanak Merah Pentagram
overview: The story of turmoil in a household is told by a wife who is having an affair with another man. The man he was having an affair with turned out to be a Satanist who always sacrificed anyone asked by the devil as a sacrifice to get wealth. Finally, his wife and children became sacrifices and became ghosts wandering around and wanted revenge for the behavior of the husband who had made sacrifices for his worship.

title: Di Balik Malam
overview: The film by visionary director Bagas Setyo Putra, Di Balik Malam, raises important issues in society. This is the credits sequence.

title: Jiwo
overview: On his daughter’s wedding day, a father struggles with the onset of his mental illness and tries to compose himself to be the person his family needs him to be.

title: A Banded Perturbation
overview: After had a biggest lost in his life, a young man felt uneasy when he arrived at his family home, -convinced himself there's was something disturbing lurking here.

title: Mbok Wantun & Anak-anaknya
overview: Keluarga pedagang yang berkeliling wilayah penjajahan Hindia Belanda berharap keuntungan dari kesengsaraan, mereka adalah Mbok Wantun dan Anak-anaknya. Mbok Wantun yang cerdik dan licik beserta Edi, Susi, dan Tini sebagai anak angkat sekaligus pelayan sejatinya, melalui segala peristiwa menggunakan gerobak kepemilikan ibu angkatnya itu. However, the conversation that Silvi had with the salon keeper, as well as some of the hairstyles she saw in the catalog book, triggers a sudden collection of memories between Silvi and her husband. This makes Silvi reconsider what she really wants and needs.

Fortunately, Soleh found a VCD entitled "5 Steps to Get a Girl !!!". From there, the poor Soleh was taught to be a bad boy in 5 steps to get Sari's heart.

The film tells a love story between Teguh and Tonny, which becomes the foundation of why this fight needs to be fought for.

overview: Two kids become friends when they discover the news about a doomsday comet.

Hingga suatu hari, Leli bertekad merubah rasa takutnya menjadi sesuatu yang lebih bermanfaat. Leli berhasil mengolah ketakutannya menjadi inspirasi untuk menulis film horor yang akhirnya mengantarkannya ke jalan kesuksesan. Namun, apakah Leli  benar-benar sudah lepas dari ketakutannya?

title: Homebound

title: Mertua vs Menantu

Yono went to the cell phone counter, because he thought that the reason Suryo never called him was because his phone was broken.  Is that right?  Or are there other facts that strain the father and son relationship?

Pada hari Idul Fitri, Nenek Ani ditemukan tewas dalam genangan darah, dipenggal. Ambar menduga tragedi itu mungkin terkait dengan penemuan peti yang berisi pernak-pernik dan patung tanpa kepala di ruang bawah tanah paviliun panti jompo. Sekarang, Ambar harus menyelesaikan dendam makhluk yang perlahan merayap ke dalam hidup mereka, bahkan untuk kepala mereka.

Suami barunya yang begitu kaya membuat Nana dipandang rendah oleh kerabat suaminya. Ino, istri simpanan suaminya, menjadi tempat berbagi rahasia, masa lalu, & masa sekarang. Bersama-sama, keduanya mencari cara untuk menemukan arti kebebasan.

title: Sipet Anak Dayak

When submitting an assignment, he finds an internet network problem. As a result, he accidentally connects to his neighbour's WiFi, which causes an argument between himself and the next-door neighbour.

title: Pendekar Dari Bukit Kalaumang: Mencari Mamanya
originalTitle: Pendekar Dari Bukit Kalaumang: Mencari Mamanya

To free his mother, Oki embarks on an adventure to find the "Kalaumang Emas", believed to be the key to salvation. Along the way, Oki faces various obstacles, from being confused about his direction, meeting Uncle Herman, to being caught up in social conflict in a village experiencing a water shortage.

title: Madu Murni
