overview: While taking care of his beloved pet bird named Jambu, Attal must face his older brother who keeps on taking away his money.

title: The Boy Over Flowers
overview: Reno Wijaya accepts a job offer out of town to get away from his mother after refusing to continue his family florist. His mother was disappointed and fell ill. As an indecisive person, he is in a dilemma about whether to go ahead with his plan or not. He cannot bear to leave his mother alone.

title: Sampai Ujung Laut
overview: Pak Suyadi, a fisherman from Semarang, and Nilawati, a fisherman from Medan, who really want to be able to access subsidized fuel, but do not have documents related to fisheries, so they are not recorded and "invisible" by the government.

title: Bibir Merah Siapa yang Punya
overview: A trans woman tries to get their ID card done at the district office but gets mistreated by the officers who refuse to process the request.

title: Hari Keramat
overview: Three office workers were terrorized by the sudden sound of gamelan in their office. Uneasy, they approach the source of the sound and have to deal with something.

title: Riwayat Ceti
overview: Ceti is a woman from Bogor who is experiencing financial difficulties during the COVID-19 pandemic. Her clothing kiosk in Bogor Market was forced to close. Her husband, who works as an online loan debt collector, cannot collect debts from people who had lost their jobs, and her son asks for a smartphone to go to online school. Inadvertently, she finds a solution to her problems when she collects a debt from the family of someone who recently died.

title: Naga Naga Naga
overview: Bonaga and Monita are a husband and wife who are enjoying their period of success. This time, they have to face the educational problems of their only daughter, Monaga, who was expelled from her school. The grandfather, the Dragon finally got involved in the problem of the grandson to get a new school. In the midst of educational problems for Monaga, Monaga's meeting with a street child named Nira became a special spirit for Monaga to go to school. There are various obstacles and conflicting opinions on the sustainability of Monaga education. Naga's excessive love for his grandson makes matters even more complicated, causing Bonaga to be squeezed between the wishes of his wife, children, and father.

title: Encounter
overview: Sepulang kuliah, Via yang sedang sakit bertemu dengan seorang pria yang mengantarnya pulang. Namun Via tidak mengetahui siapa pria tersebut, sehingga keesokan harinya ia bersama teman-temannya memutuskan untuk mencari tahu siapa pria tersebut.

title: Suara di antara Aksara
overview: Muhammad Raditya Firmansyah, who is familiarly called Radit, is a deaf child from Tenggarong, Kutai Kartanegara,  East Kalimantan. Radit nicknamed as The Blue Eyes because his eye color is different from the eye color of the  people in his environment due to a genetic disorder (Waardenburg syndrome) that also affects his hearing.

title: Seperti Sediakala
overview: One night, Intan visits Sekala Jewelry Store to make her wedding ring. There, she meets Kala, a mysterious jeweler who seems very familiar to Intan. How will fate lead them?

title: Angka
overview: Nevan adalah seorang siswa dengan kehidupan yang biasa-biasa saja dan tidak terlalu menonjol di sekolahnya. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah cahaya besar membuat para siswa memiliki angka-angka di atas kepala mereka, termasuk Nevan yang memiliki angka yang sangat kecil. Nevan mencoba untuk menambah angka yang dimilikinya, yang, pada saat yang sama, membantunya memahami arti dari angka tersebut.

title: Kepater
overview: Trimbil (42) and Sokle (25) are in charge of delivering medicine to a health center in a village in Gunungkidul. On the way there, their car got stuck in a mud puddle on a broken road. They struggled to get the car out, accompanied by endless arguments.

title: Blackout
overview: A VR character forced to sign out when the city goes blackout.

title: Metaverse of Madness
overview: The world is getting more modern, people are starting to try to use metaverse technology.  This gave rise to new ways of having fun, worshiping gods, and even strange ways of living.

title: Sunday
overview: Edwin was in a dilemma after his daughter ran away from home because she didn't get his blessing for her love affair. This condition makes him trapped in the collections of bizarre dreams and experiences about his daughter.

title: Satria Dewa: Gatotkaca
overview: Menyadari bahwa dia adalah keturunan gatotkaca dari keluarga Pandawa, Satrio harus berjuang untuk membuka kekuatan yang ada di dalam dirinya dan menghadapi Aswatama, prajurit Kurawa yang tersisa yang hidup untuk menghancurkan dunia dengan mengubah sejarah Bharatayudha.

title: Klip Terakhirku
overview: Joy bersama teman-temannya memutuskan untuk berliburan gratis, namun perjalanan liburan yang seharusnya menyenangkan malah menjadi moment mengenaskan

title: DARYATA
overview: Hasya, a vocational high school graduate who is ambitious about her dreams. In the midst of her shortcomings, it is not an obstacle to pursuing her dreams. Being paralyzed and disabled is a challenge for her, to be able to continue pursuing her dreams. Ups and downs are no longer new, they have become food for her.

title: Terikat
overview: A dance film that explores the role of women in the domestic space.

title: Cinta Ada Karenamu
overview: Yeyet's love for Sapphire is only half-hearted, because Yeyet demands luxury from Sapphire who is only the son of a lute artist. When he meets the wealthy Angga, Yeyet immediately falls in love. Sapphire, who is heartbroken, accidentally meets Kinar, a rich man's son who is targeted by Angga. And love began to blossom.

title: Rumah Kuntilanak
overview: Melani, who is pregnant, went to find her husband at the Karet plantation because his husband had not come home for 2 months. There he met and experienced various strange events that happened to him which made him wonder, what happened in this place?

title: Ngeri-Ngeri Sedap
overview: Orang tua asal suku Batak yang pura-pura bertengkar agar anak-anaknya pulang dari perantauan.

title: Aral Melintang
overview: Andien, seorang tukang pijat berjuang untuk mempertahankan harga dirinya dengan melawan kasus pelecehan seksual yang telah ia alami. Namun, sudut pandang dari orang-orang sekitarnya membuat ia mempertanyakan keyakinannya sendiri.

title: Becquerel
overview: In an alternative future of Indonesia, when nuclear technology reaches the point of generating an artificial sun for endless energy resources, a lazy philosopher Sajad Ali wandering around seeks a place to sleep. Told in a semi-essayistic approach, Sajad Ali reflects the dynamics of nuclear technology in the future, the politics of materiality through the search for minerals such as thorium in Indonesia, as well as the complexity of nuclear issue in the Global South and its tension with ecology, energy consumption, nation-state, and productivity.

title: The Doll 3
overview: After an accident that killed both of Tara's parents, Tara now only has a younger brother named Gian as a member of her family. However, the accident traumatized Gian, so Gian chose to end his life.

title: Rasyah The Wonder Kid
overview: Rasyah's family decided to move again and this time they went to Makassar. Rasyah's father's job makes them have to change places frequently. This makes it difficult for Rasyah to get and makes Rasyah feel insecure. However, something was different when they arrived in Makassar. Rasyah got one very good friend. The dilemma begins when Rasyah knows that soon she will leave her best friend.

title: The Trial
overview: Xiu, yang merupakan seorang penyihir muda merasa tertarik untuk mempelajari mantra teleportasi yang dapat membawanya ke segala tempat dalam sekejap. Bersama dengan David sebagai pembimbing, Xiu menjelajahi beberapa spot menarik di Kota Cilegon. Sepanjang perjalanan, Xiu menemukan pengalaman yang unik. Mampukah ia beradaptasi dengan hal tersebut?

title: Kopi Pahit
overview: Gendis dan Joel, pengantin baru, kembali dari bulan madu mereka. Mereka tinggal di hotel selama tujuh hari. Gendis sensitif karena menstruasi. Tasya, mantan kekasih Joel, mengucapkan selamat atas pernikahan mereka melalui DM, meski niatnya untuk merayu Joel. Hal itu membuat Gendis cemburu sampai-sampai ribut. Selama tujuh hari di kamar hotel mereka menghadapi masalah demi masalah yang bertolak belakang dengan suasana bulan madu mereka di Swiss.

title: Srimulat: Hil Yang Mustahal – Babak Pertama
originalTitle: Srimulat: Hil Yang Mustahal – Babak Pertama
overview: Terinspirasi dari kisah nyata grup lawak legendaris Indonesia, Srimulat.

title: Cinta Subuh
overview: Angga yang jatuh cinta dengan teman kuliahnya, Ratih. Angga merupakan sosok laki-laki yang sedang mencari jati diri dan sering bergonta-ganti pasangan, sedangkan Ratih adalah sosok wanita yang taat agama.

title: Heartbroken dream, but oh well
overview: Two lover having an "okay" dinner at a restaurant until the girl rejected the boy's offer to marry him.

title: Sultan Abdul Muluk
overview: This drama performance was adapted from the poetry of Sultan Abdul Muluk. Sultan Abdul Muluk or better known as Dul Muluk was the leader of the Barbari Kingdom. One time, there was an attack from another kingdom on the Barbari Kingdom. Can Dul Muluk defend his throne and kingdom?

title: Action!
overview: In the final year of high school, a group of students embarks on creating a short film for a competition. Despite facing numerous obstacles and challenges that test their teamwork and unity, the group learns valuable lessons in persistence and collaboration. As tensions rise and doubts creep in, one member reminds them that struggles are part of the journey. Together, they push forward, determined to finish what they started. This film, made as a keepsake for their graduation, captures not only the struggles they faced but the triumph of overcoming them.

title: Monokrom
overview: Ken, diam dan sunyi bergelut dengan kepalanya yang abu nan penuh kegilaan.

title: Kencan Pertama
overview: Suryo (25), a thug asking for security money from shops, wants to be closer to Ajeng (24), who is an employee of a used clothing store. Previously, Suryo only know Ajeng by name, nothing more. When on the last day asking for security money, Suryo ventured to get to know Ajeng further.  However, Ajeng's indifferent attitude makes Suryo clumsy and almost runs out of topics to talk about. Gradually through the chat, Ajeng slowly opened up. Suryo who is at his wits end starts a chat with his move after this. But unexpectedly, Ajeng also hopes to have the same fate as Suryo. The farewell of the two of them is just  ended with Suryo getting the name of Ajeng's facebook account.

title: Anglocita
overview: Yono ( 52 ) seorang seniman ketoprak yang ingin tetap berkesenian namun dihadapkan dengan teman – teman yang telah pergi, akhirnya ia melakukan ritual sesajen dengan mannequin buatannya untuk berketoprak meski sendiran.

title: The Last Sunset
overview: A single father decides to retire from being a superhero to live with his daughter

title: 123 Peluk
overview: If hugs are tangible why am I hugging the void

title: Preman Pensiun: Menunggu Senja
overview: Kang Mus lives a quiet life in his hometown, reflecting on his past. His peaceful daily life is disrupted when the local residents face threats from ruthless debt collectors. Kang Mus and his colleagues then step in to help ease the burden on those trapped in the debt trap.

title: The Warm Blood Of A Dying Man
originalTitle: The Warm Blood Of A Dying Man
overview: No one knows how an apocalypse began. A mysterious plague that killed millions of human lives and yet it is known  only cigarettes can be the cure. In the midst of all that, Walter (19), a young man who is also infected with the plague, tries to survive  by searching for the owner of the last cigarette on Earth, Truman (19).

title: Opera Jalanan
overview: A short music experience created with the sounds, both rhythmic percussive and vocal of 35 Indonesian street vendors.

title: Kuntilanak 3
overview: Dinda yang ingin bisa mengendalikan kekuatannya pergi ke Sekolah Mata Hati. Tempat di mana seorang anak dengan kekuatan khusus belajar mengendalikan kekuatannya, tetapi bahaya tak terduga mengikutinya ke mana pun dia pergi. Bisakah Dinda bertahan di sana?

title: Gara-Gara Warisan
overview: Three brothers who never get along are forced to compete for the inheritance in the form of a guest house owned by Dahlan, their father. Adam, the eldest son who blames his father's harsh attitude for his life's failures. Laras, the middle child who is independent and idealistic. And Dicky, his father's favorite youngest child who was pampered since childhood and grew up as a naughty young man. Who will be the heirs of choice?

title: KKN di Desa Penari
overview: Enam mahasiswa yang sedang melakukan kuliah kerja nyata di desa terpencil mendapatkan terror dari penaris mistis. Ternyata, salah satu dari mereka melanggar aturan paling fatal di desa tersebut.

title: In The Pines
overview: This work re-examines the relationship between the elements that make up the quality of space, namely: "subject" and "object", "organic" and "mechanical", "reality" and "representation", "wholeness" and "partiality", " determinacy” and “indeterminacy”, “visibility” and “invisibility”, “natural” and “non-natural”.

title: Challenge Accepted
overview: Erik, a teenager who says he is not afraid of ghosts, is challenged by his friend, Wren, who is an indigo, opened his sixth sense for a day. Arrogantly, Erik extends the challenge to three days! Is he going to be okay?

title: DJS The Movie: Biarkan Aku Menari
originalTitle: DJS The Movie: Biarkan Aku Menari
overview: All his life Wulan, he only wanted to be a dancer. When his father, Lukman and his brother, Satria were still alive, they were the ones who always supported Wulan's ideals. But now they are dead, and Wulan lives only with her mother, Linda. Linda wants Wulan to succeed in her life, but she is worried about Wulan who likes to dance. For him dance is something serious. One day they are without an object, making Wulan go to the hills with Joko, her boyfriend who has been secretly hidden for so long. On their way home, they had a miraculous accident, leaving Wulan stranded in another world.

title: Dua Jiwa
overview: Tanpa sadar Wira mengucapkan kata-kata yang membuat trauma Anya muncul lagi. Hal tersebut membuat kepribadian ganda Anya kambuh lagi.

title: Dua Bulan Berakhir Di Penjara
overview: Hartono, seorang kepala Desa yang baru saja di lantik sekitar bulan lalu, mengalami perubahan dalam masa pemimpinannya. Halimah, sosok istri yang dikenal ramah, menjadi sebagai pemberi masukan dan nasehat untuk suaminya, Hartono.

title: spatiohumanism
overview: A letter writer reflects on the space and people she encounters in her never ending journey. A letter reader dreams of unexpected things in his never ending wait. Composed of dreamy images from a minimalist phone cinematography, "spatiohumanism" offers a psychogeographic study that is sometimes dystopian, sometimes realist, but enchanting as a whole.

title: Wabah
overview: A malicious anonymous confession turns Bertilda into the target of online harassment, trapping her within the darkness of her own subconscious.

title: Juxtaposition
overview: Bercerita tentang kehidupan penghuni Jakarta yang indah dan makmur,  benarkah?

title: Produsen Oksigen
overview: Oxygen Producer

title: Sedap Malam
overview: Agave Amica transports us to Indonesia in the midst of the pandemic. With an excellent eye and a unique form of narration, Gembong Nusantara follows the daily lives of workers and their toil both in graveyards and in flower fields, inviting us to a larger reflection on the contrast between day and night, life and death, flowers and graves.

title: Walking Dead - Tomate
overview: Tells about Yuna's journey to Toraja with her close friends Dewa and Andy.  Their goal to Toraja to do a report that was assigned by Clara and the coverage will be included in a competition abroad.  While in Toraja they were guided by a local guide named Kinaya.  They visited several tourist attractions and also attended the Rambu Solo' and Ma' Nene' ceremonies.  While at the Ma' Nene' ceremony, Dewa found a necklace belonging to Limbong Bulaan's grandmother in the grave.  Driven by economic problems and his mother being treated in the hospital, Dewa was tempted to steal the necklace and intends to sell it.  After returning to the inn, Dewa began to be haunted by his own feelings.  Event after incident happened, until Dewa was found unconscious and even part of his body began to blister and resemble a corpse.  How are Yuna, Andy, and Kinaya going to save Dewa?  Can God be saved because of his actions?

title: Tutuge
overview: Ameera Janus, knew that Laras, The women she just met, is not actually ill, certainly not of Alzheimer as diagnosed by  the doctors. Laras is not okay, especially as she dances that balinese dance when she does not even know how to dance. Who or what possesses her?

title: Pernikahan Dini
overview: A senior high school student commited to marry a young man even though she is still underage.

title: Pitulikur
overview: Seorang suami yang istrinya mengalami kelumpuhan dan bertekad menghalalkan segala cara untuk membuat istrinya sehat kembali, termasuk menempuh cara yang instan. Hingga akhirnya cara yang ia tempuh menimbulkan petaka kepada keluarganya sendiri.

title: Janji
overview: Kedua sahabat berusaha menjaga janji dikala diterpa oleh masalah.

title: As The Sun Sets
overview: A romantic date on the beach turns into a heated argument when Bagas is faced with an opportunity to move together with Ayu, but finds himself struggling to feel worthy of his place in the relationship due to his traumatic troubling childhood.

title: can we call?
overview: Can We Call? is a contemporary romance about two young-adults from opposite parts of the World who find in each other the only support they got against the struggles and uncertainties of adulthood. This is an independent short film about loneliness, immaturity, self-love, and digital-age relationship.

title: Kucing Mandi
overview: Cat Cleaning Herself

title: Me and My Other Self
overview: Living in a conservative family that forces her to cover up, Dhea, a teenage girl, wants to express herself through the way she dresses.

title: Robot Mom
overview: In 2030, Sisca, a teenage girl who was enjoying a television program, accidentally came across an advertisement commercialising the figure of a mother at home, namely Robot Mom.

title: Sepanjang Jalan
overview: A story of childhood memories, love, and family.  A story where Honda plays a part in every twist and turn as a family journeys through life, where childhood friends find true love only to find that fate seems to have other plans...

title: Salman Masak Nasi Goreng
overview: Salman Cooks Fried Rice

title: Sampai Memutih Rambutku
overview: Tells the story of a husband and father named Gunawan who already has a stable life by becoming a shareholder in a company he founded with his uncle, but the pressure and problems in the company make him want to leave the company, but worries continue to make Gunawan doubt whether he is able to make his family happy or on the contrary he makes his family suffer in poverty. Until something unexpected hits Gunawan's life, Gunawan must go through a life process that makes him almost reluctant to continue living, so how does Gunawan rise and make his family happy?

title: Her Soul
overview: Shinta Ratri, a 57-year-old Muslim trans woman, recounts her life experiences—childhood memories, struggles of growing up, marriage—and her journey as the founder of the Islamic Boarding School of Al-Fatah in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

title: In Retrospect
overview: A junior psychologist provides consultation sessions to three of her patients, but their experiences trigger her to question her position in this world.

title: Labirin Lembusora
overview: Minotaur Lembusora adalah sesosok kaiju yang suka memangsa manusia. Untuk menghalanginya, Raja Minos memerintahkan pembangunan penjara raksasa. Maka ditugaskanlah dua arsitek Daedalus dan Ikarus sebagai pelaksana proyek tersebut. Raja Minos menurunkan sejumlah dana namun tak pernah sampai utuh karena dikorupsi orang-orang di sekitarnya. Akibatnya pembangunan penjara terhambat dan sebagai gantinya dibangunlah sebuah labirin sesuai dengan anggaran yang ultra mepet. Suatu ketika Minotaur Lembusora mengamuk menghancurkan labirin karena jatah makannya juga dikorupsi. Ikarus lalu merekrut seorang tahanan di tanah Jawa yakni Timun Mas. Timun Mas tidak dibayar namun dijanjikan bahwa hutangnya kepada Buto Ijo lunas. Timun Mas lalu memperbesar diri seukuran kaiju lalu menghajar Minotaur Lembusora sampai nyungsep masuk kawah Gunung Kelud.

title: Menjelang Magrib
overview: Seorang reporter dan juru kameranya menyelidiki Nina, seorang wanita muda yang dipasung karena dia memiliki gangguan jiwa yang ternyata menjadi sesuatu yang mistis.

title: Rio the Survivor
overview: Rio Sudiro has been living with HIV from his birth, and both his parents have died of AIDS. Rio’s father passed away while he was still in his mother’s womb and his mother has recently passed away a year ago. After his mother died, Rio was taken care of by his grandmother. They live by selling fried food in front of the house and also have other stalls in the neighbourhood reselling their fried food.

title: Air Rebusan Kuntilanak
overview: A woman applies for a job as an editor at the Magical Water MLM office.

title: Rewind MIPA 3
overview: A short retelling of big events that happened throughout the high school days of class MIPA 3. Made for a senior year project.

title: The Table Of Death
overview: Death is the answer for some, and so for others, perhaps. But is it really the answer? Even if it's done, what follows?

title: Ciri Wanci
overview: Faraz is a student from an affluent family suffering from kleptomania. Unbeknownst to him, this psychological disorder is troubling the people around him.

title: Dibui Birahi
overview: Luna wants to get out of sexual coercion by her boyfriend, but she is blocked by the threat of spreading her vulgar photos.

title: Pinarak
overview: The spirit of Sumi, Shella's mother-in-law, came to Shella to ask for forgiveness for her past mistakes.

title: Omah Omah
overview: A less harmonious family, would become stronger when get insulted by others.

title: Pray, Begin
overview: Ruth remaja Katholik yang hidup di tengah kaum muslim. Sebagai minoritas di tempat menuntut ilmu, ia harus beradaptasi dengan kebiasaan teman-teman muslimnya. Ia harus berpindah tempat untuk mengikuti pelajaran agama Katholik, karena sekolah tidak memfasilitasinya. Hal ini membuat Ruth terbawa pada kebiasaan kaum mayoritas bahkan saat ia sedang bersama keluarganya.

title: Melodialog
overview: Telling the story of a person who has a purpose in life and strives to achieve it, this film is a tribute to Batavia Madrigal Singers, a musical about life's struggles.

title: Truth or Dare
overview: A group of friends playing truth or dare in the night, one of them doing something prohibited.

title: Atas Nama Daun
overview: Marijuana. A sensitive topic for some to talk about. Through this documentary, we try to open a room for discussion as well as a means of reflection for all of us.  Divided into 5 chapters, this film represents several points of view, each of which should be taken into consideration by all of us to review how we should respond to this issue.

title: Baby Blues
overview: Dinda decides to stop working to take care of her newborn baby, while Dika is working hard to support her family. It turns out that having children is not what they both imagined. The intervention of the mother-in-law, Dance Mother, adds to the stress level. The accumulation of all this makes Dinda experience Baby Blues syndrome which slowly hurts Dinda and Dika's relationship. In the climax, Dinda's unintentional request was granted: they swap bodies. They must learn to understand and understand each other.

title: MADESU!!
overview: Saat kerinduan terhadap sekolah mempertemukan kembali mereka, Eca menjalani hari-hari SMA yang penuh cerita. Bersama teman-temannya yang unik dan penuh warna, mereka melewati masa remaja dengan berbagai kisahtawa, haru, kebersamaan, hingga cinta

title: Unhappy Together
overview: A Man and a Woman were smoking together on the side of the road. They were arguing in an emotionless voices. As the night went, a hidden secret was revealed.

title: HIBOB
overview: Sifa, Bram, and Hoho are having fun learning Javanese using the Rap method taught by Mas Kancil. The sound of hip hop music made them even more enthusiastic about learning several English manners which were used as song lyrics. In the midst of the excitement, suddenly a supernatural event occurred. The incident started because Bram was playing a sacred gong at Sifa's house. Unconsciously, Sifa, Ibu, Mas Kancil and Bram experienced "Switched Dimensions". Sifa's soul exchanged with her mother's soul, just as Bram's soul exchanged with Mas Kancil. This incident disrupted their study session, and even sparked a dispute between Sifa and her mother. Hoho, who realized that he was the only person whose soul had not been swapped, then tried to find a way to return the situation to normal.

title: Kemarin Semua Baik-Baik Saja
overview: A documentary filmmaker, was awaiting the birth of her first child during the Covid-19 pandemic. Meanwhile, he received a grant from Rekam Pandemi, a form of social safety net for arts workers to create documentaries that record the events and stories regarding the outbreak. Along the way, he met artists and arts exhibition organizers who were planning to hold exhibitions. He was later asked to collaborate on the making of audiovisual products as a strategy of organizing arts activities during the pandemic. Halfway through, his mother, who had been looking forward to having a grandchild for a long time, died of cirrhosis. He tried his best to get through the phases of life, birth, and death, all taking at the same time while he still had work to do.

title: Till the End, Friend
overview: It is a story about friendship, where one guy decided to befriend another group of friends who would eventually hurt him and his old friend, and fate would make him choose between his true friends or his new ones.

title: Marley
overview: This is a story about Doni, a school teacher who has a pitbull named Marley

title: The Other Side
overview: Alea is a 16-year-old teenager who recently moved from Jakarta to Bandung. This move is also used by Alea to erase the memory of her ex-boyfriend, Reynand, who turns out to be having an affair with her best friend.

title: Lagu Untuk Anakku
overview: An elderly choir group brings back erased violent history by singing songs that were written in prison and have been silenced for more than 50 years.

title: Best My Friend
overview: Ini luar biasa!!  Kami pasti akan memeriksanya!  Selamat Raja!!  Tingkatkan terus!!

title: What It Takes to Get a Shot
originalTitle: What It Takes to Get a Shot
overview: Damar, seorang aktor dalam suatu produksi shooting komersial, mengalami kesulitan dalam memerankan adegan, hingga membuat kru produksi tersebut kesal. Lawan mainnya, Kika, membantu Damar agar shooting dapat berjalan lancar.

title: Happy Anniversary
overview: Distance and time apart inspired the song " Walau Ku Jauh " by David Noah, beautifully performed by Christie. The single's powerful message also inspired the creation of a short film titled "Happy Anniversary."

title: Iblis Dalam Kandungan
overview: After 15 years of marriage and adopting two brothers Alani and Vito, Amelia became pregnant. In order to take care of his wife, who also suffers from high blood pressure, Verdi the husband, moved from Jakarta to a plantation company at the foot of Mount Salak.  Problems arise when the house they live in appears by the spirit of a woman who in the past lost a baby in her womb due to a mystical event. Now the spirit has come, trying to penetrate into Amelia's body to judge the baby in her womb. Vito and Alani, who realize the danger, try to protect their mother even though they have to face a life-threatening threat.  But as it turned out, the woman's spirit was the only danger he faced. There are other, more sinister forces that have never been thought of before.

title: Halo, Sis, Gan!
overview: A young man and a shaman who has an online bidding store that sell pseudo antiques must deal with various mysterious incidents after confronted by their disappointed customer.

title: YK48
overview: A documentary about the history of local film scene in Yogyakarta.

title: Waves of Emotions
overview: In a fishing village in Indonesia, the harsh realities of climate change have left their mark, dramatically altering life as its inhabitants knew it. Among them is Marno, a resilient man haunted by the memory of a calamitous storm from a year ago that robbed him of everything he once held dear. As he endeavors to rebuild and mend the fraying ties with his wife, his relationship with their only son remains his sole beacon of hope. Yet, beneath his persevering facade lies a tangle of grief and deep-seated denial. Avoiding the stark truth of his past, Marno’s sorrow tightens its grip, pushing him closer to the precipice of mental collapse. The tale is a poignant exploration of love, loss, and the profound impact of unresolved trauma.

title: Babad Wingking Griya
overview: Barokah (42) and Minah (47) have adjoining yards that they use as a shared space for drying laundry and keeping chickens. Minah's chickens often wander into Barokah's yard, causing a mess, especially when Barokah is preparing for her child's engagement event. Frustrated, Barokah decides to put up a fence to separate her backyard from Minah's.

title: Ambo Nai Sopir Andalan
overview: Ambo Nai was fired as an interregional passenger driver when his wife was heavily pregnant. However, his hopes were dashed when he received information from his friend that the fishmonger in Bajoe, Bone Regency, South Sulawesi was in need of a driver to take his fish to the city. Ambo Nai is sure that he can be accepted for work. He does not know the competition with fellow drivers in places where the fishmongers are very tough. The innocent Ambo Nai only has passion and honesty. He got the opportunity to work with the fishmonger. However, Ambo Nai has to deal with Blonde Boss and his minions, who have been controlling fish delivery at the skipper's place. When there was a special delivery to Makassar, the jury gave their trust to Ambo Nai, not to Bos Pirang who tried to thwart Ambo Nai's mission.

title: Garis Waktu
overview: April yang hobi menulis puisi bertemu dengan Senandika, musisi yang berhasil mencuri perhatian dengan filosofi dan prinsipnya. April, melihat potensi di Sena, memperkenalkannya kepada Sanya, produser muda sahabatnya. Konflik bermula saat April dan Sena saling jatuh cinta, namun dihalangi oleh restu ayah April, Halim.

title: Kusut

Set in 2010, when Evan was in elementary school, he went to school wearing his wrinkled shoes. At school, Evan was also the target of bullying by his naughty friends because of his wrinkled shoes. Actually, Evan could buy new shoes, but he preferred to wear his old ones and save up his money to buy a laptop.

title: Apa Kabar Dinda?
overview: The lights went out, then came back on. Laughter echoed throughout the house. Dinda kept running to avoid it, but couldn't.

title: Menyerah

But they have to wake up from the fairy tale and face the real love story that just loving is not enough. One of them must lose their true self and make them as far as the sun and the earth when before they were as close as a palm and a vein.

title: Pelangi Tanpa Warna
overview: An upper-class family deals with the mother's sudden Alzheimer's.

title: Arini by Love.inc

title: Maramba
overview: Maramba tells about the burial of the King of Sumba in Indonesia. The Marapu ritual exists to be a reflection of how Sumbanese have a sacred bond with nature and their ancestral line, as if there is no line of life that is disconnected from them. Umbu Mahani Pekulangu also known as Umbu Nai Tunga is the 16th descendant who occupies the island of East Sumba. He was the last remaining king of the Sumbanese people and buried based on their belief, namely the Marapu belief. After Umbu Nai Tunga died, all of his descendants agreed not to continue the royal system, and continue with the system implemented by the Republic of Indonesia.

title: Petang di Taman
overview: Events in the park are conflicts that have nothing to do with each other, which tells the struggle of humans in their presence against loneliness and ignorance. What is very ironic about this story is where the park which should be a place of comfort and tranquility for the people who visit it is here on the contrary.

title: Sukma Terbelenggu

Starting as a family in a normal house, the grandmother's hatred for Hesti (mother) and the frightening warning never to open the locked grandmother's room make the house full of terror and strangeness.  Follow the journey of Beby and her two friends as they discover more and more strange and mystical happenings in the house.

title: The Guest
overview: Yogi, seorang karyawan yang hidup sendirian di rumahnya. Suatu saat, seorang anak yang tidak dikenal masuk ke dalam rumahnya dan mengubah hidupnya.

title: Run: Live Free or Die
overview: Maya, a beautiful woman who works as a photographer, after an accident took her father's life, feelings of guilt and trauma for the incident are hard to get rid of from her mind, so Maya and her mother decide to move to a new place and atmosphere, where the memories of her father don't linger too long. psychologically disturbing. However, her move to live in her grandmother's residence brought new problems, because Maya accidentally saw a strange incident at the neighboring residence, which in the end made Maya's life threatened.

title: Ibu

What Siti did made her children worry and forbade her. Accompanied by her adopted son Jalu, Siti is determined to take care of Murni when her physical condition is getting weaker due to cancer.

title: Ben & Jody
overview: Sejak memutuskan keluar dari Filosofi Kopi, Ben tinggal di kampung halamannya dan aktif membela kelompok tani yang tanahnya diambil alih Perusahaan. originalTitle: Amrus Natalsya yang membuat kembali keluarga tandus disendja

title: A Daughter's Lullaby
overview: A girl is still dealing with the death of her father. In the midst of her relationship with a detached mother and her own struggle to find peace, she must confront an old wound she deeply buried.

title: Dear Nathan: Thank You Salma

Unfortunately, Nathan's time is torn apart after Rebecca asks him to help Zanna, who is sexually assaulted. Nathan is in a difficult position, because he has to protect Zanna's privacy and keep this matter a secret from everyone including Salma. The problem is compounded when Salma is close to Afkar, a musician who has long idolized Salma. Nathan never stopped fighting for justice for Zanna, but at the same time he was also not willing to lose Salma.

title: Angga dan Krisis Pagi Hari

title: Ibu Cilik

title: Misteri Villa Kayangan

Villa tersebut dihuni oleh dua orang Wanita cantik yang mengalami terror dari saudara tiri mereka karena memperebutkan harta warisan. Lalu kejadian seram mulai terjadi. Mulai dari terror pembunuhan sampai ke penampakan setan bergentayangan.

overview: Rey, a photographer, was conducting a pre-wedding photo session in Likupang when he discovered a mysterious female figure appearing in the photos.

title: Potret Kerukunan Antar Etnis di Indonesia: Tradisi Bakar Tongkang Bagansiapiapi Provinsi Riau
originalTitle: Potret Kerukunan Antar Etnis di Indonesia: Tradisi Bakar Tongkang Bagansiapiapi Provinsi Riau
overview: The Bakar Tongkang tradition in Bagansiapiapi symbolizes the homecoming of Chinese descendants who settled there. Burning the boat represents their ancestors' commitment to making this port their new home. This tradition, now a symbol of inter-ethnic and inter-religious harmony, continues to be celebrated by both Chinese and Malay communities in Riau.

title: Anak Danau
overview: Her mother was gone, a void in her heart. But a tiny fish, a gift from her father, filled it with hope. Until one fateful morning, when the fish was nowhere to be found.

title: Asal-usul Danau Maninjau
overview: Sani is the only daughter among 9 brothers. Despite being in a relationship with Giran, she unfortunately doesn’t receive approval from her eldest brother named Kukuban.

title: Petualangan Lima Beradik
overview: The King of a Malay kingdom falls gravely ill. Only a mystical geliga from Tasik Pauh Janggi Island can cure him, and so his children set out on a journey to the island to obtain it and save their father.

Sandi, sebagai pemuda suku Punan Batu yang sudah berdamai dengan kondisi lama dan modern, bercita-cita agar anak-anaknya bisa sekolah di kota, tetapi keluarganya menolak karena jarak yang jauh. Sandi yang khawatir dengan masa depan Punan Batu hanya bisa berharap agar masyarakat yang masih tinggal di hutan Sajau Benau bisa mendapatkan perhatian yang layak dan tidak mengganggu hutan.

title: Panen

title: Pindahan

overview: Rewind Indonesia 2021 tidak hanya menampilkan sederet peristiwa viral di tahun 2021, tetapi juga menjadi pengingat atas kreativitas dan pencapaian para content creator.

overview: abcdefghijklmn

When Yowis Ben's family is divided, Bayu is also threatened with breaking up with Asih because of Susan's presence.

overview: Di masa Isolasi Pandemi yang berkepanjangan, salah satu mahasiswa IT yang memiliki usaha jasa laptop yaitu Juki harus merasakan dampak buruknya. Tak hanya itu, kebutuhan hidup dan tunggakan biaya sewa membuatnya berbuat curang. Dengan cara menukarkan spare part RAM pada salah satu si kecil yang bernama Audi. Hingga akhirnya Juki dipanggil oleh akun media sosial misterius untuk datang ke rumah guna memperbaiki laptopnya.

title: Mula Nengah Pungkas
overview: Ibu rumah tangga bernama Sari yang juga seorang janda ditinggal suaminya meninggal dunia, harus bekerja membanting tulang untuk melunasi hutang-hutang sang suami.

overview: SWA: the ‘Self’ is metaphorically hidden  in a multi layered 5 sheath formation  of interlocking caves  we lose touch  with our true subtle selves,  when we identify with  a fluctuating mind  and the multiplicity  of a manifest reality  the film explores a vision...  to experience and merge  with the Universal Absolute;  is the culmination of Inner Spiritual Wealth  we need to be at peace  with ‘Wholeness’  thus in our lucid states of meditation...  our consciousness experiences  a joyful sharing of the same space  as the ETERNAL INFINITE;  an eternal infinite, that supports all mutations...  the effortless sublime state of ‘Samadhi’  we are enlightened...  as the film, elevates human consciousness

overview: The film tells about the various activities of citizens in 9 regions of Indonesia during the pandemic. Starting with morning activities until the evening, where the situation in each location is very different. The issue of pandemics and the application of health protocols is the most common problem in each location, as well as in other parts of the world. The existence of the Corona virus that is not visible in front of the eyes makes some residents see it as not a dangerous threat. This film records fragments of events from various perspectives of residents with their respective activities. The story of each location is combined into visual poems, which can be related or unrelated. The most important thing about this film's story is how culturally people face a pandemic which is recorded with the simplest cameras.

title: The Last One Hundred and Fifty Seconds
originalTitle: The Last One Hundred and Fifty Seconds

When he crosses paths with a tough female fighter named Iteung, Ajo gets beaten black and blue, but he also falls head over heels in love. Will Ajo’s path lead him to a happy life with Iteung, and, eventually, his own peace of mind?

After the Java War ended, Java entered a new order that can be called the modern era. The post-Java War and Cultuurstelsel agreement led to a decline in self-confidence, social, economic, political, and cultural.

title: Ibu Ora Sare

Brenda (F/26), a former military academy student as well as a judo athlete, decided to go to the forest to get away from the city, but Brenda faced a problem due to not having a supply of gas mask filters. Brenda who found information in the middle of the forest immediately approached, but it was not that easy. Brenda had to make an exchange with Toni (M/28) by exchanging rifles, and where Brenda did not allow it, because this rifle was a means of protecting herself. Then Brenda was expelled, because Brenda's ambition was so great she kept trying to get what she wanted, including hurting other people.

Rizal and his two friends became illegal sugar carriers from Malaysia to Indonesia, through the “rat route” for several days and got quite a large fee.
