In one tiring night of survival, a family secret is revealed. Alya will break the promise she swore to her mother she will keep. The other two children, Alma and Andra, fight for their individuality feud. In the midst of a family crisis, the children, Alya, Alma, and Andra soon realize that they don't really know anything about their own mother. Who he really is? And who is their father? Meanwhile, two doctors, Dr. Myra and Dr. Miyagi struggles with the reality of the inability of medical care in the face of imminent death.

title: Marapu, Fire & Ritual
overview: Marapu, Fire & Ritual is a story that follows Pak Ledi, Poho Maga’s uncle, as he overcomes his family’s tarnished reputation by taking responsibility to fix the past. He believes it is the right timing to conduct a sacred four day ritual to invite the Marapu spirits back into the village. But not everyone agrees to this. Pak Ledi must first unite the village leaders.

title: The Scent of Rat Carcasses
overview: After the death of the head of the family, Nina finds herself taking over the household responsibilities. While still grieving, she has to care for the house—beginning with the removal of dead rats.

title: Pindah Ke Bulan
overview: The pandemic isn't over yet. Many countries have re-implemented lockdowns, even countries big talk will go to the moon. A boy named Zeldi really wanted to go to month. One time his unemployed father discovered a program to move to the moon but turned out to be too expensive. Zeldi found a way for them to pay the cost.

title: Usaha Keluarga
overview: On the early pandemic of Covid-19, Adel's family struggles to maintain livelihood as her mother had her work terminated by the office. The family consist of 5 kids to protect. So by then, they decided to open a family business, lead by her mom as she knows the best about food. With everyone helping around and discussing the future of the business, it led to many adventure for them as family.

title: Tak Bicara Bersuara
overview: One night Monalisa is getting asked by mysterious voice from her body.

title: Wa’anak Witu Watu
overview: Based on a popular myth in Minahasa, Indonesia, Wa’anak Witu Watu explores the conception of the goddess Karema who was birthed from a stone as well as the rituals surrounding stone worship today.

title: Kelambu
overview: Murni wants to be ronggeng but she doesn't want tradition  to serve men keep going. With the help of Pandu, her  educated little friend, they try  lying to the public that Murni has opened  "kelambu" with him. But the lie doesn't work  smooth when she rejects other men who want to sleep  with her and made all the citizens turn around  insulted her. This made Pandu expelled, they thought  educated people are against the culture and both of them  finally separated.

title: Langit Kala Senja
overview: Langit harbors a love for his half-sister named Senja, but the mother does not give her blessing. Langit is a novelist while Senja is a junior editor at the publisher where Langit usually writes for publication. The publisher boss named Kala is obsessed with getting Langit's heart by using Kala as a tool to approach him. Kala was in a very difficult position to determine the answer between heart, career and rest.

title: One Night Stand
overview: A young man must attend two major events in one funeral and wedding day. In those two events, he met the woman who would change his life.

title: The Enigma of HeDonism
overview: The Enigma of Hedonism are profile documentaries that tell the life of Heri Dono. His attitude and view as an artist that transcends canvas and time has had an important impact on artists and artists in other fields in their work. Not only that, his exploration of the various and types of working mediums and the experience of participating in various prestigious exhibitions in the world has made him dubbed as the greatest artist of Indonesia today.

title: Kadet 1947
overview: When the Dutch initiates an aggression against Indonesia to regain its rule post World War II, a group of inexperienced cadets need to defend the last remaining airbase so they may have a chance to help the Republic win the revolutionary war and to protect what they have come to care for.

title: Yowis Ben 3
overview: Bayu's life is comfortable, apart from Yowis Ben's growing popularity, Asih, his girlfriend, also always supports Bayu in his every dream. Bayu begins to feel anxious about his future when Nando, his keyboard player, decides to study music abroad, Cak Jon decides to leave Yowis Ben and pursue his love, Mbak Rini, who is engaged to an officer, Captain Arjuna. The situation is made worse by the arrival of Susan, Bayu's ex, who makes them close again without Asih's knowledge. Will Bayu succeed in defending Yowis Ben and maintaining Asih's love, when Bayu is secretly close to Susan again?

title: Temimpi Maunjun
overview: Someone tells of a dream he had, which was to go fishing and get lots of fish, this kind of dream is often associated with a symbol of good luck. But he was afraid that the dream would happen again and again, from generation to generation.

title: DOLO
overview: Ia adalah guru. Ia adalah seorang ibu bagi seniman-seniman muda, ibu bagi para aktivis pergerakan sosial dan kebudayaan. Indonesia memiliki luka sejarah yang panjang dan tak terselesaikan, mulai dari peristiwa 1965, pembungkaman para aktivis demokrasi dan hak asasi manusia, dan merebaknya politik identitas. Di tengah itu semua, DOLO, seorang pematung perempuan membuka luka-luka sejarah tersebut melalui karya-karya patungnya.

title: Pelebon Ring Pandemi
overview: This documentary tells/explains the pelebon of a pair of sulinggih in this Corona pandemic situation, the difference between pelebon/cremation as usual in Bali, with pelebon/cremation during the pandemic, especially corpses that have been exposed to covid. Then they found and used a very unique, simple method, a method very rarely used by Balinese people to carry out pelebon, namely using Tirta Prenawa Pengawak Solas. This film also inserts a "little" love story of a husband and wife until death picks them up. The couple had made a promise that the husband would die first. However, the wife did not keep her promise and died first. The husband felt disappointed, devastated, and sad because the wife did not keep her promise. Because their love is so strong that they are not separated from each other, the husband is "trusted" to "let go" of himself and then follow his wife.

title: Masa Mengenang
overview: My grandfather's historical narrative of the Indonesian people's movement in Malaysia which is not mentioned in official history.

title: Menegakkan Tiang
overview: Suatu hari, sekelompok pekerja bersiap-siap untuk menegakkan kayu penyangga sebuah masjid.

title: Suatu Hari di Tempat Pemancingan
overview: Some men can't go to their hometown due to Covid-19 Isolation. They talk about it while fishing.

title: Culas
overview: Yana, a debt collector at an illegal online loan company, is caught in a conflict of interest when she has to collect from her best friend, Desi, who is in arrears at the company where Yana works. Yana’s sincerity is tested whether she really cares for Desi or expects something else. In the end, money becomes an obstacle in human relations.

title: Dari Hal Waktu
overview: Fajar Suharno was a theater maestro from the 80's to the 90's. He was imprisoned because his theater activities were considered against the New Order government. At its peak, he made a show entitled "Geger Uwong Ngoyak Macan" about the events of crushing people who were considered thugs/criminals (Petrus). The show was held exactly the day before the massacre took place

title: ... And That's What a Marriage Is
originalTitle: ... And That's What a Marriage Is
overview: A film director meets a dancer and they go around the city all day. He finds something from her that he doesn't find from his wife.

title: A Tale Before Nightfall
overview: Ayu (35), a woman who works in Jakarta decided to kidnap Clara (9), her employer's daughter to her hometown.

title: Don't Be a Stranger
overview: A pair of strangers with a shared past are stuck together when their bus breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

title: Please Be Quiet
overview: Seorang karyawan wanita tanpa sengaja menyaksikan insiden yang tidak pantas di tempat kerjanya dan dia memikirkan apa yang harus dia lakukan dengan rahasia tersebut.

title: Cinta Bete
overview: When Bete Kaebauk, who lives in Atambua, NTT, started getting her period, she was “introduced” by her own father, Fritz Manek, that she was ready for a marriage proposal. Emilio was the first man Bete fell in love with. They both like it. But Emilio wanted to be a priest. Alfredo's presence for a moment made him happy. Despite having different social classes and Alfredo being unable to pay the dowry for his marriage, Bete decides to elope with Alfredo. Bete's life is not as beautiful as he imagined. He gets violent treatment from Alfredo. Bete forced to return home pregnant. On the way, the baby died in her womb. He rages like a madman and keeps him locked up in his house. Emilio who has become a brother returns to his village and tries to treat Bete as one of his congregation. He put Bete in the rectory, and took care of her. Alfredo did not accept it and together with several residents went to the rectory.

title: Losmen Bu Broto
overview: Losmen Bu Broto is an inn managed by Bu Broto, Pak Broto and their children. However, a problem arises, worsening a  conflict within the family.

title: Ranah 3 Warna
overview: Alif had just graduated from Pondok Madani. He returned to Maninjau and couldn't wait to start college. However, his friend, Randai, doubted that Alif would pass the entrance exam for university because he did not have a high school certificate. He obtained the certificate and passed the exam at Padjadjaran University. Then, Alif's father's passing forever nearly made him despair. His favorite proverb, "man jadda wa jada," which means "whoever strives will succeed," seemed insufficient to face life, so he remembered his other favorite proverb, "man shabara zhafira," meaning "whoever is patient will be successful." Armed with these two sayings, Alif tried not to be afraid in the face of every obstacle in his life.

title: Snow Coke
overview: A teacher must unravel the strings of occurrences that may connect with him after a tragedy strikes at a school where he teaches.

title: Momok
overview: Being scolded while playing, three children plot small revenge on an old lady. A decision they regret later.

title: Philosophy of Death
overview: When Death talks about the meaning of life.

title: My Dear Spectre
overview: When a lady goes home to her apartment after a hard day at work, an apparition of one from her past appears in her presence. Her bittersweet memories then shows as flashbacks in the presence of the spectre, reminding her of what used to be.

title: Camcorder
overview: Geraldine tanpa sengaja menemukan camcorder tua di gudang kantornya. Hal itu membuat Geraldine masuk ke alam lain.

title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
overview: Irma, a successful fashion designer is trying to reject the proposal of the man from her past that she loves, Yusuf. The reason is because Irma does not want to leave her father who she considers the last door to heaven.

title: Paranoia
overview: Dina runs away with her teenage daughter Laura after her abusive husband Gion gets imprisoned. However, Gion is released from the prison due to the pandemic and Dina is panicking because not only she took Laura but also took Gion’s valuable antique statue away. Raka, a mysterious man appears and makes things even more complicated.

title: Sudut Mati Komedi
overview: A documentary that explores aspects of the comedy world that are often unseen by the general public, the struggles of being funny, the realities of working in comedy, the dark side of comedy, and its correlation with mental health issues and depression, as well as other matters related to the world of comedy and comedians.

title: Salim & His Noodle Family
overview: Keluarga Salim yang ditinggal sosok istri sekaligus ibu bagi anak - anaknya membuat kecang-gungan antara Salim dan Yusuf yang berbeda pendapat soal akan diapakan jenazah ibunya, hingga akan dibawa kemana masa depan keluarga mereka.

title: Sorot
overview: Raka has an imaginary friend who seems to voice his thoughts on the chat he reads. His imaginary friend let out a kind remark when the group talked about good and bad things

title: Enchanted
overview: Alvian, a tour participant who has a heart for the Banten Indah tour guide named Salsabila. Love made Alvian take all the tours directed by Salsabila. Because he didn't want to see Salsabila sad, Alvian secretly helped Salsabila. Until finally Alvian dared to say love.

title: Soekma
overview: Sukma (40), seorang janda yang berprofesi sebagai ART, ingin membuktikan bahwa ia  tidak mencuri cincin milik Tutik (48), tetapi ia tidak dipercaya karena keadaan  ekonominya yang kurang dan kejadian di masa lalunya.

title: Liku
overview: Rudi (35) merupakan seorang office boy yang harus di PHK oleh perusahaan karena mengalami kerugian terus-menerus. Saat ini ia bingung harus mencari uang dari mana, Rudi pun cukup banyak memiliki utang yang harus dibayar secepatnya. Rudi memberitahu kepada istrinya, Yulia. Yulia akhirnya mendesak Rudi untuk kembali menjadi calo SIM. Setelah berpikir panjang, Ia akhirnya menerima permintaan istrinya karena ia sudah putus asa mencari uang. Suatu ketika, ia mendapatkan pelanggan yang menerima jasanya. Namun, ternyata pelanggan itu adalah seorang polisi yang menyamar menjadi pemohon SIM.

title: Malang-Malang Putung
overview: Sheila was asked by her brother, Rijal, to sell his laptop. As it turned out, before the laptop gets to Sheila, a fraud took the laptop from the post office. Sheila, Rijal, and their friends traced the disappearance of the laptop through the ID card that had been sent by the fraud.

title: Bisikan Jenazah
overview: Aldi and Emma are a newlywed couple, Aldi from Indonesia and Emma from Malaysia. After getting married, they wanted to go on a honeymoon to Ipoh, but Aldi had work in Kuala Lumpur for a few days, they also looked for lodging in Kuala Lumpur, but they got lost in a place they had never been to. They don't know that it turns out that the house is a haunted house, where the owner Sukri is a devil worshiper and his wife and children were killed in the house to become the devil's sacrifice. Emma is always terrorized by the spirits of Sukri's wife and children. And the climax is when Emma is possessed by the spirit of Sukri who turns out to also die as a victim of the devil.

title: SINTAS
overview: Raras is a 16-year-old girl from a broken home who lives with her workaholic father. Due to his nature, the relationship between Raras and her father is strained and disharmonious. As a result, Raras has grown into a withdrawn individual who lacks affection. She also has a boyfriend named Rio, who is significantly older than her.  One day, Raras becomes determined to end her relationship with Rio, as she can no longer endure his toxic, dominant, and abusive behavior. Ultimately, this leads to Rio spreading Raras's private photos that were taken and distributed without her knowledge and consent.

title: Nirmala (To Preserve a Sunflower)
overview: Nirmala, a young woman full of dreams with a fear of darkness, involves in an intimate relationship with the Sun. Living with her protective Aunt, Nirmala begins to find comfort in Bayu, her close friend. As they get closer, Nirmala strays away from the Sun, unknowingly bringing darkness into her life.

title: Dedari
overview: Indonesia has a variety of local wisdom to prevent or fight epidemics.  This ritual is not just incantations and prayers but in the form of dances and poetry which are still preserved today.  The Sang Hyang Dedari dance combines dance and chants to drive away reinforcements and ask for the protection of the gods.  This dance is very related to what is happening in the world today, a pagebluk that destroys human life.  This pandemic is nature's answer to human greed. Only by purifying the heart, nature and knowledge can all these obstacles be overcome together.

title: Story of Dinda: Second Chance of Happiness
originalTitle: Story of Dinda: Second Chance of Happiness
overview: Dinda just wants to be happy, but often reality does not match expectations. But now he meets someone who makes him realize: good love is not always full of wounds. A sense of calm that is not restrained, maturity that is not excessive and still gives freedom to every childish nature.

title: Dua Pilar Satu Atap
overview: A father reconnects with his long lost daughter, and wants to readopt her after no contact for years. Religious differences between the two of them complicates things.

title: Siklus
overview: The story of a dancer who finds mysterious objects in the practice room. The things that brought her gave birth to a new spirit and choreography. Things from a mysterious man who turns out to be a maestro from the past.

title: Janji Dari Iblis
overview: Pada tahun 1998, Devi adalah gadis lugu yang memiliki asal muasal kelam dan mengerikan. cerita-cerita kelam dalam dirinya disembunyikan oleh keluarga nya terutama kakak kandung nya sendiri.  Devi bukan seorang anak biasa, di dalam jiwa raganya terdapat benih tabur sang Iblis.

title: Mimpi Pati di Ujung Selatan
overview: Pati Amar (Andika Nugraha) wants to get a proper education. Pati Amar's struggle to get an education is not easy, because Pati Bahri (Budi Semprul), his father, forbids Pati Amar and his sister Hamidah (Sephia Amanda) to go to school. Hamidah is betrothed to Aimar (Eggie Frestisio), a young and arrogant young man. Pati Amar and Hamidah's enthusiasm continues thanks to the help of their best friend Mohammad Hanan (Sultan Ghari).

title: Bangka I'm in Love
overview: Four medical students from Jakarta, Bima, Gaga, Sela and Bibi does research on medicinal plants on the island of Bangka. In this research, Bima asks Via, the children of the Ikatan Cinta Orphanage and Ana et al for help. While searching for medicinal plants, Fika gets lost and is bullied by Ana et al. Bima stops the process of searching for medicinal plants and looks for Fika. In addition, the orphanage will be confiscated because it is in debt.

title: Anxietus Domicupus
overview: Dopaminus, seorang gadis pengidap kecemasan yang tinggal di sarkofagus terbang mendapat job mengantar barang ke Endorfinus, alien yang tinggal di planet mini. Di sana Dopaminus dibayang-bayangi oleh Rampokanus, anggota sekte berhaluan garis keras. Dopaminus menghajar mereka dalam pertarungan pedang. Sementara itu Dopaminus mencari jalan untuk meredakan kecemasannya.

title: The Tortured Painting
overview: About a painter who romanticizes the myth of a tortured artist

title: Udin's Inferno
overview: Set in an Indonesian suburban Middle-Class neighborhood, Udin’s Inferno, tells a story about 12 years old kid named Udin, who got traumatized after reading a comic book about a depiction of hell torture. In the book, Udin sees a very graphic and disturbing violent depiction of tormented sinners that haunts him throughout the day. One of the sinners in the book is a person who got a tattoo in his life. One of his friends mocks Udin, a tattooed person in the book is Udin’s father, a guy who got tattoos all over his body. Udin thinks if he can manage to erase his father’s tattoo, he can save him and his father from getting to hell in the afterlife. Udin tries all efforts to erase his father’s tattoo which he obviously fails. Udin cannot deal with his obvious failure. He got even more haunted by his own depiction of hell not only when he was awake, but also in his sleep. In the end, his fears and trauma turn into a nightmare.

title: Roh Mati Paksa
overview: Ketika Sepasang Muda Mudi yang terjebak dalam manisnya cinta, harus menerima akibat dari perbuatanya, keangkuhan Boy (Arnold Leonard) mempermainkan perasaan Lastry (Dea Annisa) menjadi penyebab segala teror yang terjadi pada teman-temannya kecuali Vina (Gabriella Larasati) di sebuah villa terpencil milik kakek Boy.

title: The Rumbling in the Night
overview: A kid secretly plays a video game in the middle of the night. When he suddenly felt hungry, he must take a food in the fridge without waking up his father.

title: Seraoet Wadjah Dibalik Tjermin
overview: Idah memutuskan pulang setelah menerima luka yang lebam. Kemudian, pada perjalanan pulang Idah bertemu orang-orang yang menguapkan ingatan mereka masing-masing.

title: A World Without
overview: Founded by the power couple, Ali and Sofia Khan, The Light is a training center that claims to be a self-betterment organization, focused on helping youths take charge of their life for a brighter future. But when three best friends join this organization, they soon realize that dark shadows lurk behind The Light and must find a way to escape.

title: Cipak Cipuk
overview: Two bickering siblings unite to fight pirates who want to steal their precious Sun Pearl necklace that’s needed for their family ritual.

title: Nussa
overview: Planning to impress his father who is coming home after being abroad for a year, Nussa the smart 9-year-old kid participates in his school’s science competition. But when he receives news that his father cancelled his trip home and is unable to attend the competition, and at the same time a new, smart student named Jonni quickly becomes his rival in the school's science competition, Nussa learns the true meaning of gratitude.

title: Selangkah ke Seberang
overview: An ex-athlete woke up from a dream that she was going to die. Finding all the clues from her dream in reality, she tries to prevent her death. But she always seems to be getting closer to her destiny.

title: 20AN
overview: Dimas ( 20 tahun ) baru saja mengalami duka karena pandemi dan menjadi sebatang kara dirumah. Dimas menaruh banyak harapan diusia 20 tahun. Namun Dimas seringkali merasa tidak percaya lagi dengan adanya harapan, karena semua yang pernah dekat, menghilang begitu saja. Terlepas dari semuanya itu, Dimas mencoba untuk hidup dengan sebaik-baiknya dimasa pandemi ini.

title: Eyang Putri
overview: Tells the story of a brother and sister who finally decide to take care of their grandparents who turns out to be keeping a sinister secret which, in fact, the longer the secret is kept, the more often they are terrorized by the unseen.

title: Laut Memanggilku
overview: A young boy, Sura, lives alone and lonely in a fishing village. He earns money from chores while waiting for his father, who may never return. One day, he finds a broken sex doll washed ashore, and tries to fix it.

title: Hompimpa
overview: After receiving a text from Jena, their long-dead friends Angel, Niko, Ririn and Lili must overcome dangerous obstacles whose goal is to take their lives. With the help of Asher and Moira who are caught up in this game, they must find out the mastermind behind Jena's guise and stop him.

title: Aku Lupa Aku Luka
overview: Surviving an assassination attempt that causes her to lose her memory, Laura tries to find her identity and finds herself even more trapped in a dark case that befell her.

title: Penyalin Cahaya
overview: When photos of her at a party cause her to lose a scholarship, a student investigates whether something devastating happened to her that night.

title: My Clouded Mind
overview: Naura,19, ended her long-distance relationship after her boyfriend revealed a different side of him.

title: Zerre: Pendekar Ufuk Timur
overview: Zerre, a man from Papua, decided to train himself to be a warrior after his self-esteem was lowered by his rivals, he joined PON to solve his problems with his rivals.

title: End of the Tunnel
overview: Dody Iskandar, Abdul Karim, and Taufik Zulfikri are three blind individuals with different levels of visual impairment. All three have a passion for watching and producing films, and express this passion by watching films, producing films independently, and playing an active role as participants in Inklusi Film Indonesia (INFI), a community for individuals with disabilities to produce and enjoy films.

title: Njuk Ngapuro
overview: Released early on remission during the COVID-19 pandemic, a former prisoner joins her grandmother on a walk that slowly leads her toward an unexpected reckoning with the past she thought she had left behind.

title: AUM!
overview: The story of the struggle of Satriya and Adam who fought together with other fellow activists for a common goal: change.

title: Necessity of Life
overview: At midnight, a middle-aged taxi driver must drive his female passenger home but his intentions are unclear.

title: Distraction from Heaven
overview: Abu (20), a band musician who was expelled from his old boarding house due to problems with payments that were in arrears, armed with information from social media, he was forced to move to an attic room with a cheap rental price with damp and dark conditions

title: Semara
overview: Sari (26) comes into the life of Adi (28), a man who has been completely blind since birth, as a neighbor in the rented house he recently lived in. Sari always visits in the afternoon, to check on Adi's condition, who recently lived alone. Melted by Sari's attention, Adi wants to be able to see, wants to be with his girlfriend longer.

title: Black Hole
overview: When Rizky woke up, he immediately took care of household chores, such as cleaning, sweeping and cooking. Meanwhile, Rizky's father left and his destination was unclear. Rizky likes one of his favorite soap operas with his playmate, Amel. However, due to the absence of supervision, they suddenly saw a scene they were not supposed to watch.

title: Mitos Kampus
overview: Agni has to figure out whether the campus curse, which claims that whoever got it must compete with another person for likes on social media or they would die, is real or not before she dies as well.

title: The Watcher
overview: Krishna who had to languish at home because of an injury. In order not to get bored, he uses the binoculars his friends gave him to look at his beautiful neighbor named Tiara.  One day, Krishna accidentally found out that a group of people were planning to kidnap Tiara. He tried to stop the plan before it was too late.

title: Cheap Thrills
overview: Two strangers hook up and then talk about hook-up culture, the first time they had sex, coming-out and what it feels like to be gay in a largest Moslem country in the world.

title: Nyanyian Teras Rumah
overview: It has been tens of years that Father & Mother were left by their child who did not know where to go. Patiently Mr. & Mrs. waiting for the presence of the child in front of the terrace of his house. A deep song is always uttered by the father and mother when they are waiting for the arrival of the child. But the child never came. Father & Mother's body is not as great as it used to be, but patiently, Father & Mother always wait for the Son faithfully in front of the terrace of his house. Until finally where the child returned home with great regret when he found out that Father & Mother were gone.

title: Ibu
overview: A 60 year old mother who lives alone at home and does everything herself. A few months later, the mother's son named Zainal (30 years old) and his wife Siti (28 years old) and their daughter named Anggit (10 years old) returned from overseas because the company where Zainal worked went bankrupt. Mother was happy because her son returned. However, his son Zainal doesn't care about his mother anymore. Zainal could not stand the presence of his mother in the house. Until one day Zainal called his younger sister Ana (27 years) who has been successful in the overseas. To take his mother abroad with Ana. But Ana did not want and objected if her mother lived with her.

title: Kepada Istriku
overview: Upon the death of his wife, Yohan keeps a coffin in his bedroom and insists on being left alone, leaving his children baffled by their father’s behavior.

title: Tour de Serpong
overview: Anton ran away from home to study in Paris. After a scholarship scam, he ends up in Serpong. He meets Komang, who will then take him around to find Paris within Serpong.

title: Poster Joni
overview: Joni, a lonely junkman, struggles to avoid being distracted by an annoying Narrator who disapproves of his love affair with a poster.

title: Omong Kosong Yang Manis
overview: Pilkades (village head election) will still be held in a village when the virus pandemic hits. Sunarta is a village head who will nominate again using other means of campaigning other than using MMT. At the same time, mass back pain also occurred in the village, making Bahar a mosque takmir who felt restless because his mosque was always quiet. The unused mosque car also took part in the Sunarta campaign at the Village Health Center.

title: Urban Clown
overview: Dika, seorang pelayan rumah makan yang memiliki jerawat di pipinya. Sebelum berangkat kerja, Ia bercermin lalu mencabut jerawatnya yang telah matang. Atasannya menyinggung penampilan Dika yang bekerja melayani pelanggan. Atasan menyarankannya untuk memakai topeng logo rumah makan. Penampakan Dika yang memakai topeng menyebabkan rumah makan semakin ramai pelanggan. Atasan kemudian menyuruhnya untuk tetap memakai topeng, namunn kali ini dilengkapi dengan kostum badut.

title: THE GREBEK: DARK JOKES COMEDY! AYAM BAKAR PENGHUNI JERUJI
originalTitle: THE GREBEK: DARK JOKES COMEDY! AYAM BAKAR PENGHUNI JERUJI
overview: The Grebek, Ngawur Short Movie

title: Pandemi(e): Gumpalan
overview: Isa, a teenager who is currently self-isolating, gets a delivery of food. When opened, it was filled with noodles. Instead of being full, Isa got heartburn and nauseous after eating it, what's behind the noodles?

title: Pandemi(e): Berpulang
overview: Ilham woke up from his sleep in the middle of the night because he was hungry. Ilham was forced to make instant noodles, even though he was forced to fight his fear. Because his brother had just died, while his brother's body was still lying in the living room.

title: Pandemi(e): Arumi & Lidah Pocong
overview: Arumi feels frustrated because she lost her soy sauce during her self-isolation, even though she misses eating noodles. So he ordered Liur Pocong as a flavoring ingredient for his noodles. But Arumi is not aware of the danger behind Pocong's tongue.

title: Pandemi(e): Mie Level Setan
overview: Dinda, just recovered from a virus but is still restrained by her sister to stay at home and eat healthy food. Unfortunately, Dinda is someone who is addicted to spicy instant noodles. Until finally, something scary happened.

title: Starlight
overview: Gita merasa aneh saat satu akun anonim selalu menandainya di tiap postingan Instagram. Kemudian di saat bersamaan ia kerap bertemu seorang pria yang anehnya selalu memiliki barang yang sama dengannya

title: Srikandi
overview: This fantasy drama is a modern retelling of an Indonesian myth of the same name. After her father's death that took a toll on the family's income, teenage Anjani struggles to regain control as her mother tries to sell the house, which doubled as her father's puppetry studio. Little did she know that he has been teaching her the ways of a shadow puppeteer in private, as women are not allowed to practice it. When she returns to the puppets, Anjani is able to reconvene with her father's spirit, learning one final lesson through the artform before she sets out to realize her own future - becoming a modern Srikandi.

title: Kabar Buruk
overview: Di masa pandemi, Satria yang tinggal jauh dari keluarganya tiba-tiba mendapat telepon dari ayahnya yang membawa kabar buruk.

title: Kelana Citra Jakarta
overview: Indonesia had their so-called golden age of cinema during Soeharto's regime (1966-1998). This was marked by the increasing number of films being made, prominence of key film industry people, and censorship. Because of this, Soeharto is aware of the power of cinema. This documentary attempts to map out how the Indonesian cinematic language progresses despite the many endeavors to suppress it, and how it begins at the New Order capital of cinema, Jakarta.

title: Rotasi
overview: Pada suatu sore, di suatu tempat, seorang anak basket yang bosan memasuki tanah kosong di tengah kota. Setiap tanah kosong adalah 'milik mereka'. Dia memutar tubuhnya, tetapi kemudian dia tidak sendirian.

title: Lika Liku Laki
overview: In a city when the ‘men’ have to go crazy about football, Akbar has to pretend to love football in order to prevent rejection.

title: Telur
overview: Ziya tells the story of the discrimination she experienced through two egg characters that she brings to life in her world.

title: Self Control
overview: The story of a young man who misses his friends but can't meet them because of the pandemic.

title: Menunggu Sore Setelahnya
overview: Lie down in the afternoon

title: Tampias
overview: Wahyu, a high school boy who must witness the relationship between his parents which is no longer harmonious. Under the same roof they live together, but their relationship is like strangers who have no connection.

title: Notebook
overview: Muslim teacher Rintik is desperate to go to Sumba to teach. He falls in love with Sumba and a young man, Arsa, even though many of them have different beliefs from Rintik himself. Can they unite in differences?

title: Two Language and A Sausage
overview: Bunga, an introverted translator, experiences flashbacks of past sexual trauma and the only person she could turn to for solace is Bintang, an erotic movie star.

title: Sebuah Surat Untuk Istriku
overview: A short documentary about a husband’s longing for his wife, presented through the longing rhymes that adorn his bland life.

title: Preman Pensiun: Manusia Merdeka
overview: Kang Mus plans to renovate and enlarge the mosque in his hometown. However, he faces the issue of a developer purchasing community land for a tourism project, sparking conflict and terror from certain groups.

title: Kisah Suara Pramuda
overview: A story of Rara who just got accepted in her dream campus, Padjadjaran University. A struggles Rara's going on during her campus activity from the orientation activities, difficult times in classes, the dilemmas experienced by a student who wandered, until finally she was able to finished her studies.

title: Bawor
overview: Dimas (8 tahun) mulai mempertanyakan simbol Bawor yang dia temui hampir di seluruh sudut kotanya. Dito (20 tahun) sebagai kakak pun menjawab segala pertanyaan tersebut. Namun disaat Dito menceritakan sosok Bawor, Dimas justru tertidur. Saat terbangun, Dimas terkejut melihat dirinya menyerupai sosok yang selama ini dia pertanyakan.

title: Balada Sepasang Kekasih Gila
overview: An accidental meeting between Jarot and Lastri produces seeds of deep love and longing. This is a love story of a couple who are considered crazy by those who claim to be sane. But why do people who claim to be sane more often do crazy things to them?

title: Casting Terakhir
overview: Yuli yang bekerja sebagai bagian casting di sebuah production house sedang lembur menyelesaikan data casting. Lalu saat malam datang empat anak perempuan berpenampilan seram untuk mengikuti casting.

title: Planga O Plongo
overview: A film about a person who is remembering the outside world when he is trapped in restrictions during the covid-19 outbreak.

title: Senandika
overview: What's the difference between reality and imagination?

title: Bangau
overview: She never quite fits in anywhere, she is neither This nor That. How and where does she belong then? Where is home?

title: Selesai
overview: Ayu wants to leave her partner, Broto, because she is tired of being cheated on. However, the pandemic lockdown comes, and her mother-in-law arrives at their home. In the midst of Ayu's efforts to protect her mother-in-law's feelings, Broto discovers a new fact about his wife that has never been revealed before.

title: Serigala Langit
overview: Gadhing Baskara is a new combat pilot in the Sky Wolf Squadron. Because so far he is always the best in taking flight academies and schools, he feels he would easily become the best in the Sky Wolf Squadron. This excessive self-confidence makes him arrogant so that senior pilots do not like him.

title: life, what is it anyway?
overview: about a boy who telling his personal life

title: Head In The Clouds
overview: Laiila’s journey that looking for an answer to the questions that plagued her mind. In the middle of her journey, Ale comes to help Laiila to define what happiness truly is.

title: Ghibah
overview: Firly dan teman-teman satu kosnya, Dina dan Ulfa, memiliki kebiasaan untuk membicarakan orang. Hingga Firly menyadari ada sesuatu yang tidak beres pada dirinya, ketika ia menjadi suka mengkonsumsi daging mentah padahal ia seorang vegetarian. Bahkan bau tubuh mereka seperti bangkai, karena orang ghibah sama seperti makan bangkai saudaranya sendiri. Hubungan Firly dengan teman kampus pun merenggang. Cuma Arga yang tak pernah menjauhinya. Mereka mencoba mencari jalan keluar bersama.

title: Sungai
overview: The political crisis in 1965 is a trauma, terror, and violence inflicting tragedy. Most victims were murdered without trial. Rivers are stages of the massacre, which holds the tragedy.

title: Dear to Me
overview: A 27-year-old Indonesian, Tim, is having a family vacation with both of his parents on a remote island far from the city, where they learn about the myth of a reincarnated deer that exists somewhere along the beach. Island locals believe that seeing the deer is a sign of meeting one’s soulmate. Tim is the only one who secretly hoping to discover the deer, hiding his desire from his very devout Christian parents.

title: Pengikut Jahanam
overview: kisah perjalanan hidup seorang anak laki-laki bernama Verick yang lahir dari keluarga keturunan Mangkujiwo yang darah suci nya banyak diincar oleh para penyihir.

title: Short on Cash
overview: What could you do with two thousand rupiah? In this journey a bill of two thousand rupiah will walk you through humans' life full of diversity in way of thinking. The two thousand rupiah bill will explain and observe the money-engaging activities of human life especially with thousand rupiah bill, just like a documentary resource person do. A bill of two thousand rupiah sarcasticly notes comment on humans who use it.

title: Brighter, Brighter Day
overview: A mentally deranged man in a constant battle with himself decided that there's one more thing left for him to do.

title: Dua Ikan dan Sepiring Nasi
overview: One morning in the village, a woman, 30, came to the house she used to live in. It was quiet until she saw a man named Rosman, 25, cooking in the kitchen and her husband Paimo, 32, was getting ready to harvest fish from the pond. They have an awkward conversation that leads them to a shocking fact in one day.

title: Balada Cinta Peknggo!
overview: A neighbor couple must face the hatred and gossips coming for them because people thought that they are not compatible to each other. However, they always believed that they could become a legendary couple who would later become an inspiration for the villagers.

title: Will
overview: Andra who is in a household breakdown with Vina, falls and breaks a bone in the middle of the forest. Unable to move, without food and drink, Andra had to rack his brain and heart to survive.

title: I
overview: After Sanjaya loses his wife who he loves so much, unstoppable anger and anger makes Sanjaya darken his eyes and turn into a sniper who thirsts for blood and justice.

title: A Perfect Fit
overview: Saat pergi bersama temannya ke satu tempat, Saski (Nadya Arina) diramal oleh seseorang yang membawanya ke sebuah toko sepatu. Saski kemudian memasuki toko itu untuk memilih sepatu yang cocok. Tanpa ia sadari kunjungannya ke toko sepatu itu memicu sederet kejadian yang akan mengubah hidupnya.

title: Merapi
overview: A study of the landscape, the clouds and the weather around Merapi, a volcano located in Indonesia.

title: Sarikat
overview: Tan Kian Djien (72) dan Ruth Suryani (70) adalah sepasang suami istri asal Kudus, Jawa Tengah. Di masa lansianya mereka menceritakan kembali momen-momen penting dalam hidupnya, seperti momen bagaimana pertama kali mereka bertemu.

title: Bayangan yang Tak Hendak Kau Lihat
originalTitle: Bayangan yang Tak Hendak Kau Lihat
overview: Madnur seorang yatim yang ingin mengikuti lomba menyanyi lagu daerah, orang-orang mengenal ayah Madnur adalah seorang seniman, dan Madnur kini memiliki satu peninggalan berharga ayahnya, yaitu cincin.

title: Malam ini milik Kuyang
overview: One night, a woman, who was calming a baby in her lap, was visited by a scary creature commonly called Kuyang or Tuju, and the unexpected happened.

title: We
overview: Tells about Adin with his father and mother who are waiting for the announcement for Adin to go to the next level of education. Although enthusiastic, the worries of Mr and Mrs were mixed with the prayers and hopes that were held for Adin in the future.

title: Perempuan dari planet lain
overview: Bagaimana jika kamu bertemu seseorang perempuan misterius yang bisa melupakan semua sakit hati mu

title: Tali Mati
overview: Hari, a young psychologist and his sister Eka, goes back to their village for the funeral of their estranged mother who committed suicide by hanging. There they are confronted with the superstitious beliefs of the locals which is behind their mother’s death.

title: Rompis: Tentang Sahabat
overview: Liburan kuliah telah tiba, Sam (Umay Shahab) dan Roman (Arbani Yasiz) pulang ke Jakarta. Namun di sela liburannya, Roman diminta menghadiri undangan sebagai alumni pembicara di SMA mereka dulu untuk sharing tentang beasiswa di luar negeri. Namun, pikiran Roman sedang kacau karena memikirkan Wulan (Adinda Azani) dan curhat pada Sam. Sam justru bertemu Yola (Ersya Aurelia), seorang musisi yang memikat hatinya, tapi kebersamaan mereka diganggu oleh Radit (Debo Andryos), orang yang posesif terhadap Yola.

title: Februari
overview: A month without a break in the rain. Everyone is afraid to go outside, retreating into their homes. Thunder crashes overhead. I can feel the rainwater running down the walls of the house, touching my ankles, and my eyes

title: Devil on Top
overview: Perusahaan digital marketing Facade kedatangan bos baru bernama Sarah. Sarah membuat Angga dan rekan kerjanya Richard, Boni, dan Rudi, merasa sepertî bekerja di bawah pengawasan setan di neraka. Suatu hari, Angga menemukan selembar kertas yang berisi data para pegawai Facade. Khawatir akan kemungkiran bahwa para pegawai yang ditandai itu akan dipecat, Angga beserta para rekan kerjanya pun berencana untuk menggulingkan Sarah dari jabatannya sebelum pemecatan terjadi.

title: Annah la Javanaise
overview: In 1893, a 13-year-old girl comes to work for French painter Paul Gauguin as his maid and model. They called her Annah la Javanaise. This is a reimagining of her story.

title: Sudah
overview: A lovers are on their way to fulfill their vacation list. But 4 years of relationship is not a guarantee of a pair of fateful love for each other. Who would have thought that this trip would be their last trip together?

title: Kartika
overview: Two Indonesian students on scholarship in Prague 1966, are asked to sign a loyalty paper with a newly established government in Indonesia or else they would be forbidden to return to their country.

title: Ali & Ratu Ratu Queens
overview: Ali yang pergi ke New York demi mencari ibunya, Mia yang telah lama menghilang dari kehidupannya. Film yang disutradarai oleh Lucky Kuswandi ini terinspirasi dari kisah nyata.

title: Skizofrenia
overview: The girl who have a melancholic story about her loving best friend, where's his gone when she is aware the true because she loves him and need him in everything of her situation.

title: Sarung
overview: "Sarung" follows a dancer who is inspired by this versatile piece of cloth and begins creating new choreography. In the process, she is reminded of her mother whom she has not seen in a long time, spurring her to make the journey home. Sombre yet moving, this film by award-winning director Garin Nugroho  reflects on the notions of home and familial bonds.

title: Gelora: Magnumentary Of Gedung Saparua
overview: This documentary shows that the music community in Bandung does not just gather, but embraces each other. Even with their limitations, they can unite into a solid and creative community to conquer all negative views of the general public in the past. All challenges and obstacles were overcome together to later grow into a music industry that we know today. It is this long-standing concern that is trying to be revived through the inspiration of previous successes.  GOR Saparua is a complete proof of the unyielding spirit displayed by Bandung music activists. Even Alvin, the director noted that the music event in Saparua had existed since 1963. It was started by Aneka Nada, a band that was strengthened by Sam and Acil Bimbo as well as Guruh Soekarno Putra. Until then its use is maximized by the next generation. Especially the 90's.

title: Arumi, Night is Blue
overview: In the midst of chaos in her family and relationship with her boyfriend, Arumi realized that Juna, her colleague, was able to heal her sadness. They spent that blue night, which would define their future relationship.

title: Between Days
overview: A short made by Ephraim Ryan as a one-man short for the 2021 MPC Short Film Festival following the theme of 'Everyday Life'. 'Between Days' won 1st place at the MPC Film Festival.

title: Ayah Ikhlas
overview: Ayah Ikhlas merupakan sebuah Stand-Up Comedy Special dari komika betawi kita, David Nurbianto. Disini David menceritakan seluruh perjalanan dan curahan hati seputar rumah tangganya. Tidak hanya cerita mengenai hidupnya setelah menjadi Ayah Ikhlas, namun juga pengalamannya jauh sebelum menjadi seorang Ayah. David berhasil memecah tawa tiap penontonnya dan mengakhiri pertunjukannya dengan isak tangis yang mengharukan.

title: Danyang
overview: A creative studio employee decides not to come home to continue watching a movie. In the middle of it, he fell asleep and had a nightmare that led to an unexpected disaster.

title: Till Death Do Us Part
overview: Vanesha had the chance to kill her boyfriend, Arya. Arya, however, did not recognize her and confess that they never had a relationship.

title: Invisible Hopes
overview: Reveals the apprehensive life of children born to inmate mothers who are forced to live and become victims shrouded in prison.

title: Sound Of Unheared Knock
overview: Dua Gadis, Ami dan Kania tumbuh besar di sebuah ruang sepanjang usia mereka. Akibatnya mereka tidak mengenal konsep “luar” dan “dalam” ruang. Bagi mereka dunia ini hanyalah dapur dan kamar. Mereka tidak pernah tahu apa itu langit, halaman, bahkan, matahari. Namun ada perbedaan sikap antara Ami dan Kania. Kania selalu patuh dan mengiyakan apa yang ibu ucapkan. Namun Ami mudah penasaran. Jika dilarang sesuatu ia malah melakukannya.

title: One Day Trip
overview: Tantri (32) yang baru saja cerai memutuskan untuk pergi ke Yogyakarta untuk menemui  sahabat lamanya, Puspa (32). Obrolan mereka tentang masa lalu membuat mereka pulang dari  pantai larut malam. Dalam perjalanan pulang, mobil mereka yang tiba-tiba mogok menjadi  awal dari rentetan malapetaka yang mengubah hidup mereka.

title: Pertelon
overview: Sepasang suami istri, Dewi (26) dan Sandi (28) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kontrakan  yang berlokasi di pertigaan jalan atau biasa disebut dengan ‘Tusuk Sate’. Dewi lantas membuka  usaha warteg kecil di depan rumahnya. Seiring berjalannya waktu, Dewi merasakan keanehan di  dalam rumahnya diperburuk dengan kondisi warteg yang tak kunjung ramai. Dewi yang percaya  akan mitos Rumah Tusuk Sate pun akhirnya berselisih paham dengan sang suami. Suatu saat, Ibu  Sandi (53) datang menjenguk mereka. Hingga akhirnya, Ibu Sandi mengetahui permasalahan  yang dihadapi oleh Dewi dan Sandi. Lantas, bagaimana kisah kelanjutan keluarga ini? Apakah  hadirnya Ibu Sandi pada akhirnya mampu menyelesaikan permasalahan mereka?

title: Candala
overview: Seorang pengemudi ojek online yang religius mengalami keadaan pelik ketika menjelaskan  dirinya menjadi korban pelecehan seksual oleh seorang wanita.

title: Nyigar
overview: Ari (28) merupakan anak pertama dari dua bersaudara, ia tinggal bersama ibu dan  istrinya. Semenjak ayahnya meninggal, ia melanjutkan usaha ayahnya sebagai tuan tanah  untuk membiayai adiknya, Teguh untuk melanjutkan pendidikan. Tepat seribu hari setelah  wafat ayahnya, sang ibu menyampaikan wasiat berupa warisan tanah kepada kedua  anaknya. Akan tetapi, pembagian warisan tidak berjalan dengan baik. Ari dan Teguh  terlibat konflik dalam memperebutkan warisan tersebut yang dilatarbelakangi oleh  kepentingan masing-masing.

title: Kahanan
overview: Abimanyu (18) adalah seorang anak laki-laki yang ingin menjadi dokter. Ia merupakan  anak satu-satunya dari Darminah (52) dan Lasmana (55). Sejak satu tahun yang lalu Darminah  sakit lumpuh dan Lasmana hanyalah seorang buruh batu gamping. Lasmana melarang Abimanyu  pergi kuliah karena alasan ekonomi dan juga keadaan Darminah. Sedangkan Darminah  memperbolehkan Abimanyu kuliah karena ia peduli terhadap masa depan anaknya. Atas  keinginan kuatnya, Abimanyu tetap ingin kuliah tanpa menghiraukan larangan Lasmana.

title: Lelaki
overview: Reza (14) adalah anak laki – laki yang berbeda dari anak lainnya. Reza menyukai hal yang berbau kecantikan seperti make up. Ibunya merupakan seorang ibu rumah tangga dan ayahnya adalah TNI. Karena kesukaan Reza itu lah, ayahnya ingin mengubah Reza menjadi seperti laki – laki sesuai dengan definisi maskulin menurut ayahnya. Ayahnya menuntut Reza untuk mengikuti jejaknya sebagai tentara. Karena hal itulah ayahnya memasukan Reza untuk berlatih Taekwondo. Namun, Reza tidak menyukai hal tersebut. Karena penampilannya dan gerak geriknya Reza juga menjadi bahan olokan oleh teman lelaki sebayanya yang membuat Reza tidak nyaman. Hal ini membuat ia ingin mengubah dirinya menjadi seperti keinginan orang disekitarnya.

title: Gaptek
overview: Seorang siswa bernama Andhra menghadapi tantangan besar saat ia harus menyesuaikan diri dengan cara belajar baru yang berbasis teknologi. Apakah Andhra mau beradaptasi?

title: Cadong
overview: Danan, a former regent, and Drajat, a former governor, share a prison cell as both have been convicted of corruption. Their conflicting attitudes towards corruption create tension within their confined space.

title: Imam
overview: A woman begins to experience disturbances from an unseen presence while she is performing her prayers. What initially feels unusual धीरे develops into a terror that unsettles her inner peace. This short film is a spin-off of Pocong The Haunt, featuring the character Leni as the main protagonist, and is set two years before the events of the original film.

title: Preman Pensiun: Kembali ke Fitri
overview: Kang Mus returns to his hometown in Garut with plans to renovate a mosque. Meanwhile, Ujang and Serena's kicimpring business is becoming increasingly successful, but Ujang is faced with a complex dilemma due to his romantic entanglement.

title: Tarian Lengger Maut
overview: One by one the corpses without a heart were found in Pagar Alas Village. At the same time, Sukma, a beautiful girl in the village is just about to become a Lengger dancer, and Dr. Jati, a young doctor has just arrived to work in the village.

title: Terima Kasih Emak Terima Kasih Abah
originalTitle: Terima Kasih Emak Terima Kasih Abah
overview: The story begins when Abah has lost his home and property. That is a consequence of paying too much brother-in-law's debt. Then Abah and his family moved to a house in a remote village in West Java. The house is his childhood home, a legacy from his father. Initially, they planned to stay temporarily during the trial of his brother's debt case. Unfortunately, they lost in court. The court's decision left Abah's family threatened to live forever in the small house in a state of poverty. Not only Abah, Euis, Abah's first child also helped raise money for the family. While Cemara or Ara, who is still small, seems to remain eager to live life. They work hand in hand to rise from the deterioration of economic conditions. The Cemara family is an adaptation of a television series with the same title by Arswendo Atmowiloto.

title: La Tukad'djib
overview: Mustaqiem seorang anak soleh yang penurut, Saat mengaji dia diajarkan Untuk tidak berbohong. Suatu ketika Abah meminta Mustaqiem untuk mengangkat telpon dan berbohong dengan memberitahu jika tidak ada Abah dirumah, Mustaqiem pun bimbang harus menuruti yang diajarkan Guru Mengajinya atau yang diperintahkan Abahnya, Mampukah Ia mempertahankan ajaran dari Guru Mengajinya tanpa mengecewakan Ayahnya?

title: Noda Ranjang Membekas
overview: Awakening from a coma, Bobby falls in love with Inggrid, a nurse whose age is far apart from him. Disasters arise as they drift deeper and deeper into love. They were caught in a cunning scheme.

title: Hari Yang Dijanjikan
overview: At the last second, a father struggles to fulfill his promise to pay off his debt on the day he promised.  But conditions in the midst of the pandemic made it difficult to fulfill promises to debt collectors and promises to their children.

title: Pocong The Haunt
overview: Two content creators who experience continuous supernatural events and terror from a pocong after exploring an abandoned old building.

title: Wedding Proposal
overview: Bisma, a single photographer who is constantly being asked to marry by her parents, finally meets a perfectionist wedding organizer named Sissy. However, the struggle to get it is not always easy. Together with Ito, Bisma tries to win over Sissy's heart so that marriage can be achieved.

title: Petani Muda
overview: The Young Farmer is a Mockumenteries film uses fictional language about the last generation of hallucinogenic herbal farmer who fight against the times to preserve the culture of their ancestors

title: Adit Sopo Jarwo: The Movie
overview: Adit bersama Ayah dan Bundanya pergi berlibur ke Yogyakarta menggunakan kereta api. Di tengah perjalanannya, kereta berhenti sejenak di Stasiun Cirebon. Bundanya yang tengah hamil mendadak sakit perut, ia pun berniat membelikan biskuit untuk bundanya tanpa izin terlebih dahulu. Saat Adit ingin kembali, keretanya telah berangkat dan membuat Adit tertinggal seorang diri di stasiun. Sopo yang saat itu bekerja sebagai porter menghampiri Adit karena merasa iba. Namun, alih-alih mengantarkan Adit ke Jogja, ia malah mengantarkannya ke rumah makan Gudeg Jogja. Melihat Adit kebingungan, Jarwo yang saat itu diturunkan dari kereta menawarkan Adit untuk mengantarkannya ke Yogyakarta. Perjalanan panjang mereka ke Yogyakarta pun dimulai.

title: Pembalasan Jenglot
overview: Nana dan teman-temannya membuat film di hutan keramat. Karena perbuatan tercela yang mereka lakukan, makhluk yang memiliki tempat itu membunuh mereka satu per satu kecuali satu. Yang terakhir kemudian membuat kesepakatan dengan makhluk itu.

title: Awang-awang
overview: Bejo (11), a young boy with dreams of becoming a pilot, faces the harsh realities of financial hardship when his mother admits she can’t afford his education. Feeling discouraged, he meets a university student who inspires him to keep his dreams alive. But as new challenges arise, Bejo learns that life’s journey is not always as straightforward as it seems.

title: Kitiran
overview: Struggling to find financial stability far from home, a freelance photographer meets an elderly woman who sells pinwheel toys and begins to reconsider his passion and the path he has chosen.

title: Pulau Plastik
overview: Gede Robi, vocalist of Navicula, Tiza Mafira, lawyer from Jakarta & Prigi Arisandi, biologist & river guard from East Java in tracing plastic waste whose tracks have infiltrated the food chain & its impact on human health.

title: HIGH ON GRAVE
overview: Frustated Dimas looking for cannabis that lead him to the mysterious grave he has been looking for. What will Dimas do?

title: Sisterlillah the Movie (Siblings Version): Impian, Cinta & Keluarga
originalTitle: Sisterlillah the Movie (Siblings Version): Impian, Cinta & Keluarga
overview: Tells the story of the struggle to reach dreams and fraternal relations, friendship to romance from Oki Setiana Dewi, Dr. Shindy, and Ria Ricis.

title: Kalo Gak Ada Ramadhan
overview: Why does Ramadan come when you think about Eid? What if there is no Ramadan?  The story of the portrait of the Indonesian people who always miss the presence of Ramadan with different motivations. Will Ramadan just be an annual cycle?

title: Bara
overview: In the forests of Borneo, Iber Djamal has been fighting large-scale deforestation around his village for decades. But at 77, and despite unwavering devotion, the struggle becomes more and more illusory in the face of the voracity of the agribusiness monsters. An urgent and tragically universal ecological fable.

title: Tenang
overview: In this heartfelt short film inspired by Yura Yunita’s new single, Agus stumbles upon an old videotape that holds the key to a forgotten memory of his father’s voice.

title: Surga yang Tak Dirindukan 3
overview: Meirose strives to create heaven in her family, with her husband and their two children. One day, Ray, a man from her past, returns and wants to build his lost paradise with Meirose and Akbar.

title: Don't Be Alone
overview: A girl is followed by a ghost because she walks alone at night

title: Falhan's Love
overview: Untung and Nesti really love their 6 year old son who has autism. Their daily life becomes more challenging because both of their parents are disabled, but their love and passion is truly heartwarming.

title: Sholat Sendirian
overview: A woman refuses to be invited to salat together with her friend because each time she recites surah too long. However, when the woman is praying alone, her feelings are not calm.

title: Ghostbuser: Misteri Desa Penari
overview: Sigit who has the ability to see ghosts sees a great advantage to get money from these advantages. His life spins out of control because it turns out that getting rich is not that easy.

title: Karena Kamu Cuma Satu
overview: Binsar, a final year law student, son of Saelan, owner of the Metromini Bus business, recently lost his bus due to traffic violations. Binsar is involved in a complicated love affair with the spinster Sofia, the nephew of the famous Turpin's lawyer. Binsar and Sofia try to return their love in the midst of their respective problems.

title: Preman

title: Villa Angker Lembang
overview: Kemal is a young, successful man, he is the owner of a large stock brokerage company and has a small, happy family. He and his wife, Citra planning to build a resort business on an empty land in the city of Lembang, Kemal went to the village around his land, and accidentally met Sujiwo, the villa keeper.  Sujiwo offered him an old resort with several villas and large land inside which the owner had abandoned abroad. The man gave Kemal a good price for the villas compared to if Kemal had to build a new resort on empty land which would have cost more.  Kemal finally decided to buy the villas and intended to renovate them. Kemal, Citra along with Satria (her child), and Nadine (her sister-in-law), they went to the resort for a weekend getaway. Not long after, Kemal and his little family realized that the villas were haunted. They are haunted by creepy figures who lead them to the darkest side of the resort.

title: Sampai Jadi Debu
overview: Knowing that his mother has Alzheimer's, Damar made the biggest decision in his life to care for his mother and leave his lover, Laras.

title: REC

title: Jangan Sendirian

overview: Di tahun 90-an, masa di saat tokoh-tokoh di ujung transisi menuju milenium baru. Yura (Clara Bernadeth) gadis malang yang tinggal dengan orang tua angkat, dibuai oleh harapan jatuh ke pelukan keluarga kaya. Tapi malang tak bisa ditolak, Yura yang sempat tersanjung, mengecap harapan sesaat, mesti dicampakkan.

title: Rita dan Kebun Absurd
overview: Beni sedang ngedate dengan kekasihnya yang bernama Rita di sebuah kebun tebu. Kebun tersebut memiliki sebuah mitos yang mengatakan, jika ada sepasang kekasih yang berpacaran di kebun ini, maka salah satu dari mereka akan menghilang. Rita tiba-tiba menghilang secara misterius sehingga Beni panik dan harus mencari Rita.

title: Titisan Setan 2
overview: Rico, a famous tailor, meets a mysterious woman who ordered a dress. After that night all Rico's friend is gone one by one.

title: Ghost Like Us
overview: Revisiting the Indonesian horror / exploitation films of the 80s and 90s that he loved as a teenager, Riar Rizaldi examines the ways in which these films – shown outside of the theatre and other formal spaces of the film industry – constitute a ‘cinematic elsewhere’.

title: Di Antara Mendung dan Kabutnya Kota Poso
originalTitle: Di Antara Mendung dan Kabutnya Kota Poso
overview: There are four bestfriends with different beliefs. Until one day, Mr. X plans to destroy Poso City. Then there was a dispute between the four bestfriends.

title: Bisikan Arwah Mantan
overview: The making of the latest Kudeta Production's film is interrupted when one of the cast approaches Viki to get revenge on her sister ruin Viki's household with Angel. Since then, ghost terror has emerged.

title: Ayudia dan Jalan Pulangnya
overview: Ayudia's marriage plans are opposed by her uncle and aunt who have taken care of her since she was a child. As it turned out, her uncle and aunt intended to match her.

overview: Three years have passed since the “The Prince” syndicate was arrested. Unfortunately, he reports it to the wrong person—a police officer who is secretly part of “The Prince” cartel. This report puts both Falih and his younger brother, Danen, in grave danger.

overview: Ketika hantu pengetuk pintu misterius mengetuk rumah warga kampung,  Gino justru mengajak hantu itu bermain.

overview: Saidjah wanted to marry Adinda, but poverty prevented him. Saidjah then decided to work in Batavia. Adinda is now alone in Lebak waiting for Saidjah to return.

overview: Having a best friend is rather tricky. Ben Sarjono must do all of those so his friendship can emerge beautifully from its cocoon.

title: Pungkasan

title: Gerajak
overview: Sebuah film surealis dengan konsep tari yang mengangkat sejarah tentang Gerajak, sebuah komite yang mayoritas terdiri dari pamong desa dan buruh tani. Gerajak dibentuk untuk melakukan reformasi agraria di tengah bencana kekeringan dan kelaparan di Gunung Kidul pada tahun 1963. Kondisi ini kemudian menjadi momentum terjadinya perilaku yang vandal di dalam masyarakat.

title: Overtime

Every post he encounters that is uninteresting to him is commented negatively through forms of insults or satire. After a while, he finds a video of a girl who wants to kill herself. Reza comments on the post and is later DM-ed by a girl who then sends photos of him in the office. Reza becomes afraid and so he attempts to leave the building.

title: Setelah Multatuli pergi
overview: In 1860, Max Havelaar was written by the famous Dutch writer. Multatuli was first published "The book that killed colonialism”. In one and a half century after it was written, many scholars reflected on whether the book is a made-up story or a collection of facts. However, no one seems to have ever asked the question: what happened to the oppressed people of Lebak, which Multatuli stood up for? The documentary film After Multatuli Left tries to find out what has or has not changed since then by following the trail of Arjan Onderdenwijngaard’s video footage in 1987.

title: 4 Sekawan Sebelum Dunia Terbalik
overview: Kisah ini menceritakan tentang kisah 4 laki-laki rantau dalam menjalani kehidupannya di Jakarta. Idoy, Dadang, Aceng, Akum mereka sangatlah berbeda karakter. Perbedaan karakter lah yang membuat mereka menjadi bersahabat. Namun, sebuah kejadian membuat persahabatan mereka harus terpecah.

overview: A street dog is taken in by a young couple, and the family pit becomes an instant accomplice as he adjusts to his new, loving home.

overview: Sebagai sepasang kekasih yang sudah berjalan selama setahun lebih DARA (22) merasakan moment bahagia ketika ALIF (25) sang pujaan hati tiba-tiba melamarnya. Namun ibu Dara MARNI (58) belum merestui hubungan mereka sebelum Dara mencarikan jodoh untuk kedua kakaknya, ANGGI (27) yang tomboy, cuek dan galak terhadap semua lelaki dan NINA (25) yang gemuk dan jerawatan.

title: Affliction

originalTitle: [Revisi: 3 Februari 1965] Gugatan-Gugatan dari dalam Tudung Saji

A forbidden love blossoms between them, but their differing views on faith stand as an unbridgeable divide.

title: Jaraknya
overview: Jaraknya (The Lost Dream) tells the story of a boy named Ali who lives in a village across the river, where the only way for him to get to school is by crossing the Kapuas River. Ali dreams of pursuing an education to the highest level so he can build a bridge in his village. However, difficult economic conditions and a lack of support from those around him make Ali think twice about pursuing his dream.

title: Mendayung Harapan

She won nine gold medals and six silver medals by the end of the 1990s. After retiring, Leni founded a preschool and a rowing school to equip the youth in her village with activities that benefit both their environment and themselves.

title: Neonatal Unit
overview: A lost video signal transmitted to the past from the future of remilitarised Indonesia archipelago when demographic dividend reached its peak. Narrated by one of the members of the Operation of Sovereignty for Gestational and Surrogate Mothers, the video dissects the dynamic of natalism, nationalism, agency, and reproductive technology as well as questioning the meaning of kita (‘we’ in Indonesian).

title: Rokok Sintren
overview: Sintren Cigarettes has been operating for 70 years with all its employees being elderly.

title: Eva

title: A Postcard for the Giants
overview: For some people, loving the local football club is a calling. Anything can be a calling to everyone. People say that the calling is: PSS! Sleman Regency's beloved club is adored not only by Sleman locals but also by anyone who is enchanted by its calling. Those called by PSS took Brigata Curva Sud (BCS) as their identity. Whenever PSS matches are held, home or away, it is a big day to be celebrated. Fanaticism involves love, and love trumps logic. At that time, the industry, which did not value integrity and loyalty, took advantage of people's affection for PSS. PSS is not a business; PSS is love and dedication!

Deni pun menyembunyikan identitas demi mendapatkan cinta Tenri.

title: Ubag-Ubeg
overview: Mrs. Marni, a successful pottery entrepreneur, is busy getting her shop ready to open  after being closed for a long time due to the pandemic. At that moment, his employees, Tresno and Bejo, found a towering pile of cardboard inside the shop. Tresno and Bejo, who were suspicious about the contents of the box, finally tried to find out what Mrs. Marni was planning. Unexpectedly, the search ended in facts that they had never thought possible.

title: Quarantine Tales
overview: Quarantine Tales is a collection of stories by 5 directors who tell the stories of life experienced during the pandemic.

originalTitle: Tuntung Pandang Ruhui Rahayu (The Wedding Proposal)

Karena mereka baru saja bertemu, Bella lebih mempertanyakan hubungan mereka di hujung hubungan, apakah melanjutkan atau bagaimana.

Festivals, he believes, are celebrations where cultural egalitarian spaces are recreated. This film also portrays how to place artistic work in an effort to maintain heritage and traditions with tourism which has a different way.
