overview: A villager of Desa Jepitu named Rubiyanto conducted a water extraction project from Gua Pulejajar with a group of volunteers. Echa, a student of cultural anthropology, involved herself in the project for her research. The water reserve in Gua Pulejajar does not only give hope to Rubiyanto and the other villagers of Desa Jepitu, but also reignites spiritual relations between Echa and her late father, who was a former activist of Gua Pulejajar.

title: Diam & Dengarkan
overview: Be Quiet & Listen came out of the stillness of the Covid-19 pandemic: a documentary essay about universal consciousness, and about what comes up when the world goes quiet.

title: Balalek
overview: A father who was arrested for allegedly being the perpetrator of land burning, and his son, is an Indonesian National Army (TNI) who regretted his father's actions of burning forests and land.

title: Survival of Illusion
overview: Film pendek ini menceritakan tentang seorang siswa yang bernama Nana, terlalu banyak main game sehingga terjebak di dalam ilusi game itu sendiri. Tetapi... Ilusi Nana tersebut bukanlah sebuah ilusi biasa... Melainkan dia sudah terkena mantra Imperius dari David, penyihir dari Wizard Lineage Series (lanjutan dari salah satu adegan Wizard Lineage episode 3) yang merupakan mantra terlarang. Apakah Nana mampu menghadapi semuanya???

title: Garda Terdepan
overview: Abimanyu (16) struggles to understand the importance of health protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic. While his father, a dedicated healthcare worker, is on the front lines battling the virus, the boy often neglects basic safety measures like wearing a mask. But a sudden, life-changing moment forces him to reconsider his actions and the true cost of the pandemic.

title: Dulhaji Dolena
overview: Dulhaji lives in Pekalongan. Poor urban planning and excessive extraction of groundwater have caused the land to decline. Because of this, his village has been hit by severe floods several times since 2008. Dulhaji never tire of reminding the authorities to pay attention to the situation in his village, while also tirelessly trying to make a living. Singing and singing, seems to be a more healthy channel.

title: Human vs Elephant
overview: Riau Province has been a habitat for Sumatran elephants since ancient times. Massive forest clearing occurred and resulted in almost the entire forest as elephant habitat being lost to oil mining factories, infrastructure buildings, community gardens and settlements. Loss of habitat causes elephants to enter populated areas and destroy plantations, even people's homes. Until finally a conflict arose between the residents of Karya Indah and wild elephants. This living space conflict occurs almost every day and causes losses and even casualties between the two parties.

title: Waiting, but...for what?
overview: Conditions seem unbelievable, spending day after day without clarity,  and waiting for something that is uncertain, but for what?

title: True North
overview: After his father disappears and the rest of his family is sent to a notorious political prison camp in North Korea, a young boy must learn to survive the harsh conditions, find meaning in his perilous existence, and maybe even escape.

title: Truth Finds a Way
overview: Tobias Natterer explains the motives of creating The Uncensored Library, a library containing forbidden articles from several countries around the world inside a Minecraft server. The documentary also digs further into the press freedom situation around the world and the sad truths behind it.

title: Breath
overview: Sherly and Gina are having problems with their business due to the impact of the ongoing pandemic. Then Sherly has a solution to solve their problem.

title: Rumah Kuta Kita
overview: Tanu and Fani, a newly-married couple, had to cancel their honeymoon plans to Bali due to a riot in Jakarta, 1998.

title: Subuh
overview: Samuel decided to embrace Islam, his decision caused a problem with his father who is a Christian Pastor. Now, their relationship is at stake, but Samuel tries to restore the harmony between them.

title: Yth.
overview: Wijaya is a 35-year-old priest who was transferred one day to continue the period of service as a church ministry leader in a village with a majority population Muslim.

title: Java Man
overview: Kelana, a Solo's college student asked by a museum to photograped some of their rare collections and then when Kelana see to the museum's stuff, she see many mysterious thing in there.

title: Harapan-harapan yang Sempit
overview: Indonesia, 2019. BAGAS (8) a nosy and intelligent single orphan lives with his mother, MARNI (32) - a hard-working and sensitive young widow. One night Bagas asked Marni about her birthplace. Too tired because of the house chores that she did all day alone, and a sense of confusion to respond, Marni had to lie by saying that the birthplace of Bagas was from the armpits. Instead of obeying his mother's command to sleep, Bagas instead tried to find the place of birth that his mother intended. Because of Bagas's excessive behavior, Marni woke up and got annoyed that she did something unwise for her son. However, Bagas only hoped for a brother, which for Marni it is impossible to be realized.

title: Cerita tentang Jendela
overview: This short 7-minute film tells a story of two lovebirds who find a lot of new things from behind the window and end in a certainty of their feelings.

title: Sepuluh Meter
overview: Worried, anxious, afraid, stressed, feeling guilty, just at home? You are not alone in living it. It comes from the anxiety that we both experience in the midst of uncertain situations.

title: Virtual Buddy With Kevin
overview: Not having the emotional maturity or the qualification doesn't stop Kevin from making an online service where he offers to befriend people who are feeling lonely in the pandemic. This can't backfire, right?

title: Punah
overview: The bag, the personification of a plastic bag, wakes up on the beach after being swept from the sea. The bag then tries to interact with the environment and nature around it. Slowly but surely the Pockets descended into a strange and wonderful reality.

title: Pengantin
overview: Prospective martyrs face their last night.

title: Aphrodite Stereotype
overview: Tentang seorang remaja laki-laki yang berada dalam proses pengakuan jati dirinya. Apakah dia berhasil mendapatkan pengakuan tersebut?

title: memories/fortress
overview: An Indonesian student in London attempts to deal with the absurdity of confinement and immobility due to then-ongoing coronavirus lockdown by talking to his parents – who also face similar movement restrictions in Jakarta – over the phone.

title: X-tra Absurd
overview: Raisa gets a mysterious birthday present containing Bi Asuh who claims to be a maid. Instead of alleviating, Bi Foster actually creates a lot of problems. Besides Raisa's grandmother suffering more, her sister also disappeared. Raisa also had to ask the help of her friends to find her sister and drive Bi Foster.

title: Maria Ado'e
overview: Maria (17) from the East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia tries to survive in Java island for her higher education. Maria often changes boarding houses because she always gets attacked by the locals due to her differences in skin color and the food she ate.

title: Gendaan
overview: Eko (37) seorang sopir truk yang sudah lama tidak pulang dan bertemu keluarganya. Susi (35) istri Eko bekerja dengan membuka warung jajanan. Hubungan pasangan suami istri ini tidak berjalan baik karena nafkah lahir & batin yang tidak terpenuhi. Eko dan Susi memiliki pasangan gelap tanpa diketahui satu sama lain bahkan anak mereka sendiri. Buah dari hubungan ini adalah ketidaknyamanan pada Andi (11).

title: Wani
overview: Wani (23) yang merupakan perempuan dewasa muda yang terjebak dalam kisah asmaranya  bersama Rita (27) sejak mereka dipertemukan di dalam satu sel penjara yang sama. Namun, kisah  asrama mereka berakhir ironi bagi Wani, ketika hadirnya sosok Gunawan (40) yang diketahui  sudah menjalin hubungan badan dengan Rita. Rasa cemburu dan kecewa akan hal itu membuat  Wani memutuskan untuk pergi meninggalkan Rita.

title: Rabiah & Mimi
overview: In Indonesia, 265 million people are spread amongst more than 17,000 islands. Managing the healthcare system in the world’s biggest archipelago is a nightmare. An out of sight, out of mind approach has failed her people. “Rabiah and Mimi” explores the difficulties the world’s largest archipelago faces in providing adequate health care to its people, through the story of a family who have dedicated their lives to this pursuit in the remote islands of the Flores Sea.

title: The Bajau
overview: Tells a riveting strory of two Bajo families living in the waters surrounding Sulawesi.

title: Rendang Maut
overview: In a quaint Padang restaurant, filled with many people enjoying their lunch break, two extremely platonic bros put their extremely platonic friendship to the test when it turns out that there’s only a single plate of their favorite food left: The Rendang of Death. (Massacre may or may not ensue.)  Rendang of Death was created with inspiration from the legendary animated short 'Bar Fight' made by the equally legendary animator Christy Karacas.

title: Tenripada
overview: "Hari Lamaran" yang seharusnya menjadi hari pembuktian cinta antara Syamsir dan Melati justru menjadi hari penghianatan. Melati pergi dengan laki-laki lain di hari itu. Kehadiran Kayla yang bermaksud menolong, malah memperkeruh keadaan. Maka terjadilah duel antara Syamsir dan Melati, duel untuk saling menghabisi namun tetap saling mencintai.

title: Buku Harianku
overview: Kila anak yang ceria, cerdas, kritis, tapi juga keras kepala. Dia senang mencurahkan isi hati dengan menulis di buku harian. Suatu ketika, oleh ibunya Kila dititipkan sementara sekaligus mengisi masa liburan ke rumah kakeknya, Prapto, di Desa Goalpara, Sukabumi. Di desa yang asri tersebut Kila bertemu kembali dengan kawan lamanya, Rintik, yang diproteksi oleh ibunya karena menyandang disabilitas. Kila menganggap Rintik sebagai teman baiknya. Keceriaan Kila semakin bertambah karena mendapatkan teman-teman baru yang sebaya di desa tersebut. Mereka menghabiskan waktu dengan bermain, bernyanyi riang, bahkan ikut latihan baris-berbaris dengan Kakek Prapto, pensiunan tentara. Berbekal rasa keingintahuannya terhadap berbagai masalah dan kepedulian terhadap sekelilingnya, Kila ikut membantu warga desa keluar dari jeratan perangkap seorang pengusaha properti.

title: Mariposa
overview: Iqbal Guanna seperti kupu-kupu Mariposa bagi Natasha Kay Loovy atau Acha. Tiap kali didekati ia selalu menghindar. Acha bertekad ingin mendapatkan hati Iqbal, seorang cowok cakep, pintar dan dikenal berhati dingin. Sahabat Acha, Amanda, berusaha mencegah niat Acha untuk mendekati Iqbal. Acha yakin, jika pun hati Iqbal sekeras batu, Acha adalah air yang menetesinya setiap waktu, hingga batu itu akan pecah dan menerima dirinya.

title: Sekala
overview: Two young men who determine what he will do for his work,  Between Staying or Leaving It, this film contains a choice of two people and the reasons for choosing it

title: Aku Tahu Kapan Kamu Mati
overview: Setelah mengalami mati suri, Siena mendapatkan kemampuan untuk melihat tanda-tanda kematian pada orang yang akan segera meninggal. Namun, teman-temannya tidak percaya dengan kemampuannya itu. Hingga akhirnya, tanda tersebut mulai muncul pada orang-orang terdekatnya.

title: Mekah I'm Coming
overview: Hubungan Eddy, pemilik usaha bengkel desa, dan Eni bisa kandas lantaran Eni akan dijodohkan dengan saudagar kaya dari kota, Pietoyo. Berkat saran Ibunya, Eddy berhasil merayu orangtua Eni dengan mengatakan akan berangkat Haji tahun ini. Faktanya, untuk mendapatkan kuota visa Haji resmi harus mengantri selama 10 tahun. Eddy memutuskan menjual bengkel tempat usahanya, dan mengambil jalur kilat. Sesampainya di Jakarta, Eddy baru sadar kalau ia ditipu. Dalam kebimbangan, Eddy harus menyembunyikan hal tersebut dari siapapun. Ia menunggu waktu yang tepat untuk pulang kampung, agar seolah-olah ia benar-benar naik Haji dan bisa segera menikahi Eni.

title: Nasi Padang
overview: A filmmaker from Norway becomes an internet phenomenon and national celebrity in Indonesia after making a love song to the traditional cuisine nasi padang.

title: Narimo
overview: Seorang duda yang tinggal sendiri, senang mengisi waktu luangnya dengan  memancing. Disela-sela aktivitasnya, ia selalu mencoba menghubungi anak  perempuannya. Namun, pada akhirnya ia tidak berhasil menemuinya.

title: Lastini
overview: Desi (20) adalah seorang kembang desa yang tidak bisa melangsungkan pernikahannya  dengan Sakti (21), kedua belah keluarga pun sudah sepakat. Namun, karena adanya suatu  accident membuat Desi merayu kedua orang tuanya supaya pernikahannya dengan Sakti dapat  terwujud. Ayahnya mendukung keinginan Desi, namun sang ibu tetap pada pendiriannya.  Konflik yang terjadi di keluarganya membuat Desi frustasi dan mengungkapkan keadaan  sesungguhnya. Setelah terjadi konflik, Desi mencari kepastian jawaban dari Sakti, namun  jawabannya membuat keadaan Desi semakin terpuruk. Desi pun terpaksa menanggung deritanya  seorang diri.

title: Nunut
overview: Tutik (35) tidak mampu membayar iuran sampah, maka dari itu ia membuang sampah ke  tempat sampah milik Ningsih. Ia melakukannya secara berulang-ulang. Saat Ningsih dan  tetangganya berbelanja sayuran, mereka membicarakan tempat sampah Ningsih yang sudah  menumpuk. Suatu hari, Tutik dan Ningsih berkonflik karena kecurigaan Ningsih terhadap  sampah popok yang ada di tempat sampahnya. Ningsih dan tetangganya menyudutkan Tutik dan  akhirnya membuat Tutik mengakui perbuatannya. Ia pun mempertanyakan kemana ia dapat  membuang sampah.

title: Nakal
overview: A story of high school friendship colored with ego, love and ambition. Starring Yoeriche Endine, Regina Kandou, Cindy Thefannie and Bella Verena. What do you think will happen when friendship is based on their story?

title: Other Side
overview: A student named Rafel who has problems at school. He is always scolded by the teacher and has no friends. Until finally, there is one person who is willing to extend his hand to Rafel. What actually happened to Rafel?

title: The Book Binder
overview: Rahmat, a senior book repairer who lives on his own, is invited to his son's engagement dinner. While he is happy for his son, his ego gets in the way.

title: Bokor Jimat Setan
overview: Arjuna's hurt towards those closest to him made him hold a deep grudge. With the encouragement of one of the administrators of the Gumenjangbrama sect, Nyi Rengganis, a female soul devil, Arjuna performed a ritual of sending demons to those who hurt her using bokor media.

title: Riki Rhino
overview: Riki, a young Sumatran rhino, lost his horn, which was stolen by a hunter. Riki goes on an adventure with Beni and gets horns with a hidden power.

title: #TemanTapiMenikah 2
overview: As Ayu and Ditto finally transition from best friends to newlyweds, a quick pregnancy creates uncertainty for the future of their young marriage.

title: Sebelum Iblis Menjemput: Ayat 2
overview: Dua tahun setelah lolos dari teror iblis, seorang wanita muda masih dihantui penglihatan yang tidak wajar. Bahaya yang menanti dia dan teman-temannya semakin mengancam.

title: Unseen Mist
overview: Riani, a famous college student, got terror from one of her followers on Instagram who claimed to be her fans. she has to choose either delete her social media life on Instagram or keep her Instagram account despite the dangers from the unknown still look after her

title: Kemboja
overview: Percakapan kecil seorang narapidana sebelum ditembak mati

title: Dan Pulang
overview: Rina wants to tell her best friend, Eli, about her arranged marriage, by dating her on the last night they could be together.

title: 4 Mantan
overview: Sara, Airin, Rachel, and Amara were accidentally brought together because of the death of Alex, their ex-boyfriend. They also received a letter from Alex after Alex died, and one of Alex's killers was among them.

title: Toko Barang Mantan
overview: Toko Barang Mantan adalah toko jual-beli barang-barang mantan bagi orang-orang yang ingin move-on dari mantannya. Sebagai pencetus ide, pendiri dan pemiliknya, Tristan rela meninggalkan kuliah hukumnya demi bisa fokus mengembangkan toko ini bersama sahabatnya, Amel dan Rio. Berbagai macam kisah-kisah sedih, lucu dan absurd tentang barang-barang tersebut menjadi makanan mereka sehari-hari.

title: Kajeng Kliwon
overview: A murder incident threatens the lives of Agni and Nicho who will soon get married. Wijaya's presence also increasingly tested their love.

title: Milea: Suara dari Dilan
overview: Tidak ada kisah yang lebih Indah dari kisah cinta di SMA.Sama halnya dengan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea.Dari yang awalnya benci hingga saling mencintai. Dari yang awalnya manis hingga menjadi rumit.Menjelang reuni akbar,Dilan memutuskan untuk menceritakan kembali masa masa itu.

title: Poniah
overview: Poniah kehilangan pekerjaannya akibat pandemic covid-19. Poniah tidak  ada pilihan harus menjadi pelacur. Poniah tenggalam dalam kehidupan  mewah yang semu.

title: Moksa
overview: Mbah Sapto’s journey to meet the end of his life

title: Sematawayang
overview: Memahami bahasa gerak dari seseorang yang lahir sematawayang

title: Contrast
overview: Sebuah kasus pembunuhan terjadi di sebuah kamar di apartemen, dua orang detektif berusaha menyelesaikan kasus ini

title: Pemburu di Manchester Biru
overview: Sebagai penghormatan kepada sang ayah, seorang sarjana yang tekun mengambil keputusan menantang untuk menjadi reporter sebuah klub sepak bola Liga Premier Inggris.

title: Nikah Yuk!
overview: Arya still maintains his relationship with his chosen girlfriend, Neyna, and rejects the coercion of his parents to marry young. However, his meeting with Lia made Arya fell in love and broke heart at the same time.

title: Temen Kondangan
overview: Ketakutan terbesar Putri (Prisia Nasution) akhirnya datang ketika menerima undangan resepsi pernikahan mantan pacar terindahnya, Dheni (Samuel Rizal). Untuk membuktikan kalau dirinya sudah move-on, Putri ditantang oleh sahabat-sahabatnya untuk hadir ke pesta tersebut, dengan syarat tidak datang sendirian.

title: Semes7a
overview: Through the lens of faiths and cultures in seven provinces in Indonesia, this documentary follows individuals who strive to address climate change.

title: Mangkujiwo
overview: After being removed from his position at the Keraton by Cokrokusumo, Brotoseno intends to take revenge. Brotoseno invites a woman named Kanti who is also filled with hatred for Cokrokusumo.

title: Dewi Sartika
overview: In 1904, Dewi Sartika, a young woman who dream to change the future of Indonesian woman through education.

title: Kesurupan Erotik
overview: Enjoy terror offerings in Standard Definition visuals! Shot by MiniDV. Three syndicate women decided to hold a sex party to celebrate the success of their mission. These three women want to try to feel the pleasure of making love with people who are possessed. But they did not know that the pleasure must be paid handsomely!

title: Sentuhan Binal Iblis
overview: Nindya hates humans. For her everyone is trash. The only human she can tolerate is her girlfriend, Reno. And her younger sister, Tyas. One day Nindya found a site about a cult. In that sect, the only way to meet the devil is to have an orgasm, and one orgasm can grant a request. Nindya is determined to join the sect and sell her soul to the Devil. She has a request that she has been dreaming of, and she will do anything as long as her request is granted, despite the lives at stake.

title: Mangga Muda
overview: Agil (Tora Sudiro), a taxi driver, and his wife Luli (Alexandra Gottardo), a salon employee. live in a mediocre state. They are bussy looking for income. It makes them difficult to get a baby. Then Agil makes a wish: if his wife is pregnant then he will fulfill all requests of his wife. His prayer is answered. Luli is pregnant. Instead of being happy, Agil actually is confused. One morning he finds a brochure of a red Yaris car under the pillow of his wife's bed. He asks his wife if she really wants a red Yaris. Luli says yes. His efforts to fulfill the wishes of his wife failed continuously, and he falls into a failed robbery.

title: Akhir Kisah Cinta Si Doel
overview: Kepulangan SARAH bersama DUL ke Jakarta, disambut bahagia oleh keluarga DOEL. Namun hal tersebut juga membuat ZAENAB, SARAH, dan DOEL dihadapkan pada pilihan besar. ZAENAB yang positif hamil dan masih trauma pernah kehilangan buah hati di masa lalu, kini harus memilih antara tetap berada di sisi DOEL, atau merelakannya demi menyatukan kembali sebuah keluarga.

title: Dignitate
overview: Alfi meets Alana, a new student at school. It turns out that they are in one class and sitting next to each other. Instead of getting along, they often argue because they both are stubborn.

title: Menanti Keajaiban
overview: An optometrist and a young woman he just met slowly realize they are characters in a story being written by a pair of writers.

title: Anak Garuda
overview: 7 Anak Garuda face conflict in the absence of their mentor in Europe as they struggle to work through their differences to make this expensive trip their most memorable one.

title: Janin
overview: Randy and Dinar are married couple, and Dinar is pregnant. Their happiness disappears when a middle-aged mother becomes their new neighbor.

title: Nyanyian Akar Rumput
overview: Fajar Merah (21 years old) is the son of Wiji Thukul – a poets and human rights activist who was ‘made to disappeared’ in 1998 by The Soeharto Regime. Together with ‘Merah Bercerita’, a band established at 2010, and supported by his family, he tries to bring back his father’s poems to life, covers them with music notations and creates a music album. In a dynamic background of 2014 Presidential Election, 16 years after the 1998 tragedy, Fajar and family develops a new hope on one candidate; Joko Widodo, to solve some Human Rights Violation cases, to find Wiji Thukul and other victims.

title: Anak Ambar
overview: The neglected ties between a mother and her Ambar Child brings strange occurrences to the family.

title: Titus: Mystery of the Enygma
overview: TITUS (Arbani Yasiz) adalah tikus detektif pecinta puzzle yang tinggal di kota Steamburg. Dalam petualangannya sebagai detektif, ia ditemani kelinci pesulap bernama BOBIT (Lukman Sardi) serta FYRA (Ranty Maria) si kadal cantik yang juga seorang pilot amatir dan gemar bertualang.

title: Surat dari Kematian
overview: Failing to prove the urban legend of Mbak Rohanna's ghost at Virgin Bridge, Yogyakarta, makes Zein (Endi Arfian) have to propose other haunted places to Kinan (Carrisa Perruset) to make content on their YouTube channel. One time, Pasha (Omara Esteghlal), a student from the same college with Kinan and Zein, carries out a gruesome action in the middle of the city of Yogyakarta and claims to get a letter from the death. The letter threatens, if Pasha does not do what is ordered in the letter, then death would pick him up. From that letter, Kinan and Zein investigate Gama Plaza, an old building that had been used as a place of suicide by their campus students several years ago, Darius (Jerome Kurnia). When they begin the investigation, the next letter arrive again to one of their campus student, and this time it takes a life. Kinan believes that this is a premeditated murder, but Zein argues that everything that happens is related to the spirit of Darius.

title: Abracadabra
overview: A black comedy from a magician named Lukman who performs illusion magic that suddenly become real.

title: Cerita Cintaku
overview: Throughout the end of 2019 to early 2020 Raditya Dika toured Indonesia for the My Love Story tour, a show consisting of stand-up comedy and interaction with the audience.

title: Awang-Awang (In Their Mind)
overview: Pak Jito (49 tahun) & Ibu Suminah (45 tahun), pasangan suami istri yang sedang menonton berita perampokan di TV dengan cemas. Keduanya ingin menebus semua hutang mereka dan menghabiskan semua uang mereka secepat mungkin. Di tengah percakapan mereka, tiba-tiba suara seorang pria mengagetkan mereka berdua.

title: The Language Beneath
overview: Two language tutors meet for a short reunion after their separation in high school. There, they talked about what happened to each of them after graduating high school.

title: Rasuk 2
overview: Isabella experienced something in the autopsy room when dissecting a female body that came without identity. It changed all the views of her life.

title: Nanti Kita Cerita tentang Hari Ini
originalTitle: Nanti Kita Cerita tentang Hari Ini
overview: Harboring a deep secret, a seemingly happy family confronts the trauma of years past as a clash between generations threatens to separate them.

title: Main Lagi?
overview: Tini, an elementary school student, wanted to play on a seesaw after school. Her friend Bobi arrived unexpectedly and they started playing. The problem is: Bobi was heavier than Tini.

title: A Story From Land of Borneo
originalTitle: A Story From Land of Borneo
overview: A child experiments with a toy.

title: Death of the One who Knows
originalTitle: Death of the One who Knows
overview: In the Toraja highlands of Sulawesi (Indonesia), Lumbaa is one of the last masters of ritual speech. After his forced conversion to Pentecostalism, he is compelled to stop all his ritual activity and oratory. Concerned by the disappearance of “those who know”, a young Catholic priest named Yans Sulo sets out in search of the society’s ancient oral genres, seeking to invent new forms that would keep them alive. The two men meet. But it is too late. By recounting the life and death of Lumbaa, the film shows how the intrusion of world religion disrupts a Southeast Asian society.

title: Hide N' Run
overview: May 1998. A young girl named Ita has to run away from her father in a game of "cops and robbers". Fleeing her dad's store with her imaginary friend Beru, she is oblivious to something sinister that has happened in the outside world.

title: A "Normal" Day for Art Students
overview: Ronie, an animation student, thinks that being an animator is easy. Little did he know there are big challenges in the way.

title: Kampung Ghibah
overview: A story about a kampung of gossip-spreaders. Will they change or be stuck with the label of 'kampung ghibah'?

title: Si Manis Jembatan Ancol
overview: Maryam, a woman who are looking for happiness when her love life with Roy is in the verge of destruction. The presence of Yudha are able to make Maryam calm. But, a tragedy happened.  After that a horror urban legend started to spread. Besides bringing havoc, Maryam's presence brings a valuable lessons for the people around her.

title: The Puppets Exploded
overview: A story of "Golek" maker, traditional puppet from Sundanese, who has been a victim of two suicide bombing back in 2006 and 2009 at Bali and Jakarta, and how he survived the aftermath.

title: Wastafel
overview: Tells a story about two people being confused because of the supernatural moment that happens in their house.

title: My Super Dad
overview: Tentang perjuangan seorang Ayah bernama Johan yang baru saja dipecat dari profesinya dan kini dia melakukan apa saja demi mewujudkan keinginan putrinya bernama Mia, untuk pergi ke taman hiburan. Namun Mia tidak menyukai kebohongan, dan Ayahnya terpaksa membohongi Mia.

The year of tragedy in East Sumatra. Attacks, kidnappings, looting, robberies, rapes, and massacres occurred everywhere. Collapsed civilization, dying ancestors; covered in blood and most of them vanished without a trace. All of it resulted to inequality and poverty that is still felt to this day.

title: Barep Lanang
overview: On their way back home after delivering Tumpeng (a cone-shaped serving of yellow rice accompanied by assorted side dishes), Arman told his mother that tomorrow he will filming a movie.

title: Nussa: Bundaku

overview: A wife prepares iftar, but a shocking discovery about her husband and the caregiver leaves the family in an awkward, tense silence as they break their fast together.

title: Mahasiswi Baru
overview: Di usianya yang sudah lanjut, LASTRI (Widyawati) ingin sekali kuliah di perguruan tinggi. Saat menjadi mahasiswi baru, Lastri bersahabat dengan DANNY (Morgan Oey), SARAH (Mikha Tambayong), ERFAN (Umay Shahab) dan REVA (Sonia Alyssa). Mereka pun membentuk sebuah geng. Geng Lastri sering membuat kehebohan di kampus dan menimbulkan kericuhan hingga anak Lastri, ANNA (Karina Suwandi), pusing menghadapi ibunya yang ikut-ikutan bandel seperti pulang larut malam dan sering keluyuran. Anna jadi sering memarahi tingkah laku Lastri seolah memarahi anaknya sendiri.

title: Wedding Agreement
overview: Hari pertama tiba di rumah Bian, suaminya, Tari langsung dihadapkan pada perjanjian pernikahan yang isinya mengatakan bahwa mereka akan bercerai dalam waktu satu tahun. Bian berencana menikahi Sarah, kekasihnya. Bian melakukan pernikahan hanya demi bakti kepada orang tua. Tari pun tidak menyerah, ia mencoba mengambil hati Bian. Namun, sekuat apapun Tari mencoba, selalu ada Sarah di antara mereka.

title: Setengah Hari Kurang Sedikit
overview: Gendhis was cleaning her house while accompanied by guests who came every day, but she was still waiting. She found many items given by the guests, until finally they left, and Gendhis remained friends with nothingness.

title: Prison: A Short Introduction
overview: Tanjung Gusta Prison is the largest prison in North Sumatra. The North Sumatran region has the highest crime rate in Indonesia. In 2013, Tanjung Gusta experienced major riots caused by several internal and external problems. This could happen to other prisons in the future and will continue to worsen if the government does not fix the root cause of social issues throughout country.

title: Bridezilla
overview: Sinopsis belum diketahui.

title: Zeta: When the Dead Awaken
overview: Deon, a high school delinquent and his mother, Isma suffering from early stage of Alzheimers, are trapped inside their apartment during a sudden mysterious outbreak. Deon bumps into Reza, who was on his way to his brother’s apartment, Reyhan. Meanwhile, Deon’s father, Dr. Ross joins the special force to get the serum for the outbreak.

title: Rong
overview: Late night in Jakarta, a woman walks home alone and becomes a man's sexual harassment target, but things take an unexpected turn when the hunter suddenly becomes the hunted.

title: Koboy Kampus
overview: Pada masa kuliah tahun 90-an, Pidi dan teman-temannya, Ninu, Deni, Erwin, dan Dikdik mendirikan sebuah negara sendiri yang bernama “Negara Kesatuan Republik The Panasdalam”. Problematika masa kuliah dan kisah cinta pun mereka alami.

title: Uka-Uka The Movie: Nini Tulang
overview: Shelly ditemani Rama, Karin, Doni, dan Eja berada di hutan Alas Moyang untuk ikut serta dalam sebuah acara uji keberanian. Begitu acara dimulai, Shelly berteriak menyebut "tulang" yang menjadi pantangan di hutan itu. Tak lama, Shelly menghilang, teror dan pencarian pun dimulai.

title: Kutuk
overview: Maya yang bekerja di sebuah panti jompo, kerap mencium bau busuk di kamarnya dan mendengar suara-suara aneh setiap malam. Meskipun begitu, Maya selalu mendapat dukungan dari sang pemilik panti yang bijaksana. Dukungan ini memang kontras dengan sikap Gendis yang ketus dan tampak tidak suka dengan kehadiran Maya. Maya pun bertemu Reno, pemuda yang sering beramal untuk panti jompo. Reno memperingatkan Maya untuk segera pergi karena sisi kelam panti jompo tersebut sebentar lagi akan membahayakan dirinya.

title: Liburan Bersama Kiko
overview: Tells about the journey of Kiko and his friends on a happy holiday.

title: Sunny SIde of the Street
overview: Sunny Side of the Street follows a young truck driver who is looking for his wife amidst the riots and commotion in 1998, Jakarta. During his search, he meets a Chinese Indonesian woman who’s hiding from the masses. They end up sharing a journey through the night, in hopes of getting back to their families. After a tense encounter with a group of rioters, the driver fears his wife’s safety is not guaranteed and doubts his decision to help the woman.

title: Bilateral
overview: Two leaders carried away by emotions due to land disputes.

title: Pemuda Ka'bah
overview: Andy is a loyalist of the Ka'bah Youth Movement (GPK) which is one of the 'civil militias' under the United Development Party (PPP) based in Yogyakarta. In 2019, Andy decided to support Prabowo Subianto to become the President of Indonesia. During the unstable political tension in Indonesia, Andy was required to maintain the condition in Yogyakarta.

title: Old Mercy
overview: To pay for her dying mother's hospital bill, a woman tries to persuade her divorced father to contribute. She soon discovers that his father would rather tend to his beloved Mercedes Benz sedan.

title: Suwung
overview: Once upon a time Nyi Patek often terrorized the people of Karangnongko village at the foot of Mount Merapi. She kidnapped children to become slaves. At that time also in Karangnongko stood a hermitage led by Ki Iklik, which made Nyi Patek able to be crippled and locked in a well. At the hermitage also lives Ayu who works as a jathilan dancer. Ayu has a special relationship with Ningrum. Then, comes Sapta, the writer, who attracts Ayu's heart. At the same time Nyi Patek that was paralyzed by Ki Iklik, is terrorizing again the village of Karangnongko. Apparently Nyi Patek has a past bond with Ayu.

title: Pintu Merah
overview: Aya, seorang wartawati muda yang ambisius dan idealis, sedang dalam proses observasi untuk menulis sebuah artikel tentang sebuah kasus pembunuhan. Namun, ada misteri di dalam kasus pembunuhan ini yang menyeretnya masuk ke dalam kengerian.

title: Dilarang Menyanyi di Kamar Mandi
overview: Diangkat dari cerita pendek yang berjudul sama karya Seno Gumira Ajidarma.

title: Iqro: My Universe
overview: Aqilla bermimpi untuk menjadi seorang astronaut dan berusaha memenangkan lomba membuat vlog tentang tokoh antariksa dengan hadiah diundang ke Pusat Penelitian Angkasa Luar di Inggris. Kekecewaan karena Opanya yang seorang astronom harus bertugas ke Inggris dan tidak dapat membantunya membuat vlog akhirnya mempertemukan Aqilla dengan seorang astronaut wanita Indonesia yang sedang melakukan penelitian tanaman untuk hidup di luar angkasa.

title: Ikut Aku ke Neraka
overview: Kebahagiaan Lita dan suaminya, Rama, tidak berlangsung lama karena Lita kerap diteror oleh makhluk halus berwujud wanita menyeramkan. Rama membawa Pak Adam untuk membersihkan rumah mereka dari gangguan hantu tersebut. Pak Adam menjelaskan teror ini bukan dari rumah, melainkan dari dalam diri Lita sendiri. Pak Adam memberikan petunjuk bahwa jawaban dari teror hantu tersebut ada di masa lalu Lita, dengan meminta penjelasan dari Sari, ibu yang dia tinggalkan. Sari dirawat di rumah sakit jiwa.

title: Dua Garis Biru
overview: Dara dan Bima berusaha menjalani tanggung jawab yang menyulitkan karena telah melanggar batas. Keluguan mereka pun diuji saat keluarga memaksa masuk ke dalam perjalanan hidup mereka.

title: Untukmu Agamamu Untukkulah Agamaku
overview: A girl listened to a conversation of her friend Ronald, a Catholic, regarding fasting in the holy month of Ramadan. Ronald became the talk of the school after she told other students about Ronald's conversation.

title: Ada yang Salah dengan Ray
overview: Ray may avoid eye contact, not talk much, and move awkwardly, but he's always relatively normal until one day... he isn't, and it's up to his friends to find out what's wrong with him.

title: Melaung
overview: A man wants to report that he has been raped by woman, but the authorities do not believe his story.

title: Suburbia
overview: After receiving a blood test result and learning the name of his soul mate, Jon, a nerdy high school boy goes to confess his love for his high school crush and friend, Vio, a tomboy teen girl, despite not being each other's chosen soulmates. They both begin an unlawful relationship. At the end of the school year near the Vio's supposed marriage with her soulmate, she suggests for them to run away together, but Jon is hesitant, very much aware of the government's regulation against choosing your own partner.

title: Anak Muda Palsu
overview: Tumming, Abu, Illank, dan Darwis adalah mahasiswa semester akhir di Universitas Hasanuddin yang galau karena memikirkan kuliah mereka yang tak kunjung selesai. Mereka tinggal di tempat kos yang sama dan berjanji untuk wisuda bersama-sama. Tumming, dan kawan-kawannya tersebut juga harus menghadapi ibu kos yang super galak dan desakan dari orang tua agar segera lulus.

title: Say I Love You
overview: Terinspirasi dari sekolah SMA Selamat Pagi Indonesia (SPI) di Batu, Malang.

title: Hominins
overview: The conception of the work is based largely on prehistoric cave paintings on Sulawesi Island, as well as fossils and remains undiscovered or still undergoing excavation in East Asia, Southeast Asia and other regions. The creation of cave paintings marks the dawn of the intelligent creature discovering images for immersive experience. Species of different lineages can develop similar functions because of being in similar environments— what we call convergent evolution; different ethnicity groups, too, are able to develop consistent cognitive ability in similar spaces. As one of the oldest cave paintings, the painting at Leang-Leang cave had witnessed the beginning of consciousness, which happened across different locations in human history. It illustrates the common ground of humans and how they gradually evolve to share more similarities.

title: Lamun Sumelang
overview: A forty years old father seeks a way to save his ill daughter by killing seven people as a way of sacrifice. He chooses his victims by waiting for red comet as a sign that there will be a suicide. One night, he's planning to kill his sixth victim that leads him to a night he won't be able to move on from.

title: Koki-Koki Cilik 2
overview: When a group of kid chefs find out that their beloved cooking camp is closed, they try to raise enough money to reopen it using their culinary skills.

title: JumAhad
overview: Dua orang sahabat yang berbeda keyakinan dan tinggal dalam satu atap, Juhri yang mengira hari Minggu (Ahad) mencuci semua bajunya pada hari Jumat.

title: Sabyan Menjemput Mimpi
overview: Kisah anak-anak muda yang dipimpin Ayus untuk membentuk dan mengembangkan grup musik gambus bernama Sabyan. Banyak kisah menarik di balik perjuangan mereka dalam menggapai sebuah mimpi. Mereka mulai terkenal berkat unggahan video sederhana di YouTube. Sabyan mulai memiliki penggemar. Bahkan, ada penggemar fanatik seperti Ndut Kece yang selalu hadir di mana pun Sabyan ada, juga Bilal yang memiliki keterbatasan fisik dan hanya mampu melihat Sabyan di dunia maya.

title: Note
overview: A young immigrant from Afghanistan, overcame his boredom during a stopover in Kupang - Indonesia by carrying out positive activities, one of which was learning to make films with local people in Kupang.

title: Mendadak Kaya
overview: Karena sejumlah permasalahan, Doyok, Otoy, dan Ali Oncom terpaksa harus menghasilkan uang banyak dalam waktu singkat. Mereka terpaksa melakukan aksi tipu-tipu dan terlibat transaksi misterius antargangster. Peristiwa itu justru membawa keuntungan. Mereka berhasil membawa kabur uang miliyaran rupiah dan impian mereka menjadi orang kaya pun tercapai. Namun, mereka tidak paham jika kekayaan tersebut juga menghadirkan petaka.

title: Rumah Merah Putih
overview: Farel, Oscar, dan kawan-kawannya yang tinggal di perbatasan NTT-Timor Leste mengikuti lomba panjat pinang. Namun, bukannya bersatu, mereka berdebat hadiah mana yang harus diambil lebih dulu. Mereka gagal dan kemudian menyalahkan satu sama lain. Masalah semakin rumit ketika dua kaleng cat merah putih milik Farel hilang. Takut dimarahi ayahnya, Farel, Oscar, dan kawan-kawannya berupaya mengumpulkan uang untuk membeli cat. Mereka mengetahui akan ada lomba panjat pinang lagi berhadiah cat merah putih. Saat lomba, Oscar terjatuh dan sakit. Ini kisah Farel, Oscar, dan kawan-kawannya untuk merayakan 17 Agustus.

title: Doremi & You
overview: Perjuangan empat sahabat, Putri, Anisa, Imung, dan Markus, berusaha mengganti uang ekstrakurikuler paduan suara yang tidak sengaja mereka hilangkan, dengan mengikuti kompetisi menyanyi ‘Doremi & You’. Perjuangan keempat sahabat untuk memenangkan kompetisi tersebut menjadi berat saat Reno, asisten pelatih paduan suara yang diharapkan menjadi pelatih mereka, ternyata menjadi saingan terberat mereka di kompetisi.

title: Take Back!
overview: This  documentary follows an investigation by Prigi Arisandi and his team into the smuggling of imported domestic waste from Western countries into East Java, disguised as shipments of used paper. The investigation exposes how developed countries contribute to Indonesia’s waste crisis, despite Indonesia being labeled the world’s second-largest contributor of plastic waste to the oceans.

title: Mountain Song
overview: Since his father died, Gimba did not want to get away from his mother, while his mother feels that her health is getting worsen. One day, Gimba was left in a hut by his mother. Gimba also realized that his mother was gone too long.

title: Humba Dreams
overview: Martin, seorang mahasiswa film di Jakarta, pulang ke kampungnya di Sumba untuk sebuah tugas yang tak mudah. Perjalanan mempertemukan Martin dengan Ana dan berbagai pertanyaan tentang Humba, dan dirinya pun perlahan menemukan jawaban.

title: Bacakut Pandir
overview: Two men argues about presidential candidate choices.

title: Presence of Mind
overview: ​​Presence Of Mind menceritakan tentang penghuni kostan dengan berbagai macam karakter unik di dalamnya. Penghuni kost ini sangat tidak akur satu sama lainnya dan memiliki sifat individualis, Ketika mereka semua dihadapkan dengan suatu kejadian, akankah mereka dapat melaluinya?

title: The Sacred Peacock Flies Above Jupiter
originalTitle: The Sacred Peacock Flies Above Jupiter
overview: "Randy is an introvert and hypersex college student who puzzled his mind when he realized that he has a sexual interest to his sister (Sandy) after he peeked his sister in the middle of Jaipong dance practice."

title: Posko Palu
overview: On 28 September 2018, the Indonesian city of Palu was hit by an earthquake that was followed by a tsunami. The city was almost completely destroyed. This documentary shows how three teens cope with losing their school, home and even family members. Besides the great loss, there is also time for fun.

title: Si Doel the Movie 2
overview: Kabar bahwa suaminya bertemu dengan mantan kekasih dan anak membuat Zaenab bingung memilih: mempertahankan pernikahannya dengan Doel, atau merelakannya. Terlebih saat Doel mengatakan bahwa Sarah dan Dul akan menetap di Jakarta., Zaenab mencoba mencari jawaban atas takdir yang harus ia pilih. Harapan mulai terbuka saat Doel mendapat kabar dari Atun bahwa kemungkinan Zaenab tengah mengandung. Penegasan datang saat Sarah datang berkunjung untuk mengungkapkan penyesalan atas apa yang terjadi di masa lalu kepada Maknyak dan meminta Dul untuk memanggil Zaenab sebagai ibu.

title: Kuntilanak 2
overview: Dinda yang berhasil lepas dari teror Kuntilanak, tanpa persetujuan Tante Donna, berniat untuk menemui seseorang yang diyakini sebagai ibu kandungnya, Karmila. Bersama adik-adiknya dan ditemani Julia dan Edwin, mereka malah terjebak dalam sebuah rumah di tengah hutan. Banyak kejanggalan terjadi. Dinda kembali harus berhadapan dengan Kuntilanak, tetapi berbeda dengan yang pernah dikalahkannya dengan menggunakan paku atau mantra.

title: Single: Part 2
overview: Ebi bertekad untuk melepaskan status single-nya sebelum ulang tahunnya yang ke-30 meskipun ia tidak tahu bagaimana caranya.

title: Ghost Writer
overview: Sebuah buku catatan harian tua berisi rahasia kelam. Bagi Galih, buku ini adalah sebuah pembelaan terhadap prasangka kedua orangtuanya. Bagi Naya, buku ini adalah materi bagus untuk novel terbarunya setelah tiga tahun kering ide. Maka sebuah kerjasama beda alam pun dimulai.

title: Hit & Run
overview: Tegar ditugaskan untuk menangkap Coki, seorang gembong narkoba yang kabur dari penjara. Bersama Lio seorang penipu, Meisa, dan Jefri, justru membuatnya semakin sulit.

title: Angen-Angen
overview: One sunny afternoon after school, Deo watched the fish in the jar. Budhe rebuked the habit and said that there would be consequences for his behavior. Deo insisted that what he was doing did not harm the fish. Budhe finally introduces the concepts of heaven and hell to Deo, making him wonder how he got there. This is his struggle to achieve that desire.

title: Nawal
overview: Maha, a student involved in the activism movement during May 1998 in Indonesia, grapples with the choice of joining the protest or heeding his mother's advice not to participate in the demonstration.

title: Down Swan
overview: Nadia, pengidap sindrom down, memiliki cita-cita menjadi penari balet. Kegigihan Nadia  melibatkan kedua orangtuanya, Bisma dan Mitha. Mitha, mantan penari balet, sempat tertekan dan kecewa setelah tahu janin dalam kandungannya divonis terlahir dengan sindrom down. Padahal, Mitha sangat berharap putrinya bisa menjadi pebalet. Setelah Nadia lahir, bertahun-tahun Mitha memilih sikap penyangkalan. Bisma yang lebih dekat dengan Nadia di tahun-tahun pertama kehidupan gadis kecil itu. Saat berusia sembilan tahun Nadia semakin penasaran dengan balet. Secercah harapan tumbuh di hati Mitha. Dia tergerak untuk lebih dekat dengan Nadia, bahkan mengajari putrinya menari balet.

title: One of Those Murder
overview: A woman was brutally murdered. His body was found by two cleaners, who cared nothing but gossip and content.

title: #Malam Jumat The Movie
overview: Untuk memberikan pengalaman berbeda pada penontonnya, Ewing mencoba hal baru dengan menjelajah sebuah taman bermain bernama Wonder Park yang telah lama terbengkalai. Bersama dengan timnya, Agan, Oji, Wingky, dan Lulu, mereka menemukan jaket dan topi berinisial RH di taman tersebut. Diduga benda-benda itu milik pelaku bunuh diri, tapi mereka tidak menemukan mayatnya. Seorang gadis bernama Dinda, mengaku sebagai adik pemilik jaket dan topi tersebut. Dia tidak yakin kakaknya bunuh diri. Untuk membuktikan itu, Dinda mengajak Ewing dan timnya untuk kembali ke Wonder Park. Pada kunjungan yang kedua ini, mereka harus menghadapi kenyataan yang lebih mengerikan.

title: The Lawyers: Pokrol Bambu
overview: Johan Nabawi sangat mencintai istrinya Nina Tanjung, tapi Nina menuntut cerai karena Johan mengidap penyakit sadomasochist. Keduanya menyewa pengacara. Johan memakai jasa RM Wicaksono, pengacara papan atas, sedangkan Nina menyewa jasa Supermen, pokrol bambu.

title: Jack (2019)
overview: Jack, keturunan Arab, dipaksa untuk meneruskan usaha toko milik Abinya, Wak Dollah. Demi mengikuti kemauan Abinya, Jack rela kuliah di jurusan yang tidak sejalan dengan dunia seni yang ia cintai. Sudah hampir tujuh tahun kuliahnya tak kunjung usai. Suasana makin memanas ketika Wak Dollah mengetahui kedekatan Jack dengan gadis keturunan Tionghoa, Meyling, anak tunggal Koh Halim, juragan toko obat cina ternama di Surabaya.

title: Ambu
overview: Ambu Misnah ditinggal anak perempuannya, Fatma, yang pergi dari rumah mereka di Baduy demi cintanya pada pemuda Jakarta, Nico. Fatma kemudian memiliki anak bernama Nona. Suatu hari, Fatma membawa Nona pulang ke Baduy. Polemik keluarga muncul.

title: Truly Manly
overview: Resigned from his job in the capital, Zulkifli decided to move to Yogyakarta, with his wife and son Zaky. His life in Yogyakarta underwent many changes. How did Zulkifli deal with his family?

title: Roh Fasik
overview: Kematian Zahra, istrinya, membuat Akbar tidak lagi mau mengimani agama dan Tuhannya. Bahkan ketika sudah menikah lagi, kehidupan Akbar bersama istri barunya, Renata, tidak pernah seindah dulu. Hingga suatu ketika, Hasan, sahabat lama Akbar datang untuk menjenguk dan mengajak Akbar kembali ke jalan yang benar, setidaknya demi Amira, buah hati pernikahan Akbar dan Zahra. Meskipun sempat menolak, namun pada akhirnya Akbar mengizinkan Hasan mengajarkan Amira bertadarus. Dan, sejak saat itulah kejadian-kejadian aneh mulai terjadi. Naasnya, Renata lah yang paling sering menjadi korban teror dari Iblis yang bersemayam di rumahnya.

title: Pariban : Idola Dari Tanah Jawa
overview: Moan adalah pemuda Batak yang sudah lama tinggal di Jakarta. Meski usianya sudah menginjak 37 tahun, tetapi ia belum punya pacar. Situasi ini membuat ibunya yang bermukim di Samosir pusing. Ia memaksa Moan mudik dan menikah dengan sepupunya, Uli. Di luar dugaan, Uli yang diceritakan sebagai wanita cantik dan mencintai budaya Batak, sudah memiliki kekasih, Binsar.

title: Robot Vampire
overview: Acang dan Ghanit sepasang kekasih yang harus menyelesaikan urusan pekerjaan masing masing. Suatu ketika Acang jatuh sakit dan sang Ibu menyuruhnya untuk mencari pekerjaan lain. Akan tetapi pekerjaan tersebut justru menimbulkan permasalahan baru, hingga Acang meminta bantuan Ghanit untuk melancarkan aksi terror di tempat kerja barunya, saat sang ibu berangkat senam mingguan.

title: Hatiku Di Skakmat By You
overview: Ceritanya tentang Bayu (24) nyaris lenyap dikeroyok warga sekampung setelah dituduh mencuri ayam. Dia sakit hati karena keadaan ekonomi yang rendah seringkali mendapatkan diskriminasi dan penghinaan. Dengan segenap tekad, Bayu merantau ke Jakarta untuk mewujudkan mimpinya jadi artis dan berharap warga kampungnya dilanda sesal.

title: Alon-Alon Waton Kelakon
overview: A man gets back to his home in a little village and wants to take his father and his sister to live in the city. But he find difficulties that they reject to move and accept new culture.

title: Schafe - A Stop-Motion Film Spontaneously Created by Two Students Eager to Pass Their Second-Year Course
originalTitle: Schafe - A Stop-Motion Film Spontaneously Created by Two Students Eager to Pass Their Second-Year Course
overview: A short story about two beings sharing life experiences as they go - A stop-motion film inspired by 'Shaun the Sheep', but in a horror version. Made on a second-year student budget with all its limitations—from a small production team to lack of sleep and dwindling finances. You can find this short film in Youtube.

title: Sukep: The Movie
overview: Sukep yang sudah menjadi publik figur berkat aksi-aksi lawak-tunggalnya, ingin membalas budi pada Ivan, salah seorang sahabat karib yang telah banyak membantu dalam perjalan kariernya. Namun, Sukep justru terjebak dengan kisah cinta masa lalu dengan Anty, yang ternyata menjadi istri Ivan. Sukep dan Anty intens menjalin komunikasi, hingga suatu hari, Ivan mengetahui masa lalu antara Sukep dan Anty serta menangkap basah komunikasi mereka berdua. Anty akhirnya membongkar rahasia Sukep yang selama ini ditutupi.

title: Sekte
overview: Lia sempat mengalami hilang ingatan pasca kecelakaan. Saat terbangun, ia berada di sebuah rumah besar yang terisolasi. Itu tempat sebuah komunitas yang terdiri dari orang-orang yang tak memiliki rumah dan kerabat. Mereka hidup rukun dan saling menjaga. Mereka lah yang menolong Lia saat kecelakaaan. Karena tidak ingat siapa dirinya dan kemana harus pergi, Lia pun tinggal disana untuk mendapatkan perawatan. Hari berlalu, Lia yang mulai sedikit pulih menyadari ada hal yang aneh dengan situasi tempat dirinya tinggal. Ternyata para penghuni rumah terdiri dari para pengikut sekte aliran sesat dan orang-orang yang masuk ke rumah tersebut tidak pernah bisa keluar lagi.

title: Cinta Monyet Never Forget
overview: Hendra (Ricky Harun) dan Jennifer (Glenca Chysara) adalah teman dimasa kecil dahulu, namun karena Hendra yang justru dekat dengan cewek lainnya membuat Jenni kecewa dan mulai sejak itu mereka saling berpisah sampai dewasa.

title: 27 Steps of May
overview: Seorang remaja perempuan bernama May sedang menghadapi masa trauma karena kekerasan seksual yang ia alami. Ayahnya merasa bersalah dan menyalahkan dirinya karena tidak bisa menjaga anaknya hingga melampiaskannya di ring tinju. Tetangganya yang seorang pesulap mencoba membantu dan memahami keadaan May dengan trik-trik sulapnya.

title: Heelp!! Mamiku Lebih Laku dari Aku
originalTitle: Heelp!! Mamiku Lebih Laku dari Aku
overview: Biru (Angelica Simperler) sebal karena punya mami yang cantik dan masih muda, Mira (Jelita Callebaut). Biru yang sedang giat-giatnya cari jodoh, tapi hidupnya mendadak jungkir balik karena Mira yang baru saja bercerai ternyata juga sedang cari jodoh baru. Biru semakin sebal ketika Mira lebih laku daripada dirinya. Bagaimana kisah selanjutnya?

title: Lasagna
overview: Approaching Rudi's execution (Mirna's Husband), Mirna was asked to come to the  prison with a Lasagna. Her husband wishes to enjoy the Lasagna with Mirna for the very last time. But when Mirna came with the Lasagna, Rudi chooses not to eat it.

title: From Gadungan Jadi Tunangan
overview: Hardi Fadillah mengalami hilang ingatan setelah ditabrak oleh Glenca Chysara. Pasca hilang ingatan, anehnya Hardi malah merasa kalau dirinya adalah seorang dokter padahal dirinya hanya seorang tukang bakso.

title: Subak
overview: Nespresso Talents is a celebration of creative filmmaking. Now in its fourth year, this unique competition empowers filmmakers to tell a story through the format of vertical video. More than 380 videos were submitted from over 40 countries.

title: Menjadi Dara
overview: ANTO (12) and BUDI (12) must take a responsibility how it feels becoming a girl name DARA (12) who experienced her first menstruation when they were playing football in abandoned field far away from the market.

title: Pocong the Origin
overview: Ananta, pembunuh berdarah dingin telah dieksekusi mati oleh Negara. Sasthi, putri satu-satunya, harus mengantarkan jenazah sang ayah untuk dikuburkan di kampung halamannya. Dengan ditemani Yama, sipir penjara, keduanya berpacu dengan waktu untuk mencapai kampung Ananta. Hal ini menjadi semakin sulit karna berbagai gangguan gaib menghalangi mereka di sepanjang perjalanan.

title: Rumput Tetangga
overview: Kirana, ibu rumah tangga, mengalami krisis kepercayaan diri dan ingin jadi perempuan single sukses.

title: Kucumbu Tubuh Indahku
overview: Perjalanan penari lengger lanang, Juno, yang mengalami berbagai trauma kekerasan usai bertemu dari petinju hingga maestro penari Reog hingga berupaya menemukan keindahan tubuhnya sendiri.

title: Sexy Killers
overview: An Indonesian documentary about the destructive impact of coal mining.

title: Diary of Cattle
overview: In Indonesia, in the Padang district, an open landfill site borders the forest. A landscape of precipitous terrain, with its crest lines and its chasms, serves as a pasture for several hundred cows. Amidst the dance of the diggers and trucks discharging their loads onto the slopes of a mountain of rubbish, a herd makes its way through the chaos, in search of something to graze. This nightmarish decor in which bovines live, copulate, play, sleep and die, becomes the scene of an appalling spectacle.

title: Bumi Itu Bulat
overview: Kerap berseteru dengan ayahnya yang banser, Rahabi lebih memilih teman-temannya di kampus, Markus, Hitu, Sayid dan Tiara membentuk grup acapella. Produser musik yang menawari rekaman punya syarat menyertakan Aisha, mantan penyanyi cilik yang punya ideologi berbeda.

title: Sunyi
overview: Physical and mental violence became Alex's daily menu at the school. Terrible incident haunts senior students after a spirit-calling ritual.

title: Ave Maryam
overview: Seorang suster taat yang merawat para seniornya harus memilih antara memegang sumpahnya atau menuruti perasaan terlarang yang ia simpan untuk seorang pastor menawan.

title: MeloDylan
overview: Melody pindah sekolah karena menghindari masalah, apalagi ia memiliki masa lalu yang buruk dengan David, mantan kekasihnya. Tetapi di sekolah baru, masalah kembali muncul saat Melody mengenal Dylan, cowok yang selama ini terkenal cool, suka bikin masalah namun tetap menjadi idola karena kegantengannya. Rumor tentang Dylan sudah menjadi rahasia umum. Melody dan Dylan tak menemukan titik temu dalam masalah cinta mereka, sehingga mereka sepakat untuk memutuskan hubungan mereka. Melody baru sadar bahwa cintanya pada Dylan begitu besar. Tetapi, terlambat. Dylan dikirim ayahnya kuliah ke luar negeri. Melody hanya bisa sedih melepas kepergian Dylan. Sebelum berangkat, ternyata Dylan memberikan sebuah video romantis pada Melody. Dengan vidio itu, Dylan mengungkapkan semua isi hatinya. Kejujuran Dylan membuat Melody memiliki harapan baru.

title: Lukisan Ratu Kidul
overview: Dimas and Satria Soedibyo actually has many questions when their father died: their grandfather; Rusdi Soedibyo, is a famous painter in the 80s, the death of their mother who was never told, the house that is now suddenly passed on to them, also about a painting hidden in the house. Dimas invites his wife and child, Astrid and Sandra, to visit the house to find answers. Satria finds various items that make him sure, that the house might have been occupied by them as a child. In that house, when the night comes, appeares the figure of a woman dressed in Javanese nobility, who haunting Satria. Dimas actually want to sell the house to a collector who believes that there is a very high value painting in the house. The painting is later discovered by Sandra. The Queen of South painting by the grandfather was the source of the Soedibyo family's disaster for decades. The figure behind the painting now threatens the safety of Dimas, Satria, Astrid and Sandra.

title: Mantan Manten
overview: After a betrayal at work, a finance professional becomes an assistant to a bride shaman in order to salvage her only remaining property — and love life.

title: Suporter Masuk Pesantren
overview: Aso yang punya kegemaran menonton sepakbola ke stadion setiap tim kesayangannya bertanding, dimasukkan ke pesantren oleh orang tuanya. Kondisi pesantren menyebabkan Aso tidak lagi bisa secara leluasa menyalurkan kegemaran menontonnya ke stadion. Aso kemudian bersahabat dengan Dul, Yos dan Sultan, yang berasal dari daerah berbeda. Pesantren kemudian menjadikan persahabatan mereka melebihi kedekatan dengan saudara kandungnya sendiri. Mereka kemudian menjalin persahabatan dengan sebutan "sahabat kandung".

title: My Stupid Boss 2
overview: Having driven away many of his employees, Bossman and three of his long-suffering workers try to find cheap labor in Vietnam but find trouble instead.

title: MatiAnak
overview: Since a new kid arrives at an orphanage, weird things started to happen.

title: Rangsangan Gaib
overview: One night, Amanda realized her body covered in dirt. She heard Bram moaning next room. Turn out he's having sex with his ex-girlfriend's corpse, Santi. After confronting Bram, Amanda surprised that actually it is her who brought Santi's corpse to their home.

title: Matahari Terbit di Hutan
overview: A quiet hamlet in the backwoods of West Java, a boy is left curious by the death of his father. One day, he meets a forest spirit whom he thinks may know where his father is.

title: Pohon Terkenal
overview: As a new cadet at the Police Academy, Semarang, Bara Maulana, Ayu Sekarwati and Johanes Solossa have to say goodbye to normal teenage lives. Their future is no longer their own. Who will survive and who will give up? Especially when love and heart are at stake.

title: Roy Kiyoshi: The Untold Story
overview: Roy, who has the ability to interact with supernatural beings, is very frustrated when his sister Rani is kidnapped by the demon. Roy feels he failed to protect his younger sister. Three years later, Sheila, one of the NGO workers who cares about lost children, is terrorized by the devil while dealing with cases of children mysteriously disappearing. The demon always appears in the middle of the night and wants to kill Sheila. Sheila is very confident that the appearance of this demon has something to do with the case she is handling. Moreover, Sheila knows that one of the members of the NGO died horribly while handling this case.

title: Kuambil Lagi Hatiku
overview: Agra City, India, will be the witness to the marriage of Sinta and Vikash, which are just counting the days. But Sinta is shocked by her mother, Widhi Malthora, who suddenly disappears. Sinta tries various ways to find out her mother's whereabouts while Vikash's family urge that the marriage be carried out immediately. Apparently Widhi returns to her hometown in Indonesia after receiving a telephone call from Dimas, her only brother. Widhi gets word that her father had died three months ago. Sinta is shocked because she always heard from her mother that her mother has no family in Java. Sinta is following her mother's departure with a thousand questions and delays her marriage in India. Arriving in Borobudur Village, Widhi's hometown, how surprised is Sinta, when she discovers the reality of her true roots and the dark secrets of her mother's past is not as beautiful as she has imagined so far. This reality will change her life forever.

title: Leak (Penangkeb)
overview: Yessy, Sandra, Kayun, Edy, and Yunda want to prove the weirdness that happened in an old villa. The oddity is felt when the villa guard says that there is one room that is not rented, because it is specifically for the family of the villa owner. The mystical aura they feel, makes them try to enter a different realm. However, the terror they feel in the unseen realm forces them to return to the real world. Because of the mistakes made by Sandra, the terror continues and is increasingly frightening. With this incident, the mystery of the family room in the villa begins to unfold. There is a grandmother who lay paralyzed for five years. Grandma is deliberately exiled by the family, because the neighbors suspect grandmother of being able to become leak (evil spirits).

title: The Sacred Riana: Beginning
overview: In her childhood, Riana lived in a small town with her father and her mother who ran a funeral house business. A disaster required them move to Uncle Johan's house in Jakarta and Riana meets with Riani doll. Riana grows up and one day got visited by Mrs. Klara, a counselor-teacher in her school who wants to know why Riana has not attended school and suggests Riana rehabilitated. Disasters take place to Riana's parents. Mrs. Klara comes again with Hendro, Lusi and Anggi, to help Riana socialize. But, their presence triggers a bigger problem; a vicious creature of the past ia released and terrorize them all.

title: Yowis Ben 2
overview: Recently dumped and facing eviction, a musician pins all his hopes on securing new gigs – but getting his band's groove back won't be so easy.

title: Woo Woo
overview: Ali, 19 years old, had no family or friends except for being quiet who eventually terrorized him and the people around him.

title: [Ma]Cho
overview: Indonesia has been very progressive. Women are daring to be exposed by the heat of the sun to vocalize their thought. One of the demand is acceptance for LGBT community. On the other side, a masculine lesbian wanted to have a child.

title: Adaptasi
overview: Seorang remaja mencoba untuk pulih dari masa lalunya yang traumatis, sambil melawan ketakutan batinnya untuk kembali bersosialisasi

title: Reva: Guna Guna
overview: Reva, a cheerful student, suddenly changes after her 21st birthday. Reva becomes moody and doesn't want to hang out. Then at her house, her mother and two younger siblings are killed sadistically. Reva is declared a murderer and is rehabilitated in a mental hospital. Devi, Reva's best friend, does not believe this and feels there is something about Reva. At the hospital Reva is terrorized by a horrible supernatural being. Doctor Karina, Reva's aunt, always assures her that it is only Reva's hallucinations. But, the supernatural creature keeps appearing and tries to kill Reva. From the paranormal smuggled into a mental hospital, it is discovered that the supernatural being is sent to kill Reva. Reva and Devi try to find out who and what supernatural beings sent for to Reva. From this supernatural being it is revealed who killed Reva's mother and sisters.

title: Kill Me by Your Hands
overview: Vio and Adim’s friendship had changed after one of them felt the existence of love. Vio's overacting reaction led Adim to the adventure that was not supposed to be. Lira became a witness how Vio and Adim got more closer and turned into deadly jealousy in an island of memories.

title: Mepet Ngiwa
overview: Peni (40) ingin memiliki mobil karena terpengaruh lingkungan disekitarnya. Kemudian, ia  membujuk suaminya Nana (47) untuk segera membelikan mobil. Namun, Nana masih  mempertimbangkan hal tersebut karena masalah keuangan. Ketika mereka sudah memiliki mobil  kehidupan mereka menjadi tidak tenang, karena keterbatasan lahan parkir di rumahnya yang  mengharuskan mereka untuk memarkirkan mobilnya di pinggir jalan depan rumah. Hingga suatu  hari, Peni merasa mobilnya hilang, yang kenyataannya dibawa Nana untuk mengantar tetangganya  yang terkena serangan jantung.

title: Aram Temaram
overview: Kuncung (17) yang masih menduduki bangku SMA tinggal bersama ibunya yang  bernama Sumiati beserta adiknya, Dwi (10). Ayahnya yang bernama Parman (38) pergi dari  rumah karena ketidakharmonisan hubungan dengan Sumiati. Sejak Parman pergi dari rumah,  terpaksa Kuncung harus berhenti sekolah dan mengganti peran Parman karena perekonomian  mereka semakin memburuk. Saat Kuncung menghadapi kondisi yang menghimpit keluarganya,  Kuncung terpaksa menjalankan profesi sebagai kurir narkoba.

title: Ahengkara
overview: Pak Pram merupakan seseorang yang dihormati di kampungnya. Ia adalah seorang  pensiunan swasta yang tinggal berdua dengan burung yang sangat Ia sayangi,  Naren. Para warga kampungnya menaruh rasa hormat yang besar padanya, karena  burungnya memiliki kicauan yang sangat indah. Ia juga sering memenangkan lomba  kicau burung di kampungnya. Tahun ini Ia berencana untuk ikut lagi, namun sesuatu  yang buruk terjadi pada burungnya.

title: Dumogi Memargi Antar
overview: Suci, a pregnant woman who went away from home to her late father's house. In their tradition, pregnant women are forbidden to enter the funeral.

title: Dilan 1991
overview: 22 Desember 1990, Dilan (Iqbaal Ramadhan) dan Milea (Vanesha Prescilla) resmi berpacaran. Ditengah kebahagiaan mereka Dilan terancam dipecat dari sekolah akibat perkelahian dengan Anhar (Giulio Parengkuan). Dilan juga semakin sering berkelahi dan mendapatkan musuh.Milea khawatir dengan masa depan Dilan. Milea merasa berhak melarang Dilan terlibat dalam geng motor. Suatu ketika, Dilan dikeroyok oleh orang tak dikenal. Saat mengetahui siapa yang berbuat, Dilan merencanakan balas dendam. Milea akhirnya meminta Dilan berhenti dari geng motor atau hubungan mereka berakhir. Dilan, seorang panglima tempur dan ketua geng motor, akan selalu terlibat masalah. Di tengah semua masalah itu, hadir Yugo (Jerome Kurnia), anak dari sepupu jauh ayah Milea yang baru pulang dari Belgia. Mereka sering menghabiskan waktu bersama. Yugo menyukai Milea. Dan Milea...hanya mencintai Dilan.

title: 11:11: Apa yang Kau Lihat?
overview: One night at 11:11 sharp, Galih (Rendy Kjaernet), an archaeological student who likes diving and photography, found the whereabouts of Dewi, her mother. Dewi disappeared when Galih was a child on a remote island called Tanjung Biru. Galih travels to the place with three friends, Ozan (Fauzan Smith), Vania (Twindy Rarasati) and Martin Bayu Anggara). During that dive, they find a ship wrecked on the sea floor. Inside the ship they find an ancient artifact that is a clue to look for Galih's mother, but the artifact also brought disaster. The disturbance after disturbance from the guardian ghost of Tanjung Biru hit the group.

title: Anak Hoki
overview: In his early teens, Ahok has to leave the comfort of his life in Belitung and start living independently in Jakarta. Ahok then gets to know Daniel, Bayu, and Eva who become his closest friends. Ahok is determined to apply all the moral values and goodness he learned from his father. But doing good is not as simple as he thought. When Bayu begins to fall in love with Eva and is jealous of Ahok, when Daniel begins to involve Ahok in his lies with his family, and when Eva apparently keeps a big secret and runs away from home, Ahok realizes, there were times when doing right needed sacrifice and struggle. Not to mention when Ahok realizes that he could not fulfill his father's hopes of becoming a doctor.

title: Foxtrot Six
overview: Demi kekuasaan, suatu rezim kejam memonopoli pasokan makanan di Indonesia. Seorang mantan marinir membentuk tim yang berisi mantan rekannya untuk membereskan masalah ini.

title: Sampah
overview: A teenager from the city who recently moved to the village and often throws garbage into the river. But after he had a dream and a strange incident he no longer threw garbage into the river.

title: Kemanten
overview: When her younger sister falls ill, Lilis faces a dilemma between continuing with her wedding ceremony, which is still being prepared, or canceling it.

title: Kain Kafan Hitam
overview: Evelyn, a student, has two younger siblings: Arya and Maya who are still in elementary and middle school. Evelyn has a boyfriend, Bimo, who has a hobby of horror. In fact, he has a strange community on campus, a demon search community. Bimo is accompanied by Angeline and Roy in the community. Evelyn says that after her parents died in an accident, she has to move from her house because the house had been mortgaged to the bank for a long time. They find a house that was in line with Evelyn's financial abilities. Mysteries happen in that house.

title: Calon Bini
overview: Ningsih is forced to marry Sapto by her father. She refuses the arranged marriage and fled away to Jakarta. She falls in love with the person she met on the internet.

title: Antologi Rasa
overview: The relationships of a group of co-workers grow complicated due to a great deal of unrequited love between them.

title: A Criança Roubada
overview: During Timor's brutal occupation by Indonesia thousands of children were stolen, as were many of the country's resources. This is 'Jose' Abdul Rahman's story. In 1978 Jose, eight at the time, was hiding on Mount Matebian when a plane dropped a bomb, killing 22 of his family. He survived, fled the mountain and started following an Indonesian Battalion. The soldiers forced Jose, and many other boys, to work as porters. In 1979 the soldiers took the children by ship to Indonesia.

title: Satu Suro
overview: Bayu brings Adinda to hospital to give birth. Bayu goes back home and when he returns to the hospital he finds an empty, vacant old building.

title: Laundry Show
overview: Uki or familiarly called Kokoh chooses to resign from his office to set up a laundry business. At the beginning, he has to deal with his employees who have various ridiculous personalities: Tiur, a receptionist who is very ignorant, Kendi and Deden who always make troubles at the ironing table .. However, Kokoh's biggest challenge is unexpected competition from Agustina, who suddenly sets up a laundry business right in front of her kiosk. Now, Kokoh must choose between business or the seed of love that slowly begins to grow.

title: The Way I Love You
overview: A girl who has never been in love falls for someone she met online. When they meet in real life, she starts to realize that love is complicated.

title: Jalan Jalan Sore
overview: When they lose their wallet during a picnic, a husband and wife rediscover the beauty in their romance through conversation of life, Jakarta, rich people and cheap shoes.

title: Salmiyah
overview: Salmiyah explores fragments of memory, perceptions of historical actors, history buffs, and audiences. The past, always leaves questions, it can never come back in its full form. People are competing with each other to create their own history. Salmiyah is an attempt to describe the complexity of history which is always full of bias and distance.

title: PSP: Gaya Mahasiswa
overview: Monos, Rojali, Ade, Andra, Adit, Dindin, James, and Omen are students who are crazy, ignorant, but cool in music and are members of the OM Pancaran Sinar Petromaks (PSP). They are always agree in all matters, but in romance they make bets, as do Rojali, Monos and Ade. Ade has fallen in love with Fatima, a beautiful and sexy boarding house nanny. Dindin, Andra, and Adit are the trouble maker. They like to make pranks on campus so they are subject to sanctions for dropping out. They are shocked by the case of robber. This case developes into a hoax, which involved their college friends. Omen and James are moved to investigate this case with the help of PSP friends.

title: Tembang Lingsir
overview: Mala always deals with Tembang Lingsir, a song taught by her mother from her childhood. After a mysterious fire incident that killed her mother, Mala lost her voice. Then, Mala lives in her uncle's house, Gatot, and his wife Gladys with their two children, Daisy and his younger brother, Ronald. At the house, Mbok Rahma also takes care of their needs. Daisy is disturbed by Mala's presence, while Ronald is happy. Since Mala's arrival, the atmosphere of the house is no longer the same. Many strange events appear. Mbok Rahma accuses Mala of causing all this chaos. Mala feels that there is a big secret in this house that make all the terror appear. Especially when she discovers that she has a twin sister she has never known before.

title: Terlalu Tampan
overview: Witing Tresno Jalaran Soko Kulino alias Mas Kulin (Ari Irham) yang terlalu tampan selalu menghindari masuk ke sekolah regular dan memilih menghabiskan hampir 100% hidupnya di dalam rumah. Hal itu yang membuat ayahnya, Pak Archewe (Marcelino Lefrandt), ibunya, Bu Suk (Iis Dahlia), dan kakaknya, Mas Okis (Tarra Budiman), khawatir. Mereka menyusun skenario yang berhasil membuat Mas Kulin setuju untuk menghabiskan tahun terakhir masa SMA-nya di sekolah khusus pria, SMA Horridson. Ketampanan Mas Kulin terekspos ke dunia luar hingga hari-harinya berjalan tidak biasa: guru-guru wanita pingsan dan menjadi incaran siswi-siswi SMA BBM. Termasuk seorang gadis terlalu cantik: Amanda (Nikita Willy). Namun, di tengah semua itu, Mas Kulin menemukan Kibo (Calvin Jeremy) dan Rere (Rachel Amanda), yang membuatnya percaya bahwa masih ada orang yang dapat melihat dirinya apa adanya.

title: Lihat Dulu Kiri-Kanan
overview: When a pornographic VCD gets stuck inside the VCD player due to a power failure, An adolescence boy must race against time to pull it out before his menacing father finds out

title: Lamunan Oi!
overview: A portrait of the largest Muslim Punk community in the world, as seen through the eyes of Punk teenagers, in relation to the extreme social, environmental and political environment they live in.

title: Dancing boy
overview: Dancing boy bercerita tentang seorang anak laki-laki yang mempunyai mimpi untuk menjadi penari, namun ia terhalang oleh lingkungan sekitarnya, karena stereotype tarian hanya untuk anak perempuan.

title: Tabu: Mengusik Gerbang Iblis
overview: When six best high school buddies are cross the forbidden forest and broken all the rules in there, something evil follow their back and causing death among themselves.

title: Matt & Mou
overview: A seemingly platonic friendship gets tested when a high school teen wants her closest friend to endorse her new romance with a local musician.

title: Orang Kaya Baru
overview: Cerita tentang kaya mendadak yang dialami oleh sebuah keluarga yaitu Ibu (Cut Mini), Ayah (Lukman Sardi) dan tiga anak mereka: Tika (Raline Shah), Duta (Derby Romero), dan Dodi (Fatih Unru). Keluarga ini selalu menjalani kehidupan sehari-sehari mereka dengan serba apa adanya. Ketika sang ayah meninggal, barulah diketahui bahwa selama ini ia ternyata orang yang sangat kaya. Hartanya diwariskan kepada keluarga yang ia tinggalkan  Uang kaget tersebut kemudian digunakan oleh istri dan anak-anaknya. Mereka yang tadinya hidup susah, kini membeli rumah, mobil hingga barang-barang mewah lainnya.

title: Neon City Files
overview: Digital recreation analysis file taken in Neon City safe. The DNR subject attempts to synthesize illegal "vitamins" with recipes stolen from "Neon City" safes. Official Bull 01 with the Conselour Unit to the location to neutralize. Official Bull (data censored).

title: Terimakasih Cinta
overview: Eva just enters high school when she meets Ryan, because both belong to a group of student who have a disease during the School Orientation Period. Ryan thinks that Eva is just pretending to be sick like him. An incident makes Ryan take Eva to the hospital and has to be treated. Lupus is the doctor's diagnosis of Eva's disease after a series of tests. Sugiarti and Badarudin, Eva's parents, hesitate to tell Eva about her illness. Her roommate, Dewi, a patient with pancreatic cancer, makes a beautiful friendship. Eva continues to wait for Ryan who does not come again because he is banned by his parents. Dewi also always awaits the presence of her brother, Nanan, who always comes at night when Dewi falls asleep, Nanan is unable to see Dewi suffer. Dewi is devastated when Dewi leaves and Ryan ends their relationship. The same feeling of loss makes Eva and Nanan close.

title: Preman Pensiun: The Movie
overview: Gobang kembali ke Bandung, mengundang teman-temannya, para mantan preman untuk bertemu kembali. Mereka yang diundang adalah Ujang, Murad, Pipit, Cecep, Bohim, Mang Uu, Dikdik dan Joni. Dikdik kemudian tidak jadi datang karena masalah dengan istrinya.  Dalam pertemuan yang disebut “reuni kecil-kecilan” itu, Gobang meminta bantuan teman-temannya untuk melakukan penyelidikan, siapa pelaku pembantaian terhadap adik iparnya hingga tewas. Pelaku pembantaian kemudian diketahui adalah Darman dan kawan-kawan yang hanya sebagai orang suruhan. Dalang di balik kejadian itu ternyata teman mereka sendiri, sesama bekas anak buah Muslihat yang sebenarnya juga sudah pensiun. Muslihat mencoba mencegah terjadinya perang saudara, tapi Gobang sudah terlanjur datang dengan membawa dendam, “darah dibayar darah, nyawa dibayar nyaw.

title: Mata Batin 2
overview: Setelah adiknya meninggal, ALIA memutuskan untuk memulai hidup baru dengan tinggal di sebuah panti asuhan milik Bu LAKSMI dan Pak FADLI sekaligus kerja sosial di sana. Tapi Alia merasa ada yang janggal dengan panti itu. Apalagi NADIA, salah seorang anak panti yang ternyata juga memiliki mata batin terbuka seperti Alia, bisa mendengar suara misterius yang minta tolong dari seluruh dinding rumah. Alia dan Nadia pun membuka sebuah kamar misterius yang terkunci.

title: Lagi-Lagi Ateng
overview: The story of Ateng and his twin Agung who have been separated for a long time. Ateng and Iskak, his friend, go to Jakarta for the first time. Unexpectedly, Ateng meets Agung who has the same body and face as himself. Iskak and Agung's personal assistant, Cemplon are also surprised. It is revealed the fact that they are twin brothers who were separated. Ateng and Agung later realize that their parents were still complete even though they were divorced. So the idea arises to exchange places to meet with parents they have never met. The plan is made to reunite the family.

title: Perjanjian dengan Iblis
overview: Annisa married Bara, a widower with a daughter named Lara.
