title: Critical Eleven
overview: Ale (Reza Rahadian) dan Anya (Adinia Wirasti) pertama kali bertemu dalam penerbangan Jakarta - Sydney. Saat pertemuan terjadi, 3 menit pertama Anya mulai terpikat, 7 jam berikutnya mereka duduk bersebelahan dan saling mengenal lewat percakapan dan tawa satu sama lain, sampailah pada 8 menit sebelum berpisah.

title: Huhate
overview: A documentary about fisherman at Maluku and their problems in the sea.

title: A Faerie's Wanderlust
overview: The life of an empty-minded man suddenly becomes fulfilled when a beautiful otherworldly figure appears in his life. Forever charmed, the man completely fell for her enchanting dark sorcery.

title: Membabi Buta
overview: Under restrictive and mysterious rules a handmaid went crazy when her children became sick.

title: Satria Heroes: Revenge of Darkness
overview: Saat membangun ulang peradaban di dunia paralel, seorang pahlawan super harus kembali ke bumi untuk membantu temannya yang juga kuat melindungi planet dari musuh kejam.

title: Kodhok
overview: Two young men look for frog to get the magic number.

title: Seteru
overview: Students of two different high schools, infamous for their rivalry in school brawls, are gathered together to be disciplined by Lt. Col. Rahmat.

title: The Curse
overview: Seorang wanita muda yang berprofesi sebagai pengacara di Melbourne menghadapi salah satu kasus yang rumit dan mungkin saja diluar nalar.

title: Surau dan Silek
overview: An eleven-year-old boy discovers the true meaning of silek (a martial art) when he meets a 60-year-old retired university teacher and former silek warrior that he is resolved to put an end to his feud with his competitors.

title: Stip & Pensil
overview: Toni (Ernest Prakasa), Aghi (Ardit Erwandha), Bubu (Tatjana Saphira) dan Saras (Indah Permatasari) adalah anak anak orang kaya yang dimusuhi anak anak di SMU sekolahnya. Karena dibanding yang lain mereka selalu merasa sok jago dan songong.

title: Kartini
overview: Biografi Kartini dalam memperjuangkan pendidikan untuk semua kalangan

title: Keluarga Satu Setengah
overview: Agung lives with his mother in a remote village on a mountain. Apart from having to deal with his obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD), Agung must maintain a harmonious relationship with his mother and their past trauma.

title: Hitam & Putih
overview: Ruanli, a martial arts coach, has a younger brother named Ashui who is secretly working as a film actor without his brother knowing.

title: Mengejar Halal
overview: Haura (Inez Ayu), who lives with her brother Yaser (Ryan Qori), and her brother-in-law Zizi (Ressa Rere), canceled their marriage to Shidiq.

title: The Guys
overview: Alfi, seorang karyawan yang bercita-cita jadi bos, ingin mendapatkan cinta Amira, teman sekantornya. Namun, masalah timbul ketika Via, gebetan abadinya, yang tadinya mengabaikan Alfi, mulai menujukkan rasa cinta..

title: Night Bus
overview: A group of civilians share a bus ride to Sampar, a town full of natural resources. It is heavily guarded by the state army who is fighting against the rebel militias, who want freedom over their homeland.

title: Labuan Hati
overview: Kehidupan tiga wanita bertemu di Labuan Bajo. Mereka langsung berteman saat berada di laut, tetapi ketegangan timbul saat seorang instruktur selam muncul.

title: BFF: Best Friends Forever
overview: The Bratz are as close as ever in these episodes which find the gals helping one pal build confidence while urging another to be true to herself. They've got tales to tell and lessons to learn. Stories from four fashionable pals who put friendship first.

title: Jalan Berkeadilan - Kejahatan Negara Setelah Peristiwa 1 Oktober 1965
originalTitle: Jalan Berkeadilan - Kejahatan Negara Setelah Peristiwa 1 Oktober 1965
overview: In the early hours of October 1, 1965, a crime took place: the murder of several military officers. Many of those responsible were arrested and prosecuted before military tribunals. What remains far less known to the public are the events that followed. In their aftermath, numerous other crimes were committed—crimes that have largely remained concealed to this day.

title: Danur
overview: Film ini bercerita tentang Risa di hari ulang tahunnya ke-8, Risa dengan polosnya meminta seorang teman agar ia tidak kesepian lagi. Namun ternyata ibunya, Elly, mulai curiga mendapati anaknya sering tertawa sendiri dan bermain seolah-olah dengan banyak teman, padahal Elly hanya melihatnya bermain sendiri! Elly mencari jalan untuk memisahkan Risa dari sahabat nya yang ternyata hantu.

title: Mooncake Story
overview: After a fateful meeting of a widow and a young entrepreneur with Alzheimer's, friendship between the two blossoms following the man's request to make traditional mooncakes.

title: Dear Nathan
overview: The romance between a teen troublemaker and the girl he adores faces an emotional test when his ex returns to play with his heart.

title: Baracas: Barisan Anti Cinta Asmara
overview: Bandung is frightened because of the youth who left his family to join Baracas. Baracas is a place where men are disillusioned by women formed by Agus. They muster strength and unite feelings to hate women all over the world and on all the elements concerned with women. Agus is a former girlfriend of Sarah, who suddenly Sarah broke up their relationship. The resistance movement against Baracas accused the police and the city administration of deliberately allowing Baracas to flourish. That's why they are demos. Even Baracas got a physical attack. Resistance is also done by ex-girlfriend members of Baracas. They do various ways to change the way Baracas thinks.

title: Perfect Dream
overview: A rich ambitious street mob lost his mind. He endanger his family members, so did his marriage. He had to pay back his fault, and look forward to that destiny was on his side.

title: Cayasukma
overview: Al’ya, a light-miner girl, desperately needs the help of her father, Qu’rai, to perform a forbidden sacred ‘Kirakira’ lightdance to resurrect an ancient being before they are stopped by a mob of angry villagers.

title: Bid'ah Cinta
overview: Relationship between Khalida (Ayushita) and Kamal (Dimas Aditya) not getting approval from both families which hate each other because of their differences. Their families have their own understanding about Islam.  The dispute between H. Rohili, Khalida's father and H. Jamat, Kamal's father having effects on their relationship. Would love erase all the hate between them?

title: Trinity, the Nekad Traveler
overview: Awalnya TRINITY (Maudy Ayunda) adalah seorang Mbak-mbak kantoran yang hobi traveling sejak kecil. Namun hobinya ini sering terbentur dengan duit pas-pasan dan jatah cuti di kantor. Akibatnya Trinity sering diomeli BOSS (Ayu Dewi). Trinity memiliki sahabat yang punya hobi sama, yakni YASMIN (Rachel Amanda) dan NINA (Anggika Bolsterli), ditambah dengan sepupu Trinity, EZRA (Babe Cabita). Trinity selalu menuliskan pengalamannya dalam sebuah blog berjudul naked-traveler.com.

title: Musik Untuk Cinta
overview: In Cirebon, Cecep is captivated by a beautiful female dancers who come from Kasepuhan Palace named Dewi (Arumi Bachsin) during the Cirebon Culture Carnival. Tit for tat, but the barrier comes from Surya (Ferry Ardiansyah), son of batik trader (Kadir), which likes Dewi also. Dewi’s mother also does not want her daughter to have a husband from poor families.

title: Galih & Ratna
overview: Cinta pertama. Atau cinta monyet. Atau apalah itu. Semua pasti pernah merasakannya, terutama di masa-masa remaja yang indah. Tetapi ini tidak pernah dirasakan oleh GALIH (Refal Hady), seorang siswa SMA teladan tetapi introvert yang hidup dalam bayang-bayang almarhum ayahnya dan tuntutan ibunya yang harus struggle sebagai single-mother.

title: Ular Tangga
overview: When a group of students gets lost during a hiking trip, they stumble across a deserted house containing lost souls and a deadly board game.

title: Preman Pensiun: Paket Untuk Mengenang Kang Bahar
originalTitle: Preman Pensiun: Paket Untuk Mengenang Kang Bahar
overview: Opik meminta tolong Rojak untuk menemaninya mengantar paket ke Bandung. Setelah pensiun, Dikdik belum mendapat pekerjaan tetap, ia menjadi penagih hutang bersama Murad dan Pipit. Selama perjalanan Opik dan Rojak mengobrol tetapi saat sampai di Kota Bandung mobil Opik mogok dan mereka bertengkar.

title: Pendakian Birahi
overview: In this homage to 90s Indonesian sexploitation movie, a call-girl who desperately need money for her mother's medical bills has to encounter a client from hell.

title: Silariang: Menggapai Keabadian Cinta
overview: Cia (Dinda Surbakti) and Ali (Jeyhan Kler) face a steep road in attaining their love. Cia, Petta Lolo's daughter, falls in love with Ali. When love becomes so deep, Cia knows that Ali is the brother of the woman who committed suicide because Cia’s brother married another woman. There is no blessing from both families. It’s fortunate that Cia and Ali have faithful friends: Ati (Nur Fadillah), Rio (Ikram Noer), and Mamak Ramlah (Husen) who always give advice and support. Yet Cia and Ali chose to elope which is also called silariang in South Sulawesi. Knowing his daughter silariang with Ali, Daeng Mariolo (Syahriar Tattoo) becomes furious. His family agrees to seek them both. Siri (self esteem) must be upheld.

title: Pinarak
overview: A story from Yogyakarta. Mrs. Ninik received a call from her daughter. She can't come home on Christmas holiday because of her work in Jakarta and didn't get a day-off. One day, Mrs. Ninik have a hope after seeing one thing in her house.

title: Kuncup
overview: John is in love with an Indonesian woman and wants to marry her. But her father asks him for one thing. John has to be circumcised first. Kuncup tells us the story of John finding ways to solve this problem.

title: Errorist of Seasons
overview: Being fired from his job, Pulung follows his friend's advice to invest his compensatory dismissal to start a new business: inflatable boat rentals.

title: London Love Story 2
overview: Caramel sangat bahagia. Betapa tidak, impiannya sejak kecil untuk melihat dan bermain salju akhirnya terwujud karena Dave memberinya hadiah kejutan liburan ke Swiss untuk merayakan ulang tahun Caramel.

title: Buka'an 8
overview: A married couple prepares for the birth of their child. But conflict and chaos ensue when the wife's family gets wind of the husband's money.

title: Moammar Emka's Jakarta Undercover
overview: Pras wants to realize his dreams of having a significant life and career as a journalist, but Jakarta changes everything.

title: Salawaku
overview: A road movie about a boy, Salawaku, and a wealthy modern metropolitan woman from Jakarta, named Saras, on a journey to find Salawaku's lost sister.

title: Remember The Flavor
overview: Pernahkan kamu merasa justru bisa terbuka dengan orang asing? Inilah yang terjadi, Arnesti dan Melodi, dua orang yang tidak saling mengenal yang bertemu secara tak sengaja di kereta. Setelah 3 tahun, Melodi pulang kembali ke Jogja, dan kini ia menceritakan kisah cintanya di sepanjang perjalanan.  Melodi dan Dimas, dua sahabat sejak kecil yang sebetulnya saling menyintai. Dimas putra pemilik kedai es krim Mirasa, sedang Melodi adalah gadis yang bercita-cita jadi penyanyi. Apapun yang Melodi inginkan, Dimas menjadi orang pertama yang mendukungnya. Sayangnya Melodi terlalu egois untuk mengakui bahwa ia membutuhkan Dimas, sedang Dimas berusaha terlalu keras meyakinkan Melodi bahwa cintanya pantas diterima.  Melodi yang agresif menggapai mimpinya sebagai penyanyi, telah memecah belah keluarganya sendiri. Ketika ia diusir oleh ibunya, satu-satunya orang yang mau menampung adalah Dimas. Cinta mereka bersemi, tetapi akankah bersatu? Atau hanya tumbuh menjadi sekedar cinta platonis?

title: Hantu Gunung Kawi
overview: Dika concerns on Drajat (46), his father, who behaves strangely and terrifyingly. Bella (20), Dika’s cousin, who helps oversee Drajat, nearly be killed because she is assumed have been long dead. Drajat’s oddities began when his cigarette factory went bankrupt. When Dika accidentally discovers the photographs of Drajat with a grandfather at Mount Kawi. Other evidences ensure Drajat’s engagement with pesugihan (enriching mantra) practice based in Mount Kawi. After discussions with Bella, Dika decides to look for clues to Mount Kawi. Dika bring friends to Mount Kawi for Mbah Kawi. Having never been to Mount Kawi, they invite the school security guard, Jono Kawat, who claimed to have worked selling tuyul (small) crackers at Mount Kawi.

title: Generasi Kocak: 90-an vs Komika
overview: Allan (Afif Xavi) and Dellon (Adi Bing Slamet) are two figures who have  different postures and different ages but inseparable companions. Both are members of gangsters led by Si Naga 90s (Kadir) and Naga Komika (Anyun Lisp). One day when Allan is frantic when  hefinds out that his father (Jaja Miharja) goes to Jakarta, assisted by a taxi driver (Mandra) His father wants to see Allan’s 24-hour clinic. Allan has claimed to be a doctor and had his own clinic. Allan tells Dellon to gather their friends to pretend to be patients. Allan and Dellon pretending to be doctors and their girlfriends, Susi (Arafat Rianti) and Mia (Resti Wulandari) as nuns.

title: Chrisye
overview: Biopic perjalanan hidup penyanyi legendaris Indonesia

title: Pertaruhan
overview: Four brothers Ibra, Elzan, Amar, and Ical attempting to collect money for their father's medical bills. Always in stalemate, the brothers eventually took a very reckless decision.

title: Surga Yang Tak Dirindukan 2
overview: Dalam sekuel film tahun 2015 peraih penghargaan ini, Pras, Arini, dan Meirose menghadapi tantangan baru yang bisa mengubah dinamika cinta segitiga mereka nan unik.

title: Boven Digoel
overview: Doctor John Manangsang has to perform a caesarean section to Agustina, who had given birth nine times. Tragically, the health center and have no adequate means and personnel for this operation.

title: The Chocolate Chance
overview: Orvala Theobroma (Pamela Bowie), an chocholate addict.  Her dreams is to able work in anything that relate to chocolate. That dreams come true when she met Aruna Handriani (Miqdad Addausy), her-soon-to-be-boyfriend. He ask her to join in Fedde Velten Cafe.  Afterwards, Theobroma meet her ex-boyfriend, Juno Aswanda (Ricky Harun). Also, some girl named Fidela (Sheila Dara Aisya) take a part in that relationships. That's where her quadrangle love started.

title: From London to Bali
overview: When Lukman's girlfriend, Dewi, moves to London, he tries his best to make money doing anything he can to chase after her. Meanwhile, for the first time, Dewi is face-to-face with the temptations of living abroad on her own.

title: The Promise
overview: Riri (Mitha The Virgin) is an announcer who reads mystery stories on the radio and Wanda (Dara The Virgin) is a fan of Riri’s show. Wanda likes to write a mystery story but does not have the guts to send it to the radio. Wanda was paralyzed after a car accident that killed his brother, Tino. Once Riri is found by her mother hanging herself in her room. Since the death of Riri, Wanda often gets harassments at her home.Wanda is frightened and decides to investigate the case.

title: Kungfu Kaw
overview: Saleha, mangsa jenayah yang tekad untuk menguasai ilmu kungfu akibat mengalami trauma yang menimpa dirinya. Saleha mendekati Pakcik Lee untuk mempelajari ilmu kungfu. Adakah dia berjaya?

title: Iqro: Petualangan Meraih Bintang
overview: Aqila, 9 years old, is a highly infatuated girl to the science but lack the interest in learning the Qur'an. Aqila has a grandfather who works as an astronomer and stays at the Center Boscha Star Observation. Aqila intends to make school work related to astronomy. Her grandfather gives Aqila permission to use binoculars in Boscha to complete the task, but with one condition: she should be able to read the Qur'an. Aqila promises it. In her grandfarher’s house Aqila met Ros, daughter of the maid. Ros asks her to play in a mosque. In the mosque Aqila learn to read the Qur'an in a Iqro method, which is fun, rhythmic and sung lightly. Aqila’s experience of learning the Qur'an and the example of his grandfather is what inspires her mind of the greatness of Allah who created the universe.

title: The Last Barongsai
overview: The story of Aguan who received a scholarship to study in Singapore, but was under control over the cost issue. He then invited his father, Kho Huan, owner of a Barongsai studio, to take part in the lion dance competition, because the prize could be used for living expenses in Singapore, but his father did not approve of it.

title: Abid
overview: Farhan, a young introvert guy who has been struggling with his sexuality and spirituality, had crush on his new neighbor who made him question about being what he wants and what his God wants.

title: Dua Ribu Rupiah
overview: Tells the story of a small child Tatan (8) who was faced with various choices when he found 2000 rupiah in cash

title: 21 Petang Berdarah
overview: Short films about the brothers lawsuit of legacy.

title: Demi Cinta
overview: Bagus (Ricky Harun) and Masbin (Tora Sudiro) are two cousins ​​who are willing to sacrifice anything for love. All starts with Bagus who put his heart in Cempaka (Farali Khan), their neighbors in flats. Seeing Cempaka approached by a rich man, Bagus accepts Syamsudin’s offer. To be Toni’s men, they should have experience of crime. The first crime in their lives is done: kidnapping a child. But it all falls apart, because the child is Toni Montana’s from his mistress, Amara (Titi Kamal). They are stuck on a fun and silly runaway. In the process of escape, Bagus falls in love with Sandra (Nasya Marcella), the child’s baby sitter. And Masbin falls in love with Amara (Titi Kamal). Love turns out to put them in a more difficult and complicated situation.

title: Security Ugal-Ugalan
overview: Acho, Dana, Lolox pegawai perusahaan Megapolitan Security yang dipimpin oleh Komandan Indro. Berbagai kejadian lucu terjadi dalam keseharian para security. Dana jatuh hati pada cewek cantik bernama Angela.

title: Istirahatlah Kata-Kata
overview: The Suharto regime has been holding power in Indonesia for over 30 years, shutting down democracy time and time again. Highly critical of the regime and unafraid to speak his mind, Wiji Thukul is a poet whose words are often yelled proudly by the crowd during political protests. When riots break out in Jakarta in 1996, he and a few other activists are accused to be responsible. Forced to flee, Wiji escapes to Pontianak in Borneo where he hides for eight months, sometimes living with complete strangers. There, he has to change his identity several times, but continues to write poetry and short stories under a pen name. In the meantime, in Solo, central Java, his wife, Sipon, lives with their two children under constant surveillance. In May 1998, Wiji Thukul is declared missing, a month before Suharto is deposed by his own people.

title: Sinema Wajah Indonesia: Sarjana Kambing
overview: Irul isa young man want to prove to her parent for succes not necessary PNS to be.

title: Ayu Anak Titipan Surga
overview: Ayu dan kedua sahabatnya berusaha menyelamatkan Evi yang diculik dan disekap oleh sekelompok mafia perdagangan manusia. Ayu pun mendapatkan simpati dari berbagai pihak atas keberaniannya.

title: Cahaya Cinta Pesantren
overview: Shila (Yuki Kato), daughter of a fisherman around Lake Toba, wants to go to favorite high school in Medan. But alas, Mother wants her to enter into the pesantren (religious boarding school). Shila complains to Father. This time Father agrees with Mother. Shila disappoints and their relationship is strained. Pesantren’s life is full of activities and disciplined, making Shila difficult to adapt. She becomes homesick. Even so Shila still dreams of being a novelist. Together with his friends, Manda (Febby Blink), Ayesha (Via Blink) and Icut (Vebby Palwinta), she discovers the meaning of true friendship. They even have a "pot of tears", where they keep all of sad and happy tears. Shila’s life at pesantren is decorated with colorful typical problems of adolescence.

title: Jomblo Ngenes
overview: Noval falls in love when he meets with Astika. But, between love and happy there is also pain. He repeatedly mires in a situation where she deceives him. She asks him to do and say strange things in various comical situations. He could have been away, but her charm makes him could not leave her. He plans to declare his love for her. Unexpectedly, in the most important moments she tells that her boyfriend, Nico, will return after 100 days missing. He delays to declare his love until the day when her old boyfriend is back.

title: Jalan Pulang
overview: Suharjo wanted to visit his wife tomb in Yogyakarta so he requested his son, Aldy to go with him.

title: Oleh-oleh
overview: Ibu Yati is indirectly burdened by one of the group's cultures preachings before her departure to Umrah. Ulfa is the only child of Yati and feels uncomfortable with the culture, because she thinks it is harming her and her mother, especially harming the initial intentions of the Umrah worship they will carry out.

title: Janji
overview: As an introverted college student catches the eye of a new friend in Italy, his estranged buddy visits and brings a surprise with him.

title: Dusk & Demitasse
overview: Two friends, set on a journey to find the tastiest coffee flavor in the archipelago.

title: Antar Kota Dalam Provinsi
overview: Adam (26), a bus driver from Surabaya - Jember, always works with Yudha (35) as a driver and Bagus (29) as a conductor with minimal income. At that time, Ana (23) who is Adam's girlfriend participated in the trip to Jember. Unexpectedly, Ana brought news that if Adam did not immediately propose he would be an arranged marriage.

title: Telovisi
overview: Wahyu (11) and Dwi (9) come from an underprivileged family. Their father, Supri (32), works as a farm laborer, while their mother, Sri (37), is a housewife. One day after school, they found a television at home. Driven by curiosity, they decided to try it out and it led to a quarrel, which ended with the television breaking. They then tried to cover up the damage in their own way.

title: Shantika
overview: Santi (27) is a sex worker in Gang Dolly, Surabaya. To provide for her child after being divorced by her husband, Santi is willing to serve any man who comes to her every night. However, when the Surabaya City Government shuts down Dolly, life in the district suddenly comes to a halt.

title: Down Up
overview: A story about a boy named Anton (17) who has many friends who are his underlings in a gang. Anton and his underlings play until late at night and he is scolded by his father named Pardi (55). One day Pardi is asked for a debt by Tejo (40) but Pardi does not have any money. Then Tejo is scolded by his boss named Bambang (50) for not completing his files. When Bambang arrives home he is immediately scolded by Wati (46) for being too busy with his work and not having free time for his family. Ado (15) a child of Bambang and Wati whines to Wati because she didn't buy him a car to go to school. When Ado comes home from school, Bimo (17), Cipta (17) and Dodi (17) ask for money and then use the money to buy snacks.

title: Jana Bastiaan
overview: Jana Bastiaan (32), a man working at a private insurance company, felt jealous and disappointed when his colleague, Budi Pradipta (34), received a promotion. Overcome with emotions, Bastiaan chose to isolate himself and reflect. As he was crossing the street, a motorcycle sped toward him. In an instant, after blinking, he found himself in a desert. A man approached him and told him that he was dead.

title: Kamis
overview: a short film by M. Irfan Ramli

title: Jalan Dakwah Pesantren
overview: This country is home to educational institutions with a long and storied history. For centuries, they have weathered countless events and embraced change after change. These institutions are rooted in religious tradition, yet closely tied to local culture with its diverse customs and heritage. They have always engaged in dialogue with their surroundings and have become part of global civilization. One such institution is the *Pondok Pesantren*, the popular name for this type of school. Guided by the principle, “Preserve good traditions and adopt better innovations,” pesantrens continue to live, grow, and serve their communities. It is no surprise that along their journey, pesantrens remain strong in tradition while constantly innovating. Nor is it surprising that they have become woven into many aspects of life—spanning religion, the arts, social affairs, and even nation-building.

title: Hening dalam Riuh
overview: A child with a disability longs to go to school. However, in the area where he lives, there are no schools equipped to accommodate his condition. He even experienced mistreatment when he tried attending a regular public school. Eventually, he spends his days working as a palm oil laborer, using part of his wages to pay for his medical treatment.

title: C'est La Vie
overview: A male political prisoner, after years of imprisonment, finally gets the chance to testify about the tragedy he experienced. It is a golden opportunity to seek a measure of justice for himself—an act of redemption to stay sane in living his life. Whether the opportunity is real or merely a dream does not matter.

title: Bang, Kiri Bang
overview: A short film by Stanislaus Daryl

title: Awal: Nasib Manusia
overview: During the era of President Soekarno, several students were selected to study abroad, including Awal Uzhara, Sjumandjaja, Ami Priono, and Zubair Lelo. They were sent to Russia to study cinematography at VGIK (The Gerasimov Institute of Cinematography). Sjumandjaja and Ami Priono went on to become famous directors in Indonesia, but Awal Uzhara never had the same fortune. After completing his Master's degree in Moscow around 1965, political instability in Indonesia arose. The country's background, where Awal had studied, became associated with a negative stigma about communism, which was linked to him.

title: Amak
overview: a short film by Ella Angel

title: Arti Merdeka
overview: Olive, a little girl, lives in a broken family. Both her parents are busy working. Olive misses love and attention. Until she did her own thing to get the attention of her parents until she received violence from her father.

title: Munggah Kaji
overview: In a village down at the slope of mount Merapi, Wening (80 years old) is preparing for the Hajj. Her departure this time has been planned long in advance as she is delegating her close friend Darmi's pilgrimage as well. This is as Darmi is unable to perform the Hajj by herself. Close to the day of departure, Darmi’s family holds to a ritual of recitation and prayer. Wening's husband Kusmin, however, makes Wening feel uneasy about going for the pilgrimage. Will Wening still perform the Hajj despite her husband's opposition?

title: The Hotel's Water
overview: A hotel room cleaner was cleaning one of the rooms and came across an experience he had never had in his life.

title: Petualangan Singa Pemberani Atlantos 2
overview: The Shadow Master returns with the power of the Sea Pearl to sink the world. To defeat him, Paddle Pop and his friends must adventure in the sea and find Magus, a legendary lion who can teach Paddle Pop to use his powers in the sea.

title: Otajin
overview: Virnie, who studied in Jakarta, received news that his parents had been mysteriously killed in his own home.

66 tells the story of an assassin-for-hire, who is hired to kill a police informant, but instead steals the money and runs, igniting the spark that leads a criminal organization to go to war with itself.

title: Cek Toko Sebelah
overview: Erwin menikmati hidupnya dengan karir gemilang di usia muda, dan kekasih cantik yang tak kalah sukses, Natalie. Tapi semua jadi pelik saat Koh Afuk yang kesehatannya makin memburuk, ingin mewariskan toko sembakonya kepada Erwin, anak kesayangannya.

title: Project 17 The Movie
overview: Film ini merupakan film berdurasi agak panjang pertama dari Green Project Production yang mana pada tahun 2016 masih bernama Project 17. Film ini tidak pernah selesai. Film ini menceritakan kisah kehidupan Leandy yang sedang memperjuangkan cinta Aisah sambil membantu Dimas dan Ical dalam bisnis jual beli berlian. Ternyata, itu semua hanyalah jebakan dari mafia rakus Bos Yayan dan Koh Febri. Mampukah Leandy, Dimas, dan Ical melawan mereka pada akhirnya nanti?

title: Hangout

overview: Darsono, the son of a poor farmer, fights against many difficulties and challenges to reach his dream. His father does not understand the importance of education. Even so this barrier never diminish the hope of his future and dreams he builds together with Jamhari, his best friend since childhood, who always support him. His friendship with Jamhari and the struggle to tackle the poverty, social conflicts in society, and his affair with Ika become a unity of signs in his symphony of life.

title: Surat Untukmu
overview: The unrequited letters motivate Gendis to come to Jakarta to find out where his mother has been.  By following the Annual Student's Annual Camp, Gendis has hope in realizing his dream to be able to see and embrace the figure he missed.  Meeting Gilang and some friends in the camp was the start of an elaborate search in Jakarta. Gendis thinks it will be fine, but on the contrary, every quest leaves a mystery to be solved by it.  Is Gendis able to meet his mother and return safely?

title: Indonesia Itu Jujur
overview: Honesty isn't just about actions and decisions. It's a value..

title: Mimpi Anak Pulau
overview: The true story of Gani Lasa, Deputy BP Batam. He is a coastal child of Nongsa who lives in poverty. His mother is a cake seller. After graduating from elementary school, he had to row a canoe to Tanjung Pinang from 17.00 to 06.00. to continue their education at PGA (Religious Teacher Education). That was the first time he wore shoes. Then he migrated to Yogyakarta to become a scholar.

title: 3 Pilihan Hidup
overview: The story of comedian named Kabul Basuki, more commonly known as Tessy. Tessy is experiencing many twists and turns of life. One time a case changes him. The case is the abuse of illegal drugs. Tessy has three options: rehabilitation, imprisonment, or death.

title: Triangle: The Dark Side
overview: Deddy, the assassin who is member of a secret organization, deeply traumatized when his beloved wife was killed. He decides to quit. However, there is still a final contract that he must do before he can get out of the underworld.  The target is Volland, ruthless thug who has a sister, Chika. In his guise Deddy is close and fall in love with Chika. With a dark past, a desire to quit and ending the task, he faces a difficult choice: kill the target and lose his new love or quit the party risking himself and his girlfriend to be killed by his organization.

title: Pantja Sila: Cita-Cita & Realita
overview: This is the story of Pantja Sila the five foundational principles of Republic Indonesia,  view from  historical perspective since its inception and its relevance for today.  As told by the genius mind like Soekarno and other founding fathers of Indonesia.

title: LAsjkar Di Tapal Batas
overview: Dutch Military Aggression II, 1948. Bogor people gets angry when the Dutch return to colonize. Many of them volunteer to serve as fighters by forming small groups called Lasjkar Rakyat (People’s Troop). Tidjan hate the Dutch. He joins the troop under the leadership of Djulu with his best friend: Enim, Anau and Rais. Tidjan feels a dilemma: his parents and his girlfriend, Nonon, do not support him to enter the war.

title: Winter in Tokyo
overview: Saat mencoba mengatasi perasaan yang masih tersisa, seorang pustakawan bertemu tetangga baru yang mencoba melupakan romansa lama dan memulai lembaran baru.

title: Across Gender
overview: What is it like being transgender in Yogyakarta? There is no single answer to this question. This film aims to show different ways of negotiating visibility in the Indonesian society when one ‘crosses gender’. The difficulty of this negotiation becomes apparent through the anti-LGBT sentiments and actions in early 2016.

title: Bintang di Langit Belitong
overview: Dendam masa lalu membuat keluarga Sofyan serta kedua anaknya, Dinda dan Bintang, harus mengalami petualangan berat di pulau Belitung ketika mereka berlibur setelah menghadiri pemakaman kakek mereka. Seorang wanita dari masa lalu tidak bisa melupakan dendamnya pada Sofyan. Melalui anaknya, Leona, ia menculik Bintang agar Sofyan merasakan bagaimana sakitnya kehilangan orang yang dicintai.

title: 3 Srikandi
overview: Indonesia di tahun 1988. Dunia olah raga mempersiapkan diri turun serta di Olimpiade Musim Panas ke 24 di Seoul. Cabang panahan berada di titik kritis, di mana dibutuhkan pelatih yang bisa menyiapkan tim panahan wanita dalam waktu yang singkat. Satu-satunya yang bisa diandalkan menjadi pelatih adalah Donald Pandiangan (Reza Rahardian) yang dikenal sebagai “Robin Hood Indonesia”.

title: Rayuan Pulau Palsu
overview: A documentary film about Jakarta Bay reclamation project, from the standpoint of fishermen and coastal residents. Reclamation in northern Jakarta is part of about 14 reclamation projects in the coastal cities of Indonesia for property sector business expansion.

title: Desire
overview: An uncensored conversations between a couple about their future relationship. They talk about romantic comedy, unrealistic character, phone sex and sacrifice.

title: Bangkit!
overview: Addri works hard to save the entire bus passenger which plunged into the abyss due to torrential rain. Addri’s wife, Indri, is very understanding of her husband's work as a member of the National SAR team. Separately, Arifin, weather analyst, is trying to meet the demand of her lover, Denanda, a physician.  Huge flood enveloping Jakarta. Arifin sees the weather has passed the normal limits and continued to argue with Hadi, his boss, on what to do. At the time he is doing some anticipation of disaster, he reunited with Addri.

title: Jihad Selfie
overview: Following the story of Teuku Akbar Maulana who intends to join ISIS after seeing his colleague's experience on social media.

title: Uang Panai' Maha(r)l
overview: Anca, a Bugis-Makassar guy, just back from overseas. Accidentally he is reunited with her former lover Risna. The seeds of love resurfaced. Hoping not to lose Risna for the second time, Anca intends to marry Risna.  But his intention is blocked by the marriage customary terms: Uang Panai or dowry in fantastic quantities. Anca’s struggle begins. He is assisted by his friends Tumming and Abu, who often gave hilarious and absurd ideas.  In the midst of Anca’s struggle to collect the dowry, comes Farhan, Risna’s old friend who has just returned from abroad. Farhan's father who is also Risna’s father best friend, is intending to match Farhan and Risna. Anca depressed. He takes more longer time to gather the dowry. Risna worries whether Anca will leave her as before. Risna’s family does not want to stall off any longer.

title: Untuk Angeline
overview: Based on a true story. This is one of the viral stories in Indonesia where a mother kills a child named Angeline who is thought to be missing by many people.

title: Merestorasi Tiga Dara
overview: This short documentary piece consists of experiential statements from people involved in the process of restoring the Indonesian 1956 classic film "Tiga Dara" by the famous Indonesian director Usmar Ismail, that's been conducted throughout the year 2015-2016. This collaborating group of Indonesian and Italian tried to assemble and restore frame by frame of a decayed film that were damaged due to its own age and lack of sufficient care. A journey full of surprises and experimentation.

title: Video Maut
overview: Doni’s plan to bring his girlfriend, Maya, to a secluded villa is to make video the two of them in bed, and to sell it to Alvin for distribution on the Internet. Maya, a plain girl, does not aware of this. Involuntarily she brings her friend, and this makes Doni upset. But, he could not do anything because Maya does not want to come along without her friend. Doni finally creates problems with Maya’s friends, until they leave the villa.  So Doni and Maya are alone there. Doni who already set up a hidden camera, executes his plan. He persuades Maya to go to bed with him, Maya tries to refuse, but Doni ties her and says that he just wants to enjoy the time with Maya. Maya can not fight Doni. When Doni wants to kiss Maya suddenly a shadow flashes near them.

title: ILY from 38.000 Ft
overview: Aletta (Michelle Ziudith) pergi ke Bali dengan tujuan berlibur. Di sana, ia bertemu dengan Arga (Rizky Nazar), seorang mahasiswa, yang menyebabkan Aletta langsung dekat dengannya. Lambat laun, hubungan Aletta dan Arga semakin dekat sehingga pada saat Aletta hendak kembali ke Jakarta, Agra berjanji akan menyusul Aletta ke Jakarta untuk menikahinya. Akan tetapi, Arga belum juga hadir ke Jakarta untuk memenuhi janjinya tersebut kepada Aletta

title: Koala Kumal
overview: Dika (Raditya Dika) adalah seorang cowok yang baru saja batal menikah karena pacarnya, Andrea (Acha Septriasa) selingkuh darinya dengan cowok bernama James (Nino Fernandez). Patah hatinya membuat Dika kesulitan menulis bab terakhir dari bukunya. Suatu hari, Dika bertemu dengan cewek bernama Trisna (Sheryl Sheinafia), cewek yang unik yang membuat sudut pandang Dika terhadap dunia menjadi berbeda.

title: Jilbab Traveler: Love Sparks in Korea
originalTitle: Jilbab Traveler: Love Sparks in Korea
overview: Rania travels all around the world documenting her experiences. When her father suddenly falls sick, Rania goes home. Rania meets Hyun Geun, a Korean guy, who is stubborn but charismatic. She faces her toughest decision in her life.

title: Sabtu Bersama Bapak
overview: Gunawa memiliki seorang istri, Itje, dan dua anak kecil: Satya dan Cakra. Hidup mereka berubah ketika Gunawan tahu hanya memiliki satu tahun lagi untuk hidup. Gunawan memutuskan, kematian tak boleh membatasinya dari menyayangi kedua anak. Ia membuat banyak rekaman berisikan pesan-pesan untuk kedua anaknya. Setelah Gunawan berpulang, Itje, sang istri memutuskan agar kedua anak dapat bertemu sang bapak satu kali seminggu, setiap hari Sabtu.

title: Rudy Habibie
overview: Film biografi ini menelusuri keterpurukan dan kejayaan pada masa awal kehidupan B.J. Habibie, sosok Presiden Indonesia yang transformatif.

title: Janji Sahabat
overview: Nomination of Police Movies Festival 2016.

title: Ikhlas
overview: Best Animation Police Movie Festival 2016.

title: Kesusu
overview: Runner-up short film Police Movies Festival 2016.

title: Joni Sok Jagoan
overview: Joni, a high school student who was urinating on a tree was suddenly approached by a police officer and given a ticket. While feeling furious because of being ticketed, Joni got a new problem when he met Sarah, a woman who needed help. What problems did Joni experience and how did Joni solve his problems.

title: Jangan Dengerin Sendiri
overview: Reno is desperate to listen to JDS radio channel alone and ignores warnings that his actions can provoke the emergence of ghosts. As a result, the three of them had to deal with a ghost that kept following and terrorizing them even until they reached their homes.

title: Bangkit dari Bisu
overview: Silenced for more than 50 years, a group of elderly women in Indonesia decided to share the country’s forgotten history to the young generation through singing. The women formed a choir group that sings songs written inside prisons by those who were arrested and sentenced for years without any single trial. The singing and sharing has helped them heal their trauma as well as connecting them with an eager young audience.

title: Indera Ke Enam
overview: Merry dan putrinya, Dina, memutuskan untuk mengatur hidup mereka dengan pindah ke rumah kecil. Tetapi situasi yang berjalan dengan baik berubah drastis ketika dia mulai melihat lagi pada okultisme.

title: Dubsmash
overview: Teejay (Teejay Marquez), a new student from the Philippines, made hysterical girls at school. Teejay is famous for Dubsmash videos that are often uploaded on social media! Teejay lives with his happy family who just moved to Indonesia. Elsa (Jessica Mila) who has a broken home family background, feels comfortable when close to Teejay. Elsa has never found anyone who can understand her, including Marvel (Verrel Bramasta), her boyfriend. This relationship makes Marvel jealous.

title: Sundul Gan: The Story of Kaskus
originalTitle: Sundul Gan: The Story of Kaskus
overview: Two college friends with contrasting personalities overcome challenges and turn a simple university assignment into Indonesia's leading online discussion forum, proving that friendship can be the foundation of a successful business.

title: Bahagianya adalah Bahagiaku
overview: No sacrifice is in vain for the happiness of the people you love. Just like this family, who sacrifice each day to bring a smile and a happiness for the mother.

title: Pacarku Anak Koruptor
overview: Untuk menjadi koordinator sebuah organisasi bernama GANK alias "Gerakan Anti Narkoba & Korupsi" memang membutuhkan kesabaran, kerja keras, keberanian, ketegasan serta kecerdasan lebih.

title: The Stork Who Dropped Me
overview: Ani saat itu mengadakan pesta makan malam dalam rangka ulbg tahunnya. Ulang tahunnya saat itu adalah sekaligus perpisahan dengan ayahnya

title: Aisyah: Biarkan Kami Bersaudara
overview: Aisyah just graduated. She lives in Ciwidey, West Java, a religious village near a tea plantation, with her mother and younger brother. Her father had died a few years ago. She wants to be a teacher. One day, she gets a call from the foundation where she enrolled: she gets her wish fulfilled at the location that she never knows: Derok, North Middle Timor District.  From the beginning she feels like a "foreigner". The local people mistake her as Sister Maria, just because she wears a veil like a sister. The people is expecting the arrival of Sister Maria as a teacher in the village. This isolated village is without electricity and cellular signals. The new environment, the different tradition and religion make Aisyah giddy. Fortunately there is Pedro (Arie Kriting) who makes the problems easy. She must face the hatred of one of his student, Lordis Defam. Through the chief, she understand that she is a Muslim who is considered an enemy by Lordis Defam who is a catholic

title: My Stupid Boss
overview: Cerita tentang hubungan kerja antara Boss yang absurd dengan karyawannya. “Bossman” (Reza Rahadian) adalah orang Indonesia yang memiliki perusahaan di Kuala Lumpur.

title: Cinta di Balik Awan 2
overview: A Sequel to "Cinta di Balik Awan" movie.

title: Prenjak
overview: The experience of Jarwo, who accepted an unexpected offer from a desperate village girl, Diah during a lunch break in a warehouse.

title: The Window
overview: Dewi pulang ke kampungnya di Jogjakarta, setelah sepuluh tahun meninggalkan tempat itu.  Sebuah surat dan potongan berita koran yang dikirim ibunya, membuat ia harus kembali ke kampungnya: kehamilan misterius Dee, kakaknya yang cacat mental. Dewi mendapati situasi di rumah orangtuanya yang tak berubah. Yang berubah adalah kehamilan Dee dan pemandangan di balik jendela besar rumahnya yang silih berganti. Dewi  lalu mengenal Priyanto yang baru setahun tinggal di kampung itu.  Priyanto dan Dewi menjalin kisah asmara yang tak biasa. Joko, teman kecil Dewi, cemburu. Kedatangan Dewi menguak masa lalunya yang tak selesai.

title: Ini Scene Kami Juga!
overview: Film dokumenter ini menceritakan tentang perempuan yang terlibat dalam DIY Punk di Indonesia, terutama di Pulau Jawa. Dan telah mewawancarai 14 perempuan yang masih aktif di scene DIY Punk sampai sekarang dari seluruh pulau Jawa. Gender, seksisme, seksualitas dan aktifisme semua dibahas dalam film dokumenter ini. Film ini memberikan gambaran tentang bagaimana perempuan-perempuan ini berpartisipasi dalam scene DIY Punk, dan bagaimana hal itu mempengaruhi kehidupan sehari-hari mereka sampai sekarang.

title: The Fabulous Udin
overview: Udin and his friends, Jeki, Ucup, and Inong welcome the new girl, Suri, who suffers from brain cancer. Together they solved various problems ranging from bullying, suicide attempts, and mental stress.

title: Komedi Gokil 2
overview: Film "Komedi Gokil 2" garapan rumah produksi MD Pictures ini bercerita tentang rumah kost milik om Indro (Indro Warkop) yang kedatangan penghuni baru yaitu Acho (Muhadkly Acho), adik Boris (Boris Bokir), Lolox (Lolox), keponakan tanta Maya (Maya W. Sardjono) dan Mia (Senk Lotta). Setelah mengalami sedikit masalah pada awal kedatangannya karena kesalahan paham tentang koper Mia yang tertinggal oleh Acho dan kemudian oleh Lolox saat berada di bandara, ahkirnya semuanya selesan dan Acho pun yang awalnya tidak bertujuan nge-kost disitu akhirnya memutuskan untuk menetap setelah melihat kesempatan untuk mendekati Mia.

title: Mars: Mimpi Ananda Raih Semesta
overview: Tupon, wanita tua di kaki Gunung Kidul, tanpa kenal lelah membesarkan Sekar Palupi untuk terus sekolah. Sang ibu yang buta huruf yang selalu membawa Sekar Palupi melihat alam semesta, Tupon selalu menunjukan lintang lantip (bintang yang cerdas), planet Mars. Ia selalu bilang bahwa Sekar bisa ke sana dengan ilmu pengetahuan. Sekar mampu meraih gelar master dalam bidang astronomi di Oxford Univeristy, Inggris

title: #Modus
overview: A smitten student who lacks confidence enlists the help of his brother to learn everything possible about his dream girl so he can win her over.

title: Rumah Pasung
overview: Ryan, Sultan and Mayang are the crew of the unseen natural expedition for the tv program, Horror Calling. Ryan acted as the host of the event. Mayang, an indigo, the money shows life invisible magic. The Sultan of the cameraman. One day Ryan had to go through his papa's funeral. Harsono and Ratna, Ryan's toddler, unfold the real Ryan past. Ryan is the adopted child. Through Harsono, Ryan's father, Gunawan, entrusted the will of a very remote residence outside the city.

title: Ada Apa Dengan Cinta? 2
overview: Cinta dan Rangga, dua orang remaja yang saling mencintai terpisahkan 14 tahun yang lalu. Kini, setelah bertahun-tahun, Rangga dan Cinta mendapatkan kesempatan untuk kembali bertemu. Akankah ini menjadi kesempatan kedua untuk mereka kembali bersama? Apalagi hidup mereka tidak lagi sesederhana dulu.

title: Cipali Km 182
overview: Several accidents on the motorway Cikopo–Palimanan aka Cipali attract public attention. Many believe that the construction of the road has mystical story. There is a mysterious stone piled on the side of the motorway. The mystery is revealed by this film.

title: Surat Cinta Untuk Kartini
overview: At the turn of the 20th century in Indonesia, a widowed postman falls in love with women's education pioneer RA Kartini. Inspired by her true story.

title: Super Didi
overview: In two weeks absence of his wife, a young brilliant architect has to look after his two little girls as a clueless father. In the meantime he got a deadline of the most important project in his career.

title: Juara
overview: The story “from zero to hero” of a teenager named Bisma who has martial arts talent. His outstanding talent never realized because his mother always trying to keep him from anything associated with martial arts.

title: Kalam Kalam Langit
overview: Jafar has achievements in the field of reading the Koran. Various achievements were achieved in several competitions including MTQ. Jafar's success is not supported by his father who thinks that MTQ only sells verses of the Koran.

title: 1 Cinta di Bira
overview: Iqbal (Fauzan Nasrul) does not return home for six years. He prefers a career in Jakarta than to resume the family business of building phinisi ship. The death of his father makes Iqbal to return to Bira. He is mandated to continue pinisi ship business.  Iqbal who've drowned in the sea Bira in childhood gets trauma. He slips and falls again into the sea while visiting his father's place of business. When awake, Iqbal sees a beautiful woman smiling at him. He think the woman is the "keeper of the sea" who once helped him. Iqbal falls in love with the woman named Devi, daughter of Uncle Rustam, a friend of his father.  Iqbal wants to sell the ship business and brings Devi and his mother to Jakarta. His intention is halted by Enre and Olla. Iqbal gives up when Olla shows the beauty of Bira and tells the struggle of his father to build Bira. Iqbal is in doubt to sell the business and moves to Jakarta. His heart is also undecided to choose Devi or Olla.

title: Get Up Stand Up
overview: Babe Cabita, a radio broadcaster in Medan, has a lot of fans. But Well, honey, working on a small radio so it is not growing. Fatiya, Babe's girlfriend, suggested Babe stop working on the radio and become a regular employee in his uncle's office.Despite his heavy heart, Babe follows Fatiya's advice to undergo an interview at Fatiya's uncle's office. But Babe broke his promise. Fatiya is angry and decides to leave Babe for Jakarta because he has been accepted to work in a law office. Babe who could not escape Fatiya then followed him to Jakarta and looked for him. During the search, Babe met Abdur, a friend from overseas who was trying his luck to become a comedian at the Stand Up Comedy event.

title: Ghost Diary
overview: Marsha, who lives in a girl boarding school, is often bullied by her friends, Puput, Stefani, and Nina. In the holidays Marsha does not go home, because since her mother died and her father remarried, her stepmother does not like Marsha. While Puput, Stefani, and Nina does not go home because of a penalty as a result of bullying Marsha.  The strangeness for the sake of weirdness are going on. Marsha hears the cries from a room situated in the upper floor of dormitory building. The administrator, Rossa, says that Marsha is just hallucinating. Every night, Marsha still hears the sounds from the room. Marsha finally ventured to dismantle the room’s door that seems be kept secret. In that room she founds a diary.

title: Gila Jiwa the Movie
overview: Four friends work on film production in the method that has never been done before. But when they all have different goals, how could the film be made? Gila Jiwa crosses diverse genres of horror, action, drama, comedy, and musical.

title: Arang & Asa
overview: Pak Fuad is one of many Go-Jek drivers in Jakarta. On his rides, he meets all kinds of passengers in all kinds of situations. There, too, he finds the thing he has always longed for.

title: Oops!! Ada Vampir
overview: Rendy & Meylan love each other. Due to different social status, Rendy is not confident to speak with Aming, Meylan's father, who is notoriously hard and opposes the difference.

title: Beauty and the Best
overview: Ira adalah remaja cantik yang juga berprofesi sebagai model. Kelly, teman sekelasnya adalah anak yang berprestasi. Suatu kali Ira mendapat nilai lebih tinggi dari Kelly. Kelly tidak terima dan menuduh Ira mencontek. Ira menyangkal. Kelly kemudian menantang Ira, jika Ira bisa mengalahkan nilai-nilainya pada saat UAS maka Kelly percaya kalau Ira tidak mencontek. Ira menerima tantangan Tersebut walaupun teman-teman dekatnya ragu.

title: Raksasa dari Jogja
overview: Bian falls in love with the gentle giant, Gabriel who eventually opens his heart to her. But Bian's past trauma comes back to haunt her.

title: Blusukan Jakarta
overview: Tony, an American journalist, is assigned to assist the investigation team of Berita Satu. In Jakarta, Tony immediately attracted to cover street children and Acil is his choice. Interviews are initially go smoothly, but it turns into a mess when Acil steals Tony’s camera.  Tony pursue Acil mightily to get into the area of the fishing village. There he meets with Anggun, who is a teacher for street children. Then Marni, a mother who has to be prostitute, and Jampang, the head thug in the fishing village. Through them, Tony goes into marginal lives of the people of Jakarta with all their problems.

title: Abdullah & Takeshi
overview: Cerita tentang 2 orang bayi laki-laki yang dilahirkan di rumah sakit yang sama di Jepang, Sang bayi keturunan Arab, dibesarkan oleh keluarga dan kebudayaan Jepang diberi nama TAKESHI. Sementara bayi keturunan Jepang, dibesarkan oleh keluarga dan kebudayaan Arab dan diberi nama ABDULLAH.

title: Wawancara
overview: Sarjana yang pernah menjadi pengendara ojek online telah berkali-kali gagal dalam wawancara kerja.

title: Pontien: Pontianak Untold Story
overview: Artha mendapat kabar tentang kehilangan abangnya yang tinggal di Pontianak, Kalimantan Barat. Ia menelusuri kota itu untuk menemui iparnya yang bernama Inur. Pencariannya justru memunculkan cerita tentang lingkungan hidup yang rusak. Artha terseret dalam sebuah dunia lain yang mengungkap misteri di balik kehilangan abang.  Hutan Kalimantan Barat membawanya ke masa lalu tentang kota Pontianak. Ia dibuntuti oleh misteri di balik cerita masyarakat kota Pontianak tentang adanya keterkaitan nama kota Pontianak dengan hantu Pontianak/Kuntilanak.  Lando, aktifis lingkungan, yang juga rekan abangnya dalam sebuah NGO, tiba-tiba meninggal tragis. Kejadian ini semakin menguatkan niat Artha membongkar semua misteri. Di sisi lain, Niar, ibunya Inur yang juga keluarga keturunan kesultanan Pontianak, merasa Artha adalah manusia pilihan.

title: Viva Tar!
overview: From the lens of its alumni, this film chronicles about the history of Marching Band Korps Putri Tarakanita, a marching band extracurricular that continues its legacy to this day.

title: Makmum
overview: Nurul is a diligent and religious student. One night, she wake up at 2 AM and pray as usual. She felt there is someone behind her and copy her movement during praying. She thinks that someone behind her is one of her friend. At last, she realize that she's the only one who stay at the dorm. Because all of her friends have gone back to their hometown. So, who's behind her?

title: Wa'alaikumussalam Paris
overview: Itje, a girl from Bojong, is hoping that her life will change drastically after marrying a French man, Clement or Emen as Itje calls him. Likewise Itje’s parents who always show off to thier neighbor if Itje is married to the wealthy and would stay in Paris. But, what is expected far from reality. Itje is taken to a remote village in the southern city of Bordeaux, in wineries, and live in home that is far from everywhere.  Itje disappoints and complains to her husband. Another misfortune: there is no internet and telephone, Itje who can not get out of gadgets and social media, is tormented. Every day she is fuming mad and asks Emen to take him to Paris for shopping and selfies in tourist spots.

title: Pulau Buru Tanah Air Beta
overview: "They" reminisce about their stories of living on the Island of "Hope", hope for a long life, so they can feel the taste of going home one day, among free choices.

title: You Have A Secret Admirer
overview: A secret love is beautiful, sweet and sacred when it's just a light infatuation; but when that person reaches over and touches you in the heart, making it alive in a way it has never known, that secret love becomes disheartening when you finally knows what happens behind the scenes.

title: Iblis
overview: Since they occupy the house, many strange things that these couples, especially Kim. Kim was always harassed by the presence of the figure who terrorized her. Den also feel the same.

title: hUSh
overview: Tells the story of an aspiring singer from Bali who travels to Jakarta to find success. There she encounters the trappings of success; insincere boyfriends, materialistic impulses, fast friendships, empty sexual encounters. When a breakup causes her extreme heartache, she decides to travel back home to take refuge. Her journey becomes the foundation for a discussion about all things pertaining to women's issues.

title: Reco
overview: Mr. Bejo found an ancient statue in his yard and shared the story with his wife. He decided to sell the statue after the discussion with his wife. The village people received the news when the wife started to share the secret with her close friends. The whole village started digging to find more statues and earn.

title: Pesantren Impian
overview: Sepuluh orang gadis mendapatkan undangan undangan misterius untuk tinggal di Pesantren Impian. Sebuah tempat di daerah terpencil yang didirikan Gus Budiman untuk menjadi jembatan hidayah. Gadis-gadis muda pun datang membawa masa lalu mereka.

title: Comic 8: Casino Kings - Part 2
overview: Ke delapan agen rahasia (Arie Kriting, Babe Cabiita, Bintang Bete, Ernest Prakasa, Fico Fachriza, Ge Pamungkas, Kemal Palevi, Mongol) yang memakai nama samaran “COMIC 8” kembali beraksi.  Mereka yang telah dijebak oleh THE KING (Sophia Latjuba) bersama para pasukannya yang dipimpin oleh Isa (Donny Alamsyah) dan Bella (Hannah Al Rashid), serta seorang konspirator licik bernama Dr. Pandji (Pandji Pragiwaksono) ; terpaksa bertaruh akan kelangsungan hidup mereka, di dalam permainan Judi online yang tersebar ke para Raja Judi di seluruh dunia.

title: Stay With Me
overview: Dimas and Deyna are lovers who promise to stay together forever. One day Deyna got the news that her parents died in a plane crash. The incident focred her to go to Europe and live with her Aunt. Six years passed. Boy became a film director & married, as fate would have it, one day bumps into Deyna who is now also married. Despite being married to other people and having seperate lives, Boy still believes that Deyna should be with him.

title: Dia Pasti Datang
overview: After being persecuted by Anto and Fendy until she died, Larasati possessed the body of Alya, her best friend from cyberspace.

title: I Am Hope
overview: Mia is a writer who's very eager to make her own play with her musician father, Raja Abdinegara, until that very dream halts due to her newly found lung cancer, the same disease that once claimed the life of her mother. Mia and Raja, who came from wealth, now have barely enough for their needs, for the cost of her mother's treatment in the past means the musician has lost his muse. When Mia discovers she has only eight months left to live, accompanied by the presence of the Rainbow Girl, her own fictional character that was inspired by her mother, Mia sets herself to be as positive as possible. When Mia attends an independent play, she meets a young actor, David. As their relationship becomes romantic, they seem to resolve their grief.

title: Jagoan Instan
overview: Di Amerika ada tiga jagoan yang nganggur karena kondisi negeri mereka yang sudah damai dan makmur. Di Indonesia ada bekas jagoan yang gagal memperbaiki keadaan. Korupsi dan kejahatan tetap merajalela. Om Gun (Dede Yusuf) , bekas jagoan Indonesia itu, mengundang tiga jagoan Amerika yang rindu beraksi itu untuk beraksi di Indonesia dengan syarat membawa apa yang dinamakan serum jagoan.

title: Cinta di Balik Awan
overview: Life is like clouds, it comes and goes, sometimes it's dark, sometimes it's bright. Sometimes it looks lonely alone, but sometimes it also comes in droves. Change from one form to another.

title: A Copy of My Mind
overview: The new romance between a beauty salon worker and a subtitle writer for pirated DVDs gets pulled into danger when they view a forbidden recording.

title: Dan Pernyataan Yang Sama
overview: The story of 5 proletariat who strived for their life.

title: London Love Story
overview: Cinta bukanlah cinta, jika menyerah..  Adalah Dave (Dimas anggara), kepopulerannya di kalangan para mahasiswa ternyata tidak dapat menutupi kekosongan hatinya, sejak ditinggalkan oleh satu satunya cewek yang dicintainya. Cewek yang lenyap dari hidupnya justru di saat Dave ingin menjadikannya cinta terakhir. Suatu malam ketika baru pulang dari pesta ulang tahun temannya, dia bertemu dengan seorang cewek yang berusaha bunuh diri yaitu Adelle (Adila Fitri), Dave berusaha meyakinkan apa yang dilakukan sia sia. Awal pertemuan membuat cewek yang ditolongnya justru jatuh cinta hanya dalam waktu dua hari, dari sikap dave yang sangat baik.

title: Talak 3
overview: Setelah resmi beberapa bulan bercerai, rumah kredit bersama Bagas dan Risa terancam akan disita bank. Mereka berdua dengan terpaksa harus bersama - sama mengerjakan sebuah project besar yang hasilnya bisa menyelamatkan kondisi keuangan mereka berdua. Masalahnya, pekerjaan mereka berdua menuntut keduanya harus bersama. Dalam proses pengerjaan project tersebut, muncul kembali benih – benih cinta diantara Bagas dan Risa. Akhirnya mereka memutuskan untuk rujuk kembali.

title: Aach... Aku Jatuh Cinta
overview: Kisah percintaan dua manusia, Yulia (Pevita Pearce) dengan Rumi (Chicco Jerikho) yang tumbuh sejak kecil saat mereka bertetangga. Hubungan yang unik, puitis, penuh tragedi dan komedi mewarnai perjalanan mereka melewati masa-masa perubahan zaman. Perubahan gaya hidup dan hadirnya produk-produk konsumsi ikut menjadi saksi cinta Rumi dan Yulia.

title: Air Terjun Bukit Perawan
overview: Marzuki asks six friends to go to the village of his girlfriend Tina, who has been almost three months without any message. Tina turns out not in her house, so Marjuki asks his friends to camp in the hills nearby. When the tents built, suddenly Tina comes.  When sleeping, Marjuki has nightmares. Tina’s is killed in waterfall and her body is dragged between the rocks. The next morning, when they finish bathing in the waterfall, Marjuki sees a stone which is similar to the one his dream.  Marjuki approachs the stone and is suprised to see the bodies of Tina behind the stone. Marjuki is scrambling back to the tent, and there he sees Tina cooking with the others.

title: Surat dari Praha
overview: Larasati (Julie Estelle) atas desakan keadaan terpaksa memenuhi wasiat ibunya, Sulastri (Widyawati Sofyan) untuk menhantarkan sebuah kotak dan sepucuk surat untuk Jaya (Tio Pakusadewo) di Praha.

title: Siti
overview: A young mother to her son, Siti has to find ways and means to care for the boy, her husband and her mother-in-law. By day, she sells snacks; by night, she works as a karaoke guide. Tainted by her nighttime employment, Siti finds her husband no longer wishes to speak to her.

title: Mana Janji Ayah?
overview: A child sometimes does not appreciate all the hard work their parents do to please their child even in the most difficult conditions.

title: Ketika Mas Gagah Pergi the Movie
originalTitle: Ketika Mas Gagah Pergi the Movie
overview: Mas Gagah was changed. After went to Ternate for his assignment suddenly he changed drastically. His sister, Gita Ayu can't accept this. She thought Mas Gagah is a new person who totally different from the previous one.

title: Bombe’ Dua: Dumba’-Dumba’
overview: Aya, Sesha, Yudi, Zaki, Kayla, Rara are now friends in a classroom unlike in Bombe 1. However, their friendship is disturbed when Yudi’s and Zaki’s father pick up them both at school. These parents turned out to hold a grudge for long time. Zaki's father had been imprisoned because of Yudi’s father's testimony in court. Hostilities between these parents impact on the friendship of Yudi and Zaki.

title: Muka'Ku
overview: A Narcissistic Girl loving herself and admires her Beauty in front of a mirror, when suddenly a Demon approaches her and seduces as 'it' told that she can be more that which destroy herself in the process.

title: Get in Tune: Indonesia Kirana
overview: ‘Get in Tune’ is a music documentary film that takes you on the journey of the only Asian participant in one of the world’s highest level of choir competitions. For the first time, they are able to get the chance to represent their country, Indonesia, in the Grand Prix stage. The team is under pressure while expected to bring home a victory.

title: Sawadikap
overview: OCEP (Zaky Zimah) mendapat tiket liburan ke Thailand untuk 3 orang. Bersama sahabatnya BRYAN (Kiki Drajat) dan ARIEL (Lionil Hendrik).  Saat mereka tiba, rupanya sedang ada perayaan Pee Ta Khoon, sebuah perayaan adat Bangkok dimana arwah orang yang sudah meninggal, turun kembali ke bumi.

title: Rock 'N Roll
overview: Asti and Indra are two best friends who have been separated for two years because Asti has been studying abroad. Asti returns to Jakarta to find her best friend has changed his profession from a journalist to a farmer.  To celebrate their reunion, they travel all over Jakarta, to visit their favourite restaurants. Places that evoke memories of their friendship, and questions about what change between them.

title: Hantu Cantik Kok Ngompol?
overview: Tells the story of four female college students who are majoring in breeding and are now continuing their education at the Livestock Research Center (PPP) located in remote and remote areas of the city. One day the way to the school broke up.

title: Midnight Show
overview: Based on real story, the film tells Naya (Acha Septriasa), Juna (Gandhi Fernando), Sarah (Ratu Felisha) and the rest of the moviegoers are involved in a murder mystery in an old movie theater at midnight. The murders occur while the theater is showing a controversial movie about a twelve year-old boy who kills and mutilates his entire family.

title: Wanita Berdarah
overview: Amira, a nurse at a hospital in Jakarta, had to take care of her mother suffering from a stroke. Amira's mother's condition worsens and dies of the world. Before she died she asked Amira to look for her sister, Irin, who had long gone to Hong Kong to become a TKW. Amira went to Hong Kong to find his sister.

title: White Shoes & The Couples Company Di Cikini
originalTitle: White Shoes & The Couples Company Di Cikini
overview: White Shoes & The Couples Company in Cikini is a documentary film that captures the special moments of the homecoming concert of the legendary Jakarta band, White Shoes & The Couples Company. Directed by Henry Foundation, the film not only showcases music and nostalgia, but also serves as an emotional journey back to the band's roots—the Cikini neighborhood. Through archives, intimate conversations, and concert footage, the film reveals the members' personal relationships with the spaces that shaped their identities as artists: from the streets and campuses to the creative spaces that witnessed their early days. "White Shoes & The Couples Company in Cikini" is a love letter to the city, the music, and the friendships that endure among Jakarta's old buildings.

title: Kami Hanya Menjalankan Perintah, Jenderal!
overview: A short film by Ilman Nafai

title: Izinkan Saya Menikahinya
overview: Suryati’s happiness is shattered by a letter rejecting her marriage request. Her fiancé, Suryono, a soldier, is forced to obey his superior's orders—citing her grandfather’s ID, marked “ET,” as the reason for denial.

title: Ruang/Waktu
overview: Moments of clandestine romances where in the end, choices were made, affecting three couples.

title: Noise is Serious Shit
overview: This video is part of an effort to document the noise/experimental music scene in Yogyakarta. All interview, recordings, and music footage in this video represent the aspirations of the scene at least until 2016.

title: Fiksi
overview: Fiksi (Fiction) presents a subjective view of historical narrative, de-emphasizing legibility and transparency. The film is composed of images of dioramas at Indonesia’s National Museum.

title: Jeni Lova
overview: Jeni escapes from the pre-wedding session and heads to the beach. Before running away, he left a letter for her fiancé, Jaki.

title: Pustaka
overview: A young man tries to get out of an old library, as rock creatures from his childhood book threatens his life.

title: Ngenest
overview: Ernest (Kevin Anggara/Ernest Prakasa) tidak pernah memilih bagaimana ia dilahirkan. Tapi nasib menentukan, ia terlahir di sebuah keluarga Cina. Tumbuh besar di masa Orde Baru dimana diskriminasi terhadap etnis Cina masih begitu kental. Bullying menjadi makanan sehari-hari. Ia pun berupaya untuk berbaur dengan teman-teman pribuminya, meski ditentang oleh sahabat karibnya, Patrick (Brandon Salim/Morgan Oey). Sayangnya berbagai upaya yang ia lakukan tidak juga berhasil, hingga Ernest sampai pada kesimpulan bahwa cara terbaik untuk bisa membaur dengan sempurna adalah dengan menikahi seorang perempuan pribumi.

title: Biduan Dangdut Bau Kambing
overview: Belum tersedia

title: Midnight
overview: Gofar (Gofar Hilman) and Guntur (Guntur Triyoga) who work as radio broadcasters in Jakarta, always feel someone is watching every broadcast of their Midnight program. Guntur also always feels scared because there are sightings of casting demons. The radio station is a building with a production house office that often holds casting.

title: Natalan
overview: Not having returned to Jogja for four years, Resnu promised that he would celebrate this year's Christmas Eve mass together with his mother. Anxiety and longing for the mother invades Restu's mind during the journey with his wife from Jakarta.

title: Negeri van Oranje
overview: Ini adalah kisah tentang perjalanan lima sahabat, memaknai hidup, cita-cita, perjuangan dan cinta, di negeri yang jauh dari asal mereka.  Perjalanan yang membawa seorang perempuan bernama Lintang ke hari ini. Satu hari sebelum pernikahannya. Hari di mana segala ingatan itu kembali. Tentang sahabat-sahabatnya: Daus, Banjar, Wicak dan Geri.

title: Sunshine Becomes You
overview: A contemporary ballet dancer helps a pianist recover from his hand injury after causing him to fall down the stairs.

title: Bulan Terbelah di Langit Amerika
overview: Setelah mendapat kiriman email video seorang gadis berjudul “Do you know my dad?”, Hanum (Acha Septriasa) seorang jurnalis muslim dan bekerja di sebuah kantor berita di Wina, diberi tugas untuk menulis artikel provokatif oleh bos redaksi, berjudul “Apakah dunia lebih baik tanpa islam?”.

title: Single
overview: Ebi adalah seorang anak muda naif yang belum mempunyai pekerjaan. Ebi bahkan masih sering meminta uang dari ibunya setiap kali ibunya datang ke Jakarta.Ebi juga seorang single forever atau jomblo dari lahir yang belom pernah pacaran. Ini karena setiap kali Ebi mendekati perempuan, Ebi selalu aja ditolak. Intinya, kehidupan Ebi layak untuk dikasihani.

title: Black Honeymoon
overview: Rangga is a loving and caring boyfriend to Cinta, but things turns upside down during their honeymoon after they got married. Rangga turn into a cold and abusive man towards Cinta.

title: Harim di Tanah Haram
overview: Qia, a pesantren resident who had a bitter experience as a child, when villagers burned their houses and dragged and abused their mother. His life was further disturbed when Basri, a donor, proposed to him, because after marrying Basri he received wrongdoing. Qia was desperate to run away.

title: Penghuni Lain
overview: Talk about a family who just moved home and is located quite far from the city. Initially when the new move to the house all went well, but when a grandmother with a spooky figure appeared and seen and terrorize Lisa so that Lisa feel strange and suspicious of the grandmother who lived in the house opposite them.

title: Djakarta-00
overview: An artist meets a girl. Together they are discussing the past and the future of Jakarta, a city above water.

title: Aufwachen
overview: A girl wakes up in an enchanted forest, but all on her mind is how not to be late for work.

title: Tida Lupa
overview: In 1965, mass killings swept across Indonesia, targeting members and sympathizers of the Indonesian Communist Party (PKI). This film focuses on the localized atrocities that occurred in Manggarai-Flores, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), where individuals merely suspected of having ties to the PKI were systematically murdered. The narrative uncovers a dark chapter of history, detailing how the few survivors were eventually released only after enduring brutal torture.

title: Kitorang Basudara
overview: It tells a story of how hard it is for Papuan students to find living spaces because their dorms are fully occupied.

title: Ilalang Ingin Hilang Waktu Siang
overview: This situation occured when in asian financial crisis 1998. A little boy, Ilalang walked out of the house every night to find his father who disappeared when looking for whealty way from black magic. The myths about instant wealth spread rapidly into villagers. Including Ilalang's grandmother.

title: Miracle: Jatuh Dari Surga
overview: Andri Tjohjokusumo (Darius Sinathrya) dan istrinya Eli (Anneke Jodi) tampak rukun bersama putri semata wayang mereka, Krista (Naomi Ivo). Namun, semuanya berubah ketika Krista memperlihatkan keajaiban: ia mampu mengobati orang sakit dengan sentuhan tangannya. Ditambah lagi dengan kehamilan Eli, semuanya membuat keluarga kecil ini guncang. Andri yang trauma dengan luka masa lalunya banyak berkeluh kesah dengan sahabatnya, Ramadan (Indra Birowo).

title: Villa 603
overview: Alya, who was pregnant, often had nightmares and hallucinated seeing ghosts, which worried Randy, his wife. At the doctor's advice, he took his family on vacation to Villa 603. In the villa Alya could sleep well without experiencing the usual nightmares. But the calm was disturbed when Alya again hallucinated to see many apparitions at the villa and became hysterical. He urged her husband to leave the villa. On another occasion, their daughter Amanda was found in a state of shock after disappearing in the forest around the villa.

title: Guna Guna
overview: A young man try to save his friend, cursed by black magic.

title: Skakmat
overview: Jamal , motorcycle taxi drivers who like to play chess, had a dream to open a the motor wash near his base. Rodiah, Jamal’s mother, threatens him if not promptly changes his life, the family land quota for him will be his cousin. In love affairs Jamal is challenged by Mirna’s parents because his unstable work.  Jamal is asked by Ivan, whom he knew inadvertently, to take Dito, a courier heroin, to Tanah Tinggi Boss. He gives Jamal is an advance of 10 million and 90 million reward if he can complete the task. Having never seen that much money, Jamal directly takes it.  Ivan knows that Dito is targeted by Mami Tuti, a bookies who revenge on Dito because he made her sister a broken heart and became a junkie. After giving this task to Jamal, Ivan flees to Hong Kong with his wife.

title: Calon
overview: Adam is on the brink of the most important night, as he tries to convince his girlfriend Nisa’s father, that he is the right guy for her. Things took a wrong turn as Nisa’s father, a religious conservative man, questioned every single thing that Adam said in logics that he can't understand.

title: Lost
overview: Lost told about Intan who was sitting on the swing alone and suddenly Deffa came and sat next to her to accompany her. They became friends from childhood to adulthood and they gave each other surprises on birthdays until finally Deffa, who was diagnosed with brain cancer, gave Intan a birthday surprise for the last time.

title: Warisan Olga
overview: In need of money, a boarding house owner's brother heads off to an island to find a precious stone but must fend off several bumbling treasure hunters.

title: Nay
overview: Nay, who's pregnant for about 11 weeks now, has to face life's adversities and the true nature of the people around her: her boyfriend Ben, her manager Ajeng, Ben's mother, and Pram - who she thinks is dependable. Shot entirely in a car.

title: Badoet
overview: After three children are found tragically dead, a band of college students are forced to conduct an investigation. And that is when terror from a mysterious clown figure starts to mount. Our heroes soon realize that what they are facing is a force that disguises its darkness through laughter—a force so menacing, it will not hesitate to take lives to get what it wants: immortality.

title: Catur
overview: Because of his passion for chess, a middle-aged man is called "crazy" by the people around him. Everyday he asks people to play chess, then one day he disappears. A student who used to know him suddenly feels responsible to track and find him.

title: Train Station
overview: When a mysterious train accident forces a man to change his plans, he is confronted with a series of choices. Each decision he makes leads to a different scenario, each one filmed by a different director with a different cast.

title: Misterius
overview: Film "Misterius" merupakan film yang berasal dari Indonesia dengan genre Horror. Film ini disutradarai dan diproduseri oleh Muhammad Yusuf. Artis yang bermain di film ini seperti Lia Waode, Sofia Adios, dan artis pendatang baru Efritha Belliana.

title: Kakak
overview: Cerita film kakak mengikuti sepasang suami istri yang telah gagal tiga kali untuk memiliki anak akibat keguguran. Suatu ketika mereka berdua menemukan sosok arwah anak kecil di rumah baru yang mereka tempati. Meski awalnya sempat ketakutan oleh keberadaannya arwah anak kecil itu, namun mereka justru sering mendapatkan bantuan dan perolongan dari arwah ini. Karena itu, arwah hantu anak kecil ini dianggap keluarga dan dipanggil dengan sebutan “kakak” oleh pasangan ini.

title: Nyumbang
overview: Pak Bejo and Sutini are a poor family in a small village on a mountainside. The harvest of their rice fields fail and Sutini who sell fried snacks in the market also was not doing well with the selling. In the most difficult days of their life. There were many events was held in a village and due to the culture rules, everyone has to attend and donate money. The frustrated Mr. Bejo made a plan to be donated by villagers when he found himself in a terrible economy moment.

title: Tinta Perajut Bangsa
overview: Soesilo Toer is the youngest of the Toer siblings and a Doctor of Philosophy who graduated from a prestigious university in Moscow, Russia. However, the younger brother of the renowned author Pramoedya Ananta Toer also became a victim of Indonesia's 1965 political turmoil. Following his exile, he chooses to embrace a humble existence, surviving by the sweat of his own brow and remaining determined to be a useful, contributing member of his community.

title: Ayah Menyayangi Tanpa Akhir
overview: Arjuna atau Juna (Fedi Nuril), seorang pria dari keturunan ningrat yang jatuh cinta ke seorang gadis Jepang, Keisha (Kelly Tandiono). Ia harus berjuang keras agar cinta nya di setujui oleh pihak keluarga. Kekuatan cinta Juna mampu menerobos benteng perbedaan, hingga akhir nya mereka resmi menjadi pasangan suami istri.

title: Sebuah Lagu Untuk Tuhan
overview: Indonesia drama movie titled "A Song To The Lord" is a film that tells the story about a girl named Angel (Eriska Rein) and a famous singer named Gilang (Steven William). Angel is deaf, honest and have a genuine kindness. The beginning of the story begins when Angel met with Gilang, Gilang which was a vacuum at the loss of the inspiration of the music world for corruption-related cases that are befalling his father into growing inspiration to make a song Because of his encounter against Angel.

title: 3 Dara
overview: Three self-centered playboys are forced to find their sensitive sides when an insulted bartender's magic curse alters their personalities.

title: Bait Surau
overview: The story of the simple life of a human child in finding his identity and returning to the way of Allah SWT.

title: 菜籃公
