Maya, who heard about it, got mad at Tio. Tio cannot take it anymore, and in the end, killed Maya, even after knowing that she is pregnant with their child. Tio decided to make a sculpture from her body so people would not know the truth.

title: Telanjang?
overview: As a developing country, Indonesia faces challenges stemming from its internal diversity—ranging from ethnic groups, languages, cultures, education, and religion.  Many people work in the arts under the guise of pornography, leading many to confuse art with pornography. It is the artists who bear the brunt of this.  In this documentary, viewers can learn about the opinions of various segments of the arts community regarding the Pornography Act, as expressed through their intellectual perspectives.

title: A Very Boring Conversation
overview: A conversation that starts with music and email, then ends with  possibilities that change the relationship between two people from a 'mother-daughter' relationship  into a 'female-male' relationship.

title: Heart
overview: Kisah diawali pertemanan sejak kecil antara Rachel (Nirina Zubir) dan Farel (Irwansyah). Mereka tumbuh dewasa bersama. Ketika Farel bertemu pengarang komik, Luna (Acha Septriasa), dan bercerita pada Rachel tentang rasa cintanya pada gadis berambut panjang itu, Rachel pun tersentak. Rachel yang berambut pendek suka berpakaian kasual, jauh dari kesan feminin. Rachel tipe gadis tomboy yang doyan mobil dan olahraga. Sementara Luna bertolak belakang dengan Rachel. Luna suka memakai rok dan lemah lembut. Cinta Farel kepada Luna menyadarkan Rachel pada rasa cintanya sendiri kepada Farel.

title: Maskot
overview: A boy is told by his dying father that he can inherit the family business only if he finds a new chicken mascot for the company's logo printed on the soy sauce bottles. But his quest becomes a nightmare as his father's assistant does everything he can to stop him from becoming heir.

title: Foto, Kotak, dan Jendela
overview: TV producer Dimas Airlangga, magazine editor-in-chief Nur Larasati, and actor Reno Barata work together on a TV show, only to realize each of them are facing the same dilemma -- they couldn't forget their exes.

title: d'Girlz Begins
overview: Alexa, a young policewoman, is assigned to capture the drug kingpin, Ricardo Monte Carlo. The police try to find the key witness, but he is missing and only his daughter, Casandra, knows his hiding place. Then Alexa has to go undercover as a college student to get close to Casandra, but when the latter also goes missing, Alexa gets her fellow classmates mobilized to help.

title: Berbagi Suami
overview: Three women from three different social, economic, and ethnic groups discuss their lives in polygamous household.

title: Ekspedisi Madewa
overview: Tiro Mandawa accidentally discovers a mysterious ancient artifact while he is guiding an archaeological mission. The artifact is believed to be the last piece of an ancient inscription related to Indonesian folklore. Prof. Kuncoro, a professor of history on ancient civilization, believes that the artifact is the key to the location of an ancient relic that has an endless powerful force. A giant company, the Madewa Group, headed by Adinoto Madewa is willing to finance the expedition to find the ancient relic. Tiro, and his faithful assistant, Satrio, the head of Madewa Group special staff, Miranda, plus Prof. Kuncoro and his two children, Sandhika and Panji, join this expedition mission. Their work is then obstructed by a treasure hunter, Maulana, who is also after the ancient relic.

title: Dunia Mereka
overview: Filly loves playing blues music on her late mother's Fender. Impressed by her gift, Ivan invites Filly to join his band Capung Biru.

title: Jatuh Cinta Lagi
overview: Lila is an idealistic, serious lawyer who defends tortured women. In contrast to her, Andre with his flirtatious attitude, is a corporate lawyer with big clients. Then Lila represents her client, Dr. Gatot, who wants to divorce his wife, Angel, a dangdut singer. Both parents want to custody of their only child. This case brings Lila and Andre together as the latter is Angel’s lawyer. Their relationship develops into romance. Love makes Andre neglect the interest of his client, Angel, while Lila doubts the sincerity of his love.

title: Jomblo
overview: Four single college mates try their luck in love by taking a stab at dating, leading them to humiliating, cringeworthy, and formative experiences.

title: Realita, Cinta dan Rock'n Roll
overview: Ipang (Vino G. Bastian) dan Nugi (Herjunot Ali) adalah dua orang sahabat yang tidak menyukai sekolah dan gemar bermain musik. Kehidupan mereka jalani dengan impian untuk mencapai cita-cita mereka menjadi pemusik rock'n roll. Ipang merupakan anak seorang dosen (Frans Tumbuan) dan memiliki seorang adik laki-laki yang bernama Dido. Sedangkan Nugi adalah anak tunggal yang tinggal bersama ibunya. Diceritakan ayahnya sudah pergi ke Amerika sejak kecil dan tak pernah sekalipun mengengoknya. Mereka berdua (Ipang dan Nugi) sering bolos sekolah hanya untuk bersenang-senang atau main ke toko kaset milik Sandra (Nadine Chandrawinata).

title: Garasi
overview: Gaia, Aga, and Awan only have one goal in their lives, to play music. They formed a band and became local heroes. Outside the band, they have secrets.

title: 9 Naga
overview: Manusia terbaik di Indonesia... adalah seorang penjahat!!!

title: The Anniversaries
overview: A gloomy portrait of a husband and wife relationship depicted through their wedding day by setting in a lift.

title: Adu Kabau
overview: In the high plains of West Sumatra, two feuding families strive to uphold family honor and pride in the arena of buffalo fights. Change begins when 9-year-old Pandi questions his family's tradition.

title: Still Life
overview: Resembling the setup of Dutch still life painting, this piece captures four women of different nationalities fighting for their dignity.

title: Kwek
overview: A toy duck finds itself awakened in the middle of an empty bathroom. Confused about its whereabouts, it tries to help its fellow toy ducks so they can be reunited once more.

title: Free as a Bird
overview: Like many other diverse cultures, a group of teenagers in a corner of Bandung also has its own culture: alcohol. One of them stands out as an icon—Qbong—who then speaks extensively about their core beliefs.

title: Die Jongen Kan Zingen, Ode untuk Soebronto
originalTitle: Die Jongen Kan Zingen, Ode untuk Soebronto
overview: a short film by Ratih Prebatasari

title: Di Atas Rel Mati
overview: Wahyudi, Ropik, Ade, and Wanto share their daily lives as anak lori (cart boys). These children try to survive by offering push cart transportation services—carts used to carry passengers and goods, often utilized by residents of Dau Atas village, Ancol-Jakarta.

title: Dalam Diam
overview: Infidelity — a word that, for some, is unforgivable. For others, it holds a certain beauty, especially when it happens within an unhappy relationship. It is both a habit and a dilemma. A psychological affliction that, for those who commit it in secrecy, can feel strangely beautiful.

title: Adu Jago
overview: The village community’s democratic maturity is put to the test during the election of a new village head.

title: Once Upon A Time In Malang (Jongos)
originalTitle: Once Upon A Time In Malang (Jongos)
overview: In Once Upon A Time In Malang, bread is employed (representing "West") as the metaphor in offering the filmmaker's findings regarding the "cultural policy" in the colonial period of forbidding native servants to position the food they serve below their mouths lest their breath will pollute, poison the food.

title: Alienosaurus di Ladang Tebu
overview: After the events of September 30, 1965, a village in Bantul was frequently visited by flying saucers. While walking in a sugarcane field after seeing a flying saucer, an elementary school boy meets a small dinosaur. The incident was the beginning of the appearance of other dinosaurs in the village.

title: The Last Believer
overview: Bella believes she can save her sister's life by becoming a vampire.

title: Gue Kapok Jatuh Cinta
overview: David is just breaking up and seeing his pitiful situation, his four friends - Once, Andi, Eddie, and Piyu - introduce him to the exciting singles life in Jakarta. Once, Andi and Eddie all have bitter romantic experiences so they choose to be single. On the other hand, Piyu, who falls in love and has a fiancee, lives only for love.

title: Menyemai Terang Dalam Kelam
overview: A history of surrounding the context of the September 30 1965 and the various political and social changes in Indonesian society after that. The film features the voices of the community that during the New Order period silenced. Those who for more than thirty years of those who do not have connections and relationships in the events of 1965 are victims and victimized.

title: Kejar Jakarta
overview: Ujang, a young man from Cibatu, West Java, travels to Jakarta in the hope of becoming wealthy. He leaves Neng, his lover, behind. Ujang meets Dadang, whom people say has been successful. It turns out that the news is false as Dadang is poor. Then they manage to deceive Dewo, the conglomerate boss and Ujang and Dadang are entrusted to lead Dewo’s company. In reality, Dewo has deceived Dadang and Ujang into carrying out his money laundering activity. Luckily, Dewi, Dewo’s wife, comes to rescue the guys.

title: The Year of Living Vicariously
overview: This split-screen documentary by a Malaysian director chronicles the shooting of the Indonesian film Gie (2005) in the middle of 2004, which is also when the country is undergoing its first direct presidential elections. Opinions from the cast, crew and extras of the film are sought on politics, filmmaking and the national myths of the past and present.

title: Alexandria
overview: Bagas Gunawan (Marcel Chandrawinata), lelaki pendiam dan sangat pemalu memendam rasa kepada Alexandra Yasmina (Julie Estelle), tetangganya yang baru. Alex adalah gadis unik dengan kamera dan koleksi komiknya dan mimpi utamanya: pergi ke kota Alexandria di Mesir, yang kata ayahnya merupakan asal muasal nama dirinya: Alexandra.

title: Belahan Jiwa
overview: Cairo, Baby Blue, Arimbi, and Farlyna are a soulmates. They think they have a connection each other and it's reveals from when they are have a boyfriend. Unknowingly by them, the quartet share their love to one person named Bumi, a man who can adapted of their different personality. He recently shares his love to only one woman with tragic past and trauma named Cempaka. Cempaka always been a weirs-act or something like that. But, when all of women pregnant, the problems shown and will end in a disturbing answer.

title: Apa Artinya Cinta?
overview: A rich teen who yearns to study abroad meets an intriguing college student who could offer her some valuable insight — and potentially more.

title: Mirror
overview: A high school girl named Kikan began to see dead people through the mirrors.

title: Detik Terakhir
overview: Regi suffers from depression since childhood, being raised by wealthy parents who have little time for her, but plenty to fight with and cheat on each other. While in college she meets and becomes close to Rajib, a drug dealer. Developing an intense hatred for men, inspired by her violent and insensitive father, she identifies as a lesbian. Her introduction to the drug-scene engulfs her and she develops a cocaine habit which rapidly accelerates into a preference for White China heroin. She meets and falls in love with Rajibs ex drug-dealing partner, Vela, who has already become a hardcore junkie. Her and Vela's downward spiral into chronic addiction is portrayed powerfully throughout the film as is their intense attachment to each other. The plot (based on a true story) is exceptional in its depiction of the drug problems in Indonesia, the often terrible 'solutions' to these problems, and the reasons behind why they occur.

title: Dealova
overview: A high school girl is torn between two young men, each loving her in their own way.

title: Issue
overview: Linda melamar pekerjaan sebagai reporter TV. Dalam perjalanannya ke sana, dia menyaksikan kematian seorang wanita dan tanpa dia sadari, korban memasukkan mini disc ke dalam tas Linda, sebelum meninggal. Disk mini berisi gambar wanita yang sekarat di jalan. Kemudian gambar dalam disk mini disiarkan, dengan Linda bertindak sebagai presenter. Pembunuh menonton laporan berita dan menjadikan Linda target berikutnya.

title: Vina Bilang Cinta
overview: Pada usia 24, Cillia Yulia tumbuh menjadi gadis yang keras kepala dan pesimistis. Suatu hari, Tri, seorang lelaki berusia 25 tahun dari desa yang menyukai lagu-lagu Vina Panduwinata, ingin mencoba peruntungannya di Jakarta sebagai penyanyi. Nasib menyatukan mereka. Cillia harus membantu Tri dalam mengejar karier musiknya. Memang menjadi tugas yang sangat sulit karena Cillia menentang segala sesuatu yang diyakini Tri.

title: Cinta Silver
overview: Syahlevi, a workaholic neglecting his personal life, contends with his mother's nagging efforts to encourage him to settle down and marry.

title: Gie
overview: Indonesian activist Soe Hok Gie experiences a political awakening during the tumultuous regimes of Soeharto and Soekarno.

title: Untuk Rena
overview: Eleven-year-old Rena loves her orphanage like family and won’t let anyone take her ‘siblings’ away. But when a mysterious visitor arrives, she fears he may change everything.

title: Inikah Rasanya Cinta?
overview: Jason wants to tell Nadia how he feels, but she only has eyes for Ryan, the school’s star. But as her fairytale romance turns complicated and her home life grows unbearable, Nadia begins to wonder if the love she’s been looking for has been beside her all along.

title: Ungu Violet
overview: The loves of a struggling photographer and a bus ticket clerk are inextricably tied together after a chance encounter.

title: Lovely Luna
overview: Four best friends, Desta, Abi, Bobo, the three guys and one tomboy girl, Luna, face a frayed friendship when Desta has a crush on Angel, a student in his campus. While Angel is only flirting with Desta, Luna starts to realize that she has feelings for him. Then Abi and Bobo try to match Desta and Luna.

title: Kara, Anak Sebatang Pohon
overview: Kara is a little girl living in an isolated place. Her father disappeared after Ronald killed her mother. A journalist's invasion of her life makes her decide to seek out Ronald and ask him the ultimate question.

title: Janji Joni
overview: Seorang pria pengantar film menjanjikan seorang wanita muda yang cantik untuk mengantarkan film tepat waktu ke bioskop.

title: Anne Van Jogja
overview: Anne’s mixed Dutch – Javanese parentage causes her father to be banished by his family. After building his own plantation, Anne’s father dies in an accident when she was a child. When she turns 10, Jogja is in a crisis. Anne’s school is closed, and the company run by her Dutch mother has to be handed over to the locals. The plantation is taken over by Satrio’s father. Satrio is a friend of Anne. This change leads to the death of Anne's mother, so Anne moves to Solo and opens a successful batik business. Apparently Satrio secretly helps her by buying her batik as he is still in love with Anne. But he can’t pursue her as he is arranged to marry a princess from the Sultan’s palace. Anne finally learns of Satrio’s deeds, but she also has to bury her feelings, as she has lung cancer. She decides to give Satrio a piece of batik that she personally makes as the wedding present.

title: Catatan Akhir Sekolah
overview: 3 orang sahabat yang dikenal sebagai A3, Agni (VJ Ramon), Alde (Marcel) dan Arian (Vino Bastian) yang dicap geng cupu dan dianggap loser di sekolah mereka, bertekad membalas dendam kepada sekolah mereka lewat sebuah film dokumenter tentang catatan akhir sekolah

title: Me vs High Heels
overview: Sasha is a tomboy and dislike being feminine. After meeting a boy, Arnold whom she really likes, she starts changing her appearance to suit his ideal criteria.

title: Serambi
overview: A college student, a young female dancer, an orphaned adolescent, a rickshaw driver, and an eternal optimist all discuss the manner in which the 2004 tsunami set into motion by an Indian Ocean earthquake dramatically altered their lives in filmmaker Garin Nugroho's reflective documentary.

title: Banyu Biru
overview: Disillusioned with his life and career, a supermarket customer service employee sets out on a journey to locate his estranged father.

title: Panggung Pinggir Kali
overview: The film tells the story of a couple, Rais (Agus Kuncoro) and Rani (Kristina) who have been in a relationship since their teens when they both live in a suburb. At the edge of the river they built a stage, as a form of their dreams for the future. At that time Rani had started to become a dangdut singer even though it was only for the village class. Their dreams both seem to really be like a stage in life, which can change fate from gray to luminous, Rani transforms into a famous singer, after going through various career-making struggles. Meanwhile, Rais, it turns out that it is very difficult to get happiness in his life.

title: Panggil Namaku Tiga Kali
overview: Panggil Namaku Tiga Kali adalah sebuah film Indonesia bergenre horor yang dirilis tahun 2005 yang disuradarai oleh Koya Pagayo dan dibintangi antara lain oleh Hayria Lontoh, Rionaldo Stockhorst dan Titi Qadarsih.

title: Tentang Dia
overview: Reluctant to start a new relationship, a heartbroken college student finds solace in a stranger she encounters by accident.

title: Error Terror Public Horror
overview: Using images from television news, he captures Indonesia as a country divided between modern, rational developments and old, exorcistical practices. Recordings of police raids sketch a picture of old medicine men as terrorists.

title: Stand van de maan
overview: Three generations of one family weather the challenges of living in modern-day Indonesia, the largest Muslim community on the globe.

title: Ku Rela Mati
overview: A film set against the backdrop of the 2004 election, where rival factions are willing to lay down their lives to defend the interests of their beliefs.

title: The Waiting
overview: Everyone agrees that waiting is boring. Dull and exhausting. Suratinah is waiting for her boyfriend to accompany her to the city.

title: Kalah atau Menang
overview: Markun and Jarkin bet that the one who loses must not only clean the neighborhood but also Codet River, which runs through the entire town. Who will win?

title: Terjunjung 9
overview: A satirical parody of Indonesian soap operas, which are unmistakably filled with violence.

title: Lukas' Moment
overview: Story about Lukas, a young Marind fisherman who is trying hard to finance his own education. He starts a small business with the support of a development project.

title: Setelah 40 Tahun: Kebebasan Berbicara
overview: a short film by Tintin Wulia

title: Joki Kecil
overview: Horse racing is a popular folk tradition in Sumbawa. The riders are children whose lives are far less fortunate than the horse owners. These young jockeys ride wild horses without proper safety equipment for only a small reward—a story of victory, pride, gambling, and sorrow.

title: Free!
overview: The Man who wants to escape, and Free!

title: Aku Dengan Nina
overview: A short film by Dinda M. Djunanda

title: September Ceria
overview: This video was made for an exhibition project commemorating the political tragedy in Indonesia in September 1965. The exhibition was organized by Kedai Kebun Forum Yogyakarta. With the title "September Something.  This 3 minute video capture was taken from a long duration which was full of tense situations. In this capture I deliberately took about the joy of children who are full of laughter, joy, hope and the future. This innocent little child named Ade Irma Suryani became a victim of cruelty and was shot dead by a barrage of stray bullets because her father, General AH Nasution, was still able to escape. This source of the film was taken from VCD G30S/PKI (30 September Movement/Indonesian Communist Party) directed by Arifin C. Noer. This more than 2 hour long film is known as a New Order political propaganda film.

title: Still
overview: A gay teenager detached from his surroundings, Guy (Jason Woo) runs away from home to escape the idle stillness of his life in the ethereal nearly silent short film Still . He is desperate for a human connection, some kind of a substitute for love—something he never receives from his absent, distant father, whom he never fully knows or understands. Guy takes the train towards a beach town and checks into a dilapidated motel, roaming the barely-alive streets aimlessly and cruising through life’s clichess only to find discomfort and disillusionment.

title: Black Cherry
overview: A woman finds herself confronted by her own image: who is she, and what makes her a woman? As she finds a black cherry that seduces her, she is forced to explore and to finally take full control of her own body. Her desire is aroused by an apparently insignificant fruit.

title: Alam: Syuhada
overview: Alam has an aspiration to become a soldier. But, he went to Jakarta because of economical difficulties. He wants to relief the burdens of his parent. Alam told stories about life, human dreams who fought for their survival in big city.

title: Yasujiro no jinsei
overview: The film portrays the fictional wanderings of Yasujiro Yamada (Suzuki Nobuyuki), who in 2002 travelled to Indonesia in search of the grandfather after whom he was named.

title: Bangsal 13
overview: Bangsal 13 merupakan film horor Indonesia yang dirilis pada tahun 2004 yang disutradarai oleh Ody Harahap. Film ini dibintangi antara lain oleh Endhita, Luna Maya, dan Lia Chandra, beserta pemeran pembantu lain. Film ini dibuat di daerah Sitamala, Tangerang pada tahun 2003.

title: Ketika
overview: Banyak eksekutif konglomerat memilih untuk bunuh diri ketika mereka bangkrut atau ditangkap karena korupsi. Tajir, yang merupakan kasus seperti itu, membatalkan rencananya untuk bunuh diri, ketika ia mengingat istri dan putrinya, Mutiara. Kebangkrutannya dalam bisnis menyebabkan kemiskinan, ketika semua propertinya disita. Tajir kemudian menjadi sopir bajaj, sementara istrinya membuka warung.

title: Brownies
overview: After enduring heartbreak, a woman with a passion for baking brownies must choose between seeing someone new or getting back with her scheming ex.

title: El Meler
overview: An alley in a small village is kept under tyrannical rule by a group of small children, led by a boy nicknamed El Meler. The group bullies the other children living in the alley, until a newcomer appears, who dares to oppose them.

title: d'Trex
overview: Jerry (Mandala Abadi) and his four buddies like to street race. After making promises to one another that they will stay single for their hobby, the presence of a girl shakes off their friendship.

title: Virgin
overview: Biyan 16 tahun, seorang remaja yang sangat menjaga keperawanannya. Ayahnya playboy yang banyak mengencani wanita-wanita muda, kenyataan yang membuat ibunya sangat menderita. Disitulah Biyan berpendapat pentingnya arti keperawanan.  Biyan bersahabat dengan Stella dan Ketie. Ketiganya bergabung dalam komunitas

title: Rindu Kami PadaMu
overview: Set in and around a mosque in sprawling Jakarta, Indonesia, during the Muslim holiday of Lebaran, the interwoven stories of family, faith and romantic love in this humorous yet poignant film are revealed through the eyes of kids.

title: Impian Kemarau
overview: A man who is in charge of seeding clouds to bring rain to a parched district becomes obsessed with a traditional singer.

title: Tina Toon & Lenong Bocah The Movie
originalTitle: Tina Toon & Lenong Bocah The Movie
overview: Tina, a fifth grade elementary school student lives with his father, Tono. She busks in the streets to earn the admission fee needed for junior high school. When Tina is singing on the street, she meets a record producer, Aswin, who is fascinated by Tina’s dance style. Then Tina and Tono are evicted from their rented house. Tina is entrusted to her grandmother who also lives with her two children, Mak Wecek and Opang. Mak Wecek and her daughter, lvi, are upset with Tina, for receiving more attention from grandma. Tina is then invited to join the Lenong Bocah group. Then the group performs at a birthday party for Aswin’s son. Aswin immediately asks Tina for a recording. Tina's album becomes a huge success. Tina is now wealthy, as well as Mak Wecek who becomes Tina’s manager.

title: Kutunggu di Sudut Semanggi
overview: The film features the events taking place during the first Semanggi Tragedy, November 13th 1998. Combining fiction and real events, it uses footage from television coverage of the Semanggi shootings. Lanang, a student activist in Atmajaya University, is preparing for a mass scale demonstration at the Parliament Special Session with his friends. Lanang's mother, Mrs. Satya Graha and her friend, Jeng Tri, help the student action by providing logistics. On the same day, Novie, Lanang’s girlfriend is having her birthday. Lanang asks Novie to join the demonstration and after that, they will celebrate Novie’s birthday together. But Novie chooses to have a party at Indri’s house instead. In the afternoon, the Semanggi incident breaks. Lanang is one of the 250 victims of the shootings. Novie tries to find Lanang at the corner of Semanggi, but then she receives a call from Lanang’s friend, telling her that he is in the hospital.

title: Ada Hantu di Sekolah
overview: Six good friends enters same high together only to find out there is more to this school than expected, when a female ghost begins to haunt them.

title: Angel's Cry
overview: Bulan is a street hawker whose parents were killed during the Bali Bombing in 2002. A talented sculptor, she secretly carves a statue inside a cave that she names the Angel's Cry. She gives the statue as a gift to her friend, Kevin, a mixed Balinese Caucasian, who wants to help by displaying the sculpture at his father’s gallery. An Australian tourist buys the statue and more so Bulan’s secret talent is revealed. The success brings a dramatic turn to her life and Kevin’s parents also adopt her.

title: Klayaban
overview: A restaurant owner just hired a new guy to work in his restaurant. In one unexpected evening, two unexpected guests visit the restaurant to unravel the past of the owner as well as the new guy.

title: Buruan Cium Gue
overview: Buruan Cium Gue merupakan sebuah film Indonesia yang dirilis pada tahun 2004. Film yang disutradarai oleh Findo Purwono HW ini dibintangi antara lain oleh Hengky Kurniawan, Masayu Anastasia, Dimas Setowardana, Ratu Felisha, Tommy Kurniawan, Imelda Therinne, Aimee Juliette, Irfan Hakim, dan Dewi Rezer.

title: Rukun Agawe Sentosa
overview: A short animated film telling the story of the friendship between Petruk and Gareng through a traditional children's wind-spinner toy.

title: Di Sini Ada Setan: The Movie
originalTitle: Di Sini Ada Setan: The Movie
overview: Based on information read on the internet, Choky invites his girlfriend to visit a lake. Legend has it that any couple who goes to that lake will have a long-lasting relationship. His sister, Lola, who has just broken up with her boyfriend, is told by her mother to join her brother. Choky's friends also join in. On their way to the lake, the car breaks down in the forest. Then Lola goes missing and the fun vacation turns into a nightmare.

title: Mengejar Matahari
overview: The relationship between four best friend turns complicated when a woman enters their lives, and once their past returns to torment them.

title: Aries
overview: Aries is the code of living in Heaven, until one day the passion comes and forbidden fruits fall to the earth

title: Petualangan 100 Jam
overview: Budiman, a 10-year-old boy, lives in the village and dreams of going to Jakarta. This obsession grows when his uncle sends him the map of Jakarta plus his self-portrait, standing in front of a luxurious car and house. His father, Darsono, works as a village official, but the village head, Lurah Sarkawi, uses Darsono as a scapegoat to cover up his corruption. So Budiman wants to free his father from prison. So he leaves his village in Muntilan, Central Java for Jakarta. Initially, he is accompanied by Rini but they separate later. Then Budiman meets Marsya, a singer, who is also the daughter of her uncle's boss. On the journey, Budiman is chased by Sarkawi’s goons, Diran and Dirun.

title: Homeland
overview: Bumi, a 14-year-old boy, is stranded on a foreign planet, when the shuttle that transports him has an accident. He loses contact with his father and all he has is a device that repeatedly transmits his father's last messages. It tells that his father left him a castle at the end of the planet named Utopian. With the help of a dragon, Bumi finds the Utopian castle. What he does not know is that a sword symbolising the power of four kingdoms that were at war, is being kept in the castle. Nino, one of the kingdom's warlords thinks that Bumi has pulled out the sword and hence becomes the true ruler of the four kingdoms. So Nino tries to take over the castle. With the help of his friends, Bumi defends his new home.

title: Fantasi
overview: "Jakarta Cinderella", a musical performance, is performed by three main actors. Indah plays Jutek, the step-sister, Bunga plays Upik Abu, with Ronald as the Prince. In reality, Bunga is an arrogant girl as she has experience acting for television. Bunga is also dating Ronald, whom Indah has a crush on. Then Ronald’s relationship Bunga is jeopardized by Bunga’s jealousy of Indah. So Bunga starts seeing other people and forces Indah out from the school musical. Finally, when the substitute actor is sick, Indah resumes her role and gets Ronald’s attention

title: Sangat Laki-laki
overview: Andra is the champion goalkeeper in the campus soccer team. His love life is ruined as he spends most of his time and energy on the field. But this sport also gives him the opportunity to meet Riri, who claims that she has football running in her blood since her father died on the field.

title: Dajang Soembi: perempoean jang dikawini andjing
originalTitle: Dajang Soembi: perempoean jang dikawini andjing
overview: Silent short (with music and inter-titles) telling an old Indonesian folk tale of a princess who ends up married to a dog.

title: Aku Ingin Menciummu Sekali Saja
overview: A Papuan teenager becomes fixated on his first kiss after meeting a woman at the port, unaware that his father's fight for justice has put their family in grave danger.

title: 30 Hari Mencari Cinta
overview: Kisah tiga sahabat, Keke (Dinna Olivia), Gwen (Nirina Zubir) dan Olin (Agnes), yang berkawan sejak SMA dan saat kuliah masih bersama-sama tinggal di rumah orangtua Olin. Suatu saat mereka tersadar belum punya pacar, dan mereka sepakat untuk mencari pacar. Usaha pertama gagal, dan mereka lalu bertaruh siapa yang pertama mendapat pacar dalam 30 hari. Kebersamaan mereka jadi merenggang.

title: Gembos
overview: In an attempt to fulfill their own dire needs, an unsuspecting street food vendor and a sinister auto-mechanic are forced to become rivals.

title: Mencari Madonna
overview: Joseph is infected with HIV-AIDS, and tries to escape from the reality of life, because there is an AIDS sufferer who was burned by his family. He meets a Javanese prostitute named Madonna, and this encounter begins a new journey in his life.

title: Sitor di Atas Batu
overview: a short documentary by Afrizal Malna

title: Peronika
overview: A mistrust in rural family ensues just because the existence of once-famous answering machine called “Veronica”.

title: Patah
overview: A boy and girl sit opposite each other on the floor and have an uncomfortable conversation.

title: Kulihat Tamanku
overview: A short film by Renas Makki

title: Kado untuk Ibu
overview: A short film by Rumekso Setyadi

title: Ibu
overview: The tragic side of life is portrayed by a woman forced to become a prostitute, trying to survive and feed her family.

title: Djedjak Darah: Surat Teruntuk Adinda
overview: Hardjono, a ketoprak performer whose art is a calling of the soul, is faced with an unavoidable situation. He tells his story through a letter to his beloved. Friends and neighbors come urging him to flee, as the leader of his ketoprak troupe has already been arrested. But Hardjono stands firm. Soldiers and a mob arrive to take him away, leaving a trail of blood on the floor of his home.

title: 17th - Seventeen
overview: Adolescence is the most wonderful time but it turns out that adolescence have many issues, ranging from love, family, and the consequences for the actions.

title: Tak Biasa
overview: Abi fails to get admitted to the Economic Faculty in University of Indonesia and he ends up getting involved in three miserable romances. The first girl, Melisa, is easily influenced by her friends, so she dumps Abi via telephone. Then there is Nadya the high school student. Abi tries to win her love by pretending to be a flower seller. The relationship ends when Nadya has to move to France. Broken-hearted, Abi takes time off to visit his uncle at the tea plantation. Here, Abi falls in love when he sees Rama, the village girl. But their relationship does not work out.

title: Kanibal: Sumanto
overview: Sumanto's crime of cannibalism caused a commotion to everyone in a small village and made headlines in the newspapers. He recounts his life journey and crimes to a journalist.

title: Bunian
overview: Andra, who is studying at the Sydney University of Technology, is looking for a house. Then she finally gets an apartment and shares it with some Indonesian students. As they become closer, love grows and conflicts arise. One day, Andra sees a ghost in the apartment.

title: The Soul
overview: After experiencing trauma and disappearance of her son, Astrid struggles to cope with the reality. She has to face one of the perpetrators who brings up painful events.

title: Arisan!
overview: Between divorce, bad relationships and coming out as gay, a group of affluent friends realize that none of their lives are as easy as they seem.

title: Eiffel... I'm in Love
overview: A privileged teen meets her match when a blunt, outspoken young man visits from France and stays with her family.

title: A Very Slow Breakfast
overview: When a boy is too confused to speak with his non-communicative family, words eventually lose their meaning. He decides to communicate with his dandruff and a cup of cold coffee instead. His father ignores these eccentricities, assuming it is just a ploy to get attention. Meanwhile, the boy's sister likes exercising seductively in front of men and is better able to capture her father's attention than her brother. Their mother is oblivious, perpetually talking to people on her mobile phone and the space the family occupies grows narrower and narrower.

title: Bedjo van Derlaak
overview: Indonesia 1949.Dutch in 2nd agressor. One platoon Indonesia army guerilla on the mission. Ducth attack them and war began. Bedjo, one of Indonesia army guerilla be separate from that platoon. Bedjo found a small house in the middle oh jungle. He hear  something from inside and found Maryam, a pregnant woman and Van Derlaak, dutch army. What will happen to them!?

title: Andy Bertanya
overview: A part of Massroom Project

title: Kiamat Sudah Dekat
overview: About a rockerstar from USA falling in love with a good girl.

title: Untukmu
overview: Ryan, a new student, finds difficulties in adjusting to the lessons. This becomes the beginning of his meetings with Laras, a clever and modest girl, who helps him. The intimacy between Ryan and Laras causes Anggie to get jealous. So Anggie and her friends gang up on Laras, and this misunderstanding causes a rift with Ryan. Then Ryan admits that he is in love with Laras.

title: Cinta 24 Karat
overview: Shana, a-19-year-old, has 24-carat diamond implants in her teeth. She lives with her cousin, Vantje, while studying in Sydney. Vantje feels that he has to find Shana her perfect partner. So he pairs her off to Jacky. They get along well, but then Jacky has to go back to Jakarta, so they start to miss each other. It turns out that Jacky's return to Jakarta is prompted by his brother's illness. So he has to work to earn money to cover the medical expenses. Shana then sells her diamond teeth to cover for Jacky's brother’s surgery.

title: Singa Karawang Bekasi
overview: Set during the war between Dutch/Allied troops and the people of Cibening Cakung in 1945, the story begins when a young man captures 22 Indian soldiers and four British crew members who land on Rawa Gatel. Based on real events, the factual protagonists are KH Noer Ali, leader of Laskar Hizbullah, who is also an ulama (religious leader) who founded the Islamic boarding school; Luke Kustaryo from the Indonesian People's Army; Bang Jole, a local fighter; and Hussein Kamali, an intellectual. Among the fictional characters are H Komar and his wife, who are executed by the Dutch, in front of their children. Then there are also Mahfud and Hafid, members of Hizbullah, who are opponents but who reconcile when they are about to die.

title: Dewa: Live in Japan
overview: Dewa 19 live concert in japan

title: Novel Tanpa Huruf 'R'
overview: Drum has a violent childhood and his mother goes missing in the ocean when they try to escape from the village. Then a car hits his father in front of him while his Chinese girlfriend is killed in a riot. When he grows up, he works as a crime reporter and writes a novel that becomes a bestseller and is sought after by a student, Air Sunyi (Lola Amaria), for her thesis subject. Then Air contacts Drum, in his beach house. But then she gets tied up as apparently, Drum is using Air to find his mother's face. Air fights back and bites Drum's finger off. In the VCD, this particular scene is not shown due to censorship. The story ends when Air receives a package from Drum containing the novel, "Novel Tanpa Huruf R".

title: Pelangi di Atas Prahara
overview: Two Indonesian students, Arman and Andara, meet in Perth, Australia. Arman is obsessed with photography and the story touches on the controversy concerning pornographic VCDs in 2001. An illicitly circulating VCD shows two people making love. The real people in the pornographic VCDs become the victims of disclosure whose private space is violated for public entertainment. Andara is then shown as being one of the victims so that when her relationship with Arman is getting closer, she becomes hesitant.

title: Tusuk Jelangkung
overview: It all starts when Rea invites her boyfriend Zacky to play jelangkung. Her friend scold at her for doing this but it is too late, calamity already begins. A spirit is haunting them and Rea tries to find a way to get rid of it. They go to see a paranormal, and they are told that the only way to get rid of the spirit is by pulling up a jelangkung doll that is planted one year ago in Angker Batu.

title: Biola Tak Berdawai
overview: A woman with a dark past dedicates herself to taking care of multi-handicapped children. When a young musician comes into her life, she is forced to face her history, or it will destroy her future.

title: 100% Sari
overview: Sari, a 17-year-old Balinese girl, is the daughter of a famous painter. In charge of her father's gallery, she is also expected to continue preserving the traditional values. But secretly, Sari wants to become a disc jockey (DJ), knowing that her father would oppose it. Sari's father is preoccupied with his own problem, fearing that his new work would not match his previous ones. Then Sari meets Daniel, a musician from Jakarta. Her father opposes their relationship especially after finding out that Sari has been secretly learning to DJ.

title: Kwaliteit 2
overview: Four freshmen, Santoso, Sly, Limin, and Zulfikar, are competing with their seniors, led by Vanco. As fighting is forbidden inside the campus, they resolve the conflict through a pillow fight contest. With the help of a retired warrior, Santoso and friends go on a training program. The competition shows flashbacks of their unpleasant past. At the same time, they also fall in love with the same girl, Saskia.

title: Biarkan Bintang Menari
overview: Grey and Neyna Neviana’s close friendship loosens when Grey's family move to Jakarta. After being separated for nine years, Neyna and Grey reunite during the student orientation in college. Neyna is a college freshman while Grey is a sophomore who loves to make trouble. Neyna is still the same little girl from nine years ago while Grey has changed. They have to struggle to rebuild their friendship again.

title: Rumah Ketujuh
overview: Lintang dan Cakra adalah teman baik sejak kecil. Mereka menjalankan toko penyewaan video dan mereka berencana untuk membuka bioskop rumah seni. Lintang sangat percaya pada astrologi, jadi dia mencari seorang pria Taurus sebagai belahan jiwa ketika dia mencapai usia 25. Tapi Cakra percaya pada interpretasi mimpi karena dia selalu melihat gadis yang sama dalam mimpinya, tetapi dia tidak bisa melihatnya dengan jelas. Lintang percaya bahwa belahan jiwanya adalah Arman, dan Cakra percaya bahwa belahan jiwanya adalah Alina. Keduanya terbukti salah ketika mereka akhirnya menemukan satu sama lain sebagai belahan jiwa mereka yang sebenarnya.

title: Peti Mati
overview: Rudi tries to avoid the terrifying prediction of being dead in a black coffin. He is frightened and tries to get rid of the coffin. Will the prediction come true?

title: Saya Rasa Itu Sulit untuk Dihilangkan
originalTitle: Saya Rasa Itu Sulit untuk Dihilangkan
overview: A short documentary by Danial Indrakusuma

title: Ketok
overview: One night, a mother hears a mysterious knock at her door. Some time later, her husband experiences the same unsettling event.

title: Ketika
overview: A short film by Hanung Bramantyo

title: Bunga dan Tembok
overview: This film is dedicated to the victims of human rights violations from 1965 to 1998. It tells the story of victims uniting in solidarity and demanding that the state take responsibility in restoring justice for them.

title: Bawakan Aku Bunga
overview: A short film by Ndik Pradhono

title: Durian
overview: A married man in his 30s and a teenage school girl are having their last rendezvous in their regular shady hotel. Smuggled for their dessert is a strong-smelled fruit called durian.

title: Janus: Prajurit Terakhir
overview: Janus, a 34th century android, is trapped in the 21st century and caught in a war between nations. He tries to return to his own time to defend his nation, Genoc, with the help from Mayo and Indri, his 21st century friends. Two enemies are after them, as well as Draco's gunmen who are sent from the future.

title: The Globalisation Tapes
overview: Filmed by Indonesian workers during their working hours on rubber and palm oil plantations, this film exposes the devastating role of militarism and repression in building the “global economy.” Through chilling first hand accounts, hilarious improvised interventions, collective debate, and archival footage, the film explores the relationships between trade, Third World debt, and international institutions like the IMF and World Bank.

title: Andai Ia Tahu
overview: A handsome television producer, Roi Danisworo, is trapped inside an elevator with a beautiful young writer, Nata Adiswara. Instead of panicking, they are attracted to each other. Their accidental encounter leads to their growing curiosity. Renata is assisted by her best friend, and Roi gets Jimmy’s help. The latter even hires a shaman to learn about Renata, that provides some comic relief. Implicitly, the film suggests old-fashioned beliefs in fate and chance.

title: Titik Hitam
overview: The cousins, Heru and Retno, have the sixth sense. Heru can see ghosts and Retno can feel their presence. This shared experience makes the two close since childhood. Retno is also in love with Heru. But Heru feels that it is impossible to be in a romantic relationship with his own cousin. After Heru grows up, he goes to study at the Jakarta Arts Institute, and then starts to date Rianti. Retno is broken hearted when she finds out and she has a car accident. Retno’s death troubles Heru and Rianti’s marriage. Heru is bound to his oath with Retno, that whoever dies first, will come back to tell the living about the afterlife.

title: Kafir: Tidak Diterima Bumi
overview: A shaman uses black magic to give his followers everything they want, but where is the source of his abilities come from?

title: Bendera
overview: Budi and Rosi are assigned by the teacher to raise the flag on Mondays. But when the teacher gives Budi the flag for washing, he falls asleep and forgets that the bucket he is using to soak the flag, is usually used by his neighbour, Bang Ali, to wash his bajaj (motor tricycle). Budi panics when he learns that the flag is missing. He calls Rosie and they look for it around the house. Then Bang Ali returns the bucket, and they rediscover the flag. But when they wash and dry it, the flag goes "missing" again. This takes Budi and Rosi on an "adventure" to find the flag again.

title: The Black Magic
overview: Three young men vacationing in Bangkok, Thailand meet a Thai woman who ends up dead the next morning. Upon returning to the states, the men are haunted by the vengeful spirit of the woman.

title: Eliana, Eliana
overview: Five years after running away from an arranged marriage, Eliana is unexpectedly visited by her mother.

title: Marsinah: Cry Justice
overview: Marsinah: Cry Justice adalah sebuah film drama kisah nyata tahun 2001 yang diproduksi oleh PT Gedam Sinemuda Perkasa, disutradarai oleh Slamet Rahardjo Djarot. Film ini diangkat dari kisah nyata tentang Marsinah, seorang aktivis dan buruh di sebuah perusahaan jam tangan di Sidoarjo yang hilang diculik dan ditemukan tewas pada 8 Mei 1993 setelah aksi unjuk rasa tegang antara buruh PT. Catur Putra Surya dengan pihak manajemen pabrik yang melibatkan anggota polisi dan militer Indonesia. - Wikipedia

title: Ada Apa dengan Cinta?
overview: Bertemakan cinta di masa-masa SMA, Ada Apa dengan Cinta menampilkan Cinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo) sebagai seorang pelajar SMA. Ia langganan juara lomba puisi di sekolahnya yang rutin diadakan tiap tahun. Cerita berawal dari Alya (Ladya Cherill) yang tubuhnya memar karena kerap dipukuli sang ayah yang kerap cek-cok dengan ibunya. Alya adalah sahabat karib Cinta dengan teman-temannya yang lain seperti Carmen (Adinia Wirasti), Maura (Titi Kamal), dan Milly (Sissy Priscillia)

title: Ca-Bau-Kan
overview: Determined to discover her roots, a young woman travels to Indonesia and pieces together her parents' unconventional love story.

title: Aikon: Sebuah Peta Budaya
overview: Documentary about the West Papuan Congress held in Jayapura in May–June 2000. Garin Nugroho explores West Papuan cultural identity, political expression, and calls for independence, offering a perspective on a community whose voices have often been marginalized in the broader narrative.

title: Ketemu Bapak
overview: A mother tells her son the truth about his father: he is incarcerated in the city.

title: Telepon Misterius
overview: A short film by Rano Dimas

title: Mystically Fated
overview: a short film by Priesnanda Dwisatria

title: Jangan Panggil Aku Cina
overview: Pia, a Chinese-Indonesian girl raised in a Minang community, falls in love with Yusril, a young doctor. Their relationship faces cultural and traditional barriers when Yusril’s family tries to arrange his marriage to his cousin. Amid family pressure and financial hardship, the two fight to keep their love alive.

title: Kado Buat Rakyat Indonesia
overview: A documentary film that explores the political events before and after the 1965 tragedy in Indonesia, known as Gestok (1st October Movement). The film features interviews with people who lived through and were involved in those events, offering different views from what was commonly told during the New Order era. The film aims to show the political tensions between different groups—such as the military, student activists, religious organizations, and left-wing movements—and how these tensions led to the violent events of 1965 and the change in government.

title: Devil's Daughter
overview: King Daha calls on Master Warrior Baraba, whose son, Bahwula, is due to marry the witch's daughter Ratna, in the hope that they can steal the Book of Lontar and defeat Calon, a black magic witch who creates a severe drought in the Kingdom of Airlangar, in order to take over the throne.

title: Beth
overview: The story takes place in a mental hospital. Many things are going on. There is Pesta (Bucek Depp), a junky who was moved from a prison to the hospital. He meets Beth (Ine Febriyanti), the daughter of a high-ranking government official, who asked that her daughter gets a special treatment, but this must remain a secret. There are a poet, a politician and a nurse who was an ex-patient, and Beth’s helper, also Rehan (Nurul Arifin) who has her own set of problems. The doctors at the hospital seem no different from the patients. There is also an artist who makes installation art works. His artistic doctrin is: the more complicated it is for a work of art to be understood, the better. It is unclear if the artist is the hospital 's patient, because he is never inside of the hospital but is always in the courtyard.

title: Jakarta Project
overview: Shanty (Claudia Hidayat), a magazine journalist, proposed a coverage of Trisakti diamond which is discovered in the 60s, and now vanished. Dodo (Ba'i Soemariono), internet addict, manages to enter the site of NSA, US intelligence agencies, and retrieves data on Indonesia. It turns out that the action caught, and he was visited by NSA agent who request the data diskette. He gives a false diskette. He is chased but always missed. Shanty is also visited by the agent. She is asked to cooperate to take the diamond that is on top of Monas (National Monument). Dodo asks for help of Mita (Syarmi Amanda), mathematics and science student, to crack the password of the data taken from the NSA website. The data tell that Trisakti diamond is at the top of Monas. Dodo cs go to the monument. Shanty who is willing to cooperate with the NSA agent, goes there as well. All get nothing.

title: Tragedi
overview: Three youths get into debt from a thug. Because they can not provide the money in time, they robb. At the same time a woman accidentally get into a mafia’s base. She must run away from the mafia. This problem makes the woman and three young men united.

title: Jelangkung
overview: Four young people investigating urban legends in Jakarta venture to Angkerbatu, West Java, where a Jelangkung spirit-calling toy alters their lives upon their return.

title: Pasir Berbisik
overview: Berlian and her teenage daughter Daya are on the run from political violence. Constantly daydreaming that her absent father will return, young Daya chafes under the stern hand of her mother. Forced to move inland from their seaside home to a desert of constantly shifting sands, the pair settle down to their familiar antagonism. Finally, Daya sees a vaguely familiar face shuffle in from across the wasteland.

title: Telegram
overview: In Jakarta, a young journalist struggling to escape from the confines of familiar obligations, receives a telegram informing him that his mother is dying.

title: Lajar hidoep
overview: In his contribution, Garin Nugroho wants to show the importance of the new and the old harbour of Jakarta. In the harbour districts Keroncong Tugu (the old district) and Tanjung Priok (the present harbour district), multicultural communities have emerged that have opened up Jakarta society towards Europe and Asia. Nugroho uses archive footage to show that the heritage of the Portuguese who exploited Indonesia before the Dutch is for instance still visible in the existence of a Portuguese community with its own music culture. The development of the harbours is important for the future, but their history also has sad stories. For instance, Nugroho points out that many wars were started about who controls a port. (Rotterdam International Film Festival)

title: Bunga, Jangan Ada Dusta
overview: Bunga (Sonia Isabella), ran away from the orphanage because she did not want to be accused as a liar. In his flight she starves and has to sing on the streets with a boy, meet criminals, etc. She was put in an orphanage by her father, Budi (Deddy Mizwar), for stealing and lying to her stepmother. Budi died after visiting Bunga. A car hit him. Orphanage administrators search for Bunga.

title: Pasar
overview: Two market thugs with all their troubles.

title: Mass Grave
overview: When the bones of the military massacre victims of March 1966 were found in Wonosobo in 2002, old wounds resurface. This documentary shows how the conflict stays unresolved until present-day Indonesia.

title: Dukun Santet
overview: A beautiful ghost woman returns to terrorize a group of people. She is accompanied by her partner, a homosexual spirit. This time, they focus their efforts on an obese man, his rotund wife, and a beautiful woman.

title: Di Antara Masa Lalu dan Masa Sekarang
originalTitle: Di Antara Masa Lalu dan Masa Sekarang
overview: Sastro Atmodjo was an Indonesian force army. He fight for Indonesian independence day. He is the only one who life after all of his friend dead. He is very disapointed with Indonesia condition now. He give up to fight the reality at the present.

title: Hati-Hati, Malam-Malam!
overview: Taking a taxi at night in Jakarta is very dangerous. Especially for attractive young girls. In this case, it's more dangerous for the taxi driver.

title: Joshua oh Joshua
overview: Jojo (Joshua Suherman) dan Jejen (Mega Utami), adalah dua anak jalanan yang harus mencari uang sepulang sekolah. Mereka pergi ke pusat perbelanjaan untuk mengamen atau membantu membawakan barang belanjaan. Mereka tetap riang dan suka bernyanyi sambil berlari-lari. Jejen punya ibu kandung yang baik, sedang Jojo hidup dengan ibu Angkatnya, Nani (Cut Keke), yang kejam, padahal di sekolah Jojo selalu rangking satu.  Jojo sebenarnya bukan anak kandung Nani dan suaminya, Gito (Eeng Saptahadi), yang selama ini membesarkannya. Ketika bayi, Jojo diambil Mpok Ati (Inggrid Widjanarko), perempuan tidak waras, lalu di tinggalkan di suatu tempat. Di situlah Gito menemukannya. Orangtua kandung Jojo adalah orang kaya yang baik hati.

title: Puisi Tak Terkuburkan
overview: The poet Ibrahim Kadir plays himself in a political drama about his arrest and incarceration in Aceh in the 1960s. Kadir survived the mass murder of suspected communists by the Indonesian government that cost between 500,000 and two million lives.

title: Sebuah Pertanyaan Untuk Cinta
overview: This film almost literally visualize three short stories on which it is based. The difficulty was to assign real spaces in the film for the world of short stories that does not require material reality. The question of ”What is love?” is stretched into three periods: the 70s, the 80s and the 90s. The story which is divided into three periods is trying to reveal the story of the main characters through three different periods of their lives.

title: Bintang Jatuh
overview: A young boy dreams of seeing a girl with a blue scarf and a special fragrance. He then searches for this girl.

title: Reinkarnasi
overview: History repeats itself when a criminal with evil intention is reincarnated as a wealthy businessman after 600 years. Will there be a hero to stop him?

title: Don't Touch
overview: Empy is enjoying her solitude, drunk.

title: Critters
overview: In the meeting place of two oceans in Indonesia's Lembeh Strait, photographers capture the majestic, otherworldly creatures living below the surface.

title: Hang Tuah
overview: The minister of the King of Malaka frames Han, a young sailor who saved him from a pirate, thus becoming personal guard to the King, and he is thrown into the sea.

title: Pancasaka 2 - Bara Api Dalam Hati
overview: "The peace alliance between King Astina and King Jahato has broken down. Under the direction of the former, high officer Gata leads an air strike against Amarta Island. Lord Rada sends two Galaxy Patrol warriors; Gen to ward off any attack from the air and Saka to protect the sea." - Official Synopsis.  Hong Kong English dub of an Indonesian Cartoon titled "Pancasaka"

title: Damar Wulan
overview: Based on a folk tale back in the year 1681, the King expands his power over his neighbour state.

title: Portrait
overview: A group of high school students try to photograph a female ghost that haunts their school.

title: Dewi Mayangsari
overview: An adaption of an Indonesian folk tale about a banished celestial princess and two feuding brothers.

title: Kamar Mandi
overview: Family. Father. Mother. Child. One day. In the bathroom.

title: Sri
overview: Sri is a village girl married to Hendro, a 70-year old Javanese aristocrat. When Hendro falls ill, she has to nurse him back to health and negotiates with the God of Death not to take him away.

title: Loh Purush
overview: Watch the action unfold in "Loh Purush" starring Dharmendar and Jaya Prada.

title: Malin Kundang
overview: Young Marty loves the open sea, much like his father, which is of major concern for his mother since his father died at sea when Marty was a baby. Now her son has gone missing on a sailing voyage. Many years later she meets a young man who looks exactly like him, but he does not recognize her. Could this be Marty and has he finally found his way back home?

title: Siluman Ular Putih
overview: Based on a Chinese folk tale, this is the story of a forbidden romance between Janyi, a white snake ghost, and Holeman, a poor medicine man living a simple life.

title: Abunawas
overview: King Arashid falls sick from a runaway wind around town, and the only person who can help catch it is genius wizard Abu Nawas.

title: Menentang Nafsu
overview: A hit man is released from prison after serving 10 years. He holds a grudge against the police officer that shot him and causes his impotence. He wants revenge although the syndicate boss has forbid him. The syndicate has developed an organization where some business can be executed legally. He ends up killing the head of the syndicate, to take his path of revenge.

title: Kisah Veronika
overview: After her parents are laid off from their job, Veronika ventures to the city to look for work. She gets a job in an insurance company. To get customers, she uses ways that she does not like. Veronika’s career rises quickly and she becomes the hot topic amongst the managers. One night, when she is on a date with a director of a large company, a man observes her from a distance. When they exchange looks, the man runs away. When she returns home, Veronika finds out that the man who observed her is her husband. They argue, but they make peace in the end.

title: Miyah: The Life of a Javanese Woman
originalTitle: Miyah: The Life of a Javanese Woman
overview: This is an intimate portrait of a Javanese woman who works as a servant and a cook for a prominent family in Jakarta, Indonesia. While there are many aspects of her life that are specific to circumstances pertinent to Indonesia, Miyah also presents us with a more universal picture. Women all over the world will be able to identify with the strong single parent who is approaching middle age, who must struggle with the day to day problems of making a living to support not only her own children but also her aging parents. Miyah is one of millions of women who live their lives with a kind of quiet dignity that deserves our respect and admiration.

title: Alibaba & 40 Penyamun
overview: Ali Baba steals hidden treasure from some raiders who then seek revenge on his family.

title: Kuldesak
overview: Four stories unfold in Jakarta, a big city that feels cold and dehumanizing. Life there strips away meaning, turning people into soulless zombies. In their search for purpose, youths turn to the only things that seem worthwhile—television and movies. This obsession pushes them down a dark path, transforming them into twisted versions of anti-heroes who make anti-social choices that spiral out of control.

title: Daun di atas bantal
overview: The Indonesian society is seen through a middle-aged lady's eyes in her daily encounters with the street children who work and live off the harsh and sleazy world of adults.

title: Sudah Sore! Sebentar Lagi Jam Lima! Cepat Datang!
originalTitle: Sudah Sore! Sebentar Lagi Jam Lima! Cepat Datang!
overview: A student waked up after falling asleep in class and realizes that it is already late. In a desperate hurry to get home before five, he races through the streets, encountering various obstacles along the way.

title: My Family, My Film, and My Nation
originalTitle: My Family, My Film, and My Nation
overview: Garin Nugroho revisits his filmography to investigate how family, cinema, and nationhood intersects, offering a personal look at his identity & perspective on Indonesia's uncertain future.

title: Gairah Membara
overview: Fights between children in a "mafia" family, Leo (Baron Hermanto) and Carmen (Sony Dewantoro) want to get rid of Rigo (Barry Prima), the family's stepson who is loved by his father, the head of the "mafia".

title: Petualangan Si Kancil
overview: Tiger Bram, the king of the jungle, is looking to get even with the little mouse-deer, having been tricked one too many times by her.

title: Timun Mas
overview: Free-spirited teenage girl Coco confronts Green Buto, a giant monster who made a pact with her mother so that she could have a daughter, and now needs to feed off her youth in order to maintain his magic.

title: Permainan Membara
overview: Kisah yang menceritakan tentang pertarungan dua orang yang ternyata mereka bersaudara. Namun, dalam suatu peristiwa mereka bersatu untuk melawan sindikat.

title: Misteri Banyuwangi (Dukun Santet)
overview: Ratmono is attracted to a Gandrung Banyuwangi (a traditional dance from Banyuwangi area) dancer and he intends to divorce his wife. His intention to marry the dancer costs him his wealth and drives him into poverty. He ends up hanging himself. This incites the hatred of the villagers against the voodoo shaman and they decide to chase away all shamans. But a Muslim minister (Ustad), Sutar, prevents them from doing so. Soon, the village is gripped by a series of killings of those considered to be voodoo shamans. They start suspecting the religious figures (Kiai) but the murders are committed by several men in black, with their faces covered like ninjas. The minister is also threatened by anonymous phone calls and is even attacked. Then the authorities release a statement that there are no ninjas. The murders remain a mystery. Symbolically, it ends with a little boy carrying the national flag with his friends.

title: Kisah Nyata Dukun AS Misteri Kebun Tebu
originalTitle: Kisah Nyata Dukun AS Misteri Kebun Tebu
overview: Berdasar kisah nyata yang terjadi di PT Perkebunan Nusantara II, Dusun I, Kelurahan Aman Damai, Kecamatan Sunggal, Kabupaten Deli Serdang, tahun 1997. Terbongkar pembunuhan berantai terhadap 26 perempuan. Pembunuh dengan inisial AS mengaku telah membunuh 42 orang. Dalam film ini disisipkan pengakuan Datuk asli dalam bentuk suara.

title: Balifilm
overview: Balifilm was originally commissioned as a stage performance,  created from diary images and sounds collected in 1990 and 1992 by Peter Mettler on the island of Bali. The soundtrack is a live recording of eight Gamelan musicians playing the  bronze and wooden instruments of Indonesia during the projection of the film. balifilm is a personal, lyrical observation and expression of the creative pulse of an extraordinary culture.

title: Gordel van smaragd
overview: Theo Staats arrives at his uncle's rubber plantation in 'Our' Indies, The Emerald Belt. He meets Ems, the beautiful singer of the club, and falls head over heels for her. Ems, who comes from a poor Indonesian-European family, does not want to betray her Dutch husband, to whom she owes her status, but she cannot suppress her feelings. The Emerald Belt follows their passionate affair for ten years: from 1939, when the Dutch are carefree and enjoying their colonial power; through the Japanese invasion in 1942 and the difficult war years that will separate the lovers; to the struggle that led to Indonesian independence in 1949, when they are faced with a new choice.

title: Fatahillah
overview: Disappointed after seeing his homeland, Pasai, destroyed by the Portuguese, Fadhilah Khan, later known as Fatahillah or Fala Tehan, completes his education in the Holy Land, then joins Sultan Trenggono who rules the Sultanate of Demak. He gains a respectable position as a cleric, then marries the sister of the Emperor, Ratu Pembayun, and Ratu Ayu, the widow of Pati Unus, who died in the battle against the Portuguese in Malacca. The Portuguese want to establish a fort at Sunda Kelapa. But the Sultanate of Demak is determined to wage a war against the Portuguese. Fatahillah is elected as the commanding officer, and he conquers Sunda Kelapa, and changes its name to Jayakarta, which later became Jakarta.

title: Lukisan Berdarah
overview: A female photographer, Selly, and a female writer, Dina, live in a haunted house. Where Mr. Latif, the house keeper, reminded them of the room that they should not disturb.

title: La dernière potière de Bornéo indonésien
originalTitle: La dernière potière de Bornéo indonésien
overview: The Leppo’ Ké, a subgroup of the Kenyah, an important Dayak set of people scattered in Borneo across the provinces of East and North Kalimantan (Indonesia) and the state of Sarawak (Malaysia), live in the district of Bahau Hulu, on the uppermost Bahau River, a tributary of the mighty Kayan River. The film was shot in Long Pengayan hamlet, at Apau Ping, the last settlement on the Bahau, and home to Oko’ (Grand-Mother) Asung Kiring. In the past, all Kenyah Leppo’ Ké women were potters, but today this is a dying craft, which is considered dirty work and therefore quite unpopular.

title: Penari Malam
overview: Maggy adalah penyanyi yang sukses tetapi ibunya dikirim ke penjara dengan tuduhan membunuh suaminya. Kemudian Maggy menyewa seorang pengawal setelah dia mulai menerima ancaman. Dia memiliki hubungan dengan promotornya tetapi mereka putus, setelah dia tahu bahwa dia memiliki wanita simpanan. Maggy kemudian menjadi intim dengan pengawalnya. Kemudian, dia menemukan bahwa ancaman datang dari ayah tirinya yang masih hidup.

title: Gadis Penggoda
overview: Seeking revenge for a wrecked home life and a rape, psychotic young beauty Ellen poses as a maid to infiltrate the home of unhappy married couple Bob and Fanny and their alienated teen daughter, Tisa. Suicide attempts, seduction and murder follow in what sounds an awful lot like the Indonesian version of Poison Ivy (1992).

title: Birahi Perempuan Halus
overview: In order to pass as human and blend in with society, a ghost couple need to drink virgin blood every full moon.

title: Selingkuh
overview: Febryan forbids his wife, Rowena, to work, so that she can get pregnant. But due to his busy schedule, they hardly find time to have sex, and they often do it when Rowena is not fertile, so they have not been able to have children. Rowena is often away from home for her painting hobby. Then, she meets Cindy, who says that her husband is a seaman and she also introduces her to Rex, her brother-in-law. When they become closer, Cindy seduces Febryan, while Rex seduces Rowena. Cindy records Febryan having sex with her, while Rex makes Rowena fall so much in love with him that she asks Febryan for a divorce, especially after seeing the tape of Cindy and him. So Febryan gets half their property rights and half of their money. Actually, Cindy and Rex is a criminal couple, and they are actually husband and wife. Rowena is later persecuted, also attempts suicide. So she calls Febryan and they get along again. Then, they discover a foetus of two months old that Rowena is carrying.

title: Happy Ending
overview: Clouded by so many violence in entertainment, two boys couldn't differ what's okay and what's not.

title: Gairah Yang Panas
overview: Gela, the son of a widow, lives an unruly life with his friend, Tomi. When he meets Astrid on the street, a fight breaks out and someone is killed. Gela goes to jail, since Astrid is not allowed to give testimony by her father, though she knows exactly what happened. After his release, their relationship is continued and they fall in love with each other.

title: Penyimpangan Sex
overview: Someone is killing prostitutes whom he dates.When Bram notices Jean, a beautiful girl, on the road, he follows her car, until a collision occurs. Jean, who feels guilty, gives her business card and is willing to repair the damage. Bram is eager to date Jean, but fails at the first attempt. Then Bram uses his black magic skills to force Jean to keep coming to his house. As a result, Jean loses her concentration at work.

title: Jalan Raya Pos
overview: Road movie-style documentary about the Great Post Road (De Groote Postweg/Jalan Raya Pos). Pramoedya Ananta Toer (1925), one of the most important Indonesian authors of recent decades, wrote an essay about the Great Post Road at the request of director Bernie IJdis. This thousand-kilometer road across Java was built at the beginning of the last century under the leadership of the Dutchman Daendels and cost the lives of thousands of Indonesian forced laborers. Because Toer, as a former political prisoner, is restricted in his freedom of movement, the filmmakers act as his eyes and ears during a trip along the Post Road. During the journey, parallels between Indonesia in the past and present slowly unfold. In addition, as the film progresses, the grimness of Toer's situation and the situation in his country becomes palpable.

title: Gairah Malam Yang Ketiga
overview: During a fight scene in a film shoot, the lead actor Jodi got shot and died. Jodi is transported to a mystical plane between life and death. The mastermind of this is Jodi's aunt, who wants to steal the supernatural powers of Jodi's father.

title: Permainan Erotik
overview: Tony (Ibra Azhari), a producer, is a playboy who recklessly toys with women. Mala (Indah Febrizha) is one of his victims. One day, he falls for Linda (Windy Chindyana), a girl who enjoys frequenting bars and working out. With the help of his friend, Tony manages to get to know Linda, but she becomes furious when he impatiently tries to take her to a hotel. His friend advises him to apologize. As soon as he apologizes, Linda immediately agrees to marry him. After the wedding, Tony’s behavior remains unchanged until Linda catches him in the act. This time, Linda runs away. His friend steps in to advise him again. Tony apologizes once more, and he and Linda reconcile.

title: Jaringan Tabu
overview: Ray adalah seorang pembunuh bayaran. Ia diculik Yorgos, kepala mafia sedari kecil dan dididik untuk kemudian membunuh ayah kandungnya sendiri.

title: Nafsu X
overview: Tony and Enny start up a car repair shop and develop a sibling-like bond. After winning a race with Ronggur, Tony gets Ronggur's girlfriend Lidya as prize.

title: Membakar Gairah
overview: Natasha finds difficulty in collecting her property, the legacy of her father, since it involves a corrupt international syndicate. For this purpose, she seeks help from Jack. (courtesy: Film Indonesia)

title: Kekuasaan dan Wanita
overview: Textile company owner Anita (Sally Marcelina) is trapped in an unhappy marriage with a philanderer who's bossed around by his controlling sibling. The sister-in-law attempts to murder her so her brother will inherit the factory.

title: Bisikan Nafsu
overview: While on their honeymoon, a couple encounter a ghost.

title: Mistik Erotik
overview: Desperate to cure his sudden impotence, Fred begins a secret affair with Melva, a seductive disco singer who seems to be the only remedy for his condition. However, as Fred regains his virility, his wife Sonia becomes the target of terrifying supernatural disturbances. Ignoring warnings from an old friend about a dark presence, Fred unknowingly walks into a deadly black magic trap, unaware that Melva's seduction hides a sinister vendetta from the past.

title: Hukuman Zinah
overview: Ivan saves Amanda from a gang rape and they start a forbidden affair, as he is married with a wife, Dona. Amanda refuses to acknowledge this and stalks his office and his house, and even claims that she is pregnant. Ivan confesses to his wife, who cannot forgive him, so Ivan has to leave home.

title: Bergairah di Puncak
overview: The story follows Revan, who uncovers the mystery behind the death of his former lover, Reny, ten years after she vanished. The truth is revealed through Reny's spirit at her family's tea plantation villa.  Ten years prior, Revan worked as an engineer at the plantation. After the owner passed away, management fell to his friend, Bono, who plotted to seize the estate by marrying his reckless son, Guntur, to Reny. While Guntur obsessed over Reny, his sister Selvi was deeply in love with Revan. Consumed by jealousy because Revan only had eyes for Reny, Selvi manipulated a foreman named Degol to murder her rival. In the ensuing chaos, Degol shot both Reny and Guntur. The crime was covered up with a lie that the two had eloped together, leading a heartbroken Revan to eventually marry Selvi. Now, guided by Reny's restless spirit and the testimony of an old witness named Pak Amat, Revan finally exposes the dark conspiracy buried in the past.

title: Pergaulan Metropolis 2
overview: Budi (Ferry Tanjung) succeeded in making fun with Ineke (Inneke Koesherawati) who was made a model. Then he pretended to be a garong to make a surprise at Lisa (Windy Chindyana), the director where he worked. Then they were married. Ineke could only see through the glass of his car. Then it was shown that Budi was seducing the other prospective models that he wanted to orbit.

title: Terjerumus di Lembah Hitam
overview: Bobby (Bagoes Galistan) is not finished with his work, because he is haunted by the death of his sister who was sold by her boyfriend to a brothel. When he was taking his friend Hendra (Chairil JM) to a brothel, he was asked for help by Rini (Ayu Yohana), who was about to escape from the brothel. He remembered his sister, and then determined to free Rini. At first, in a gentle way, dating Rini. They also fell in love with each other, while Hendra already had a girlfriend there. After being defeated repeatedly by the security of the brothel owned by Dewi Anjani (Sonny Dewantara), Bobby and Hendra managed to free their girlfriends who were forced to become residents of the brothel.

title: Sesepuh Majapahit
overview: This film is a re-edited compilation of Saur Sepuh I, Saur Sepuh II, and Saur Sepuh III.

title: Bebas Bercinta
overview: Donny and Selly return from their wedding reception, to make love at their fancy house. Soon, Selly is pregnant and sets up a nursery room. The work tires her and makes her lose the baby. Selly is in for more shocks when Donny brings Eva, her best friend, to stay at their house.

title: Bulan Tertusuk Ilalang
overview: A story about a court musician student man named Ilalang who is faced by his trauma while studying court music.

title: Pencet Sana Pencet Sini
overview: Dono, Indro and Kasino really want to have a car, but they don't have money. So the arrival of Uncle Dono, Dewo Sastro, was used to request a car. Unfortunately Dewo Sastro was very stingy, Dono's request was not granted. They don't run out of mind. With the help of his friends, Dono's kidnapping plays were arranged by real villains, Mata Satu who happened to be an acquaintance of Indro. Criminals ask for a ransom from Dewo Sastro, which is enough to buy a car. But by Mata Satu, the ransom requested is far greater than originally agreed. Dono was even kidnapped real and really would be killed if his request was not granted. But Dewo Sastro still doesn't want to redeem Dono. Forced by Kasino, Indro and his female friends tried to save Dono. Later Dewo Sastro actually presented a luxury car to Dono because he had succeeded in arresting Mata Satu.

title: Cinta Mei & June
overview: Mei and June, two best friends who are involved with the same man.

title: Dongeng Kancil untuk Kemerdekaan
overview: The film commemorates the 50th anniversary of Sukarno driving through the street in the aftermath and waving the Flag of Indonesia as he became the first President proclaiming "My nationalism is humanity".  The film investigates modern life on the street and whether early promises made by Sukarno lived up to expectations.

title: Roda-Roda Asmara di Sirkuit Sentul
overview: A love triangle between Desi, a designer, Alvin, a racer, and Novi, a female mechanic. Alvin maintains his relationship with Desi to get sponsors for his races.

title: Panther
overview: A drug dealer's gang arranges a brutal massacre in the house of the girl's relatives. But her loyal friend comes to the rescue.

title: Let in Those Who Weep - The Toraja of Sulawesi
originalTitle: Let in Those Who Weep - The Toraja of Sulawesi
overview: There is a special moment in the lives of the  that can be described by a single word: Mabadong. Toraja funerals are as they were 500 years ago. The tradition of letting into the inner circle of mourners anyone weeping for the deceased, is a ritual which brings together every rank of society. It is a huge ceremony which reinforces the social hierarchy and keeps alive the spirit of the Toraja culture. But it is also a tradition that threatens to put this people into financial ruin. This is the story of a young man who puts his family in debt, sells his parents' house and gambles the lot on cockfights, to raise the money for his grandmother's funeral and thus preserve his family's rank in the tribe.

title: Cinta dalam Misteri
overview: A ghost story originally made for television.

title: Pawang
overview: While on a hunting trip, Tias (Keke Hamzah) is bitten by a cobra. From then on out, strange and often life threatening things (being attacked by a crocodile, etc.) begin happening to both her and her boyfriend and they're pursued by a "tiger woman" (Malfin Shayna).

title: Ranjang Cinta
overview: A wife not into her husband's S&M games jumps ship and finds herself another lover.

title: Gairah Malam yang Kedua
overview: After her married lover's wife finds out about their affair, economics student Shayna (Malfin Shayna) becomes involved with a lesbian stripper, a suspected gay dance troupe leader, a smitten stalker at her college and a madam. The latter starts setting her up with men but her clients keep getting murdered by a helmet-wearing psycho brandishing a sickle.

title: Cinta Terlarang
overview: A scorned pregnant woman gets decapitated during a black magic battle with her ex-boyfriend, Andre. Her spirit then possesses the body of Andre's new girlfriend, turning her into a blood-sucking seductress.

title: Permainan Binal
overview: A bankrupt schemer tries to get his hands on a wealthy widow's money but the daughter intervenes. Meanwhile, a mysterious killer is running amok.

title: Nama Saya Selasih
overview: Highlights about the first female Indonesian novelist, Sariamin Ismail, also known as Selasih.

title: Sorgaku Nerakaku
