Finally, Kumala runs into Safi’I, who is in a taskforce aimed at eradicating illegal money lending, and he helps her to solve the problem.

title: Tjioeng Wanara
overview: Tjioeng Wanara is the man who crushes the evil king of Galuh. The revolt succeeds with the help of the people who have suffered enough. This is the first epic film in Indonesia, and its publication was considered massive during its time.

title: Wanita dan Satria
overview: Soedrajat abuses his high social status in order to womanise and becomes his rich uncle's heir despite the latter having a son, the kindly and noble Soelarsa. The uncle is disappointed with Soelarsa and considers Soedrajat the better man. Being considered high class, he is unwilling to associate with people of the lower classes. Ultimately Soedrajat falls for a beautiful young woman, Koestijah. Meanwhile, Soelarsa saves Koestijah's life while driving a truck through her village; the two fall in love at first sight. By manipulating Koestijah's father, Soedrajat arranges for her to marry him.

title: Srigala Item
overview: Mardjoeki goes missing after his wealth is taken by his brother, Djoekri. His son, Mochtar, is left behind and is treated like a slave by Djoekri. Later, The Black Jackal, a man in a mask, thwarts Djeokri's cruelty. In a chase scene between Djoekri and The Black Jackal, it turns out that Mardjoeki is still alive, and he is the man behind the mask all this time.

title: Koeda Sembrani
overview: In a story that takes place in a kingdom in the middle east. A traveler came to present a gift to the royal princess in the form of a flying horse. In the presence of the king and royal nobles, the royal crown prince tried to ride the flying horse. It flew away and never came back. The traveler was imprisoned. Apparently, the crown prince went to another kingdom and met a princess. The two of them fell in love with each other.  However, the king of another kingdom kidnapped the princess he proposed to and took her flying horse. The crown prince also came to the kingdom disguised as a shaman, managed to outwit the kidnapping king and save the princess with the help of the flying horse he had captured.

title: Panggilan Darah
overview: Two orphans try their luck in the city. They are employed by Pak Haji's family, but is ill treated by his wife. Soon they run away. It is later discovered that both orphans are actually the Haji's nephews. When they are found, they express a wish to set up an orphanage.

title: Garoeda Mas
overview: According to the artist, Nasroen AS, the story used for this film is not his work. Yet Populer Film named him on the title credits to gain publicity. And he was paid a high fee for this.

title: Matula
overview: Johan Bessey is a tycoon with two daughters, Emma and Diana. Matula (the ugly face), wants to court Emma, so he makes a pact with the shaman to make him look good in return for his soul. He almost loses his soul but Johan Bessey’s magic bamboo spear prevents this. Matula returns to his original ugly look, and his body emanates a rancid odour.

title: Boedjoekan Iblis
overview: add the plot.

title: Noesa Penida
overview: Two brothers, Jaya and I Pageh, are commoners who love Gusti Ayu Pandansari, the daughter of the King of Tabanan Bali. Since young, Pandansari was close to Jaya and Pageh, and romance grows in a triangular relationship. The only constraint is the social hierarchy or caste. Although Pandasari prefers Jaya, she finally marries Pageh instead, since she is led to believe that Jaya has died in exile.

title: Asmara Moerni
overview: The film followed a doctor who falls in love with his maid, as well as her failed romance with a fellow villager.

title: Moestika dari Djemar
overview: Djoeriah is a child movie star, born in 1932, who would later be known as Djoeriah Karno (wife of Rendra Karno). Djoeriah also co-starred in Poelo Inten.

title: Elang Darat
overview: Elang Darat, who leads a gang of robbers continuously harasses the village of Kresek. To overcome the security threat, the head of the village calls for assistance from a detective, R. Parlan.  During a raid, Parlan is injured, and is nursed by Rukmini, the village head’s daughter. Their closeness prompts jealousy in Gunawi, the adopted son of the village-head. Later, it is revealed that Gunawi is the son of R. Bardan, Parlan’s father. Parlan then must face Gunawi because he is actually the one that people call Elang Darat.

title: Pah Wongso Tersangka
overview: Pah Wongso has come under suspicion and must clear his name.

title: Bajar Dengan Djiwa
overview: The film depicts the lives of two families. There is Basuki who always puts other’s interests first, while his wife, Suryati who only thinks about herself. There is also Umar with his immoral behavior, who sells his daughter Djuliah to Asnan, a loan shark, when he is in debt. This tragedy makes Ruhiyat, Djuliah’s boyfriend, heartbroken.

title: Mega Mendoeng
overview: Kustini, the daughter of Retnaningsih and Winata, has a lover named Sujono. But Sujono betrays her. The girl is slandered and Winanta punishes her. Following his own conscience, Sujono arrives at Mega Mendung, and reunites with Kustini.

title: Aladin dengan Lampoe Wasiat
overview: Aladin, the son of a poor widow, continues living modestly although he owns the magic lamp. The lamp is only used on special occasions, such as when the Wazir commands him to. Finally, when he is threatened, Aladin uses the magic lamp to defeat the evil Wazir and inherit the kingdom’s throne.

title: Singa Laoet
overview: Menceritakan tentang perkelahian yang memakan korban jiwa sehingga salah satu harus di usir ke luar pulau. Diakhir cerita akhirnya dapat diketahui siapa sebenarnya yang menjadi pembunuh.

title: Sorga Palsoe
overview: Mrs Roti treats her first daughter Hian Nio badly. On the other hand, she treats her other daughters, as her favorites. Hian Nio has a boyfriend, Kian Bie, who works for Bian Hong. But since Bian Hong, a widower, has feelings for Hian Nio, he fires Kian Bie in order to achieve his desire. Married to a man of wealth like Bian Hong does not make Han Nio happy, so she decides to run away while leaving her child, Gin Nio, behind. This child becomes the reason why she returns, but not long after that, she dies.

title: Melati Van Agam
overview: Norma is a girl who sacrifices her personal happiness out of respect to her parents. Her lover, a poor young man named Idrus must let go of Norma when she marries a young wealthy man. Norma and ldrus are finally reunited inside the grave.

title: Zoebaida
overview: The music score in this film is performed by Oriental Novelty Five, a Hawaiian music group.

title: Kartinah
overview: Anak-anak yang dicintainya meninggal dunia. Titi menderita penyakit kurang ingatan. Suaminya Suria (Astaman) mencintai perawat Kartinah (Ratna Asmara), namun dia tidak ingin beristri dua.

title: Harta Berdarah
overview: This film reveals the darker side of human nature, when lust for wealth cause others to suffer. The story is tangled with a tragic yet beautiful romance. The film’s message is clear when the rich are finally punished by God.

title: Kedok Ketawa
overview: Minarsih (Fatimah) is rescued from four thugs by the painter Basuki (Basoeki Resobowo). They fall in love and begin planning their life together. However, a rich man interested in taking Minarsih to be his wife sends a gang to kidnap her. Basuki is unable to repel them. The Laughing Mask (Oedjang) comes to the rescue. (Soerabaijasch Handelsblad 1940).

title: Kris Mataram
overview: Featuring the clash between modern thinking against traditional conservatism, the story has the troubled romance between the noble princess, RA Rusmini, and the peasant, Bachtiar. This film ends with compromise, that there is nothing wrong with either modernity or tradition.

title: Roekihati
overview: Roekihati is a peasant girl who is married to Mansur, despite his father’s objection. Later, under the influence of his peers, Mansur is drawn to Aminah, a city girl. Roekihati, however, remains loyal to their vows and her kindness finally makes Mansur realize his error.

title: Siti Akbari
overview: Siti Akbari has a happy family life until her husband deserts her for another woman. But Siti Akbari remains unshakeable. Her devotion leads to her eventual fulfillment.

title: Dasima
overview: Winata’s preoccupation with his business causes a lot of conflict with his wife, Dasima. Eventually they end their marriage. Then Dasima becomes Samiun’s wife, who only wants Dasima’s wealth. When Samiun’s behavior gets worse, Dasima asks for a divorce. She demands for her jewelry, all of which are already gambled away by Samiun, be returned. Samiun makes a deal with Bang Puasa to get rid of Dasima. When she is cornered by Samiun and Puasa, she jumps off a bridge and dies. Later, the police arrest Samiun and Puasa.

title: Sorga Ka Toedjoe
overview: This is Roekiah's first film with her new partner, Djoemala, after her separation with Rd. Mochtar.

title: Pah Wongso Pendekar Boediman
overview: Barja falls in love with Siti, the daughter of his uncle, Haji Hartawan. However, his feelings are unrequited, and this sparks Barja’s anger. He kills Pak Haji and takes over his fortune. But Siti remains adamant. Out of frustration, Barja turns to gambling and later becomes a crime lord. Then L. V. Wijnhamer Jr. aka Pah Wongso gets into action. He makes an investigation that leads to the arrest of Barja’s gang.

title: Impian di Bali
overview: The prominent scenery of Bali is presented through the journey of a romancing couple. It also features the martial arts skill of a young woman, the tear-jerking humour of a comedian, and layered with musical elements.

title: Rentjong Atjeh
overview: Bintara is a pirate captain who sails the Malaka strait. He robs ships and murders their crews. Two children survive one of the attacks. They are Rusna and Daud. 15 years later the two become teenagers and live in the woods. There they meet the courageous Panglima Ali. At that time, Bintara is still conducting his evil deeds. But his life is ended by Panglima Ali’s blade.

title: Matjan Berbisik
overview: Follows two men who are raised as brothers and compete for the love of the same woman.

title: Gagak Item
overview: Ahmad, the son of a landlord, tried to marry Rochani in various ways. He has many bouncers who like to be cruel to the people. Meanwhile, Rochani likes Yusuf, a young man who has just worked at Ahmad's parents' company. Once, Rochani's younger brother, Dahlan, was beaten by Ahmad's men. However, Dahlan survived because someone dressed and wearing a black mask came to his aid. The black masked person called himself the Black Crow.  Black Crow then helped many people who were bullied by Ahmad and his men. When Ahmad was about to kidnap and force Rochani. The attempt failed because of the help of Black Crow, who was none other than Yusuf.

title: Alang-alang
overview: Travelling through his coconut plantation, Suhiyat, the prodigal son of a wealthy man, runs into Suyati who is being harassed by Rainan. When he helps Surati, he also inflames the jealousy of Rasmina, the widow, who is attracted to him, even though she is courted by Karta. Heartbroken, she gets Rainan to abduct Surati. But she escapes inside the woods and manages to befriend the animals. These animals are the ones who save her when Rainan's men raid the woods to take her back. Finally Suhiyat rescues Suyati. Rasmina regrets her evil deeds and returns to her former husband, Karta.

title: Roesia si Pengkor
overview: Haji Saleh is going on a pilgrimage to the sacred mountain. Meanwhile, his wife and daughter, Suti, stay behind in Tangerang. As the beauty of the village, Suti attracts a lot of young men. But Saari is the one who she is interested in. Yet, Saari faces competition from Usin. In the end, Saari emerges victorious. Later, it is revealed that the one who has been keeping Suti out of danger is none other than Pengkor, who is her own father Haji Saleh.

title: Tjiandjoer
overview: The siblings, Kim Djin and Kim Tjiang’s characters are as different as between the earth and the sky. The older of the two is lazy and spoiled by his father. On the contrary, the father, Tan Koan Liong, underestimates the hardworking and honest, Kim Tjiang. His father even throws Kim Tjiang out of the house believing in Kim Djin's slanderous gossip. But in the end, Koan Liong realizes his mistakes.

title: Fatima
overview: The people of Motaro live in prosperity. The beauty of the island, Fatima, is romantically involved with Idris, a fisherman's son. This ideal relationship is disrupted when Ali, who always boasts about his wealth, steps in. When Ali gives Fatima a ring, she forwards it to Idris instead. It is the same ring that leads the police to come to the island to capture Ali who is actually heading a gang of criminals.

title: Oh Iboe
overview: After his wife past away, Tjoa Kim Liong remarries and her daughter Loan has to live with her new step mother. Meanwhile Kim Liong is much more into gambling than taking care of his family. He delegates his business to Kian Hwat. But due to Kian Hwats dishonesty, Kim Liongs wealth falls into his lap. Later on, all of his wealth are restored thanks to the help of Goan Hin, Loans fiancé.

title: Terang Boelan
overview: Rohaya (Roekiah) must separate from her lover, Kasim (Rd Mochtar), so that she can marry her father's choice, the disreputable but rich Musa (Eddie T. Effendi). The night before the wedding, Kasim plays the song "Terang Boelan" for Rohaya, and they agree to elope. The following day, Rohaya and Kasim escape from Sawoba Island to Malacca, where Kasim begins work at a drydock and Rohaya keeps busy as a housewife. They discover that Kasim's old friend, Dullah (Kartolo), has lived in Malacca for some time.

title: Gadis jang Terdjoeal
overview: Han Nio is in love with Oey Koen Beng. But her money-hungry mother pairs her off with a young wealthy man, Lim Goan Tek, to finance her gambling debt. Han Nio and Goan Tek's marriage is not a happy one, despite having a daughter, Lin Nio. Han Nio is even kicked out after Goan Tek loses his money even though it is actually Eng Swan, Han Nio's brother, who commits the theft. Koen Beng's meets Han Nio again after he tries to help Lin Nio. But Han Nio is already ill, and soon dies. Koen Beng takes revenge for his lover's death by paying Goan Tek a visit. But Eng Swan, who also wants to take revenge for Han Nio's death, gets there first and kills Goan Tek.

title: Pareh
overview: Mahmud, a young fisherman is in love with Wagini, a farmer girl. The love story is situated in rice fields, mountains and naturally beautiful Indonesian scenery, lending it almost an anthropological quality. It is also presented with songs and sets of poetic quatrains.

title: Pembakaran Bio "Hong Lian Sie"
overview: The burning of the Hong Lian Sie temple triggers a big fight between the Kuen Luen Pai clan and Oen Kung Pa clan. The temple is filled with secret weapons and led by evildoers who are fond of abusing the weak. The story is a classic battle of good versus evil.

title: Lima Siloeman Tikoes
overview: A wife is confused after her husband turns into two indistinguishable persons. Which one is the real husband? One of her husbands is actually the manifestation of the rat demon. Luckily, the God Djie Lay steps in by sending a magic cat in the size of a tiger to wipe of all of the five rat demons.

title: Anaknja Siloeman Oeler Poeti
overview: The child feels as if he lives in a dream. He does not know who his human father is as his mother is the white snake ghost. He is often verbally and physically abused. In desperation, he runs away to seek his mother at the place where she is repenting. In his escape, he gets lost in the forest and falls into the hands of a giant monkey.

title: Pan Sie Tong
overview: The story is adapted from See Yoe's series.

title: Ang Hai Djie
overview: The story is adapted from See Yoe's series.

title: Poei Sie Giok Pa Loei Tay
originalTitle: Poei Sie Giok Pa Loei Tay
overview: Tells the story of Poei Sie Giok who was taught martial arts since he was a child, and inherits the knowledge passed down by his mother, Tjoei Hoa.

title: Tie Pat Kai Kawin
overview: The pig demon Tie Pat Kai marries a human woman. When her father drives him out, Tie kidnaps his wife and escapes. He is hunted down by two monks.

title: Suikerfreule
overview: Dirk van der Kooy returns to the Dutch East Indies for a five year stint as the administrator of a sugar factory. His second wife Betje, however, unexpectedly decides to join him. Once there, she finds out that Dirk has a daughter from an earlier marriage, leading to misunderstandings galore...

title: Ouw Peh Tjoa
overview: The white snake demon transforms into a beautiful woman when she is attracted to a man named Khouw Han Boen. The two marry. Later, Han Boen finds out that his now-pregnant wife is the white snake demon in disguise.

title: Amorira
overview: Christian mission propaganda film about 'a slice of heathen life, with the bamboo bush people of Borado-Likowali'. Keli is forced to marry Wesa but has a lover in another village. This causes war to break out between the two villages and Wesa is killed. Wesa's father Meo now wants Keli to marry his other son. Keli refuses and the hostilities continue. Just when the authorities have locked up a number of troublemakers, Father Jacobs arrives. The missionary tries to win the confidence of the locals but becomes embroiled in the conflict. An assault by Meo's men leaves him dangerously wounded. The villagers stop fighting and Meo asks the dying missionary's forgiveness.

title: Pengorbanan Karina
overview: Raden Ajeng Karina is of mixed-descent, born to a Dutch mother – who has since returned to the Netherlands – and Javanese father. She lives in the palace at Yogyakarta and must integrate herself with the majority Javanese society. In doing so she wears traditional clothes such as the kebaya. She later becomes involved in a love triangle with a foreign representative stationed in the city and his wife.

title: Njai Dasima
overview: This film is the first talking picture made by Tan's Film.

title: Melati Van Agam (I dan II)
overview: The story that resembles Romeo and Juliet takes place in West Sumatera. Norma's beauty has her known as Melati van Agam (the Jasmine of Agam). She falls in love with Idrus, and the feeling is mutual. Without any knowledge of the lovers, Norma’s parents accepts Nazarudin’s proposal for marriage. Nazarudin is a rich man. After she gets married, Norma is taken to Kota Raja (Banda Aceh). Sometime later, Idrus falls ill and passed away at Fort de Kock (Bukit Tinggi). But Nazarudin's suspicion does not end there. He alleges the baby that Norma is carrying is Idrus' child. This allegation makes Norma ashamed. She commits suicide and is laid to rest next to Idrus's grave.

title: Sinjo "Tjo" Main Di Film
overview: This film is an extra from Indonesia Malaise. Ida Schilling is a radio singer. She sings keroncong and stambul songs.

title: Indonesia Malaise
overview: A woman, who already has a lover, is forced to marry someone else. Tragedy then piles up when the husband has an affair, their baby dies and her former lover goes to prison. The woman falls ill due to her suffering and yearning for her former lover. When she is about to die, the lover that she has been longing for appears. This gripping moment is interrupted by jokes made by Oemar, the comedian. The woman's illness is cured when she hears actor M.S. Ferry sing keroncong songs. The film ends with a scene of Oemar courting the maid on top of a rubber tree.

title: Sam Pek Eng Tay
overview: This fatal love story is about a girl, Giok Eng Tay and a young man, Nio Sam Pek. Eng Tay's father, Giok Kong Wan is an official whose position has led him to marry his daughter to Ma Bun Cai, the son of a rich regent. The romantic tie between Sam Pek and Eng Tay is severed. Then Sam Pek is abused by Kong Wan's men, and dies. On their way to Bun Cai's house, the bride's entourage makes a stopover at Sam Pek's grave. The grave suddenly opens, and Eng Tay jumps into Sam Pek's grave.

title: Boenga Roos dari Tjikembang
overview: Oh Ay Cheng, who works on a plantation, has to turn away Marsiti, his faithful lover, for the sake of following his father’s command that he marries Gwat Nio, the daughter of his plantation boss. Marsiti herself persuades Ay Cheng to obey his father. Marsiti then leaves and passes away. Gwat Nio’s father reveals his secret; that Marsiti is his mistress's daughter. From Ay Cheng and Gwat Nio's marriage, Hoey Eng or Lily is born. She grows into a beautiful girl. She is engaged to Sim Bian Koen, the son of Tjikembang's plantation owner.

title: Terpaksa Menika
overview: A young Indonesian intellectual falls in love with a woman. Although she loves him, she is told to marry an older man, one who has gone on the hajj. Ultimately they are able to be together.

title: Atma De Vischer
overview: This documentary film describes the journey of Queen Olanda and King Hertog in the city of Den Hagg.

title: Si Pitoeng
overview: Pitoeng is the original Batavian champion whose popularity draws from lenong folk performances. People believe that the Rawabelong champion has the ability to “disappear” because he always manages to escape the pursuit of Dutch police. He is perceived as the local version of Robin Hood: who only robs the rich to give to the poor.

title: Java
overview: Amateur colour film of Java taken by E. Wilhelmina Ness showing Batavia (now Jakarta), Mount Papandayan, Kawah Kamojang and Borobodur temple.

title: Lari Ka Arab
overview: The humorous story told by Halimoen's film production about life was difficult during the malaise, when the Dutch East Indies was hit by the economic depression that hit the whole world. The film humorously depicts the life that went awry from the main character. At home it is wrong, going out is wrong, this is wrong, so wrong. So he decided to just run away to Mecca. But with a cynical intent, that there may only be a peaceful life because it will only worship, not thinking about the economy.  Originally the title was Lari Ka Mecca, because it was forbidden by the film commissie, this is because the name Mecca is a holy place for Muslims that cannot be played with. So the title was changed to Lari Ka Arab, to keep it attractive.

title: Njai Dasima (II)
overview: Dasima's remorse worsens after she leaves her husband and her 8-year-old daughter, Nancy. Samiun’s first wife, Hayati, who is a heavy gambler, squanders all of Dasima’s wealth. Dasima plans to tell her former master about the ill-treatment that she has been receiving from her current husband, Samiun. Samiun panics. He asks Bang Puasa to kill Dasima. Based on a witness account, Bang Puasa and Samiun are arrested. The killer goes to prison while Samiun is sentenced with banishment.

title: Njai Dasima (III) - Nancy Bikin Pembalesan
overview: Edward William returns to the Dutch Indies after his stay in Europe to manage a plantation in Banten area. He is accompanied by his daughter from Dasima, Nancy. Upon his arrival in Batavia, she receives news that Samiun (Dasima's murderer) has served his sentence and is coming back. Nancy dreams of meeting Dasima who asks her to take revenge on Samiun and his wife, Hayati. Eventually, Samiun falls over a cliff and Hayati is stabbed by her own knife.

title: Si Ronda
overview: A story of a hero from Betawi (local utterance of Batavia, now known as Jakarta), not unlike other stories, such as Si Jampang and Si Pitung.

title: De Stem de Bloed
overview: De Stem des Bloeds, also known as Njai Siti, is a 1930 film from the Dutch East Indies. It was directed by Ph. Carli and starred Annie Krohn, Sylvain Boekebinder, Vally Lank, and Jan Kruyt. The film follows a man and his mistress who reunite after their son and step-daughter unwittingly fall in love.

title: Karnadi Anemer Bangkong

Namun saat Sardiri melaporkannya pada program “Lapor Petugas, Langsung Gas”. Bukannya mendapat perlindungan, Sardiri justru melewati peristiwa yang mengantarkannya pada pintu bahaya.

title: Sepuluh
overview: A young girl goes missing during a game of hide-and-seek, forcing her busy parents to search for her before it is too late.

title: Undefined Spaces
overview: A young man journeys alone through roads, crowds, and quiet places, searching for a sense of belonging. Told through imagery and original music, the film explores isolation, disconnection, and acceptance.

title: Fit In
overview: For Kirana (17), moving to a new city no longer feels like an adventure, but a burden that slowly erases her memory of what it means to have a home. Left isolated by her parents’ blind pursuit of their careers, she has grown accustomed to forcing herself into social circles by copying everything she observes. Kirana memorizes speech patterns, takes up foreign hobbies, and buys the exact same items as her peers just to avoid being seen as an outsider. Yet, when she finally sets aside this crafted "mask" to reveal her true self, she is met only with awkward glances and receding footsteps. Does getting to know the real Kirana mean loving her less?

title: Jendela
overview: Bimo and his father had just allowed going home by train after doing Bimo’s surgery. On the train, they just realized that their relationship is not like other father-son-relationship. Theirs feels just like a formality, which is written in the family card. In fact, they made a boundary between them and it felt awkward. Some words were spoken if they’re needed to. In his silence, Bapak (Father) couldn’t hide his guilt until Bimo saw a piece of paper in the rucksack.

title: PAKARYAN
overview: Di tengah pembangunan sebuah proyek besar, Arief, seorang insinyur muda yang bekerja di lingkungan proyek, perlahan menyadari bahwa dunia yang ia jalani tidak hanya berbicara tentang pekerjaan dan pembangunan, tetapi juga tentang kepentingan, kekuasaan, serta kompromi yang terus bergerak di dalamnya.  Di balik suara mesin, debu, dan struktur yang terus dibangun, terdapat manusia-manusia dengan kepentingan, rahasia, serta cara bertahannya masing-masing. Lingkungan proyek yang semula tampak biasa perlahan berubah menjadi ruang yang memperlihatkan bagaimana sistem bekerja, menekan, dan membentuk orang-orang di dalamnya.  Diadaptasi dari novel Orang-Orang Proyek karya Ahmad Tohari, “Pakaryan” adalah potret tentang pembangunan, kuasa, dan manusia-manusia yang perlahan menyadari bahwa tidak semua hal yang dibangun benar-benar berdiri di atas sesuatu yang utuh.

title: Tilas Kapitayan
overview: Seven people climbed Mount Lawu on Friday night to explore the various myths that circulate among climbers. Setting out via the Candi Cetho trail, their journey began, but it did not go as they had expected.  Through this journey, Tilas Kapitayan seeks to examine how myths, suggestions, and beliefs take root in people’s experiences while on Mount Lawu.

title: Tetangga Masa Gitu?
overview: Adapted from TV series named “Tetangga Masa Gitu?”

title: Nyaah
overview: Yati (60) visits her pregnant daughter-in-law Putri (24) and immediately criticizes her over the messy house. Yati keeps calling her a lazy wife and blames her for her husband's frequent absences. Putri finally breaks down, revealing that her husband, Yati's own son, is an alcoholic who has abandoned her. Frustrated, Putri grabs a knife, threatening to kill herself and her baby.

title: Buwuh
overview: Thole dan Bu Sumarsih travels by motorcycle to attend an event in the village. Their trip opens up many conversations when the main road is blocked.

title: LUNAS!

title: Batak, Perjalanan ke Tanah Leluhur
overview: Batak, a Pilgrimage to Ancestor's Land follows the origins of Batak civilisation in Sumatra, and asks what its values mean to Batak people today. The film premiered inside the exhibition Batak: Perjalanan ke Tanah Leluhur at Galeri Foto Jurnalistik Antara, Jakarta, in December 2012.

title: Begu Ganjang
overview: There is no phenomenon that Tobi, a young doctor, can explain about the supernatural phenomena that occur around him. Medically, through his YouTube channel, he can reveal what really happens when people are possessed, crushed, and even see apparitions. For him, the ghost emerged from people's ignorance of the serious disease that infected them. Tobi refuses to believe in mystical beliefs.

title: PRESUMED DEAD
overview: When a suspected domestic violence case takes a horrifying turn, homicide detectives Ringgo and Linda find themselves confronting something the world has never encountered before: the dead coming back to life.  As the investigation spirals beyond anything they could have imagined, the two detectives are forced to separate.  Fighting for survival on separate fronts, both detectives uncover the horrifying reality behind a case that is no longer just about death.

title: Diary Pramugari: Seks, Cinta & Kehidupan
overview: The story is about a flight attendant from Solo named Jingga who, for some reason, has come to hate men. Jingga is close friends with two fellow flight attendants—Anya and Puri—who each have their own unique personalities. The three of them share their joys, sorrows, and secrets about their jobs.

title: The Killer Teacher
overview: Samuel, the son of a politician working undercover as a restaurant employee, wants to distance himself from his family's status. He works alongside his girlfriend, Chelsea, who struggles to pay her younger sibling's school fees. When Chelsea receives a suspicious invitation for a promotional model job at a hotel, Samuel drives her there. After a man attempts to assault Chelsea, Samuel and the attacker get into a fatal fight, leaving the man dead.  Turning Samuel into a fugitive making media headlines, his politician father gives him a plane ticket to NTT with a false address, claiming an uncle will meet him. Abandoned at the wrong location, Samuel ends up in a remote coastal village with no electricity or infrastructure. There, he rescues an elderly woman, Grandma Marni, from a pickpocket and starts a new life under the identity of Neo.

title: Pacar Mama, Kekasih Papa
overview: Two teenage best friends, Icha and Dea, face a dilemma when their parents plan to remarry. Unaware that their parents’ prospective spouses are related, the two girls fight against these plans. The situation becomes complicated when they finally discover that Icha’s mother is going to marry Dea’s father, causing a rift between them.  They must learn to overcome their prejudices and anger, as well as understand their parents’ motivations, in order to restore their friendship and accept the new family that will be formed.

title: Ciak, Ciak, Ciak!
overview: As an only child in a Chinese-Indonesian family where eating together was a ritual, Feli was raised with abundant love from her father. However, as she grew older, her differing perspectives began to clash.

title: Negeri Fatamorgana
overview: The presidential election in the Land of Fatamorgana is about to take place. Langit (Panji Zoni), a young man living in the village, realizes that something unusual is happening in his village in connection with the upcoming election. He plans to prevent these events from unfolding so that a fair and honest election can be held in his village. Nawang (Angel Lisandi), an influencer, and Nayla (Ditha Samantha), a political activist, are fighting together to campaign for honest and clean elections for the future of Fatamorgana, amidst the widespread dishonesty that is currently taking place and will continue to occur, even at the village level.

title: 가시고기

Namun, tuntutan keluarga dan lingkungan membuat keinginannya untuk sekadar bermain menjadi hambatan terbesar dalam hidupnya.

Di tengah keterbatasan, ia berjuang menggalang keadilan melalui tulisan — tanpa menyadari bahwa perlawanannya memicu ancaman gelap yang mengintai keluarganya jauh di desa.

title: Gurda Gurdi
overview: Gurda Gurdi bercerita tentang seorang perempuan muda yang hidup dalam trauma setelah mengalami kekerasan seksual. Ia terus dihantui rasa takut dan ingatan masa lalu, hingga sulit membedakan kenyataan dan halusinasi.  Di tengah kondisi itu, ia merasakan kehadiran sosok misterius bernama “Gurda-Gurdi”, yang menjadi simbol amarah dan dorongan untuk melawan.  Cerita ini terinspirasi dari budaya Karo dan berkaitan dengan tradisi tarian Gundala, yang memperkuat nuansa mistis dalam film.  Seiring waktu, trauma yang ia rasakan berubah menjadi keberanian yang gelap, membuatnya harus memilih: tetap menjadi korban atau melawan dengan cara yang berbahaya.  Film ini menggambarkan perjuangan batin, luka, dan usaha seseorang untuk menemukan kembali dirinya.

title: Bulan di Langit-Langit
overview: Mengikuti satu malam seorang remaja pecandu narkoba yang berusaha mengamini sisa-sisa harapannya, tepat saat sebuah keputusan kejam membawanya kembali pada trauma masa lalu yang memaksa ia menghadapi riuh batinnya sendiri.

title: Holy Mother
overview: A trans woman discovers she is mysteriously pregnant. Shunned by society, she flees to her submerged hometown to make sense of the impossible and reconnect with the spirit of her lost twin, where memory, nature, and body begin to merge.

title: Na Willa 2
overview: A sequel to Na Willa (2026).

title: Aku Melihat Tuhan
overview: Naomi merasa kehilangan arah setelah suaminya meninggal. Ia mempertanyakan imannya. Dalam keadaan kelelahan, ia menemukan sesuatu yang tak terduga.

title: Positif +
overview: POSITIVE + mengisahkan John, seorang pria muda yang terdiagnosis HIV setelah terjerat dunia malam dan seks bebas. Kehidupannya terjun bebas ke jurang rasa bersalah, depresi, dan isolasi. Pertemuannya dengan Susan—seorang PSK yang dulu dekat dengannya—berubah menjadi konfrontasi brutal yang makin menghancurkan. Diwarnai muntah, amukan, paranoia, hingga tubuh yang akhirnya membusuk di dalam koper, Positive + adalah drama psikologis yang menghantam batin, mentah, dan tanpa kompromi.

title: The Devil in Connection
overview: Sekelompok filmmaker Banten yang berjumlah lima orang tengah membuat film dokumenter tentang kritikan terhadap pemerintah. Namun di tengah proses pembuatan film dokumenter tersebut, mereka dihadapkan dengan beberapa tragedi mengerikan yang berkaitan dengan hal-hal mistis di Banten. Karena tanpa disadari, mereka semua telah terkoneksi dengan sesosok iblis yang mengincar nyawa mereka satu per satu.

title: Dikejar sugus - Short Horror Movie
overview: Seorang remaja pecandu alkohol bernama Dimas dihantui oleh manifestasi mengerikan ayahnya yang telah meninggal—sosok mayat hidup dengan gergaji mesin yang terus memburunya. Malam berubah menjadi perkelahian brutal dan penuh darah, sementara batas antara realitas dan halusinasi mulai runtuh. Di balik kekerasan tersebut, tersembunyi konflik metaforis: pertarungan batin antara rasa bersalah, kehancuran diri, dan kemungkinan untuk berubah.  Film pendek ini diproduksi secara independen tanpa naskah konvensional, mengandalkan improvisasi sebagai pendekatan utama. Seluruh proses—dari penyutradaraan, pengambilan gambar menggunakan perangkat mobile, hingga editing, sound design, efek visual, dan makeup—ditangani oleh satu filmmaker dalam waktu satu minggu, bersama para pemeran dari kalangan pelajar SMA.

title: Rantemas
overview: This film tells the story of a site in Gunung Kidul that was used as an execution ground for people accused of being PKI members in 1965, as well as for gali (repeat offenders/ex-convicts) during the 1980s.

As he follows two contrasting young voices, an idealistic activist and a wealthy DJ who treats activism as image making, Arka becomes increasingly consumed by the blurred line between truth, performance, and exploitation in his pursuit of a powerful story.

title: Unseen Tapes
overview: A student in her last year of college journals her life through recordings on her webcam and is kept on a drive labelled "Unseen Tapes". As each video file plays and loads, the images of her life start to corrupt under stress and malwares.

title: WAVES THAT SHAPE US — Senggigi Beach
originalTitle: WAVES THAT SHAPE US — Senggigi Beach
overview: At Senggigi Beach in Lombok, a surfing competition brings together young surfers from across Indonesia. Amid crashing waves, competitive tension, and the support of their families, they learn to face fear, build courage, and discover their own identity.  Waves That Shape Us is a portrait of a new generation of Indonesian surfers and of how the ocean, the waves, and the community shape their character and their future.

Sementara itu, Pak Kholik, ustadz yang hendak menguburkan "kulup" , justru mengalami insiden kocak dan membingungkan di sepanjang perjalanan. Perjalanan mereka berlanjut ke masjid, tempat kesalahpahaman muncul. Pak Kholik meletakkan bungkusan "kulup" di tempat wudhu, lalu Pak Yanto, marbot masjid, mengira barang itu hendak dicuri sehingga ia menyimpannya di lemari. Masalah tambah pelik ketika Pak Yanto terburu-buru pulang, menitip pesan kepada Pak Yudi. Saat dicari, lemari terkunci. dan kuncinya justru terbawa Pak Yudi tanpa disadari.

One day, he attempted suicide again, but his attention was diverted by a mysterious book about soul resurrection. Despite the fact that it goes against the nature of this world, he deemed the method permissible in order to be reunited with his mother. But can he succeed? Or will he be the one to meet his end?

title: SANDWIC(S)H
overview: Andin, a woman who has reached the lowest point in her life. Every day, Andin works tirelessly selling sandwiches to support her family. Andin, who also plays two roles at once, a dutiful daughter and a patient mother, never complains and has no place to rest. However, that day was different. Behind the quiet of their simple home, emotions erupted one by one, the limits of patience cracked, and tragedy struck without warning.

title: Jemur-jemur Baju Kering Kerontang Nasibku
overview: Mr. Lukas, a deaf traveling tailor in a small village, unintentionally receives a wrong delivery from one of his customers, Mrs. Siti. Wanting to return the item a piece of intimate clothing he is spotted by Mrs. Siti's neighbor, who misinterprets his intentions. What begins as a simple act of kindness quickly spirals into suspicion and public humiliation. As gossip spreads, Mr. Lukas becomes the target of harsh accusations, unable to defend himself against the villagers’ judgment due to his disability. In a world that claims to be understanding, he learns how easily silence can be mistaken for guilt.

title: Diantara Jeda
overview: Bagi Lana, perpustakaan sekolah bukan sekadar tempat membaca, melainkan satu-satunya ruang untuk bernapas sebelum ia harus kembali ke rumahnya yang penuh tekanan. Di sana, ia terbiasa dengan kehadiran Arsen, asisten perpustakaan pendiam yang selalu menyelipkan pesan serupa di setiap buku yang ia pinjam: “Baca pelan-pelan, jangan sampai ada yang terlewat.”  Awalnya, Lana menganggap rutinitas lambat Arsen hanyalah sebuah keanehan. Namun, ketika Arsen lulus dan suasana perpustakaan berubah menjadi serba cepat dan modern, Lana mulai merasakan ada sesuatu yang hilang. Melalui sebuah catatan lama yang tertinggal, Lana akhirnya menyadari bahwa di balik keheningan itu, seseorang telah dengan sengaja memperlambat waktu untuknya—memberikan jeda yang ia butuhkan di dunia yang menuntutnya untuk terus berlari.

title: Nak, Kamu gapapa, ‘kan?

Ditekan oleh tradisi keluarganya yang tak terucapkan, ia menyiapkan semangkuk hidangan istimewa untuk pria yang ia cintai sebuah sajian yang diam-diam akan menentukan apakah kesetiaan lebih kuat daripada cinta.

title: Dompet Ayah Sepatu Ibu
overview: Set against the socio-economic landscape of West Sumatra, two working-class adolescents wage a relentless campaign against systemic poverty, enduring grueling labor to break the cycle of generational destitution for the sake of their future descendants.

title: The Man from Nowhere
overview: For the past decade, Jian has lived in hiding in Jakarta, a reclusive man once known as one of the city’s most feared enforcers before tragedy erased his family and past. When a fearless young girl from his neighborhood is abducted by a powerful criminal network, Jian is forced back into the city’s violent underworld, confronting old enemies and unleashing a relentless fury to save her and destroy the world that took everything from him — this time with nothing left to lose.

title: 38 The Last Swing
overview: Arum mengumpulkan 38 bola golf bekas demi membayar biaya kegiatan PLS (Pendidikan Luar Sekolah). Namun, tepat di bola ke-38, sebuah pukulan melayang dari kaum borjuis menghancurkan mimpinya, sebuah ironi tragis yang mengakhiri perjuangannya seketika.

title: Sri
overview: Sri is a symbol of rice fields or the embodiment of Sri Pohaci Larasati, better known as Dewi Sri. When people sold their rice fields to build houses and buildings, Sri felt uneasy, afraid that the villagers would lose their livelihoods and no longer care for the rice fields. This is especially true when Kohar, the village head, is approached by a businessman who offers him a large sum of money to sell the communal rice fields in his village to build a hotel. KOHAR (50) must make a decision. On the table is a brown suitcase filled with money given to him by INDRA (40), a Chinese investor who offers change. If he wanted his village to progress, he had to sell the kabuyutan rice fields to INDRA, who promised significant economic change after the village had been devastated by the pandemic.

title: Caput Mortuum
overview: Three days after her grandchild’s passing, Nana attempts to contact Maryam, longing to see the child one final time before the burial.

title: Belom Ada Judulnya

title: Main Kayu
overview: Main Kayu depicts a conflict over land and teak forests between villagers and the Indonesian state, represented by Perum Perhutani. The film traces the roots of this bloody struggle to reveal how main kayu—literally “playing with wood,” meaning both stealing timber and wielding violence—defines both sides of the fight. It questions who gets to decide what “the state” means, and who truly owns the land, the forest, and the people within them. Echoing Samin Surosentiko’s words—“The earth, the water, the wood belong to all”—the unfinished 54-minute film (circa 2006–2007) endures as a haunting reflection on power and ownership.

The establishment of indigenous schools and youth patrols serves as a means of regenerating the community. Knowledge about customary structures and their functions must be passed down to strengthen their land rights. The harmonious life of Papuan communities is reflected in their economic transactions through the trade of agricultural products such as vegetables, fruits, and fish in local markets. Mengikuti jejak tinta dan arsip personal petani aktivis Cece Jaelani, Kian Melekati Titik Didih menelusuri bagaimana amarah kolektif mengeras menjadi nasib yang diwariskan, berujung pada satu tindakan purba: warga memohon agar gunung itu sendiri memuntahkan isi perutnya.

title: (Ab)Surd
overview: Kegilaan Seseorang meledak hingga tak terbaca

title: Piala Emas
overview: Plot unknown

title: Sukses Jaya
overview: Follow the journey of Iman, a construction worker from Malang who has been working in Jakarta for five years and is obsessed with turning his life around to become successful. Together with his friends Sutris and Kojek, he accepts an offer from Boim, a shifty broker, to work on a statue construction project. However, the project—with its meager budget and impossible deadline—drags Iman into trouble until he is made the scapegoat.  Caught up in his ambition, Iman gradually becomes selfish and loses the trust of those closest to him, including Windy, the woman he loves. In his solitude, Iman then tries to prove his innocence and rediscover the true meaning of success.

title: Diari Merah: Bayangan Terakhir
overview: Ketika Teresa tanpa sengaja menemukan Diari Merah, ia terseret ke dalam jejak kelam seorang penyihir bernama Oravan—pewaris terakhir garis keturunan Thamurak yang berusaha melanjutkan ambisi leluhurnya. Bersama Fernando, Teresa harus menghadapi masa lalu yang terlupakan sekaligus mengungkap rahasia di balik Diari Magis sebelum kegelapan bangkit kembali.

title: Asa Putus Asa
overview: Feeling desperate due to the difficulty of finding a job, Asa followed Esim's invitation to claim the two and a half percent they believed was their rightful ownership.

title: Peserta Kerja Bakti
overview: Surya is compelled to return to his village after failing to secure a job in the city. He takes on the responsibility of managing his deceased grandmother's shop. Due to financial pressures, he reluctantly accepts embezzled money from a friend and is subsequently accused of practicing black magic by the villagers.

title: Suloh
overview: A mother argues in front of community leaders during a village trial. The trial asks the family to be responsible and pay compensation for their negligence in caring for their child with special needs.

title: The End of Limboto Lake
overview: Lake Limboto as a habitat for endemic fish species, has shown a drastic decline in fish populations. Despite the ecological crisis, Ais remains determined to continue his life as a fisherman. His unwavering spirit remains unbroken, and he is confident that he can still make a living from the lake.

title: Melati: Balas dendam Dalam Darah
overview: The sole escapee of a haunted house, Fadil discovers that he has been cursed by Melati, who harnesses the inn’s dark curse, and in return gains eternal life and the power of resurrection. In a quest for vengeance, Fadil assembles a squad of killers to hunt down those responsible for his torment. However, as Fadil learns more about the inn’s resurrective powers, he is consumed by his desire to bring back his wife and consequently, a violent battle ensues.

title: Sayap-Sayap Patah 3
overview: Third installment of Broken Wings trilogy. Plot TBA.

title: Painted Laws
overview: Ester an eighteen years old girl who lives in the Nainggolan village around Toba lakes in Medan, goes about her daily routine until she met with a strange man Raja (M/24). Raja is the brother of one of the local girls who is her acquaintance, which just moved back to the village after a long time being away. The two unintentionally fell in love with each other although knowing that it was forbidden due to their family background. Ester and Raja lives in a village which is still strong with their cultural influences and one of it is the people with the same Marga cannot marry, Ester and Raja coming from the same Marga is now in trouble. Knowing that they cannot be together and live in that village, they decided to run away together. Unfortunately, as they were planning it, the local residents attacked the house they were in and they were punished accordingly. Which in the case of their culture is to be tied up to a post for an unknown period of time.

title: Bangkit dari Kubur
overview: Dari dalam tanah, Soekarno bangkit kembali. Kembali, bukan untuk berkuasa, tapi untuk menyaksikan langsung negeri yang pernah ia perjuangkan. Dengan setelan jas lusuh dan tubuh berdebu, ia berjalan di tengah pasar, di antara percakapan rakyat kecil yang getir namun jenaka. Di sana, ia berhadapan dengan realitas kontemporer yang absurd, mengenaskan, sekaligus menggelikan

title: Serete Sarine
overview: Hamzah (24) travels to Belitung to relive his childhood memories, but he gets lost after his phone breaks. By chance, he meets Ros (22), who claims to be his childhood friend. Together with Ros, he embarks on an adventure to various places, eventually rediscovering the Bedulang tradition he had long forgotten.

title: Salted Fish
overview: Rini, seorang remaja sekaligus salah satu murid di tempat pengajian yang ada di kompleksnya. Pada awalnya, Rini menikmati kegiatan belajar mengaji di tempat pengajiannya dan tidak menyangka bahwa ustad yang ia hormati akan melakukan pelecehan seksual. Bukannya mendapatkan dukungan, Rini justru disalahkan oleh orang-orang di sekitarnya yang mengibaratkannya seperti kucing tergoda ikan asin. Dalam keadaan tersudut dan tidak berdaya, akankah Rini tetap diam atau mencari keadilan atas tindakan ustad dan mereka yang menyalahkannya?

title: But U Fly
overview: Altar, a young boy with a deep passion for art, lives with his father who forbids him from pursuing art school. As he struggles between his dreams and his father’s disapproval, a buried past slowly resurfaces — one that holds the key to his father's hidden trauma.

title: Rika
overview: Kala (27), pelukis penyendiri yang obsesif, terobsesi menyelesaikan mahakarya terakhirnya dengan warna merah yang “hidup.” Ia mengundang Rika (26), pacarnya yang ceria, untuk menjadi model. Namun, ketika obsesinya memuncak dan Rika tanpa sengaja merusak lukisannya, batas antara cinta dan kegilaan pun kabur dan darah menjadi warna terakhir dalam karyanya.

title: DALANG
overview: Deon merupakan siswa baru yang mencoba untuk mencari tahu apa yang membuat Lili hilang. Ia mencari petunjuk, menggali isu-isu yang tersebar dan menemukan hal-hal mencurigakan yang mengarah pada sesuatu hal yang lebih besar dari sekedar hilangnya seorang siswi, Deon harus berhadapan dengan berbagai pihak yang ingin menutupi kebenarannya, akankah Deon berhasil mengungkapkan siapa dalang di balik misteri ini.

title: Buncah di Padang Hijau
overview: Di sebuah padang hijau setelah kehidupan, Fatimah dan Hani—dua wanita dengan busana yang berbeda—berbincang tentang luka masa lalu, pengampunan, dan keadilan Ilahi, hingga perdebatan mereka memuncak saat Hani dihadapkan pada keberadaan seseorang dari masa lalunya yang kelam.

title: Berdiri; Pergi
overview: Protagonis tinggal di sebuah rumah terbengkalai, pagi itu Ia bangun dari ranjangnya. Perasaan yang tak nyaman dikarenakan mengalami depresi membuat ia mulai menceritakan pengalamannya dengan rasisme.Protagonis memikirkan perbedaan kecil seperti warna kulit dapat menilai harga diri manusia. Protagonis mulai berangan-angan bagaimana dunia tanpa rasisme.Disaat Protagonis melepas angannya,Ia masuk ke dalam ruangan gelap dimana suara teriakan dan mohonnya bergema.Protagonis keluar dari ruangan dengan kursi dan tali. Protagonis melanjutkan aksinya dengan menyiapkan tempat dan alat untuk Ia bunuh diri.Protagonis pun menggantung diri.Namun, tidak diduga,sang Protagonist tidak mati.Ia mulai berjalan keluar menuju sebuah cahaya.

title: Expedisi
overview: A group of students who run an event organizer business, but fail and go bankrupt. Finally, the students who almost dropped out decided to change direction to become documentaries about supernatural things.

title: BATIKSLOT THE GUACOR
overview: Batikslot merupakan move ber genre petualangan yang berkisahkan seorang anak muda yang mencoba keberuntungan bermain permainan slot dan seketika ia bisa mendapatkan kekayaan secara instan dari permainan tersebut dan di dalam film memiliki 4 orang pemain inti yaitu andi sebagai aktor utama, lisa sebagai aktor ke 2, udin aktor ke 3 dan faisal aktor ke 4

title: Adak Engkot
overview: Aidil, remaja dari Pulau Maratua yang bersiap mewarisi usaha budidaya ikan kerapu milik ayahnya, Jahin. Di tengah tantangan alam dan tekanan keluarga, Aidil tumbuh dari seorang anak menjadi rekan kerja sang ayah. Film ini adalah potret kedewasaan, warisan, dan ikatan ayah-anak di tengah laut yang terus berubah.

title: SUMPAH SARAPAH
overview: Andre and his two friends visit his grandfather who is sick in Guntur village. The village once had a very terrible curse. They need to be careful not to break it. Unfortunately, there is one rule that they break, which causes the curse of the oath to happen again in the village.

title: Menara Terkutuk
overview: Provoked by the horror content from the Steps Devils account, four teenagers from the same school, Dimas, Fandy, Elsa, and Intan, decided to sneak into the Khadra Tower, a building that has been abandoned for over a decade and has left behind a number of scary stories, such as urban legends, in the community surrounding it. They were also tempted to create content inside the Khadra Tower and wanted to go viral like Steps Devils. But as they were about to enter the building, Intan refused and eventually went home with the agreement that she would pick up her friends. But that night was the last night Intan saw Dimas, Fandy, and Elsa. The three of them never left the Green Tower again.

title: Birds of a Feather
overview: Based on the characters of The Shadow Strays.

title: 20 Tahun
overview: A funeral. A cremation. An attempt to articulation. To (fail to) purge. Flipping the image on the burning, destruction and violence decades ago, the filmmaker documents a funeral and cremation she held for the ethnic hate still spoken to her 20 years later. Can memories be erased? What can we choose to forget? What continues to haunt us?

overview: A man deeply in love with his wife. When death takes her from him, he shows his unwavering dedication by making sacrifices to bring her happiness, even if it means taking an unexpected path.

Mendekati hari ulang tahun, Abi terus memberikan kode kepada Mira, hingga berniat membuat roti ulang tahunnya sendiri. Film ini menceritakan tentang harapan, cinta, dan kebahagiaan yang sederhana.

title: A Cup of Love
overview: A 22-year-old young man, Jake, is captivated and falls in love with Niki, the owner of his favorite café. He soon realizes that Niki is mute. In an effort to get closer to her, Jake decides to learn sign language to show his sincerity in getting to know her.

overview: A delivery potion boy named Suro in the Majapahit Era is trying to save her sister's life by smuggling and stealing their potion that is worth more than his own life

title: Soul of Moscow (Душе Москвы)
overview: The film tells the story of a man trapped in his own thoughts, so detached from the outside world that he struggles to truly live. One day, a strange phenomenon occurs—his body begins changing into unusual colors, which turn out to reflect the city of Moscow. This forces him to explore the city, leading him to confront his own mind and gain a new understanding of himself.

title: KEJEK
overview: Nyaneut merupakan tradisi masyarakat sunda khusus nya warga Cigedug Kab.Garut, yaitu meminum teh sebelum melakukan aktivitas dipagi hari. Tradisi ini sudah dilakukan sejak jaman dahulu guna menghangatkan tubuh karena cuaca di kaki gunung cikuray yang sangat dingin. Teh yang di gunakan untuk nyaneut yaitu teh Kejek, teh yang proses pembuatan nya yang masih tradisional dengan cara di injak-injak guna mengeluarkan semua getah dari pucuk teh dan menghasilkan aroma yang khas.

Upacara Ngalaksa biasanya dilaksanakan selama 7 hari, 7 minggu, dimulai dari panen hingga padi dibawa ke goah (lumbung) kemudian dilanjutkan dengan lisung hingga diolah menjadi laksa (olahan tepung beras) sambil diiringi dengan permainan alat musik tarawangsa.

Trapped in the past and haunted by Pocong and Kuntilanak, they struggle to find a way back to 2025.

overview: Rinjani ingin pergi ke akhirat dengan tenang, namun dia terjebak di dunia karena suaminya belum bisa merelakannya.

title: Tamu Tak Diundang
overview: Mila, a geriatric nurse, has been fired from the nursing home where she worked. Bimo (Roy Sungkono), Mila’s boyfriend, is a young man who works at a cell phone credit kiosk. One day, Bimo runs into his old friend Ranty (Agnes Naomi Shivapriya). Ranty needs a caregiver for her mother, since she’ll be in Singapore for two weeks. Bimo passes this offer on to Mila. Since it’s only a two-week job, Ranty offers a very attractive salary. Mila agrees to take care of Ranty’s mother, Anggini (Dayu Wijanto). However, it turns out that Anggini suffers from schizophrenia and dementia. Those two weeks in the house feel like an eternity, as Mila is terrorized by all sorts of strange occurrences that even threaten her life.

With a single click, he loses his wealth and hopes, realizing that unchecked ambition can destroy everything. "The Rush That Misses" is a poignant tale that serves as a stark reminder of the dangers of the digital world and hasty decisions.

Seventeen years later, Adrian and Kemala go through a divorce, and Raska reappears. Raska has terminal cancer and only have months, or even weeks, to live. He tells them that he has always love Kemala away on a trip, just the two of them. Adrian refuses this absurd idea, but Kemala is determined to go. Out of jealousy, Adrian follows them to South Korea, where a secret of Kemala's past is revealed.

title: Kamu Adalah Aku
overview: The meeting between Diana and Romeo evolved into a sweet relationship. Romeo, who comes from a dysfunctional family, feels that Diana's presence is a remedy for him. Not only because Diana is a psychologist, but also because she is the one who can truly understand him. However, the death of Pram, Romeo's father, nearly shattered their relationship due to the emergence of a woman from Romeo's past named Yasmin.

overview: Farhan, feminine Indonesian teen who is a K-Pop cover dancer in Makassar struggles to maintain his true identity and expression after a catastrophe occurs to his family business.

overview: A psychologist who, upon receiving patients suffering from mental illness, is reminded of their own past traumatic memories and decides to consult another psychologist.

Andi mengalami perundungan di sekolah oleh anak-anak VVIP yang menyebabkan Andi menjadi koma.  Hal tersebut membangkitkan kembali sisi gelap Jon Woles.

overview: Idris berbincang dengan sepupunya di hari raya setelah sekian lama. Namun perbincangan nostalgia itu mengarah pada hal yang Idris tak mau rasakan selama ini.

All the time, Nature remained silent in the place where she last saw the child and made a grave as a place to express her longing for the child. Two years later, an industrial center will be built on the land and the only person who doesn't want to sell the land is Alam. What will happen to Nature in the future? Will he sell the land or not? You can see Alam's inner battle between defending his grave or selling it because he experienced terror after terror, in the short film entitled Pajaratan Cinta.

Then, Bligus (normal vision) married Ayu, someone who had been completely blind since childhood. Their relationship embodies genuine love for each other. Lakshmi's presence colors their love journey. They present unique love from Bali.

Living in the house left behind by Jiwo’s parents, Oyin begins to be terrorized by supernatural beings. She often dreams that the child she is carrying will be struck with a pestle. The terror intensifies when Yuli, a student at the dance studio, becomes possessed by the spirit of Mbok Fatimah and drives Oyin away. Oyin herself suffers a miscarriage after being visited by the spirit of Mbok Fatimah. Jiwo, while digging into his family’s past, discovers that his mother, Rahayu, had once made a dark pact—sacrificing a fetus in exchange for wealth. With the help of Mbah Jereng, Jiwo, who is trying to break the curse, finds the grave of an unborn baby beneath the floor of his house.
